The practice of the three kāyas at the time of the path causes the mind’s abiding nature from the time of the ground to become actualized in the manner of the result. As long as the rootless state is not yet manifest, it is important to persevere in giving up busyness and meditating in isolation.
gnyis pa gegs sel ni/
b. Dispelling Obstructions

rtsa log rlung log sogs gegs sel te chos drug sogs thabs lam gyi yan lag yin pas thun mong bar song ste 'dir mi 'chad/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs bsal ba ni/ nyams kyi rtsis ma bcings pa dang / snang stong phyogs rer ma shor ba la 'bad pa ste/

Instructions to dispel obstructions, such as those of inverted channels and winds, are a branch of the Path of Methods, such as the Six Dharmas and so forth, and so they are common knowledge and will not be explained here. Here, the uncommon removal of obstructions concerns efforts to not be bound by the glue of [mere] meditative experience and not to stray into prioritizing appearance or emptiness.

de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum la zhen na gol bas/ lus sems dga' bde ci skyes dang / rig pa la dangs cha dang gsal cha ci byung dang / stong sang sang po'i mi rtog pa'i nyams ci shar la dga' zhen med bar bskyur/ nyams mthug drags pas bshig mi thub pa 'dra ba byung na mi sgom par snang ba'i steng du gang dgar bskyur la 'jog / bde gsal stong par zhig pa na gnas lugs rjen gyis 'char/

Attachment to any one of the three [meditative experiences] of bliss, clarity, and nonthought is a deviation. Therefore, whatever joy and bliss arises in body and mind, whatever aspect of radiance or clarity occurs in your awareness, and whatever experience of nonthought dawns in the bright emptiness, leave it behind without the attachment of being pleased with it. If your meditative experience becomes too thick, as if you cannot break it, don’t meditate; just let yourself go in whatever appearances you enjoy. When bliss, clarity, and emptiness disintegrate, the abiding nature arises starkly.

sems kyi snang cha dang gsal cha dang 'char sgo la bden zhen skye/ chags sdang 'dzin zhen rags su song ba'i nyams byed na/ sgyu ma lta bur mos shing btsal bas mi rnyed pa la 'jog / des de stong par 'chad/

Attachment to the reality of mind’s appearing aspect, clarity aspect, and mental perceptions arises. If this degenerates into gross fixated attachment to desire and anger, imagine that it is like an illusion and, after searching and not finding, let it go. Through that it will arise as empty.

rang sems kyi ngo bo la'ang khyad mi 'dug pas las 'bras spang blang mi dgos so snyam pa'i log lta skyes na/ las 'bras bden par med kyang kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med/ me mi bden kyang shing tshig / chu mi bden kyang gsher ba mi 'gag pa ltar (249) las 'bras la yid ches bskyed dgos so/ / de ltar nyams su blang / /

Since there are no distinctions in the essence of one’s mind, you might think that there is no need to be concerned with the results of actions. If such a wrong view develops, think about this: Although the results of action are not true, in a conventional way, the results of causes are inevitable. Fire is not true, but it burns wood. Water is not true, but that does not stop it from being wet. You must develop belief in karmic results and practice accordingly.

de la sems gsal stong 'dzin med du gnas na zhi gnas yin te/ bying rgod gnyis sel ba zhig dgos/ snang ba thams cad sems/ gnas 'gyu thams cad ngos bzung med par myong thog tu phebs na lhag mthong skyes pa yin no/ / gang shar la rang ngo shes pas bzo bcos med par skyong thub na phyag chen dngos gzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa yin no/ / sems la ci bsam/ snang ba la ci shar thams cad dran pa dang rtsol ba brten mi dgos pa thams cad rang ngo shes pa'i gsal stong rgya 'byams su song ba'i tshe/ rtsa bral zhes bya ba rjes kyi nyams myong mthar phyin pa yin no/ /

Abiding without fixation on the clarity and emptiness of mind is calm abiding. You need to dispel dullness and agitation. All appearance is mind. If you are able to directly experience it without identifying all the abiding and moving, that is the birth of higher insight. If you can maintain an uncontrived state by recognizing the nature of whatever arises, the realization of the main mahāmudrā practice is born. When whatever you think in your mind and any appearances arise, without needing to rely on mindfulness and effort, the clarity and emptiness of recognizing your own nature in everything is continuous. That is called rootlessness and is the final culmination of meditative experience.
zhes pa 'di'ang tA ra nA thas shar kong po'i yul gyi bshes gnyen mkhyen rab ces bya ba'i don du nye bar gdams pa'o/ / dge'o/ / (250) (251)
This is the direct instruction by Tāranātha for the benefit of Khyenrab, the spiritual friend from the eastern region of Kongpo.
Two Celestial Goddesses
@#/ /shangs pa'i gser chos khrid chen rnam lnga las/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi nyams len dbu ma'i mdud 'grol ces bya ba bzhugs so// //
11. Releasing the Knots of the Central Channel. A Practice of White and Red Khecarīs[1]
(252)@#/ /na mo gu ru badzra bA ra hI yai/ /
namo guru vajravārāhī yai
rgyal ba ma lus 'byung ba'i chos kyi dbyings/ / bde chen 'od 'bar phyogs kyi na bza' 'chang / / zla ba nyin byed mdangs can der btud nas/ / zab mo'i rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung bzhin 'chad/ /

In the realm of phenomena, source of every victorious one, the light of great bliss blazes, wearing local clothing, radiant as the moon and the sun: I bow to you. I explain the profound yoga according to the adept transmission.

mkhas grub kyi rgyal po khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs kyis ye shes kyi DA ki ni gu ma las mkha' spyod gnyis ka dang / grub thob nag po rA hu la las dmar mo/ dpal ldan a ti sha las dkar mo'i smin grol gdams skor rdzogs par gsan pas lugs srol de dag gi byin rlabs chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur ba'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba

The learned adept Khedrup Khyungpo Naljor received the entire cycle of maturing and liberating instructions of both of the celestial goddesses (Khecarīs) from the Awareness Ḍākinī Niguma, Red Khecarī from the black adept Rāhula, and White Khecarī from glorious Atiśa. He merged the blessings from all of those traditions into a single stream to form the basic practices.
White Khecarī

mkha' spyod dkar mo'i bskyed bzlas kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems khyad par ba chos drug ltar tshig mtha' bsgyur ba'am/ yang na spyi mthun sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon tu 'gro bas/

If you wish to practice the yogas of creation and recitation of White Khecarī, the preliminary is to go for refuge and arouse awakening mind using the special version in the Six Dharmas, but changing the last line.[2] Alternatively, repeat three times the general prayer that begins “Buddha, dharma, and supreme assembly…” (sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog…etc.) and meditate on the four immeasurables.
oM swa b+hA ba shud+d+haHsarbaHswa b+hA ba shud+d+ho‘haM/
oṃ svabhāva śuddhaḥ sarva dharmāḥ svabhāva śuddho ’haṃ

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba/ de'i dbus su hrIHyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib (253) sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ston zla ltar dkar ba la yid tsam dmar ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa 'dzum khro chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa/ dmar la bkra ba'i spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig 'phrul bas gzigs pa/ thod skam lda'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar stabs dang g.yon thod pa khrag gang phyir bstan tu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyab ngos nas phrag par bkal bas chu skyes ze'u 'bru lhag ger bzhad pa/ rked skabs phra zhing brla dang skye gnas nu 'bur mtho la bde ba rgyas pa'i sku phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ me ri dkar po rtse mo gsum pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oM dkar po/ mgrin par AHdmar po/ thugs kar hU~M sngon pos mtshan pa'o/ / rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod par gyur/ oM badzra puSh+pe nas shap+ta AHhU~M gi (254) bar gyis mchod / /

From within emptiness, I appear instantly as Cakrasaṃvara. In the space before me is a white tetrahedral source of phenomena, radiating light rays. Made of bliss, it arises as bliss. In its center is a white letter hrīḥ radiating white light rays that purify the negativities and obscurations of all sentient beings. {253} The light reabsorbs and completely transforms into Vajrayoginī. She is white as the autumn moon, beautified by a hint of red radiance. She is charming and in the prime of youth. She smiles fiercely with a passionate attitude, her eyeteeth slightly bared. Her black hair falls loosely over her back. She glares with her three bloodshot eyes roving through space. She wears a tiara of five dry skulls and a garland of fifty fresh heads. In her right hand she brandishes a flaying knife and holds a blood-filled skull cup to the side with her left hand. Her two legs bend around the side of her back and rest on her shoulders, showing the anthers of her open lotus. With a slender waist and full thighs and vulva, her body is swollen with bliss. She is adorned by the five symbolic ornaments and sits amid a bonfire with three-pointed white flames. White oṃ marks her forehead, red āḥ her throat, and blue hūṃ her heart. Offering goddesses emanated from my heart present the offerings. oṃ vajra puṣpe…(etc. to)…śabda āḥ hūṃ {254}
dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ / ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ / 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/
Praise: Glorious Vajra Ḍākinī, wheel wielder of the ḍākinīs, five awarenesses and three kāyas— homage and praise to the protector of migrators.

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes mos gus shugs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma'i gnas gsum gyi oM AHhU~M las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spyan drangs yig 'bru gsum la thim/ 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gcig la gcig 'khril ba'i tshul du byon/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud b+ha ga nas thon/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad dag / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo/ / de ltar na 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma so sor snang yang thabs shes dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ ting nge 'dzin de la yid rtse gcig tu gtad cing thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas/

Supplicate with devotion: Exalted Vajrayoginī, please grant me your blessings. Through the force of that supplication: White, red, and blue light rays radiate from the oṃ āḥ hūṃ in Vajrayoginī’s three places. They invoke white, red, and blue light rays that are the nature of the awakened body, speech, and mind of all the ten-direction buddhas and bodhisattvas. Those dissolve into the three seed syllables, from which white, red, and blue light rays emerge, coiling around one another. They travel down the length of the central channel, emerge from her bhaga, and dissolve into my three places. All obstacles of negativities, obscurations, sickness, and spirits are purified. My body, speech, and mind are in essence Vajrayoginī’s awakened body, speech, and mind. Cakrasaṃvara and Vajrayoginī appear individually and yet are essentially one in the inseparability of method and wisdom. In this meditative absorption, focus with single-pointed attention and in a state of knowing everything as illusory, recite:
oM oM oM sarba bud+d+ha DA ki nI yai badzra bar+kha nI yai badzra bai ro tsa nI yai hU~M hU~M hU~M phaT phaT phaT swA hA/ zhes 'bum phrag sum bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa ci nus bzla'o/ /
oṃ oṃ oṃ sarva buddha ḍākinīyai vajra varṇanīyai vajra vairocanīyai hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā Repeat this three million, two hundred thousand times or however much is possible.

thun 'jog pa na gong bzhin mchod bstod byas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab la 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'pho ba'i dmigs pa bsgom pa'am/ dkyus tsam la/ rje btsun ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nang bdud rtsis bde chil gyis gang / sku gsung thugs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par gyur bar mos la 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag / de las ldang ba na dge ba byang chub du bsngo/ / thun mtshams rnams su snang ba lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par lam du khyer/ zas skom ye shes kyi bdud (255) rtsir shes pas longs spyod/ 'dod yon thams cad lha sku bde ba chen por rang snang ngo / / skabs su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /

At the end of the session, repeat the offerings and praises as above. Supplicate three times with Exalted Vajrayoginī, please lead me to the pure realm of Khecara. Then meditate on the visualizations of Transference as found below, or just continue here with Vajrayoginī melts into light and dissolves into the top of my head, filling my body full with the elixir of bliss and bestowing the blessings of vajra body, speech, and mind. Rest in the equipoise of Lucid Clarity Mahāmudrā. When you arise from that, dedicate the virtue to awakening. In between all sessions, integrate on the path by regarding all appearances as the deity’s body, like illusion. {255} Enjoy food and drink with the understanding that it is the elixir of timeless awareness. All sensory pleasures are the deity’s natural appearance of great bliss. At this point, if you would like to offer torma, then follow the description below.
Body Blessing

'di la lus byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba rdzogs rim dang 'brel ba'i rjes gzhig zab mo ni/ rje btsun ma spyi bor bsgoms pa'i gsang gnas pad+ma nas byang chub kyi sems dmar po'i tshul du 'phros te byung / rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus gang bas 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar ltem ltem du song bas rgyud la bde ba khyad par can sing sing ba skyes/ de yang me long gi rlangs pa bzhin mtha' nas 'od du yal/ snying kha'i bar du bsdus/ mthar stong pa nyid kyi ngang la lhod de klod/ / rig pa dwang sing nger 'jog / slar bde mchog gam rje btsun ma'i skur ldangs/

Now, what’s called the body blessing is a profound final dissolution connected with the completion phase. While meditating on Vajrayoginī on the crown of your head, imagine red bodhicitta flows from her lotus at the secret place, enters through your cranial aperture, and fills your body to the brim with redness the nature of light. Special bliss arises joyfully (sing sing ba) in your being. Like the condensation of breath on a mirror, your body dissipates from the outer edges inward and gathers into your heart. Finally, relax within emptiness. Settle awareness in limpid radiance. Arise again in the forms of Cakrasaṃvara or Vajrayoginī.
Secret Blessing

yang gsang ba byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi nor bu'i rtse mor mkha' spyod ma dkar mo gsal btab/ 'od du dmar ltem gyis zhu rdo rje'i lam brgyud lus kyi nang mer gyis gang / nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sangs kyis dag / lus 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar ltem ltem du 'jug pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ 'dod chags la lhag par bsngags so/ /

In what’s called the secret blessing, imagine White Khecarī at the tip of your gem. She melts into reddish light and enters the passageway, completely filling up your body. The afflictive emotion of desire is cleansed and purified. Meditate as above that your body becomes the nature of light, red, full, and so forth. This is lauded as especially good for desire.
Repairing Sacred-Pledge Violations

yang 'di la brten nas dam tshig nyams chags gso ba'i thabs ni/ mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ byang chub tu sems skyed/ rang gi mdun tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bkrag mdangs zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa 'od lam mer bzhugs par mos/ dngos bsham dang yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgya cher spel te ting nge 'dzin kho na'i stobs kyis sam tshigs bcad gang yang rung bas mchod/ dad gus drag tu bsgom la gsol ba drag por btab/

The method to repair violations of sacred pledge based on that is to first arrange whatever offerings you have, go for refuge, and arouse awakening mind. Before me is a lotus and moon seat, upon which is my root guru, with a radiant body and smiling countenance, sitting within clear light. Increase the offerings, whether actually laid out or mentally emanated, and offer them through just the force of your meditative absorption or by reciting suitable verses. Meditate with fervent faith and devotion, and make fervent supplications.

mdor bsdus spyi tsam du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lda bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid gyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ / bzhes nas bdag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang ba dang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stan thog 'di nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang /
spyi (256) bshags bla ma rdor 'dzin ma lta bu'am/ khyad par rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la ma gus pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig nyams chags yid la dran pa de dang ming nas smos la bshags/

Perform the confession with standard verses such as “Guru vajra holder…” (bla ma rdo rje ’dzin pa…etc.), or else using the particular version of recalling and naming [each of] the sacred-pledge violations, such as a lack of respect for your root guru.

de nas bla ma'i smin mtshams su mkha' spyod ma dkar mo/ / de'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog / sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas de dag gi smin mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar po byung / bla ma'i spyi bor zhugs pas sku la zag med kyi bde ba skyes/ slar mkha' spyod ma'i gsang ba nas 'od zer dkar nar gyis byung / rang gi smin mtshams su zhugs/ bla ma'i sku la dam tshig chags nyams su gyur pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sang gis dag par gyur/

Then: White Khecarī is at the point between the guru’s eyebrows. White light rays radiate from her secret place, touching all the buddhas and bodhisattvas and pleasing their bodies with offerings. From between their eyebrows, white awareness elixir emerges and enters the guru’s head, arousing undissipating bliss. Again, a stream of white light rays emerges from Khecarī’s secret place and enters my midbrow point. All negative acts and obscurations, including violations related to the guru’s body, are cleansed and purified.
oM gsum ma brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/
Recite the three-oṃ mantra one hundred and eight times.
mthar mkha' spyod ma rgyangs kyis byon nas rang gi smin phrag tu thim par mos/
Finally, imagine the following: Khecarī arrives from afar and dissolves into the point between my eyebrows.
des 'gres te/
Repeat that formula:

bla ma'i mgrin par mkha' spyod ma dmar mo/ / 'od zer dmar po/ / gsung mnyes/ mgrin pa nas bdud rtsi dmar po/ / bla ma'i mgrin par zhugs/ 'od zer dmar po rang gi mgrin par/ gsung la dam tshig chags nyams/ oM gsum ma brgya rtsa/ mkha' spyod ma mgrin par thim/

Red Khecarī is at the guru’s throat. Red light rays radiate from her secret place, touching all the buddhas and bodhisattvas and pleasing their speech with offerings. From their throats, red awareness elixir emerges and enters the guru’s throat, arousing undissipating bliss. Again, a stream of red light rays emerges from Khecarī’s secret place and enters my throat. All negative acts and obscurations, including violations related to the guru’s speech, are cleansed and purified. Recite the three-oṃ mantra one hundred and eight times. Khecarī arrives from afar and dissolves into my throat.
de bzhin tu/ bla ma'i thugs kar mkha' spyod ma sngon mo dang 'od zer sngon po oM gsum mam brgya rtsa/ mthar rang gi snying gar thim/

Blue Khecarī is at the guru’s heart. Blue light rays radiate from her secret place, touching all the buddhas and bodhisattvas and pleasing their minds with offerings. From their hearts, blue awareness elixir emerges and enters the guru’s heart, arousing undissipating bliss. Again, a stream of blue light rays emerges from Khecarī’s secret place and enters my heart. All negative acts and obscurations, including violations related to the guru’s mind, are cleansed and purified. Recite the three-oṃ mantra one hundred and eight times. Khecarī arrives from afar and dissolves into my heart.

lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i dang du sing gis bzhag la yun ring du bskyang / mthar dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ / bsnyen pa tshad ldan grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas mkha' spyod kyi ril bu bsgrub pa sogs rtsa ba'i gzhung las rtogs par bya'o/ /

Rest lucidly in the mahāmudrā of the deity’s form and sustain it for a long time. Finally, dedicate the virtue to awakening. Yogins who have completed the required recitations should learn how to accomplish the Khecara [long-life] pills and other practices from the source texts.
Transference

yan lag gi rnal 'byor myur la ma 'pho ba'i gdams pa ring brgyud thun mong ba ni yig rnying ltar la/ 'dir nye brgyud thun mongs ma yin pa ltar na/ gong gi bsgom bzlas gsol 'debs bcas grub mthag par ram/ 'di nyid sger du byed na skyabs sems sngon du 'phro bas/

Instructions for the auxiliary yoga of the fast path of the Transference of Consciousness that is held in common with the long lineage are taught in the ancient texts. Here I will present the uncommon version according to the direct lineage.[3] This can follow immediately after the above meditation, recitation, and supplication. Otherwise, if it is to be done separately, first go for refuge and arouse the awakening mind.

rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lus gyi nang du rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug ltar drang (257) ba/ kha dog dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ mar sne gsang gnas dang yar sne tshangs bug tu zug pa'i spyi bor mkha' spyod dkar mo gzhon sha can yid du 'ong zhing bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pa/ cha lugs spyi dang mtshungs pa zhig gi chu skyes dang dbu ma'i yar sne 'phrad pa shin tu gsal bar bltas la/

Within your ordinary body, the central channel is as straight as an arrow. {257} Its color is white and vividly clear, the nature of light. The lower end reaches the perineum and the upper end the cranial aperture. At the crown of your head is White Khecarī, youthful, attractive, and swollen with great bliss. Her attributes are the same as usual. Her lotus and the upper end of your central channel are in contact. Focus very precisely on that.

de nas rang gi smin mtshams yan gyi thod pa 'od du zhu phyag gi b+hany+dza dang 'dres/ rang lus lte ba yan gyi gdos bcas sha khrag rnams thod pa'i nang du zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa gsol bas mnyes/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du rang gi rlung sems gcig 'dus kyi ngo bo a dkar po 'od 'bar ba yar la khang pa/ rdo rje'i rtse mor hU~M sngon po mgo gyen bstan zhig gsal gdab/ gsol ba drag tu gdab/ 'jam rlung cung zad bzung / yid kyis oM gsum ma bzla/ rgyu zhabs 'ubs kyis 'then la rlung phyir bsal ba'i tshe ti kra dang po brjod/ dmigs pa hU~M gi rlung shugs kyis lte ba'i a deng gis 'bul/ dbu ma'i nang nas skar mda' chad pa ltar rgyangs kyis song / rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs/ thugs kar sleb/ rang sems dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang stong nyid gsum dbyer med du bsres la mnyam par 'jog /

Then your skull from the eyebrows up melts into light, which blends with the [contents of] the bhañja (skull cup) in [Khecarī’s] hand. Your body from the navel up, including all corporeal matter, flesh, and blood, melts into that skull cup, becoming awareness elixir. She drinks it and is pleased. Within your central channel at the level of the navel, the essence of your vital winds integrated with your mind is the white letter A, blazing with light and ready to lift off. Visualize a blue hūṃ facing upward at the tip of your sexual organ. Fervently supplicate. Slightly hold a gentle breath. Mentally recite the three-oṃ mantra. Pull up from the bottom of the belly and clear out the breath while uttering a long sound of hik. Visualize the force of the vital winds of the hūṃ offered up to the A at the navel, which then shoots right out from inside the central channel like a shooting star. It enters Vajrayoginī’s secret place and arrives at her heart. Your mind and Vajrayoginī’s mind and emptiness—these three blend inseparably. Rest in that equipoise.

yang a dang hU~M gsal gdab pa sogs dmigs pa de nyid lan bdun tsam bskyar/ de nas rang sems dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dbyer med pa bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa gsang ba'i sgo nas byon/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo bzhi gang / dbang bzhi thob/ /

Again, visualize the A and the hūṃ and so forth as before, repeating that visualization seven times. Then your mind and Vajrayoginī’s blessings inseparable become white elixir with a reddish tinge. It emerges from her secret opening, enters through the crown of your head, and fills the four chakras. You receive the four empowerments.
mthar lus thams cad byang sems kyis gang bas nyams bde bas khyab pa la mnyam par bzhag /
In the end, your entire body is filled with bodhicitta and you experience pervasive bliss. Rest in equipoise.

de thun chung gcig yin/ slar rtsa dbu ma gsal 'debs pa nas bskyar te thun re la de 'dra tshar grangs gang 'gro bskyar te sbyang / / 'phro 'jog pa na rje btsun ma'ang 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim/ tshangs bug gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram haM yig dang bcas pas bkag par mos/

All of that is one short session. Repeat it again from the visualization of the central channel, and keep training as many times as works in each session. When your interest wanes, Vajrayoginī melts into light and dissolves into your head. Think that your cranial aperture is blocked by a golden vajra cross marked with the letter haṃ.

dmigs pa bsdu na gsol 'debs kyi rjes su hi ka zhes lte ba'i dbu ma nas a yig 'bar/ rje btsun ma'i gsang bar zhugs/ thugs kar sleb/ mkha' spyod du 'phur/ slar byon/ a (258) yig ka zhes slar lte ba'i dbu mar bab/ de ltar lan grangs bskyar/ mthar a bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu/ rang lus sngar bzhin gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar a brjid dang ldan pa'i ngo bor gyur/ tshangs bug bkag / mkha' spyod ma gshegs pa'ang lugs gcig ste/ de ltar rtags ma thon bar du sbyang /

For a shorter visualization, say hik after the supplication, making the A letter lift off from the navel in the central channel. It enters Vajrayoginī’s secret place and arrives at her heart. She flies to Khecara, then returns. {258} By uttering ka, the A letter again falls to the navel in the central channel. Repeat this a number of times. Finally, the A melts into the form of elixir and, with your body visualized as before, enters your cranial aperture and becomes the essence of heavy A at your navel. Block the cranial aperture. [The practice that includes] the departure of Khecarī constitutes one style. Train in this way until you produce signs [of success].

rang nyid 'chi khar las la sbyar ba'am/ shi ba'i 'pho ba gzhan la 'debs na rnam shes phyir mi 'bebs par rtags ma thon par bskyar nas sbar/ mthar rje btsun ma'ang mkha' dbyings je mthor gshegs par mos la spros bral gyi rang ngo bskyang bar bya'o/ / rje btsun ma 'di la yi dam ma chags par byas shing yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang gsol 'debs la 'bungs na mkha' spyod du 'gro ba la the tshom med ces gsungs so/ /

If you utilize them yourself when dying or apply them for another dying being, the consciousness does not come back down. Raise it up repeatedly until the signs appear. In the end, imagine that Vajrayoginī departs higher and higher into the sky’s realm and then maintain unembellished recognition of your nature. It is said that if you practice this Exalted [White Khecarī] as a yidam without interruption, diligently doing the offerings and supplications on the tenth days of the waxing and waning moon, you need have no doubt that you will go to the celestial realm of Khecara.
Red Khecarī
yang mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par spro na/ bskyed bzlas kyi rim pa la thog mar skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ /
If you wish to practice the yoga of Red Khecarī, the sequence of creation and recitation is preceded by going for refuge and arousing the awakening mind. Then:
oM swa b+hA ba sogs/
oṃ svabhāva…(etc.)

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes 'od lnga 'phro bar gsal ba'i mdun tu chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ bde stong du 'char zhing rgyu ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i gdan/ de yi steng du baM yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma li khri'i mdangs can/ dmar zhing bkra ba'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs cing khro gnyer yid tsam bsdus pa gtums pa'i nyams can/ gzhon nu ma lang tshol babs pa rked skabs phra zhing brla dang skye gnas nu 'bur mtho la rgyas pa/ gcer bu dbu skra sil bur grol bas sku stod khebs shing mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mthur du bsnun cing g.yon thod khrag steng du bzung ba la zhal ras phyogs pas bde ba'i rgyun gsol ba/ gru mo g.yon par thabs kyi rang bzhin kha T+wA~M` ga dkar po 'chang ba/ thod skam lda'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ zhabs g.yas pa rgyangs pas mi ro'i snying gar brdzis shing g.yon phrag bar bgal (259) ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/

From within emptiness, I appear as Coemergent Cakrasaṃvara radiating five-colored lights. Before me is a double-stacked source of phenomena, white on the outside and red on the inside. It arises as bliss-emptiness. In its center is a seat of a lotus, sun, and human corpse. In its center, the red letter vaṃ completely transforms into Vajrayoginī, with a complexion of vermilion. Her three bloodshot eyes glance around. She bares her fangs and slightly grimaces wrathfully with a fierce expression. She is in the prime of youth, with a slender waist and full thighs, vulva, and breasts. She is naked with her hair loose and flowing over her back, beautiful and attractive. In her right hand she holds a vajra pointing down and with her left a blood-filled skull cup held high as she turns to drink from its stream of bliss. In the crook of her left arm is a white khaṭvāṅga, the nature of methods. She is adorned by a tiara of five dry skulls, a garland of fifty fresh skulls, and the five symbolic bone ornaments. Her right leg is extended, pressing on the heart of the human corpse. Her left leg rests behind her shoulder. {259} She stands in the midst of a blazing fire of timeless awareness.

spro na/ oM badzra puSh+pe sogs kyis mchod/ / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / sogs kyis bstod/ mchod bstod ma byas kyang chog / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rang gi lte ba'i a thung gi 'od zer chos 'byung la phog / bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ rje btsun ma'i gsang ba'i chu skyes las 'od zer 'phros/ rang la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ zhes mos la oM gsum ma bzla/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe mchod bstod gsol 'debs dang / mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa/ dge bsngo/ thun mtshams rnal 'byor sogs mkha' spyod dkar mo'i skabs bzhin bya/

If you wish, make offerings with oṃ vajra puṣpe…(etc.) and offer praises with “Glorious Vajra Ḍākinī…(etc.).” It is also acceptable to skip the offerings and praises. Then supplicate: Exalted Vajrayoginī, please grant your blessings. Light rays from the short A in my navel strike the source of phenomena. All habitual tendencies are purified. Light rays radiate from Exalted Vajrayoginī’s secret lotus. They strike me, purifying all negativities and obscurations. Visualize that and recite the three-oṃ mantra. At the end of the session, recite the offerings, praises, and supplication. The yoginī visualized in front melts into light and dissolves into you. Dedicate the virtue. For the yoga of session breaks, follow the procedure in the White Khecarī.
The Uncommon Completion Phase

'di'i rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i stong ra legs par gsal ba'i lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba'i ze'u 'bru la mar me sor bzhi pa gsal gdab/ lus gnad rlung bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan spyi mthun la lta stangs sna rtser dbab/ rlung gtong khar mid pa'i sbyor ba byed la gtum mo'i bde drod sbar/ de sgyu ma'i nyams dang bsres pas sgyu lus rang shar 'byung / de mgrin par bzhag pas rmi lam/ snying khar 'od gsal/ gsang gnas su bzhag nas thur sel dbang du byed/ dbang du gyur na las rgya dang ye rgya'i gtum mo bsgom/ de nas dkar mo'i skabs su bstan pa ltar rjes gzhig gi 'od gsal bsgoms pas bde stong zung 'jug mthar thug gi 'od gsal 'grub par gsungs te rA hu la dang a ti sha'i dgongs pa'o/ /

Very clearly visualize yourself as Vajrayoginī with the empty internal space. At your navel is a red eight-petaled lotus radiating light rays of five colors. Imagine that the stamens are candle lights, four finger-widths high. The vital point of the body is to hold the vase breath with its four applications as usual and to let your gaze fall to the tip of your nose. When you are about to lose [holding the breath], apply [methods to prolong it such as] swallowing, causing the bliss-warmth of inner heat to blaze. Blend this with the experience of illusion to naturally raise the illusory body. Placing [the attention] in the throat induces lucid dreams; at the heart, lucid clarity; and at the secret place, gains control of the downward-clearing [vital winds]. When you control them, meditate on the inner heat in karmamudrā and jñānamudrā. Then it is said that meditation on lucid clarity of the final dissolution, as described in the context of White Khecarī, will bring the accomplishment of the ultimate lucid clarity of unified bliss and emptiness. This is the enlightened view of Rāhula and Atiśa.
Transference

'di'i 'pho ba bsgom na/ mngal gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung sngon po'i nang du rang sems hU~M mthing kha las 'od zer 'phros/ mngal gyi sgrib pa dang skye gnas kyi bag chags sbyangs/ hU~M yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od zer lnga 'phro bar bsgom/

When you meditate on Transference in this, [imagine] a blue source of phenomena that is the nature of a womb, and within it your own mind as a deep-blue hūṃ radiating light rays. The obscurations of the womb and the habitual tendencies toward that birthplace are purified. The hūṃ completely transforms into yourself as the sole hero Cakrasaṃvara. Meditate on the appearance without intrinsic nature, radiating five-colored light rays.

gong gi bskyed bzlas dang sprel na mchod bstod gsol 'debs grub pa dang mdun gyi rje btsun ma rang gi spyi bor byon par mos/ sger du byed na sems bskyed (260) sngon tu 'gro bas rang bde mchog gi spyi bor rje btsun ma skad cig gis gsal/ sngar ltar rang gi dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du zhabs bzhag / gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba lta bu tshangs bug tu sprad/ rang gi lte bar rlung sems kyi ngo bo a dkar po 'phur la khad pa nang rlung gis yam yam bskyod bzhin pa des gyen tu bltas pas tshangs bug skya ha re ba de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas mthong bas der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/

If this is done in connection with the above creation phase and recitation, do the offerings, praises, and supplication, and imagine that Vajrayoginī comes to the top of your head. {260} If it is done separately, precede it with going for refuge and arousing the awakening mind, and then visualize that Vajrayoginī appears instantly above your, Cakrasaṃvara’s, head. As before, her two legs rest on your shoulders. Her vulva, like an open red lotus, touches your cranial aperture. At your navel, the essence of your wind-mind is a white A ready to ascend, trembling as if buffeted by wind. It looks up and sees, through the clear opening of the cranial aperture, Vajrayoginī’s secret place. With the intense yearning to go there, supplicate three times.

thugs ka nas ba thag lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po nar gyis byung / lte ba'i a la reg pas khab len dang lcags 'phrad pa ltar thag gis 'then te tshangs bu ga nas thon/ b+ha gar zhugs/ thugs kar sleb pa dang tog sgra dang bcas rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' la yer gyis byon/ je mthor song nas mkha' spyod du pheb pa dang 'ja' ltar yal bar bsam la rig pa blo bral du 'jog / yang nam mkha' las sprin brdol ba ltar rnal 'byor ma lam gyis byon te sngar bzhin rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i dpung pa gnyis la zhabs bzhag ste bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas rang sems a yig chad de lte bar sleb pa des gyen tu lta ba sogs bskyar/ 'di'i skabs su 'jam rlung bzung ba gnad du che zhing spyi ltar hi kra ngag gam yid kyis bgrang yang chog go /

A white light ray, like a spider’s silk, wends its way from her heart and reaches the A at your navel. Like a magnet meeting iron, the string pulls it up through the cranial aperture and into her bhaga. It reaches her heart with a snapping sound. Yoginī quickly ascends into the sky, going higher and higher, and arrives at Khecara, where she disappears like a rainbow. Rest in awareness without thought. Like clouds forming in the sky, Yoginī reappears and arrives back, again placing her two feet on your, Cakrasaṃvara’s, shoulders. As she sits there, your mind as the letter A breaks off from her heart and descends to your navel, where it again looks upward, and so forth. Repeat the process. During this time, it is crucial to hold the gentle breathing. You can say hik [and ka] audibly or mentally.

thun mthar a lte bar phab ba'i rjes su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pa tsam mam/ de'i pad+ma nas byang sems dkar dmar bde khri li li babs/ rang lus 'khor lo bzhi gang / dbang bzhi thob/ zag pa med pa'i bde pas khyab/ rje btsun ma spyi bo nas lte bar byon/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skyes par mos la mnyam par bzhag / mthar tshangs bug sra mkhregs rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu mos/ las sbyor ni dkar mo dang 'dra'o/ /

At the end of the session, the A falls to your navel. After that, Vajrayoginī melts into light and dissolves into the crown of your head. Alternatively, [visualize that] pink bodhicitta flows from her lotus and fills the four chakras of your body. You obtain the four empowerments and are pervaded by undissipating bliss. Vajrayoginī comes through your cranial aperture and arrives at your navel. Imagine that the timeless awareness of nondual bliss and emptiness is born. Rest in equipoise. Finally, imagine that your cranial aperture becomes solid, the nature of vajra. The working application [at the time of death] is the same as in White Khecarī.
White and Red Khecarīs
Torma Offering
mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis ka la thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ bza' btung sna tshogs kyi gtor ma lag mthil g.yon par bzhag / g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung la bsang sbyang /

If you wish to offer tormas in the session breaks to both White Khecarī and Red Khecarī, first place a torma of various food and drink in the palm of your left hand. Join the right thumb and ring finger, and cleanse and purify.

stong ba'i ngang las a dkar po las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hU~M b+h+rUM oM dzriM khaM rnams (261) kyis mtshan pa'i sha lda dang bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang bar gyur/ /

From within emptiness, a white letter A becomes a vast and wide skull cup, white on the outside and red on the inside. {261} It is completely filled inside with the five meats marked by hūṃ - bhrūṃ - oṃ - jriṃ - khaṃ and the five elixirs.
oM AHhU~M/ lan gsum/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsir gyur/
oṃ āḥ hūṃ (repeat three times)—it becomes the elixir of sacred pledge.
oM A:hU~M/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/
oṃ āḥ hūṃ (repeat three times)—it becomes a vast ocean of elixir of timeless awareness.

mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun mkha' spyod ma la 'khor ye shes kyi DA ki ma dpag tu med pas bskor nas byon par gyur/ pheM/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bas zag pa med pa'i bde bas dgyes par gyur/

Exalted Khecarīs appear before me surrounded by an immeasurable entourage of awareness ḍākinīs. pheṃ! Deities and retinues extend their tongues of light-ray straws to drink it and are delighted by undissipating bliss.

oM gsum ma la 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ Ar+g+haM sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs phrin bcol spyi ltar bya/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas nas/

Repeat three times the three-oṃ mantra with the added three seed syllables to offer the torma. Then offer with arghaṃ…(etc.), praise with “Glorious Vajra Ḍākinī…(etc.),” and request awakened activity with “Accept this torma I offer to you…(mchod sbyin gtor ma ’di bzhes la)…(etc.). Repeat the hundred syllables and supplicate for forbearance. Then:
rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/
Exalted ones with their entourages melt into light and dissolve into me.
spro na phrin bcol gyi rjes su chos skyong spyi gtor yang bya/ gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs/ !
After the request for awakened activity, if you wish, you can also offer general tormas to the dharma protectors. Take the tormas to a clean place.
Hand Offering

tshes bcu'i mchod pa sogs kyi sngon tu lag mchod spro na/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin brlab/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga par gsal/ nang mchod thig le dbus dang 'dab ma rnams la g.yon bskor du bkod de/

If you wish to do the hand offering before other rituals, such as the tenth-day offerings, consecrate the inner offering as in the torma ritual [above]. A five-petaled lotus appears on the palm of my left hand. Place a drop of the inner offering in its center and on the four petals in a counterclockwise order.
oM baM/ haM yaM/ hriM maM/ hriM hriM/ hU~M hU~M/ phaT phaT/
oṃ vaṃ / haṃ yaṃ / hriṃ maṃ / hriṃ hriṃ / hūṃ hūṃ / phaṭ phaṭ

yig 'bru de rnams yongs su gyur ba las go cha'i dpa' mo drug gi skur gyur/ oM badzra puSh+pe sogs dang / 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ lag pa'i 'byung ba lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin tu byin gyis brlabs/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas lag par thim/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar ram/ oM badzra s+pha ra Na khaM/ zhes pa tsam gyis yid kyis byin brlab/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mkhrigs mar chos 'byung sogs lha bskyed/ oM badzra yo gI nI ar+g+haM pra tI ts+tsha swA hA/ / badzra puSh+pe AHhU~M sogs kyis phyi mchod dang / 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang khyad (262) par du dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ dpral mtshams 'khyud rgya bcings te/

Those seed syllables completely transform into the forms of the six armor heroines. Offer with oṃ vajra puṣpe…(etc.) and the inner offering with the three syllables. The five elements of my hand are consecrated as the nature of the five families. All the deities dissolve into my hand. Do the consecration of offerings as usual, or just say oṃ vajra spharaṇa khaṃ to mentally consecrate them. Create the deity visualization with “On the wrist of my left hand is a source of phenomena…(etc.).”[4] Present the outer offerings with oṃ vajra yoginī arghaṃ pratīccha svāhā…pādyaṃ…oṃ vajra puṣpe āḥ hūṃ…(etc.). Present the inner offering with the three syllables. Recite the eight-line praises that appear below. Supplicate to accomplish your wishes: Exalted Vajrayoginī, please grant me all supreme and common spiritual powers without exception. {262} Especially, please guide me to the celestial realm of Khecara. Do the hundred syllables and the request for forbearance. Make the mudra of embrace at the forehead and say:
oM yo ga shud+d+haHsarba d+harma yo ga shud+d+ho‘haM/
oṃ yoga śuddhaḥ sarva dharmāḥ yoga śuddho ’haṃ
lha 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ /
The deity melts into light and dissolves into me.
Alcohol Offering

lugs 'di'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i chang mchod dam phyag mchod dam grib kun sel ni/ ka pA la mtshan ldan chang gis bkang / rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ oM brjod bzhin tu srin lag g.yon pas dkar mo la chos 'byung rkyang pa/ dmar mo la nyis rim g.yon tu 'bri tshul bya/ thod pa chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du chang thams cad sngags kyi yig 'brur dkar dkar mos dmar sgyur/ hram me gsal ba'i steng du hrI yig dkar po sogs dang /

For this tradition’s uncommon alcohol offering or hand offering or removal of all defilement, fill a qualified kapāla with alcohol. Instantly I become Exalted Vajrayoginī. Say the three-oṃ mantra while tracing a source of phenomena with your left ring finger [on your right palm in the case of] White Goddess and a two-tiered one on your left palm for Red Goddess. The skull cup becomes a source of phenomena as a celestial palace. Inside it, all the alcohol becomes the mantra’s bright white seed syllables[5] with the white letter hrīḥ above them [radiating white light rays]…(etc.).
dmar mo la/ baM yig dmar po sogs bskyed chog mchod bstod kyi bar du bya/ oM gsum ma'i sngags 'bru rnams la do shal reg ge bzhugs par mos la reg tu btubs pa lta bur gsal gdab/

For Red Khecarī, substitute “red” for “white” and “red letter vaṃ,” etc. Continue with the creation-phase ritual [of either deity] up through the offerings and praises. Imagine that the three-oṃ mantra syllables are touching [each other] like in a necklace and visualize them as if they could be touched.
sku lus dang sngags 'bru las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin byon/ khyad par b+ha ga nas rang byung byang sems pa de khri li babs pas thod pa khengs par bsam la bzlas pa ci nus bya/

The goddess’s body and the mantra’s syllables emit light rays the nature of elixir. In particular, naturally occurring bodhicitta falls blissfully from her bhaga and fills the skull cup. Visualize that and do the recitation as much as you can.
mthar/ lha dang sngags bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu zhu nas thod pa khengs par gyur/
Afterward: The deity and the mantra melt into the nature of elixir, filling the skull cup.
oM gsum ma so sor brjod la 'don bsgom dang mthun pa'i thigs gtor bya bzhin tu/
As you repeat each mantra, sprinkle drops in conjunction with the meditation chant. Then:

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mnyes nas sku gsung thugs zag pa med pa'i bde bas dgyes par gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum du rje btsun ma sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa sib sib thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa sang sang dag par gyur/ gnas khang rje btsun mas mer gyis khengs nas sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri sgrog par gyur/

All the gurus, yidams, ḍākinīs, and dharma protectors are pleased and delighted by this undissipating bliss in their body, speech, and mind. Innumerable small thick-limbed bodies of Vajrayoginī dissolve into my own three places. Sickness, spirits, negativities, obscurations, defilements, and all things unclean are cleansed and purified. The dwelling place is utterly filled with [forms of the] Exalted One and reverberates with the natural humming sound of the mantras.
rang nyid lha sku sgyu ma lta bur lhag par gsal bas rol pas/
Partake of [the elixir] with an especially vivid visualization of yourself in the deity’s form, like an illusion. {263}
sku gsung thugs kyi dam (263) tshig chags nyams dang las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag / bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par mos/ /

All violations of sacred pledge of body, speech, and mind, and all bad karma, negative acts, and obscuration are cleansed and purified. The timeless awareness of coemergent bliss and emptiness arises.

de ltar nyams su blangs pas yi dam gyi zhal myur du mthong zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur gsungs so/ / chad mchod de nyid tshogs gtor sogs la 'thor zhing rang la khrus kyang bya/ dam med kyis ma mthong bar gsang ba gal che/ gzhan gyi grib sel bya tshul ni 'gro mgon ston pa'i gsung las shes so/ /

It is taught that by such practice you will quickly see the yidam and realize coemergent bliss-emptiness. You may sprinkle this alcohol offering on feasts, tormas, and even use it to wash yourself. It is important to keep it secret, out of sight of those who lack sacred pledge. You can learn other methods of removing defilements from the teachings of Drogön [Sangye] Tönpa.[6]
yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdor bsdus pa ni/
Brief Offering for the Tenth Days of the Waxing and Waning Moon[7]

stegs bu gtsang ma ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa'i steng du/ dkar mo la dkyil 'khor chos 'byung dkar po me ri dkar pos bskor ba'i dbus su thig le'am tshom bu dkar po gcig bkod/ de steng khi'ur me long la sum+b+ha ni brjod bzhin tu chang gis byugs shing sin+d+hU ra brdal bar gser gyi smyu gu lag g.yon par thogs te snying po bzla bzhin pas rdo rje chos 'byung gi dbus su oM gsum ma phreng du bris te bkod/

Smear a clean platform with the five cow products.[8] For White Khecarī, arrange upon that the mandala of a white source of phenomena surrounded by a white circle of fire, with a white sphere or heap in the center. On top of that, place a mirror suitable for inscribing and as you say sumbha ni…(etc.), smear it with alcohol and vermilion power. Take a gold-nibbed pen in your left hand and as you recite the essence mantra, write the three-oṃ mantra string within the center of the vajra source of phenomena.

dmar mo la gzhan ngo dang 'dra ba las dkyil 'khor chos 'byung dmar po gnyis brtsegs kyi mthar be bA dkar po nyis rim du bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod/ me long chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs dbus suM baM la oM gsum mas bskor ba'i mtha' mar AHyig bdun/ zur drug la go cha'i sngags/ logs drug tu dga' ba 'khyil ba drug bri/ steng du me tog gi tshom bu bdun bkod/

The process is the same for Red Khecarī except for the following: the mandala is a red double-stacked source of phenomena,[9] outlined by a double white border (re kha) around the edges and a vajra in the middle. Arrange five heaps of flowers on that. In the center of the mirror and double-stacked source of phenomena, vaṃ[10] is encircled by the three-oṃ mantra. Draw seven āḥ letters around the edges of that, the armor mantras in the six corners, and [six] joy swirls by the six [outer concave] sides. Upon that, place seven piles of flowers.

gnyis ka la dkyil 'khor ras bris byas nas rgyun tu 'chang bstabs bde la/ me long 'bri spyad gser smyug sogs kyang ma 'byor na der mos pa tsam gyis 'thus/ dkyil 'khor ras bris rdul tshon gang yang mi 'byor ba'i skabs su ni maN+Dal la lag mchod chang gis mtshon byed bris te 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas chog go / gang ltar de'i mdun tu kha zas bzang dgu las byas pa'i gtor ma/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs mchod pa gang 'byor g.yon bskor chos 'byung gi tshul du bkod/ g.yas su tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor/ g.yon tu chos skyong dang spyi gtor gnyis bsham/ (264) rang gi mdun tu nang mchod sngon gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'du byas la/ sngon gtor sum+b+ha nis bsang / swa b+h+wa ba sa sbyang / oM AHhU~M ha hoHhrIHsa byin brlab/

In both cases, the best method is to draw the mandalas on cloth and always keep them. If you don’t happen to have a gold-nibbed pen and other implements, you can gather them just in imagination. On occasions where you have neither a drawn nor a powder mandala, it is sufficient to draw, with alcohol, a mandala on your hand and place piles of grain. In any case, put a torma of many excellent ingredients before the mandala and arrange the two water offerings, sense offerings, and any other offerings in a counterclockwise order in the shape of a source of phenomena. Put the feast articles to the right and the dharma-protector torma and general tormas to the left. Arrange the inner offerings, preliminary torma and whatever other requisite articles in front of you. {264} Cleanse the preliminary torma with sumbha ni…(etc.) and purify with svabhāva…(etc.). Consecrate it with oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha hoḥ hrīḥ.
pheM/ badzra A ra l+li hoHdzaHhU~M baM hoHbadzra DA ki nI sa ma ya s+t+waM dr-i sh+ya hoH zhes mgron 'gugs/
Invoke the guests: pheṃ vajra āralli hoḥ / jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ / vajra ḍākinī samayastvaṃ dṛśya hoḥ
oM kha kha khA hi sogs lan gsum/
Offer with oṃ kha kha khāhi…(etc. three times) and arghaṃ…(etc. through)…śabda.

ar+g+haM nas shab+da'i bar/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ / gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ / gsang spyod don du gtor ma 'di/ / 'bul gyis yang dge bzhes nas kyang / / rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs phrin las bcol/
Request activity: Whoever lives in this place— gods, nāgas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, or others— I offer this torma for the secret activity. Genuinely accept it and may we yogins and our retinues…(etc.).
sum+b+ha nis bgegs bskrad/ gnas yo bsang sbyang /
With sumbha ni…(etc.), expel obstructors and cleanse and purify the place and articles.

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ b+h+rUM las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oM AHhU~M las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod pa'i sprin phung zag med kyi bde ba skyed par byed pa yul dus chad pa med par nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gang bar gyur/

From within emptiness, hūṃ produces a protection circle. Within it, a celestial palace with completely perfect characteristics arises from bhrūṃ. Inside that, oṃ āḥ hūṃ produces cloudbanks of vajra offerings that generate undissipating bliss, filling the bounds of space, continually in time and place.
oM badzra ar+g+haM swA hA/ pA d+yaM oM badzra puSh+pe AHhU~M/ nas shab+da'i bar/ oM sarba bid pU ra pU ra/ su ra su ra/ A brta ya A brta ya ho/ oM badzra s+pha ra Na khaM/ zhes byin brlab/
oṃ vajra arghaṃ svāhā /…pādyaṃ…oṃ vajra puṣpe āḥ hūṃ / (etc. to)…śabda Consecrate by saying: oṃ sarva vida pūra pūra / sura sura / āvartaya āvartaya hoḥ / oṃ vajra spharaṇa khaṃ
de nas rgyas par spro na rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus sam/ bde mchog bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang gi bar du bya/ bsdu na/

Then, if you wish to do an extended ritual, follow the Principal Deities of the Five Tantras or the Five-Deity Cakrasaṃvara from the self-creation through the recitation, dissolution, and rearising of the deity. Or, in brief:
skad cig gis rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur/
Instantly I become the form of Glorious Coemergent Cakrasaṃvara.
yig bdun brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ gong smos lag mchod dang chang mchod bya/ mdun gyi maN+Dal bsang sbyang /
Repeat the seven syllables one hundred times. Do the hand offering and alcohol offering described above. Cleanse and purify the mandala in front.
stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha' chos 'byung sogs nas lha bskyed dang / dkar mo la gnas gsum byin rlabs bar/
From within emptiness, in the space before me is a white, tetrahedral source of phenomena…(etc.). Continue with the self-visualization of White Khecarī through to the blessing of her three places.
thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ o rgyan gyi gnas dang mkha' spyod rdo rje'i grong khyer chen po nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs badzra sa mA dzaH/
Light rays radiate from her heart and invoke Vajrayoginī and her entourage from the lands of Oḍḍiyāna and the great city of Khecara—vajra samājaḥ.
'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing /
Circle with the blazing mudra at your forehead.

pheM/ chos sku spros bral dag pa las/ / longs sku sgyu ma'i tshul ston pa/ / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma/ / phyag rgya chen (265) po'i dbyings nas bzhengs/ / sems can don la dgongs mdzod la/ / skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol/ / oM badzra A ra l+li hoH sogs/

pheṃ From the pure, unembellished dharmakāya, saṃbhogakāya displays in the way of illusion. Vajrayoginī, with your host of ḍākinīs, arise from the basic space of mahāmudrā. {265} With your intention for beings’ benefit, please come here this instant. oṃ vajra āralli hoḥ…(etc.).

rje btsun mkha' spyod ma la ye shes kyi DA ki sde lnga sogs rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor bye ba rdul snyed kyis bskor ba/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ bar na yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ 'og tu myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs chos skyong dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par bzhugs par gyur/ dzaHhU~M baM hoH gong ltar mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ dmigs gnad bcas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slar mchod pa kha bsos la byin brlab/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ / sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag / mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ / ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /

Exalted Khecarī is surrounded by a host of the four ḍākinīs and others, such as the five classes of awareness ḍākinīs, as numerous as atoms. Above her are the root and lineage gurus, around her the host of yidam deities, and below her the Swift-Acting Awareness Protector and other dharma protectors and guards, as vast as an ocean. They are invoked and become indivisible with the deities visualized before me—jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ. Make offerings, praises, and supplications as above. With the vital points of the visualization, do a bit of the mantra recitation. Again refresh the offerings and consecrate them: These supreme waters of mantra, pure and flawless and pleasing, I offer to you with good faith please accept whatever you like.
oM shrI badzra yo gi nI sa pA ri bA ra ar+g+haM pra trIts+tsha hU~M swA huM/
oṃ śrī vajrayoginī sapārivāra arghaṃ pratīccha hūṃ svāhā
de bzhin tu yon chab dang ar+g+haM gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil dang ma sbyar/
Repeat this, replacing “water” and “arghaṃ” with “washing water” and “pādyaṃ.”
me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang / / dri chab zhal zas rol mo rnams/ / bdag gis dad pas khyed la 'bul/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/
Flowers, incense, light, perfume, food, and music, I offer to you with good faith: please accept it and be pleased with me.
sngags gong ltar la/ badzra :puSh+pe nas shab+da AHhU~M/ spro na/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog sogs tshang bar brjod/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs kyis gos zung 'bul/

To the above mantra, [substitute] vajra puṣpe through śabda āḥ hūṃ. Then if you like, you may recite the full offerings, beginning with “The flower of genuine joy…(etc.)” and the offering of fabric with “…soft and light…”[11]
rang gi snying ga nas a A i I u U r-i r-I l-i l-I e ai o au aM aHrnams spros pa las mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang bar gyur/
From my heart radiates a ā / i ī / u ū / ṛi ṛī / ḷi ḷī / e ai / o au / aṃ aḥ. The syllables completely transform into the sixteen offering goddesses that emanate out, filling the sky.
oM bI Ni badzri NI huM hU~M phaT/
oṃ vīṇe vajrī huṃ hūṃ phaṭ

de bzhin tu/ baM she/ mr-i daM ge/ mu ra dze/ hA s+ya/ lA s+ya/ gI tI/ nr-i tI/ puSh+pe/ d+hU pe/ A lo ke gan+d+he/ rU pa/ ra sa/ spar+she/ d+harma d+hA tu badzri NI/ zhes sbyar bas rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/
Likewise replace with vaṃśe…mṛdaṃge…muraje…hāsye…lāsye…gīti…nṛtī…puṣpe…dhūpe…āloke…gandhe…rūpa…rasa…sparśe…dharmadhātu vajrī ṇī These are the offerings made by the sixteen awareness goddesses.
phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro/ / reg bya khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa/ / mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na/ / bzhes nas bla (266) med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /
Whatever is excellent throughout time and space— form, sound, smell, taste, and texture— when I offer with devotion to you, Exalted One, please accept it and grant the highest supreme powers. {266}
sngags mthar/ rU pa shab+da gan+d+he ra sa spar+she pra tI ts+tsha swA hA/ /
oṃ śrī vajrayoginī saparivara rūpa śabda gandhe rasa sparśe pratīccha svāhā
zhing 'dir rin chen sna bdun gyis/ / mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ / dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ / nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/
The skilled completely fill this realm with the seven precious possessions; the wise offer them daily for the sake of their desired spiritual powers.
sap+ta ma hA rat+na/
oṃ śrī vajrayoginī saparivara śabda mahāratna āḥ hūṃ
nang mchod byin brlabs la thigs gtor 'bul zhing / oM gsum ma la 'bru gsum btags pa dang / /
Consecrate the inner offering and offer it by flicking drops. Add the three syllables to the three-oṃ mantra and recite:
rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun mkha' spyod ma/ / rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Venerable Khecarī, mother of all victors, and five-family ḍākinīs—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
rdo rje 'chang sogs nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Vajradhara and others filling space, root and lineage gurus—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
'khor lo sdom pa la sogs yi dam lha/ / bar snang khyab pa'i zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Cakrasaṃvara and others, the yidam deities, pervading the interspaces—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
ma mgon lcam dral dam can chos skyong ba/ / sa gzhi khyab pa'i zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Protector sister and brother, oath-bound dharma protectors, covering the ground—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
skye bzhi lam rgyud lngas bsdus sems can kun/ / rnal 'byor mar gsal zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
All beings from four modes of birth in five states, imagined as Yoginī—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang /
Taste the elixir [while saying] the three syllables.
oM sarba ta thA ga ta a nu rA ga Na badzra swA b+hA ba Ad+ma ko‘haM/ /
oṃ sarva tathāgata anurāgaṇa vajra svabhāva ātmako ’haṃ
'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ / srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ / bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ / 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /
Here there is no beginning, middle, or end. No existence and no transcendence of it. No self and also no other. This is supreme great bliss itself.
ces pa'i don la mnyam bar bzhag pa rnams kyis mchod/ mchod phreng rgyas par spro na rigs mthun gzhan nas blang bar byas/ / de nas bstod pa rkang brgyad ni/ rol mo dang cang te'u'i sgrar sbyar bas/ /

Rest in equipoise with that thought to complete the offerings. If you are interested in a longer series of offerings, take them from other similar sources. Then do the eight-line praise, adding the sounds of cymbals and drums.

oM bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni/ / gzhan gyis mi thub 'jig rten gsum yum rig ma ste/ / dbang phyug 'byung po'i 'jigs pa kun sel rdo rje che/ / rdo rje'i gdan ma mi pham dbang mdzad gzhan mi rgyal/ / spyan 'phrul dug skem drag mo khro mo mche gtsigs ma/ / skrag byed gsod byed 'joms byed rnam rgyal gzhan las rgyal/ / rmugs byed rmongs byed rengs byed rdo rje phag mo ni/ / rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang mo mkha' 'gror 'dud/ /

oṃ Bhagavatī Vajravārāhī, Exalted One, invincible mother of the three worlds, awareness goddess, sovereign who dispels fears of spirits, great vajra, undefeated power on the Vajra Seat, undefeated by others, magic eyes that desiccate poison, fierce one, wrathful one, barer of fangs, terrifying, killing, destroying, totally victorious over others, Vajravārāhī, you stun, stupefy, and paralyze, I bow to great Yoginī, sovereign of desire, ḍākinī.
hU~M hU~M phaT/ zhes dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ (267) sogs sh+lo ka gcig /
ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / kun tu rtog pa'i 'chings gcod cing / / 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma/ / de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/
Vajra Ḍākinīs, however many there are, who cut the bonds of concepts, and fully enter worldly activity: I bow and praise all of you.
lte ba'i dbus gnas 'byung bzhi 'phro/ / chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan/ / mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma/ / rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Four elements radiate from the navel center with dharmakāya and saṃbhogakāya. She who gathers the ḍākinīs, Exalted One, I bow and praise you.
zhes pa tsam mam/ nus shing spro na jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod dkar mo'i bstod pa sogs gnyis/ dmar mo'i bstod pa gzhan dag nas 'byung ba ci rigs pas bstod/

Do just this much, or if you are able and willing, recite any appropriate praises, such as the two kinds of praises to White Khecarī by Jowo Je [Atiśa] or praises to the Red Khecarī from other sources.
slar yang /
Then continue with this praise:
rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yum gyur bcom ldan ma/ / chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dngos/ / zag med bde stong lhan cig skyes ma'i sku/ / rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Bhagavatī, mother of all victorious ones, the real perfection of wisdom of the realm of phenomena, with the body of undissipating coemergent bliss-emptiness, Vajra Queen, I bow at your feet.
phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ / nyes byas thams cad snying nas so sor bshags/ / yi rang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / rtag tu bzhugs gsol dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /

ji srid byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ / bla med theg par bdag gis sems bskyed do/ / dbang bzhi mnos shing dam tshig lam la gnas/ / byin rlabs rgyud sbyangs rim pa gnyis la sgom/ / ngo mtshar spyod pa gsum gyis rol ba sogs/ / mtha' dag lam rnams bdag gis bsten par bgyi/ /

I go for refuge until I attain awakening and arouse the awakening mind in the highest vehicle. I will take the four empowerments, stay on the path of sacred pledge, refine my being in blessings, meditate on the two phases, enjoy the three wonderful conducts, and so forth: I will rely on all approaches.
ting 'dzin brtan cing phrin las thogs med 'grub/ / pho nya gsum 'dus grub pa brgyad sogs thob/ / 'gro ba'i don spyod mthu dang ldan pa yi/ / tshe 'dir he ru ka dpal thob par shog ces bstod/

With stable meditative absorption, I will accomplish unrestricted activity, gather the three messengers, attain the eight powers,[12] and so on, imbued with the ability to perform the benefit of migrators, may I attain the state of glorious Heruka in this life.
skabs 'dir gtor 'bul gong du smos pa ltar byin brlabs/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i sogs nas/ mchod bstod brin las bcol bar bya/

At this juncture, offer the torma. Consecrate it as explained before, then continue with “Exalted ones and retinues extend their tongues…(etc.),” including the offering, praises, and request of awakened activity.
de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs mchod phrin las yar 'phel ltar la/ (268) byin rlabs bebs pa'i thog mar/
Then for the feast offering, follow the feast offering of Five-Deity Cakrasaṃvara called Increasing Awakened Activity.[13] {268} At the beginning of the descent of blessings, add:

oM mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing / / dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod na/ / shes rab pha rol phyin ma la/ / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes grags/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor/ / khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis/ / byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /

oṃ The immutable joyous realm of Akaniṣṭha in the pure bliss-emptiness of Khecara, Lady Perfection of Wisdom renowned as Vajrayoginī, surrounded by ḍākinīs of three regions, I practice following in your footsteps: please come here to grant your blessings.
zhes sbyar/ 'di nyid mdor bsdus pa'i dbang gis/ 'dir rnams chos rnams sogs brda dang brda'i 'bul len ma byas kyang rung / /
Since this is a condensed [version of the feast], there is no need to do the words of symbolic offering and accepting, such as “Regard the phenomena here…(etc.).”[14]
lhag ma byin gyis brlab/
Consecrate the leftovers.
oM kha kha sogs dman lhag kho nas 'thus/
It is sufficient to offer with just the moderate oṃ kha kha…(etc.).
rjes mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/
Afterward, refresh the offerings and consecrate them.
sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod dang /
Present the outer offerings with just the mantra.
snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod bul/
Present the inner offerings by adding the three syllables to the essence mantra.
rkang brgyad kyis bstod/
Recite the eight-line praise.
rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal ba dang dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/
Supplicate for your desires with this and other prayers: Exalted Vajrayoginī, please grant me all supreme and common spiritual powers without exception and guide me to the celestial realm of Khecara.
yig brgya lan gsum dang / sngags dman pa dang cho ga dman/ / bya ba dman pa gang gyur pa/ / thabs dang mchog gi bdag nyid gtso/ / lha mo de dag bzo mdzad rigs/ /

Repeat the one hundred syllables three times, and Inferior mantras, inferior rituals, inferior actions—whatever I’ve done: main epitome of the profound and sublime, Goddesses, it is reasonable to forbear.
lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / / des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ / bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ / bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /
Authentic goddess and authentic pledge, the authenticity of their words are supreme. May that truth become the cause for those goddesses to accept me.

ces sogs smon lam bya zhing rten yod na mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhu ste thim pa sogs bdag bskyed ltar bya zhing dge ba bsngo/ / rten med na dam ye gnyis ka rang la bstim/ mgron thabs kyi lha rnams sarba gats+tshas rang gnas su gshegs/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma'am zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshig phreng ci rigs brjod pas bde legs su bya'o/ /

Say that and other aspiration prayers. If you have a representation [of the deity], let the awareness beings from the front visualization remain in that. The pledge beings melt through the crown of your head, dissolve, and so forth as in the self-visualization, and then dedicate the virtue. If you do not have a representation, both the pledge and awareness beings dissolve into you. Send the guest deities back to their own places with sarva gaccha. Recite the Sealed Word of Auspiciousness[15] or any appropriate verses spoken directly [by the masters] in order to create happiness and well-being.
[Conclusion and Colophon]

shangs chos rtsa ba gser chos lnga'i ya gyal me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar zhes yongs su grags kyang / / byin rlabs kyi bka' gsum dang yig rnying kha shas zhig gi lung rgyun 'pho ba'i khrid srol tsam las yig cha phal (269) cher gyi rgyun ma bzhugs pa dang / skabs 'dir ni grub mchog gong ma dag gis mdzad pa'i yig cha ci rigs bzhugs par nges pa'ang bka' lung lta ci smos/ dpe tsam yang spyad yul du ma gyur bas/ zab chos 'di nyid nyams len gyi rgyun nub par phongs te/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab rtsa bar bzung / yig rnying gi dgongs bcud bsdus/ rigs mthun 'os shing 'thad pas zur brgyan nas 'dus gsal du bkod pa'o/ /

The White and Red Khecarī practices are well known as the flowers of the Five Golden Dharmas that form the core of the Shangpa teachings. However, apart from the continuity of textual transmission (lung) of the three permissions for blessing,[16] some ancient texts, and the guidance tradition of Transference, the records (yig cha) have mostly not survived. {269} In the case here, though there are certainly suitable records of the works created by excellent adepts of the past, [no one has] witnessed even the texts, let alone their transmissions and permissions. Therefore, the continuity of the practice of this profound dharma itself has declined and left us destitute. So, taking the excellent teachings of the all-knowing Venerable One as a basis, I gathered the quintessential intent of the ancient writings and whatever extra adornments that were appropriately consistent and justifiable and made this clear arrangement.
chos 'dir dad cing gzhan la phan 'dod blos/ / 'os par bsam zhing 'thad par sbyar rloms kyang / / don zab gnas la byis blo rnam par 'khyams/ / de bas 'gal 'khrul bla ma lha la bshags/ /

With faith in this dharma and a mind to benefit others, I audaciously compiled what I thought was proper. Though my childish mind has strayed from the profound meaning, I confess the contradictions and errors to the guru and gods.
'gro kun rdo rje btsun mos rjes bzung ste/ / mkha' spyod thar pa'i pho brang nyams dga' bar/ / tshogs kyi dbang phyug snying rje'i stobs can tu/ / gyur nas mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'dren byed shog /
May the Vajra Queen nurture all migrators. In the joyous palace of liberation, Khecara, may I become lord of the assembly with compassion’s power to guide all migrators to that celestial realm.

ces pa'ang zab chos 'di la mi phyed pa'i 'dun pa can karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod de bI ko Ti tsA 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen la rdzogs par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // (270) (271)

Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso, with undivided trust in this profound dharma, completed this composition at Devīkoṭi Tsadra Rinchen Drak, the remote retreat of glorious Palpung, on the gathering of the ḍākinīs celebration during the waning moon.
rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa
12. In Praise of Vajrayoginī, the Especially Exalted Praise[1]
@#/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra yo gi nI sto tra/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/
Sanskrit: Vajrayoginīstotra Tibetan: rDo rje rnal ’byor ma la bstod pa
rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Homage to Vajra Khecarī.
hrIHlas gyur ba'i mkha' spyod ni/ / nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba'i phyir/ / mkha' la dri med pad zla'i steng / /
Khecarī appears from hrīḥ. You rest in space on a pure lotus and moon, since you ease the torment of afflictions.
lang tsho shin tu mdzes pa la/ / bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i tshul/ / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos phyir/ / ston zla'i mdog ltar 'od zer 'phro/ /
[Your body] is youthful and very beautiful, in the manner of a sixteen-year-old. You are the color of the autumn moon, radiating light, since you are untouched by the flaws of cyclic existence.
ma rig gnyid las sad mdzad phyir/ / grags stong hU~M dang phaT sgra sgrog / bde dang stong pa lhan cig skyes/ / gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug thugs/ /
You call hūṃ and phaṭ, the echoes of empty sound, since you wake us from the sleep of ignorance. Your mind is the unity of nonduality, coemergent bliss and emptiness.
mkha' la spyod phyir zhabs gnyis ni/ / rgyab nas phrag pa gnyis la bkal/ / 'gro rnams mkha' spyod 'dren pa'i phyir/ / b+ha ga rgyas shing shin tu yang / /
Your two legs rest behind your two shoulders so that we may enjoy the space. Your bhaga swells wide open since you lead migrators to the celestial realm.
thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ / sku smad rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ / chags shing bde ba rgyas pa'i phyir/ / sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur/ /
Your lower body sports bone ornaments to show methods and wisdom are not dual. Your body is full with rising breasts since you are passionate and full of bliss.
ma rig rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ / phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la 'phyar/ / gnyis med bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i phyir/ / phyag g.yon thod pa mkha' la 'dzin/ /
You brandish a flaying knife in the right hand since you sever ignorance at the root. You raise a skull cup to space with the left since you drip with nondual elixir.
'gro ba'i don la dgyes mdzad phyir/ / zhal ni 'dzum khro dag dang ldan/ / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzigs pa'i phyir/ / spyan gsum mkha' la drag tu gzigs/ /
Your face is smiling and wrathful since the welfare of beings delights you. Your three eyes look intensely into space since you see the buddhas of ten directions.
sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ / dbu la thod skam lnga yis brgyan/ / chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ / dbu skra mthon mthing shin tu gnag /
Your head is crowned by five dry skulls since you completely perfect the five kāyas. Your dark-blue hair is jet black since true reality is immutable.
nyon mongs bag chags brnyil ba'i phyir/ / rus bcas lcang los sku stod non/ / sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ / 'gying tshul dar gyi cod pan mdzes/ /
Your braids with bones press on your back since you suppress habitual afflictions. You proudly wear a lovely silk-ribboned tiara since you possess a charming air.
yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa'i phyir/ / dbu rgyan snyan cha dpung rgyan dang / / (272) mgul rgyan do shal do shal phyed/ / phyag gdub zhabs gdub rgyan rnams ni/ / rin po che yis rab tu spras/ /
You are fully decorated in precious gems: tiara, earrings, armbands, {272} choker, garland, necklace, bracelets, and anklets, since all good qualities adorn you.
rnam rtog spangs phyir mi mgo'i phreng / / brgya phyed dag gis ga shal byas/ / nyon mongs bud shing bsreg pa'i phyir/ / me ri dkar po'i gseb na bzhugs/ /
A string of fifty human heads forms your garland[2] since you abandon all conceptual thought. You dwell within a mountain of white fire since the firewood of afflictions burns up.
sgyu ma'i don dang ldan pa'i phyir/ / 'ja' 'od tshogs kyis kun nas bskor/ /
Masses of rainbow lights surround you since you possess the meaning of illusion.
mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / dad brtson dam tshig ldan pa yis/ / mchod bstod gsol ba btab gyur na/ / yang dag mkha' spyod gnas su ni/ / 'dren mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
I pay homage and praise Khecarī, I bow and praise you who guide to the pure celestial realm of Khecara if those with faith, diligence, and sacred pledge supplicate you with offerings and praises.
mdun gyi mkha' la lha mo khyod bzhugs nas/ / lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang / / bems rig bral tshe bar gcod med pa ru/ / yang dag mkha' spyod gnas su drang du gsol/ /
Goddess, remain before me in space bless my body, speech, and mind, and as soon as my body and awareness part, please take me straight to the heart of Khecara.[3]
mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i bstod pa/ paN+Di ta dI paM ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /
paN+Di ta de nyid dang / lo ts+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur pa'o/ /(273)
Composed by Paṇḍita Dīpaṃkara and translated by the paṇḍita himself and Lotsāwa Rinchen Zangpo.
@#/ /mkha' spyod dkar mo'i 'pho ba bzhugs so/
13. White Khecarī Transference[1]
oM swasti/
oṃ svasti
mkha' dbyings dbang po'i gzhu yi 'od kyi rlabs/ / 'khyil ba'i dbus na rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ / ston zla'i mdangs kyis byugs pa'i lang tsho can/ /
Exalted Yoginī amid the swirling light waves of the rainbow, mighty one of celestial space, anointed with the autumn moon’s radiance, is youthful.
mnyen lcug rnams dang 'gyur ba cir yang ngoms/ / gang gis mchog gi dkyil 'khor nyid/ / skal ldan rnams la gsal bar ston/ / bde ba chen po'i ye shes ni/ / skad cig nyid la ster bar mdzad/ /
With agility she changes and displays anything at all: she clearly shows the fortunate ones the supreme mandalas, and in the same instant bestows the timeless awareness of great bliss.

'dir nai gustA zhes pa nges par sbas ma'am/ /nges par gsang ba ma zhes pa de cung zad zur chags pas/ /nai gu ma zhes yongs su grags pa mkha' la spyod pa'i dbang mo 'ja' lus 'chi ba med pa'i sku can ma de nyid kyis grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po thang stong rgyal po zhes grags pa snyan pa'i sprin rnga mkha' klong yongs su gang ba de nyid la zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur nas dga' ba bzhi'i lang tsho yongs su gang zhing / / de'i tshe zhu ba dang zhu lan dang brda dang brda lan dang / ga Na tsakra'i longs pa'i yon tan rmad du byung ba la dges par rol pa sogs gsang chen gyi kun tu spyod pa cir yang mdzad la/

The name Naiguptā (or guhya)[2] means “definitely concealed” or “she who is definitely secret.” Abbreviated, it becomes Niguma, who is renowned as a mighty lady who moves through space with an immortal rainbow body. She actually revealed her face in visionary experience to the great universal emperor of adepts known as Tangtong Gylapo, whose fame resounds like thunderclouds completely filling the sky’s expanse. She conferred the four empowerments in their entirety in the supreme great mandala and he was completely filled with the youthful vitality of the four ecstasies. At that time, they fully engaged in every form of the great secret conduct, such as questions and responses, symbols and countersymbols, and the delightful enjoyment of the amazing pleasures of a communal feast.
