yig 'bru rnams pad+ma las cung zad 'phags pa/ gshang sgor yaM las rlung dkyil ljang gu bcas gsal gdab/ thog mar 'og rlung cung zad bskum pa'i rkyen gyis gshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i pad+ma la phog pas pad+ma kha dog lhag par dmar zhing reg bya tsha ba g.yon bskor du sgo ro ro 'khor ba la dmigs pa drag tu gtad/ steng rlung dal bus mnan te kha sbyar du bzung bas lte ba'i a las me kha dog dmar la reg bya tsha ba ngo bo bde ba'i rang bzhin te chos gsum ldan mthe bong tsam 'bar ba dmigs/ rlung khugs kha shas mtshams a'i 'od zer dmar pos phyogs kyi yig 'bru bzhi bskul/ de rnams las kyang chos gsum ldan gyi me 'bar bas thog mar lte ba'i phyogs kyi lus nang thams cad khyab pas bde drod skyes par mos/ de la goms nas rim par snying ga /mgrin pa'i bar du khyab cing mthar lus thams cad me 'od dmar 'tsher gyis gang bar bsam (304) la de dag rnams kyi skabs su/ a ha ri ni sa zhes yid bzlas bya'o/ /

Those seed syllables are slightly higher than the lotus. At the anus, imagine a green wind mandala arisen from yaṃ. First, slightly contracting the lower winds causes the wind in the anus to stir. That strikes the lotus at the navel, making the red color even brighter and hot to the touch. It begins to spin counterclockwise, round and round. Focus intently on that visualization. Gently press down the upper winds and hold the joining [with the lower wind]. Visualize a thumb-sized flame of fire arising from the A in the navel. It possesses three qualities: red in color, hot to the touch, and essentially the nature of bliss. After a few rounds of breathing (rlung khug), the A’s red light rays invoke the four seed syllables from the [four] directions. They also blaze with fire endowed with the three qualities. First they pervade the entire inside of the body at the navel; imagine bliss-warmth arising. After becoming familiar with that, imagine [the fire] pervading in stages to the heart and to the throat. Finally, think that your whole body is filled with sparkling red firelight. {304} During all those [stages], mentally recite a ha ri ni sa.

bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan spyi dang 'dra/ yig rnying las dngos sum gsungs kyang chos drug spyi'i yan lag yin pas 'khrul 'khor thub na legs shing bogs 'byin tu 'gyur/ des thog mar lus tshor la drod skye/ des sems tshor gyi steng du zhu ba de drangs/ des mi rtog pa rtsol med du shar nas lhag mthong gi rang zhal hrig ger mthong bar 'gyur bas/ drod skye ba'i 'go brtsams pa na rtsol ba mi klod pa dang / bde ba skyes pa'i tshe sems rtog tshor ba de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar lta stangs dang rig pa smin mtshams kyi bar snang la gtod cing / phyi nang gi dbyings dang bsres pas bde stong zung 'jug gi rang ngo 'gyur med du shes pa ni thabs lam gyi dgos don no/ /

[Perform] a vase breath with the standard four applications.[5] Though it is not actually taught in the ancient writings, since it is a general branch of the Six Dharmas, doing the yogic exercises if you are able will be very good and enhance the practice. Through that, first there will arise a bodily sensation of warmth. Then the mental sensation of melting bliss is invoked on top of that. Then nonthought will arise effortlessly and you will vividly see the true face of higher insight. If warmth starts to arise, do not relax your efforts; and when bliss arises, without following the mental sensation of conceptual thinking, just focus on the yogic gaze with awareness of the space between your eyebrows. Through blending the outer and inner spaces, you will understand the unchanging true face of the integral unity of bliss-emptiness. That is the actual goal of the path of methods.
gnyis pa sgyu lus ni/
2. Illusory Body

spyi bor gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gong bzhin drag tu gdab/ rang lus mkha' 'gro'i stong ra gsal btab pa'i lte bar pad+ma yig 'bru lnga bcas gsal ba'i 'og tu/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug cing gdengs ka gyen tu phyogs pa'i nang du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can dmyal ba tsha grang / yi dwags bkres skom sogs rang rang gi bde sdug la longs spyod pa/ sgyu ma lta bu snying po med pa bun lang lang shig shig tu bsam/ 'di rnams mi bden pa la bden par bzung ste 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam du snying rje dang / 'di rnams snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyang /

Meditate on the guru on a four-tiered seat above your head and fervently supplicate as before. Visualize your body as the ḍākinī, empty inside, and the lotus at the navel with the five seed syllables. Beneath that is a tetrahedral source of phenomena, white outside and red inside. The lower point touches the perineum and rises up from there. Within it are the sentient beings of the six kinds of migrators, each experiencing their own kind of suffering: heat and cold for the hell beings, hunger and thirst for the hungry ghosts, and so forth. Imagine it like an illusion, without a core, rising and fading like mist. Think with compassion on how all these beings grasp as real what is unreal and wander in cyclic existence under the power of that delusion. How pitiful! Think, “Though all this does arise; in reality, it is not real. It is illusion. It is dream.” Intensely cultivate that intentionality.

rlung kha sbyor bzung la yid bzlas byas pas lte ba'i a las 'od 'phros yi ge bzhi la phog / de las kyang 'od 'phros chos 'byung nang gi rigs drug la phog pas sdig sgrib nyams chags sdug bsngal thams cad sangs kyis sbyangs te de rnams 'od du ldem ldem 'dug par mos/ 'og rlung bskum/ pad+ma'ang g.yon tu drag tu 'khor bar (305) bsam/ sems chos 'byung nang gi rigs drug la gtad de/ sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun drag po bya/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ chos 'byung phyi nang rang yal du bzhag /

Hold the joined winds while doing the mental recitation. This causes light to radiate from the A in the navel. It strikes the four letters and light radiates from them as well. That strikes the six kinds of beings within the source of phenomena, cleansing and purifying all the sufferings from negativities, obscurations, and violations. Imagine them all staying there in shimmering light. Contract the lower winds. Think that the lotus spins intensely counterclockwise. {305} Focus your mind on the six kinds of beings inside the source of phenomena. Produce the intense intentionality of remembering illusion and dream. When the session ends, let the source of phenomena, outside and inside, vanish by itself.

lte ba'i a las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi tshangs bug nas thon/ lha'i bu mo dkar dwangs/ mchu la cha ga /mig la kri ga /lte ba man chad gos dang bral zhing gsang sgo'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i b+ha gar phog pas bde ba bskul te ze'u 'bru rgod pa las byang sems bde ba'i rgyun thams cad drangs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus nang thams cad gang / khyad pad+ma zer ba de yin/ yas lpags steng ri mo de la zer/ par lte ba'i yig 'bru la thim pas bde ba tshad med pa skyes par mos la rlung kha sbyar du bzung /

Light rays radiate from the A at the navel and emerge from your cranial aperture. The god’s girl is radiant white. Her lips are edged. (This refers to the lotus.) Her eyes are lined. (This refers to the drawing on the upper eyelids.) Below the waist she is naked and the lotus at the secret door is open. [The light] penetrates the bhaga and summons the bliss, exciting the [lotus] stamens and drawing out all the streams of blissful bodhicitta. That enters the top of your head and fills your whole body inside. Especially imagine that [the bodhicitta] melts into the seed syllables at the navel, generating immeasurable bliss. Hold the joined winds.

des rigs 'gres te/ dri za'i bu mo sngo sang / bram ze'i ser skya/ mi'i dkar dmar/ klu'i dkar ser/ gdol pa'i smug nag rnams kyi bde ba'ang gong bzhin tu drangs/ sgyu ma'i rang babs bskyangs pas lus thams cad bde chen gyis khengs shing / de'i dbang gis snang ba thams cad bde chen tu 'char bar 'gyur/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas sgyu ma rang shar/ rmi lam zin pa/ rlung 'byongs pa/ drod skye ba rnams dus gcig tu 'byung / dge sbyor bogs 'don la 'di las che ba med gsungs so/ /

Apply the same process to the gandharva girl, who is blue; the yellow brāhminī, the pink human, the light-yellow nāgī, and the brown caṇḍālī. Their bliss is drawn in as before. By your nurturing a natural state of illusion, your whole body fills with great bliss and, on the strength of that, all appearance will arise as great bliss. Through that practice, illusion arises naturally, dreams are recognized, the winds are controlled, and warmth arises—all this occurs at the same time. It is said there is no greater enhancement of applied virtue than this.
gsum pa rmi lam ni/
3. Dream

bla ma snying gar bsgom la gsol 'debs gong bzhin dang / khyad par rmi lam zin par byin gyis rlobs zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ lte bar pad+ma yi ge lnga dang bcas pa gsal/ a las 'od zer 'phros/ yi ge bzhi la phog / de rnams drag tu 'khor/ de las 'od zer dmar po bde drod kyi rang bzhin 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gsal bar bsam/ de rnams kyi bar mtshams thams cad du bde drod kyi rang nyams can/ rmi lam yin snyam du 'dun pa drag po rgyun chags su bya zhing rlung kha sbyor du bzung la yid bzlas bya/ khyad par srod dang gnyid du 'gro khar rtse gcig tu bsgom/ mthar yig (306) 'bru bzhi a la thim/ a 'od du yal bar bsam pa'i ngang gnyid log pas rmi lam zin cing / ma zin na gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog hrib pa de nyid rmi lam gyi sa bon yin pas 'di ka rmi lam du 'dug snyam dran shes grims lhod ran po byas pas mi zin mi srid do/ /

Meditate on the guru in the heart and supplicate as before. In particular, fervently supplicate with, “Bless me to grasp dreams.” Clearly imagine the navel lotus, (the natural experience of bliss-warmth), with the five letters. Light rays radiate from the A and strike the four letters. They spin forcefully and emit red light rays the nature of bliss-warmth. Think that your whole body inside becomes clear. In the intervals of those [visualizations], think, “It is a dream,” and fervently develop that intentionality continuously while holding the joined winds and mentally reciting. In particular, meditate with single-pointed focus in the evening and when going to sleep. {306} Finally, imagine that the four seed syllables dissolve into the A, and the A disappears into light. Fall asleep within that state and recognize dreams. If you do not recognize them, then in the gap between appearance and sleep, when thoughts are dim (hrib pa), which is itself the seed of dreams, think, “This itself is a dream,” and find the balance between concentration and relaxation. In this way it is impossible not to recognize them.

zin pa la brtan pa thob nas sbyong ba ni/ nyin par kun tu snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba/ lus 'di'ang yid lus su 'dug / 'di gnyis la bden par ma grub pas gang byed byed yin snyam du/ dngos po che chung bzang ngan phan tshun sna tshogs go bsnol du bsgyur ba dang / lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs pa nges med du bsgyur zhing / de thams cad kyang 'dzin med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas 'byongs nas rmi lam du'ang de ltar 'byung ngo / /

Once you attain stability in grasping [the fact that you are dreaming], you refine the dreams. Think, “These appearances throughout the daytime are dream appearances. This body is a mental body. Both of these are not truly existent, so I can do anything.” Switch various things back and forth between big and small, good and bad, or change the deities’ forms, seed syllables, hand implements, and so forth that are not definite. Refine all of that without fixation, resting in the equipoise of mahāmudrā. Then that will also occur in your dreams.
de la goms nas spel ba dang sprul pa sogs chos drug gzhan dang mthun zhing / yul snang lta ba'ang /
When you become familiar with that, you can advance to increasing, emanating, and so forth, in accordance with other [explanations] of the Six Dharmas.

a'i 'od zer gyis yig 'bru bzhi dang bcas pa 'od kyi rang bzhin tu song ba'i rkyen gyis/ lus thams cad phru ma phus btab pa bzhin phril song bar bsam la sems gsal stong 'dzin med du bzhag / gnyid du 'gro khar gang blta 'dod pa'i zhing khams la sogs pa'i lkog gyur de la a las 'od zer byung ste gsal lam gyis phog / de'i 'od lam la phyin te lta ba'am goms nas de la sems gtad pas ji bzhin gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro/ /

For [the practice of viewing] objective appearances, light rays from A cause the other four seed syllables to turn into the nature of light. Think that by those means the whole body quivers, like a blown-up balloon, and rest your mind without fixation in empty clarity. When you go to sleep, think of whatever hidden place you wish to visit, such as a pure realm. The light rays emitted from the A illuminate that place and you arrive via the path of light. Once you have looked or become accustomed to it, focusing your mind there will ascertain it accordingly.
de dag gi skabs su'ang mos gus gal che zhing gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur ba sogs 'phrul shes par bya/ /
Devotion is important for this occasion, so understand how to properly change the final sentences of the supplications [to specifically supplicate for this practice] and so forth.
bzhi pa 'od gsal ni/
4. Lucid Clarity

bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar ltar la 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab/ lte bar pad+ma yig 'bru lnga bcas kha dog dkar por gsal/ rlung dang yid bzlas byas pas a las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ yig 'bru bzhi 'od du 'bar/ pad+ma yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer shel (307) dkar la nyi zer phog pa lta bu byung nas khong pa'i nang thams cad khengs/ phyi nang thams cad 'od phung dkar me rer gyur par mos la sems gsal stong bzod med kyi ngang du sa le hrig ger yun ring du bzhag /

Practice guru yoga as before, fervently supplicating to recognize lucid clarity. Clearly visualize the lotus with five seed syllables at the navel, all white. Do the wind [exercises] and mental recitation. White light rays radiate from A, and the four seed syllables blaze with light. Crystal-white light rays come from the lotus and seed syllables, like the striking of sun rays, and fill your insides. {307} Imagine everything outside and inside becomes a mass of shimmering white light. Rest your mind for a long time in uncontrived empty clarity—brilliant wakefulness.

khyad par nyin mo rnam shes kyi rang bzhin a dkar po skye ba med pa de la sems ma yengs par gtad/ nub mo dang lhag par gnyid du 'gro khar drag tu bsgoms la gsal la rtog med kyi ngang mdangs bskyangs/ gnyid la khad par yig 'bru bzhi a la thim/ a 'od kyi rang bzhin la sems gtad de rtog pas bar ma chod par gnyid log pas 'od gsal mi 'char mi srid cing / shar nas 'chor mi srid gsungs/

Particularly in the daytime, focus with unwavering attention on the unborn white A, the nature of your consciousness. In the evening, and especially when going to sleep, meditate intently and maintain the splendor of nonconceptual clarity. If sleep ends, the four seed syllables dissolve into A. Focus your attention on the A as the nature of light without any interruption by conceptual thought and go back to sleep. It is said to be impossible for lucid clarity not to arise and impossible to lose it once it has arisen.

'od gsal la srab mthug phra rags nyams rtogs kyi khyad par sogs gnad dang dbye ba phra mo mang yang / gnyid du song ba'i tshe snang ba gsal lam me dran rig dang bcas pa byung na 'od gsal zin pa'i tha snyad byed cing / de la goms na nyin par kyang nub mo'i dge sbyor gyi shugs kyis drangs pa'i gsal stong rjen pa rang shugs su 'char ba de nyid nan tan tu bskyangs pas myur du nyin mtshan kha sbyor gyi 'od gsal la dbang 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /

There are many subtle divisions and important points concerning lucid clarity, such as thin or thick, subtle or coarse, different experiences and realizations, and so forth.[6] Nevertheless, when you have fallen asleep, if vivid appearances are accompanied by mindful awareness, that is designated as recognition. When you get used to that, even in the daytime the naked empty clarity will arise, brought on by the strength of the nighttime’s virtuous practice. If you persistently sustain it, you will quickly gain mastery over the lucid clarity of joined day and night.
lnga pa 'pho ba
5. Transference
['di] la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang / las la sbyar ba'o/ /
This has two parts: (1) training and (2) application in action [at death].
dang po ni/
a. Training

bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs tshig rkang bzhi pa'i mtshams/ rnam shes dag pa mkha' spyod du 'pho bar mdzad du gsol zhes bsgyur/ rang gi lte ba'i pad+ma yi ge bzhi bcas dkar por gsal la rlung dang yid bzlas kyis sems bsdu/ spyi bor bug pa 'phang lo tsam ta ler gsal/ yi ge bzhi 'byung ba bzhir mos la/ ri ha la thim/ ha ni la thim/ ni sa la thim/ de a la ste 'byung ba sdud rim dang mthun par bsdus/ a de 'bar la khad 'dug pa la/ 'og rlung bskum pa'i rkyen gyis gshang sgo nas rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i a la phog pas (308) skar mda' chad pa bzhin spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas yar rgyangs kyis song / nam mkhar skye med du yal bar bsam/ thun re re la de 'dra nyer gcig re bskyar nas rtags thon par sbyang / thun 'jog pa na nam mkha' nas a dkar po lam gyis byung / tshangs bug nas lte bar brjid dang ldan par babs pas lus tsha chil gyis byung / spyi bo'i bug pa sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag par bsam/

In the guru yoga practice, after the first four lines of the supplication, add “Please let my consciousness transfer to the pure celestial realm.” Visualize the white lotus in your navel with the four letters, and practice the breathing exercises and recitation to collect your mind. The hole in the top of your head is the size of a spindle, vividly clear. Imagine the four letters as the four elements. The letter ri dissolves into ha, that into ni, that into sa, and that dissolves into A. This corresponds to the dissolution stages of the elements [at death]. That A is there ready to blaze up; contracting the lower wind causes the winds to stir from the anus and strike the A at the navel. {308} It ascends up like a shooting star through the cranial aperture and flies far away. Think that it vanishes in unborn space. Repeat this twenty-one times in each session and train for the signs to show. At the end of a session, the white A appears clearly from space, falls through the cranial aperture, and lands heavily at the navel. This forcefully produces the body’s heat. Think that your cranial aperture is blocked by a crossed vajra.
gnyis pa ni/
b. Application

'chi ltas nges pa can byung nas 'chi bslu sogs kyis ma bzlog pa'i tshe/ nyes byas bshags sdom bya/ lus longs spyod bla ma dkon mchog la phul te zhen 'khris rbad kyis bcad/ rnam shes mkha' spyod du 'pho ba la brod pa chen po dang bcas sngar gyi dmigs pa de bsgom/ ngag tu hi ka drag po brjod cing rang sems a yig nam mkha' dang bsres la phyir mi dbab/ 'chi ka mar lus gnad seng ge'i nyal stabs kyi ngang nas de ltar 'phos pas mkha' spyod du mi 'gro ni srid gsungs/ sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i gnad do/ /

When the signs of impending death are clear and the methods such as cheating death have not deterred it, confess your faults and vow [to desist from them]. Offer your body and possessions to the guru and Jewels, energetically cutting your entanglements. Verbally shout “hik”—your mind as the letter A blends with space and then does not come back. At death, lie down in the position of a reclining lion. It is said that having done the transference of consciousness in that way, it is impossible not to go to the celestial realm. It is the vital point of forcefully attaining buddhahood for great sinners.

mkhyen rab chos rje'i khrid yig na/ sbyong ba'i skabs yi ge bzhi mkha' 'gro ma gri thod 'dzin pa/ pad 'dab 'byung bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ a yig spar zhing 'bebs/ las la sbyor ba'i tshe pad 'dab bzhi mkha' 'gro la thim/ de bzhi a la bstims nas spar gsungs/ /

According to the guidance manual of Khyenrab Chöje,[7] during the training, the ḍākinī holds a flaying knife and skull cup, and one thinks of the lotus petals as the essence of the four elements. The A letter flies and falls. During the application at death, the four lotus petals dissolve into the ḍākinī. Those four [seed syllables], having dissolved into the A, then ascend.
drug pa bar do ni/ /
6. Intermediate State

bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs mtha'/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku 'thob par mdzad du gsol zhes bsgyur/ lte bar pad+ma yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsal/ rlung dang yid bzlas byas pas a las 'od 'phros/ yig 'bru bzhi ngo bo yig 'bru la rnam pa lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag bsnams par gyur pa'i sku la phog / 'od du ldem ldem 'dug par mos/ res gsal la rtog med rang shar gyi ngo bo la ma yengs par che re 'jog / res yid bzlas bya/ yang a las 'od zer (309) dkar po 'phros/ DA ki bzhi'i gsang gnas su phog pas bde chen tu lam lam 'jug par mos/

Change the end of the supplication in the guru yoga to “Please let me attain the victors’ saṃbhogakāya in the intermediate state.” Clarify the lotus with the seed syllables at the navel. Through your breathing exercises and mental recitation, the A radiates light. The essence of the forms of the four seed syllables are the goddesses with one face and two arms, holding flaying knives in their right hands and blood-filled skull cups in the left. The light strikes their form; imagine shimmering light. Sometimes rest openly without distraction in the essence of self-arising nonconceptual clarity. Sometimes do the mental recitation. {309} Again white light rays radiate from A. They penetrate the secret places of the four ḍākinīs.

de dag gi skabs rnams su/ a pa nga shi nas 'dug / snang ba thams cad bar do'i snang ba/ lus 'di yang bar do'i yid lus/ tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad kyang ming bzhi 'dus pa'i phung por 'dug / bden par grub pa ni gcig kyang med snyam du bsam la cir snang ci grags thams cad bar dor lam du 'khyer/

Imagine their vivid great bliss. In all those contexts, think, “Alas! I am dead. All the appearances are intermediate state appearances. This body is also the mental body of the intermediate state. All appearances of the six consciousness groups are the aggregates included in the four names.[8] Nothing at all here is real.” Whatever appears, whatever resounds, integrate all of it into the path of the intermediate state.

yang skabs su/ bar do 'di nyid du sangs rgyas nas phyin chad mngal sgo mi 'grim pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du bsam la/ rang lus snang stong lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu/ snod gzhal yas khang / bcud kyi sems can snang ba lha/ grags pa sngags/ dran rtog chos nyid spros gral 'od gsal/ khyad par pho dang zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje/ mo dang 'dod chags skye ba'i yul thams cad bdag med mar bsams la/ mnyam par bzhag pa nyid yun ring du goms na/ rmi lam lha sku rang shar mi 'byung mi srid cing / de byung na bar do longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang mi rgya mi srid gsungs/ da lta dran rig dang 'dun pa'i shugs bzang na srid pa bar do'i 'khrul snang shar ba'i tshe/ dang po ngos zin/ de nas lam bsgoms pas skad cig de nyid du grol bar 'gyur ro/ /

Again, sometimes think, “I must be sure to avoid wandering through the entrance to the womb; I must become buddha in this very intermediate state.” Imagine your own body as the rainbow-like empty appearance of the deity’s form, the environment as a celestial palace, the appearance of its inhabiting sentient beings as deities, sound as mantra, and thoughts as the unembellished nature of phenomena in lucid clarity. In particular, think of all males and objects that inspire anger as Hevajra, and all females and objects that produce desire as Nairātmya. If you get used to resting in such equipoise for a long time, it is impossible that the self-arising deity’s form will not arise in your dreams. When that occurs, it is said to be impossible not to get enlightened as the saṃbhogakāya in that intermediate state. If you have good recollection and awareness in the present, and powerful intentionality, then when the deluded appearances of the intermediate state arise, first you recognize them; then, because of your meditation on the path, you are instantly liberated at that moment.
des na lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dran pa dang shes bzhin la rags las so/ /
Thus, the root of all approaches depends on mindful recollection and awareness.
gsum pa rjes
III. Conclusion
['di] la gnyis/ dngos dang / khyad par gyi 'phros don no/
This has two parts: (1) the main part and (2) the particular elaboration.
dang po ni/
A. Main Part

de ltar bskyed rdzogs kyi thun mtha' thams cad du shes na bsngo ba bka' rgya ma sogs dang / mi shes na'ang theg pa chen po spyi dang khyad par zung 'jug gi smon lam/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba dngos dang rjes mthun pas rgyas gdab/ mnyam bzhag tu (310) rnal 'byor gang la brtson pa de nyid rjes thob kun tu'ang dran shes kyis bskyang / sgyu ma rmi lam bar do la sogs pa'i skabs de dag gi dran 'dun rgyun chags su bya/ dge sbyor la gol sa 'byung ba'i rgyu the tshom/ snyoms las/ nga rgyal log lta sogs dug ltar spang / dge sbyor la gegs byed pa'i rkyen skyon yon bzang ngan la re dogs dgag bsgrub blang dor mi bya bar btang snyoms su 'jog / dge sbyor gyi bogs 'don mchog tu gyur pa mos gus/ dag snang / snying rje rnams thams cad kyi grogs su khyer te nyams len la gnad du bsnun pas/ spros pa nang nas chod/ 'khrul pa bun long du zhig / yon tan shugs las 'char/ zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro/ /

At the end of all sessions of creation and completion phases, do the Sealed Word Dedication[9] if you know it. If you don’t know it, then do general Mahayana aspiration prayers and in particular the aspiration of integral unity. Seal that with actual and associated dedications [while maintaining] the complete purity of the three spheres. {310} Whatever yoga you have been pursuing during equipoise, maintain that same one with mindful awareness at all times in subsequent attainment. Keep the continuity of mindful intentionality from the practices of Illusory Body, Dream, Intermediate State, and so forth. Avoid like poison the causes of deviations in applied virtue such as doubt, laziness, pride, and wrong views. Rest in equanimity without engaging in the conditions that hinder virtue: faults and qualities, good and bad, hopes and fears, affirming and denying, and rejecting and accepting. Take as your support for everything the supreme enhancements of applied virtue: devotion, pure view, and compassion. Through persistence in the crucial practice, proliferating thoughts will be severed from the inside, delusions will vanish like mist, qualities will arise automatically, and you will manifest the state of integral unity.
gnyis pa
B. Particular Elaboration

khyad par 'phros don gyi tshul du smos pa/ bo dong kun mkhyen 'jigs bral chen po la nye brgyud du stsal ba'i tshe sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bya/ sngon tu song na 'dir mi dgos/ swa b+hA lba sogs brjod pas chos thams cad stong par sbyang /

Here is a description of a method of further elaboration. If you wish to take up the practice of longevity that Bodong Kunkhyen Jikdral the Great received in a direct lineage,[10] you do not need to do the refuge, awakening mind, and the four immeasurables if you have done them previously. Purify all phenomena by saying svabhāva…(etc.).

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje'i ra ba me ri zlum skor gyi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil zhing nor bu sna tshogs kyis gtams pa'i dbus na yar/ dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ldem pa'i lte bar/ seng khri pad+ma zla nyi sA ra'i pags pa'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas dpyi zur g.yas pa'i thad nas gdan la btsugs shing / (311) g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya thugs kar gtod pa/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i phreng bas kun nas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis tsog pur bsnol ba'i tshul gyis 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i gur khang na bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AHthugs kar hU~M/ de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa badzra sa mA dzaH dza:hU~M baM hoH gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dgyes rdor lhan skyes yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/

From within emptiness, you instantly become glorious Coemergent Hevajra. Before you in space is a circular vajra enclosure. Within it is a multicoloured lotus with a hundred thousand petals; its center is a swirling ocean of milk filled with various gems. The trunk of a wish-fulfilling tree rises in its midst, with branches, leaves, flowers, and ripened fruit. In its center, on a lion throne with a seat of lotus, moon, sun, and antelope skin, your root guru is indivisible from the Ḍākinī of Timeless Awareness, Spiritual Power of Bliss (Sukhasiddhi). She is white with a red glow, with one face and two arms. Her right hand rests on the seat near her right hip. {311} Her left hand makes the trident mudra facing her heart. She is beautifully adorned by silks, jewels, and bone garlands. She sits in a squatting posture with legs drawn up and crossed [at the ankles] in a pavilion of swirling rainbow light. The letter oṃ is at her forehead, āḥ at her throat, and hūṃ at her heart. Light from those letters radiates out and invokes the awareness beings—vajra samājaḥ / jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they become indivisible. Again light rays from the heart invoke the empowerment deities. They confer empowerment, fill her body, and purify stains. The excess water rises up and becomes the crown ornament of Coemergent Hevajra couple.

oM dz+nyA na DA ki su kha sid+d+hi badzra Ar+g+haM pra twits+tsha swA hA/ de bzhin du/ ma sbyar/ oM badzra puSh+pe AHhU~M/ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang / oM pany+tsa kA ma gu Na ma hA su kha AHhU~M gis mchod/ /
Offer: oṃ jñānaḍākinī sukhasiddhi vajra arghaṃ pratīccha svāhā (similarly with)…pādyaṃ…(etc. then) oṃ vajra puṣpe āḥ hūṃ (through)…śabda…(and) oṃ pañca kāmaguṇa mahāsukha āḥ hūṃ
bcu drug lang tshos mdzes shing sgeg / bde stong mkha' dbyings dwangs ma'i sku/ / brjod bral skye med ngang la bzhugs/ / bde ba'i dngos grub ma la bstod/ / ces pas bstod/
Praise: Lovely and charming, youthful as a sixteen-year-old, with the radiant form of empty bliss in basic space, you dwell within the ineffable unborn state; I praise the Spiritual Power of Bliss.
thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hU~M yig dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa'i mthar sngags phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas su 'khor bar gyur/ /
In her heart, on a moon-disk mandala, is the letter hūṃ, white with a red radiance. The multicolored mantra string circles clockwise around it.
oM AHgu ru DA ki nI ye su kha sid+d+hi A yu r+dz+nyA na sid+d+hi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ zhes ci nus bzlas pas/
oṃ āḥ guru ḍākinīye sukhasiddhi āyurjñāna siddhi mem prayaccha Repeat that as much as you can.

sngags phreng las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rnams la phog / de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs/ ro bcud dwangs ma thams cad spyan drangs/ ye shes DA ki'i sku la thim/ de las 'od zer 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs/ bdag gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ lus thams cad mer khengs/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib (312) nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad sangs kyis dag / 'chi med dwangs ma gsum ldan mchog gi sprul sku bla ma 'grub par byin gyis brlabs par bsam/

Immeasurable multicolored light rays radiate from the mantra string and strike the entire environment with its inhabitants and all the sugatas of the ten directions. It invokes their compassionate blessings and all their flavor, potency, and refined essence, which dissolves into the awareness ḍākinī. Immeasurable light rays as the elixir of immortality flow down from her into your cranial aperture and fill your whole body. The mass of all negative acts, obscurations, faults, downfalls, and stains accumulated during beginningless lives in cyclic existence is cleansed and purified. {312} Think that the immortality [elixir] with its threefold essence blesses you with the accomplishment of the supreme nirmāṇakāya guru.
mthar/ gong ltar phyi mchod dang / oM AHhU~M gis nang mchod 'bul/
At the end, present the outer offerings as above and the inner offering with oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
'ja' lus sku brnyes mi shigs pa'i/ / dwangs ma lhan skyes sgyu ma'i sku/ / 'od gsal bde chen longs spyod rdzogs/ / su kha sid+d+hi khyed rang mkhyen/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/
Supplicate: You attained rainbow body of indestructible essence, the illusory form of coemergent lucid clarity and great bliss—saṃbhogakāya; Sukhasiddhi, consider me!

mdun bskyed bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gdan khri dang bcas pa 'od du ltems se zhu/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs gnyis su med par thim pas/ dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu thob/ gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa dag cing mthar thugs sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par bsams la rig pa chos nyid bya rtsol bral ba'i ngang du ci gnas su bzhag / mthar zung 'jug gi skur ldangs la bsngo smon bya'o/ /

The front-visualized guru Awareness Ḍākinī, along with the seat and throne, melts completely into light. Her awakened body, speech, and mind become indivisible from your body, speech, and mind as the yidam. Thus the four empowerments are obtained in one sitting. Think that the obscurations of the four circumstances are purified and the ultimate four kāyas are attained. Rest intrinsic awareness in the effortless state of phenomena’s nature for as long as it abides. Finally, arise in the form of integral unity and do the dedication and aspiration.

spyir ye shes mkha' 'gro su kha'i chos skor la/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid dang / phag mo gsang sgrub kyi skor sogs mkhas grub khyung po nyid las byon pa dang / phyis gnyan ston chen po la dngos su stsal ba'i bskyed rim gzer gsum/ lte ba sprul 'khor sogs gdams ngag shin tu zab cing 'dril ba'i smar chos 'ga' zhig gi nang nas/ deng sang yig rnying phal cher zhig gi lung rgyun dang khrid brgya'i nang tshan tsam las cher mi bzhugs kyang / rtsa ba ni chos drug 'di dang phyag chen dag pa ye shes gnyis po yin zhing / mkhas grub khyung pos dka' chen spyad pa'i gces nor gser chos 'di nyid chad du phongs pas phyis 'byon blo bzang ngag gis rgyun bskyang ba dang / 'di'i byin rlabs thob nas nyams len gyi rtsa ba 'di tsam la 'bad pas kyang grub pa gnyis bde blag tu brnyes par 'gyur ba ni ye shes (313) DA ki'i tha tshig gi nges pa'o/ /

In general, in the dharma cycle of Awareness Ḍākinī [Sukhasiddhi], Nairātmya’s inner guidance, and the cycle of Vārāhī’s secret sādhana came from Khedrup Khyungpo himself and later were directly received by the great Nyentön. From among the few highly valuable teachings of incredibly profound instructions, such as the Three Nails of Creation Phase [and] the Navel Emanation Chakra, these days most of the ancient writings are no longer extant, other than in the reading transmissions and what’s included in the Hundred Guidances [of Jonang]. However, the basis is these two: this Six Dharmas and the Mahāmudrā timeless awareness. Khedrup Khyungpo retrieved these Golden Dharmas through his difficult labors and precious treasure. Because of that, those with noble minds in the future will maintain its continuity and, having obtained its blessings, will readily attain the two spiritual powers through effort in just these main practices. This is the assured promise of the Ḍākinī of Timeless Awareness.
[Colophon]

dad brtson dam tshig ldan pa yis/ / lo'am zla ba drug nyid du/ / rdo rje 'chang dngos 'grub byed pa/ / thabs lam snying po yid bzhin nor/ / grags phyir ma yin chos tshul 'di/ 'phel zhing gnas phyir ci nus su/ / bshad pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun/ / bde chen dngos grub mchog brnyes shog /

For those with faith, diligence, and sacred pledge, this brings attainment of the real Vajradhara in a year or six months. This dharma system, not merely rumored as the heart of the path of methods and wish-fulfilling gem, I’ve explained as best I can for its increase and duration. Through this virtue may I and all others gain the supreme spiritual power of great bliss.

ces pa'ang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po many+dzu g+ho Sha'i zhal snga nas chos tshul 'di snying gi thig ler nod pa'i tshe/ mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rje dbon blo gros bzang po'i thugs bzhed kyis rkyen byas te/ bla ma'i zhal lung zin thun gyi tshul du yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs kyi gdan sar bris shing / yig rnying rnams kyi dgongs don kyang tshang bar 'dus gsal gyi khul du spel ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig /

At the time of receiving this dharma system of the heart’s drop directly from the great all-knowing all-seeing Mañjughoṣa, the aspirations of the master of highest knowledge, my lord nephew Lodrö Zangpo contributed the conditions; I, Yönten Gyatso, wrote this in the monastic seat of Palpung, in the style of a memorandum of the guru’s oral transmission. The intended meanings of the ancient writings were also gathered in their entirety for further clarification. May this benefit the doctrine and sentient beings.
dge legs 'phel// // (314)
Let virtue prevail!(315)
@#/ /su kha sid+d+hi'i zhal gdams kyi skor dang / gzer gsum gdams pa rnams bzhugs so/
18. Sukhasiddhi’s Cycle of Oral Instructions and Instructions on Three Nails[1]
[I. Oral Instructions of Four Empowerments]
(316) @#/ /na mo gu ru/
namo guru
gsang dbang bzhi'i zhal gdams sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyi/ / dbang bzhi'i zhal gdams bri bar bya/ /
I write the oral instruction of the four empowerments of the Emanated Navel Chakra Secret Sādhana.[2]

de la sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ rnam pa gzugs su grub pa/ reg pa rdzas su ma grub pa/ bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa gcig bsgom/ de'i lte ba'i a las 'od zer tshangs pa'i bu ga nas yar song bas/ 'od kyi rtse la lha'i bu mo sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ sku gzhon zhing sgeg pa/ rin po che dang / lha'i pany+tsa li ka'i gos sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing mdzes pa/ mdun dang pad+ma shin tu gsal zhing chags pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ mthong ba'am/ thos pa'am/ reg pa tsam gyis bde drod dpag tu med pa skye bar byed pa'i rje btsun ma de lta bu gcig mdun du byon par bsam mo/ /

Precede this with arousing the mind of awakening. Instantly you become Cakrasaṃvara as a solitary hero holding vajra and bell. Meditate that as form, you exist as body; as touch, you do not exist as substance; and you possess the experience of bliss. Light rays from A at the navel move up through the cranial aperture. On the tips of the rays are goddesses, white with red radiance. Youthful and voluptuous with full breasts, their young bodies are charming, beatified by jewels and various divine Pāñcālikā garments.[3] Their front sides and lotuses are very vivid with a glow of passion. Just seeing or hearing or touching them causes immeasurable arousing bliss. Imagine that one such venerable goddess arrives before you.

de nas rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i nor bu'i rtse la hU~M mthing nag gcig bsam/ de las 'od (317) zer lnga 'phros/ mdun gyi lha mo'i gsang gnas na yar 'phros pas/ de bde bas brgyal ba dang / 'od zer des bde ba bkug nas rang gi nor bu'i nang na yar bde phri li li/ tsha chi li li song ba dang 'og rlung drag tu bskum nas/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/

With yourself visualized as Cakrasaṃvara, imagine a dark-blue hūṃ at the tip of your gem (glans). {317} Five-colored light rays from that radiate up into the secret place of the goddess in front. She faints in bliss. The light rays capture the bliss and bring it inside the gem; bliss flows up—tri li li, warmth spreads—chi li li. Think that as you contract the lower winds intensely, the timeless awareness of nondual bliss-emptiness arises in your being.

yang hU~M las 'od 'phros/ pad+ma na yar song ba dang / bde ba thams cad tshur bsdus nas nor bu'i nang na yar song ba dang / bde ba de nyid gsal sing ba gsal stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyud la skye'o/ /

Again light radiates from hūṃ and goes up the lotus and brings back all the bliss, which goes up the gem. That bliss itself is utterly lucid; the timeless awareness of nondual clarity-emptiness arises in your being.

yang hU~M las 'od 'phros pad+ma na yar song ba dang / bde bas myos nas bdag la kyud kyis byung nas/ sbyor ba byas pa dang / sbyor mtshams nas chags pa'i zil pa thigs tsam thigs tsam byung bas/ bde phril phril ba la/ lus thams cad bde bas khyab pa dang / 'og rlung drag tu 'then no/ /

Again light radiates from hūṃ and goes up; intoxicated by bliss, [she] comes to embrace you and have intercourse. From the place of union, the dewdrops of passion come drop by drop; [you] quiver with bliss—tril tril ba—and your whole body is pervaded by bliss. Contract the lower wind intensely.

de nas nor bu'i bu gar yum gyi bde ba'i rtsa dang byang sems dmar po rnams tshud pa dang / 'og rlung drag tu bskum byas pa dang byang sems dmar po (318) rnams nor bu'i nang na yar bde phri li li/ tsha chil li li/ dmar na ra ra byung gsang gnas dang lte ba man chad khengs pas bde ba drag po skyes/ yang snying ga dang mgrin pa dang / spyi bo man chad dmar mer gyis khengs pas lus thams cad bde bas khengs par bsam/ de nas rang nyid bde la dmar ba'i byi ru'i mdog lta bur gyur pa'i mdangs des yum dbang du bsdus/ yum gyi mkha' la dkar ba gcig spros pas yum kyang bde bas brgyal te/ dkar ba la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par bsgom/ de ltar yab yum gnyis ka bde bas brgyal te/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngang la gnas par bya'o/ / de la mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi yang rtsi bar bya'o/ /

Then at the hole in the gem, the channel of the goddess’s bliss and the red bodhicitta penetrate and by vigorously drawing up the lower winds, {318} the red bodhicitta that is all inside the gem flows up—tri li li; warmth spreads—chil li li. Red [bodhicitta] continuously arises in the secret place and fills up below the navel, arousing intense bliss. As the redness completely fills up to the heart, to the throat, and to the crown of your head, your whole body is filled with bliss. Then as your bliss turns you as red as the color of coral, your splendor overpowers the mother. One white [bodhicitta drop] emanates to the goddess’s vagina and she faints in bliss. Meditate on the white with a radiance of red. In this way, both female and male faint in bliss; remain within the nondual bliss-emptiness. This is also counted as the four upward-supporting ecstasies.[4]

de bzhin du dri za'i bu mo dkar ba la ljang khu'i mdangs chags pa dang / bram ze ljang khu la dkar ba'i mdangs= gdol pa dmar ba la dkar= klu ser ba la dkar= mi yid du gang 'ong ba'o/ / de ltar drug ka rim gyis bsgom par bya'o/

This is also applied to the white gandharvī with a green radiance, the green brāhminī with a white radiance, the red caṇḍālī with a white radiance, and the yellow nāgī with a white radiance. The human [girl] is whatever [color] pleases you. Meditate thus on all six sequentially.
[Concluding Verse]

dbang bzhi bla ma sum ldan 'di/ / mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub kyis/ / sangs rgyas gnyan ston rin chen la/ / dngos su gsungs nas bdag la gnang / / dpa' bo DA ki'i srog snying 'dis/ / lo zla tsam gyis mngon sangs rgya/ / /

The four empowerments were directly received from Ḍākinī Spiritual Power of Bliss by this guru with three [qualities][5]— Sangye Tönpa Rinpoche, who gave it to me.[6] This vital heart of the hero [and] ḍākinī enlightens you in just a year or months. ithi
ngo sprad kyi zhal gdams ni/
II. The Oral Instructions of Introduction[7]
bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Homage to all holy gurus.
mkha' 'gro dang rang sems gnyis med du rang sems phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa ni/
The introduction of one’s own mind’s mahāmudrā in the nonduality of the ḍākinī and one’s own mind:

lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rkang pa cung zad bsnol/ lag pa g.yon pa sdigs mdzub byas pa la thugs kar bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb chen dang / mthe'u chung gnyis bcangs pa sor mo gsum gdengs tshul du byas/ ldan pa yi/ / nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ / rig bcas dmigs sems kyi rtsa ba gcun mig hur re blta/ / rtsa ba gcun dang lhug par bzhag /

With the physical yogic exercise (legs slightly crossed, left hand in the threatening gesture at the heart, the right thumb and little finger grasped and the other three raised), in empty space, which lacks awareness, with awareness (visualize) taming the root of mind (looking with sharp eyes). Tame the root and rest relaxed.

mi phod pa brdzis/ 'khri ba bcad/ zhen pa bzlog / snang ba bsgyur bar bya/ (319) spyod pa skyungs/ 'tshangs yul nas 'don/ rkyen dngos grub tu shes par bya/ sdug bsngal chos nyid du shes par bya/ 'dod pa dbang du bsdu bar bya/ mi 'dod pa gzhil bar bya/ tshogs drug lhug par bzhag / des 'khor 'das thams cad rang grol du 'gro gsung ngo / / rig pa khrol dbyung / snyan brgyud mi la ma spel cig /

Overcome inabilities. Cut entanglement. Reverse attachment. Transform perception. {319} Banish activity. Leave the crowded country. Understand [difficult] conditions as spiritual powers. Understand suffering as the nature of phenomena.[8] (Control what is desired, give up what is not desired, let the six consciousness groups go dumb. By that, all cyclic existence and transcendence is naturally free. So it is said.) Release and draw out intrinsic awareness. Do not spread the aural lineage among people.

de ltar nyams su blangs pas rten 'brel mngon du ji lta ba bzhin 'char te tshe 'di nyid du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob nas nus pa dang yon tan phrin las lhun gyis grub pa rgyun chad med pas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par sems can smin cing grol bar byed do/ /

By your practicing like that, auspicious interconnections will actually arise just as they are. You will attain the state of a vajra holder in this very life, and your abilities and qualities and continuous spontaneous awakened activities will ripen and liberate sentient beings until the ocean of cyclic existence is emptied.

de la mkha' 'gro gnang la dbab pa'i gdams pa ni/ dbang po la khrog dbyung / rig pa la gsal gdab/ bzhin gyi ngar blud/ rtsa ba {skye ba med par/} dran pas bzung / mkha' 'gro rang sems sems skye med phyag rgya chen por shes pa/ su ngo sprad/ des snang ba dang mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'du'o/ /

This is the legacy of instruction bestowed by the Ḍākinī: Release and draw out the faculties, clarify intrinsic awareness,[9] reinforce strength, and hold with mindfulness the root [of mind] (as unborn). The introduction to one’s own mind [as] ḍākinī (called mahāmudrā of unborn mind) brings appearances (and all ḍākinīs) under control.
gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams rdzogs so/ // !
This concludes the oral instruction of the secret sādhana.
sgrub pa'i zhal gdams ni/
III. Oral Instructions on the Sādhana[10]
bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ / gsang sgrub zhal gdams bri bar bya/
Bowing at the feet of the holy gurus I write the oral instructions of the Secret Sādhana.

de la bdag bskyed sngon du song pas/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar bskyed pa'i rtsa dbu ma gsal gdab/ de'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ mdun sngo skya/ g.yas dmar/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon ser po bsam/ dbus kyi lte ba dkar po la a dkar po bsam/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsam/ de'i mdun du hU~M las dgyes mdzad dang bir wa pa tha dad med par bsgom/ de'i g.yon du haM las bdag med ma dang (320) su kha sid+d+hi tha dad med par bsgom/ rang gi spyi bor dam pa phyag na spa'i gling bu rtsa dbu ma la reg ge ba bsnams pa/ dam pa'i mdun du bla ma bzhugs par bsam nas/ rje btsun bir wa pa hU~M/ su kha ma sid+d+hi haM/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/

Precede this with the self-visualization. Instantly you create yourself as Exalted Lady with the central channel appearing clearly. Imagine at the navel a four-petaled lotus, the front petal light blue, the right red, the back white, and the left yellow. Imagine a white A in the white center of the central stamen. Then imagine all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the space before you. Meditate on hūṃ becoming Hevajra indivisible from Virūpa in front of them, and to their left, from haṃ, Nairātmya indivisible from Sukhasiddhi. {320} Above your head is Dampa holding a cane flute in his hand that touches your central channel. Think of your guru sitting in front of Dampa and supplicate three times with “Venerable Virūpa hūṃ Sukhasiddhi haṃ.”

sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad dang / khyad par bir wa pa hU~M/ su kha ma sid+d+hi hU~M/ dam pa gsum gyi thugs ka nas oM AHhU~M mu tig dar la brgyus pa bzhin du dam pa'i spa'i gling bu'i nang na mar song / rtsa dbu ma brgyud nas yi ge bzhi la sib sib thim pas/ nyams chags nus pa smad par bsgoms nas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes grub tshad byas pas/ bdag mkha' 'gro'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing / mkha' 'gro bdag gi dbang du 'du ba'i gnad yin no/ /

That causes the three letters oṃ āḥ hūṃ, like strings of pearls, to emerge from the hearts of all of the buddhas and bodhisattvas, primarily from those three: Virūpa, Sukhamasiddhi,[11] and Dampa. The [letters] come through Dampa’s bamboo flute and descend, entering the central channel, finally dissolving into the four letters. Meditate that this reduces the potential of transgressions. Then say, “I go for refuge in the triad of guru, yidam, and ḍākinī.” By doing the full measure of practice, you will not come under the ḍākinī’s control; it is the vital point to bring the ḍākinī under your control.

de nas bzlas pa ni/ a dkar po las 'od 'phros/ ngo bo lha mo rnam pa yi ge gsang gnas su thim pas/ nyams chags nus pa smad nas bde phril phril/ 'od du ltem ltem 'dug par bsams nas/ yi ge bzhi po gang bas thos tsam du bzlas pas/

Then for the recitation, imagine light emanates from the white A. It dissolves into the secret place of the letter, which is the goddess in essence. The potential of transgressions is reduced; bliss vibrates and light suffuses. Think that and then recite the four letters fully but just barely audible.
yi ge mi 'khor bar pad+ma g.yas bskor du sgo ro ro 'khor bar bsams la/ lus mi gnas sgul bskyod/ ngag mi gnas bzlas pa/ yid mi gnas chos nyid la gnas par bya'o/ /

de nas rmi lam 'dzin cing sbyong bar 'dod na AHlas 'od zer spro ba/ pad+ma 'khor ba rnams las sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin snyam pa yid la sems shing ngag tu'ang brjod la/ spyod lam thams cad du sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya'o/ /

Now, if you wish to recognize and refine dreams, [imagine] light rays radiate from A. Think and say aloud, “All the lotus array is illusion. This is a dream.” During all daily activities, remember the intentionality of illusion and dream.
dbang du sdud na sgrub bya thams cad a'i 'od zer gyis bkug nas yi ge dang pad+ma la bstim nas 'dun pa dang chags pa drag tu btang ngo / /
To bring under control, all the objects of accomplishment are drawn in by the A’s light rays and dissolve into the letters and lotus. Then intensely arouse intentionality and passion.

bde ba 'dod na 'og rlung bskum pad+ma bde ba'i rang bzhin (321) 'khor bas/ rang gi sha la reg ge byung nas bde ba khyad par can skyes par bsam/ drod 'dod na a las 'od zer tsha ba'i rang bzhin 'phros/ yi ge bzhi dang pad+ma las 'od dmar po tsha ba'i rang bzhin 'phros pas/ khong pa thams cad khengs te tsha bas tshig nas brgyal ba tsam du bsams nas/ pad+ma myur du 'khor ba la shes pa ma yangs par gtad pas lus me'i gong bur 'gyur ro/ /

If you want bliss, contract the lower winds, causing the lotus, which is the nature of bliss, to circle. {321} As it touches your flesh, think that special bliss is aroused. If you wish for warmth, light rays the nature of heat radiate from A. Red light the nature of heat radiates from the four letters and the lotus, filling all your insides. Think that, burned by the heat, you almost faint. The lotus spins rapidly; focus your consciousness on that without distraction while your body becomes a fireball.

lha sku rang shar dang yul snang gtan la phebs pa dang / 'od gsal la sogs pa'i gsal snang dang / mthong snang myur du 'ong bar 'dod na/ lte ba'i a dang yi ge bzhi 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsams pas/ nyin mtshan kun tu ma yengs par bya/ khyad par du a'i 'od kyis spyir khong pa'i nang dang / khyad par du lte ba'i nang thams cad 'od kyis khengs shing / 'od kyi nang na a gsal ba de las ma yengs par bya/ de dmigs pa gtso bas gnyid dang 'gro 'chag sogs kyi dus su/ dmigs pa brtan par bya ba gal che gsung /

If you want the natural arising of the deity’s form, the ascertaining of objective appearance, the clear appearance of lucid clarity and such,[12] and for the perceived appearance to arrive quickly, imagine that the A at the navel and the four letters are the nature of light and maintain undistracted attention day and night. In particular, with the light of A inside your body in general and especially the entire inside of the navel filled with light, focus without distraction on the clarity of A within that light. With that as the main visualization, it is said to be important to maintain stable visualization when you sleep or move about and so forth.

bzlas pa dang dmigs pa de rnams la skyo na bde bas bsdu par bya ste/ a las 'od 'phros nam mkha' thams cad khengs/ lha'i bu mo'i gsang gnas nas byang sems dmar po'i rnam par bkug nas/ yi ge bzhi la thim pa dang bde phril phril byung bar bsam/ de bzhin du gzhan lnga la yang bya'o/ /

When you grow tired of the recitation and that visualization, dissolve it in bliss. Light radiates from A, filling all of space. It draws in the form of red bodhicitta from the divine girl’s secret place. Imagine that it dissolves into the four letters and you feel vibrating bliss. Do the same for the other five.
gang dbang du bya ba de mang po dpag tu med par sprul nas rje btsun ma la 'bul ba de zab par 'dug pas nyams myong gis grub pa yin gsungs so/
Whatever you control, emanate immeasurably many and offer them to Exalted Lady. It is said this is the profound way that accomplishes meditative experience.
gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams la lhag ma gcig kyang bzhag re kan/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub lo zla tsam gyis 'byung ba'i gnad kyi man ngag su kha sid+d+hi nas brgyud pa'o// //

There is absolutely nothing that has been left out of the oral instructions of this Secret Sādhana. The esoteric instructions of vital points that produces supreme and common spiritual powers in a matter of years or months is the lineage of Sukhasiddhi. {322}
IV.
IV. [Navel Emanation Chakra][13]
bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas/ (322) lte ba sprul 'khor bri bar bya/ /
Bowing at the feet of the holy gurus I write the oral instructions of the Navel Emanation Chakra.

rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar bskyed pa'i lte bar/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gcig bsam/ de'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa gcig gi lte ba las/ mdun du ha/ g.yas su ri/ rgyab tu ni/ g.yon du sa swA hA/ de ltar yi ge 'bru bdun po de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang gi nus pa dang phrin las thams cad ma lus par bsdus nas yi ge /pad+ma chos 'byung dang bcas pa la bstim mo/ /

Instantly you are generated as Exalted Lady. Imagine at the navel, from E (A?), a tetrahedral source of phenomena, white outside and red inside. Within that is a four-petaled red lotus. From its center, to the front is ha, to the right ri, to the back ni, and to the left sa svā hā. Light radiates from those seven seed syllables. It draws in all the magnetizing ability and awakened activity of all the buddhas and bodhisattvas, which dissolve into the letters, lotus, and source of phenomena.

des yig 'bru rnams dmang zhing dbang gi nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam/ de ltar nus pa dang phrin las thams cad kyi bkrag gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i yi ge de rnams las 'od 'phros/ srid pa gsum po thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas khengs par bsam/ de dag thams cad 'od dmar por gyur/ skye 'gro sems can du gyur pa thams cad kyi 'dod yon thams cad tshur bsdus pa dang / srid gsum bkrag nyams par bsam/ de ltar 'dod yon thams cad chos 'byung du bsdus pa dang / yi ge pad+ma rnams bkrag gi rang bzhin du gyur/ yang yig 'bru las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bsgrub bya gang yin pa de rang dbang med par byung nas pad+ma'i steng du bstim/

Imagine the reddening of the seed letters and the abundance of magnetizing ability. Those letters, endowed with dazzling brilliance of all that ability and activity, radiate light. Think of the three existences filled with the five sense pleasures all becoming red light. Imagine all the sense pleasures of all sentient beings drawn back in and imagine experiencing the brilliance of the three existences. In that way, all the sense pleasures are gathered into the source of phenomena, and the letters and lotus become the nature of brilliance. Again, red light rays radiate from the seed syllables like hooks and whatever practice consort is to be achieved powerlessly appears and dissolves upon the lotus.

de nas yi ge'i steng du bla ma sku mdog dmar po gcig bsam la/ chos 'byung kha bsdus pa dang bla ma las 'od dmar po byung nas bsgrub bya de la phog pa dang / lus dmar ltem ste song nas/ lus ngag yid gsum bcer bur bsams te/ de yang lus gcer bu gos med par phyag byed pa/ ngag gcer bu ngag gus pa/ yid gcer bu dad pa gus pa gdung shugs chen po dung dung 'bral (323) mi phod par bsams la/ pad+ma myur du 'khor ba/ yi ge mi 'khor bar 'od 'phro bar bsams la/ lus mi gnas sgul bskyod/ ngag mi gnas bzlas pa/ yid mi gnas pho la byams pa/ mo la chags pa/ nor la bdun pa drag po'o/ /

Then imagine the red guru upon the letters. The opening of the source of phenomena closes and red light comes from the guru. It strikes the practice consort, and their body is filled with red. Imagine their body, speech, and mind as naked. That is, their naked body prostrates without clothes; naked speech speaks of devotion, naked mind is great forceful faith and devotion, yearning and yearning, unable to bear separation [from you]. {323} Imagine that and think of the lotus spinning rapidly while the stationary letters emit light. The nonabiding of the body is movement; the nonabiding of the speech is recitation; and the nonabiding of the mind is the male’s love, the female’s passion, and the gem’s intense longing.[14]
bsgrub bya yang bstim pa dang / bla ma la mos gus zhung zhung byed par bsam/
Think the practice consort also dissolves, and bow repeatedly with devotion to the guru.
bla ma shangs pa'i gsang sgrub lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad mi 'byung mi srid pa'i zhal gdams so// //

Based on the Secret Sādhana of the Navel Emanation Chakra by Lama Shangpa (Khyungpo Naljor), it is impossible that all supreme and common spiritual powers will not arise—such is this oral instruction.
V.
V. Close Attainment

nyer sgrub kyi skabs su rang rje btsun mar bsgoms la/ grub na bzlas pa gzhung bzhin bya/ ma grub na rang rje btsun mar bskyed pa'i mdun du bsgrub bya yod na rab/ med na gsal bar bsam pa'am/ yang na a'i 'od kyis bkug la de'i chos 'byung nang du pad+ma 'dab bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa/ ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin du bsams nas/ lus mi gnas sgul bskyod/ ngag mi gnas bzlas pa/ yid mi gnas chos nyid la bzhag nas/ ngag tu ha ri ni sa dga' zhes brjod pa dang / chos 'byung gi pad+ma dbang med du myur du 'khor bas/ de'i 'od kyis rtsa bo che dang rtsa phran thams cad dral te/ yul de bde bas brgyal ba dang / gsang gnas na mar la byang sems them bu btang ba bzhin dmar na ra ra byung ste/ rang gi mthe bong g.yas pa'i 'og tu hril hril byung ba dang / rang nyid dmar ldem gyis song bar bsam/ de'i mdangs kyis yul de kha dog dmar zhing yid myos pa dang / dad gus byed par bsgom/ oM ha ri ni sa lha'i bu mo'i lte ba'i 'og nas bde ba khug ces bya'o/ / bde ba de rang la bsdu'o/ // !

In the context of close attainment, meditate on yourself as Exalted Lady. If you have fulfilled it, do the recitation as in the main text. If not, then with yourself generated as Exalted Lady, the best is if you have the practice consort before you. If not, then visualize them clearly or, alternatively, imagine the light from A summoning them and the four-petaled lotus with letters within the source of phenomena [and so forth], as you have [previously] meditated. Then rest in the nonabiding body of movement, the nonabiding speech of recitation, and the nonabiding mind of phenomena’s nature. Then audibly say, “ha ri ni sa—joy!” The lotus in the source of phenomena uncontrollably spins rapidly. Its light rends all the major and minor channels and that practice consort faints in bliss. A red stream of bodhicitta flows from her secret place, as if the stopper had been pulled. It beads up below your right big toe. You become completely red. Through that radiance, imagine that the consort becomes red and mentally intoxicated and becomes faithfully devoted. This is called “summoning bliss from below the goddess’s navel [with] oṃ ha ri ni sa.” That bliss is gathered into you. ithi
VI.
VI. Esoteric Instructions of the Three Nails[15]
mkha' 'gro su kha sid+d+his/ gnyan ston pra dz+nyA la gdams pa gzer (324) gsum gyi man ngag yod/
These are instructions on the Three Nails that Ḍākinī Sukhasiddhi bestowed on Dharmaprajña.[16] {324}
gu ru rat+na/ tsakra saM b+ha ra/ shrI badzra yo gi ni/ na mo/
guru ratna / cakrasaṃbhara / śrīyoginī / namo

mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsang sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyi/ / khyad 'phags gzer gsum zhal gdams ni/ / spyi bor bla ma dam pa'i gzer/ / snying ga yi dam bde mchog {gi gzer} ste/ / lte ba mkha' 'gro{'i gzer} sde bzhi'o/ /

Homage to Ḍākinī Spiritual Power of Bliss. Specially exalted Three Nails instruction of the Secret Sādhana Navel Emanation Chakra: the nail of the guru on the head, (the nail of) yidam Cakrasaṃvara at the heart, (the nail of) the four ḍākinīs at the navel.
dang po bla ma'i mos gus kyis/ / sa {bcu} lam {lnga} lo {dang} zlas bgrod 'dod na/ / bde ba'i stan la skyil krung bcas/ / sems bskyed tshad med sngon song pas/ /

First, with devotion to the guru, if you wish to traverse (ten) levels and (five) paths in years (and) months, sit with crossed legs on a comfortable seat, and accomplish the awakening mind and four immeasurables.
rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal ba yi/ / spyi bor pad {ma dang} nyi'i steng du ni/ / hU~M yig nag po bsam par bya/ /
Visualize oneself as Vajrayoginī with [red] color and hand implements. On your head, upon a lotus (and) sun imagine a black letter hūṃ.
de las 'od 'phros {sems can smin grol sangs rgyas mchod} don gnyis byas/ /
Light radiates from it and accomplishes the two purposes, (ripening and liberating sentient beings and offering to the buddhas).

tshur 'dus hU~M de gyur pa las/ / bir wa pa dang dgyes mdzad 'dra/ / tha dad med par bsam par bya/ / rang gi rdo rje'i bum {sa ste nor bu'i} nang du/ / chos 'byung kha dog dmar po yi/ / nang du yi ge a dkar las/ /

Light returns and transforms the hūṃ into Virūpa and Hevajra; imagine them to be indivisible. Inside of your vajra’s vase, (the gem),[17] is a red source of phenomena and within that the white letter A.

'od 'phros don byas tshur 'dus pas/ / a de bdag med ma dang ni/ / su kha sid+d+hi gnyis med bsgom/ / de nas rlung gnyis kha sbyar te/ / steng 'og dmigs {bir wa dang su kha sid+d+hi gnyis} pa gsal ba dang / /
Light radiates, achieves two purposes, and returns. Meditate that A is Nairātmya inseparable from Sukhasiddhi. Then join the two winds, clearly visualized above and below (as Virūpa and Sukhasiddhi).
rang lus g.yas su gcus pa yi/ / bdag med ma ni lte bar byung / / g.yon du gcus pas snying ga ste/ / de bzhin g.yas g.yon sbyor ba yis/ / mgrin pa nas ni spyi gtsug gi /
Twisting your body to the right makes Nairātmya come to the navel. Twisting to the left, she comes to the heart. By that joining of right and left she goes from the throat to the crown.

tshangs bug nas ni yab {kyud kyis} la 'khyud/ / gnyis su med pa'i snyoms 'jug gis/ / zag med bde ba rgyas par bsam/ / de yi mdun du rang nyid kyi/ {dang po spyi bor bla ma'i gzer} rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom par bya/ /
From the cranial aperture she (fully) embraces the father. They enter into nondual union. Imagine the spreading of nondissipating bliss. Meditate on your root guru in front of them.
dgyes mdzad yab yum bla ma dang / / bcas pa gsal bar bsgom (325) pa la/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ /
Meditate clearly on the guru and the Hevajra couple. {325} Imagine the buddhas, bodhisattvas, and hosts of ḍākinīs all around.

de la rang {sems gzhan du} ma yengs {par rtse gcig tu} gdung ba yis/ / hU~M ring {bir wa pa hU~M su kha ma sid+d+hi haM zhes} gsol ba drag tu gdab/ / nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ rtse gcig gsol ba btab gyur na/ / phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang / / 'du ba rnam {mkha' 'gro zas nor} gsum dngos su 'byung / /

With (single-pointed focus) on that without being distracted (elsewhere), fervently supplicate with long hūṃ. (Say, “Virūpa hūṃ Sukhasiddhi haṃ.”) If you supplicate with single-pointed attention three times each day and night, outer and inner obstacles will subside and the three gatherings (of ḍākinīs, food, and wealth) will actually occur.

khyad par {mkha' 'gro} bde ba dngos grub bdag {gis} / / dngos su byin rlobs {mchog thun mong gnyis kyi} dngos grub ster/ / sa bcu lam lnga lo zlas bgrod/ / {gzhan dang} thun mong ma yin gsol 'debs so/

Especially, (Ḍākinī) Spiritual Power of Bliss will grant you blessings in person and spiritual powers (both supreme and common). You will traverse ten levels and five paths in years and months. This is the uncommon supplication (unlike others).
rang nyid rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i/ / thugs kar yi dam bde mchog ni/ / gsal la rtog pa med pa la/ / ma yengs bsgoms shing sngags bzlas na/ / rmi lam du yang rang shar 'byung / /

Yidam Cakrasaṃvara is in the heart of yourself as Exalted Vajrayoginī. If you meditate without distraction on that clarity without concept and recite the mantra, it will also arise naturally in your dreams.

de ni longs sku dngos yin no/ / lte ba {gsum pa} mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i gzer/ / a yi 'od kyis bsregs byas te/ / {lus ngag yid gsum} mi gnas gsum du nyams blangs na/ / mchog dang thun mong lo zlas 'grub/ /
rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ / gsang sgrub nye bar sgrub pa 'di/ / bsdu dang dgug dang bde ba bsdu/ / dang po skyabs 'gro bzlas pa bya/ /
This secret practice of near attainment of Exalted Vajrayoginī gathers and summons, and gathers bliss. First do the recitation of going for refuge.
de nas bsgrub bya yul gyi gnad/ / chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum du/ / pad+ma 'dab bzhi yig 'brur bcas/ / 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal bar {sgrub thabs ltar} bsgom/ /
Then for the vital point of the practice consort, meditate clearly (as in the sādhana) in the source of phenomena, on the four-petaled lotus with seed syllables as being the nature of light.

de nas a yi 'od zer gyis/ / yig 'bru bzhi po gnad bskul nas/ / ha ri ni sa dga' zhes pa/ / ngag tu brjod pas rkyen byas nas/ / yig 'bru pad+ma'i 'od zer gyis/ / rtsa chen rtsa phran thams cad khengs/ /

Then light rays from A evoke the vital points of the four syllables. Audibly saying “ha ra ni sa—joy” creates the condition for light rays from the lotus and four syllables to fill up all the greater and lesser channels.
bsgrub bya bde ba rgyas gyur nas/ / bde ba'i rgyu ni {rtsa thams cad nas} g.yos gyur (326) te/ / 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma nyi ma ni/ / them bu btang pa bzhin byung nas/ /
The practice consort’s bliss increases, and the cause of bliss is movement (from all the channels). {326} The sun of the radiance of the four elements comes out as if the plug were pulled.
rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i/ / zhabs g.yas mthe bong 'og tu ni/ / me tog hril hril 'dus par bsam/ / rang dang bsgrub bya gang yin pa/ / rgya skag mdog ltar gyur nas kyang / /
You appear clearly as Exalted Lady. Imagine beneath the right big toe, the flower rolled up in a bead. You and whoever the practice consort is become the color of lac dye.

gus {sgrub byed bdag la} ldan {pa dang zhing} bde ba rgyas par bsam/ / mi gnas {lus lha ngag sngags sems chos nyid} gsum po gsal ba gces/ / de nas dgug pa'i sbyor ba ni/ / chos rab chos 'byung gzhal yas su/ / pad+ma yig 'bru gong bzhin bsam/ /

Imagine (the consort’s) devotion (to you and) bliss increasing. Clarifying three nonabidings (body as deity, speech as mantra, mind as the nature of phenomena) is crucial. Then the application of summoning. Imagine as before the lotus and seed syllables in the celestial palace of excellent features, the source of phenomena.
khyad par a ni dmar po las/ / 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ / yi ge bzhi yi gsang gnas song / / drod kyis {yi ge'i} bde ba'i gnas bskul nas/ / pad+ma {g.yas bskor} dbang med drag 'khor te/ /

In particular, the A is red and emits red light rays that go to the secret place of the four letters. Warmth evokes the place of (the letters’) bliss and the lotus uncontrollably spins (turning to the right).
pad+mas pad+ma bcad pa dang / / rang byung me tog bcas nas su/ / byung ste mthe bong g.yas ba'i 'og / hril hril dbang med 'dus bsam mnan/ /
A lotus breaks off [from] the lotus and comes from the self-occurring flower. Imagine underneath the right big toe it gathers uncontrollably into beads, [then] press.

pad+ma bcad cing mnan pa dang / / 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ / rtsa khengs bde ba rgyas gyur pas/ / lus dmar gus ldan nyams shed chung / / blta mi phod cing nyi ma'i rgyun/ rkang 'og dbang med 'dus par bsam/ /

The lotus breaking off and the pressing and the red light rays radiating fill the channels and increase the bliss. With red body, devoted and relaxed, she cannot bear to look; the flow of the sun uncontrollably gathers under foot.
bcad dang rang byung res mos bsgom/ / sngags ni gong bzhin bzlas par bya/ / rjes la gsang ba'i gnas su bstim/ /
Meditate by turn on the breaking off and the self-occurring [flower]. Recite the mantra as before. Afterward dissolve into the secret place.
sngon du bsnyen pa thems pa dang / / rang dang mdun bskyed gsal ba gsum/ / 'dzom {par} gyur {na} skad cig gcig gis ni/ / mi gnas ma yengs bsgoms gyur na/ /

The previous fulfillment of the recitation requisite, the clarity of yourself, and of the front visualization: these three converge and moment by moment you meditate without distraction in nonabiding.

'du ba gsum dang 'char ba {lus bde ngag nus sems rtogs pa} gsum/ / lo zla tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ / dbang bzhi khyad 'phags chu rgyun gyis/ / bde ba bsdu ba'i rim pa ni/ / snod ldan gzhan la bskur {maN+Dal sogs byas nas} ba'o/

The three gatherings and the three arisings (physical bliss, verbal ability, mental realization), will be achieved in just years and months. The stages of gathering the bliss by the water stream of especially exalted four empowerments should be conferred on other worthy recipients (having done the mandala, etc.).
rang (327) nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe/ / skyabs 'gro bzlas pa {nas tsam ste} grub tshad bya/ / de nas rang nyid bde mchog gi / lte ba'i a las 'od 'phros pas/ /
When doing the practice yourself {327}, do from the recitation of refuge (through) the full measure of practice. Then you are Cakrasaṃvara with light radiating from A in the navel.

lha mo mdog dkar {bal ser ba'i} gzi mdangs can/ / bde ba'i mdangs ldan gzhon sha sgeg / pany+tsa li {lha'i gos} dang rin po che/ / sna tshogs brgyan pa'i gsang gnas su/ / 'od de phog pas mdun du byon/ /

The goddess is white with a brilliant (golden) radiance, she is youthful and charming with a blissful glow, adorned by various jewels and Pāñcālikā’s (divine garments). That light strikes her secret place and she arrives before you.
de yi gsang gnas gsal bar bsgom/ / de nas rang gi dbang po'i rtser/ / mthing nag hU~M las 'od zer lnga/ / 'phros pas chos 'byung gnas su song / / rtsa 'dab khengs pas bde ba rgyas/ /

Meditate clearly on her secret place. Then on the tip of your organ the blue-black hūṃ radiates light rays of five [colors] to the source of phenomena, filling the channel spokes and increasing bliss.
de yi bde ba'i 'od zer gyis/ / tshur la drag tu bsdus nas ni/ / rang gi dbang po'i gnas na yar/ / song nas rtsa 'dab thams cad {rje btsun mas} khengs/ /
Light rays of bliss from that gather forcefully on their return. They move up inside your organ and all your channel spokes are filled (by Exalted Lady).

de yis bde ba skyes pa dang / / 'og rlung drag bskum {lha mo'i/} bsus pa sbyar/ / bde stong gnyis su med par bsgom/ / yang gcig hU~M las 'od 'phros nas/ / bde ba gong bzhin bkug pa yis/ / rang lus zag med bde bas rgyas/ /

Bliss is born and forcefully raising the lower wind joins (the goddess’s) belly. Meditate on bliss and emptiness inseparable. Once again light radiates from hūṃ and draws in the bliss as above. Undissipating bliss increases in your body.

gsal stong gnyis su med par bsgom/ / de nas lha mo rje btsun ma/ / rang la gnyis med 'khyud nas ni/ / thabs dang shes rab bsrubs pa yis/ / drod kyis bde ba'i gnad bskul nas/ / yum gyi rang byung nyi ma'i rgyun/ /

Meditate on clarity and emptiness inseparable. Then the goddess, Exalted Lady, embraces you in nondual [union]. The churning of method and wisdom makes warmth that evokes the vital points of bliss; the mother’s self-arising sun flow.
bde ba phun sum tshogs pa de/ / rdo rje nas ni khong pa yi/ / nang na yar la song ba yis/ / rtsa chen rtsa phran thams cad khengs/ / bde bas rgyud ni gang zhing rgyas/ /
That excellent abundance of bliss goes up inside the vajra and fills all the greater and lesser channels. Bliss fills your being and expands.
rang lus zag med bde ba rgyas/ / rang lus rak+ta'i mdog ltar gyur/ / de yis yum ni dbang du 'du/ / rang gi de kun phar 'phros pas/ / yum de bde ba rgyas gyur nas/ /
Undissipating bliss increases in your body. Your body turns the color of rakta, controlling the mother. Your own kunda radiates over and the mother’s bliss expands.

dkar {yum gyi mdog} la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pas/ / yum ni yab kyi dbang du 'gyur/ / de ltar yab yum 'od 'khrug cing / (328) bde bas rgyud ni gang ba'i tshe/ / 'og rlung drag tu bskum pa dang / / bde bas stong pa'i don bstan cing / /
stong pas bde la chags mi bya/ / bde stong gnyis med ye shes mchog / dmar ba yun ring dkar ba thung / / gnad kyi mchog tu shes par bya/ /
[But] do not let emptiness attach to bliss; supreme timeless awareness is nondual bliss-emptiness. The red lasts long, the white is short. Understand the supreme vital points.
snang stong lha sku bde chen la/ / gsal la rtog pa med par bzhag / de ltar yab yum gnyis med kyi/ / ngang nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ / oM ha ri ni sa la sogs bzlas/ /
Rest without thought in the clarity of great bliss in the deity’s form of empty appearance. Do the recitation within that state of the nonduality of mother-father: reciting oṃ ha ri ni sa and so on.
de yis lha sku phyag rgya che/ / zhen pa'i dri ma thams cad dang / / bral bas rang shar dag tu 'gyur/ / de yis gang 'dul lhun gyis grub/ /
Through that, the mahāmudrā of deity’s form free of all stains of clinging, becomes self-arising purity, spontaneously present for all disciples.

de ni mthar thug 'bras bu'o/ / dri za bram ze gdol pa dang / / mi dang klu la de bzhin no/ / thun mong ma yin dbang bzhi 'di/ / snod dang ldan pas nyams blangs na/ / 'du ba gsum dang 'tshar gsum 'byung / /

That is the ultimate fruition. Practice in the same way with [partners of] gandharva, brahmin, caṇḍāla, human, and nāga. This uncommon fourfold empowerment if practiced by worthy recipients, will produce the three gatherings and three arisings.
khyad par {su kha sid+d+hi} bdag gis dngos grub ster/ / rje btsun ma ni drug po yang / / lo zlas zhal mthong yum gyur nas/ / bcu gsum sa la 'gro bar 'gyur/ /

In particular, (Sukhasiddhi said), “I will grant you spiritual powers. The Exalted Lady, as those six [partners] will be seen in months or years, and become the mother consort. You will proceed to the thirteenth level.”
de skad su kha sid+d+his gsungs/ / ston ka rin chen 'byung ldan dus/ / DA ki 'du ba'i ri gong du/ / zhag bdun bar du bzhugs nas kyang / /
These words were spoken by Sukhasiddhi in the autumnal time of precious sources, at Rigong, the ḍākinīs’ gathering place, where she remained for seven days.

{su kha sid+d+his sangs rgyas} dbang bzhi bskur zhing {gsang sngags kyi} gnad rnams gsungs/ / rnam dag bde chen lung bstan mdzad/ / 'gro 'dul su kha sid+d+hi yis/ gnyan ston d+harma pra dz+nya {chos kyi shes rab} la/ / {DA kis} ji skad gsung bzhin {gnyan ston gyis} yi ger bkod/ / {slob ma} gcig las mang {su kha sid+d+his} na bka' rgya yod/ //

(Sukhasiddhi) conferred four empowerments (to Sangye), taught the vital points (of Secret Mantra), and prophesied authentic pure great bliss. So the tamer of beings, Sukhasiddhi, taught Nyentön Dharmaprajña (Chökyi Sherap). The (ḍāki’s) exact words are written down (by Nyentön).[18] This carries (Sukhasiddhi’s) command seal of [no] more than one (disciple). ithi /
mang+ga laM/ (329)
maṅgalaṃ
@#/ /su kha ma sid+d+hi phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod bzhugs so/ /
19. Sukhasiddhi’s Introduction to Mahāmudrā[1]
na mo/
namo
I.
I. Introduction to Mahāmudrā
mkha' 'gro rig pa'i ngo sprod ni/ / nam mkha' ris med stong pa la/ / rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba gcun/ / rtsa ba gcun nas rang sor zhog /
Ḍākinī’s pointing out of intrinsic awareness: in empty space without distinction, tame mind’s root with awareness. Tame the root, then rest naturally.
bskyed rim bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang / / g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag / g.yas pa'i khu tshur mdzub sgreng phyar/ / rdzi dang nyi mas mi gnod pa'i/ / nam mkha'i dkyil du gcer gyis blta/ /
Creation phase and recitation completed, place the left fist at the heart, and raise up the right fist. Stare nakedly at the center of the sky unobstructed by wind or sun.
rig pa ngar btags dbang po bzlog / shes pa hur thon lus cha sgrim/ / rlung yang cung zad bzung byas la/ / rang gi lte bar a gcig bsgom/ /
Heighten awareness and reverse the faculties [inward]. Wake up consciousness, tighten the body, and slightly holding the winds, meditate on an A in your navel.

dbu ma nas brgyud tshang sgo nas/ / nam mkhar 'phur te yal ba dang / / chos nyid spros dang bral ba dang / / sems nyid spros dang bral ba dang / / spros bral nam mkha'i ngang nyid du/ / ma bcos so ma nyid du zhog /

It courses up the central channel, out the cranial aperture, flies into space, and disappears. The nature of phenomena free of elaboration, the nature of mind free of elaboration, free of elaboration within space itself; rest in freshness without contrivance.

rtog pa'i rkyen gyis ma bslad par/ / phaT kyis rig pa mnan nas bskul/ / so ma so ma nyid du bzhag / rtog pa'i rkyen gyis g.yengs pa dang / / btang snyoms le los grol ba med/ / tha mal shes pa rang lugs 'di/ / ma bcos ngang du klod pa la/ /

Without corruption caused by concepts, press awareness by phaṭ, then evoke it. Rest freshness in freshness itself. Without distraction caused by concepts, without loosening equanimity through laziness, relax within the uncontrived state of this natural condition of ordinary mind.
bsgom par bya ba ci yang med/ / sgom 'dod blo de skyur la thong / / kho rang rang gi gshis la zhog / rjes shes snang grags chos rnams kun/ / rmi lam sgyu mar rtogs par bya/ /

There is nothing at all to meditate on here, discard any idea of wanting to meditate. Rest awareness in its own innate disposition. Afterward realize all phenomena— consciousness, appearance, and sound—as dream and illusion.
