lhan skyes zung 'jug srid gsum bde chen dngos/ / dmigs med thugs rjes khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan zad mi mnga'/ / chos dbyings rnam dag g.yo med khyod la 'dud/ /

Coemergent integral unity, the real great bliss of three existences, liberates all migrators in three realms with nonreferential compassion. Inexhaustible qualities of knowledge, love, and power; I bow to you, unwavering purity of the realm of phenomena.
nyid kyi ye shes gcig gi rang snang las/ / ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas sprin spro ba/ / bden pa gnyis kyi rnam thar tshad mi mnga'/ / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor 'dud/ /

The natural appearance of your single timeless awareness emanates clouds of every buddha and their heirs. Your liberation story of two truths knows no bounds; I bow to the united essence of all buddhas.
khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang / / bdag med ma dang rje btsun bir wa pa/ / rgyal ba kun bskyed bde ba'i dngos grub dang / / sa bcu'i dbang phyug ni gu ma la 'dud/ /
Pervasive master, lord of the wheel, Vajradhara, Nairātmya and Venerable Virūpa, birth mother of all victors, Spiritual Power of Bliss, and mighty one of ten levels, Niguma; I bow.
mai tri pa dang bsod nams 'byung gnas sbas/ / rA hu la sogs mkhas grub brgya lnga bcu/ / khyung po rnal 'byor rin chen brtson 'grus dang / / dpon ston gnyan ston chos rje ston par 'dud/ /
I bow to Maitrīpa and Puṇyakāra, Rāhula, and all hundred and fifty learned adepts, Khyungpo Naljor, Rinchen Tsöndru, Öntön [Kyergangpa], Nyentön, and Chöje Tönpa.
mkhas grub rnam gsum khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ / ras chen shangs dkar sangs rgyas dpal bzang po/ / nam rgyal legs rgyal grol mchog lha dbang grags/ / rje btsun chen po tA ra nA thar 'dud/ /
I bow to Khedrup [Shangtön], Khyungpo Tsultrim Gön, [Ritrö] Rechen, Shangkar, Sangye Palzangpo, Namgyal, Lekgyal, Drolchok, Lhawang Drak, and to the great Venerable Tāranātha.
rgyal mtshan dpal bzang rdo rje gzhon nu che/ / nam mkha'i rnal 'byor byang sems sbyin pa bzang / / grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po sogs/ / ring brgyud nye brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /
I bow to Gyaltsen Palzang, great Dorje Zhönu, Namkhai Naljor, Jangsem Jinpa Zang, mighty adept Tangtong Gylapo, and others; to all the gurus of long and direct lineages.
phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/
Present the outer offerings.
mdog bzang dbyibs legs tshims pa'i dri bsung can/ / man+dA ra dang ut+pal ku mud sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i me tog kun/ / skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /

I offer all actual and imagined flowers with nice colors, good shapes, and satisfying fragrance, such as coral tree, utpala, and water lily, to the assembly of glorious gurus, the supreme refuge. {364}
oM (364) rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra badzra puSh+pe pU dza me g+ha sa mu dra s+pha ra Na sa ma ye hU~M/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra puṣpe pūja megha samudra spharaṇa samaye hūṃ
rgyu bzang mnams na zhim pa'i dri ngad can/ / a ga ru dang tsan+dan sprul snying sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i bdug spos kun/ / skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/

I offer all actual and imagined incense with delicious aromas when their fine ingredients are sensed, such as aloe, sandalwood, and snake heart[4] to the assembly of glorious gurus, the supreme refuge.
oM rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra badzra d+hU pe pU dza me g+ha sa mu dra s+pha ra Na sa ma ye hU~M/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra dhūpe pūja megha samudra spharaṇa samaye hūṃ
mun sel dngos kun gsal ba'i gzi brjid can/ / sgron me nyi zla lus kyi 'od la sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i snang gsal kun/ / skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /

I offer all actual and imagined light with brilliant illumination of all things to dispel darkness, such as lamps, fire, moon, sun, and body radiance, to the assembly of glorious gurus, the supreme refuge.
oM rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra badzra A lo ke pU dza me g+ha sa mu dra s+pha ra Na sa ma ye hU~M/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra āloke pūja megha samudra spharaṇa samaye hūṃ
dri zhim byug na bde ba'i reg mchog kun/ / ga bur gla rtsi mnom pa'i dri la sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i dri mchog kun/ / skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /

I offer all actual and imagined perfume with the supreme touch of bliss when their sweet scent is spread, such as camphor, musk, compounded scents,[5] and others to the assembly of glorious gurus, the supreme refuge.
oM rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra badzra gan+d+he pU dza me g+ha sa mu dra s+pha ra Na sa ma ye hU~M/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra gandhe pūja megha samudra spharaṇa samaye hūṃ
mdog bzang myangs na bde ba'i ro bcud can/ / 'bras chan ka ra rgya gtar khu ba sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i zhal zas kun/ / skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /
I offer all actual and imagined food with fine color and nutritious flavor of bliss when tasted, such as jackfruit, sugarcane, and blood soup, to the assembly of glorious gurus, the supreme refuge.
oM rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra nai bid+ya pU dza me g+ha sa mu dra s+pha ra Na sa ma ye hU~M/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra naividya pūja megha samudra spharaṇa samaye hūṃ
don zab thos na snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ / rnga chen dung dang pheg rdob rgyud mangs sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i sil snyan kun/ / skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /
I offer all actual and imagined music with sweet melodies and profound meaning when heard, such as big drums, horns, cymbals, and lutes, to the assembly of glorious gurus, the supreme refuge. {365}
oM rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra shab+da pU dza me g+ha sa mu dra s+pha ra Na sa ma ye hU~M/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra śabda pūja megha samudra spharaṇa samaye hūṃ
srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos/ / mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ / mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ / bdag kyang rdo (365) rje'i sku thob shog /
I offer the soft, light fabric of the gods to clothe the form of your immutable vajra. When I offer with undivided faith, may I also obtain the vajra body.
oM rat+na gu ru sa pa ri bA ra badzra was+t+ra ya AHhU~M swA hA/ /
oṃ ratna guru saparivāra vajra vastraya āḥ hūṃ svāhā

mgon khyed bkres skyems mi mnga' yang / / 'o thug bur khu bdud rtsi'i chu/ / bza' dang bca' ba rgya chen po/ / kha dog dri ngad ro ldan pa/ / thams cad sbyar ba bshos kyi mchog / kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ /

Lord, though you have no hunger or thirst, [I offer] drinks of milk soup, syrup, and elixir, together with vast amounts of food imbued with color, smell, and taste, all added into this excellent food. Please accept in ever-excellent great bliss.
bde ba'i dngos grub dkyil 'khor gtso/ / bla ma mchog dang tha mi dad/ / bka' brgyud thams cad khyed kyi 'phrul/ de phyir snying nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /
Spiritual Power of Bliss, principal of the mandala, inseparable from my supreme guru, all the precept lineage is your emanation, therefore I pay homage from my heart.
bdag ni skyabs gnas gzhan kun pas/ / ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang / / lhag par yang ni dad lags pa/ / rmongs pas ma yin rgyu dang bcas/ /
As for me, I have more faith in a single pore of your body than for all other sources of refuge. Not through folly; there is a reason:
sangs rgyas kun las ches lhag par/ / rgyud sde kun tu rgyal bas bsngags/ / mdo sogs kun tu mtshungs par gsungs/ / rgyal bas nan tan bstod la 'dud/ /
In all the tantras the victors praised you as higher than all buddhas, and said the same in all sutras and such. I bow to you who are ever praised by the victors.
phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa rgyal sras kyis/ / byang sems rdo rje bzhin du blta/ thams cad nyin re dus bzhi ru/ / phyag 'tshal mchod nas 'di skad du/ /
The victors’ heirs and guides in ten directions, regarding you as the Awakening Vajra, paid homage and offerings in the four times of every day and proclaimed this:
bdag cag de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ / pha ma ston pa khyed ces sgrog / ston pa rdo rje 'dzin khyod la/ / skyob par bcas pas phyag 'tshal lo/
“The parent of all the tathāgatas is you, our teacher.” Teacher, vajra holder, to you we pay homage and go for refuge.
grangs med bskal par rgyal rnams la/ / rin chen zhing mchog phul ba bas/ / khyed kyi sku la til mar gyi/ / thig pas mchod na'ang bsod nams mchog /
There is more good merit in offering a drop of sesame oil to your body than offering the supreme jewel realm to the victors for incalculable eons.
ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyi/ / ye shes ma lus khyod las byung / / mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ / rje btsun khyod la mchod cing 'dud/ /
If you ask for what reason: all buddhas’ timeless awareness comes from you. I will abandon all other offerings and offer and bow to you, Venerable One.
rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub chogs/ / nyid kyi sku gsung thugs la gnas/ / khyod ni gang la'ang mi gnas te/ / mkha' (366) mnyam 'od gsal rmad byung che/ /
All spiritual powers of the three vajras abide in your awakened body, speech, and mind. But you do not abide anywhere; {366} your great wonder is lucid clarity equaling space.
rtsod pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje sems/ / dngos su mthong ba'i skal med pas/ / slob dpon gzugs kyis sgrub rnams la/ / brtse bas mchod pa len la 'dud/ /
In this time of strife, beings have no fortune to see the real Vajrasattva. I bow to those who practice in a master’s body and accept offerings out of love.
rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ye shes lnga/ / 'gro ba 'dul phyir phung po lnga/ / tshad med lha mo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/ / 'byung bzhir ston pa ya mtshan rmad/ /
To tame migrators, their five aggregates are the fivefold awareness in five-family mandalas. The four immeasurable goddesses in the mandala indicate the four elements—so marvelous.
spyan sogs yang ni sems dpa' brgyad/ / tshigs sogs yang dag khro bo bcu/ / gzugs sogs yang ni rdo rje ma/ / ye shes sku la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /

Their eyes and so forth are the eight bodhisattvas, their joints and so forth are the pure ten wrathful ones, their bodies and so forth are vajra females: I pay homage to the forms of timeless awareness.
skye 'chi can gyi sku'o zhes/ / log par bzung ba gnong zhing 'gyod/ / de bas bsam pa thag pas bshags/ / bdag kyang khyod ltar mngon gyur cig /
“Your body is subject to birth and death.” I’m ashamed and regret all such mistakes, and moreover sincerely acknowledge them. May I manifestly become like you.
byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ / bcom ldan sku yi cha shas lags/ / cod pan rigs lnga ba spu rnams/ / dgra bcom lags te de bas 'dud/ /
The thirty-seven factors of enlightenment are surely part of the Bhagavat’s body. The crown is the five families, all the pores are surely the arhats; I bow to you.
'jig rten lha rnams khyed kyi gdan/ / srid gsum bla ma khyed nyid lags/ / khyed ni dkon mchog gsum lags shing / / rin chen gsum gyi byed por gsungs/ /
The worldly gods are your seat, the three existences are surly you, Guru. You are surely the Three Jewels, creator of the three precious ones.
g.yo sgyu tshig tsam ma yin par/ / deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi/ / lhag par dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Not with mere hypocritical words, from now until the heart of awakening, I sincerely go for refuge, and pay homage with utmost faith.[6]
bar 'dir maN+Dal tshom bu so bdun ma spyi mthun rgyas pa dang /
At this juncture, do the standard thirty-seven-heap extensive mandala and this Mandala of the Sealed Word:
bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maN+Dal mchog / dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas/ / gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes/ / phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan/ /

The sublime mandala exquisitely arrayed, majestic mountain in the center, four continents and lesser lands, the illuminating sun and moon circling, beautifying. Outside the iron mountains, between them rolling oceans adorn.
rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ / rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter dang brgyad/ / ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ / phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi (367) khyab/ /

Jewels, wish-fulfilling trees, bountiful cows, seven royal emblems plus the treasure vase, the eighth, harvest that needs no toil, water with eight qualities, unimaginable clouds of outer, inner, and secret offerings. {367}
dga' dang spro ba skyed pa'i maN+Dal 'di/ / don gnyis bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / brtson pa'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam dang / / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbul bar bya/ /
This delightful and pleasing mandala offered by a yogin who seeks to achieve both purposes, I offer on the strength of my diligence to guru, yidam, and the ocean of victorious ones.
sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas/ / mnyes byed maN+Dal bzang po 'di phul bas/ / nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun spangs nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /
This yogin, descendant of all the buddhas, offers this excellent, pleasing mandala. Please remove the mass of defects, faults, and stains, and grant the supreme and common spiritual powers.[7]
zhes maN+Dal bka' rgya ma'ang 'bul/
[…Mandala of the Sealed Word]
'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dam pa dang / / blon po glang po rta mchog dmag dpon te/ / rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpag med kyang / / mngon par sprul nas bla ma mchog la 'bul/ /
Sacred wheel, gem, queen, minister, elephant, supreme steed, and army commander, the seven precious emblems of royalty, I emanate and offer to the supreme guru.
ral gri pags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang / / gzims cha gos dang mchil l+h+wam rin po che/ / bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /
Precious swords, skins, gardens, mansions, seats, garments, and boots, I offer to the guru and mandala deities; please accept them and grant me blessings.
rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul/ / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bde ster ma/ / me long pi wang sbos khang bza' btung snod/ / ras phran bzang dang pad+ma b+hany+dza na/ /
The victors’ fulfilled wishes in goddess style: goddesses give bliss of form, sound, smell, taste, and texture [with] mirror, lute, incense burner, food vessel, fine soft cloth, and padma bhañja.
cang te'u sgra sgrog kha T+wAM la brten ma/ / dkar sngo ser dang dmar dang ljang ba'i gzugs/ / gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri ldan bcud ldan ma/ / bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma/ /

Goddesses who play clay drums, resting on khaṭvāṅgas, with bodies white, blue, yellow, red, and green. Goddesses with beautiful form, sweet sound, fragrance, and nutrition. Goddesses who mature the haughty through blissful youth.
nam mkha' gang bas bla ma lha tshogs mchod/ / bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ma/ / pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can/ / rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan/ /

me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma/ / gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma/ / bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma/ / rdo rje rig ma dga' bas (368) rol pa 'dis/ / he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /
khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang / / reg na bde ba lha yi gos/ / mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang / / glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog /
Sacred ponds for bathing, divine clothing blissful to touch, garuḍas, bulls, peacocks, oxen, horses, and other supreme mounts.
dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba/ / ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog dang / / dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i mchog / bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /
bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / / dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/
I offer my body and possessions, and all my virtue from the three times.

gser dngul mu tig bai DUr+Ya/ / rin chen zhing rnams bkang nas 'bul/ / dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar/ / ma rgad bye ru dzam+bu'i gser/ / zla shel rin chen bdun gyi ri/ / zhing gi rdul snyed dbul bar bgyi/ /

I offer realms filled with precious jewels: gold, silver, pearl, chrysoberyl, sapphire, diamond, ruby, emerald, coral, Jambu gold, moon crystal, and mountains of seven gems, as numerous as atoms in the realm, I offer.
ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ / dzA ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ / me tog karni ka ra dang / / mA li ka dang yu thi ka / me tog ka ra lbI ra yang / / bsam gtan stobs kyis khyod la 'bul/ /
Utpala lotus in five colors, three colors of nutmeg flowers, karnikar-tree flowers, chinaberry flowers, ornamental jasmine, and oleander flowers,[8] I offer you by the powers of meditation.
mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang / rna rgyan dang ni gdub bu dang / / mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang / /
Fearless lions, jeweled throne, excellent seat of lotus, sun, and moon. Earrings, bracelets, anklets, necklaces, and perfect rings,
gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ / dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas/ / rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ / dkar dang gnag dang ser skya dang /
golden sashes carried for offerings,[9] crowns with silk scarves, long garlands, red, gold, white, black, and pale-yellow victory banners.
de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang / / me tog phreng ba du ma dang / / bla bre dag las dar dpyangs pa'i/ / mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /
Also clothing of various kinds, many flower garlands, canopies hung with silken arrows and curtains, so beautiful.
de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis/ / rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya/ /
Also I offer food and drink through deep quiescence.
gser ni brgya stong du ma dang / / rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / / ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang / / glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang / /
Gold in the hundreds of thousands, a variety of precious jewels, cloth of a hundred fabrics interwoven, elephants, horses, and estates,
chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ / bran pho bran mo sring mo dang / / blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ / bdag nyid (369) kyang ni dbul bar bgyi/ /
good spouses and children, male and female servants and siblings, with intelligence and inspiration I offer myself as well. {369}
bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ / dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog / sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso/ /
nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog / sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing / / bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga/ / shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi/ /
supreme drink of flawless peace, the five ingredients for [making] intoxicants: honey, molasses, grain, composite, and tree sap; I offer these as the nature of wisdom.
oM AHhU~M/
oṃ āḥ hūṃ
thabs shes lhan cig sbyor ba las/ / rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa'i/ / zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa/ / gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi/ /
From the union of method and wisdom together, melting bliss, the nature of perfectly pure appearance, completely pervades the three realms. May this secret offering please you.
khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ / sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med/ / nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ / khyed kyi sku ni ston mdzad 'dud/ /
Your form is without hollow spaces, neither flesh, bones, nor blood, like rainbows in the sky; I bow to the teaching of your body.
sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang med/ / bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang / / khyed ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir/ / 'jig rten bya ba ston mdzad 'dud/ /
Your form is without disease or filth, without feelings of hunger or thirst, since the whole world follows you; I bow to teaching of worldly deeds.
chu zla bzhin du gzung du med/ / chos rnams gang la'ang gnas pa med/ / nga rgyal med cing mi gnas pa/ / dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Nothing to cling to, like the moon in water, all phenomena do not abide anywhere. Without pride and nowhere abiding: homage and praise to you, the inconceivable.
gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims/ / spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ / rtag par mnyam par 'jog gyur pa'i/ / dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Going and sitting and also sleeping, in all regular activities you always remain in equipoise: homage and praise to you, the inconceivable.
sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ / rdzu 'phrul che la rnam 'phrul cing / / sna tshogs min la snyoms 'jug pa'i/ / dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/
Illusion-like meditative absorption while projecting great magical manifestations is equilibrium in the lack of various distinctions: homage and praise to you, the inconceivable.
khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing / / nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la/ / 'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa'i/ / dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Free of the three realms, equal to space, unsullied by desires: homage and praise to you, the inconceivable.
phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang / / skye mched rnams la mi brten cing / / phyin ci log las rnam grol ba'i/ / dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
rnam rtog (370) med cing kun rtog med/ / thugs ni rab tu mi gnas la/ / bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ / dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Without concepts and without conceptuality, your mind is totally nonabiding, unimaginable awakened mind: homage and praise to you, the inconceivable.
ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing / / spros med gos pa med pa ltar/ / mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ / dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Just as space does not abide anywhere, free of embellishment and untainted, your mind is equal to space: homage and praise to you, the inconceivable.[10]

'gro ba chu yi zla ba bzhin du lta ba dang / / thos pa brag cha dang ni mtshungs par dag 'jug / sems kyang mya ngan smig rgyu lta bur blta bya zhing / / 'di ltar bza' dang btung ba dag ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /
Migrators are seen like the moon in water, what’s heard is like echoes, genuinely engaged, mind beyond misery seen as a mirage, so with food and drink, which are like the sky,

dri ni nam mkha'i me tog mtshungs par gnas pa dang / / yid ni nyi ma zla ba lta bur khyab pa nyid/ / yang dag gnas pa de yang ri bo mchog dang mtshungs pa yin/ / gzhon nu ma yi rmi lam ji bzhin rmi bar bya/ /
smell is sensed like the scent of sky flowers, mentation pervades like the sun and the moon, genuine abiding is like the Supreme Mountain, like dreaming of a young love in a dream.

tha snyad dag ni sgyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur brjod/ / 'di ltar ji bzhin lhan skyes bde 'byung de bzhin te/ / srid pa'i rang bzhin bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ / rtag tu 'char ba bde gshegs lam mchog dag gis mchod/ /

Conventions are like expressions of illusory mirages, their actual nature like the source of coemergent bliss, while existence has no intrinsic nature, unimaginable mind, always arising, is the sugatas’ sublime path: homage and praise.[11]
zab zhi spros dang bral ba gnyug ma'i don/ / snang dang stong pa gnyis dang gnyis min la/ / e ma ho 'di snyam bral ba'i lta ba can/ / bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyod la 'dud/ /
Profound peace, free of embellishment, the native state, appearance and emptiness, these two are not two. Wonderful, this view free of thought: I bow to you, the innate play of great bliss.
smra bsam brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la/ / bde stong 'dzin pa med pa bde ba'i nyams/ / e ma ho rtsol bral lhug pa'i sgom pa can/ / bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud/ /

The nature without expression, thought, or utterance, is experience of bliss without fixation on bliss or emptiness. Wonderful, relaxing in meditation without effort: I bow to you, the innate play of great bliss.
spang blang byar med rang bzhin 'od gsal la/ / gzung 'dzin glo bur dri ma rnam dag pa/ / e ma ho rang bzhin lhun grub 'bras bu can/ / bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud/ /
Natural lucid clarity, without rejecting or accepting, is pure of incidental stains of dualistic fixation. Wonderful, the natural coemergent fruition: I bow to you, the innate play of great bliss.
zhes phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod bstod bya/ /
This concludes outer, inner, secret, and suchness offerings and the praises.
de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa dang / / khyad par (371) gnas sbyar ma lugs gnyis sogs skabs 'dir 'don/ /
Then recite extensive or concise supplications as appropriate. {371} In particular, recite the two lineage prayers in the style of attached locations and others at this juncture.[12]
yongs khyab dang ldan zhing rgyas par spro na/ /
Then, if you have time and want to do the elaborate version:
gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ / skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / / bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ / rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /
You whose kindness causes great bliss to arise instantly: vajra guru with jewel body, I bow at your lotus feet.
stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ / kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan sku/ / bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / / rigs kun khyab bdag zhabs la 'dud/ /
Emptiness and compassion inseparable, your body with seven aspects of union,[13] Vajradhara’s integral unity of bliss and emptiness: pervasive lord of all families, I bow before you.
dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum/ / brgyud 'dzin bu la dngos grub ster/ / zag med ye shes DA ki ni/ / su kha sid+d+hi'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Birth mother of all buddhas of the three times, granting spiritual powers to children of the lineage, ḍākinī of undissipating timeless awareness, Sukhasiddhi, I bow before you.
lhan skyes shes rab pha rol phyin/ / mi phyed gsang ba kun gyi mdzod/ / mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ni gu ma/ / rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Coemergent perfection of wisdom, unshakable treasury of all mysteries, mighty Ḍākinī Niguma, Vajra Queen, I bow before you.
ri khrod mgon pos byin gyis brlabs/ / snying po don gyi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ / mtshan thos don ldan rgyal ba'i sras/ / mai tri pa yi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Blessed by the lord of retreat [Śavarῑpa], holder of the secret treasure of essential meaning, victors’ heir, just hearing your name is meaningful: Maitrīpa, I bow before you.
grub mchog mnga' bdag chen po dang / / mkhyen rtogs dbyer med rnal 'byor ma/ / mkha' spyod gsang ba'i dbang mo mchog / rad+na de bI'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Yoginī, whose knowledge and realization equals the great masters of supreme accomplishment: supreme mistress of the secret celestial realm, Ratnadevī, I bow before you.
byang chub sems kyi rtsal chen rdzogs/ / rdo rje gdan du bstan pa skyong / / mthong thos dran reg bde la bkod/ / bsod nams 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud/ /
The great energy of awakening mind perfected, you maintained the doctrine at the Vajra Seat; seeing, hearing, recalling, and touching you is bliss: Puṇyākara, I bow before you.
khyad par lha bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ / phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang grub/ / rdo rje'i lus kyis rab bzhugs pa/ / rA hu la yi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Specially blessed by the four deities, you attained the state of mahāmudrā; your vajra body still lives: Rāhula, I bow before you.
byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag mchog / bod khams mun pa sel ba'i sgron/ / sa gsum grags pas khyab pa yi/ / a ti sha yi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Supreme master of the mind of awakening, lamp that illuminates the darkness of Tibet, renowned throughout the three worlds:[14] Atiśa, I bow before you.
bcom ldan 'das mas rjes su bzung / / thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal srid skyong / / sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bur grags/ / 'jigs (372) med 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud/ /
Graciously accepted by Bhagavatī, you protected Śākyamuni’s domain: acclaimed as like a second Buddha, Abhayākara, I bow before you. {372}
nA ro paN chen thugs kyi sras/ / man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son/ / skye dgu'i mgon gyur d+ha chen po/ / byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Heart son of great paṇḍita Nāropa, on the far shore of vast esoteric instructions: lord protector of many living beings, Great Dha Bodhisattva, I bow before you.
tha dad yul dang dud 'gro'i skad/ / ma bslab pa yi bstan bcos sogs/ / rtsa gnas dgongs pa gtad pas mkhyen/ / ta thA ga ta'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You know various countries and languages, treatises, and so forth without studying, by just concentrating on your subtle body: Tathāgata[rakṣita], I bow before you.
brtul zhugs spyod pa phyogs med grub/ / mthu stobs phrin las thogs pa med/ / mi 'jigs gding ldan grub pa'i rje/ / don yod rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Adept of impartial deliberate conduct, your power and activity are unhindered: lord of attainment with fearless confidence, Amoghavajra, I bow before you.
gsung rab kun la mkhyen pa rgyas/ / gzhan phan bsam mi khyab pa mdzad/ / ngo mtshar snyan pa dang ldan pa/ / blo gros bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
With thorough knowledge of the scriptures, you enacted unimaginable benefit for others and enjoyed wondrous celebrity: *Matibhadra, I bow before you.[15]
mkhyen rtogs nus pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ / bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ / bai ro tsa na rak+Shi ta/ / rnal 'byor dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Perfectly skilled in knowledge, realization, and ability, gaining supreme power in the intermediate state, you became a mighty yogi: Vairocanarakṣita, I bow before you.
gshin rje gshed dang dbyer med cing / / mu stegs kla klo'i rigs kyi gshed/ / bsam pa tsam gyis las rnams 'grub/ / pad+ma srung pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Inseparable from Yamāntaka, you slew the clans of barbarian extremists and accomplished all actions by mere thought: Kamalarakṣita, I bow before you.
rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul/ / rdo rje dril bu mkha' la 'jog / dus gsum gzigs pa'i paN+Di ta/ / gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Manifesting the real Vidāraṇa mandala, you placed your vajra and bell in the space: paṇḍita who sees the three times, Advayavajra, I bow before you.
bde chen bde ba'i gzi mdangs can/ / lta bas mi ngoms sgeg pa'i nyams/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje/ / kun tu bzang mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
With blissful resplendent glow of great bliss and charm that one never tires of seeing: chief of the ḍākinī hosts of three sacred sites, Samantabhadrī, I bow before you.
sa dang lam rnams mthar phyin te/ / rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i ye shes sbar/ / rdo rje'i gsang ba 'dzin pa mo/ / su ma ti yi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Reaching the culmination of levels and paths, your timeless awareness of yogic realization blazed: lady who holds the vajra secrets, Sumati, I bow before you.
ye shes mkha' la rnam par 'gro/ / skal pa ldan rnams rjes su 'dzin/ / sprul sgyur sna tshogs gzugs can ma/ / ka na ka shrI'i (373) zhabs la 'dud/ /
Freely moving through the space of awareness, you look after the fortunate ones with your variety of emanated forms: Kanakaśrī, I bow before you. {373}
sa 'og dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas/ / ral gri'i grub pas da lta yang / / lha min sems can don mdzad pa/ / gang+gA d+ha ris zhabs la 'dud/ /
You journeyed below the earth, and with the power of the sword help the demigod beings even now: Gaṅgādhari, I bow before you.
rol rdor bde ba'i rdo rje dang / / d+harma pha la 'phags pa lha/ / b+han+d+ha pa sogs mkhas grub ni/ / brgya dang lda bcu'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Lalitavajra, Sukhavajra, Dharmapala, Āryadeva, Bhandapa, and the other learned adepts: one hundred and fifty, I bow before you.
lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gyis spras/ / snang ba mtha' yas thugs las sprul/ / 'brel tshad don ldan byang chub sems/ / glang thang pa yi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Adorned by the three higher trainings, emanated from Amitābha’s heart, Bodhisattva, any connection is meaningful: Langri Tangpa, I bow before you.
shes bya kun mkhyen dbang bcu brnyes/ / ye shes DA ki'i gsang ba 'dzin/ / rgyud sde lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ / khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs la 'dud/ /
Knower of all things, you attained the ten powers,[16] holder of the secrets of awareness ḍākinīs, you are the very essence of the Five Tantras: Khyungpo Naljor, I bow before you.
ngo mtshar srid mtha'i byang chub sems/ / thogs med mkha' la bya ltar lding / / rlung sems dbang thob rmog lcogs pa/ / rin chen brtson 'grus zhabs la 'dud/ /
Amazing bodhisattva in your final existence, you soared freely in space like a bird: with power over wind-mind, Mokchokpa, Rinchen Tsöndru, I bow before you.
ting 'dzin sgo brgyar dbang du mdzad/ / tshad med thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang skyer sgang pa/ / chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You mastered a hundred doors of absorption; with immeasurable compassion you guide migrators: Avalokiteśvara Kyergangpa, Chökyi Senge, I bow before you.
sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sku/ / ye shes mgon po bran du khol/ / sa bcu'i dbang phyug ri gong pa/ / gnyan ston chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
In the form of Buddha Hevajra, with Awareness Protector at your service: mighty one of the tenth level, Rigongpa, Great Nyentön, I bow before you.
bde stong 'gyur med sku lnga'i bdag / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i drwa ba sdom/ / rdo rje'i rgya bkrol 'gro ba'i mgon/ / sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Master of five kāyas in immutable bliss-emptiness, you bound the net of heroes and ḍākinīs: lord of migrators who lifted the vajra seal, Sangye Tönpa, I bow before you.
sangs rgyas zhing sbyong 'gro smin mdzad/ / bla na med pa'i cho 'phrul ston/ / mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston rje/ / tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You refined buddha realms, matured migrators, and displayed unsurpassable miracles: Khedrup Lord Tsangma Shangtön, Tsultrim Bum, I bow before you.
gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon shes sogs/ / bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar can/ / mkhas grub chen po bsam sdings pa/ / gzhon nu grub mchog zhabs la 'dud/ /
In your unthinkable life of liberation were recollections, absorptions, and clairvoyance: great Khedrup Samdingpa, supreme Zhönu Drup, I bow before you.
mthong thos dran reg sgrol mdzad pa'i/ / rgyal sras dpa' (374) bo'i spyod pa 'chang / / mkhas btsun mchog gyur 'jag chen pa/ / rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /
You hold the heroic conduct of a victors’ heir, liberating through seeing, hearing, recalling, or touching: supreme Khetsun Jakchenpa, {374} Gyaltsen Bum, I bow before you.
bsam bzhin srid par sku sprul nas/ / 'khor ba dong sprugs sems dpa' che/ / khyung po gnyis par grags pa yi/ / tshul khrims mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You emanated in existence with intention to dredge the depths of cyclic existence: great bodhisattva known as the second Khyungpo, Tsultrim Gönpo, I bow before you.
gzung 'dzin mdud pa dbyings su grol/ / 'byung ba bzhi po dbang du mdzad/ / brtul zhugs mthar phyin ras chen pa/ / sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You released the knots of dualism in basic space and brought the four elements under control, consummating deliberate conduct: Rechenpa, Sangye Senge, I bow before you.
mkhyen pa gnyis kyi rtsal chen rdzogs/ / spyan lnga rnam par dag pa 'char/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin shangs dkar ba/ / rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud/ /
You perfected the great skill of twofold knowledge and the five eyes of totally pure vision arose: descendant of the Victor, Shangkarwa, Rinchen Gyaltsen, I bow before you.
bde stong gzi brjid 'od du 'bar/ / 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i lus su rtogs/ / dngos grub mchog brnyes lkugs lung pa/ / sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs la 'dud/ /
You blazed with brilliant light of bliss-emptiness and realized samsara and nirvana as illusory body: with supreme spiritual power, Kuklungpa, Sangye Palzang, I bow before you.
ci snang ye shes 'khor lor dag / las dang dngos grub thogs med grub/ / rmad byung mchog gi grub pa che/ / nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud/ /
Whatever arose you purified as an awareness wheel and accomplished unimpeded action and powers: amazing great adept of supreme spiritual powers, Namkhai Gyaltsen, I bow before you.
'khor 'das gnyis la sbang blang bral/ / chos kun mngon sangs rgyas par gzigs/ / sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rgya sgom pa/ / legs pa rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud/ /
Free of rejecting or accepting samsara or nirvana, you saw all phenomena as manifest buddhahood: hidden buddha, Gyagompa, Lekpa Gyaltsen, I bow before you.
ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung / / mkhyen nus phrin las mkha' dang mnyam/ / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo che/ / kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la 'dud/ /
Accepted by the Awareness Ḍākinī, your knowledge, ability, and activity equaled the sky: great hero adept, Jamgön, Kunga Drolchok, I bow before you.
snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzad 'dzin/ / grub pa bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug brag stod pa/ / lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Treasure holder of the aural lineage instructions, crown jewel of millions of adepts: mighty yogi, Draktöpa, Lhawang Drakpa, I bow before you.
rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'changa / / 'jigs med shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ / gsang ba'i bdag po he ru ka / tA ra nA tha'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Vajradhara in the times of strife, fearless knower of all things, lord of secrets Heruka, Tāranātha, I bow before you.
ye shes gcig gi ngo bo nyid/ / rnam 1 (375) 'phrul du ma'i gar mdzad pa/ / ston 'khor dbyer med rgyal tshab mchog / ye shes rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Essence of the single timeless awareness dancing in the manifold manifestations, {375} teacher and student inseparable, supreme regent, Yeshe Gyatso, I bow before you.
skyes thob sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan/ / gzhan rgyud smin cing grol nus pa'i/ / byin rlabs dpal 'bar rdzong steng pa/ / yon tan mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
With qualities of innate and acquired learning, you matured others and could liberate them: ablaze with glorious blessings, Dzongtengpa, Yönten Gönpo, I bow before you.
dka' grub brtul zhugs mtha' ru phyin/ / 'ja' lus mkha' spyod grong du gshegs/ / ngo mtshar rmad byung spong ba pa/ / mgon po dpal 'byor zhabs la 'dud/ /
You consummated ascetic deliberate conduct and your rainbow body left for the celestial realm: amazing magnificent renunciant, Gönpo Paljor, I bow before you.
rim pa gnyis la brtan pa thob/ / de nyid bcu po dbang du 'byor/ / mtshan nyid kun ldan slob dpon mchog / mgon po grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You stabilized the two phases and mastered Mantra’s ten principles:[17] endowed with all qualifications, supreme master, Gönpo Drakpa, I bow before you.
nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ / sgom pa'i drod rtags tshad la pheb/ / yon tan bsam yas grub pa'i dbang / / mgon po rnam rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /
You perfected experience and realization’s great energy, and reached the full measure of meditative warmth signs; you have inconceivable qualities of a mighty adept: Gönpo Namgyal, I bow before you.
dag pa'i sa la legs bzhugs shing / / sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro don mdzad/ / 'gran zla bral ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ / tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You dwelt fully in the pure levels while your various emanations helped beings: incomparable awareness holder, Tsewang Norbu, I bow before you.
gdod nas mngon par byang chub kyang / / 'gro 'dren thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad/ / gangs can mgon po 'brug pa rje/ / phrin las shing rta'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Though you are awakened since forever, yet your continuous compassion guides migrators, protector of the Himalaya, Lord Drukpa, Trinle Shingta, I bow before you.
byams chen ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul/ / snyigs dus 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ / sgrub brgyud mnga' bdag 'jig rten mig / bstan pa'i nyin byed zhabs la 'dud/ /
Great Maitreya in the guise of saffron robes, ornament of the world in the time of degenerations, master of the practice lineage, eyes of the world, Tenpai Nyinje, I bow before you.
gong ma'i brgyud 'dzin rnam thar skyong / / rtogs pa'i bdag nyid rmog lcogs pa/ / kun dga' dge legs dpal 'bar dang / / lhun grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Holders of the ancestral lineage, exemplifying their lives, epitome of realization, Mokchokpa, Kunda Gelek Palbar, and Lhundrup Gyatso, I bow before you.
chos brgyad rnam g.yeng rtswa ltar dor/ / bas mthar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ / 'khrul pa zhig pa'i skyes bu che/ / bka' brgyud bstan (376) 'dzin zhabs la 'dud/ /
Eight worldly concerns discarded like straw, you planted the victory banner of remote practice: great person who destroyed delusion (Trulshik), Kagyu Tenzin, I bow before you. {376}
'khrul snang dbu ma'i dbyings su thim/ / dag pa'i snang ba rgyun chad med/ / sprul sgyur nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / karma lhag mthong zhabs la 'dud/ /
Delusions dissolved into the central channel’s basic space, and pure appearance arose continuously: yogi with the ability to emanate and transform, Karma Lhaktong, I bow before you.
'byung bzhi'i gnod pas mi brdzi zhing / / yi dam lha zhal grangs med gzigs/ / snang sems rang dbang sgyur ba'i rje/ / karma gzhan phan zhabs la 'dud/ ! /
Unaffected by harm from the four elements, you saw the yidam deity countless times, and gained control over appearance and mind: Karma Zhenpen, I bow before you.
[Prophesied in all the sutras and tantras, you mastered longevity and awakened activity, your deeds were those of a second victor: Lodrö Taye, I bow before you.
A thousand-petaled lotus of ethics blossomed, love’s fragrance permeated the ten directions, and the fruit of creation and completion hung heavy: Zhiwai Nyingpo, I bow before you.
Planting the victory banner of attainment in one life, you departed to the domain of great nonmeditation and achieved the wondrous rainbow body: Norbu Döndrup, I bow before you.]
[The last three verses are supplications added by Karma Rangjung Kunkhyab.][18]
rdo rje 'chang dang bdag med ma/ / bir wa su kha sid+d+hi'i zhabs/ / ni gu ma dang rdor gdan pa/ / rA hu la yi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Vajradhara and Nairātmya, Virūpa, Sukhasiddhi, Niguma and Vajrāsana, and Rāhula, I bow before you.
mkhas grub chen po brgya lnga bcu/ / khyung po rnal 'byor rmog lcogs pa/ / dbon ston gnyan ston 'gro ba'i mgon/ / gtsang ma shangs ston zhabs la 'dud/ /
One hundred fifty great learned adepts, Khyungpo Naljor, Mokchokpa, Öntön, Nyentön, Drogön, and Tsangma Shangtön, I bow before you.
'jig rten gsum po snyan pas khyab/ / 'jig rten skyong bas zhabs la btud/ / 'jig rten mgon po gnyags ston che/ / rgyal mtshan dpal bzang zhabs la 'dud/ /
Famous throughout the three worlds, worldly protectors bowed at your feet: world protector, great Nyaktön, Gyaltsen Palzang, I bow before you.
'phrul dang mngon par shes la sogs/ / lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin kyang / / sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur bzhes pa/ / rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You mastered the qualities of the path such as magical display and clairvoyance, yet engaged in hidden deliberate conduct: Dorje Zhönu, I bow before you.
srid pa'i 'ching ba rab tu bcad/ / spang rtogs yon tan bsam mi khyab/ / dpe bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud/ /
You broke the bonds of existence, with qualities of renunciation and realization: unimaginable sky yogi without compare, Namkhai Gyaltsen, I bow before you.
tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son/ / stong nyid snying rje rtsol med mnga'/ / 'gro ba'i 'dren pa byang chub sems/ / sbyin pa bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You crossed the ocean of two accumulations, and readily mastered emptiness and compassion: guide of migrators, bodhisattva, Jinpa Zangpo, I bow before you.
dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje/ / grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur/ / tshe dbang mnga' brnyes lcags zam pa/ / thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Lord of the assembly of heroes and ḍākinīs, wheel monarch of an ocean of adepts, with mastery over life, Iron-Bridge Builder, Tangtong Gyalpo, I bow before you.
yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin tu/ / don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ / dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' srol (377) 'dzin/ / brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Just like wish-fulfilling gems, you spontaneously achieve the two purposes: holders of the teaching system of glorious Shangpa, gurus of the lineage, I bow before you. {377}
thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag / mkhas dang grub pa kun gyi gtsug / 'phags pa'i sa la rab bzhugs pa/ / mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Master of the whole doctrine of the Buddha, crown of all those learned and accomplished, dwelling fully on the level of the exalted ones, Khyentse Wangpo, I bow before you.
shangs pa'i thugs sras chen po drug / mkhas grub rnam gsum la sogs pa'i/ / gdan sa slob brgyud las byon pa'i/ / skyes mchog kun gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /
The six heart sons of Shangpa, the three learned adepts, and others from the disciple lineage of the monastic seat, all great beings, I bow before you.
'jigs bral chen po yab sras sogs/ / ni d+hi gnyis kyis rjes bzung zhing / / zab mo'i gdams pa spel mdzad pa'i/ / grub mchog rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /
Great Jikdral, father, sons, and others, nurtured by Niguma and Sukhasiddhi, those who spread the profound instructions, sublime adepts, I bow before you.
dgyes pa rdo rje gsang ba 'dus/ / sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'khor lo sdom/ / 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Essence of Hevajra, Guhyasamāja, Mahāmāya, Cakrasaṃvara, and Vajrabhairava, glorious guru, I bow before you.
sangs rgyas rdo rje rin po che/ / pad+ma las kyis mkha' 'gro ma/ / myur mdzad ye shes mgon po dang / / dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Inseparable from buddha, vajra, jewel, lotus, and action ḍākinīs, and from Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, glorious guru, I bow before you.
dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ / ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos/ / gcig chog rgyal po skyabs kyi phul/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Three Jewels and Three Roots, are contained in your one actual form: the single sufficient sovereign, highest refuge, glorious guru, I bow before you.
dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ / snyigs dus slob dpon gzugs su 'phrul/ / bsam mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa can/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
The glorious vajra holder incarnated as a master in the age of strife, you have done this incredible deed: glorious guru, I bow before you.
khams dbang mos pa'i bye brag ltar/ / gsang gsum rnam thar sna tshogs ston/ / thabs mkhas thugs rje che mnga' ba'i/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
You display your three secrets in various lives, attuned to different characters, abilities, and interests, with skillful means and great compassion: glorious guru, I bow before you.
nyes pa'i skyon rnams rab tu zad/ / legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs/ / rgyal ba sras bcas skyed mdzad pa/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
The problems of flaws fully expended, and all good qualities perfected, giver of gifts to victors and heirs, glorious guru, I bow before you.
mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro sgrol/ / gsol (378) ba btab pas byin rlabs stsol/ / gus pas brten na 'dod rgu 'byung / / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /
Bad destinies are averted by just hearing your name, blessings are granted by supplicating you, {378} necessities accrue by relying on you with devotion: glorious guru, I bow before you.
[Seven-branch prayer]
yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma rin po che/ / 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung par bgyi/ /
I hold you as the supreme refuge from now until the heart of awakening, precious root and lineage gurus, like wish-fulfilling gems.
bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can gyis/ / rdul snyed lus dang bstod pa'i ngag / yid ni rtse gcig gus btud de/ / phyag 'os khyod la phyag bgyi'o/ /
I prostrate to you who are worthy of worship together with all beings equaling space, our bodies equaling atoms, voices of praise, and minds in single-pointed devotion.
kun bzang rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin/ / sgo gsum dge rtsa dang bcas pa/ / nam mkha' lta bu'i blos bzung ste/ / mchod 'os rnams la rtag tu mchod/ /
I forever offer to those worthy of offering Samantabhadra’s display of offering clouds, and the roots of virtue from my three doors, encompassed by my sky-like mind.
thog med sgrib pa chen po dang / / bcas pa'i kha na ma tho sogs/ / nangs pa snying nas 'gyod bshags na/ / 'gro ba'i mgon pos tshangs par stsol/ /
I confess with sincere regret and shame the big obscuration since time immemorial, along with the hidden misdeeds and such; protector of migrators, grant purification.
skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam par thar/ / ngo mtshar bla na med pa dang / / srid zhi'i legs spyad ci mchis la/ / dga' zhing gus pas yi rang ngo / /
I rejoice with respect and delight in the lives of liberation led by great beings that are amazing and unsurpassed, and in any good deeds in existence or peace.
rigs dang mthun pa'i chos sgo dang / / khyad par sras bcas rgyal ba kun/ / bgrod pa gcig pa'i 'khor lo yis/ / 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gsol/ /
Please dredge up the depths of cyclic existence through dharma doors in harmony with all types, and in particular, turn the wheel of the single path traversed by the victors and their heirs.
chos sku rgyun gyis rtag pa'i phyir/ / gzugs sku 'char nub mi ston par/ / mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du/ / rdo rje lta bur bzhugs su gsol/ /
Please remain firm as the immutable vajra, manifesting to our senses’ sphere of experience in form kāyas without arising and setting, since the continuity of dharmakāya is eternal.
bsod nams 'di dang 'gro kun gyi/ / dge rtsa thun mong nyid byas te/ / bla ma'i gsang gsum mdzad par bcas/ / tshe gcig kho nas 'grub phyir bsngo/ /
I dedicate this merit shared in common with the roots of merit of all migrators, to the accomplishment in just one lifetime of the guru’s deeds of the three secrets.
chos kyi rgyal po sras bcas kyi/ / thugs rje'i phyag gis yongs bzung ste/ / lam gyi mngon rtogs mthar phyin nas/ / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /
May I be held by the compassionate hands of the dharma monarchs and their heirs, and complete real realization on the path, to spontaneously achieve the goals of self and others.
bla ma las gzhan rgyal med pas/ / nam yang mi mnyes ma gyur cing / / sgo gsum zhabs tog dgu phrug gis/ (379) mnyes pa kho na sgrub nus shog /
rtag tu dgyes pas byin rlobs shing / / thugs yid dbyer med 'dres nas su/ / spang rtogs bum pa gang byo bzhin/ / bdag gi rgyud la 'pho bar shog /
May the blessings of always pleasing the guru cause our minds to merge inseparably, and may renunciation and realization, like a full vase, be transferred to my stream of being.
rnam thar ji bzhin rtogs pa dang / / gsung gi gsang ba ma lus pa/ / stsal nas legs par 'dzin nus shing / / dar rgyas byed pa'i skal ldan shog /
May I be granted the realizations of the life and secrets of the guru’s speech, and with the ability to retain it well, be fortunate to spread and increase it.
rdo rje theg pa'i rigs su skye/ / bla mas rjes bzung dam tshig 'chang / / rdo rje dril bu mi 'bral bar/ / ye shes yangs pa'i gar byed shog /
May I be born into a Vajrayāna family, be accepted by a guru, keep sacred pledge, never be apart from vajra and bell, and dance in the arena of timeless awareness.
rdo rje'i gsang ba 'dzin pa dang / / blang dor bral ba'i don rtogs nas/ / brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa yis/ / 'jig rten sgron me gcig gyur shog /
May I grasp the vajra mysteries, realize the import without accepting or rejecting, and by accomplishing unbiased deliberate conduct, become a lamp for the whole world.
gzhan yang dpal dang dbang phyug dang / / nad med pa dang rdo rje'i tshe/ / chos mthun 'byor pa rab rgyas shing / / bstan pa phyogs brgyar spel byed shog /
May I also gain glory and influence, good health and vajra longevity, and plenty of resources in harmony with dharma, so I can spread the doctrine in a hundred directions.
tshe 'dir mchog dngos ma grub na/ / 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can/ / khyung po yab sras zhabs drung du/ / skad cig tsam gyis skye bar shog /
May I be born in Sukhāvatī as soon as I die if I fail to achieve supreme spiritual power now, and in the instant that I am born there, come before Khyungpo and his heirs.
bzang ngan bar ma'i 'brel thogs kun/ / sgrib pa gnyis po rab bsal nas/ / snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams der/ / sprul pa du mas 'dren nus shog /
May I be able, through my many emanations, to dispel the two obscurations of all those with whom I had good, bad, or neutral connection, and guide them there to Amitābha’s pure realm.
rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rnam par thar/ / ma lus bdag gis myur 'grub ste/ / srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro sgrol ba'i/ / ded dpon khyod dang mtshungs par shog /
May I quickly attain everything in the lives of root and lineage gurus, and become a guide like yourself, who liberates beings from the ocean of existence.
zab mo bla ma'i rim pa yis/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar sbyor ba/ / rdo rje 'chang gis rab gsungs pa'i/ / bden pas smon lam kun 'grub shog /
The profound practice sequence of the gurus brings the level of a buddha in one life; by the truth well spoken by Vajradhara, may all these aspirations by accomplished.

gzhan yang rgyun bshags/ / yan lag bdun pa'i rigs ji ltar nus pa skabs 'dir brjod/ / tshogs 'khor bya bar spro na rje btsun grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs mchod gsung rgyun ma ltar bya ba las/ / byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i thog mar/ /

Also do the regular confession.[19] At this point recite whatever appropriate seven branches that you are able. If you are interested in doing a communal feast, follow the liturgy of the Five-Deity Cakrasaṃvara feast offering created by Venerable Kunga Drolchok,[20] except add the following at the beginning of the descent of blessings: {380}
oM chos dbyings khyab brdal chen (380) po'i zhing / / 'khor 'das kun gyi snying po nas/ / rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag la/ / dpal ldan bla ma zhes su grags/ / rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor gyis bskor/ /
oṃ In the great pervasive realm of phenomena, from the heart of all samsara and nirvana, the lord over all the families is known as the glorious guru, and is surrounded by buddhas and heirs.

khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis/ / byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ / zag med bde ba sbyin pa'i gnas/ / tsan+dan sman gyi nags tshal du/ / rgyal yum rdo rje bdag med la/ / su kha sid+d+hi zhes su grags/ / gdan gsum tshang pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /

I will train following your footsteps; please come here to grant your blessings. In the place that bestows undissipating bliss, the forest of medicinal sandalwood trees, the queen mother Vajra Nairātmya is known as Sukhasiddhi, surrounded by the three seats complete.[21]
khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis/ / byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ / zhes sbyar/ /
I will train following your footsteps; please come here to grant your blessings.
myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po la gtor chog bsdus pa ltar gtor ma 'bul zhing / 'grub na mkha' 'gro sde lnga la'ang tshogs gtor zur du 'bul lo/ / tshogs lhag ma bcas zin nas/ /

Offer torma to the Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, such as the Concise Torma Ritual.[22] If you have practiced it, offer a feast torma with Ḍākinīs of the Five Classes Torma Offering as a supplement.[23] Once the feast and the leftovers are complete, continue:

dmangs rigs nyis stong bram ze gcig dang mnyam/ / de bzhin bram ze dge slong rdul med dang / / ye shes ldan rnams stong phrag gnyis gnyis su/ / bsgres pa'ang slob dpon gcig dang zhing mnyam par/ / gsungs phyir mgon po rdo rje slob dpon khyod/ / zhing gi rab mchog phul dung byung med pas/ /

It is said that two thousand commoners equal one brahmin, and likewise two thousand flawless brahmin monks and two thousand folks with the eyes of awareness equal the offering field of a single vajra master. Therefore, lord protector vajra master, you are the most excellent field, none more eminent.

rgyal khyod mnyes par byas na kun mkhyen mchog / ye shes bla med thob par yang yang gsungs/ / slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa des/ / bsod nams kun byas dka' thub thams cad bsten/ / sdig 'joms sdug bsngal zhi mdzad sred pa yi/ / rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /

Victor, if one pleases you, it is repeatedly said, one will attain omniscience and timeless awareness. Offerings made to the master, Vajrasattva, create all merit, serve as all hardship, vanquish negativity, calm suffering, and free one from the depths of existence. Homage!
khyod la rjes mthun gus pas yon phul na/ / rims sogs gnod pa mi 'byung phyogs bcu yi/ / rgyal ba kun la phul bar 'gyur bas na/ / dngos grub mchog ni nges par thob par gsungs/ /

It is said that if one thus offers respectfully to you, compared to offering to all the ten-direction victors, preventing plagues and other misfortunes, one will surely attain the supreme spiritual power.
bdag gis dus gsum dge ba lus longs spyod/ / yongs su gzung ba med pa'i mchod rdzas dang / / smon (381) lam sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ / rab bsgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /
khyod la brnyas bar byed pa kun/ / rgyal po me dang dug dang rims/ / log 'dren rnams kyis bsad nas kyang / / rtag tu dmyal bar 'tshed par gsungs/ /
It is said that all those who scorn you will be killed by rulers, fire, poison, plague, and rogues and then cook in hell forever.
khyed la brnyas shing rmad na ni/ / sangs rgyas kun la brnyas shing smad/ / gzims cha stan dang l+h+wam dang gdugs/ / 'gom zhing co 'dri byed pa ni/ / don reng dpal nyams nad kyis thebs/ /
To scorn and malign you is to scorn and malign all buddhas. One who treads on or ridicules your bedding, seat, shoes, or parasol will fail in enterprises and fall ill.
sku yi grib ma la 'gom pa/ / mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ / de dag bgyis gang so sor bshags/ / snying nas slob dpon sbyong pa ni/ / rmi lam du yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /
To step over your body’s shadow is said to be like destroying a stupa. I confess each such act that I have done. To unequivocally criticize the master prevents accomplishment even in dreams.
slob dpon yon tan bzung bya yi/ / skyon ni nam yang ma yin no/ / yon tan bzung na dngos grub ste/ / skyon brjod pa las dngos grub nyams/ /
To appreciate the master’s qualities is not ever a fault. Pondering the qualities is spiritual power; speaking of faults spoils spiritual power.
bdag gi sgo gsum bag med pas/ / nyes par bgyis kun mthol lo bshags/ /
I acknowledge and confess all such faults that I have committed with careless three doors.
khyed kyi ba spu nyag re yi/ / bsod nams la yang dus gsum gyi/ / rgyal ba'i phrin las thams cad kyi/ / char yang bskrun par mi nus pas/ /
The merit of each hair on your body cannot be matched even in part by all the enlightened activity of the victors of the three times.
nyid dang nyid kyis rjes bzung dang / / nyid la mchod dang phyag 'tshal sogs/ / bsod nams mi zad byed pa la/ / lhag par dang bas yid rang ngo/ /
I rejoice with highest inspired faith in the inexhaustible merit created by you, your chosen disciples, and whoever worships and honors you.
bskal pa bye bar mdo rgyud la/ / thos bsam sgom pas rab sbyangs kyang / / bla ma'i man ngag med pa yis/ / byin rlabs rim par mi rnyed gsungs/ /
Though one trains for a million eons in study, contemplation, and meditation of sutras and tantras, it is said that without the guru’s esoteric instructions, one will never receive their blessings.
bla ma'i lung thob dngos grub mchog / 'bad med thob par 'gyur bas na/ / bdag sogs 'ching ba las grol phyir/ / zab mo'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /
To obtain the guru’s transmission is to get supreme spiritual power effortlessly. I request you to turn the profound dharma wheel so that you may liberate us from our bonds. {382}
'od (382) gsal lhan skyes bde ba che/ / thams cad stong pa bla ma yi/ / drin gyis gsal bar 'gyur bas na/ / bdag byin brlabs pa ma rnyed na/ / ngal ba 'bras med de bzhin du/ /
Since it is the guru’s kindness that illuminates lucid clarity coemergent with great bliss and the emptiness of everything, if I do not receive the master’s blessings, I have toiled to no end.
bla mas phongs pa sngags dang ni/ / phyag rgya rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ / mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /

mtho ris gnas su lha yi dbang / / sa steng 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid/ / sa 'og gdengs can bdag po'i tshul/ / oM yig gtsang ma rig byed mchog / 'gro ba'i bla ma pha ma myes/ / grogs dang mgon dang byed po dang / / skyon 'joms yon tan kun gyi gnas/ / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can la 'dud/ /

Lord of the gods in the higher realms, wheel-wielding monarch on the earth, lord of the hooded nāgas underground, the letter oṃ in the pure, supreme Vedas, guru, father, mother, ancestor, friend, and protector of migrators, conqueror of flaws, site of all qualities, holder of vajra yoga, I bow to you.
kun 'gro'i ye shes brtan g.yo kun/ / 'gro 'ong med par khyab mdzad pa/ /
Ever-present timeless awareness pervades the whole world without coming or going.
skyes bu khyu mchog thub dbang po/ / dbul dang mgon med thams cad kyi/ / skyob pa yid bzhin nor bu la/ /
Leader of the people, lord of sages, like a wish-fulfilling gem, you protect all the poor and vulnerable people.
mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag / 'di phyi kun tu snying thag pas/ / sgo gsum dad pas khyod bsten no/ / rdo rje'i rigs la slob dpon bzung ba ni/ / dam tshig kun gyi rtsa bar yang yang gsungs/ /

Terrified by unbearable cyclic existence, I rely on you from now and ever after with heartfelt faith of body, speech, and mind. For vajra practitioners, accepting the master is often said to be the root of all sacred pledge.
myos byed dman pa'i mchod dang sbyin sreg ni/ / mar dang bral na 'bral med rigs kyi chos/ / btang pas mi gnas don med de lta bur/ / slob dpon dang bral chos kyang don mi 'grub/ /

Just as offering inferior intoxicants and dry burnt offerings are fruitless types of religious practice that are transitory and meaningless when performed, the dharma without a master will not be productive.
de phyir dam tshig kun las khyad par du/ / slob dpon dam tshig 'bad nas bzung bar bgyi/ / dus dang gnas skabs dag ni thams cad du/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las bsgrub par shog /
Therefore, as the most important of all sacred pledges, I will endeavor to keep the sacred pledge with my master. At all times and in all circumstances, may I accomplish my glorious guru’s activity.
khyod nyid gang la mnyes pa de sgrub nas/ / mi mnyes byed pa thams cad spang bar shog / khyod nyid dgyes par gyur na bdag cag rnams/ / byang chub mchog thob las kyang lhag pa nyid/ /
May I accomplish whatever pleases you, and abandon anything that does not please. When you are delighted, it is much better than all of us attaining supreme awakening.
gal te khyod mi mnyes na tshe 'di la/ / byang chub thob kyang don mchog 'ga' ma (383) mchis/ /
If somehow you are not pleased, then in this life even attaining awakening is not the supreme goal. {383}
bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ma lus pa/ / gcig tu bsdus pa'i stobs las tshe 'di la/ / mchog gi dngos grub dam pa mngon 'gyur zhing / / rtag tu bla ma mnyes shing mchod byed shog /
By the power of collecting together all my and others’ virtue from the three times, may I actualize sacred supreme spiritual power in this life and always please and make offerings to my guru.
bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud rnams la/ / 'dren pa khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / mos gus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ / thugs rjes g.yel ba med par gzigs su gsol/ /
For those of us incarcerated in cyclic existence, there is no other refuge than you, our guide. I supplicate you continuously with devotion: please watch over us with unfailing compassion.
rdo rje slob dpon sku dang bdag gi lus/ / dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i ci gsung sgrub pa dang / / gsung ngag dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung thob shog /
May the vajra master’s body and my body be inseparable and blessed as the vajra body. May I achieve whatever the glorious guru says and our speech be inseparable as vajra speech.

thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang / / thugs yid dbyer med 'dre bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bde stong zung 'jug stong nyid snying rje'i ngang / / thabs shes dbyer med bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mchog /
May I hold the whole treasury of mind’s secrets and our minds merge, inseparable and blessed. May I become like you, the real Vajradhara, seeing and realizing actual unborn lucid clarity,
skye med 'od gsal mngon sum mthong zhing rtogs/ / rdo rje 'chang dngos khyod dang mtshungs par shog /
by uniting creation and completion, inseparable method and wisdom within the emptiness-compassion of unified bliss-emptiness.
bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang / / zhi lhag dbyer med ting 'dzin rab 'byams can/ / sgo gsum spyod pa rnam dag dri med kyis/ / gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i gnas las grol bar shog /

May I see the guru as the actual Buddha, have vast absorptions of tranquility and insight inseparable, and with flawless pure conduct in body, speech, and mind become liberated from this cyclic place of dualism.

bsam yas brjod bral rlabs chen thabs mchog dpag med pas/ / da lta nyid du mchog gi dngos grub sku bzhi'i bdag / nam mkha'i mthar thug 'gro rnams theg mchog la bkod nas/ / myur du phan bdes zhing kun khyab par byin gyis rlobs/ /

Through the boundless supreme means of massive blessings beyond thought or word, bless me now with supreme spiritual powers and the four kāyas, to place all migrators throughout the reaches of space in the supreme vehicle and quickly fill all realms with benefit and happiness.
zhes slar yang yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba nan tu gdab cing / / gzhan yang / /
Again earnestly supplicate for your desires by means of the seven-branch service and then also recite:
yid la 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rin po che/ / mgon po khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos/ / thos bsam sgrub pas (384) rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /
thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams/ / sku la snyun med phrin las rab rgyas shing / / rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ / thar pa'i bde la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ /
Let the virtuous friends who hold the doctrine, freedom guides, be free of sickness, spread their awakened activity, and place ever-suffering migrators in the happiness of freedom.
dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyis/ / zab lam bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin nas/ / spang rtogs mthar son bla ma'i sa thob ste/ / gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /

Let all those who diligently practice the Holy Dharma complete the profound path of devotion to the guru, perfect renunciation and realization, attain the guru’s state, and accomplish immeasurable benefit for others.
de ma thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du'ang / / bla ma mchog gis rtag tu rjes 'dzin cing / / lus dang longs spyod dge bas mnyes byas te/ / brtse bas byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ /
Let us, in the meantime, in all circumstances, always be accepted by the sublime guru, please the guru with body, possessions, and virtue, and with your love receive the blessings.
dbang bzhi len pa ni/ /
Taking the four empowerments:
gsol ba btab pas 'khor rnams 'od du zhu/ / bla ma'i skur thim gnas gsum 'bru gsum gsal/ / bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dpral ba nas/ / 'od zer dkar po bdag gi dpral bar thim/ /

My prayer causes the entourage to melt into light and dissolve into the guru’s body with its three-place letters. White light rays from the guru Awareness Ḍākinī’s forehead dissolve into my forehead and I receive the vase empowerment.
bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sdig sgrib dag / sku yi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ / bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mgrin pa nas/ / 'od zer dmar po bdag gi mgrin par thim/ /

Physical negativities and obscurations are purified and the blessings of awakened body enter my being. Red light rays from the guru Awareness Ḍākinī’s throat dissolve into my throat and I receive the secret empowerment.
gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi sdig sgrib dag / gsung gi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ / bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ / 'od zer sngon po bdag gi snying khar thim/ /

Verbal negativities and obscurations are purified and the blessings of awakened speech enter my being. Blue light rays from the guru Awareness Ḍākinī’s heart dissolve into my heart and I receive the wisdom-awareness empowerment.
sher ye'i dbang thob yid kyi sdig sgrib dag / thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ / slar yang gnas gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing / / gcig char 'phros nas bdag gi gnas gsum thim/ /

Mental negativities and obscurations are purified and the blessings of awakened mind enter my being. Again white, red, and blue light rays from the three places radiate all at once and dissolve into my three places.
bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgo gsum bag chags sbyangs/ / ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur/ / skye med phyag rgya ched du phyar mdzad nas/ / dgyes pas dgongs te ngo sprad stsal bar gyur/ /

I receive the fourth empowerment, purifying habitual patterns of my three doors. The blessings of vajra awareness enter my being. Sukhasiddhi raises the mudra of the unborn, considers me with delight, and bestows the introduction:
nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ (385) rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba bcun/ / rtsa ba gcun la lhug par zhog / ces gsungs mkha' dang rang sems dbyer med 'dres/ /
In empty space, which lacks awareness, tame the root of mind with awareness. Tame the root and rest relaxed. {386} My mind and space blend inseparably.

nam mkha' bzhin tu rang sems skye 'jig dang / / mtha' dbus ngos bzung bral ba'i rang bab klod/ / bsam med ngang du cung zad klod de bzhag / ma bcos so ma rang shar lhan ne ba/ / lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa'i ngang du btang / /

Like the sky, my mind relaxed in its own state is free of identifiable birth or cessation, center or boundary; I rest relaxed awhile without conceptual thought. Uncontrived freshness is self-arising and serene, effortlessly focused within spontaneous presence.
dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dang bdag gi lus/ / dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ /
Bless me that the glorious guru’s awakened form and my body merge inseparably as vajra body.
dpal ldan bla ma'i ci gsung bsgrub pa dang / / gsung ngag dbyer med gsung gi rdo rjer shog / thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang / / thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /

May I achieve whatever the glorious guru says and our speech be inseparable as vajra speech. Bless me to hold the whole treasury of mind’s secrets, and for the guru’s mind and mine to merge inseparably.
bla ma dgyes pa'i bya ba kun bsgrubs nas/ / mdzad pa phrin las mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /
Bless me to achieve all acts that delight the guru and to equal the guru’s acts of awakened activity.
mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang / / lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ / ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ / yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /
May I keep the guru as a crown on my head, hold the vajra and bell in my hands, recite the sovereign secret mantras with my voice, and meditate on integral unity with my mind.
nongs pa bshags pa ni/ yig brgya brjod la/
For the confession of faults [in performing the ritual], recite the hundred syllables.
bdag ni mi shes bag med dbang gyur bas/ / ma rig nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gang bgyis pa/ / brtse ldan khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ / thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bzod par gsol/ /
Whatever ignorant faults I have accumulated through carelessness and lack of understanding, I confess in your presence, loving master, the nature of compassion: please forbear.
bsdu rim ni/ /
Dissolution phase:
skyabs mchog khyed ni 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad/ / chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang / / gzugs sku bdag gi lus la rab bskyod nas/ / brtse ba chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /
Supreme refuge, you have enacted the welfare of migrators. Although the dharmakāya is not subject to change, please move your form kāyas toward my body and bless me with your great loving-kindness.

bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dgyes pa chen pos 'od zer gyi gong bur zhu ste rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gyur/ / ces bzo med dang du yun ring mnyam (386) par bzhag la/ / shes shing spro na smon lam bka' rgya ma sogs theg pa chen po'i smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab bo/ /

In great delight, the guru Awareness Ḍākinī melts into a globe of light rays and dissolves into me. My three doors and the guru’s awakened body, speech, and mind become inseparable, like water poured into water. Rest in equipoise for a long while within an uncontrived state. {386} If you know it and are so inclined, do the Aspiration of the Sealed Word and any other appropriate aspiration prayers of the Mahayana.
de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni/ /
Then the [Sealed Word of] Auspiciousness:
yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ / byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshims mdzad cing / / rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i/ / chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /
sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / / mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ / dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ / yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /
You watch over practitioners as your children, ever together like a body and its shadow, giver of spiritual powers to those with sacred pledge; may there be auspiciousness of the yidam deities.
dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing / / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ / sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ / chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /

You take care of practitioners holding vows and properly accomplish various awakened activity, such as pacifying, enriching, controlling, and subjugating; may there be auspiciousness of the dharma protectors.
snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ / bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ / yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / / bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /

Apparent existence self-liberates like illusion and dream, that is the experience of uninterrupted great bliss in the space of empty clarity of mind mental engagement; may there be auspiciousness of great-bliss mahāmudrā.
sgrub pa po la brten cing 'phrog pa dang / / skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ / thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ / mnyam med byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /
Whether they support and offer[24] to practitioners or treat them with contempt, everyone will be placed on the path of awakening; may there be auspiciousness of incomparable awakening mind.
'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi/ / bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ / skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu bkra shis shog /
However many states of auspiciousness there are in all of cyclic existence and its transcendence, like the course of a great river of abundance; may there be auspiciousness for all beings always.
bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ / snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin tu khyab/ / tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ / yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog /

May merit rise like the sovereign Supreme Mountain, great acclaim spread everywhere like the sky, and long life, health, and others’ welfare be spontaneously present; may there be auspiciousness of an ocean of supreme qualities.[25]
rjes mchod pa'i ras ma ji ltar mchis pa dag kyang 'bags btsogs dang bag med spyod pa'i gnas su 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /
Afterward, do not discard whatever offering morsels are left in desecrated places or where there is careless behavior.
[Concluding Verses and Colophon]
ye shes mkha' 'gro gtsor gyur ba'i/ / shangs lugs bla ma mchod pa'i thabs/ / bris las (387) bsod nams gang thob pas/ / 'gro kun bla ma mchog 'grub shog /

May whatever merit has accrued from writing down the means to make offerings to gurus of the Shangpa tradition, primarily the ḍākinīs of timeless awareness, {387} go toward all migrators obtaining the sublime guru.
dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi/ / bsam kyis mi khyab rnam thar tshogs/ / de dag bdag gis myur 'grub nas/ / 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal gyur shog /
May I quickly accomplish those inconceivable life stories of the glorious Shangpa Kagyu and become the total glory of migrators.
'di la 'brel pa thogs tshad kyang / grub chen khyung po yab sras kyis/ / bde ba can du legs drangs nas/ / byang chub mchog tu lung ston shog /
May whoever comes into contact with this be brought to the pure land of Sukhāvatī by the great adept Khyungpo and his heirs and receive the prediction of their enlightenment.

ces pa 'di'ang rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rjes su gnang ba dang / rang nyid kyi mos pa chen po'i blos mtshams sbyar te/ / brgyud pa 'di nyid la mi phyed dad pa'i bag chags lhan skyes su mnga' ba karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rabs byin rlabs kyi khyad par du gzhir bzhag / kha 'gengs 'os pa rnams gsar du sbyar te badzra tsit+ta ko Ti'i sgrub gnas su rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen byang chub sgrub pa'i 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes shin tu dge bar thun khongs gcig tu sug bris su bgyis pa 'gro mgon shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che sa chen yongs su khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig / mang+ga lam// (388) (389)

This was faithfully composed with the permission from the venerable dharma king who knows and sees everything, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, coupled with my own strong interest. I, Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso Lodrö Tayepai De, have an innate propensity of undivided faith in this particular lineage. I took Venerable [Tāranātha] Rinpoche’s blessed teachings as the specific basis and added whatever new material was worthy.[26] At the practice place of Vajracittakoṭi, on the holy day of the Victor’s descent from the god’s realm, it was composed during a single session on the very virtuous positive conjunction of the astrological juncture of accomplishing awakening. May it become the cause for the widespread flourishing of the great precious teachings of the Shangpa Kagyu, the guide for migrators.
@#/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi ngo mtshar rin chen brgyud pa'i rnam thar la gsol ba 'debs pa u du m+ba ra'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// //
26. Garland of Uḍumbara Flowers. Supplications to the Lives of the Amazing Jewel Lineage of the Glorious Shangpa Kagyu[1]
(390)@#/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of the Vajra: Supplication to All-Pervasive Great Vajradhara
rigs kun bdag nyid thog ma tha ma med/ / dngos gcig brtan g.yo kun khyab zung du 'jug / rang bzhin 'od gsal bde chen ye shes sku/ / khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Epitome of all families, without beginning or end, a single entity encompassing the stable and moving in unity, the nature of lucid great bliss in an awareness body— pervasive lord Vajradhara, I supplicate you.
spros pa kun bral stong nyid sangs rgyas pa/ / rdo rje btsun mo'i b+ha ga gsang ba'i dbyings/ / chos 'byung thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ / gdod nas mngon byang chub la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Free of all embellishment, awakened in emptiness, the secret space of Vajra Queen’s bhaga, city of great freedom, source of phenomena— original manifest awakening, I supplicate you.
gnyis med g.yo ba med dang ris med dang / / 'dod dang mchog tu mi 'gyur 'dod chags che/ / dngos dang dngos po med pa zad pa dang / / ye shes dang ni sems dpa' kun tu bzang / /
Nondual, immutable, unbiased, great desire, neither desire nor excellence, entity and not entity, extinguished, timeless awareness, bodhisattva Samantabhadra,

nyon mongs med dang nyon mongs chen po dang / / lhan skyes dpal ldan byang sems thig le 'dzin/ / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang / / thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rnal 'byor mtshan/ / rnam grangs du mar ldan la gsol ba 'debs/
no affliction and great affliction, coemergent, glorious bodhicitta, holding vital drops, glorious Kālacakra Vajra, methods and wisdom, epitome, yoga— with numerous names, I supplicate you.
stong nyid snying rje dbyer med mi 'gyur ba'i/ / bde ba chen po yod med mtha' bzhi las/ / rnam grol bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ / don dam ye shes sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Emptiness and compassion inseparable, changeless great bliss beyond the four extremes of existence and nonexistence, the very essence of all sugatas, those gone to bliss, ultimate timeless awareness, I supplicate you. {391}
shes dang shes bya gcig gyur spros pa'i mtha'/ / (391) kun las rab 'das rgyu 'bras ma lus pa/ / ye shes gcig gis gcig car gzigs gyur pa/ / dpe bral chos kyi sku la= /
Knowledge and knowables unified, well beyond the extremes of embellishment, every cause and effect seen at once by the one timeless awareness— dharmakāya without compare, I supplicate you.
stong nyid sgra brnyan shar ba'i nyin mor byed/ / nges pa lnga ldan sku dang zhing khams ni/ / snang la rang bzhin ma grub mkha' ltar khyab/ / longs spyod yongs su rdzogs la= /
Echoes of emptiness rise like the shining sun, kāyas and pure lands with five certainties appear with no intrinsic nature everywhere like the sky— completely perfect saṃbhogakāya, I supplicate you.
