bzo skye mchog sogs dag dang ma dag pa'i/ / gzugs brnyan pad+ma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ / sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ / gang la gang 'dul ston la= /

As artist, person, supreme, and so on, pure and impure reflected forms, with fully bloomed lotus eyes, diverse emanations enacting the welfare of migrators, manifesting in whatever way tames them, I supplicate you.
sna tshogs gzugs dang rnam pa thams cad gsung / / mi 'gyur bde ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ / stong nyid zung 'jug gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ / mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor lor= /
Various bodies and all forms of speech, all aspects of changeless bliss in integral unity with supreme emptiness of all forms, inconceivable mystery, inexhaustible continuous wheel, I supplicate you.
rigs drug bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / / de nyid bcu drug rigs brgya mtha' yas rigs/ / gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad pa/ / rigs kun khyab bdag de la= /

Six families, twelve principles of truth, sixteen of suchness, one hundred families, infinite families, the many dancing in the experience of the one— pervading lord of all families, I supplicate you.
chos rnams kun la nye ring med par khyab/ / 'gro khams zad med rjes su 'dzin pa la/ / 'phel 'grib mi mnga' rtag par bzhugs nas su/ / rtsol med don chen sgrub la= /
Pervading all phenomena impartially, caring incessantly for beings everywhere, abiding eternally without increase or decrease— effortless accomplishment of great purpose, I supplicate you.
gzhi dus rang bzhin 'od gsal ngo bo nyid/ / lam dus zag med bde stong rnal 'byor gyis/ / bral 'bras dag (392) pa gnyis kyi mthar thug pa/ / spangs pa chen po de la gsol= /

Essence of natural lucid clarity during the ground, yoga of undissipating bliss-emptiness on the path, {392} reaching the result of separation as ultimate two purities— great renunciation, I supplicate you.
sgyu ma rmi lam pra phab brgyad bzhin tu/ / ji snyed shes bya rtogs bral ma 'khrul gzigs/ / chos can ji lta ba nyid mngon gyur pa'i/ / rtogs pa chen po de la= /

Like the eight metaphors: illusion, dream, mirror divination,[2] you unerringly see without concept the extent of all knowledge and the manifest subject itself just as it is— great realization, I supplicate you.
nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ don rnams 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa yi/ / dmigs med thugs rje chad pa med par 'jug / sems dpa' chen po de la= /
Engaging nonreferential compassion ceaselessly in spontaneous effortless welfare for every being for as long as space endures— great being, I supplicate you.
sa chu me rlung nam mkha' nyi zla dang / / rnam par shes pa sgrib bral dag pa yi/ / mtha' yas stobs dang nam yang skyon med sogs/ / yon tan brgyad ldan de la= /
Pure unobscured earth, water, fire, wind, space, sun, moon, and consciousness have limitless power, ever faultless, and so on— endowed with eight qualities, I supplicate you.[3]
rtag pa dang ni mi gdung rab tu bsil/ / gcig pur 'gyur med bde ldan dri ma med/ / dga' dang rtag tu mnyam 'jog yid dang ba/ / ro myang brgyad dang ldan la= /
Permanent, very cool and painless, single, changeless, blissful, flawless, joyful, and always in clear equipoise— endowed with eight flavors, I supplicate you.
bsam gyis mi khyab sku gsung thugs ldan cing / / rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas gnas skabs kun tu khyab/ / gnas gyur don sgrub byang chub skyed mdzad pa/ / dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan la= /

With inconceivable awakened body, speech, and mind, limitless miracles, pervading all situations, transforming, achieving purpose, and arousing awakening mind— endowed with eight masteries, I supplicate you.
longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde ba che/ / rang bzhin ma mchis snying rjes yongs su gang / / sku dang ye shes mi 'chad mi 'gogs pa'i/ / yan lag bdun dang ldan la= /
Complete enjoyment, union, great bliss, no intrinsic nature, completely filled with compassion, kāyas and awareness uninterrupted and unceasing— endowed with seven aspects,[4] I supplicate you.
gzugs phra reg pa yang zhing kun tu khyab/ / yang dag thob brnyes rab gsal brtan dang ldan/ / dbang phyug chen po 'dod rgur sgyur bar mdzad/ / khyad 'phags brgyad ldan de la= /
Subtle body, light to touch, all pervasive, genuine attainment, total illumination, reliable, great might, producing all one’s desires— endowed with eight superiorities, I supplicate you.
rang bzhin med cing rang rig 'phel ba dang / / 'grib pa ma mchis rnam par mi rtog par/ / dngos po kun gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yi/ / zab pa'i ye shes ldan la=

No intrinsic nature, reflexive awareness spreads, having no obscuration, without conceptual thought, all entities are seen as appearing reflections— endowed with awareness of the profound, I supplicate you.
bsod nams ye shes de yi spyod yul snang / / chos kun la dmigs thams cad rnam pas 'jug / kun nas thams cad don spyod phrin las te/ / rgya che'i ye shes rdzogs la= /

The domain of merit and awareness appears, and by observation the whole of reality is engaged; utterly meaningful conduct is the awakened activity— perfect timeless awareness of vastness, I supplicate you.
yul dang dus la nye ring ma mchis shing / / ngo bo dbyer med de nyid tha mi dad/ / chos kun mi rtog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pas/ / khyab pa'i ye shes brnyes la= /
Without partiality of object or time, inseparable essence, undifferentiated suchness, seeing the equality of all phenomena without concept— timeless awareness of pervasiveness, I supplicate you.
rgyun mi 'chad cing 'gog pa'i chos (393) mi mnga'/ / phra rab rdul dang 'gyur ba gtan nas spangs/ / rgyal sras kyis kyang bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ / rtag pa'i ye shes ldan la= / /

Uninterrupted, with no phenomena that hinders, {393} utterly removed from the most subtle atoms and change, beyond even the conceptual realm of the victors’ heirs— timeless awareness of permanence, I supplicate you.
kha sbyor sku dang 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs/ / rnam pa snying rje rtog pa'i nye sbyor thim/ / rlung 'gag zhu bde mngon gyur byang chub sems/ / mi 'gyur bde ba rdzogs la= /
Body in union, mind in unchanging bliss, compassion’s form, concepts dissolve in close union, vital winds blocked, melting bliss actualized in bodhicitta— perfect unchanging bliss, I supplicate you.
stong nyid las skyes las snang sdug bsngal 'gogs/ / gar yang phyin cing g.yo med rlung sems gzugs/ / shes bya mi 'gal mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku/ / rang 'dra'i sprin phung 'phro la= /

Born of emptiness, karmic appearance and suffering ended, the body of immutable wind-mind arrives anywhere, not opposing the known, the body of perfect marks and signs emanates multitudes of replicas; I supplicate you.
gnyis ka ma yin mi rtog chos kun gyi/ / rang bzhin la zhugs dag pa rab 'byams snang / / kun tu don mdzad go 'phang mi g.yo ba/ / zung 'jug yan lag rdzogs la= /
Not two, abiding without concept in the innate nature of all phenomena as infinite appearance, achieving all welfare in an unwavering state— integral unity of perfected aspects, I supplicate you.
ye shes gcig gis chos kun sgrib med gzigs/ / shes bya mnyam nyid ji snyed ma 'dres rtog / gdul bya 'dul mkhyen kun la rnam mi rtog / ye shes lnga dang ldan la= /

One timeless awareness sees clearly all phenomena, realizes every equality of knowables distinctly, and knows without thinking what tames those to be tamed— endowed with fivefold awareness, I supplicate you.
stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos/ / bco brgyad skye la thugs rje chen po mnga'/ / zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig sogs/ / chos sku'i yon tan rdzogs la= /

Ten powers, four fearlessnesses, eighteen unique attributes, great compassion for beings, undissipating awareness of the twenty-one categories, and so on— perfect qualities of dharmakāya, I supplicate you.
mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu dang / / gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu la sogs pa/ / gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis po yi/ / yon tan 'byung gnas de la= /
Thirty-two excellent marks, eighty secondary signs, sixty limbs of melodious speech, and so forth; those two form kāyas for others’ benefit— source of all qualities, I supplicate you.
rtsol med lhun grub rgyun gyis rtag pa yis/ / 'gro kun lam stegs la 'gong lam du gzhug / nges legs mthar phyin mdzad pa'i phrin las ni/ / gang 'dul mkha' dang mnyam la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Effortless, spontaneously present continuum permanently places all beings on the steps to enter the path with awakened activity that ensures definite good and consummation for beings to be tamed who equal space; I supplicate you.
bdag kyang srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas par/ / sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dngos kun khyab pa'i bdag / zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub nas/ / mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rtag spyod shog ! /

May I also not remain in extremes of existence and peace, but quickly accomplish the unified state of Vajradhara, the mighty one of four kāyas, presiding lord of all entities, and always engage the inexhaustible ornamental wheel.
ye shes DA ki ni gu ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ye shes sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Timeless Awareness: Supplication to Awareness Ḍākinī Niguma
rdo rje btsun mo rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ / smug nag rus pa'i rgyan (394) can mkha' la spyod/ / skal ldan rnams la mchog gi dngos grub ster/ / rje btsun ni gu ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Vajra Queen, mother of all the victors, {394} dark brown, adorned by bones, engaging space, granting supreme spiritual power to the fortunate— Venerable Niguma, I supplicate you.
nyi ma gung pa'i byin rlabs las sprul pa'i/ / ngo mtshar sa gzhi k+sI ra yi ljongs/ / dzam+bu'i gling na dpe med rab grags pa'i/ / grong khyer mchog tu 'khrungs la= /
In the amazing land of the Kashmir valley emanated from Madhyāntika’s blessings, in the city known as Incomparable in the world, you took sublime birth, I supplicate you.[5]
rnam dag bram ze zhi ba'i go cha yi/ / rigs kyi thig ler na ro ta pa dang / / ye shes mkha' 'gro dral dang lcam mo'i tshul/ / nyi zla zung 'brel smin la= /
In Śāntivarman’s pure Brahmin family sphere, Nārotapa and you, Ḍākinī of Timeless Awareness, as brother and sister, matured as a pair like the sun and moon, I supplicate you.
rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid kyi dngos/ / rgyal kun skyed pa'i gzugs su snang ba mo/ / srid pa'i tshul du rnam par 'khrul par yang / / sred len mtshams sbyor spangs la= /

Manifest emptiness endowed with all supreme aspects, you appear in the body of the progenitor of all victors, though in the illusory form of worldly existence, you abandon craving rebirth, I supplicate you.
grangs med gong nas sa dang lam rnams kyi/ / pha rol son pas rten 'dir rang byung gi/ / grub pa'i rnam thar bsam mi khyab pa brnyes/ / lhan skyes mkha' 'gro ma la gsol= /

Gone beyond levels and paths innumerable times before so that in this life the naturally occurring achievements found in your life of liberation are unimaginable— ḍākinī of coemergence, I supplicate you.
sbyangs pa'i ngal ba ched du ma brten par/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug dag gi gsung sgros tsam/ / snyan la sims pas chos kun khong du tshud/ / rang grol bde ba che la= /
Without depending on intentional ascetic training, just the advice of mighty adepts gracing your ears brought integrated mastery of all dharmas— self-liberated great bliss, I supplicate you.
rgyud dang gdams pa'i zab don phra mo yis/ / gcig shes kun grol mkhyen gnyis rtsal kha rgyas/ / chos nyid bden pa sgrib bral mngon sum gzigs/ / dpal ldan grub pa mo la= /

The subtle and profound meaning of tantras and instructions— knowing one liberates all—develops potent twofold knowledge that really sees without obscurity the true nature of phenomena— glorious female adept, I supplicate you.
stong pa'i mkha' la yid mig rlung bcings pas/ / d+hU tir dpyid kyi sgrub byed gzugs mthong ste/ / du sogs rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan gcig char bskyed/ / bsnyen pa'i yan lag rdzogs la= /

In the empty expanse, binding mind, eyes, and winds, you see the forms produced by spring’s [vital drops] in the dhūti, reflected vajra forms such as smoke arise all at once— the stage of approach perfected, I supplicate you.
srog rtsol mun can lto bar 'gags shing 'babs/ / 'khor lo drug tu srog thur mnyam sbyor bas/ / 'byung ba drug gi nyi zla'i bgrod pa 'gags/ / nyer sgrub yan lag rdzogs la= /

The life-force [wind] Rāhu[6] is blocked and falls to the belly, life-force and downward-clearing [winds] join in the six chakras, stopping the movement of the six elements, sun, and moon— the stage of near attainment perfected, I supplicate you.[7]
rgya gsum las 'das dpe bral phyag rgya ches/ / mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes bde rang 'od kyi/ / rnam bcu'i sgyu lus dbang po thams cad pa/ / sgrub pa'i yan lag rdzogs la= /

Beyond the three seals, the incomparable Great Seal causes the innate light of unchanging coemergent bliss to [manifest] tenfold illusory body with all its faculties— the stage of attainment perfected, I supplicate you.
nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung 'gags pas/ / de snyed mi 'gyur bde thob gtsug tor du/ / byang sems brtan las sa rnams yud kyis bgrod/ (395) sgrub chen yan lag rdzogs la= /

By blocking twenty-one thousand six hundred winds, that many [kinds of] unchanging bliss were obtained, bodhicitta stabilized in the crown and the levels instantly traversed— the stage of great attainment perfected, I supplicate you. {395}
nye rgyu'i spyod pas dgyes rgur rol mdzad pas/ / rdo rje 'chang gis rjes bzung dngos nyid dang / / skal pa mnyam yang slob pa'i zung 'jug skus/ / mkha' khyab 'gro don mdzad la= /

Through proximate-cause conduct, you reveled in pleasures, Vajradhara nurtured you and though of equal fortune, your kāya of integral unity of [the stage of] training enacts the welfare of all beings; I supplicate you.
chos rnams thams cad sgrib med mngon sum gyur/ / ting 'dzin sgo mo bye snyed bsam yas thob/ / rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod la rang dbang sgyur/ / rgyal ba kun yum khyed la= /

All phenomena became manifest without obscurity, you attained inconceivably millions of doors of absorption and gained control over the secret treasury of all victors— mother of all victors, I supplicate you.
stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bde chen sku/ / bde gshegs sprul pa thun mongs mchog gi bdag / sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal/ / rus pa'i rgyan can de la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Body of bliss, emptiness and compassion inseparable, epitome of common and supreme emanations of the sugatas, mighty one of the tenth level, glorious guide of migrators— adorned with bones, I supplicate you.
'khor bar 'khyams pa'i ma rgan sems can rnams/ / gting mtha' med pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho nas/ / zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i zhing khams su/ / dmigs med thugs rje chen pos drang du gsol/

Please lead with your great nonreferential compassion all grandmother sentient beings wandering in cyclic existence from the ocean of fathomless and endless suffering to the pure land of expanding, undissipating happiness.
lam zhugs skal ldan brtse bas rjes bzung la/ / 'gal rkyen gegs dang bar chad kun zhi zhing / / nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba dang / / lam lnga sa bcu mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ ! /

Lovingly nurture those fortunate to have entered the path, pacify all adverse conditions, obstructors, and obstacles, increase our meditational experience and realization, and bless us to complete the five paths and ten levels.
ye shes DA ki su kha sid+d+hi la gsol ba 'debs pa bde chen sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Great Bliss: Supplication to Awareness Ḍākinī Sukhasiddhi
zag med lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ster ma/ / bcu drug lang tshos gang ba'i gzi mdangs can/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs rje mo/ / bde ba'i dngos grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Giver of undissipating coemergent great bliss, full with the radiance of sixteen-year-old youth, mistress of the entire ḍākinī assembly of three places— Spiritual Power of Bliss, I supplicate you.
kha che'i yul du khyim bdag dbul po yi/ / tshul du bstan nas lam gyi rtogs pa spyod/ / dad dang snying rje chen po'i rtsal rdzogs pas/ / chags med sbyin par brtson la= /
You manifested as a pauper in a Kashmiri household, trained in realization on the path, and perfected faith and great compassionate energy, diligently giving without attachment; I supplicate you.
bskal pa gang+ga'i bye snyed snga rol nas/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen mthar phyin pa'i/ / sbyangs pa mngon gyur las 'phros dpa'i rkyen/ / khyim gyis thugs dbyung gyur la= /

For past eons as numerous as sands of the Ganges, you completed accumulations of merit and awareness. That training manifested as awakened karmic propensity and you renounced your home; I supplicate you.
gsang chen 'byung gnas nub phyogs o rgyan yul/ / pho skyes dpa' bo mo skyes dpa' mo yi/ / 'du ba'i dbus su phebs pa tsam gyis ni/ / rigs kyi nus pa sad la= /

In the land of Oḍḍiyāna in the west, source of mysteries, the males are heroes and the females heroines. Your enlightened potential was awakened just by arriving in their midst; I supplicate you. {396}
ro ldan (396) chang tshong spyod pa'i sgyu thabs ston/ / 'bras chang nyis bsing rnal 'byor ma la bskur/ / a ba d+hU ti nags khrod spyod pa dang / / dad pas nye mtshams sbyar la= /

You sold flavorful beer as a living, showed magical methods, and sent twice-strained rice beer with the yoginī for Avadhūtī,[8] the forest dweller, and with faith made a close connection; I supplicate you.
rje btsun bi rU pa yis rjes su bzung / / gsang sgrub bzhi rdzogs dbang bskur skad cig la/ / drug cu rtsa gcig lon pa'i rnam smin lus/ / bcu drug na tshod gyur la= /

Venerable Virūpa accepted you as a disciple and conferred the complete four empowerments of secret practice. Instantly your fully ripened body of sixty-one years changed to that of a youthful sixteen-year-old; I supplicate you.
nang gi lam nas rdo rje'i sa chen rnams/ / yud tsam gcig la mngon tu bgrod mdzad nas/ / zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru bzhengs/ / mkha' spyod dbang phyug ma la= /

In one instant you truly traversed all levels from the path of interiority to the great vajra level and manifested the vajra form of pure rainbow body— mighty one of the celestial realm, I supplicate you.
lhan cig skyes dngos rdo rje bdag med mar/ / dngos su gyur nas 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs/ khams gsum 'gro la gzigs pa dus drug 'jug / bcom ldan 'das ma khyod la= /
You became the actual coemergent Vajra Nairātmya, remaining in cyclic existence as long as it takes, keeping the six watches over migrators in the three realms— Bhagavatī, I supplicate you.
gsol ba 'debs la dngos su byin rlobs shing / / brgyud 'dzin bu rnams 'bral med thugs rjes bzung / / mchog thun dngos grub lo zla tsam gyis ster/ / thugs rje che mnga' khyod la= /

You grant real blessings in response to supplications, with compassion always hold close the lineage holders, and grant supreme and common powers in just years or months— great compassionate one, I supplicate you.
shes rab phar phyin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / 'gro ba'i don tu gzugs kyi skur snang bas/ / bltabs mi ngoms na mdzes sku'i me tog ni/ / mtshan dpe'i ze'u 'bru chags la= /

Your form body appears as Vajrayoginī for migrators’ sakes, a flower of such exquisite form that one never tires of looking, blooming with anthers of the signs and marks of awakening— perfection of wisdom, I supplicate you.
stong nyid rang bzhin chos sgo mtha' yas rnams/ / 'gro ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin ston pa'i gsung / / gzhom med sgra brnyan rnam pa thams cad pa/ / tshangs dbyangs drug cu ldan la= /

Your speech teaches according to migrators’ dispositions the nature of emptiness through infinite dharma doors with invincible echoes for all circumstances— Brahmā’s voice of sixty tones, I supplicate you.
bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dngos/ / brtan g.yo kun khyab lhan skyes zag pa med/ / 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i thugs mchog ni/ / chos kun 'byung gnas gyur la= /
Your sublime mind of lucid-clarity mahāmudrā, the true space vajra of bliss-emptiness inseparable, undissipating, coemergent, pervading everything— source of all dharma, I supplicate you.
bral smin yon tan bye ba'i bdag nyid can/ / bsam gyis mi khyab rnam par thar pa 'chang / / mtshan tsam thos pas zag med bde ster ma/ / yid bzhin nor mchog de la= /
Epitome of active qualities of freeing and maturing, subject of an unimaginable life of liberation, just hearing your name bestows undissipating bliss— wish-fulfilling jewel, I supplicate you.
rgyal ba sems dpa' kun dang bde sbyor mdzad/ / 'byung bzhis gar khyab de snyed rnam par 'phrul/ / bum bzang nor bu dpag bsam shing bzhin tu/ / phrin las lhun gyis grub la= /

Uniting in bliss with all victors and bodhisattvas, wherever four elements exist you emanate forms, like an excellent vase, a gem, or a wish-fulfilling tree— spontaneously present activity, I supplicate you. {397}
thugs rje nye (397) ring mi mnga' kun la snyoms/ / skal pa ldan rnams mkha' spyod lam sna 'dren/ / byams pa'i bzhin ras snying rje'i 'dzum bag can/ / skye dgu'i gnyen gcig ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /
With impartial compassion shown to all equally, you guide the fortunate to the celestial realm with a loving expression and compassionate smile— sole friend of the many beings, I supplicate you.
brgyud 'dzin gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu rnams la/ / brtse ba'i zhal ston dgyes pa'i lung mchog stsol/ / rdo rje'i ye shes chen po'i dbang skur la/ / nyid dang dbye ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ ! /
Show your loving face and joyfully grant prophecies to lineage holders, your supplicating children. Confer empowerment of great vajra awareness and grant the blessings of inseparability with you.
mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byams pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Loving-Kindness: Supplication to Great Master Maitrīpa[9]
che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ / snyan pa'i grags pas 'phags bod kun tu khyab/ / phyag rgya che brnyes jo bo mo tri pa/ / gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Your great qualities equaled the reaches of space, your fame spread throughout India and Tibet, master of mahāmudrā, Lord Maitrīpa, Advayavajra, I supplicate you.
bram ze'i rigs las mu stegs paN+Di ta/ / nA ro tA pa mjal te nang par gyur/ / dbang dang gdams ngag ci rigs gsan pa yis/ / sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad la= /
A tīrthika paṇḍita from a brahmin family, you met Nārotapa and converted to Buddhism. You received suitable empowerments and instructions that awakened the karma of former training; I supplicate you.
na len+da ru bstan la rab tu byung / / rtsod dus kun mkhyen rin 'byung zhi ba sogs/ / mkhas grub mang bsten rtsod bral paN chen tu/ / grags pa'i ba dan bsgrengs la= /

At Nālandā you ordained in the doctrine. When in dispute you attended all-knowing Ratnākaraśanti and many learned adepts, becoming an indisputable scholar, raising the victory banner of scholarship; I supplicate you.
rnam gnon tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs/ / bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad tshe rgyal ba'i yum/ / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yis zhal gzigs shing / / lung bstan byin gyis brlabs la= /
You entered Vikramaśīla Monastery, and while alternating teaching and practice, you saw the face of Vajrayoginī, mother of the victors, who graced you with prophecy; I supplicate you.
ting 'dzin grogs su 'gro ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ / nang gi kun spyod gsang zhing spyad pa la/ / glags lta'i snang ngor chang dang bud med dag / 'o ma dril bur bsgyur la= /
You knew the time had come to support absorption with the inner conduct, practiced secretly. You changed your beer and woman into milk and a bell for those who caught you; I supplicate you.
dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i tshe/ / chu bo gang+gAr lpags gdan bting nas bzhud/ / gzhan yang thun mongs thun mongs ma yin pa'i/ / nus pa dpag med brnyes la= /
When the sangha expelled you from that place, you left and spread a leather seat on the River Ganges, where you gained countless further abilities, common and uncommon; I supplicate you.
da rung de kho na nyid ma rtogs pas/ / yi dam lung bzhin dpal gyi ri bo'i ngogs/ / rgyal bu sa ka ra dang lhan cig tu/ / grub brnyes bla ma tshol la= /
Since you had not yet realized suchness, you went to the Śrī Parvata slopes, as the yidam prophesied, and, joined by Prince Sāgara, you sought an accomplished guru; I supplicate you.
ngal dub thang chad nyon mongs nyam thag kyang / / yid kyi re ba rdzogs bar ma gyur nas/ / zla (398) ba drug tu rtse gcig gsol btab pas/ / 'dod pa'i don grub gyur la= /
Although exhausted, emotional, and wretched, your resolve to fulfill your hopes never shifted. {398} After six months of single-pointed prayer, you achieved your desire; I supplicate you.
btsun mo zung gis zhabs brten ri khrod mgon/ / mngon sum mjal nas zab mo'i brda' bstan cing / / dbang dang gdams pas rjes bzung gnas lugs don/ / 'chad par rjes su gnang la= /
You met Lord Śavarī with two women attending and he taught you with profound symbols. Empowerments and instructions nurtured the abiding nature and you received permission to teach; I supplicate you.
don dam ji bzhin gzigs pa'i ye shes skyes/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mtha' yas gtso bor gyur/ / dbus 'gyur 'chang du yid la mi byed pa/ / rgya cher 'chad cing spel la= /

Awareness arose of seeing the ultimate nature just as it is and you became chief of boundless heroes and ḍākinīs. In Bodhgaya you taught widely on mental nonengagement and it flourished; I supplicate you.
bsil ba tshal du grong 'jug rol rtsed sgyur/ / nag po chen pos bzhed pa mtha' dag sgrub/ / lta stangs grub cing sku lus sna tshogs sprul/ / bas mtha' nags khrod 'dzin la= /

At Śītavana charnel ground you played with revitalizing corpses while Mahākāla accomplished all your wishes. You practiced yogic gazes and emanated various forms, keeping solitude in mountain retreat; I supplicate you.
gang+gA d+ha ri rat+na de bI dang / / slob dpon che bzhi la sogs rgya bod kyi/ / gdul bya skal ldan du ma smin mdzad nas/ / zag med dbyings su gshegs la= /
You matured many fortunate Indians and Tibetans, such as Gaṅgādharā, Ratnadevī,[10] and the four great ācāryas,[11] who went to the pure realm; I supplicate you.
bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog grub cing / / ye shes sku mchog mkha' khyab nyid du bzhugs/ / byang phyogs rgyud du snying po'i phrin las rgyun/ / thub bstan ji srid 'babs la= /

In the intermediate state you achieved supreme mahāmudrā, and your supreme awareness body dwells throughout space. In the north, your activity of Tantra’s essence continues for as long as the Buddha’s dharma; I supplicate you.
mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri gup+ta yis/ / mos pa'i bu la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ / bsam gyis mi khyab lhan skyes phyag rgya che/ / gnyug ma'i de nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ ! /
Master Maitrīgupta, son of the victors, think of me, your devoted child, with loving compassion. Bless me to realize the innate suchness, inconceivable coemergent mahāmudrā.
dpal rdo rje gdan pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa rang byung sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Natural Occurrence: Supplication to Glorious Great Vajrāsana[12]
nyi ma lta bu 'gro blo'i mun pa sel/ / zla ba lta bu mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ / thub bstan mnga' bdag rdo rje gdan pa che/ / bsod nams 'byung gnas zhabs la= /
Like the sun, you illuminate the darkness of beings’ minds, like the moon, you wax full the mandala of knowledge and love— master of the Sage’s doctrine, Vajrāsana, Puṇkyākara, I supplicate you.[13]
stobs 'byor phul byung 'phags yul ma la bar/ / mi dge'i las dang ngang gis mi 'grogs shing / / gtsang sbra'i kun spyod lhur len bram ze'i khyim/ / byin rlabs dge mtshan shar la= /

Born in excellent prosperous Malabar in the exalted land of India[14] into a brahmin household that practiced the pure conduct and was never associated with unvirtuous actions, the positive indication of blessing arose; I supplicate you.
bstan pa'i dpal du bsam bzhin srid pa bzung / / rigs gzugs longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la/ / ma chags skye bas thob pa'i blo gros ni/ / don gnyis (399) bsgrub par phyogs la= /

You took rebirth intending to glorify the doctrine. With your innate intelligence and without attachment to your good caste, form, or accumulated wealth, you practiced for the two purposes; I supplicate you. {399}
srid pa'i bde 'byor rmi lam ltar gzigs nas/ / nges 'byung blo shugs dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ / na lan+da ru bstan la rab tu byung / / legs pa'i don kun grub la= /

Having seen happiness and wealth as a dream, definite renunciation raged like the fire at time’s end and you took ordination in the doctrine at Nālandā— accomplisher all good purposes, I supplicate you.
sngon sbyangs stobs kyis rang bzhin nyes pa'i dri/ / gtan nas bral bas bcas pa'i ltung ba dang / / rmi lam du yang 'grogs par mi mdzad pa/ / don gyi dgra bcom chen por= /
The force of previous training kept you free of the stains of natural flaws, former violations, or associating with them even in dreams— genuine great arhat, I supplicate you.
'phags yul shar nub dbus kyi paN+Di ta/ / grub ba rnal 'byor tshogs kyi thugs bcud bzhes/ / thos pa'i rgya mtshor rnam dpyod nor bus gtams/ / dgos dgu'i 'byung gnas gyur la= /

You received the heart essence of hosts of adepts, yogins, and paṇḍitas in the east, west, and center of India, and filled that ocean of learning with gems of discernment— source of all needs, I supplicate you.
bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la 'gran zla bral/ / khyad par gsang sngags phyi nang chos tshul la/ / chags thogs kun spangs thams cad gzigs pa brnyes/ / mkhyen rab dbang phyug khyed la= /

You were peerless in the ten topics of knowledge, especially in the ways of outer and inner Secret Mantra, desireless and unhindered great renunciant, you gained omniscience— mighty one of highest knowledge, I supplicate you.
skal bzang bye bas pha phog thob gyur kyang / / gting mtha' mi mngon gdams ngag nor bu'i mdzod/ / mkhas grub klu dbang kun las bsdus pa bzhin/ / gzhan phyir 'dzin par mdzad la= /

Though you inherited from millions of the fortunate, the fathomless and vast jewel treasury of instructions, as if gathered from all the nāga king’s learned adepts,[15] saving it for others; I supplicate you.
skal bzang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ma ga d+har/ / thub bstan 'dzin mdzad rig grol spobs pa can/ / rgyu skar dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / tshogs kyi 'dren par gyur la= /

In Magadha, source of all the victors of the fortunate eon, you held the Sage’s doctrine boldly with knowledge and liberation[16] like the mandala of the moon amid stars and constellations— guide of the assembly, I supplicate you.
snying po byang chub chen po'i seng+ge'i khrir/ / 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug go 'phang brnyes/ / rgyal bas lung bstan rdo rje gdan pa zhes/ grags pas 'jig rten khyab la= /
On the lion throne at the heart of Mahābodhi, you attained the state of fearless lord of dharma. The Victor prophesied your name Vajrāsana— your fame pervades the world, I supplicate you.
rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bgrod gcig lam/ / byang chub thugs mchog lhun po ltar brtan cing / / bsil zer bzhin tu phyogs ris med khyab pas/ / rgyal sras thu bor gyur la= /

On the sole path traversed by victors and their heirs, your sublime mind of awakening is as stable as Meru and falls everywhere impartially like cool rays of the moon— chief of Buddha’s heirs, I supplicate you.
rin chen rgya mtsho la sogs thun men dang / / thun mong gsang ba'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas/ / grub gnyis nor bu'i dpal la rang dbang sgyur/ / rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khyed= /
Through your mastery of the common secret treasury and uncommon one, such as Jewel Ocean Tantra, you gained command of two spiritual powers— victorious vajra holder, I supplicate you.

mnyam med byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyis/ / phyogs ris med pa'i gdul bya yongs su 'dul/ / bzhugs yul snod bcud (400) shin tu bkra shis mdzad/ / mthong thos dang pa'i sa la bkod pa yi/ / 'brel tshad don dang ldan la= /

Your incomparable bodhisattva activity totally trained disciples without partiality. {400} You made the region and is inhabitants most auspicious and became an object of faith for those who saw or heard you— meaningful to connect with, I supplicate you.
thub dbang rgyal sar thub pa'i mdzad pa skyong / / 'phags bod mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ / 'jig rten lha dang bcas pas phyag byas pa/ / mi yi seng ge khyed la gsol= /
At Śākyamuni’s royal seat, you maintained his activity as the crown ornament of all Indian and Tibetan adepts. The world with its gods pays homage to you— lion of humans, I supplicate you.
bdag kyang tshul gnas thos bsam sgom mthar son/ / byang chub sems 'byongs 'gro don phyogs med 'grub/ / thub pa'i bstan pa nyin mor byed nus pa/ / skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam thar myur 'grub shog/ ! /

May I also keep the discipline, complete study, reflection, and meditation, refine awakening mind, achieve beings’ welfare impartially, be able to shine like the sun on the Sage’s doctrine, and quickly attain the liberated life of a sublime being.
'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po A b+ha yA kar gup+ta la gsol ba 'debs pa zhi ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Peace: Supplication to the Great Fearless Ācārya Abhayākaragupta
dzam+bu'i gling du nyi zla lta bur grags/ / rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad/ / rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa mchog / 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
As famous as the sun and moon in Jambudvīpa, you enacted buddha activity at Bodhgaya— supreme omniscient one in the age of conflict, Abhayākara, I supplicate you.
lho phyogs dza ri khaN+Dar rgyal rigs su/ / sku 'khrungs gzhon nu'i dus nas sgra tshad dang / / rig byed yan lag dang bcas mur 'dug gi / rgyud gzhung pha rol son la= /

Born into the royal caste in Jārikhaṇḍa in the south,[17] from a young age you studied grammar and logic and the Vedas with their branches to the end, going beyond tantras and classics; I supplicate you.[18]
skyed mos tshal du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / mdzes ma'i gzugs kyis bskul te b+hang+ga lar/ / byon nas mdo sngags kun la mkhas par sbyangs/ / sde snod 'dzin par gyur= /
In the pleasure grove, the beautiful form of Vajrayoginī exhorted you and you went to Bhangala, where you studied as a scholar of all Sutra and Mantra. Upholder of the piṭakas, I supplicate you.
rab tu byung ste 'dul 'dzin slob dpon mdzad/ / dbang dang gdams ngag 'phags yul kun tu btsal/ / chos tshul kun dang khyad par sngags rgyud la/ / mkhyen rab shin tu rgyas der= /

You ordained and acted as a Vinaya holder, and sought out empowerments and instructions throughout India. In all dharma traditions and especially in tantric Mantra, your highest knowledge flourished; I supplicate you.
dpal ldan sau'i pa yis rjes su bzung / / rdo rje phag mos 'chad rtsom mdzad par bskul/ / dur khrod kun tu bsgoms pas ting 'dzin brnyes/ / byang sems nus pa can= /

Glorious Sauripa accepted you as a disciple,[19] Vajravārāhī urged you to teach and compose, you meditated in charnel grounds and attained absorption— endowed with bodhisattva abilities, I supplicate you.
rgyud nas bshad pa'i las tshogs rab 'byams dang / / bden stobs grub cing brtag pa'i rig pa yis/ / dbul po'i zab kyi 'og nas gter 'don sogs/ / ngo mtshar mtha' yas ston= /
You taught many activity practices from the tantras, gained the power of truth and the awareness of signs, revealed a treasure under a pauper’s hearth, and so on— endlessly amazing, I supplicate you.
rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi na len+d+ra/ / kra ma shI la rnams su mkhan po mdzad/ / chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba yis/ / rigs can gdul bya 'dul= /
You became abbot of Bodhgaya, glorious Nālandā, and Vikramaśīla, and continuously turned the wheel of dharma— tamer of worthy disciples, I supplicate you. {401}
brgyad stong 'grel pa rtsom tshe phyogs bcu yi/ / (401) sangs rgyas rnams kyis mgrin gcig shes pa brjod/ / rdor phreng rtsom tshe me tog char chen phab/ / phag mo sku la zhugs der= /

When you composed a commentary to the Eight-Thousand,[20] buddhas in ten directions proclaimed it auspicious with one voice. Flowers rained down when you composed the Vajra Garland[21] and Vārāhī entered your body; I supplicate you.
snye ma rtsom tshe thog mtha' bar gsum du/ / bde dgyes dus 'khor gsum gyis bkra shis stsal/ / de bzhin don ldan legs par bshad pa'i gter/ / bstan bcos mtha' yas brtsams la= /

When you composed Ears of Grain,[22] beginning, middle, and end, Cakrasaṃvara, Hevajra, and Kālacakra granted good luck. Likewise for the other erudite, meaningful treasures and countless treatises; I supplicate you.
sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs zab don/ / phyi rabs 'gro la ngag lon bzhag pa bzhin/ / phyin chad bstan la 'byung bar dkar bas na/ / lung bstan don yod mdzad la= /

Like leaving a voice message for future generations of migrators about the profound meaning of the victors’ and their heirs’ intent, since it would be difficult for the doctrine to arise thereafter, you were prophesied to have an effect; I supplicate you.
nub phyogs yul du gtsug lag khang bzhengs tshe/ / lhung bzed nam mkhar bzed pa bza' btung gis/ / gang zhing mthun rkyen gnod gnas dbang pos sbyar/ / bzhed rgu bsam pas 'grub la= /

While building a temple in the western land, you held a begging bowl to the sky and Jambhala filled it with food and drink and supportive provisions— all views and thoughts achieved, I supplicate you.
theg chen pa rnams gtsug gi nor bu ste/ / nyan thos pas kyang 'dul 'dzin che zhes bsngags/ / rgyal ba'i bstan la dag ther chen mo mdzad/ / snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab la= /
Crown jewel of all Mahayana followers, praised by Śravakayānists as a Vinaya holder, great reformer of the Victor’s doctrine— famous in the ten directions, I supplicate you.
mkhyen rab thugs rje dbang phyug nus pa'i mthu/ / phun sum tshogs pas yongs rdzogs thub pa'i bstan/ / 'dzin skyong spel la dzaM gling rgyan rnams dang / / rnam thar mtshungs par gyur la= /

Your powerful abilities of knowledge and compassion were abundantly perfected and the Sage’s doctrine was upheld, protected, and spread in your life that equals that of the world’s ornaments; I supplicate you.
dus skabs de yi rgya bod mkhas grub tshogs/ / slob mar gyur sogs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas/ / zhi ba'i gnas gshegs bar dor phyag rgya che/ / mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la gsol= /

Many Indian and Tibetan learned adepts of that period became your students; after your activities were complete you went to a peaceful place and in the intermediate state gained supreme power of mahāmudrā; I supplicate you.
gsol btab dge bas khyod 'dra'i bshes gnyen gyis/ / skye kun rjes bzung spangs rtogs nor bu'i mdzod/ / rang dbang spyod nas thub bstan rin po che/ / dar rgyas yun ring gnas pa'i byed por sho/ ! /

By the virtue of supplicating, may I find masters like you to nurture me in all my lives and enjoy the freedom of the jewel treasury of renunciation and realization while spreading and sustaining the precious doctrine.
grub chen rA hu la gup+ta badzra la gsol ba 'debs pa rin chen sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Jewels: Supplication to the Great Adept Rāhulaguptavajra[23]
tshogs gsum rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa las/ / yon tan lhun po gling bzhi'i dbus na mtho/ / grub pa lha mchog bye bas bsten gyur pa/ / sgra gcan 'dzin sbas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

The stack of many precious atoms of your three accumulations[24] built up your qualities as Mount Meru in the center of four continents, adept to whom a million deities adhered— Rāhulaguptavajra, I supplicate you.
'phags pa'i lho phyogs e la b+hi sha'i yul/ / (402) rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sa gzhi khyad par can/ / grong khyer b+hi ra dzi ru rgyal rigs ni/ / sA la lta bur 'khrungs la= /

In the south of India, the region of Elabhiśa (Elabhaśa) {402} at the special sacred site of Vajraḍākinī, in the city of Bhiraji (Bhiriji), into the royal caste you were born like a sal tree; I supplicate you.[25]
de tshe 'od dang sgra snyan dri bzang bcas/ / sprul pa'i lha bzhis ye shes snang ba bstan/ / ngo mtshar dge ba'i mtshan ma las brtsams te/ / de ba sa twar grags la= /
At that time, with light, sweet sound, and good scent, the four emanated deities revealed their forms of awareness; the wonderful signs of virtue began then— Devasatva, I supplicate you.[26]

dgung lo nyi shu'i bar du dam chos sbyangs/ / nyer gcig dus su rdo rje tsher ma yi/ / zug rngus gdung tshe rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / / lha bzhis byin brlabs sngon gyi las ngan rnams/ / bsnyun gyis zad nas tshe 'dir mkha' spyod du/ / 'gro ba'i lung bstan thob la= /

You learned the Holy Dharma until you were twenty. At twenty-one, when afflicted by sharp vajra[-like] pains, a mighty yogin and four deities blessed you, saying that previous bad karma would be exhausted through illness and predicting your ascent to the celestial realm in this life; I supplicate you.
rang byung sgrol ma'i spyan sngar zhag lnga'i bar/ / smyung bar gnas tshe pha mas lcags su gcug / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yis legs bkrol nas/ / lung bstan byin gyis brlabs la= /
For five days in the presence of self-manifesting Tārā you did fasting practice, your parents bound you in chains, but Vajrayoginī freed you and blessed you with prophecy; I supplicate you.
rnam gnon tshul gyis bsngags pa'i gtsug lag tu/ / yongs rdzogs thub pa'i bslab gzhi legs par blangs/ / paN+Di ta dang grub thob du ma las/ / mdo rgyud rdzogs par gsan la= /
At the acclaimed temple of Vikramaśīla you learned well the Sage’s entire basic training and from many paṇḍitas and adepts you heard the complete sutras and tantras; I supplicate you.

zab mo sngags kyi don la mnyam gzhag tshe/ / bla mas a ba d+hU ti'i spyod pa la/ / gnas par bskul yang mkhas pa'i bsnyems pa yis/ / re zhig bshol bas phyis su rtse gcig tu/ / bsgrubs kyang ma grub guN A ka ra'i/ / bka' bzhin ljags dang yan lag spu gri yis/ / bcad pa'i mod la lha bzhis zhal gzigs shing / / sku lus sor chud gyur la= /

While you meditated in the meaning of profound Mantra, the guru urged you to abide in avadhūtī conduct,[27] but with your scholar’s pride you delayed. Later, even concentration couldn’t accomplish practice. You cut your tongue and limbs with a knife as Guṇasāgara had commanded you. At that moment you perceived the four deities and your body was restored; I supplicate you.
spyan ras gzigs dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / rje btsun sgrol ma myur mdzad ye shes mgon/ / nam bzhed dus na dngos su chos gsung zhing / / byin rlabs dngos grub stsal la= /
Avalokiteśvara, Vajrayoginī, Exalted Tārā, and Swift-Acting Awareness Protector taught you dharma in person whenever approached and granted blessing and powers; I supplicate you.
dz+nyA na sA ga ra yi bka' bzhin du/ / zhag bdun chur bying srin bu pad pa yis/ / sku yi khrag 'jib grong la nye ba yis/ / las sgrib rtsad nas zad la= /
You followed the command of Jñānasāgara to submerge in water for seven days; leeches sucked your blood and you nearly died— karmic obscuration uprooted, I supplicate you.

grub thob rnal 'byor rnams kyi bkas bskul te/ / rdzu 'phrul mthu yis gangs can ljongs su phebs/ / mkhas grub khyung po'i spyan sngar ya mtshan pa'i/ / cho 'phrul thog drangs byin rlabs lha bzhi (403) sogs/ / zab mo'i gdams ngag bka' dang lag len bcas/ / du ma stsal zhing sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ / skal ldan 'ga' zhig bcug nas 'phags yul du/ / yud kyis gshags bar mdzad la= /

The adept yogins encouraged you to use your miraculous powers to visit Tibet. Your wondrous apparitions appeared to learned adept Khyungpo Naljor and granted many profound instructions and practices. Beginning with the four blessing deities and so forth, {403} you inducted several fortunate ones in the emanated mandala. Then you returned to the Exalted Country and arrived instantly; I supplicate you.
lho phyogs rab brtan rdo rje'i sa gzhi ru/ / g.yengs spangs sgrub pa'i sa sde btsugs pa yis/ / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang / / 'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes la= /

At the most steadfast vajra land in the south, you renounced distraction, establishing that place for practice. You attained the supreme spiritual power of mahāmudrā and the state of an immortal awareness holder; I supplicate you.
ri bo nag po zhes grags shIng gi ri'i/ / khong gseng nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rjer bzhugs/ / sbyangs pa'i mthar son ngo mtshar rmad byung ba/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /
In the forested hills known as Black Mountain, you dwell as the vajra rainbow body— wondrous and amazing one who consummated the training, supreme mighty adept, I supplicate you.
bdag kyang sgrib gnyis dri ma kun zad nas/ / ye shes nyi ma khong nas shar ba yis/ / glo bur ma rig 'khrul ba'i mun khang bcom/ / rdo rje'i rig 'dzin tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig/ ! /

May I also exhaust all stains of twofold obscuration so that the sun of timeless awareness arises within to vanquish the incidental darkness of ignorance and attain the vajra awareness holder in this life.
mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs pa mos gus kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Devotion: Supplication to Khedrup Khyungpo Naljor[28]
dge legs kun 'byung thub pa'i bstan pa la/ / dus gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas grub che/ / mthar thug lnga ldan ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku/ / khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Great learned adept, unrivaled in the three times in the Sage’s doctrine, source of all good virtue, amazing incarnate of five culminations— Khyungpo Naljor, I supplicate you.
gdod nas byang chub chen po mngon mdzad kyang / / thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pas gdul bya'i ngor/ / rnam 'phrul mkha' dang chos dbyings khyab par ston/ / sku gsum yongs rdzogs khyed la= /
You manifested great awakening since forever, yet with ceaseless compassion for disciples your emanations fill space and the realm of phenomena— three kāyas perfected, I supplicate you.
bod yul sa yi thig le dbu ru'i ljongs/ / snye mo'i gnas su sprul pa'i mtshan dpe nyid/ / gsal ba'i mod la grub thob a mo g+has/ / byin rlabs lung bstan mdzad la= /
Born at Nyemo, the holy spot in Tibet’s central province, the moment the signs and marks of an emanation appeared the adept Amogha blessed you and made a prophecy; I supplicate you.
'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar bgrod/ / paN+Di ta dang grub thob thams cad kyi/ / thugs bcud bsdus nas 'gro rnams smin grol byed/ / sna tshogs sprul pas gdul bya 'dul bar 'gyur/ /
“This child, an incarnation, will go to India and collect the heart essence of all paṇḍitas and adepts that will ripen and liberate all migrators. His various emanations will train disciples.
theg chen snying po mtha' bral chos sgra sgrogs/ / mthar thug gsang sngags bde stong dbyer med kyi/ / seng ge'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrogs par 'gyur/ / de yi lus ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ (404)

He will proclaim essential Mahayana dharma, free of extremes, and the lion’s roar of ultimate Secret Mantra, inseparable bliss-emptiness, will be heard in the ten directions. His body will become Cakrasaṃvara, {404}
gsung ni ma hA mA ya'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ / thugs ni dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje ste/ / sprul pa'i gnas mchog gsang pa 'dus pa la/ / gsang gnas bde skyong gshin rje gshed du 'gyur/ /
his speech, the epitome of Mahāmāya, his mind, glorious Hevajra, his supreme emanation place, Guhyasamāja, and his bliss-holding secret place, Yamāntaka.
dkyil 'khor de rnams lus la bkod nas kyang / / gdul bya rnams la dngos su ston par byed/ / gzhan yang yi dam sna tshogs gzugs bzung nas/ / gdul dka'i skye bo dpag med 'dul bar byed/ /
Once these mandalas are arrayed in his body, they will actually manifest to his disciples. Further, he will transform into various yidams to train innumerable people difficult to train.
lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu 'tsho bar 'gyur/ / de yi mthar ni mdzad pa brtul ba'i tshe/ / ltas dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par 'gyur/ /
His life span will be one hundred and fifty years. At the end, when it’s time for the vanquishing deed, he will display various omens and miracles.
de nas zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can/ / rgyal ba kun bsngags zhing der sangs rgyas nas/ / theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /
Then he will pass on to the pure realm Sukhāvatī that is praised by all victors and become a buddha, turning the wheel of the Mahayana dharma.
phyi rabs dad ldan gdul bya thams cad kun/ / rgyal ba'i zhing der bgrod par the tshom med/ / de skad gsungs nas bla ma grub thob de/ / mkha' la bya bzhin gshegs la= /
Future generations of all people with faith will no doubt also go to that realm of the victors.” After saying these words, that guru adept departed like a bird in the sky; I supplicate you.
kun bzang rig snang 'od kyi rgyal po yis/ / byin rlabs ngo mtshar khyung chen gdung las grol/ / yig rtsis sems phyogs bon la mkhas shing grub/ / de 'dul gdul bya bskyangs la= /

Descended from the marvelous Great Khyung clan blessed by ever-excellent awareness appearing as King of Light, you mastered letters, astrology, and mind sections of Bön, nurturing disciples in that discipline; I supplicate you.
'byung gnas seng ge skor ni ru pa las/ / rdzogs chen sde gsum phyag chen gzhung gdams gsan/ / so so'i bstan la ston pa gnyis par gyur/ / skyes thob rtsal chen rdzogs la= /

You learned dzogchen’s three classes from Jungne Senge, mahāmudrā classics and instructions from Kor Nirupa, and became a second Teacher in each of those doctrines— natural and acquired great talents perfected; I supplicate you.
sngon sbyangs stobs kyis 'phags pa'i yul du bgrod/ / rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas gnyis pa mjal/ / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs/ / yongs rdzogs thugs su chud la= /

With the force of previous training you traveled to India and in Bodhgaya you met the second Buddha, Vajrāsana, receiving the three baskets, the four tantras, and so forth, and assimilating them; I supplicate you.
khyod ni sngon tshe rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i/ / nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che ste bdag la sogs/ / rgya gar mkhas pas mkhan po mi nus zhas/ / bsam yas yul du bsngags la= /
“In a former lifetime, as the Victor foretold, you were a śrāvaka with great magical powers; no Indian scholar could be your teacher.” Thus he praised your inconceivability; I supplicate you.
gang gis lung bstan ji bzhin bsil ldan ljongs/ / snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul glang thang pas/ / tshangs spyod thar pa'i rgyal mtshan bslangs par mdzad/ / thub dbang gnyis par gyur la= /

As [Vajrāsana] foretold, you went back to the cold regions where Langri Tangpa, a magical emanation of Amitābha, was raising the freedom flag of pure conduct— second mighty Sage, I supplicate you. {405}
dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye (405) phongs med khyer/ / gces pa'i srog la ma bltas dka' spyad nas/ / rgya dang bal po'i yul du lan bdun byon/ / sems dpa' chen po khyod la= /
You traveled seven times to Nepal and Tibet carrying rare jewels and gold without sparing yourself, enduring hardships without concern for your life— great being, I supplicate you.

rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ / khyad par mkhas shing grub thob lnga bcu dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma khyad 'phags rnam pa bzhi/ / longs sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la= / dngos su chos gsan ye shes mkha' 'gro gnyis/ / mnyes par mdzad nas mthar thug gdams ngag zhus/ / sgro 'dogs chod nas rtse gcig bsgrubs pa yis/ / mchog thun dngos grub brnyes la= /

You attended one hundred and fifty Indian scholars, among whom fifty were particularly learned adepts, and four were your especially exalted root gurus. Of those, the two awareness ḍākinīs heard teachings directly from the sixth [family], Great Vajradhara, saṃbhogakāya. You pleased them and received ultimate instructions, resolved misunderstandings, and practiced with single focus— holder of supreme and common spiritual powers, I supplicate you.
so sa gling chog seng ldeng nag gseb tu/ / rgyal yum rdo rje btsun mo ni gu mas/ / chig brgyud rdo rje 'chang gi gsang mdzod gtad/ / sa bcu'i dbang phyug gyur la= /
In the acacia forest of sublime Sosadvīpa, the royal mother, Vajra Queen Niguma, entrusted Vajradhara’s secret treasury to your single lineage— mighty one of the tenth level, I supplicate you.
bde sbyin sman gyi tshal du bdag med ma/ / su kha sid+d+his dbang bskur lung bstan cing / / gdams pa'i bdud rtsis thun min byin gyis brlabs/ / drug pa'i rgyal tshab gyur la= /
In the joyous Medicine Grove, Nairātmya as Sukhasiddhi conferred empowerment and prophecies. The elixir of her instructions held special blessings— regent of the sixth buddha, I supplicate you.
gnyis med rdo rjes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ / dbang bskur lung nod mnga' bdag mai tri par/ / phyag rgya che dang mgon po'i gdams pa gsan/ / chos skyong bran du khol la= /
In the emanated mandala of Advayavajra,[29] you received empowerment and transmission and heard Lord Maitrīpa’s mahāmudrā and protector teachings— served by dharma protectors, I supplicate you.
rdo rje gdan du dus mchod chen mo mdzad/ / ngo mtshar mtshan ltas zhag bcu sprel mar byung / / lha mi mkhas grub kun gyis mgrin gcig bsngags/ / sa gsum 'gran zla bral la= /
At Bodhgaya you held a huge offering ritual, amazing sights and signs continued for ten days; praised in chorus by gods, humans, scholars, and adepts— champion in the three regions, I supplicate you.
bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun/ / myur mdzad ye shes mgon por 'dus pa nyid/ / skye dang brgyud par bcas pa'i lha skal du/ / dngos su zhal bzhes phul la= /
Swift-Acting Awareness Protector is the very unity of all gurus, yidams, ḍākinīs, and dharma protectors. He promised in person to be the destined deity of you and your lineage; I supplicate you.
lha bzhis rjes bzung grub chen rA hu la/ / gdams ngag sgo skyel pheb nas rgyud sgrub thabs/ / man ngag las tshogs brjod las 'das pa gsan/ / ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul ston la= /

Great adept Rāhula, who was nurtured by the four deities, visited you bearing instructions; you received tantras, sādhanas, esoteric instructions, and rituals beyond count and were shown amazing miracles; I supplicate you.
sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du mar dbang bskur mdzad/ / dgra bgegs g.yul ngo sprul pa'i dmag gis bzlog / 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dmigs pa'i sgrom bu gsungs/ / nad gdon dngos su 'don la= (406)

You conferred empowerments in many emanated mandalas, averted an assault of enemies and obstructors with an emanated army, and were taught a treasure chest of visualizations by Mañjuśrī— actual expeller of sickness and spirits, I supplicate you. {406}
gshin rje'i pho nya lha yi bu mor sprul/ / rtag 'dzin can rnams skyo dang spro ba skyed/ / ri brag zang thal gcig dang du ma sogs/ / sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ston la= /

When you emanated as death’s messengers and divine maidens, those clinging to permanence developed remorse and enthusiasm. You passed through cliffs, appeared in single and multiple forms, and so on— conjurer of illusion’s apparitions, I supplicate you.
bla ma DA ki'i lung bzhin shangs su phebs/ / zhang zhang thog drangs dgon gnas brgya rtsa btab/ / nyan bshad sgom sgrub sa ster khyab par mdzad/ / bstan pa'i sgron mer gyur la= /

As the guru ḍākinī foretold, you went to Shang in Zhangzhong, and beginning there, founded one hundred monastic centers, covering the land with study, teaching, meditation, and practice— lamp of the doctrine, I supplicate you.
sku lus dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu la/ / gnas lnga rgyud sde lnga po dngos su grub/ / chos khri brgya rtsa brgyad du de snyed kyi/ / sprul pas chos ston mdzad la= /

Your body as the nine emanated deities of Hevajra really appeared with the Five Tantras’ deities in your five places. Upon one hundred and eight dharma thrones you emanated— teacher of dharma, I supplicate you.
rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha yis gsol btab pas/ / zla bdun ting 'dzin zas kyi 'tsho ba bcas/ / tA la srid kyi nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs/ / theg chen chos 'khor bskor la= /

Through the supplication of the gods of the four great kings’ abodes, for seven months you subsisted on the food of absorption and sat cross-legged in space at the height of a palmyra tree, turning the dharma wheel of Mahayana; I supplicate you.
bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs lha tshims mi rnams grol/ / sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byas so zhes/ / me tog char phab a la la yi sgras/ / lha rnams ched du brjod la= /

“You fulfilled the guru’s intentions, satisfied the gods, liberated people, and did the deeds for the Buddha’s doctrine.” Flowers rained down and the sound of a la la resounded— commended by gods, I supplicate you.
bshad grwa chen mo'i phrag dog sprul pas gzhil/ / mu ge'i dus su snga dro thang chen la/ / sa bon btab pa phyi dro 'bras bur smin/ / skye dgu 'tsho bar mdzad la= /

Your emanations suppressed the jealousy of a large college, and the seeds you planted in the morning on a wide plain during a time of famine ripened by the afternoon, nourishing many; I supplicate you.
'og min bde ba can dang po ta lar/ / yum chen 'od dpag med mgon thugs rje ches/ / skye med rnam gsum tshe sgrub bdud rtsi bum/ / snying rje mkha' khyab stsal la= /

The Great Mother in Akaniṣṭha granted the threefold [teaching of] the unborn, Amitābha in Sukhāvatī granted the longevity practice of the elixir vase, and Avalokita in Potala granted meditative absorption in all-pervasive compassion; I supplicate you.
lcang lo can dang o rgyan gnas su pheb/ / gsang bdag rnal 'byor ma yis dbang bskur zhing / / gsang rgyud 'bar dang 'du ba'i gdams ngag gnang / / ting 'dzin 'dod rgur sgyur la= /

You traveled to the sacred lands of Alakāvatī and Oḍḍiyāna, where Vaiśravaṇa and Yoginī [Siṃhamukhā] conferred empowerment and gave you secret tantric instructions on blazing and gathering— master of any desired absorption, I supplicate you.
thang lha sham po ma dros pa la sogs/ / mthu ldan che dgus srog gi snying po phul/ / dbang bskur dam btags bstan pa srung bar bskos/ / he ru ka dpal mtshog la= /

Tanglha, Shampo, Madrö, and the other strong gods offered their life essence and you conferred empowerment, bound them under oath, and assigned them as the doctrine’s guards— Heruka Great Glory, I supplicate you.

slob ma dbus gtsang khams gsum sa gzhi la/ / rme'u ston dri med shes rab sdong po skyes/ / g.yor po rgya mo phan sems yal ga brkyangs/ / dngul ston rin dbang snying rje'i lo 'dab rgyas/ / la (407) stod dkon mkhar byams pa'i me tog bkra/ / zhang sgom chos seng 'od gsal snying po lci/ / rmog lcog sgyu lus rmi lam 'bras bu smin/ /

In the ground of your disciples from U-Tsang and Kham, Meutön Drime formed the trunk of wisdom, Yorpo Gyamo, the spreading branches of altruism, Ngultön Rinwang, the expanding leaves of compassion, {407} Latö Könkhar, the bright flowers of love, Zhangom Chöseng, the core sap of Lucid Clarity, and Mokchok, the ripe fruit of Illusory Body and Dream.
bla ma DA kis lung bstan rang mnyam gyi/ / slob ma'i mthar thug drug gis gtsor mdzad pa'i/ / tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri phrag bco brgyad la/ / lo grangs du mar chos bstan smin mdzad nas/ /
These were the principals, the ultimate six disciples predicted by the guru ḍākinī to be your equals. The ultimate assembly of eighteen thousand was given teachings and matured over many years.

sku tshe'i mthar thug brgya dang lnga bcu'i mthar/ / rgyal chen sde bzhi dri za'i rgyal po sogs/ / 'jig rten che dgus mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ / gsol btab gyur la thugs rjes brtser dgongs nas/ / chos gsung lung bstan mdzad la= /

At the end of your final life of one hundred and fifty years, four classes of great kings, the gandharva king, and so forth, the nine great worldly gods supplicated you not to pass on. You considered that with compassion and love, and taught dharma and made predictions; I supplicate you.
'od dpag med pas bde chen zhing bkod bstan/ / khyod ni skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ / bde ba can du mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /
Amitābha displayed the array of Sukhāvatī pure realm and proclaimed, “You are in your final life as a bodhisattva and will become genuinely awakened in Sukhāvatī.

gang zhig khyod kyi rjes su slob pa dang / / 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos de dag kyang / / bde ba can tu rdzu 'phrul chen pos skye/ / brgyud 'dzin rnam gsum mngon dga' la sogs su/ / byang chub lung bstan thob la= /

Whoever trains by following you and hears the name of Amitābha will be born in Sukhāvatī by a great miracle. The [next] three lineage holders will awaken in Abhirati.” Recipient of prophecies, I supplicate you.
bdag gi bka' babs gdams ngag gnad 'di lta/ / gang na'ang med pas dbang po rab 'bring tha/ / rnam smin bag chags bar dor 'tshang rgya zhes/ / nges par zhal gyis bzhes la= /

“My transmission legacy of vital instructions are unique; those of highest, middling, and least capability will be awakened in the ripened, habitual, or intermediate body.”[30] Thus did you guarantee it; I supplicate you.
nga la dad rnams bde ba can zhing du/ / gsol ba thob dang der skye the tshom med/ / gsungs nas sku lus bkod pa du ma bstan/ / dbang bcu'i bdag nyid khyed la= /
“Those with faith, pray to me in Sukhāvatī! You will undoubtedly be born there.”[31] Saying that, you displayed a multitude of forms— epitome of ten powers, I supplicate you.
rgyud sde lnga dang byin rlabs lha bzhi sogs/ / so so'i skur dngos bzhengs nas dam chos gsungs/ / 'ja' 'od rol mo'i sgra yis gnam sa gang / / me tog char chen babs la= /

You manifested Five Tantras’ deities and the four blessing deities and others in your body and taught the dharma. The sky filled with rainbows and the sound of music while a great rain of flowers fell; I supplicate you.
ngo mtshar ltas bcas bde ba can du gshegs/ / sku dang ring bsrel bkra shis 'khyil ba sogs/ / dad ldan 'dren phyir gdung rigs dpag med sprul/ / grol ba bzhi ldan khyod la= /

In the midst of amazing sights, you left for Sukhāvatī, with body forms, relics, auspicious swirls, and so forth, to draw in the faithful with countless relics— endowed with fourfold liberation, I supplicate you.

bdun phrag gsum la ya mtshan ltas bzang sbrel/ / mthong grol sku 'bum (408) lha sku mkha' 'gro mas/ / dngos su mchod cing phyogs bzhir 'od zer shar/ / sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Wonderful sights proliferated for three weeks. The ḍākinīs saw your casket as divine form that liberates on sight {408} and made real offerings and light rays that shone in four directions— Buddha’s equal, I supplicate you.
bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ / gsol 'debs chu thigs dad pas blangs pa'i mthus/ / bdag dang 'grel bcas rjes bzung byin rlobs nas/ / khyod kyi rnam thar tshe 'dir mngon byed shog /

By the power of faithfully recording this prayerful drop from the ocean of your inconceivable life of liberation, please nurture and bless me and all those connected with me so that we actualize your life story in our own lifetimes.
rje btsun khyung po bslu med skyabs kyi mchog / 'gro kun spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan bzhugs la/ / thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i bka' drin gyis/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ! /

Venerable Khyungpo, our unfailing supreme refuge, stay on the lotus-moon seat on the heads of all migrators and with your kindness of unceasing compassion, please grant supreme and common spiritual powers.
mnyam med rmog lcogs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Wonder: Supplication to the Incomparable Mokchokpa[32]
don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa rgyal ba'i sras/ / ye shes DA kis lung bstan rtsod med kyi/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan rmog lcogs pa/ / rin chen brtson 'grus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Victor’s heir who spontaneously accomplished the two purposes, the indisputable lord of adepts who was predicted by the awareness ḍākinī, Venerable Mokchokpa Rinchen Tsöndru, I supplicate you.
shangs kyi lha phur she'u'i rigs su 'khrungs/ / chos sgor zhugs nas bla ma tshul bzhin bsten/ / sgro 'dogs chod nas nyams su bzhes pa yis/ / nges shes thag chod 'khrungs la= /

Born in Lhapu at Shang, into the Sheu clan, once you entered the dharma, you relied properly on the guru, resolved misunderstandings, and through practice gave birth to absolute certainty; I supplicate you.
thos pa snum dred khyer ba'i gang zag gis/ / rkyen byas gdams ngag tshol bar dam bcas te/ / khams pa a seng spyan sngar rgyud rgyal gyi/ / bskyed rdzogs zab mo gsan la= /

You met a man carrying [books], but you disdained study, so you committed yourself to seek instructions. Khampa Aseng[33] gave you profound creation and completion teachings of the sovereign tantras; I supplicate you.
bur sgom zhabs las rje btsun ras chung pa'i/ / bskyed rdzogs zhus nas sgrub la gzhol ba'i tshe/ / dgra la rtags bstan rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i/ / zhal gzigs ting 'dzin brnyes la= /

You received Rechungpa’s creation and completion teachings from Burgom [Nakpo],[34] and when you endeavored in their practice, you showed signs to enemies, saw the face of Exalted Yoginī, and attained meditative absorption; I supplicate you.
dkon mkhar g.yor po rdo rje rgyal sogs las/ / phar phyin gtsor gyur gzhung gdams du ma gsan/ / khyad par grub chen khyung pos rjes su bzung / / mnyes pa dgu phrugs bsgrubs la= /

With Kön[chok] Khar, Yorpo [Gyamo], Dorje Gyal[tsen], and others you studied many classic instructions, mainly the perfection of wisdom. Especially, the great adept Khyungpo accepted you as a disciple and you pleased him in many ways; I supplicate you.
gser gyi yon phul rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi'i/ / gdams ngag lhag ma med par gnang nas kyang / / chig brgyud bka' babs rtag tu bla ma'i sku/ / rgyud sde'i lha ru gzigs la= /

He granted you every instruction he had received from his four root gurus to whom he offered gold, and he even made you the holder of the one-to-one lineage. You always saw the five deities in his body; I supplicate you.
sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin (409) mngon tu gyur/ / gcig shas kun grol mkhyen rab rtsal kha rgyas/ / gdug pa'i 'byung po mtha' dag brtul nas kyang / / 'gro mang bder bkod mdzad la= /

You actualized illusion-like absorption, {409} realized all by knowing the one, invigorated your knowledge, and once you subdued all the noxious spirits, you made many migrators happy; I supplicate you.
mi 'khrugs pa dang ye shes DA ki gnyis/ / in+d+ra bo d+hi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / khyad par he ru ka yi zhal gzigs shing / / zab rgyas dam chos gsan la= /
You received the vast and profound Holy Dharma from Akṣobhya, the two awareness ḍākinīs, Indrabodhi, Vajrayoginī, and especially Heruka in visionary experiences; I supplicate you.
mnyam med dwags po'i spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe/ / skye ba du ma'i bu gsungs dgyes brtser mdzad/ / gcer mthong chos sku rjen par ngo sprad pas/ / rtogs grol dus mnyam gyur la=/

When you met the incomparable Gampopa, with delight and love he said that you were his spiritual child in many lives and directly introduced you to the nakedly seen dharmakāya, causing simultaneous liberation of thought; I supplicate you.
phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs brgyud pa gtad/ / ting 'dzin rtsal rdzogs de nas ji srid bar/ / tshe 'di'i rnam rtog skye bar ma myong gsungs/ / srid mtha'i byang sems khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /

He entrusted the mahāmudrā legacy lineage to you, and you perfected the skill in meditative absorption. You said from then on discursive thought never arose— bodhisattva in your final existence, I supplicate you.
rmog lcogs brag tu lo grangs bcu gnyis bar/ / mi zas spangs nas rtse gcig sgrub pa'i tshe/ / mi g.yo lha bzhi ye shes mgon po dang / / DA ki dngos su byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /

For twelve years in the cliffs of Mokchok you renounced human food and practiced with single focus. At that time Acala, the four deities, the Awareness Protector, and the ḍākinīs actually visited; I supplicate you.
shangs pa'i dus mchod mdzad tshe bla ma dang / / 'od dpag med byon dbu ma'i bdud rtsi gnang / / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas kyi/ / zhing khams mngon sum gzigs la= /

During the ritual observance of Shangpa’s holy day, the guru Amitābha came and bestowed the central channel’s elixir. You actually saw pure buddha realms as numerous as dust motes on each atom; I supplicate you.
zad par zil gnon gzhan gyis mthong bar sprul/ / nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs pas skal ldan rnams/ / dad cing rjes bzung gdul bya dpag med 'dus/ / kun kyang smin grol mdzad la= /

Others saw your emanations that overwhelmed and destroyed, and when you sat cross-legged in space, the fortunate ones had faith; you nurtured them and gathered countless disciples, maturing and liberating all; I supplicate you.
mtshan dang gsung thos bzhugs gnas mjal ba dang / / dad cing mos pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin/ / rgyud la skyes nas grol ba tshad med byung / / 'brel tshad don ldan khyod la= /

To hear your name or voice, or to see your holy residence, or just to have faith and devotion induces meditative absorption and leads to immeasurable liberation— any connection is meaningful, I supplicate you.
dbang bskur mdzad tshe sku yi gnas lnga dang / / rdul tshon dkyil 'khor rgyud sde lnga yi lhar/ / dngos su gyur ba skal ldan kun gyis mthong / / byin rlabs 'byung gnas khyod la= /

When you conferred empowerment of the Five Tantras’ Deities, they actually appeared in your five places and in the sand mandala, and all the fortunate disciples saw them— source of blessings, I supplicate you.
bde ldan zhing nas rgyal ba'i rim gro pa/ / spyan 'dren pheb kyang zhal (410) bzhes ma gnang bar/ / lo gsum brtan bzhugs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ / bu slob skyong bar mdzad la= /
Buddha’s attendants arrived from Sukhāvatī to accompany you there, but you refused; {410} you lived for three more years turning the dharma wheel— protector of pupils, I supplicate you.
nga ni 'di nas shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing / / 'od 'phro can tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ / theg chen 'ba' zhig ston par 'gyur ro zhes/ / seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags la= /

“I will go from here to the eastern realm of Abhirati where I will attain awakening on the level of Radiant Light.[35] Then I will be a teacher only of the Mahayana,” you proclaimed with the lion’s roar; I supplicate you.
brgyud 'dzin thams cad zhing der gsol ba thob/ / rnam dag zhing mchog de du skye'o gsungs/ / ngo mtshar cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa bstan/ / 'od 'phro'i zhing du gshegs la= /
“All my lineage holders who pray to me there will be born in that sublime pure land,” you said, and you displayed countless amazing apparitions, then left for Radiant Light realm; I supplicate you.
slar yang rdzu 'phrul 'od kyi lam la byon/ / brgyud pa'i dbang zhu 'gro ba'i mgon la bkon/ / shes rab ras par rigs brgyud mi 'chad pa'i/ / go sa gtad par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Miraculously, you returned on a path of light and invested the protector of migrators with the [dharma] lineage and entrusted Sherap Repa with the status of the family lineage to ensure continuity; I supplicate you.[36]
chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun rmog lcogs pa/ / gsol ba 'debs la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ / sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab pa dang / / 'od 'phro can gyi zhing du 'dren tu gsol/ ! /
Sovereign of the dharma, Venerable Mokchokpa, consider my supplication with loving compassion, bless me with your awakened body, speech, and mind and please lead me to the realm of Radiant Light.
dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Faith: Supplication to Great Öntön Kyergangpa[37]
byams pa'i sprin chen 'od gsal mkha' la 'khrigs/ / snying rje'i char rgyun gdul bya'i zhing sar 'bebs/ / grub gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad skyer sgang pa/ / chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba=
Great clouds of love amass in luminous space, a rain of compassion falls on the fields of disciples and ripens the fruit of two spiritual powers— Kyergangpa Chökyi Senge, I supplicate you.
'phags pa'i yul du shes rab go cha sogs/ / yongs su grags dang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / du mar sprul nas gdul bya dpag med 'dul/ / thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed la= /
In India you were Prajñāvarman and others, very famous masters and hidden yogins; your many emanations trained countless disciples— lord of compassion, I supplicate you.
tsI na'i yul du log spyod chos la bkod/ / phra men spre'ur rang gi rigs mthun gyis/ / rgyu 'bras stong nyid snying rje'i chos bstan mdzad/ / gang 'dul sprul pa 'gyed la= /

In China you brought misbehavers to the dharma and taught cause and effect, and emptiness and compassion to cannibals and monkeys as appropriate to their species[38]— spreader of emanations to whoever is tameable; I supplicate you.
skye ba kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ / rjes su bzung nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ / gangs ljongs 'dir yang sna tshogs sprul pa'i skus/ / 'phags pa'i phrin las bsgrubs la= /

Nurtured by Avalokiteśvara in all your lifetimes, you spontaneously accomplished the two purposes. Here in the Himalayan region, your various emanations also accomplished the Exalted One’s activity; I supplicate you.
dbu rur 'gro ba'i mgon 'khrungs skyer sgang du/ / kun mkhyen 'bal las rang (411) byung mdo phyogs dang / / klu sbugs rnams su grub thob lce sgom las/ / 'phags pa'i smin grol gsan la= /

Born in Uru, protector of migrators, you ordained at Kyergang and learned Sutra from All-Seeing Bal.[39] {411} At [Draklha] Lupuk you received Avalokita’s empowerment and instructions from the adept Chegom; I supplicate you.
mi lo phyed bzhir dka' spyad drag po yis/ / sgrub pa mdzad pas thugs rje chen po dang / / gshin rje gshed pos zhal bstan byin gyis brlabs/ / rtag tu 'bral ba med la= /
After three and a half years of intense hardship you became accomplished and were blessed by the sight of Avalokiteśvara and Yamāntaka, your constant companions; I supplicate you.
tsha sgom sben phug pa las ras chung dang / / jo bo brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gsan/ / rkyen la brten nas rang sems chos kyi sku/ / skye med mngon sum rtogs la= /

You received the complete instructions of the lineages of Rechungpa from Tsari Gompa and of Atiśa from Penpukpa. Conditions led to the direct realization of your mind as unborn dharmakāya; I supplicate you.
rje btsun rmog lcogs pa dang mjal ba'i tshe/ / ye shes mgon pos bsu zhing bran tu khol/ / chig brgyud bka' gtad snang ba'i bden 'dzin zhig / ting 'dzin rtsal chen rdzogs la= /

When you met Venerable Mokchokpa, Awareness Protector welcomed you and became your servant. Authorized as the single lineage holder, clinging to appearances collapsed and absorption’s great energy perfected; I supplicate you.
spyan ras gzigs kyis dam chos rtag tu stsal/ / rgyud sde lnga yis man ngag zab don gnang / / grub thob DA ki du mas gdams pa dang / / rjes su bstan par mdzad la= /
Avalokita always graced you with the Holy Dharma, the Five Tantras’ deities gave profound esoteric instructions, many adepts and ḍākinīs instructed you and gave teachings; I supplicate you.
skyer sgang chos kyi gdan sar pheb pa'i tshe/ / ye shes mgon po'i 'khor rnams dngos su 'ong / / bla ma'i gdan sar mchod 'bul skyel pa yi/ / zhabs tog gus pas bsgrubs la= /

When you traveled to your dharma seat of Kyergang, Awareness Protector with his retinue actually came along carrying offerings to present to the guru’s seat, and worshipped you with respect; I supplicate you.
mngon par shes pas ris med 'gro ba 'dul/ / wa ru Na yis klu yi nor bu phul/ / 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa lan gsum gyis/ / bla ma mnyes pa bsgrubs la= /
With prescience you impartially tamed migrators, Varuṇa offered you the nāgas’ gemstone, and with totally pure three spheres, thrice [you gave all] to please your guru; I supplicate you.
o rgyan gnas su pad+ma thod phreng las/ / dbang chen rta mgrin dbang dang sgrub thabs gsan/ / pad+ma'i bka' bzhin snye mo zhu yas las/ / gdams ngag rdzogs par mdzad la= /
In Oḍḍiyāna you received the great empowerment and sādhana of Hayagrīva from Padma Tötreng, and, as Padma commanded, the complete instructions from Nyemo Zhuye;[40] I supplicate you.
DA ki sprin ltar 'du ba'i zhang sgom sogs/ / grub thob rnams kyi gdams pa'i zab bcud bzhes/ / ting 'dzin gzungs chu tsam gyis nyam thag pa'i/ / 'gro ba dpag med skyong la= /

You enjoyed the profound, quintessential instructions from many adepts, such as Zhangom [Chöseng],[41] around whom ḍākinīs clustered like clouds. With only your meditative absorption, dhāraṇī, and water, you protected countless destitute migrators; I supplicate you.
bcu gcig zhal gyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ / rang gzhan nad gdon sgrib dag ting 'dzin skyes/ / dam pas zhi byed dgyes rdor yab yum gyis/ / dbyangs gsal bshags pa bstan la= /

Light rays radiating and absorbing from the eleven faces [of Avalokita] purified your and others’ sickness, spirits, and obscurations; absorptions arose. Dampa [Sangye] taught Pacification; Hevajra father and mother taught confession [using the Sanskrit] alphabet; I supplicate you.
snyigs dus khyed kyis bstan pa'i sgrub lugs 'di/ / dar zhing zhal mthong brgyud mar 'byung (412) ngo zhes/ / thugs rje chen pos gdul bya 'dul bar bskul/ / 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam la= /

The Great Compassionate One encouraged you to train disciples: “In degenerate times this practice tradition I have taught will spread and future followers will see me directly.” {412} Beings’ welfare equaled space; I supplicate you.
'di nas bde can zhing du brdzus te 'khrungs/ / rgyal las chos gsan slar yang o rgyan tu/ / sngags kyi spyod pas rdo rje 'dzin gyi sar/ / 'gro mang bkod par mdzad la= /

After this life you took miraculous birth in Sukhāvatī and heard the Victor’s teaching; again in Oḍḍiyāna your conduct of Mantra brought many migrators to the state of vajra holders; I supplicate you.
de nas mngon dga'i zhing du mi bskyod drung / / tshangs spyod mthar phyin baiDUr+Ya snang gi / / 'jig rten khams su mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ / brgyud 'dzin zhing der 'dren la= /
Then in the presence of Akṣobhya in Abhirati realm you perfected the conduct of purity and became a buddha in the world of Vaiḍūryaprabha pure realm. You lead lineage holders there; I supplicate you.
de bzhin gshegs pa dri med nam mkha'i dpal/ / sku tshe lo stong 'dus pa 'bum phrag dgu/ / dam chos lnga khri drug stong gnas 'gyur zhes/ / mi 'jigs zhal gyis bzhes la= /

“I will be the tathāgata Glory of Immaculate Space, live for one thousand years, have nine hundred thousand followers, and transform fifty-six thousand [sessions] of the Holy Dharma.” Fearlessly you made this promise; I supplicate you.
kho bo mthong thos dran reg don dang ldan/ / gsol ba 'debs rnams shar phyogs dag pa'i zhing / / sar gnas sems dpa' 'ba' zhig 'gyur ces gsungs/ / chos dbyings snyoms par zhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

“It is meaningful to see, hear, recall, or touch me. Those who pray to me will all become advanced bodhisattvas in the pure realm of Abhirati in the east.” You said this and entered equanimity in the realm of phenomena; I supplicate you.
spyan ras gzigs dngos dpon ston thugs rje can/ / bdag sogs las ngan gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams/ / thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du bzung nas kyang / / rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ! /
Compassionate Öntön, the real Avalokita, quickly grasp the hook of compassion and bless us disciples who have bad karma to accomplish the welfare of self and others.
sangs rgyas gnyan ston chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Blessing: Supplication to Great Sangye Nyentön[42]
legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab tu rdzogs/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang bshes gnyen gzugs su ston/ / sbas pa'i sangs rgyas gnyan ston ri gong pa/ / chos kyi shes rab zhabs la= /
Vajradhara in the guise of a spiritual mentor, you perfected every excellent quality, Hidden Buddha Nyentön of Rigong, Chökyi Sherap, I supplicate you.
yol mdar sA la lta bu'i rigs su 'khrungs/ / rang byung ma bcos zhen bral blo dang ldan/ / lus dang longs spyod gang la'ang ma chags par/ / sbyin pa'i phar sbyin rdzogs la= /

Born into the śāla-like [Nyen] clan in lower Yol, you had an innate, uncontrived attitude of detachment; without clinging to your body or any possessions, you perfected transcendent generosity; I supplicate you.
nges 'byung drag pos bstan la rab tu byung / / chos 'dul dbu tshad phar phyin mkhas par sbyangs/ / lhag pa'i bslab pa spyan gyi 'bras ltar bsrungs/ / tshul khrims phar phyin rdzogs la gsol= /

With intense renunciation you became a monk, learned dharma, discipline, madhyamaka, logic, and the perfections, guarding your higher training as your very eyes— you perfected transcendent ethics; I supplicate you.
