nad gdon rkyen ngan dag la mi zhum par/ / dam chos phyir du dka' ba chen po spyad/ / gnod lan kun kyang (413) phan pas blan pa yi/ / bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs la= /

Not intimidated by sickness, spirits, and adverse conditions, you endured great hardships for the sake of the Holy Dharma and responded to all harm with helpfulness— you perfected transcendent patience; I supplicate you. {413}
thos pa'i sgron mes phyi yi sgro 'dogs bcad/ / bsam byung shes rab nan tan dpag med mdzad/ / yengs med bsgrubs pas 'bras bu mngon tu gyur/ / brtson 'grus phar phyin rdzogs la= /

You clarified misunderstandings with the lamp of study, applied endless perseverance in the wisdom of reflection, and actualized the result of undistracted meditation— you perfected transcendent diligence; I supplicate you.
dbon ston thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung / / chig brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig rdzogs par gnang / / snang grags chos kun bden med 'ja' ltar gzigs/ / sgyu ma rang shar 'khrungs la= /

You were nurtured by Öntön, Great Compassionate One, who bestowed the complete single lineage of Ḍākinī’s secret words. You saw all appearance, sound, and phenomena as unreal, like rainbows, and self-arising illusion was born; I supplicate you.
dgyes rdor phag mo spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / / Ar+Ya tA res chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal/ / khyad par su kha sid+d+his ngo sprad pas/ / rtogs pa nam mkha' mnyam la= /
Hevajra, Vārāhī, Avalokiteśvara, and Tārā granted you the elixir of the dharma. In particular, through Sukhasiddhi’s pointing out, your realization equaled space; I supplicate you.
ye shes mgon pos bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub/ / ba ru Na yis bran dang 'bangs su byas/ / snang srid lha 'dre che dgus dbang zhus te/ / de dag chos su bkod la= /

Awareness Protector accomplished your orders for action, Varuṇa acted as your servant and subject, the great classes of worldly gods and demons requested empowerment, and you brought them to dharma; I supplicate you
nyin mtshan sgyu ma rmi lam lha yi sku/ / gang shar bde stong gnyis med ye shes dang / / 'dir snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa yongs su nub/ / bsam gtan phar phyin rdzogs la= /

Day and night, in illusion and dream, deities arose naturally and the timeless awareness of nondual bliss-emptiness completely eclipsed the deluded concepts of ordinary appearance— you perfected transcendent meditative stability; I supplicate you.
dur khrod nag pa'i bka' bzhin la stod pa/ / 'phags pa'i yul nas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis phebs/ / 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gsan pas gsang ba'i gegs/ / dbyings su grol bar bstan la= /

Following the command of Durtrö Nakpo, Latöpa came from India by miraculous powers and gave you the yogic exercises of immortality.[43] Your secret handicap was liberated in basic space; I supplicate you.
bla ma'i bka' bzhin ri gong dben gnas su/ / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshul gyis skal ldan rnams/ / rjes bzung phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing khams nyul/ / sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba= /

Following the guru’s orders, you stayed at Rigong retreat in the way of a hidden yogin and nurtured the fortunate. You wandered in pure realms of victors in the ten directions— master of the tenth level, I supplicate you.
grub chen brgyad cu la sogs dngos su byon/ / zhag gsum bzhugs nas dbang dang dam chos gnang / / lung bstan gsung zhing mkha' la gya gyur gshegs/ / rgyal sras thu bo khyed la= /

The eighty great adepts and others actually arrived and stayed for three days, conferring empowerments and teachings. They spoke prophecies, then left flying through the sky— foremost heir of the victors, I supplicate you.
skye med dgongs pa mnyam rjes khor yug dang / / chos rnams ma 'dres chu zla lta bur gzigs/ / dbang thob mngon par shes pa drug po 'chad/ / shes rab phar phyin rdzogs la= (414)

Your awareness of the unborn was constant during and after meditation, you saw all phenomena precisely like the moon’s reflections in water, and you were empowered and gained the six super cognitions— you perfected transcendent wisdom; I supplicate you. {414}
thog mda' bcu gsum sku la babs pa'i tshe/ / gnam lcags 'bar pa me tog rgyan bzhin gyur/ / DA ki'i sun ma bzlog nas rdo rje'i skur/ / byin rlabs gdul bya 'dul la gsol ba= /
When lightning bolts struck you thirteen times, they became blazing meteorites adorned with flowers. You sent back the ḍākinī envoys and with your vajra body trained your disciples; I supplicate you.
lha mo gnod sbyin dag gis bskul ba bzhin/ / bzo rgyu bsdogs tshe ye shes mgon po yi/ / sprul pas bzhengs nas de la dngos su thim/ / rang byon mgon po bskrun la= /

You were entreated by goddesses and rākṣasas [to make a statue], and when the materials were all collected, an emanation of Awareness Protector sculpted and dissolved into it, making a self-created Protector; I supplicate you.
rdo rje 'chang chen khyod la tshad med kyi/ / mos gus skyes pa de ni mngon 'tshang rgya/ / bdag kyang phyi bzhin byin gyis rlob po zhes/ / su khas mngon sum gsungs la= /
“Those in whom boundless devotion arises for you, the epitome of Great Vajradhara, will be enlightened. I too will bless them in the future.” Thus spoke Sukhasiddhi; I supplicate you.
khyed nyid gang gi mthong thos dran pas kyang / / de dag nam yang log par mi ltung zhing / / gdul bya'i sras su skye bar bla ma lhas/ / lung bstan yang yang mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /
“Whoever sees, hears, or recollects you will never fall back into error but will be born as your disciple.” Gurus and deities repeated; I supplicate you.
zhing 'di'i gdul bya re zhig rdzogs pa'i tshe/ / shar phyogs me tog bkram pa'i zhing du gshegs/ / rgyal ba pad+mo'i dpal du sangs rgyas nas/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la gsol ba 'debs/ /
When your work here with disciples was complete, you left for the eastern realm of Avakīrṇakusuma, where you awakened as the victor Padmaśrī— turner of the dharma wheel, I supplicate you.
'jig rten mkhyen pa rgyal ba gnyan ston pas/ / sgrib med sangs rgyas spyan gyis 'dir gzigs la/ / las ngan lus ngan gnas ngan 'khyams pa yi/ / bdag sogs sems can smin grol mdzad du gsol/ ! /
Knower of the world, Victor Nyentönpa, look here with your unveiled buddha eyes at us wanderers who have bad karma, bad bodies, and bad circumstances. Please mature and liberate all sentient beings.
'gro mgon chos rje ston pa la gsol ba 'debs pa seng ge'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of the Lion: Supplication to Drogön Chöje Sangye Tönpa[44]
yid bzhin nor bu lta bur dgos 'dod 'byung / / mtshan thos tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob/ / 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa chos kyi rje/ / brtson 'grus seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Like a wish-fulfilling gem, you make our wishes come true; just hearing your name protects us from fear of bad existences. Protector of migrators, dharma lord teacher, Tsöndru Senge, I supplicate you.
ya ngal dkar po gshen bon grub pa'i brgyud/ / mkha' reg rtswa yi sil mar mtshan dpe gsal/ / spyod lam kun tu chos kyi snang ba mched/ / sngon sbyangs bag chags sad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Born into the Yangal Karpo clan, a lineage of Shen Bön practice, in Kharek Tsaisilma, your signs and marks were manifest. In all your activities, the experience of dharma increased and propensities of previous training awoke; I supplicate you.
dgung lo dgu par ma gcig sprul pa'i sku/ / (415) byon nas gcod kyi chos dbang sems la bskur/ / zhal gdams chig brgyud gnang zhing lung bstan mdzad/ / mkha' 'gro'i sras gcig gyur la= /

At the age of nine, an emanation of Machik appeared. {415} She gave the Severance dharma empowerment conferred on the mind,[45] the single-lineage oral instructions, and made prophecies— single son of the ḍākinī, I supplicate you.
'khor ba btson khang dmyal me'i 'o bltar gzigs/ / dgos med skyo shas drag pos rab tu byung / / yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas mdo rgyud sbyangs/ / smra ba'i seng ger gyur la=/

You viewed cyclic existence as a prison or hellish firepit, with an intense sense of futility and renunciation you ordained and studied Sutra and Tantra with many tutors— Lion of Speech (Mañjuśrī), I supplicate you.
grub thob bzang yul ba yi zhal snga nas/ / grub pa'i rgyal mos brgyud pa bdun pa ru/ / tshe dpag med sprul 'byung bar lung bstan par/ / ngos bzung chig brgyud gnang la= /

In the presence of an adept of Zangyul you were recognized as the prophesied emanation of Amitāyus, seventh in the lineage of Siddharājñī, Queen of Adepts[46]— recipient of the single lineage, I supplicate you.
sangs rgyas gnyan ston spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe/ / dpa' bo DA ki du mas bsu ba mdzad/ / chos 'brel thog ma lus gsum gdams ngag gnang / / bla ma sangs rgyas mthong la= /
When you came before Sangye Nyentön, many heroes and ḍākinīs welcomed you. Your first dharma connection was instructions on the three bodies.[47] You saw your guru as Buddha; I supplicate you.
sgyu ma rmi lam sbyang sprul spel ba rnams/ / dus gcig grub nas ting 'dzin rtsal chen rdzogs/ / snang ba'i bden 'dzin mtha' dag hrul gyis 'jig / 'khrul zhig chen po khyod la= /

You accomplished all at once the Illusory Body and Dream practices of refining, emanating, and increasing; perfected the great energy of absorption; and utterly destroyed all grasping to the reality of appearances— great delusion destroyer, I supplicate you.
rdo rje 'chang nas rin chen brgyud pa yis/ / rim par lung bstan de dag gdul bya kun/ / khyed kyis 'dul zhes snyan brgyud gser chos bka'/ / yongs rdzogs skal ldan gyur la= /

From Vajradhara through the [Seven] Jewel lineage all in turn predicted that you would train all the disciples. Fortunate one to completely receive the aural lineage of Golden Dharma precepts, I supplicate you.
nyin mo blo 'das brjod bral phyag rgya che/ / mtshan snang mtshan nyid sum ldan lhun grub kyi/ / 'od gsal rang shar zung 'jug rang bzhin 'char/ / rgyal ba sku gsum rdzogs la= /
sku la grib ma mi mnga' sems can gyi/ / bsam rgyud skye ba dus gsum sa ler mkhyen/ / dgongs pa gtad pas mdze gdon gcong nad sogs/ / mod la zhi bar mdzad der= /

Your body cast no shadow and you clearly saw sentient beings’ thoughts from their lives in the three times. Your attention to afflictions of leprosy, spirits, and chronic disease instantly cured them; I supplicate you.
dbang bskur dus su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis/ / dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing so so'i sku ru bstan/ / mtshan thos lam zhugs zhal mjal tsam gyis kyang / / ting 'dzin mchog skyed mdzad la= /

When you conferred empowerment, the heroes and ḍākinīs built the mandala and displayed their individual forms. People entered the dharma by hearing your name; just seeing you produced supreme absorption; I supplicate you.
bsam gtan brag tu mkha' 'gro ni gu mas/ / mu tig phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad gnang ste/ / sbas pa'i grub thob de mtshungs 'byung ba yi/ / lung bzhin smin (416) grol mdzad la= /
At Meditation Cliff, Ḍākinī Niguma gave you a rosary of one hundred and eight pearls, foretelling an equal number of hidden adepts that you would mature and liberate; I supplicate you. {416}
bla ma'i bka' bzhin dbang po mchog dman dang / / bzang ngan rgan gzhon phyogs dang ris med par/ / nyams khrid thebs pas mtshan gyi snyan pa ni/ / rgya mtsho'i pha mthar khyab la= /
You gave experiential guidance, as your guru commanded, impartially to high and low, good and bad, old and young, such that the fame of your name reached far shores; I supplicate you.
dzam bu'i gling gi yul chen drug po dang / / gling phran tshun chad grub thob slob mas khyab/ / skal ldan 'bum phrag du ma smin mdzad pa'i/ / rnam thar bsam mi khyab la= /

The world with its six great continents and lesser regions was filled with your student adepts; you brought many hundreds of thousands to spiritual maturity through your unthinkable life of liberation; I supplicate you.
rigs drug khyab bdag yab yum lung bstan ltar/ / rin chen bdun ba'i phreng bar byon nas kyang / / rdo rje'i rgya bkrol thub bstan ji srid bar/ / thar pa'i kha lo bsgyur la= /

As prophesied by the lord couple of the sixth family, once the garland of Seven Jewels had ended, you released the vajra knot, and as long as the doctrine remains, you will be the guide to emancipation; I supplicate you.
rtag 'dzin can rnams longs med bskul ba'i slad/ / 'gro don mthar phyin 'ja' 'od me tog char/ / sa g.yo spos ngad bcas te shar phyogs zhing / / me tog bkram par gshegs la= /

In order to inspire those who cling to permanence, you completed your altruistic work and departed to the eastern realm amid rainbows, flower showers, earth tremors, and wafting incense; gone to Avakīrṇakusuma, I supplicate you.
lha mi'i mchod pa'i rten tu ngo mtshar ba'i/ / gdung rigs lha sku ring bsrel dpag med sprul/ / srid mtha'i bar du dad ldan bsod nams zhing / / mi nyams rgyas par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Your amazing remains emanated countless relics of deity forms as a support for the offerings of gods and humans, remaining a field of merit for the faithful until the end of existence, not diminishing but increasing; I supplicate you.
sa gsum 'gran zla bral ba chos kyi rje/ / dag pa'i zhing nas ye shes spyan gyis gzigs/ / gsol 'debs bu la thugs rje'i shugs bskyed la/ / tshe gcig mngon 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis rlobs/ ! /
Dharma lord unrivaled in the three regions, look from your pure realm with eyes of awareness, arouse the power of your compassion for your supplicants, and bless us with awakening in one lifetime.
mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston la gsol ba 'debs pa dpal gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Glory: Supplication to Khedrup Tsangma Shangtön[48]
mtshan dpe'i me tog bslab gsum dri ngad 'phro/ / mkhyen brtse'i ze'u 'bru dri med mdzes pa'i sku/ / mthong thos dran pas gdung sel shangs ston pa/ / mkhas grub chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
dal 'byor sdong po tshul khrims lo 'dab rgyas/ / thos bsam gzhi brtan ting 'dzin pad+mo 'dzum/ / nyams rtogs 'bras bu'i ro bcud g.yur du za/ / gtsang ma shangs ston zhabs la= /

Leaves of morality grew from the stem of your free and endowed life, the lotus of absorption bloomed from the firm ground of study and reflection, and the fruit of experiential realization was nectar ripe for the picking— Tsangma Shangtön, I supplicate you.
shangs kyi yul dang rwa rigs yab yum la/ / bkra shis dge ba'i ltas bcas sku 'khrungs nas/ / nges 'byung mos gus snying rje tshad med pas/ / byis pa'i spyod (417) las 'das la= /
Born amid auspicious portents of virtue to parents of the Rwa clan in the Shang region, your renunciation, devotion, and boundless compassion was beyond childish behavior; I supplicate you. {417}
rnyogs pa med pa'i tshul khrims rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / bslab pa phra mo dag kyang srog bzhin bsrung / / 'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ / thos bsam rgya cher mdzad la= /

You held the victory banner of unblemished ethics, guarding as your life even minor points of training. Unrivaled in explanation, debate, and composition, you broadened study and reflection; I supplicate you.
longs spyod mtha' dag chos kyi phyogs su btang / / kyal ka'i phyir yang bla ma'i gsung mi gcog / tshe 'di'i 'dun gros thams cad lings kyis bor/ / rtse gcig sgrub par gzhol la= /
You dedicated all your possessions to the dharma, never disobeyed the guru’s words even in jest, and left the schemes of this life far behind, intent on accomplishment in one life; I supplicate you.
ri gong chos rjes sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhal/ / mthong ba tsam gyis bcos min mos gus dang / / ting 'dzin mchog skyes bdun phrag zhag gi khongs/ / chos drug yon tan rdzogs la= /
Just the sight of Rigong Chöje Tönpa’s face inspired your uncontrived devotion; meditative absorption was born and within seven days you perfected the Six Dharmas; I supplicate you.
chig brgyud bdud rtsi thog mar gsol ba yi/ / skal ldan lung bstan 'khor gyi dang po zhes/ / 'gran zla bral ba'i thugs sras dam par mdzad/ / mkhas grub rtsod med gyur la= /

“You are the first to drink the elixir of the single lineage, fortunate one who was prophesied as my foremost disciple.” Thus [Sangye Tönpa] made you the unrivaled holy spiritual son— undisputed learned adept, I supplicate you.
'di dang phyi mar 'gro don dpag med 'byung / / bde ba can tu bcu bzhi'i sa thob cing / / brgyud 'dzin dang bcas dag pa mkha' spyod du/ / 'gro ba'i lung bstan brnyes la= /

“In this and future lives, you will benefit countless beings, attain the fourteenth level in Sukhāvatī, and go to the celestial realm with the lineage holders.” Recipient of that prophecy, I supplicate you.
rdo rje phag mos dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod stsal/ / a ti'i khrid gsan lta stangs bcas ma thag / rig pa tshad pheb 'od gsal rgya 'byams shar/ / 'khrul snang dbyings su nub la= /

Vajravārāhī granted you introduction to the four empowerments. You received guidance in Ati, and as soon as you practiced the gazes, you reached the culmination of awareness, infinite lucid clarity. Deluded appearance subsided in basic space; I supplicate you.
gegs skyon mtha' dag bde ba chen por grol/ / phyi nang snang srid dag pa rab 'byams gzigs/ / sgrol mas byin brlabs mnyam rjes 'khor yug 'dres/ DA ki dngos su 'dul= /

All obstructions and flaws were released in great bliss, you saw outer and inner apparent existence as infinite purity; and with Tārā’s blessing, equipoise and postmeditation blended continuously— surrounded by ḍākinīs, I supplicate you.
phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kun gsal bar mnga'/ / sku la 'bu srin dri med gzi mdangs ldan/ / zhal ras mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur/ / thugs rje che dngos khyed la= /

You displayed all the signs of a nonreturner, your body, not affected by vermin, shown with pure radiance; just seeing your face transformed people’s perceptions— Great Compassionate One incarnate, I supplicate you.
nad gdon mtha' dag zhal chab tsam gyis sel/ / mthong thos 'brel ba'i dad ldan ris med la/ / sgyu ma 'od gsal la sogs ting nge 'dzin/ / tshegs med 'char bar mdzad la= /

All disease and demons were dispelled just by your spit, anyone with faith who saw, heard, or connected with you experienced the absorptions of illusion, lucid clarity, and so on arising effortlessly; I supplicate you.
yon tan ma lus sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ / bzhugs gdan na bza' phrugs gcig ma (418) gtogs pa/ / bdag gir bzung ba'i yo byad kun spangs la/ / zhen log mthar phyin khyed la= /
Full of qualities, you lived in a hidden way, renouncing possessiveness of all material things, {418} with only your cushion and one day’s provisions— ultimate renunciant, I supplicate you.
'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas DA ki yi/ / bsu ba mkha' dbyings khyab sogs ngo mtshar ba'i/ / cho 'phrul bstan nas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ / sku gdud rgyas par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

After achieving tremendous welfare for migrators, you departed for the pure realm amid amazing miracles, such as ḍākinī envoys who filled the whole of space; you left prolific relics, I supplicate you.
dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ / bdag sogs 'khor ba'i 'dam las myur drangs te/ / tshe 'dir bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / / phyi mar sku gsum go 'phang thob mdzad gsol/ ! /

Glorious guru, with your hook of compassion, quickly pull us from the swamp of cyclic existence; in this life, fulfill our wishes that accord with the dharma, and in next life, let us attain the state of the three kāyas.
mkhas grub bsam sdings la gzhon nu grub la gsol ba 'debs pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Renown: Supplication to Khedrup Samdingpa Zhönu Drup[49]
dri med rnam thar 'gyur med rtogs pa'i mchog / g.yel med thugs rje thogs med mngon par shes/ / don ldan phrin las bdag nyid bsam sdings pa/ / gzhon nu grub mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
The epitome of a flawless life, unchanging sublime realization, unwavering compassion, unrestricted super cognitions, and meaningful awakened activity— Samdingpa Zhönu Drup, I supplicate you.
bsngags 'os yon tan brgya ldan nyang smad du/ / khyim bdag drwa mar mkha' 'gro'i lhums su zhugs/ / bltams nas dgung lo bzhi par grub pa'i gnas/ / gzigs tshe ting 'dzin brnyes la= /

In Lower Nyang Valley, praised for its one hundred qualities, in an eminent household you entered a ḍākinī’s womb. You were born, and when four years old, the sight of an adept’s dwelling generated your meditative absorption; I supplicate you.
snar thang chos grwar mchims las rab tu byung / / mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag kun la sbyangs/ / btsun mkhas shes rab zab mo'i pha rol phyin/ / rnam spyod 'gran zla bral la= /

At Nartang dharma college you took ordination from Chimpa and studied all the sutras, tantras, treatises, and instructions. You became a learned monastic, perfecting profound wisdom— unrivalled in discernment, I supplicate you.
'khor dang longs spyod tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor kun/ / mchil ma'i thal ba lta bur ring du bor/ / dka' thub drag pos dge sbyor dpag med mdzad/ / bya btang rgyal po khyed la= /

Retinue, possessions, and all the prosperity of this life you shot far away from you like drops of spittle. You engaged in boundless virtue through intense hardship— king of ascetics, I supplicate you.
mtshan ldan mkhas grub brgyad cu rtsa gsum bsten/ / thugs yid gcig 'dres thugs bcud rdzogs par bzhes/ / kun gyis gzengs bstod lung bstan rjes gnang thob/ / rgyal tshab dbang brnyes gyur la= /

You attended eighty-three authentic learned adepts; your mind merged with theirs and fully absorbed their heart essence. You obtained encouraging predictions and permissions— empowered regent, I supplicate you.
sangs rgyas ston pa'i drung du pheb pa'i lam/ / gsol ba btab pas sgyu lus rmi lam gyi/ / ting 'dzin rang 'khrungs zhal ras mthong tsam gyis/ / rtog tshogs chos skur (419) grol la= /
chig brgyud thog drangs zab chos ma lus pa/ / bum pa gang byor stsal te nga yis chos/ / bdag por 'phrod pas 'gro don mdzod cig ces/ / gnang ba lan gsum thob la= /

You were at the head of the [opening of the] single lineage and granted all the profound dharma like a full vase: “You are the chosen heir of my dharma; now help others!”— thrice you obtained such permission; I supplicate you.
bzod med snying rjes rang bde ring spangs nas/ / yengs med brtson pas chos sku'i ngang du 'byams/ / 'khrul pa'i snang ba nam yang mi mnga' ba/ / 'od gsal khor yug gyur la= /

With unbearable compassion you ignored your own happiness and with unwavering diligence floated in the state of dharmakāya, never again subject to deluded perceptions, only lucid clarity day and night; I supplicate you.
rdzogs pa che dang gsung ngag rin po che'i/ / dgongs nyams mthar phyin sangs rgyas zhing khams dang / / 'gro drug gnas rnams ma bsgribs sa ler gzigs/ / ye shes spyan dang ldan la= /

You experienced the intent of the great completion and the precious instruction [of the Path with Its Result]; you clearly saw the pure lands and the six realms of migrators— endowed with eyes of timeless awareness, I supplicate you.
gnyan khrod du mar lus srog thed la bor/ / stong nyid snying rje'i brtul zhugs rlabs chen gyis/ / rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis mnan/ / spyod yul mthar phyin khyed la= /

In numerous haunted places, without concern for life or limb, your powerful deliberate conduct of emptiness and compassion controlled your own perceptions and outshone those of others. You reached the ultimate sphere of activity; I supplicate you.
bla ma'i spyan sngar smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe/ / bka' brgyud bla ma byon nas byin gyis brlabs/ / snang sems sku dang zhing khams ye shes las/ / nam yang g.yo ba med la= /

When you were making aspirations in the presence of the guru, Kagyu lamas came and bestowed their blessings. You never wavered from the timeless awareness of appearance and mind as kāyas and pure lands; I supplicate you.
mthong thos dran reg gdul bya tshad med pa/ / thar pa'i grong du bkod nas ngo mtshar ltas/ / bsam mi khyab bcas bde ba can du gshegs/ / rnam 'phrul mkha' mnyam bstan la= /

After countless beings who saw, heard, or touched you were established in freedom, you departed for Sukhāvatī amid unimaginably amazing signs and emanations equaling the reaches of space; I supplicate you.
chos kyi rgyal po mkhas grub rin po che/ / dag pa'i zhing nas brtse bas gzigs mdzod la/ / 'gro kun srid pa'i mya ngan las bsgral zhing / / sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol/ ! /
Dharma king, Khedrup Rinpoche, regard us with love from your pure realm, liberate all migrators from miserable existences, and increase the virtuous doctrine of the practice lineage.
mkhas btsun 'jag chen rgyal mtshan 'bum la gsol ba 'debs pa rnam grol sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Liberation: Supplication to Khetsun Jakchen Gyaltsen Bum[50]
smon lam rgya mtsho dri med gting mtha' bral/ / rmad byung yon tan rin chen gter gyis gang / / mkhas btsun sangs rgyas dpal ldan 'jag chen pa/ / rgyal mtshan 'bum pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Your vast flawless aspirations had no end or boundary, you were filled by a precious treasure of marvelous qualities— learned and righteous Sangye Palden Jakchenpa, Gyaltsen Bumpa, I supplicate you.
grub rigs thig ler sprul pa'i sku ru bstan/ / ma bslab yi ge rang (420) brdol blo rtsal rgyas/ / gzigs pa tsam gyis chos kun thugs la 'khrungs/ / gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul ston la= /

You assumed an emanated form in a family of adepts, literacy flowed automatically without study, your intellectual skill grew, and all the teachings came into your mind at first sight—{420} magical emanation for any trainees; I supplicate you.
bslab gzhi kun blangs spang bya mtha' dag spangs/ / nges 'byung tshul khrims 'chal med pha rol son/ / thos pa'i bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par gsol/ / 'chad mkhas grags pas khyab la= /

You accepted all basic precepts and rejected what is to be rejected, with renunciation you perfected chaste morality, with unquenchable thirst you drank the elixir of study, the fame of your erudition spread; I supplicate you.
rgyun gcod mdzad tshe mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs/ / btung ba phal pa ro ldan bdud rtsir gyur/ / nag po chen pos zhal bstan bar chad bsal/ / rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyur la= /
When you practiced Severance regularly, the ḍākinī blessed you, ordinary drink turned to flavorful elixir, Great Black One showed himself and dispelled obstacles— natural yogin, I supplicate you.
gtsang ma shangs ston chen pos rjes su bzung / / chos dang bka' lung mtha' dag rdzogs par stsal/ / nyams rtogs nges shes dbyar gyi ljongs ltar 'khrungs/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin khyed la= /

Great Tsangma Shangtön accepted you as a disciple and granted all the teachings and oral transmissions. The certitude of experiential realization sprang up like summer’s scenery— Victor’s successor, I supplicate you.
gnyan khrod du mar spyod yul mthar phyin mdzad/ / dben pa rnams su yengs med sgrub la brtson/ / bla ma yi dam rnams kyis zhal bstan cing / / DA ki'i lung bstan thob la= /

In numerous haunted places you mastered your sphere of activity and applied yourself to undistracted practice in isolated places. You attained visionary experiences of the guru and yidams, and prophecy from the ḍākinī; I supplicate you.
'od gsal mdangs las 'khor 'das zhing kun gzigs/ / bla ma rin chen sna lnga'i dbang zhu dang / / dpe rnams stsal nas snyan brgyud bdag por bskos/ / 'gro don rjes su gnang la= /

You saw all realms of samsara and nirvana by the radiance of lucid clarity, received the empowerments of five precious gurus, were granted all the texts, appointed proprietor of the aural lineage, and entrusted with beings’ welfare; I supplicate you.
zhal mthong tsam gyis gzhan snang 'gyur ba dang / / dgongs pa gtad pas nad gdon mtha' dag zhi/ / chos 'dod tsam la ting 'dzin skyed par nus/ / snang sems dbang du mdzad la= /

Merely seeing your face transformed others’ perceptions; when you turned your attention their sickness and spirits vanished. Just desiring the dharma, disciples could experience absorption— you brought appearance and mind under control; I supplicate you.
lan re yi dam lha yi sku ru bzhengs/ / skabs su dpa' bo DA kis zhabs tog sgrub/ / 'byung po che dgus 'dud cing ci bcol nyan/ / grub pa'i spyi rje khyod la= /
rtsa gsum gnang ba ji bzhin gdams ngag rnams/ / yi ger bkod pas thub bstan ji srid bar/ / sgrub brgyud snying po rgyun mi chad mdzad pa/ / bka' drin bsam las 'das la= /

You wrote down the instructions of the Three Roots exactly as you received them, ensuring the essential continuity of the practice lineage for as long as the Sage’s doctrine exists— benevolence beyond thought, I supplicate you.
skal ldan bye ba snyed kyi don mdzad nas/ / sku lus bkod pa du mas chos bstan sogs/ / bde ldan zhing du cho 'phrul chen pos gshegs/ / ring bsrel dpag med sprul la (421) gsol ba 'debs/ /

After benefiting millions of fortunate beings, you departed for the blissful realm amid great miracles, such as teaching the dharma from multiple bodies and emanating countless relics; I supplicate you. {421}
rmu rgod bdag sogs snyigs mar chung ba rnams/ / mkhas btsun sangs rgyas chen pos byin rlobs la/ / rang sems chos sku mngon sum rtogs pa dang / / bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /

Learned and righteous great buddha, bless us, the fools who have entered the degenerate age, so that we realize our own mind as the real dharmakāya and achieve all our wishes in accord with the dharma.
de nas 'jag bsam gnyis kyi gdan slob brgyud pa ni mtha' yas pas 'bri bar rdo mi thogs kyang rang lugs brgyud par shin tu gal che ba ni/ /

From then on, the seats, disciples, and lineages of Jak and Sam were boundless; one is incapable of covering them. However, as it is my own lineage tradition and extremely important, [the following is an attempt].
khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la gsol ba 'debs pa pad+ma'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of the Lotus: Supplication to Khyungpo Tsultrim Gönpo[51]
spros bral mkha' la thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ / byin rlabs 'od kyis skye dgu'i mun pa sel/ / ye shes snang ba skyed mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ / tshul khrims mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

The mandala of compassion expanded in the space free of elaboration, the light of blessings dispelled the darkness of many living beings, your emanated form was produced as the appearance of awareness— Tsultrim Gönpo, I supplicate you.
skye 'gag gnas bral chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las/ / nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod sprin tu snang / / sna tshogs gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ / mkha' khyab gdul bya 'dul la= /

From the sky of dharmakāya’s realm without birth, cessation, or abiding, the clouds of saṃbhogakāya appear endowed with five certainties, and the variety of taming magical emanations trains beings throughout space; I supplicate you.
srid pa'i rtsa ba byang chub snying por bcad/ / zhing khams rgya mtshor rgyal ba'i phrin las kyis/ / yongs su khyab kyang khyad par dag pa'i zhing / / bde ba can du bzhugs la= /
The root of existence is severed in the heart of awakening and the victors’ activity fully pervades an ocean of realms, but the special pure land where you dwell is Sukhāvatī; I supplicate you.
gzhan snang rgyal sras snying stobs chen po yi/ / ngang tshul bzung nas rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin cing / / zhing khams yongs sbyong 'gro mang smin pa sogs/ / rnam thar bsam mi khyab la= /

You visibly assumed the mode of a brave bodhisattva [with activities] such as upholding the Victor’s dharma, transforming [the world into] a pure realm, and maturing many migrators— inconceivable life of liberation, I supplicate you.
rnyogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten la/ / snying rje'i stobs can lhag par brtse bas na/ / mi mjed 'dzam gling byang phyogs bsil ldan du/ / bsam bzhin srid par rol la= /

In the world afflicted by the five degenerations, with the highest love imbued by the strength of compassion, you willingly displayed existence in the cool north of this world Endurance; I supplicate you.
spang rtogs pha mthar son pas rang gi don/ / ched du bya ba rdul tsam ma dmigs kyang / / gdul bya thar pa'i lam du dkri ba'i phyir/ / bstan par rim 'jug mdzad la= /

You perfected renunciation and realization, and without a speck of concern for your own benefit, in order to guide disciples on the path of emancipation, you entered the stages of the doctrine; I supplicate you.
gsang gsum rdul bral gser gyi lhun po la/ / chos kyi bla gos thun mtshams dmar 'od 'khyud/ / lhag pa'i bslab pa nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ khams gsum mun pa sel la= /
thos pa'i chu gter mkhyen rab nor bus gtams/ / rmad byung bsam pa'i rlabs phreng kun tu (422) g.yo/ / sgom pa rin chen ri dbang lhun mtho bas/ / gling bzhi'i rgyan du gyur la= /

Your sea of study teemed with gems of knowledge, the wave sets of amazing contemplation rolled in, {422} the mountain of your meditation was higher than Meru adorned by four continents; I supplicate you.
gtsang ma shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs/ / bsnyen pa'i tshul mdzad snyan brgyud bdud rtsis bcud/ / thugs su bskyil nas sgom pa'i ro myang bas/ / rtogs grol dus mnyam gyur la= /

At the feet of Tsangma Shangtön Tsultrim Bum you practiced the approach phase; the nectar essence of the aural lineage pooled within your heart and you tasted meditation, causing realization and liberation to arise instantly; I supplicate you.
sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis lung bstan cing / / grub pa rnal 'byor yongs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje bo mdzad/ / gdul bzhi'i cho 'phrul ston la= /

The buddhas and bodhisattvas made predictions, completely blessing you as a yogin adept, making you lord of the ḍākinī assembly of the three sites— teacher by apparitions of four [ways to] train; I supplicate you.[52]
rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing khams gzigs/ / de snyed rnams su rnam 'phrul mtha' yas spro/ / rang rang skad du chos sgo bsam yas ston/ / sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad la= /

You saw upon one atom pure lands equaling all atoms in the universe and projected countless emanations to all of them, teaching unimaginable dharma approaches in all languages— performer of Buddha’s activity, I supplicate you.
rgyal 'phags rnams dang bka' yi bgro ba mdzad/ / mchog grub rnams dang nyams kyi gleng mo 'chad/ / mkha' 'gro rnams dang gsang ba'i brtul zhugs spyod/ / ngo mtshar bsam mi khyab la= /
You discussed the teachings with victors and exalted ones, conversed about experience with supreme adepts, and engaged in deliberate conduct with ḍākinīs— unimaginably awesome, I supplicate you.
mthong thos dran dang cha shas reg pa yang / / rnam grol gtan gyi bde bar dbugs dbyung stsal/ / mi min mi srun gdug pa'i sems zhi nas/ / byang sems myu gu bskrun la= /

Those who see, hear, recall, or touch any part of you are assured of the lasting bliss of total liberation. You pacify the noxious minds of spirits and savages, planting the sprout of awakening mind; I supplicate you.
'phags bod mkhas btsun grub pa ma lus pa'i/ / rnam thar snying po gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin/ / 'jig rten gsum na 'gran gyi zla med pas/ / khyung po gsum par grags la= /
Like the unified essence of all the lives of freedom of learned and righteous adepts of India and Tibet, you are unrivaled in the three worlds— known as the third Khyungpo, I supplicate you.[53]
skal ldan rnams la gsang ba'i mdzod khang stsal/ / bde ldan zhing du cho 'phrul chen pos gshegs/ / slar yang bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam rol gyis/ / gdul bya 'dul bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You granted fortunate ones the full treasury of secrets, then departed to the blissful realm amid great miracles. Again, with unimaginable manifestations, you trained your disciples; I supplicate you.
bdag sogs skye dgu'i lus ngag yid gsum la/ / gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs rab zhugs te/ / mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rnam thar sprin/ / chos dbyings kun khyab khyod dang mtshungs par shog/ ! /

May the blessings of your three secrets enter the body, speech, and mind of all living beings, and the continuous wheel of your life story fill like clouds the realm of reality so that we may live equal to you.
bya bral ri khrod ras chen la gsol ba 'debs pa gsang ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ (423)
Melody of Mysteries: Supplication to Jadral Ritrö Rechen[54] {423}
gangs dkar khrod du gdong lnga'i dbang po bzhin/ / bas mtha' dben pa'i gnas su ltos med bzhis/ / bsnyengs bral brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bya bral ba/ / ri khrod ras chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

In the snowy mountain fastness, like the mighty five-faced [lion][55] in the site of your isolated retreat, with fourfold disregard,[56] you fearlessly practiced deliberate conduct— Jadral Ritrö Rechen, I supplicate at your feet.
snying po'i rigs mchog yongs su sad pa las/ / 'dir snang bde 'byor rmi lam rgyal srid la/ / chu shing lta bur snying po med gzigs nas/ / dal 'byor don yod mdzad la= /

From your state of complete awakening you manifested here to your sublime essential family; once you saw the pleasures and wealth as a hollow plantain tree in a kingdom of dreams, you made your life meaningful; I supplicate you.
'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du yang / / sdug bsngal rang bzhin sha btson khang bu ltar/ / ltar snang bde ba'ang sdug bsngal rgyur gzigs nas/ / nges 'byung khong nas brdol la= /

Once you saw all places in cyclic existence, high or low, to be the very nature of suffering, like slaughterhouses, and even supposed happiness as the cause of suffering, renunciation welled up from within; I supplicate you.
lha mi'i dbang phyug mchog gi dpal 'byor yang / / mi rtag 'gyur ba glog gi gar mkhan bzhin/ / pha rol rjes 'brangs til tsam med gzigs nas/ / zhen log mtha' ru phyin la= /

Once you saw that even the wealth of powerful gods and humans was ultimately impermanent like a dancing lightning bolt, without even a sesame seed’s worth of lasting effect, you attained conclusive revulsion; I supplicate you.
rnyed bkur grags sogs chos brgyad bslu brid rnams/ / srin mo'i gling bzhin thar pa'i srog gcod du/ / mkhyen nas rmi lam du yang dor mdzad pas/ / 'khor bar phyi phyag 'tshal la= /

Once you knew that the deceptive allure of the eight worldly concerns— such as honor, gain, and fame—was like an island of cannibals where free life is murdered, you gave it up even in dreams and bid farewell to cyclic existence; I supplicate you.
ched du bcos dang gzhan gyis bskul min par/ / mchog la dad gus dman la snying rje'i shugs/ / 'phel 'grib mi mnga' dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar/ / rgyal sras sems dpa' chen por= /

Without purposeful pretense or insistence from others, the strength of faith in superiors and compassion for inferiors blazed like the fire at time’s end, neither increasing nor decreasing— Victor’s son, great bodhisattva, I supplicate you.
bshes gnyen bsten sogs chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i blo/ / pad+mo'i mtsho la ngang mo 'jug pa bzhin/ / skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs pas/ / dgongs spyod dri ma med la= /

With a mind for correct dharma practice, such as relying on a mentor, you were like a swan gliding into a lotus pond, completely perfecting the liberated life of a holy being with immaculate intent and conduct; I supplicate you.
khyad par khyung po gsum pa'i zhabs pad+mo/ / mi phyed gus pas gtsug gi rgyan du bkod/ / mnyes pa rnam dgus zab gsang bcud nos te/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin gyur la= /

In particular, with undivided faith you placed your crown ornament at the lotus feet of the third Khyungpo, pleasing him in many ways and receiving the quintessential profound secrets— successor of the Victor, I supplicate you.
mchog gi can+Da lI yi gzi brjid 'bar/ / 'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma'i lus su rtogs/ / 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por snyoms par 'jug / nying 'khrul lha skur shar la= /

The brilliance of sublime caṇḍālī blazed, you realized all phenomena of samsara and nirvana as illusory body, entered the equilibrium of lucid-clarity mahāmudrā, and perceived double delusion as the deity’s form; I supplicate you.
'gyur med bde dang stong pa'i ros myos (424) te/ / snang srid zil gnon brtul zhugs gar brgya yis/ / 'khrul pa'i snang ba dbyings su bcil mdzad pas/ / skal ldan spro ba skyed la= /

You savored unchanging bliss and emptiness, {424} overwhelmed apparent existence, and banished deluded appearance in basic space through a hundred modes of deliberate conduct, which inspired the fortunate ones; I supplicate you.
snyigs dus chos min rnam dpyod bdud ris kyi/ / sdong zlar bcas pas 'gro mang bslus gzigs nas/ / chos ltar bcos pa'i gzhan dbang ma shor bar/ / yang dag chos mthar phyin la= /

In degenerate times, you saw that many migrators were deceived by the counter-dharma behavior of devils and their ilk and made sure they didn’t fall under the influence of fake dharma by perfecting the genuine dharma; I supplicate you.
dwangs ma'i sku la ras dkar bla gos 'khyud/ / do ha'i glu dbyangs dpal gyi mgur nas len/ / dgongs pa'i drod gtad las can shes rgyud du/ / rdo rje'i ye shes 'bebs la= /

Your radiant body cloaked in white cotton robes, you sing the glorious songs from the doha melodies, and the warmth of your intent turned toward destined ones imbues their mind streams with vajra awareness; I supplicate you
rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs rje'i stobs skyed la/ / bdag blo chos min g.yang sa las sgrol te/ / srid la nges 'byung byang chub khang bzang du/ / chos kyi rgyal po'i dpal brnyes byin gyis rlobs/ ! /
Mighty yogin, on the strength of your compassion rescue my mind from the precipice of anti-dharma, bless me to renounce existence and be a dharma king in the glorious mansion of enlightenment.
mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po la gsol ba 'debs pa rnam dag sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Total Purity: Supplication to Khyenden Shangpa Karpo[57]
dri med mkhyen rab nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ / dmigs med brtse ba'i thugs rje gting mtha' bral/ / phrin las bsam mi khyab pa'i shangs dkar ba/ / rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Your flawless knowledge was as wide as the sky, your nonreferential compassion bottomless and limitless, and your awakened activity unimaginable— Shangkarwa Rinchen Gyaltsen, I supplicate at your feet.
rtag chad mtha' las rnam grol chos kyi dbyings/ / 'gyur ba med las thugs rje chen po'i rtsal/ / mos pa sna tshogs gzugs su rnam 'phrul bas/ / dus gsum gdul bya 'dul la= /

Liberated from extremes of permanence and nihilism, without leaving the realm of reality, with great compassion energy you emanated in various forms according to beings’ inclinations and trained disciples in the three times; I supplicate you.
sprin tshogs nam mkha'i klong du gcig pa bzhin/ / brgyud 'dzin gzugs sku'i rnam 'gyur du ma yang / / ye shes DA ki'i dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ / bsam bzhin srid pa bzung la= /

Just as the masses of clouds are one in the sky’s sphere, so too there are many physical expressions of lineage holders, but they are one value in the awareness ḍākinīs’ realm, so you willingly took existence; I supplicate you
mtho ris 'byor pa'i lang tshos mdzes pa'i sku/ / 'dam gyi khrod du skyes pa'i pad+ma bzhin/ / srid na srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas/ / lhar bcas ngo mtshar skyed la= /

In a young beautiful body, the fortune of higher realms, like a lotus born in the desolation of a swamp, you were born in the world but not sullied by its flaws— you inspire wonder, as with the gods; I supplicate you.
rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa'i chu gter du/ / sbyor byung thos pa'i chu klung bye ba sdud/ / yon tan kun gzhi lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi/ / grong khyer nyams dgar 'dzegs la= /

In the ocean of naturally occurring confident accomplishment, countless rivers of your acquired studies were gathered; in the joyous city of foundational qualities of higher ethics you ascended; I supplicate you.
ris med tshad ma'i skyes bu'i zhabs bsten nas/ / gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i (425) bcud gsol khyad par du/ / mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ri khrod ras chen las/ / don brgyud rtogs pa brnyes la= /

You attended unbiased masters of valid cognition and imbibed the essential nectar of their instructions. {425} In particular, through Ritrö Rechen, lord of the ḍākinīs, you realized the meaning lineage; I supplicate you.
rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa'i bcud zab mo/ / ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig ma bslad pa/ / 'bras lam chos drug grol lam phyag rgya che/ / brtson pas nyams su bzhes la= /

The profound extract of Vajradhara’s intention, the uncorrupted secret words of the Awareness Ḍākinī, the path of method’s Six Dharmas, the path of liberation’s mahāmudrā— you diligently practiced them; I supplicate you.
ro rkyang nyi zla'i bgrod pa kun 'dar mar/ / btsan thabs sbyor bas yongs su bcings nas su/ / ma dag las rlung zag pa'i grong khyer gyi/ / 'khrul 'khor bcom par mdzad la= /

You joined rasanā and lalanā, the sun and moon set in their course, in the central channel by using forceful means, fully binding them; you conquered impure karmic winds in the city of outflows through yogic exercises; I supplicate you.
zhu bde 'gyur ba med la brtan pa thob/ / snang grags rtog tshogs chu zla lta bur gzigs/ / dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang skal mnyam gyur/ / bde chen ye shes brnyes la= /

You attained stability in unchanging melting bliss, perceived form, sound, and thought like water moons, and became the peer of heroes and yoginīs— achiever of great bliss-awareness, I supplicate you.
sprin bral mkha' la nyin byed dbang po bzhin/ / rnam dag sems la ye shes nyi ma shar/ / ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i snang ba rgyas/ / chos nyid bden pa gzigs la= /

Like the sun lord in the cloudless sky, the sun of awareness rose in your pristine mind, knowledge of the nature and extent of things grew, and you saw the truth of phenomena’s nature; I supplicate you.
chu klung rgyun chad med par 'babs pa bzhin/ / brtan thob sems la mnyam rjes ris ma chad/ / bde gsal mi rtog 'phel grib med par myong / / nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin la= /

Like the continuous descent of a waterfall, equipoise and postmeditation were equal in your stable mind; you felt bliss, clarity, and nonthought without increase or decrease, and perfected experience and realization; I supplicate you.
ri rgyal lhun po g.yo 'gul med pa bzhin/ / 'khrul rtog rkyen gyis nam yang g.yo ba med/ / gzhan tu mi tshol sangs rgyas rang las rnyed/ / 'bras bu mngon gyur khyed la= /
Like the unshakable Meru, king of mountains, you were never moved by deluded thoughts or conditions; you didn’t seek elsewhere but found buddha within you— actualizing the result, I supplicate you.
rang don zung 'jug grub pa'i rgyal sar gshegs/ / gzhan don gang 'dul phrin las bsam yas kyis/ / skal dman tshar bcad skal ldan rjes su bzung / / bka' brgyud rgyal rabs spel la= /

You went to the royal seat of accomplishing integral unity for yourself, inconceivable awakened activity for others, defeated the unfortunate and nurtured the fortunate— propagator of the Kagyu succession, I supplicate you.
thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes dang mjal/ / lam mchog rdo rje theg pa'i gsang bar spyod/ / lam gyi mngon rtogs rtsol med rgyud la skyes/ / lam gsang mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ ! /

Bless us to meet a mentor who shows the path to freedom, engage the sublime path of secret Vajrayāna, effortlessly engender the actual realization of the path, and reach the culmination of the secret path.
mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs pa bdud rtsi'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Elixir: Supplication to Nyame Sangye Palzang[58]
sangs rgyas bstan pa yongs kyi dpal du shar/ / khyad par bka' brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog / (426) 'gran zla kun bral mnyam med lkugs lung pa/ / sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You arose as the full glory of the Buddha’s doctrine, in particular, the sublime master of the Kagyu doctrine, {426} totally without rivals; peerless Kuklungpa,[59] Sangye Palzang, I supplicate at your feet.
dag pa'i sar gnas dbang chen thob pa yi/ / gzugs sku'i zla gzhon gdul bya'i chu snod du/ / rnam par gsal nas bstan dang 'gro don gyi/ / sgyu 'phrul ci yang ston la= /

You dwelt on a pure level; during the great empowerment your full-moon body appeared clearly in the vessel of disciples; you magically displayed anything at all to benefit the doctrine and migrators; I supplicate you.
smon lam mthu can srid bde'i bslu brid kyis/ / mi g.yeng bzang po spyod pa chos nyid phyir/ / dpal 'byor mchil ma'i thal ba ring du btang / / gtan bde'i 'dun ma brtsams la= /

Your powerful aspiration did not waver with the temptation of worldly happiness—for dharma’s excellent conduct you spit out the droplets of glory and wealth and set out in pursuit of permanent happiness; I supplicate you.
chos min chos ltar bcos pas skye bo rnams/ / 'phral yun ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru sbyor gzigs nas/ / ston pa'i bstan pa yang dag snying po'i tshul/ / 'chug med btsal bar mdzad la= /

Once you saw that nondharmic people who pretended otherwise were creating the causes leading sooner or later to bad existences, you sought the infallible essence of the authentic doctrine of the Teacher; I supplicate you.
'jigs skyob legs smon tsam min khams gsum las/ / nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims yid bzhin nor/ / lhag bsam byang sems rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pas/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas gyur la= /

Your wish-fulfilling morality was renunciation of the three realms, not just refuge from fear or aspirations for higher realms; you set the noble mind of awakening on the tip of the victory banner— source of benefit and happiness, I supplicate you.
shes pa'i don rtogs shes bya'i chos kun mkhyen/ / skye med don gzigs 'gag med brtse ba shar/ / nang gi lam bgrod phyi ru nus pa'i mthus/ / sna tshogs gdul bya 'dul la= /

You realized the meaning of knowing and knew all knowable phenomena, saw the meaning of the unborn and unrestricted love dawned, traveled the inner path and with outer abilities trained a variety of disciples; I supplicate you.
mkhas grub kun las mdo sngags gdams pa'i bcud/ / ngoms med bzhes kyang sngon 'brel bla ma'i mchog / mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar pos rjes bzung zhing / / las 'phro sad par mdzad la= /

You eagerly tasted the essence of Sutra, Mantra, and instructions from learned adepts, but the supreme guru of previous connection was wise Shangpa Karpo, who accepted you as a disciple, awakening your karmic destiny; I supplicate you.
snyan brgyud nor bu'i mdzod chen rang nor bzhin/ / longs su spyad pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i dpyid/ / dbyar gyi sman ljongs lta bur rgyas pa yis/ / rin chen brgyud pa zin la= /

You enjoyed the great gem treasury of aural lineage as your own and the springtime of your experience and realization grew like the medicinal herb valley of summertime— holder of the precious lineage, I supplicate you.
ma dag rtsa yi mdud pa mtha' dag grol/ / gzung 'dzin rgyu ba dbu ma'i sbubs su thim/ / 'pho bcas thig le 'gyur med bde bar grub/ / grub ba'i spyi rjer gyur la= /

You released all the knots of the impure channels, dissolved the movement of dualism within the central channel, and achieved unchanging bliss of the moving vital drops— overlord of adepts, I supplicate you.
blos byas rtsol ba'i 'dzin stangs dbyings su yal/ / tha mal zhen pa'i 'khrul rtog rang sar dag / cir snang dag pa rab 'byams chen po'i ngang / / ye shes 'khor lor shar la= /
kun rdzob las snang sgyu ma'i dpe ltar gzigs/ / (427) don dam chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ / zung 'jug bde chen ye shes gar gyis rol/ / brtan g.yo byin gyis brlabs la= /

You saw relative appearances as instructive examples, {427} actualized the perspective of the absolute as dharmakāya, and danced in the timeless awareness of their united great bliss— blessing the animate and inanimate; I supplicate you.
gang 'brel blo sna dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ / skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la skyel/ / mi min gdug pa'i sems kyang zhi bar mdzad/ / snang ba dbang sgyur de la= /

You converted whoever you contacted to the Holy Dharma, conveyed fortunate ones to buddhahood in a single lifetime, and even pacified the minds of nonhuman evil spirits, bringing all appearance under control; I supplicate you.
gsang ba'i brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa yis/ / phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa mthar phyin cing / / rdo rje'i lam nas mi slob zung 'jug gi / go 'phang mngon tu mdzad la= /

Through your impartial practice of secret deliberate conduct, you reached the culmination of victory in all directions, and from the vajra path you actualized the state of integral unity beyond training; I supplicate you.
phyi ru chos brgyad 'khrul pa'i rdzun phug zhig / nang du zhu bde 'gyur med 'od 'bar zhing / / gsang ba blo bral chos sku rjen par mthong / / mnyam med sangs rgyas rnam thar myur 'grub shog ! /
khyung po tshul khrims mgon po nas 'di bar bla ma bzhi'i rnam thar zhib par ma mjal bas spyi bstod tsam du bgyis pa'o/ /
There is not much available information in the life stories of the four gurus beginning with Khyungpo Tsultrim Gönpo until here, so these supplications consist of just general praise.[60]
rtogs ldan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa zag med sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of the Unsullied: Supplication to Tokden Namkha Gyaltsen[61]

nam mkha'i dbyings su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / gangs can ljongs su bka' brgyud rin po che'i/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la mtshungs bral ba/ / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Like the mandala of the sun in the expanse of the sky, you held the victory banner of precious Kagyu doctrine in the Snowy Ranges, without comparison— Namkha Gyaltsen, I supplicate at your feet.
spros pa'i 'ching grol sred len mtshams sbyor ni/ / gdod nas spangs kyang slob pa'i lam rnams su/ / thugs bskyed smon lam mthu las gzhan snang du/ / rnam 'phrul ci yang ston la= /

You were free of the fetters of embellishment and had long since abandoned rebirth, but for those in training you appeared through the power of compassionate aspiration and displayed any emanations; I supplicate you.
mkhas grub skyes mchog du ma 'byung ba'i yul/ / sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+mas byin brlabs pa'i/ / gnas mchog khyad 'phags shangs phu'i dgon gsar du/ / bsam bzhin srid pa bzung la= /

In a country where many excellent learned adepts arose, there are sublime sites blessed by Padma, the second buddha; especially exalted was the new monastery of Shangpu,[62] where you intentionally took birth; I supplicate you.
rnam dag rje'u'i rigs dang zhang gi rus/ / gzigs pas dgongs te lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ / ngo mtshar dge mtshan du mas yab yum gyi/ / lus sems byin gyis brlabs la= /
You saw the purity of the Jeu family and Zhang clan and decided you should enter the womb amid amazing signs of virtue and with blessings of your parents’ bodies and minds; I supplicate you.
mdzes sku dpag bsam gsar pa'i myu gu la/ / skyes thob dge ba'i dri bsung ci yang 'phro/ / mtho ris 'byor (428) pa'i kho lag yongs rdzogs shing / / bslab gsum me tog 'dzum la= /

The wish-fulfilling sapling of your beautiful form took birth with a suffused fragrance of virtue, {428} and perfectly formed limbs, the fortune of higher realms, and smiling flower of three trainings; I supplicate you.
dran dang shes bzhin rtag tu bag yod pas/ / bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i/ / nyes pa'i dri mas rdul tsam ma gos pas/ / btsun pa'i dpe ru gyur la= /
Always conscientious of mindful awareness, you were untainted by the slightest stains of acquired or innate unvirtuous flaws—exemplary righteous one, I supplicate you.
nags kyi rin chen phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs/ / mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsnyen/ / mos gus sher brtson nyams bzhes nan chags kyis/ / kun gyi thugs sras gyur la= /

You served many adepts, such as Vanaratna[63] [and] Chokle Namgyal, placing the dust from under their feet on your head; with devotion, intelligence, and persistent effort you became their heart son; I supplicate you.
theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i/ / bka' dang bstan bcos tshig don thugs su chud/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom la mi 'jigs spobs pa brnyes/ / 'gran zla kun dang bral la= /

You internalized the words of Buddha and treatises, including the three vehicles and four tantra classes, and gained the fearless poise of explanation, debate, and composition, surpassing all competitors; I supplicate you.
grub brnyes sangs rgyas mtshan can thugs kyi bcud/ / rdzogs par bzhes nas dka' ba khyad bsad de/ / dben pa bsten pas bskyed dang rdzogs pa yi/ / ting 'dzin dbang thob gyur la= /

You wholly imbibed the heart essence of the adept named Sangye, and with no concern for hardship, remained in isolation practicing absorptions of creation and completion and mastering them; I supplicate you.
bde drod rang 'bar byang sems 'dzag med brtan/ / snang ba bden med 'od gsal khor yug shar/ / rmi lam rtsal 'byongs dag pa'i zhing kun bgrod/ / spyan dang mngon shes mnga' la= /

Bliss-warmth blazed on its own, undissipating bodhicitta stabilized, appearance [realized] as untrue, lucid clarity arose day and night, and you perfected Dream practice, visiting all the pure realms—master of the sights and super cognitions, I supplicate you.
mnyam bzhag 'od gsal chos sku mngon tu gyur/ / rjes thob rtsol med snying rje'i nus pa yis/ / mi dang mi ma yin kun rgyud dul zhing / / snang ba dbang du sgyur la= /

During equipoise you actualized lucid clarity of dharmakāya; in subsequent attainment, the power of your effortless compassion tamed the mind streams of all humans and nonhumans— master of appearances, I supplicate you.
dus 'khor phag mo spyan gzigs zhi drag sogs/ / lhag pa'i lha zhal gzhan la ston nus shing / / mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sprin ltar 'du/ / ci bcol phrin las sgrub la= /

In visionary encounters you saw and caused others to see special deities such as Kālacakra, Vārāhī, Avalokita, peaceful and wrathful deities; clouds of ḍākinīs and dharma protectors accomplished activities of whatever you requested; I supplicate you.
zhal chab khrus chu'i zegs mas nad gdon 'byin/ / dgongs pa gtod pa tsam gyis bar chad sel/ / bya ba las kyi 'khor los sangs rgyas kyi/ / bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad la= /
Drops of your saliva healed sickness and spirits, your mere focused attention dispelled obstacles, and the wheel of your works and deeds spread the Buddha’s doctrine; I supplicate you.
nyin gcig thos pas yid ches khong nas shar/ / rnal 'byor zla dus grub thob lo dus thebs/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i bshad sgrub kyi/ / snyan pas sa steng khyab la= /
mdo rgyud dgongs pa thogs med 'chad nus shing / / rim gnyis rtsal rdzogs (429) spyan dang mngon shes sogs/ / lung rtogs yon tan ldan pa'i bu slob ni/ / bgrang yas bskrun par mdzad la= /

With unhindered ability to explain the intent of Sutra and Tantra, {429} your two stages perfected, and the sights and super cognitions, you gathered countless disciples with qualities of scripture and realization; I supplicate you.
yar ngo'i tshes bcur dri bzang ngad 'thul zhing / / sgra 'od la sogs ngo mtshar ltas dang bcas/ / 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su snyoms zhugs te/ / sprul pa'i sprin chen spro la gsol ba 'debs/ /

On the fifteenth day of the waxing moon, with wonderful portents such as permeating sweet fragrance, sounds, and light, you entered the equipoise of lucid clarity’s realm of reality— diffusing great clouds of emanations, I supplicate you.
dpal ldan bla ma gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i/ / mngon dga'i zhing skyes theg chen bdud rtsi myang / / mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba ma lus kun/ / zhing de'i gdul byar yongs su smin byed shog/ ! /

May we be born in the realm of Abhirati, where the glorious guru attained full awakening, and taste the elixir of three vehicles. May every migrator who sees, hears, recalls, or touches you— all beings to be tamed—be completely matured in that realm.
mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs pa 'od gsal sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Lucid Clarity: Supplication to Muchen Gyaltsen Palzang[64]
nam mkha' bzhin tu phrin las rgya che zhing / / nyi zla lta bur grags pa rnam par gsal/ / rgya mtsho ji bzhin yon tan mtha' dang bral/ / rgyal ba mus pa chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /
Your awakened activity was as vast as the sky, your renown as bright as the sun and moon, your qualities as limitless as the ocean— Gyalwa Mupa Chenpo, I supplicate you.
spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro ba'i don tu 'phrul/ / gnyags rigs grub thob brgyud pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ / me tog char 'bebs sa gzhi rnam drug g.yos/ / 'jig rten mgon po khyed la= /
Avalokiteśvara emanated for the sake of migrators as the son of an adept lineage in the Nyak family; a rain of flowers fell and the ground shook in six ways— protector of the world, I supplicate you.
khro phu sems dpa' chen pos byin rlabs shing / / 'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'gyur bar lung du bstan/ / gzhon nu nyid nas 'phags pa'i rnam thar gyis/ / 'gro kun dga' ba skyed la= /

Blessed by the great bodhisattva of Tropu, who foretold your future as a glorious protector of beings; from the time you were small your life of an exalted one brought joy to all migrators; I supplicate you.
'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ / dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs/ / rig pa'i gnas dang sde snod rgyud man ngag / mi 'phrog spobs pa brnyes la= /

You put on your head the dust from under the feet of many holy ones, such as Jamyang Rinchen Gyaltsen, and learned the sciences, collections, tantras, and instructions, gaining indisputable eloquence; I supplicate you.
mtha' gong dpal gyi gnas su sgrub la gzhol/ / rim gnyis byang chub sems la brtan pa thob/ / che ba'i yon tan snyan pa'i grags pa yis/ / nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab la= /
You pursued the higher tenet systems at the place of glory and attained stability in the two stages and awakening mind; the renown of your great qualities spread around the globe; I supplicate you.
hor gyi rgyal pos pho brang tA'i tur du/ / spyan drangs 'gro phan bsam las 'das par mdzad/ / chu dbar sprul pa'i gnas su dka' thub kyis/ / spangs rtogs mtha' ru phyin la= /

The Mongol emperor [Ayawara] invited you to Tāitu Palace where you benefited beings in unimaginable ways; your ascetic practice at the emanated site of Chubar[65] culminated in renunciation and realization; I supplicate you.
mkhas grub shangs ston spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe/ / mgon po'i lung bzhin gdams (430) ngag zab chos rnams/ / dgyes bzhin rdzogs par gnang bas grub pa yi/ / go 'phang mthon por gshegs la= /

When you came into the presence of Khedrup Shangtön, he followed Protector’s prophecy and with pleasure {430} gave you the entire profound teaching instructions—gone to the heights of accomplishment; I supplicate you.
hor rgyal gan pa chen pos spyan drangs te/ / hor sog yu gur mi nyag la sogs pa'i/ / skad rigs mi gcig skye bo mtha' yas pa/ / thar pa'i gnas su bkod la= /

At the invitation of the Mongol emperor Genpa Chenpo, you liberated Mongols, Sogdians, Uighurs, and folks of Minyak— countless people of multiple ethnicities and languages— establishing them in freedom; I supplicate you.
lha dbang klu dbang mi dbang 'khor dang bcas/ / mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyis mgrin gcig brgyud/ / rkang gnyis gtso bo 'jig rten gsum po yi/ / gtsug gi nor bur gyur la=/

The leaders of gods, nāgas, and humans, with their retinues, and all the scholars and adepts unanimously declared you to be the chief of bipeds and the crown jewel of the three worlds; I supplicate you.
spyan ras gzigs sogs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ / mdun bdar snang mtha'i spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe/ / gangs can bde legs rdzogs ldan bzhin tu rgyas/ / thugs rje chen po khyed la= /
The buddhas and their heirs, Avalokita and others, spread near-perfect happiness in the Land of Snows when you arrived in the presence of Amitābha— Great Compassionate One, I supplicate you.
gnyags ston chos rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ / mos pa'i bu la brtse bas rab dgongs te/ / bdag dang bdag 'dra'i sdug bsngal lus can rnams/ / rnam grol sa la bde blag 'god du gsol/ ! /

Dharma lord, teacher of Nyak, Gyaltsen Palzangpo, remember your devoted children with love— place me and those like me, embodiments of suffering, felicitously on the level of total liberation; I supplicate.
mkhas grub rdo rje gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs pa gnyug ma'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of the Innate: Supplication to Khedrup Dorje Zhönu[66]
dal 'byor rten la bslab gsum rgyan gyis spras/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i nor mchog zad mi shes/ / skal ldan gdul byar tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster/ / rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Your free and endowed life was adorned by the three trainings; the gem of your study, reflections, and meditation was inexhaustible. You brought fortunate disciples to buddhahood in one life— Dorje Zhönu, I supplicate at your feet.
dbang po rab kyi rigs mchog yongs su sad/ / bshes gnyen mang bsten gzhung lugs du mar sbyangs/ / khyad par rgyal ba mus pa chen po yis/ / snyan brgyud bdag por bskos la= /

Your family of highest capabilities was fully awakened, you attended many spiritual mentors and trained in many traditions; in particular, the sovereign Mupa Chenpo appointed you head of the aural lineage; I supplicate you.
bshul ring lam du 'phur ba'i tshul ltar bgrod/ / grang bas mi brdzi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / bde drod rang 'bar mkha' la 'phar g.yo sgyur/ / thabs lam mthar thug 'byongs la= /

You traversed over long distances as if flying, undaunted by cold, like the mandala of the sun, bliss-warmth blazed naturally and you levitated— master of the ultimate path of methods, I supplicate you.
sgyu ma rmi lam ting 'dzin mthar phyin cing / / spyan dang mngon par shes pa'i rnam thar 'chang / / lha mi'i dbang pos bcud kyang ltos pa bral/ / chos brgyad 'ching ba grol la= /

You reached the culmination of illusion and dream, led your life with the sights and super cognitions, with the power of gods and humans, even devils were no concern, free of the bonds of eight worldly concerns; I supplicate you.
nang gi yon tan blo yi ra ba las/ / 'das kyang phyi tshul sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ / sgrub pa'i (431) rgyal mtshan g.yel ba med par btsugs/ / grub mchog chos kyi rje la= /

Your inner qualities were beyond the mind’s scope, but your deliberate conduct was outwardly hidden, {431} you firmly planted the victory banner of practice— sublime adept, dharma lord, I supplicate you.
bgrang bya du mar bgres tshul mi mnga' bar/ / shin tu zo bdog bde zhing gzi mdangs gsal/ / dangs ma bzhi yi mnyen lcugs mchog ldan pa/ / 'chi med grub pa'i rje la= /

As you counted many years, you showed no signs of aging, your physical appearance was blissful and bright with the supreme suppleness of the four quintessences— lord adept of immortality, I supplicate you.
ngo mtshar rmad byung skyes mchog rdo rje'i mtshan/ / byin rlabs thugs rje bdag sogs 'gro rgyud la/ / zhugs nas tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin cing / / grub pa mchog gi go 'phang la 'god shog ! /
Amazing, magnificent, sublime being named Vajra, may your compassion enter migrators such as myself so that we fulfill life and accomplishment and reach the state of a supreme adept.
mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs pa zung 'jug sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Integral Unity: Supplication to Muchen Namkhai Naljor[67]
skyes mchog dag pa'i zhing du mngon sangs rgyas/ / rgyal sras rnams la theg chen chos sgra sgrog / ma dag zhing du sprul pas gzhan don mdzad/ / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Great being who actualized buddhahood in the pure realm, taught the Mahayana dharma to the Buddha’s heirs, and benefited others by emanations in the impure realms— Namkha Gyaltsen,[68] I supplicate at your feet.
'phags yul paN chen nyi ma'i snying po'i zhabs/ / thugs rje che dang phyag na rdo rje yis/ / byin rlabs grub pa yab yum lhums su 'phos/ / dge ba'i ltas bcas 'khrungs la= /

In exalted India [you were] Paṇchen Sūryagarbha; you transferred to the womb of accomplished parents who were blessed by Great Compassion and Vajrapāṇi and were born amid virtuous signs; I supplicate you.
byis pa'i tshul bstan mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ / 'jig rten bya ba kun la zhen pa log / dad dang shes rab snying rje'i rtsal rgyas shing / / thar pa'i rigs mchog sad la= /

You appeared as a child but possessed unhindered clairvoyance, and you became disgusted with all worldly activities; as faith and the energy of wisdom and compassion grew, your sublime liberation family was awakened; I supplicate you.
rgyal sras thogs med zhabs sogs dge ba'i bshes/ / du ma bsten nas rjod byed sde snod gsum/ / mkhas par sbyangs shing brjod bya bslab gsum gyis/ / thugs rgyud yongs su gtams la= /

You attended many spiritual mentors, such as Gyalse Tokme, and trained in erudition through the expressing media of the Tripiṭaka while the content expressed in the three trainings completely filled your mind stream; I supplicate you.
khyad par mus chen rje dang gzhon nu bar/ / nyams khrid gsan nas rtse gcig bsgoms pa yis/ / bde drod rab 'bar sgyu ma rang shar sogs/ / thabs lam yon tan rdzogs la= /

In particular, you received from Lord Muchen and Dorje Zhönu the experiential guidance, and through your lifelong meditation bliss-warmth blazed on its own, illusion arose on its own, and so on— perfected qualities of the path of methods, I supplicate you.
nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par sgrub la brtson/ / zag med bsam gtan zas la longs su spyod/ / ting 'dzin sgo brgyar snyoms par 'jug cing ldang / / tshogs chen bla med spel la= /

You pursued practice night and day without wavering, enjoyed the food of undissipating meditative stability, settled into the evenness of a hundred absorptions and arose— increasing the highest great accumulation; I supplicate you.
bde gshegs yi dam mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung / / chags thog spangs pa'i mngon shes spyan dang ldan/ / (432) bar do'i 'gro ba mtha' dag rab gzigs nas/ / rnam kun thugs rjes 'dzin la= /

You were nurtured by sugatas, yidams, and ḍākinīs, and held the sights and super cognitions of giving up attachment; {432} you saw all the migrators in the intermediate state and cared for them with total compassion, I supplicate you.
nad pa rnams la sman pa'i rgyal po bzhin/ / 'jigs pas nyen rnams dran pa tsam gyis skyob/ / byang chub sems kyi phrin las mtha' yas pas/ / skye dgu'i mgon tu gyur la= /

You gave refuge to the sick who were gripped by fear just by your mere attention, like the physician king, and with your limitless bodhisattva activity you became protector of all beings; I supplicate you.
mthong thos dran reg phyir mi ldog la bkod/ / skye 'chi'i mtshan ma spangs kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ / sangs rgyas zhing khams mang por dus gcig tu/ / gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan la= /

Whoever saw, heard, recalled, or touched you will not regress. Though you had abandoned the signs of birth and death, to disciples you appeared to go simultaneously to many pure realms, displaying magical illusion; I supplicate you.
dad ldan don tu ring bsrel dpag med sprul/ / lha mi kun gyis srid mtha'i bar du mchod/ / ngo mtshar mtshan ma rgyun chad mi mnga' ba/ / byin rlabs bsam las 'das la= /

You emanated countless relics for the sake of the faithful so that all the gods and humans can forever make offerings; your amazing signs will be uninterrupted and your blessings unthinkable; I supplicate you.
rje btsun mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pas/ / gsol 'debs bu la thugs rje'i rtsal sprugs te/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang / / mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ! /

Incomparable Venerable Namkhai Naljor, may this child’s supplication activate your compassion: pacify adverse conditions to the accomplishment of Holy Dharma and bless us with attaining the wished-for conducive conditions.
grub chen thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa grub pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Accomplishment: Supplication to the Great Adept Tangtong Gyalpo[69]

thugs rje che dang dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal/ / dbyer med gcig bsdus mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang / / snyigs 'gro'i skyabs su sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ston/ / thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Great Compassionate One and mighty Hayagrīva inseparably united as Padmākara Vajradhara displaying the illusory emanation as refuge for beings— Tangtong Gyalpo, I supplicate at your feet.
dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen dol po pa/ / gdul dka' 'dul phyir grub pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ / ye shes DA ki yongs kyi ming gcig po/ / mtshan mchog lnga dang ldan la= /

Omniscient Dolpopa, [knower of] the buddhas of three times, returned in your adept’s body to train those difficult to train. Ḍākinīs of timeless awareness gave you a single overall name enhanced with five excellent names; I supplicate you.[70]
la stod byang du rdo rje'i mtshan dpe gsal/ / 'phags pas bskul te khyim spangs rab tu byung / / dbu skra bsil tshe 'ja' 'od me tog khengs/ / brtson 'grus bzang po'i zhabs la= /

In Latö Jang your vajra marks and signs appeared; urged by the Exalted One you rejected home and took ordination, and rainbows and flowers fell when your hair was shorn— Honorable Tsöndru Zangpo, I supplicate you.[71]
gzhung lugs sbyong tshe ting 'dzin ngang du 'byams/ / ma bslab par yang chos kun thugs su chud/ / thog ma nyid nas rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan/ / rang byung grub pa chen por gsol= /

While training in the classic traditions, you fell into a state of absorption, yet you mastered all the teachings without studying; right from the start you displayed countless miracles— self-arisen great adept, I supplicate you.
sangs rgyas byang sems rnal 'byor pho mo dang / / dge sbyong rigs ngan ku su lu pa'i tshul/ / yang dag bla ma lnga brgya phrag gcig las/ / chos sgo tshad med gsan la= /
Infinite dharma doors were disclosed to you by buddhas, bodhisattvas, yogis, and yoginīs in virtuous, low caste, and mendicant styles of five hundred genuine gurus; I supplicate you.

thar pa gling du thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe/ / rdo rje 'chang chen rigs lnga (433) sems dpa' brgyad/ / khro bcu lha mo'i tshogs bcas dngos su mjal/ / lam zab la sogs zab chos du ma gsan/ / sgrib gnyis mun pa bral la= /
thugs rje phyogs med shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ / rang snang dbang sgyur las bzhir mnga' dbang brnyes/ / rtogs pas rgyud grol brtul zhugs mtha' ru phyin/ / chos brgyad zil gyis mnan la= /

Your compassion was impartial, you knew all there is to know, controlled your own experience, mastered the four actions, liberated your mind stream with realization, perfected deliberate conduct, and outshone the eight worldly concerns; I supplicate you.
gnas chen rnams su smon lam du ma mdzad/ / sngon byon grub thob yi dam lha tshogs mjal/ / dur khrod rnams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / / tshogs kyi 'du bar rol la= /

In all the great sacred sites you made many aspirations and met past adepts and hosts of yidam deities; in all the charnel grounds you partook of communal feast with the heroes and ḍākinīs; I supplicate you.

kha ba can pa'i mi dang mi ma yin/ / gcan gzan nad pa 'on long nyam thag sogs/ / khyod sku mthong thos dran pas gnas skabs su/ / 'jigs pa kun zhi mthar thug mngon mtho dang / / nges legs thob cing theg chen dam chos dar/ /

“When humans and nonhumans in the snow lands, and animals, the sick, deaf, blind, poor, and so on see, hear, or recall your form, in the short term their fears will subside and ultimately they will reach higher realms or definite goodness and the Holy Dharma of the Mahayana will spread.

khyad par mtha' 'khob kla klo thul cig ces/ / spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun sgrol ma yis/ / yang yang gsung gis bskul la= / bcom ldan 'das kyis chos sgo mtha' yas stsal/ / yan lag 'byung las shes rab phar phyin gsan/ / he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma dpal gyis/ / dbang bskur rgyud rnams gtad la= /

Especially, subdue the barbarians on the borderlands.” Again and again you were entreated in this way by Avalokita and Exalted Tārā; I supplicate you. The Bhagavat disclosed infinite dharma doors, Aṅgaja taught you the perfection of wisdom,[72] Heruka and Yoginī conferred empowerments and entrusted the tantras; I supplicate you.
dur khrod chen po keng rus me 'bar du/ / dpal chen bi rU pa yis rjes su bzung / / lam 'bras yongs rdzogs dam rdzas bdud rtsi gnang / / zag pa rgyun chad gyur la= /
In the Charnel Ground of Blazing Skeletons, great glorious Virūpa accepted you and bestowed the complete Path with Its Result and pledge substances, which stopped your excretions; I supplicate you.
ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu lan gsum du/ / byon nas dbang dang gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang / / rdzu 'phrul mngon shes bsam mi khyab par 'khrungs/ / gdams ngag yi ger bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Three times Awareness Ḍākinī Niguma came and gave you complete empowerments and instructions, engendering unimaginable miracles and super cognitions— scribe of the instructions, I supplicate you.
zangs gling yul du grub chen sha ba ris/ / ngo sprad byin brlabs rdo la me 'bar du/ / bram ze mchog sred zhabs kyis nag po che/ / srung mar dngos su gtad la= /

On the island of Tāmradvīpa,[73] the great adept Śavarῑ blessed you with the introduction to mind’s nature; at Blazing Rock the supreme adept [Vararuci] visibly entrusted Mahākāla as your protector; I supplicate you.[74]
srin yul zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtser/ / bla ma sku gsum khyad par o rgyan rjes/ / sgrub chen brgyad sogs dbang chos mtha' yas pa/ / gnang nas lung bstan mdzad la= /

On the peak of Copper-Colored Mountain in the Land of Demonesses, the guru’s three kāyas as the Lord of Uḍḍiyāna [Padmasambhava] gave countless empowerments and teachings of the Eight Great Sādhanas and others, and made prophecies; I supplicate you.
rdo rje sems dpas a ti yo ga stsal/ / mkha' 'gros bskul te bod kyi gdul byar gzigs/ / (434) kla klo'i yul byon rdzu 'phrul tshad med pas/ / btul nas chos su bkod la= /

Vajrasattva granted you Atiyoga teachings, at the ḍākinīs’ behest you saw to the people of Tibet, {434} and in the barbarian lands, with immeasurable miracles you tamed and converted them; I supplicate you.
rgya bal kha che li dang o rgyan yul/ / rgya hor zla ba nas gling ka ling+ga/ / pri yang+ku sogs dzam gling gling phran bcas/ / mtha' dag rdzu 'phrul chen po'i zhabs kyis gcags/ /

With your great miraculous abilities you traveled to every major and minor place in the world— India, Nepal, Kashmir, Khotan, Oḍḍiyāna, China, Mongolia, Dawa, Neling, Kalinga, Priyangku, and others.[75]
skal bar ldan rnams dngos su grol bar mdzad/ / gzhan dag ma 'ongs pa na rang nyid kyi/ / gdul byar smin phyir thabs mkhas sna tshogs pas/ / sa steng chos kyis bkang la= /

You manifestly liberated the fortunate individuals and used various skillful means to ensure that the others would mature as your disciples in the future— you covered the earth with dharma; I supplicate you.
snod ldan rgan gzhon med pa mkha' spyod bkod/ / gcan gzan rnams kyang gus pas zhabs tog sgrub/ / lha srin sde brgyad btul nas dam la bzhag / 'byung zhir rang dbang sgyur la= /

You placed worthy recipients in celestial realms, regardless of age, achieved the respectful service of even wild animals, tamed and bound under oath the eight tribes of gods and spirits, and controlled the four elements; I supplicate you.
chu klung du ma lcags kyi zam pas sbrel/ / mthong grol bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten dang / / rin chen gar lugs sku brnyan du ma sogs/ / rten gsum dpag yas bzhengs la= /

You built numerous iron bridges to span the rivers, the liberation-upon-seeing Auspicious Stupa of Many Doors,[76] multiple images in the jeweled or Gar style, and other countless threefold supports; I supplicate you.
mtha' dmag kha gnon sa yi me btsa' gdab/ / 'byung bzhi'i gnyen por rten mchog kun tu bkod/ / smon lam mdzad pas nad dang mu ge yi/ / 'jigs las yun ring bskyabs la= /

You set up geomantic focal points to suppress Mongol armies, arranged excellent supports as antidotes to elemental disturbances, and through your aspirations you provided long-lasting refuge from the fears of sickness and famine; I supplicate you.
sman gyi bla mas bdud rtsi 'chi sos dang / / tshe dpag med kyi tshe yi ril bu gnang / / 'gro ba mtha' dag nad gdon dus min gyi/ / 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog la= /
Medicine Buddha gave you death-defying elixir, Amitāyus gave you longevity pills, you lifted the fear of sickness, spirits, and untimely death from all migrators; I supplicate you.
'tha' 'khob ka ma ta ru sku lus kyi/ / bkod pa bstan tshe sdig spyod rgyal blon gyis/ / mes bsregs chu yis ma tshugs de dag kun/ / dad cing chos su bkod la= /

When you showed your body in the border country Kāmata, the king and ministers who were engaged in sinful acts tried to burn and drown you, but they were converted to being faithful Buddhists; I supplicate you.
