mchog gi bu drug nye ba'i sras mchog brgyad/ / ye shes DA ki lnga dang sbas tshul gyi/ / mkha' 'gro bcu drug dam tshig DA ki nI/ / bco brgyad rig 'dzin pho mo sum cu bdun/ / las can nga brgyad mi ldog lnga brgya phrag / gzhan don nus pa bye ba khri brgyad sogs/ / smin grol mdzad nas gdams ngag skabs brgyad bsdus/ / rgyal tshab mnga' gsol mdzad la= /

You had six supreme children, eight supreme close sons, five awareness ḍākinīs, sixteen hidden ḍākinīs, eighteen pledge ḍākinīs, thirty-seven male and female awareness holders, fifty-eight people with karma, five hundred nonreturners, one million eight thousand capable of benefiting others, and more, whom you matured and liberated, then gathered instructions in eight parts— investiture of regents; I supplicate you.
sku dngos bgrang bya brgya dang nyer brgyad mthar/ / cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzhir 'od phung du/ / nam mkhar gshegs tshe thugs sras gdung dbyangs kyis/ / mdun mkhar gzugs skur bstan la= /

Your actual body lived for one hundred and twenty-eight years; on the fourth day of the miracle month, when your luminous orb rose into space, in response to the yearning melody of your heart son, you displayed a form body in the sky in front of him; I supplicate you.
slar yang gsol ba btab tshe khru gang sku/ / sgrub pa'i (435) gnas byon 'od gsal zhag bdun bzhugs/ / ngo mtshar gdung rten lha mi'i mchod yul du/ / g.yo med brtan par bzhugs la= /

When supplicated again, your cubit-high body appeared {435} at your practice place and stayed for a week in clear light. Your amazing physical relics remain firm without changing as an offering object for gods and humans; I supplicate you.
slad nas gdul bya skal ldan rnams kyi ngor/ / nye ring gang du'ang byon nas byin gyis brlabs/ / bod yul bde ba'i phrin las rgyun chad med/ / bka' drin bsam las 'das la= /
Hereafter, you will appear to your fortunate disciples, regardless of distance, to bestow uninterrupted blessings with your activity for Tibet’s well-being— kindness beyond belief, I supplicate you.
spyan ras gzigs dbang grub chen chos kyi rje/ / khyed kyi thugs rje skyo dub ma mchis pas/ / bdag sogs skal med dus mthar skyes pa la/ / zhal ston byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /
Avalokiteśvara, great adept, dharma lord, your compassion never tires or lapses— please show your face and bless us, the unlucky beings living in the end-times.
grub mchog khyed kyi sku tshe gdul bya'i zhing / / rnam thar smon lam mdzad stobs ci 'dra ba/ / de 'dra kho nar bdag gis myur 'grub ste/ / nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro kun sgrol byed shog/ ! /
Sublime adept, may I quickly attain a life span, realm of disciples, life example, and powers of aspiration just like yours and liberate all migrators throughout space.
rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa lhan skyes sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Coemergence: Supplication to Gyagom Lekpa Gyaltsen[77]
ye shes mkha' la gnyug ma'i gar stabs sgyur/ / mi shigs 'od gsal bde ba'i gzi mdangs 'bar/ / grub pa mchog gi phyag byas rgya sgom pa/ / legs pa rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You manifested the dance of the original state in the space of awareness, the brilliance of indestructible lucid-clarity bliss blazed, and you were worshipped as supreme among adepts— Gyagompa Lekpa Gyaltsen, I supplicate at your feet.
'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi btson ra bzhin tu bor/ / nges legs bstan la rnam dag tshangs par spyod/ / sngon sbyangs las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad/ / skyes bu chen po'i zhabs la= /

You totally rejected the prison of samsara’s bustle and engaged in the pure conduct of the doctrine of definite goodness, your previous training in virtuous dharma awakened— great being, I supplicate at your feet.
mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ / mang du bstan nas mdo sngags chos spyi dang / / bye brag dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi/ / ring lugs rdzogs par gsan la= /

With many learned and accomplished spiritual mentors you studied the general teachings of Sutra and Tantra; in particular you received the entire long tradition of the glorious Shangpa Kagyu; I supplicate you.
grub dbang nam mkha'i mtshan gyis rjes su bzung / / sgrub la brtson pa nyin mtshan g.yel med mdzad/ / nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la= /

Drupwang Namkha Gyaltsen accepted you as a disciple, and you practiced diligently day and night without wavering; the qualities of experience and realization grew like the waxing moon— mighty yogin, I supplicate you.
byang chub sems mchog gnyis la khyod kyi thugs/ / rtag tu gzhol bas nyi tshe'i phrin las la/ / ma bkol bar yang tshar gcod rjes 'dzin sogs/ / ye shes mgon pos sgrub la= /

The two supreme minds of awakening flowed constantly through your heart, but you would not exploit some short-lived awakened activity, so the [activities of] subjugation, protection, and so forth were accomplished by Awareness Protector; I supplicate you.
bkod pa lus kyi sprul bsgyur la sogs pa/ / rnam thar bsam mi khyab la mnga' mdzad kyang / / rtag tu tha mal brtul zhugs lhur mdzad pa/ / sbas pa'i sangs rgyas khyed la= / (436)

Though your life story revealed unimaginable skills, such as your physical transformations and so on, you always acted responsibly with common deliberate behavior— hidden buddha, I supplicate you. {436}
'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo rgyal tshab tu/ / mnga' chen gsol bas bka' brgyud grub pa'i klung / / thub bstan ji srid mi nyams 'babs pa yi/ / phrin las rmad du byung la= /

You invested the hero adept of Mañjunātha[78] as regent overlord, [ensuring that] the river of Kagyu adepts will flow for as long as the Sage’s doctrine remains—amazing awakened activity, I supplicate you.
gzhan don dgongs tshe gdung gi cha shas las/ / sprul pa'i ring bsrel zad med 'phel bas kyang / / skal ldan du ma thar pa'i gnas su bkod/ / mdzad pa mthar phyin khyed la= /

For others’ sake, you left a portion of your remains and through the endless proliferation of emanated relics you placed many fortunate ones in a place of freedom— your deeds fulfilled, I supplicate you.
gsol btab dge bas bdag sogs 'gro rgyud kyi/ / sgrib gnyis dri ma gtan nas byang ba dang / / lhan skyes 'od gsal gnyug ma chos sku'i zhal/ / gcer mthong sku gsum rang shar nyid gyur cig/ ! /

By the virtue of my supplication, may the stains of two obscurations in the mind streams of myself and migrators be permanently purified and may the three kāyas arise naturally by directly seeing the face of innate dharmakāya, coemergent lucid clarity.
rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa smin grol sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of Maturing and Liberating: Supplication to Venerable Kunga Drolchok[79]
rgyal bas lung bstan spyod 'chang grub pa'i dbang / / gangs can snying po'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i skur bstan pa/ / kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Foretold by the Victor, upholder of the conduct, mighty adept, in order to spread the essential doctrine in the Himalaya, you manifested as the hero adept Mañjunātha; Kunga Drolchok, I supplicate at your feet.
sprul pa'i zla zhal glo bo smon thang du/ / 'char tshe skabs gsum grong nas 'ong 'dra ba'i/ / pad+ma'i sdong po kha dog dri bsungs can/ / dpyid kyi dpal bzhin bzhad la= /
When the full moon of your rebirth arose in Lowo Mentang[80] it was as if the lotus plant from the heavens that keeps the color and fragrance had bloomed, like spring’s glory; I supplicate you.
mtshan dpe'i me tog 'byung 'khrugs reg pa yis/ / gtses pa'i tshe na thub bstan nyi gzhon dang / / 'grogs pa'i mod la gegs kyi g.yul las rgyal/ / chos don ngang gis 'byor la= /

When the flower of your marks and signs was threatened by elemental turmoil, as soon as you befriended the morning sun of the Sage’s doctrine, you were victorious over the onslaught of obstructions, finding dharma’s meaning within; I supplicate you.
yul dbus rig grol gnyis ldan pad+mo'i mtshor/ / ldog med ngang pa bzhin tu dga' bas zhugs/ / na tshod phra yang snying stobs spyod pa sbom/ / sems kyi mdud grol mchog la= /

In the central region, with knowledge and liberation, without hesitation you entered the lotus lake, joyful as a swan, and meditated in courageous conduct at a tender age, releasing mind’s knots; I supplicate you.
sngon sbyangs stobs sad sde snod rtsol med mkhyen/ / dbyangs can mgrin par zhugs pa'i brjod pa sogs/ / mkhas tshul gsum gyi rnam dpyod dar babs pas/ / blo gsal yid dbang 'phrog la= /

The strength of former training awakened, you effortlessly knew the piṭakas, Sarasvatī entered your throat, evoking the powers of discernment in the three ways of erudition, such as eloquence— your clear intellect was captivating; I supplicate you.
gtsug rgyan nor bus lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad/ / rin chen rnam bzhis gdams pa'i gnad rnams gnang / / paN chen gnyis kyis the tshom drwa ba bsal/ / bzhed dgongs lhun gyis grub la= /

Your crown jewel [guru] made prophecies and encouragement, four jewels gave you the vital points of instruction, two great paṇḍitas[81] cleared up the net of doubts— spontaneous accomplisher of intentions, I supplicate you. {437}
bya btang gnyis kyis (437) rtogs pa'i bogs 'don mdzad/ / dag gi dbang pos tha snyad spro ba bskyed/ / khyad par rdo rje 'chang dngos rgya sgom rjes/ / thugs kyi bang mdzod gtad la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Two renunciants enhanced your realization: Ngakgi Wangpo aroused your interest in terminology; and in particular, Lord Gyagom, the real Vajradhara, entrusted mind’s treasury; I supplicate you.
phyi tshul dri med so thar bslab pas bsdams/ / nang du byang chub sems la rang dbang 'byor/ / gsang ba sngags kyi brtul zhugs 'chang rnams kyi/ / 'khor los sgyur ba mchog la= /
gsang bdag gshin rje gshed pos bar chad bsal/ / dgyes mdzad yab yum 'khor lo sdom pa dang / / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs lhag pa'i lhas/ / byin brlabs rjes su bzung la= /
Lord of secrets Yamāntaka dispelled obstacles, Hevajra father-mother, Cakrasaṃvara, Vajrayoginī, and other special deities blessed and nurtured you; I supplicate you.
mkha' spyod dbang phyug rje btsun ni gu mas/ / chos drug ye shes mgon po la sogs pa/ / stsal bas 'od gsal mtha' dbus med par rtogs/ / ngo mtshar nye brgyud thob la= /

Mistress of the celestial realm, Venerable Niguma, granted the Six Dharmas, Awareness Protector, and others, and you realized lucid clarity without center or boundary— recipient of the amazing direct lineage, I supplicate you.
so sa gling du mkha' 'gro chen mo dang / / tshogs kyi 'du bar spyod cing byang chub tu/ / lung bstan mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i rtogs pa spel/ / mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyong la= /

In Sosadvīpa you joined the great Ḍākinī and her gathering for communal feast and she made a prophecy; your realization increased in blending equipoise and postmeditation— protected by Ḍākinī like a son, I supplicate you.
mi tra rdzo gis snying po don gsum gnad/ / legs ldan 'byed kyis brda yi chos dbang bskur/ / stobs 'phrog dbang po rnam thos sras la sogs/ / chos skyong bran du khol la= /

Mitrayogin gave you the Threefold Meaning of the Essence,[82] Bhāviveka conferred the dharma empowerment of symbols, dharma protectors such as Mighty Strength Thief and Vaiśravaṇa[83] acted as your servants; I supplicate you.
gang snang sgyu ma'i rnam rol du shar nas/ / 'dzin med rang shar ma bcos zhen bral blos/ / ma chags bu chud spyod pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ / byas tshad chos su 'gro la= /

You perceived whatever arose as the play of illusion; with a natural attitude free of fixation and contrivance you behaved without attachment like a small child, but all your acts became dharma; I supplicate you.
mthong thos dran reg ngan 'gro'i gnas spong ba'i/ / 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu zhes/ / bslu med rdo rje'i gsung gis zhal 'ches pa/ / skye dgu'i mgon por gyur la= /

“I am a person with whom any connection is meaningful; seeing, hearing, recalling, or touching me prevents bad existences.” So you promised with undeceiving words— protector of many beings, I supplicate you.
gangs can gdams pa'i chu klung mtha' dag bsdus/ / ni gu'i khrid srol brgya phrag lhag pas mtshon/ / gzhan phan nam mkha'i mthar khyab spel mdzad nas/ / mkha' spyod grong du gshegs la= /

You collected all the streams of instruction in the snowy lands, exemplified by [giving] Niguma’s guidance more than one hundred times; after spreading your altruism throughout the reaches of space, you departed for the celestial realm; I supplicate you.
slar yang 'phags bod o rgyan 'gro lding sogs/ / ma nges gnas su gang la gang 'dul gyi/ / sprul pa du mas gdul bya'i zhing sbyangs nas/ / bla med byang chub brnyes pa= /

Again, all over India, Tibet, Oḍḍiyāna, Drāmiḍa, and indefinite places where there were beings to be trained, your many emanations purified the realm of disciples and they gained unsurpassable awakening; I supplicate you.
skye kun grub pa'i dpa' bos rjes bzung ste/ / (438) gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis/ / rab 'byams rnam thar rgya mtsho'i sprin bkod pa/ / rje btsun khyed dang mtshungs par mdzad du gsol/ ! /

Accomplished hero, nurture me in all my lives {438} so that the inexhaustible ornamental wheel of my three secrets manifests clouds of oceans of infinite liberated lifetimes equal to yours, illustrious one.
chos sku lha dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs pa zab mo'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of the Profound: Supplication to Chöku Lhawang Drakpa[84]
dpal ldan khyab bdag 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ / gzhom med sgra dbyangs brjod bral rdo rje'i gsung / / bde chen zung 'jug mnyam nyid rdo rje'i thugs/ / lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Glorious pervading lord, changeless vajra body, indestructible melody of inexpressible vajra speech, great bliss of integral unity, the equality of vajra mind— Lhawang Drakpa, I supplicate at your feet.[85]
sh+lo ka 'di rje btsun rin po che'i gsung ngo / /
rdo rje'i lus la skyon bral lang tshos brgyan/ / zab lam yon tan kun skyed dpal gyis 'byor/ / brtul zhugs spyod la bsnyengs pa med pa'i blo/ / skyes thob rtsal chen rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Your vajra body was adorned by flawless youth, all the qualities of the profound path arose in glory, with a fearless attitude of deliberate conduct your great energy was perfected at birth; I supplicate you.
rdo rje'i rigs mchog thog ma nyid nas sad/ / gnyis 'dzin blang dor bral yang ltar snang gi / / 'khor ba sgyu ma lta bur nges 'byung gis/ / blo sna chos su bskul la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Your sublime vajra family was awakened from the start; though free of dualistic acceptance and rejection you simulated renunciation of illusory cyclic existence to draw various types to the dharma; I supplicate you.
rdo rje'i slob dpon sems kyi mdud grol mchog / gtsug tu bsnyen nas mnyes pa rnam gsum bsgrubs/ / gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs yongs rdzogs thob/ / dam pa'i thugs zin gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You held close upon your head and pleased in the three ways the vajra master, sublime one free of mind’s knots, and attained the totally perfect blessings of his three secrets— cherished by that holy one; I supplicate you.
rdo rje theg pa'i yang bcud rim gnyis la/ / 'bad rtsol chen pos sgrub pa mtha' ru bskyal/ / sgom byung stobs las mkhyen rab chags thogs med/ / spyan dang mngon shes mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /

With great effort in the two phases, the quintessence of Vajrayāna carried you to the culmination of accomplishment. The force of your meditation brought highest wisdom, desireless and unhindered— master of the sights and super cognitions, I supplicate you.
mos gus stobs kyis cir snang bla mar gzigs/ / gtum mo mthar phyin bde drod me ltar 'bar/ / sgyu lus dbang thob sna tshogs sprul bsgyur nus/ / dag snang rab tu 'byams la gsol ba 'debs/ /

The force of your devotion made you see everything as the guru, you perfected inner heat and bliss-emptiness blazed like fire, you controlled illusion and could variously emanate and change, your pure perception thoroughly pervaded; I supplicate you.
gzung 'dzin rlung sems a ba d+hU tir thim/ / 'khor 'das ma lus chos sku rjen par shar/ / re dogs snyems 'phrig spang blang rdul tsam med/ / bya btang rgyal po khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Dualistic wind-mind dissolved in the avadhūtī, phenomena of samsara and nirvana nakedly arose as dharmakāya, not a speck of hopes and fears, certainties and doubts, dos and don’ts— king of renunciants, I supplicate you.
rdo rje'i ye shes che la dbang 'byor pas/ / skal ldan rnams la byin rlabs dngos su 'bebs/ / rtogs pa'i stobs kyis gzhan snang zil gyis (439) gnon/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /

With the power of great vajra timeless awareness you showered real blessings on all fortunate ones, and with realization you subdued by splendor others’ perceptions— mighty yogin, I supplicate you. {439}
nyin snang sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur gzigs/ / mtshan snang rnam dag 'od gsal chen por 'byams/ / kun kyang zung 'jug bde chen thig ler shar/ / nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You saw daytime appearances as illusion and dream, nighttime appearances spread in pure great lucid clarity, everything dawned as the sphere of unified great bliss— finalized experience and realization, I supplicate you.
ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ / pho nya gsum 'dus tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod/ / zol med grub pa chen po'i rgyal thabs bskyang / / rje btsun brag stod pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /

With the blessings of the ḍākinīs of timeless awareness you enjoyed the feast circle with the three emissaries,[86] and sustained the royal guise of a great adept without pretense— Venerable Draktö, I supplicate you.
rnam grol bdud rtsi bgo bshar stsal ba yis/ / grub pa'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i nye dbang tshogs/ / sgrol ba'i mgon gyur rje btsun lha yi dbang / / mnga' gsol don chen mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /
Your distribution of the elixir of total liberation [made disciples] vassals protecting the domain of adepts; lord of liberators, Venerable Lhawang, you made meaningful investiture, I supplicate you.
ngo mtshar bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba bzung / / byin rlabs chu rgyun mi zad gter gyur pas/ / shangs pa'i bstan la bya ba rlabs chen mdzad/ / 'gran bral skyes mchog khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /
You held the golden rosary of the amazing Kagyu, and by giving an inexhaustible river of blessings your great waves of deeds benefited the Shangpa doctrine— unrivaled sublime being, I supplicate you.
'khrul med dam pa bsten cing byin rlabs zhugs/ / gsang ba'i lam mchog mthar phyin dngos grub thob/ / zab mo'i ring lugs rgyun mi chad spel ba/ / khyod kyi rnam thar 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /

May I rely on the unmistaken holy one and receive your blessings, arrive at the culmination of the secret path, and attain spiritual powers. Grant your blessings that the profound long tradition increase without a break and that I may accomplish a life of liberation such as yours.
'dir jo nang rje btsun rin po che'i gsol 'debs zhal gsungs kha 'gengs bcas sbyar ro/ ! /
(Here one should add the supplication spoken by Jonang Jetsun Rinpoche.)[87]
rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma karma gzhan phan 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs pa dge legs sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Virtue and Goodness: Supplication to Venerable Glorious Lama Karma Zhenpen Özer[88]
gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar 'chang / / tha mal snang ngor sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can/ / 'brel tshad don ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog / gzhan phan 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Holder of a life story of inconceivable secrets, to ordinary viewers you practiced hidden deliberate conduct; mighty adept with whom any connection is meaningful— Zhenpen Özer, I supplicate at your feet.
zhen log nges 'byung bcos min nang nas brdol/ / shAkya'i bstan la rnam dag tshangs par spyod/ / rje btsun smra ba'i seng ges byin brlabs pas/ / 'bri klog rang brdol mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Sincere renunciation arose freely from within, you kept the pure brahmin conduct of Śākyamuni’s doctrine, you spontaneously learned reading and writing by the blessings of Exalted Lion of Speech; I supplicate you.
ma bsgrubs par yang dmar nag me phreng can/ / zhal bstan phyi nang bar du gcod pa bsal/ / mtshan ldan yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhal (440) sgo 'grims/ / chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Unbidden, Dark-Red [Guru Drakpo] with Fire Garland revealed himself and dispelled all your outer and inner obstacles. {440} You visited with numerous authentic masters and drank dharma’s elixir; I supplicate you.
dbon ston dngos byon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / karma lhag mthong zhabs las shangs chos sogs/ / gdams ngag bcud gsol rje btsun rmog lcogs pa'i/ / rnam rol zhal gyis bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Öntön appeared and said that [you were] the hidden yogin who would imbibe the quintessence of the Shangpa dharma and other instructions received from Karma Lhaktong just as Venerable Mokchok’s manifestation promised; I supplicate you.

blo sbyong mdzad tshe lo gsum shig nad kyis/ / gtses kyang stong nyid snying rje'i dbyings su dengs/ / dka' spyad brtson 'grus bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ / gdams ngag nyams bzhes mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

When you practiced mind training, you became sick for three years, but you overcame it in the space of emptiness and compassion. With unimaginable diligence in ascetic practice, you gained experience of the instructions; I supplicate you.
gtum mo sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi/ / ting 'dzin mthar thug brnyes pas rlung sbyor gyis/ / nad gdon dngos su 'don sogs phyi yi rtags/ / bsnyon med mngon sum ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You perfected the meditative absorptions of Fierce Inner Heat, Illusory Body, Dream, and Lucid Clarity, and visibly displayed undeniable outer signs such as expelling sickness and spirits; I supplicate you.
chos brgyad dri ma rmi lam du yang spangs/ / ngo srung mthun 'jug nam yang mi mnga' zhing / / 'dir ltos bya bzhag slogs rul bzhin tu dor/ / bya btang rgyal po khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /
You abandoned the eight worldly concerns even in dreams, never pretended agreement just to save face, turned away from worldly schemes as if from rot— king of renunciants, I supplicate you.
thogs bcas thogs med ya nga skyugs bro la/ / bdag 'dzin blos btang ro snyoms zlog sgom gyis/ / thugs dam bogs thon brtul zhugs rtsal chen rdzogs/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You abandoned self-fixation, and with reverse meditation of equalizing the sickening fear of the tangible and intangible, you enhanced your practice and perfected deliberate conduct— mighty yogin, I supplicate you.
nyams dang rtogs pa bsam mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ / grub pa lha dang mkha' 'gros zhal bstan cing / / chos srung dam can tshogs kyis phrin las sgrub/ / gong ma'i brgyud pa zin la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Unimaginable experience and realization was born, the adepts, deities, and ḍākinīs showed themselves, dharma protectors and oath-bound ones accomplished activities— lineage holder of former masters, I supplicate you.
mi snang la sogs sprul bsgyur cho 'phrul mnga'/ / 'byung 'gyur gnas sogs lkog gyur dngos su mkhyen/ / dag pa'i snang ngor mar pa lo tsA sogs/ / sprul pa'i gzugs su ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You mastered magical transformations such as invisibility, explicitly understood hidden phenomena such as evolution of elements, and displayed emanated forms to those with pure vision, such as that of Marpa Lotsāwa; I supplicate you.
ma nges thod rgal spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ / rkyen snang gang byung thad ka'i lam du gcod/ / snang sems dbang du 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / karma ma Ni'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
You resolved any circumstances directly on the path by the indefinite variety of tögal conduct— yogin who controlled appearances [as] mind, Karma Maṇi, I supplicate at your feet. {441}
skal ldan gdul bya rnams la sgrub (441) brgyud spel/ / bzang ngan 'brel tshad phyir mi ldog pa yi/ / phrin las mthar phyin 'od gsal chen por bzhugs/ / ye shes sku mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You spread the practice lineage for fortunate disciples, whoever had good or bad connections with you did not regress, completing your activity, you remain in the great lucid clarity—sublime form of timeless awareness, I supplicate you.
dran mchog dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ / snying gi ze'u 'bru tshangs pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ thugs rje g.yel ba med par rtag bzhugs la/ / sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ! /

Glorious precious guru, supreme recollection, remain always with unwavering compassion with your heart-stamen in the center of my head’s mandala, and grant the blessings of your awakened body, speech, and mind.
thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la gsol ba 'debs pa bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/
Melody of the Auspicious Coil: Supplication to All-Knowing Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo[89]
ji lta ji snyed shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ / dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro la bu ltar dgongs/ / 'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i chos kyi rgyal/ / mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You know the nature and extent of all there is to know, with nonreferential compassion you consider all migrators your children— king of dharma, capable of emptying the pit of cyclic existence, Khyentse Wangpo, I supplicate at your feet.
rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / gang 'dul rnam rol chos dbyings khyab pa las/ / snyigs dus bstan 'gro skyobs pa'i dpal mgon tu/ / bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Sole father of the victors, Exalted Mañjuśrī, fills the realm of reality with manifestations to train beings. You took birth intentionally in these degenerate times as a glorious protector of doctrine and migrators; I supplicate you.
mdo smad sde bzhi dge bcu'i sman gyi ljongs/ / phrin las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i gnas kyi char/ / rnam dag rigs sogs mchog gi gzigs pa lngas/ / sprul pa'i sku ru bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /

In a medicinal valley of four kinds and ten virtues in Amdo,[90] in the emanated place of activity to train migrators, after five sublime observations such as of a pure family,[91] you manifested an emanation body; I supplicate you.
ye shes brnyes pa'i rnam 'dren mchog rnams kyis/ / dam pa'i skyes bur mgrin gcig lung bstan cing / / phal pa'i spyod las 'das phyir lha mi kun/ / 'gro ba'i mgon tu bsngags la gsol ba 'debs/ /
All the supreme guides with timeless awareness with one voice made prophecies of a holy being, gods and humans praised you as lord of beings for your extraordinary behavior; I supplicate you.
dbus gtsang bod chen kun tu zhabs kyis gcags/ / mnyes pa gsum gyis yongs 'dzin brgya lhag bsten/ / skyo ngal med par dam chos yongs su tshol/ / thugs bskyed dpag yas khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You set foot all over U-Tsang and greater Tibet and attended over one hundred masters, pleasing them in three ways. Without fatigue or regret, you thoroughly sought the Holy Dharma with boundless resolve; I supplicate you.
sa chen phug tu thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe/ / lhag pa'i lha yi phyag rgya thugs kar thim/ / spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad po yongs su grol/ / mkhyen gnyis rtsal chen rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

When doing practice in Sachen’s cave, the mudra of your special deity dissolved into your heart, fully releasing the eight great treasures, [such as] confidence, perfecting the energy of twofold knowledge;[92] I supplicate you. {442}
sgra tshad bzo gso grangs (442) gnas tshig rgyan sogs/ / gnas lnga rig pa yan lag dang bcas par/ / phul du son pas gangs can 'dzin ma'i khongs/ / mkhas pa'i snyan pas khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You excelled at the five classical sciences and their branches, such as grammar, logic, art, healing, calculation, and poetics, and your fame spread everywhere in the region of the Himalayas; I supplicate you.
'dul mngon dbu ma phar phyin gsang sngags kyi/ / rgyud kun gzigs pa tsam gyis gting slebs cing / / mi brjed gzungs thob brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i tshul/ / ma sbas gsal bar ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /

By a mere glance at the texts you plumbed the depths of vinaya, abhidharma, madhyamaka, prajñāpāramitā, and tantras. You gained infallible retention and displayed it overtly as the wheel of stability (Mañjuśrī); I supplicate you.
dri med tshul khrims nor bu'i rgyan chas sgeg / ting 'dzin 'dzum dkar skal ldan yid dbang 'gugs/ / shes rab rol sgegs sa gsum dpyid du g.yo/ / bslab gsum dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

The jewel ornament of your pure discipline attracted fortunate ones, the smiling face of your absorptions magnetized their mental powers, the elegant grace of your knowledge shook the three levels— mighty one of three trainings, I supplicate at your feet.
zab rgyas gnas la chos spyan rdul dang bral/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom la chags danga thogs pa med/ / mdzad spyod kun la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad/ / lha mi yid ches skyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /

With spotless dharma vision you saw any topic’s depth and breadth, your explanation, reasoning, and composition were open and unrestricted, and all your deeds and activities were free of the stains of delusion, inspiring the confidence of gods and humans; I supplicate you.
rang gi yon tan rgya mtsho gter bzhin sbed/ / gzhan gyi yon tan phra mor bsngags shing 'dud/ / bstan 'gro'i don du gces dgu'i bdog pa yang / / rtswa bzhin gtong bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You hid your inner qualities like the oceans’ treasures while praising and honoring the slightest qualities in others. You gave up cherished possessions as if they were grass for the sake of the doctrine and beings; I supplicate you.
gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon shes rgya mtsho mnga'/ / 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod 'os nyid gyur kyang / / khengs dregs mi mnga' dam chos tshig gcig phyir/ / dka' chen dang du bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You mastered vast retentions, absorptions, and super cognitions, becoming worthy of offerings by people in the three worlds, yet you never became haughty and would take on great hardships for a single word of the Holy Dharma; I supplicate you.
ltar snang chos la bsnyad pa'i 'dzin skyong sogs/ / 'jig rten bya bzhag gang la'ang ltos med pas/ / 'jig med seng ge lta bur kun bzang spyod/ / sa steng 'gran zla bral la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You were indifferent to any worldly actions and plans, such as preserving the explanations of pseudo-dharmas. Like a fearless lion, you engaged in ever-excellent conduct— unrivaled on this earth, I supplicate you.
sgrub brgyud shing rta che brgyad ring lugs kyi/ / gzhung gdams man ngag chu klung ma lus pa/ / thugs mtshor bskyil nas smin grol rgyud 'bebs pas/ / bstan pa'i srog rtsa mthud la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Every stream from the source texts and esoteric instructions in the long traditions of the Eight Great Chariots of practice lineages collected in your mind’s lake, establishing the continuum of maturation and liberation, and extending the doctrine’s life; I supplicate you.
thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i shing rta che/ / gdul bya ris su ma chad 'dul ba'i gnyen/ / phyogs su ma lhung grub mtha' mtha' dag gi / gtsug gi nor bur gyur la gsol ba (443) 'debs/ /
phrin las thams cad gzhan phan 'ba' zhig sgrub/ / 'brel tshad don ldan ngo mtshar ltas mang mnga'/ / bsod nams tshogs chen bsam mi khyab pa bskrun/ / sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /

All your activity was done exclusively to benefit others, your company was meaningful, you showed many amazing sights, and you produced an inconceivably great accumulation of merit— mighty one on the tenth level, I supplicate you.
o rgyan yab yum dri med bshes gnyen zhabs/ / chos rgyal mes dbon chos dbang kun mkhyen sogs/ / dgu ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lhas/ / byin brlabs dngos grub stsal la gsol ba 'debs/

The Oḍḍiyāna couple, Vimalamitra, dharma kings and successors, Chöwang, Omniscient [Longchen], and so on— gurus and yidam deities of many lineages blessed you and granted spiritual powers; I supplicate you.
kha /khyad par slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ / mdo rgyud gsang mdzad stsal nas ye shes skur/ / byin gyis brlabs pas nyid dang dbyer med pa'i/ / mkhyen rtogs rdzogs par sad la gsol ba 'debs/

Especially, Master Mañjuśrīmitra granted you the secret treasury of Sutra and Tantra and blessed you with the awareness body inseparable from himself, fully waking your knowledge and realization; I supplicate you.
ka /brtse ba chen po khu dbon brgyud bcas kyis/ / dbang bskur rgyud gtad gzhan yang 'phags bod kyi/ / mkhas grub du mas dngos nyams rmi lam du/ / yang yang rjes su bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /

With great affection, the uncle-nephew lineage [of Sakya] conferred empowerment and entrusted you with their tantras. Many other Indian and Tibetan scholar-adepts nurtured you repeatedly in real life, visionary experience, and dream; I supplicate you.
'dus pa'i dal du zhugs tshe so ston mchog / ye dbang mthu yis snyigs ma'i phung khams sbyangs/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba gsum du gyur/ / rigs kun khyab bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /

When you entered the [Guhya]samāja mandala [conferred by] the supreme teacher of the So [system], the power of the wisdom empowerment refined residues of aggregates and elements and transformed into Vajrasattva’s three secrets— sublime overlord of all families, I supplicate you.
rgyal yum rdo rje btsun mos rjes su bzung / / snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor shar/ / rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar gzigs/ / grub pa'i khyu mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /

The mother of the victors, Vajra Queen nurtured you, and apparent existence dawned as the wheel of infinite purity; you clearly saw the mandala of your vajra body— supreme chief of adepts, I supplicate you.
phyi nang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba thob/ / 'bar ba gsum gyi ye shes gong du 'phel/ / spyod pa gsum gyi rten 'brel mthar phyin pa'i/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /

You could gather the ḍākinīs of the outer and inner three places, the timeless awareness of the three blazes increased,[93] and the auspicious connection of the three conducts culminated— great mighty yogin, I supplicate you.
skyes rabs du ma'i las kyi 'phro sad de/ / mdo rgyud bka' lung dkon pa'i bu sta ka / rten mchog dam rdzas chu klung bye ba snyed/ / rnam thar rgya mtshor bskyil la gsol ba 'debs/ /

The karmic propensities from many lifetimes awoke, you found a million streams of sacred images, holy substances, rare pustaka (books) of sutric and tantric scriptural teachings that flowed into the ocean of your life; I supplicate you.
brgyud pa drug ldan sa dang dgongs pa'i gter/ / dag snang snyan brgyud rjes dran yang gter bcas/ / bka' babs rin chen rnam bdun rgyal srid brnyes/ / chos kyi 'khor los rgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You possessed the six lineages and mind treasures, pure visions, aural lineages, recollected [teachings], and reconcealed treasures; you gained the domain of the seven precious transmissions— turner of the dharma wheel, I supplicate you.
rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis mnan/ / ma 'bad par yang phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub/ / DA ki chos (444) srung mthu ldan dregs pa yis/ / ci bcol bka' bzhin sgrub la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You controlled your own perceptions and subdued others with splendor, accomplished the four activities without even trying, {444} and recruited ḍākinīs, dharma guards, and powerful haughty spirits to accomplish your commands; I supplicate you.
zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo grangs med pas/ / skal ldan bye snyed smin cing grol bar mdzad/ / bsam gyis mi khyab 'phags pa'i rnam thar 'chang / / thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /
You matured and liberated millions of fortunate ones through countless profound and vast dharma wheels; you lived an inconceivably exalted life of freedom— epitome of compassion, I supplicate you.
mi phyed gus pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ / skye ba 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ / dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral bar/ / rjes su bzung nas rnam thar mngon byed shog /

By my single-minded supplication of undivided devotion, from this time until I attain awakening, may I never be apart from you, glorious sublime guru, and once you accept me, may I manifest such a life as yours.
mnyes pa gsum gyis tshul bzhin bsten nas kyang / / thugs kyi bcud thob nyams len mtha' ru phyin/ / sa dang lam gyi yon tan yongs rdzogs te/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang 'grub gyur cig /

By my service of properly pleasing you in three ways, may I attain your mind’s essence and consummate practice, completely perfect the qualities of the levels and paths, and attain the state of mighty Vajradhara.
chos bzhin sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / / lung rtogs chos la rang la dbang thob yis/ / thub dbang bstan pa 'dzam gling kun tu spel/ / chos kyi rgyal po khyed dang mtshungs par shog/ ! /

May there be no obstacles to practice that accords with dharma, and by gaining mastery of the dharma of scripture and realization, may I spread the Sage’s doctrine across the world and become a sovereign of the dharma like you.
dpal ldan bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa kun tu bzang po'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of the Ever Excellent: Supplication to the Glorious Guru
[In this supplication to himself, the underlined words spell out Jamgön Kongtrul’s names. First is Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso Trinle Kunkhyap Pal Zangpo:]
karma bka' brgyud bstan pa'i snang byed mchog / ngag gi dbang phyug yon tan rgya che'i mtsho/ / dge legs phrin las rlabs phreng kun tu khyab/ / dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Sublime illuminator of the Karma Kagyu doctrine, powerful one in speech, vast ocean of qualities, wave sets of your virtuous activity pervade everywhere, glorious excellence, I supplicate at your feet.
[Lodrö Taye:]
tshar gcod rjes 'dzin kun shes yan lag bcas/ / bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la thos bsam dang / / sgom pa'i blo gros chags thogs bral ba yi/ / rnam dpyod mtha' yas ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You studied, reflected, and meditated on the ten sciences, [and] subjugation, protection, all-knowingness and its branches, your intellect free of attachment or hindrance is endowed with boundless discernment; I supplicate you.
[Padma Gargyi Wangchuk Trinle Drodul Tsal:]
pad+ma dbang chen sogs kyis rjes su bzung / / gar gyi dbang phyug thugs rje'i rig sngags 'chang / / phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rtsal mnga' ba/ / dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Great powerful Padma and others nurtured you, you upheld the awareness mantras of compassionate lord of the dance, with the energy of awakened activity to train migrators— glorious sublime guru, I supplicate you.
grub rigs 'dzin pa khyung gi gdung las grol/ / sbyangs pa'i las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad/ / 'khor lo gnyis kyi mthun rkyen ngang gis tshogs/ / ngo mtshar rmad du byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You were born into the Khyung clan, to a family of adepts, the karmic propensities of previous training woke the virtuous dharma, and you collected the conducive conditions for the two cycles— amazing marvelous one, I supplicate you.
gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong bas rgyud bsdams shing / / gzhan phan gzhir bcas bslab pa'i gnas la gzhol/ / rim gnyis mngon rtogs ci yang gsal ba yi/ / sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /
mkhas grub ded dpon yongs 'dzin du ma bsten/ / mdo sngags rgya mtshor lhag bsam (445) brtson pas zhugs/ / gzhung gdams man ngag nor bu'i skyes bzang gis/ / skal ldan dbul ba sel la gsol ba 'debs/ /
o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rdo rje'i bkas/ / gter 'byin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur rnams kyis/ / rnam snang bai ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul du/ / lung bstan mnga' gsol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /

According to the vajra command of the Omniscient One of Oḍḍiyāna, the accomplished leaders who reveal treasures prophesied you as an emanation of [the translator] Vairocana, investing you with power; I supplicate you.
rgyal ba yab sras mchog gling mkhyen brtse'i dbang / / mchog gzigs rnams kyis tA ra nA tha dang / / 'gyur med rdo rje'i sprul par zhal bzhes shing / / yongs 'dzin mchog tu bkur la gsol ba 'debs/ /

Sublime visionaries—Victor [Karmapa] and his heirs, Chokgyur Dechen Lingpa, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo— proclaimed you an emanation of Tāranātha and Gyurme Dorje and honored you as an excellent teacher; I supplicate you.
rgyal bstan ris med skyong ba'i dag snang dang / / 'gro phan ris med sgrub pa'i lhag bsam ste/ / gang byung thad kar khyer ba'i spyod tshul gyis/ / dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /

You had the pure view to preserve the Victor’s doctrine impartially, the noble motivation to accomplish beings’ welfare impartially, and the style of conduct that directly integrates whatever arises— holder of a holy life, I supplicate you.
tsA 'dra rin chen brag gi dben gnas su/ / tshe gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas su/ / 'chad rtsom bka' babs bstan la bya ba mdzad/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /

In the remote site of Tsadra Rinchen Drak you planted the victory banner of lifelong practice and performed acts of teaching, composing, and transmitting— spontaneous achiever of two purposes; I supplicate you.
rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa'i don/ / he ru ka yi sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ / bstan pa ji srid bar du 'gro phan gyi/ / btsas su bsgrubs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /
As clearly extolled in the vajra scriptures, you created images of Heruka’s body, speech, and mind to benefit migrators for as long as the doctrine remains; I supplicate you.
mos pa'i stobs dang rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / / mkha' spyod grong khyer chen por lhan cig 'tshogs/ / rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas mchog thob gyur cig /

On the strength of devotion and inevitable interdependence, may I never be apart from the glorious, supreme guru. May we come together in the celestial great city and attain the sublime place of Vajrasattva.
gang gi gsang gsum rdo rje ltar brtan cing / / zab rgyas chos rnga rtag tu sgrogs pa yis/ / bdag sogs legs pa'i lam kun mthar phyin cing / / bsam don lhun grub dge legs dpal 'bar shog

May your three secrets remain firm as a vajra, forever beating the drum of the profound and vast dharma, so that I and others will complete all paths of goodness. May our wishes be spontaneously achieved and the glory of virtue and goodness blaze.
[Colophon]

bsngags 'os kyi yon tan cha shas phra mos kyang ma gos shing rang nyid la bstod pa ma rabs blun po'i lugs su gyur kyang / sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa pad+ma nor bus nan tan chen pos bskul ngo ma ldog tsam (446) du 'du gsum pa yon tan rgya mtshos sug bris su bstar ba dge legs 'phel/ ! /

Without even a tiny speck of laudable qualities, to write such self-praise is a fool’s errand. Nevertheless, I could not refuse the urgent request of the diligent practitioner and holy Lama Pema Norbu.[94] {446} I, Yönten Gyatso, a person of three preoccupations,[95] wrote this by hand. Let virtue prevail.
de dag thams cad kyi gzhug tu spyir smon lam bya ba don kun grub pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /
Melody of Achieving All Goals: General Aspiration to Conclude
sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma rnams/ / dmigs med thugs rje chen pos 'dir gshegs la/ / mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ / dad ldan mos pa'i bu la rjes su dgongs/ /
All glorious gurus, the real buddhas, please come here with great, nonreferential compassion, sit upon the lotus-sun seat in the space before me and think of me, your faithful, devoted child.
bdag sogs 'gro kun zhing rdul grags snyed kyi/ / sgo gsum gus pas btud de phyag bgyi'o/ / dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / rnam pa kun tu bstod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /

I and all migrators, with bodies as numerous as atoms, bow respectfully in body, speech, and mind, and pay homage. With melodious sounds of an ocean of diverse harmonies I praise you in every way and supplicate.

lus dang longs spyod dngos 'byor yid las byung / / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya mtshos mchod/ / thog med nas bsags bcas dang rang bzhin gyi/ / sdig sgrib nyes ltung 'gyod pas bshags zhing bsdam/ /

I offer my body and possessions, real and imagined, as an ocean of Samantabhadra’s offering clouds. I regretfully confess and vow not to repeat the sins, obscurations, faults, and downfalls accumulated since beginningless time or arising naturally.
'khor 'das kun gyi zag bcas zag med kyi/ / dge ba kun la snying nas rjes yi rang / / dbang por 'tshams pa'i theg gsum chos 'khor ni/ / 'gro khams ji srid bar du bskor bar bskul/ /

I rejoice from the bottom of my heart in all the virtue, flawed or not, in all cyclic existence and its transcendence. I beseech you to turn the dharma wheel of the three vehicles according to beings’ capabilities, for as long as their realms exist.

dmigs med thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i ngang / / gzugs sku rdo rje lta bur rtag brtan gsol/ / 'dis mtshon dus gsum legs spyad ci mchis pa/ / bdag dang pha ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /

I request that you remain steady and everlasting like a vajra in the state of continuous, nonreferential compassion. I dedicate all good actions starting with this, and in the three times, to the swift achievement of the glorious guru’s awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities,

yon tan phrin las myur du 'grub phyir bsngo/ / bla ma rnams kyis thugs rjes rjes su bzung / / ma gus log lta skad cig mi 'byung zhing / / zhabs tog dgu phrugs sgo nas mnyes pa gsum/ / mthar phyin thugs yid gcig tu 'dre bar shog /

for myself and all migrators throughout space, my parents. May all the gurus nurture me with their compassion, may disrespect or wrong views never arise for even a moment, may I please you in three ways through many types of service, and ultimately merge my mind as one with yours.
tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun khyed rnams dang / / skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba ma mchis par/ / ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin/ / bla ma'i gsang ba gsum dang dbyer (447) med shog /

In all my lives may I never be separated from you, the venerable masters, not even for an instant. May I see what you do as good, hold what you say as true, and be inseparable from the guru’s three secrets. {447}
snying nas dad cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ / rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ / dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ci mchis pa/ / thams cad bdag nyid kho nas 'grub gyur cig /
By the power of my prayer made with sincere faith, may I live this one life commensurate in all ways with the lives of liberation of all those holy ones from Vajradhara down to my own root guru.
[Colophon]
so skye'i tshig gi mgal dur la/ / byin rlabs gzi brjid ldan min kyang / / mos pa kho nas sbyar ba'i dges/ / bla ma rnams dang dbyer med shog /
The charred logs of this ordinary person’s words may not have the blazing brilliance of blessings, yet through the virtue of composing with devotion alone, may I be inseparable from all the gurus.
bdag rgyud yon tan mi ldan kyang / / mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung bas/ / bka' brgyud 'di 'dra'i byin rlabs thob/ /
Though I have no inherent good qualities, I have been embraced by genuine gurus and obtained the blessings of lineages such as this.
bstan 'gror phan 'dod lhag bsam mnga'/ / skal bzang 'du shes gsum pa'i sde/ / ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho yis/ / tsA 'dra rin chen brag mgul du/ / rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus/ /

With the noble intention to benefit the doctrine and migrators, I, the lucky one with three preoccupations, Ngawang Yönten Gyatso, wrote this supplication on the hillside of Tsadra Rinchen Drak, on the holy day of the Victor’s descent from the gods’ realm.
sgra dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho yi/ / gsol 'debs rgyud mangs sgrengs pa 'di/ / sa gsum skye dgu'i rna ba ru/ / 'babs nas dbyangs su len par shog / dge legs 'phel// // (448) (449)

May these supplications, like the strings of the sitar with melodies of an ocean of diverse harmonies, fall on the ears of beings in the three places so that they too take up the song. Let virtue prevail.
@#/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/
27. Verdant Tree of Faith. The Life Story of the Glorious Holy Guru[1]
na mo gu ru b+h+yaH /
namo guru bhyaḥ
bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Homage to the holy gurus.
lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i mgon/ / kun dga'i dam chos snying po'i don ston pa/ / gang de'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i tshogs rnams la/ / mchog tu dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /

Supreme special deity Mañjughoṣa, lord of adepts, beloved Holy Dharma that teaches the essential meaning, and the assembly who performs its amazing activity— I pay homage with a mind of sincere faith.
dpag yas tshogs gnyis yun ring goms pa'i mthus/ / bod yul dbus kyi sa yi thig le mchog / chos bzang lha yi mdun sa dang mtshungs par/ / skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /

Through your long cultivation of limitless two accumulations, you [took birth in] the excellent central spot of Tibet, which is comparable to the teaching hall of Indra— to your miraculous manifestation I bow in homage.

'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje'i mtshan/ / skad gnyis smra ba'i rigs su nyer bltams pa/ / kun bzang grub pa'i dbang pos lung bstan bzhin/ / rnam 'dren mchog tu 'khrungs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /

According to the prophecy of Kunzang Drupai Wangpo, an emanation of Mañjuvajra by the name of Dorje would take birth in the translator’s family [of Ra Lotsāwa]— to your birth as a sublime guide I bow in homage.
'du ba rnam bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nyer 'tshe yis/ / rnam par gces pa'i tshe na grub pa'i mgon/ / 'bar ba'i mgon po dngos su byon nas kyang / / phyi nang bar chad bsal la mgos= /
When troubled by disturbances of the four elements, the lord of adepts appeared as Fiery Protector (Jvālānātha) to dispel outer and inner obstacles. I bow in homage to you.
de tshe rlung sems d+hU tir tshud pa yis/ / rgyal ba sras bcas dpag yas mkha' la gzigs/ / rdo rje theg pa'i bag chags yongs sad nas/ / dang ba stobs su gyur la= /

At that time, your wind-mind entered the avadhūtī, you saw countless victors and their heirs in the sky, and the former imprint of Vajrayāna was fully awakened, increasing the strength of your faith; I bow in homage.
gzhan gyis ma bstan yongs su ma bskul bar/ / 'gro ba kun la snying rje'i 'jug ba rgyas/ / theg mchog lha dang rig sngags dam chos tshul/ / ngang gis yongs su mkhyen la= /

Your compassionate commitment to all beings increased without being shown or encouraged by others; you followed the Mahayana, deities, and awareness mantras and complete understanding arose within; I bow in homage.
yi ge'i phyi mo la sogs rang mkhyen cing / / skyes rabs gleng bzhi la sogs gtam mang rnams/ / 'bad rtsol med par thos pa tsam gyis chub/ / 'khor mang dga' ba skyed la= /
You understood letters and such by yourself and effortlessly comprehended just by hearing many subjects, such as the Jātaka tales, pleasing those around you; I bow in homage.
dgyes pa'i rdo rje rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ / mi g.yo sgrol ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs kyi/ / sgrub thabs du ma lo bdun lon tshe gsungs/ / blo gsal (450) kun gyi gtso bor mgos= /
At the young age of seven you taught many sādhanas such as for Hevajra, Vajrayoginī, Acala, Tārā, and Mañjuśrī— foremost of the brilliant, I bow in homage. {450}
mkhas mchog byams pa'i gsung ngag nyer bsten te/ / sde snod gsum dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang / / sgra tshad rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la sbyangs/ / mtshungs med smra ba'i seng ger= /

You relied closely on the teachings of wise Jampa [Lhundrup], learned the Tripiṭaka and its commentaries, and all five sciences such as grammar and logic— to the unrivaled Lion of Speech, I bow in homage.
kun dga'i mtshan can bla ma chos rje yi/ / zhabs pad nyer bsten sdom gsum rim pas nos/ / dpag yas rgyud sde'i dbang lung man ngag gis/ / thugs rgyud yongs su gang la= /

You stayed close to the lotus feet of the one named Kunga [Gyaltsen] and received the three levels of vows; countless tantric empowerments, transmissions, and instructions completely filled your being; I bow in homage.
dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin cing / / gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i rdzogs rim nyams len gnad/ / rtse gcig bsgrub la nyin mtshan lhur mdzad pas/ / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam ston= /

You completed the sādhana practices of an ocean of mandalas, and did vital completion phase of an ocean of Secret Mantra, devoting yourself day and night to accomplishment. Teacher of the path enjoyed by the victors, I bow in homage.
mdo rgyud dgongs pa ji bzhin legs mkhyen nas/ / 'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa'i tshul lugs la/ / srid gsum 'di na 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ / yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la= /

You knew well the precise intent of Sutra and Tantra, and the systems of explication, debate, and composition; you were without compare in these three realms. To you, an ocean of qualities, I bow in homage.
rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing / / 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod kun gyi/ / mkhas grub bye ba'i bzhed srol ji bzhin du/ / ma 'dres thugs su chud la= /
You mastered the collection of an ocean of tantras and comprehended the interpretations of a million learned adepts of exalted India and the Himalaya fastness without mixing them up; I bow in homage.
sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon brnyes pas/ / rmi lam mtshan ma'i tshul du bar chad bgegs/ / rnam par btul nas stong nyid zab mo'i don/ / mngon du gyur pa gang der= /

You actualized illusion-like meditative absorption and totally subjugated the obstacles and obstructors that appeared as signs in your dreams by actualizing the profound meaning of emptiness; I bow in homage.
'phags yul mkhas grub zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhabs sogs bla ma las/ / legs par gsan nas thun mong ma yin pa'i/ / zab don rgya mtsho'i bdag por= /

Buddhagupta and other accomplished Indian gurus gave you the essential elixir of oral instructions; you listened well and became master of the extraordinary ocean of profound meaning; I bow in homage.
dpag med skyes rabs phreng bar mngon 'brel ba'i/ / gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje slob dpon mchog / brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / thugs yid dbyer med 'dres la= /

The supreme vajra master, the primordial lord, your connection during your succession of countless lives, [again] became your root guru, the embodiment of all lineages, and your minds merged inseparably; I bow in homage.
gang las mthar thug de nyid nod pa'i tshe/ / gnas lugs gdod ma rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ / chos kun ngo bo chos sku mngon gyur te/ / srid zhi'i mgon por gyur la= /

When you received the ultimate meaning from him, the primordially abiding nature arose naturally as coemergence and you actualized all phenomena as essential dharmakāya. To the lord of existence and quiescence, I bow in homage. {251}
zab cing rgya (451) che dpag yas dam chos ston/ / mtha' dag gcig gyur don gyi brgyud pa brnyes/ / rdzogs rim zab mo'i ye shes mngon gyur pa/ / bde chen dang po'i rgyal bar= /

You taught the Holy Dharma, infinitely profound and vast, attained the ultimate lineage where all [lineages] become one, and actualized the profound awareness of completion phase. To the original victor of great bliss, I bow in homage.
'phags yul shing rta chen po bcu drug dang / / grub thob 'khor los sgyur ba bgrang yas kyi/ / bka' babs byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags mtshan thob/ / chos kyi rgyal po bla mar= /
You attained the signs of special transmission blessings of the sixteen great charioteers of exalted India and wheel-wielding adepts beyond count. To the guru, dharma king, I bow in homage.
rdo rje theg pa'i 'phags lam rjes mthun nas/ / bcu gnyis rdo rje'i gnas pa mngon gyur te/ / rtsod pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang gi / gdung 'tshob gyur pa gang der= /
You actualized the twelfth vajra stage concordant with the exalted path of Vajrayāna and became the regent of mighty Vajradhara in this age of conflict; I bow in homage.
skye ba kun tu rjes bzung yi dam lha/ / 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson tshe/ / bdag nyid he ru kar gyur mtshan ma gzigs/ / ya mtshan dpag yas mnga' la= /

When exerting yourself in the sādhana of Cakrasaṃvara, the yidam deity who had nurtured you throughout your lives, you saw signs that you had become that Heruka. To the master of boundless wonders, I bow in homage.
sgrol ma'i dbang bzhi nod tshe rang gi lus/ / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs sbyangs byin brlabs te/ / mtha' dag rgyud kyi glegs bam rnam par gyur/ / gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag por= /

While you were receiving Tārā’s four empowerments, a host of ḍākinīs blessed and purified your body, and everything took the form of tantric texts. To the lord of Secret Mantra teachings, I bow in homage.
rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mngon gzigs shing / / 'phags pa lha yis the tshom drwa ba bsal/ / zhi ba lhas kyang 'dus pa'i rgyud don bstan/ / chos rgyun ting 'dzin brnyes la= /

You saw the actual mandala in the sky, Āryadeva cleared away the web of your doubts, Śāntideva taught the meaning of the Guhyasamāja Tantra, and you attained the absorption of dharma continuity; I bow in homage.
yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor mnyam bzhag pas/ / thog mar dge ba'i rtags rnams mthar phyin zhing / / srog 'dzin rtags snang du ma mngon gyur pa/ / bcos min ye shes gzigs la= /

While resting in equipoise of the Six-Branch Yoga, you perfected the signs of virtue from the start; many actual signs appeared indicating your control of vitality, and you saw uncontrived timeless awareness; I bow in homage.
dpal ldan gsang 'dus don la mnyam bzhag pas/ / 'jam dbyangs thugs rjes chos kun de nyid gzigs/ / khro rgyal gshin rje gshed pos byin brlabs pas/ / mthu stobs dbang phyug gyur la= /

While resting in equipoise of the glorious Guhyasamāja’s meaning, by Mañjuśrī’s compassion you saw the suchness of all phenomena. By the blessings of the king of wrathful ones, Yamāntaka, you became a powerful master; I bow in homage.
rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i don la mnyam gzhag tshe/ / rang lus lha sku'i gsal snang cher brtan zhing / / gnas gsum pho nya'i 'du ba legs thob pa/ / lhan skyes bde chen thob la= /

When resting in the equipoise of the meaning of yoga’s ultimate mystery, your body’s clear appearance as the deity’s form stabilized and you attained the gathering of messengers of the three places and coemergent great bliss; I bow in homage. {452}
rnam dag thugs mnga' (452) khyod kyi mnal lam du/ / mda' bsnun shA ba ri dang lU yi pa/ / dril bu 'bar 'dzin zhi ba sbas pa sogs/ / grub mchog du mas zhal bstan= /
Because you were of such pure heart, many supreme adepts such as Saraha, Śavarīpa, Lūhipa, Ghaṇṭāpa, Jālandhara, Śāntigupta, and others revealed themselves in your dreams; I bow in homage.
de dag rnams la the tshom gcod mdzad cing / / rgyud sde'i dgongs don rnam par 'grel ba'i tshe/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag yas brda thabs kyis/ / zab don ngo sprod brnyes la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /
You severed all doubts concerning them; when you were elucidating the intent of the tantras, countless heroes and ḍākinīs used symbols to introduce the profound meaning; I bow in homage.
dga' ldan gnas nas shAkya'i mtshan ldan pas/ / zhal bstan mi pham mgon pos bdag nyid la/ / dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ / chos 'byor rgyun mi 'chad la= /
The one called Śākya from Tuṣita visited you, Maitreya actually blessed you and you attained the signs— continual spiritual enrichment, I bow in homage.
pad+ma 'byung gnas zla 'od gzhon nu dang / / brton pa bzhi ldan la sogs mchog rnams dang / / dam pa chos kyi bka' mchid yongs thob pa/ / bshes gnyen mchog gis rjes bzung mgos phyag 'tshal/ /

You obtained all the dharma directives of the holy ones, sublime masters such as Padmasambhava, Gampopa, and the one endowed with four reliances. Nurtured by sublime spiritual masters, I bow in homage.
thos bsam mthar phyin rtse gcig sgrub la dgyes/ / sa steng chos kyi 'khor los khyab mdzad pa/ / ya mtshan mtshungs med bla ma rin chen la/ / mchog tu gus pa'i yid kyis mgos phyag 'tshal/ /

Perfect in study and reflection, joyful in single-minded practice, you have covered the earth with your cycle of dharma— incomparably wonderful, precious guru, with an attitude of deep respect I bow in homage.
ces pa 'di yan chad slob ma'i ngor tA ra nA thas smras pa'o// // mang+ga lam// // (453) /
Tāranātha wrote this in response to the disciples’ requests.
rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar gsol 'debs kha skong dad pa'i me tog ces bya ba/ /
28. Flowers of Faith. A Supplement to Venerable Tāranātha Rinpoche’s Biographical Supplication[1]
rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur rgyal ba'i sras/ / srid zhi kun spangs srid zhi kun gyi bdag / dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa bla ma'i tshul/ / sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /
sngon tshe rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan ldan tu/ / gyad kyi gtso bor stobs mtha' yas par gyur/ / rnam gzigs drung du byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ / nges pa'i ya mtshan thob la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /

In the past, at the royal palace of Śrāvastī you were the main athlete with incredible strength. The mind of awakening arose in the presence of Vipaśyin[2] and you attained its sure wonder; I bow in homage.
de nas sangs rgyas kun dang rtag tu 'grogs/ / byang chub spyod pa khyad par can rnams bstan/ / rnam 'phrul dpag tu med pas gdul bya'i khams/ / yongs su smin par mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /
Thereafter, you always accompanied buddhas, displayed the special conduct of a bodhisattva, and fully matured disciples’ buddha nature with countless miraculous emanations; I bow in homage.
shAka thub spyan sngar byang sems lnga brgya'i dbus/ / blo gros shin tu rnam par dag par gyur/ / nges don snying po'i bstan pa phyogs med du/ / 'dzin pa'i go cha bzhes la= /

Among the five hundred bodhisattvas around Śākyamuni, you developed an exceptionally pure intellect. You donned the armor of an impartial doctrine holder of the essential definitive meaning; I bow in homage.
grub pa rig 'dzin drang srong paN+Di ta/ / rgyal blon bram ze khyim bdag tha mal pa/ / sna tshogs gzugs kyis sangs rgyas bstan skyong zhing / / 'khor ba dong nas sprugs la= /
In various bodies as siddha, vidyādhara, ṛṣi, paṇḍita, minister, brahmin, householder, and plebeian, you upheld the Buddha’s doctrine and dredged the depths of cyclic existence; I bow in homage.
shar phyogs mya ngan bral bar de bzhin gshegs/ / tsam+b+ha ka drung 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal/ / ri bo'i rtse sogs sku yi bkod pa brgyad/ / gcig char ston par mdzad la= /
In the east, in Vigataśoka with Tathāgata Cambhaka, you were a universal monarch with eight bodies appearing at once on Meru’s peak and elsewhere; I bow in homage.
de bzhin 'jig rten gzhan dang bod yul 'dir/ / sprul mang dus gcig ston las 'dren pa'i gtso/ / o rgyan dpa' bo bi ShA rA dza nyid/ / sprul gzhi'i tshul du ston la= /
Likewise in other worlds and here in Tibet, you showed many emanations at the same time; of those the chief guide Viṣnurājā, hero of Oḍḍiyāna, was the emanation basis; I bow in homage.
he ru ka yis gsang ba'i mdzod gtad cing / / thub pas chos kun bdag por rjes su gnang / / nye sras brgyad kyis mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i/ / 'byung gnas byin gyis brlabs la= /
spyan ras gzigs kyis 'gro 'dul sems dpar bsngags/ nam mkha'i snying pos lhag pa'i bslab pa byin/ / rje btsun sgrol mas rtag tu zhal ston cing / / lung (454) bstan ye shes spor la= /
pad+mA ka ras khrag 'thung dal du bcug / mtsho rgyal ma yis zab mo'i brda dbang bskur/ / Dom+bi he rus gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma'i/ / bdag por mnga' gsol mdzad la= /
tsAn+d+ra go mIs ting 'dzin ngo sprad mdzad/ / bsnyun gyi zug rngu 'phags pas dngos su bkrus/ / dbyangs can lha mos ngag gi dbang phyug stsal/ / bsam yas ye shes yangs par mgos= /
grub chen brgyad cu lo tsA rnal 'byor tshogs/ / gsol ba btab res dngos su chos gsungs shing / / a b+ha ya yis rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi/ / dkyil 'khor chen por bcug la= /
The eighty great adepts, translators, and yogins, when supplicated, each taught you dharma in person and Abhaya inducted you into the great mandalas of infinite tantras; I bow in homage.
gsang ba ye shes gsang ba'i dbang bzhi bskur/ / DA kis sman mchog rnam rgyal dngos su stsal/ / de bI ko Tir mkha' 'gros bka' mchid kyis/ / chos drug thang mar brdal la= /
lU yi pA des bde chen ngo sprod mdzad/ / 'khor lo gsum du tshogs kyi 'du ba rol/ / chags chen lam las mthong thos dran reg kun/ / rnam grol lung bstan thob la= /
o DI ya na zangs mdog dpal gyi ri/ / sham+b+ha la ru rdzu 'phrul zhabs kyis bgrod/ / in+d+ra bo d+hi pad 'byung rigs ldan che'i/ / zhal lung bdud rtsi gsol la= /
To Oḍḍiyāna, Copper-Colored Mountain, and Shambhala you traveled with miraculous feet and drank the elixir of oral instruction from Indrabhūti, Padmākara, and the great Śākī; I bow in homage.
rdo rje phag mo dus 'khor gsang 'dus kyis/ / 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur rgyud sde'i don/ / rnam par 'grel la legs so'i dbugs dbyung stsal/ / gsang bdag rdo rje chos la= /

Vajravārāhī, Kālacakra, and Guhyasamāja conferred the empowerment of great light and gave assurance: “Your commentaries on the meaning of the tantras are good”— lord of secrets of vajra dharma, I bow in homage.
'jam dpal dmar nag rdo rje 'jig byed kyis/ / dbang bskur bdud sde 'joms pa'i lung bstan thob/ / bla ma grub chen brgyad kyis byin brlabs pas/ / chos kyi gting sleb gyur la= /

Mañjuśrī as Dark-Red Vajrabhairava conferred empowerment and granted the prophecy of vanquishing the hordes of devils. With the blessings of the eight great adept gurus, you fathomed the depths of dharma; I bow in homage.
ye shes pheb pas snang grags rtog tshogs kun/ / dag pa'i snang bar rgya 'byams rdo rje'i glus/ / las can 'khor tshogs rtogs grol dus mnyam gyi/ / ye shes sad par mdzad la= /

With the descent of awareness [beings], your pure outlook pervaded regarding all appearance, sound, and thought. Your vajra songs freed thoughts and awakened awareness in your karmically connected entourage; I bow in homage.
dbang bskur sgrub mchod chos 'khor bskor la sogs/ / mdzad chen ston tshe 'ja' 'od me tog char/ / mkha' 'gro'i brda glu (455) dri bzang ngad pas khyab/ / sprul bsgyur cho 'phrul ston la= /
ring lugs nyams pa gsos shing 'khrul pa bsal/ / sngon med shing rta gsar du drangs la sogs/ / nges don snying po rdo rje theg mchog gi / bstan pa rmangs nas gsos la= /

You restored the long tradition and cleared up confusions, brought forth new, previously unknown conveyances, and otherwise reinforced the foundation of the doctrine’s supreme vehicle of the essential definitive meaning; I bow in homage.
kun mkhyen chos rjes bde ba can zhing bstan/ / phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid phog / bu ston chen pos chos kyi cod pan bcings/ / thub bstan mnga' bdag gyur la= /

The omniscient dharma lord showed you Sukhāvatī realm of bliss, granting the dharma domain of nonreturning. Great Butön placed the dharma crown on your head, making you master of the Sage’s doctrine; I bow in homage.
bla ma rnams dang ris med mkhas grub tshogs/ / grub mthar dgyes pa'i legs so'i shis brjod ldir/ / skye ba gsum nas mngon par 'tshang rgya zhes/ / seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags la= /

The host of gurus and nonsectarian learned adepts joyfully shouted, “Well done!” when you completed practice and said, “In three lifetimes you will attain enlightenment,” with a lion’s roar; I bow in homage.
sangs rgyas zhal mthong mthu chen chos skyong rnams/ / 'bangs su mchi zhing srog gi snying po phul/ / mA kA la lcam dral sde 'khor bcas/ / ci bcol bka' bzhin sgrub la= /

Powerful dharma protectors who had seen the Buddha became your servants and offered their life-force essence. Mahākāla Sister-Brother and their retinues accomplished whatever you requested; I bow in homage.
tshe 'dir lta ba'i sgo nas bya ba mdzad/ / phyi mar mdo sgyu sems sogs 'gro lding du/ / dngos su spel nas pad+ma thod phreng gi / phrin las 'khor los sgyur la= /

In this life, you engaged in deeds by means of the view. In the future, in Drāviḍa, you will spread Sutra, Illusion, and Mind[4] and more, turning the wheel of the awakened activity of Padma Tötrengtsal; I bow in homage.
phag mo sgrol ma spyod 'chang pad+ma bdes/ / bskul zhing dpa' bo DA kis glu gar gdugs/ / DA dril bde skyong bdud rtsis yongs mchod de/ / zhing khams mtha' yas gshegs la= /

Encouraged by Vārāhī, Tārā, Kṛṣṇācārya, and Padma De, heroes and ḍākinīs presented you with full offerings of song, dance, parasols, drums, bells, and bliss-inducing elixir. You departed for infinite pure realms; I bow in homage.
bdud kyi gnas g.yo 'jig rten rab 'byams su/ / ngo mtshar ltas sogs ting 'dzin sa brnyes shing / / rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ / kun tu khyab par mdzad la= /

The abodes of the demons shook, and in infinite worlds amazing sights and so on heralded the state of absorption. Positive indications of accomplishments pervaded everywhere— awareness woman’s great being, I bow in homage.
au DI ya nar bIr+Ya rA dza dang / / 'gro lding gnas su bde ba'i mgon po'i tshul/ / bai DUr+Ya snang bde ba can zhing du/ / sa bcu'i dbang phyug ston la= /
In Oḍḍiyāna, you appear as Vīryarāja, in Drāviḍa in the manner of Bliss, Sukhanātha, in Vaiḍūryanirbhāsa and Sukhāvatī you manifest as a tenth-level lord; I bow in homage.
ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i drwa bar sdom/ / thun mong snang ngor 'jig rten 'od ldan tu/ / bde gshegs nam mkha'i thig ler 'tshang rgya sogs/ / rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /

In essence, you are Coemergent Jālasaṃvara, to ordinary folk, in the world called Lokābhaḥ (Luminous), you will attain awakening as the sugata Sūryatilaka— to your unimaginable manifestations I bow in homage.
'phags pa'i yul du 'jigs 'byung sbas pa bzhin/ / khyod 'dra'i (456) gang zag phyis nas ma byon pa'i/ / drug pa'i rgyal tshab nyid du nges pa rnyed/ / bla med he ru ka dpal bla ma rjer/ /
In exalted India, the likes of Abhayākaragupta will not come again—you are such a person. {456} You surely attained the level of the sixth Buddha’s regent, incomparable Heruka, glorious guru:
gus pa'i phyag 'tshal ngo mtshar mchod sprin 'bul/ / nyes byas kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / / chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag tu bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / dge kun khyod kyi go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /

I bow with respect and present clouds of offerings. I confess all faults and rejoice in virtue. I entreat you to turn the dharma wheel and always remain. I dedicate all virtue to the attainment of your state.
kun dga' snying po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan/ / rnam mthar phrin las ci 'drar bdag gyur te/ / phyogs las rnam rgyal gsung rab phyogs bcur spel/ / 'gro kun mkha' 'gro drwa bar sdom byed shog /

May I replicate Kunga Nyingpo’s life of liberation in awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activity. May I spread the good word, victorious in all directions, and bind all migrators in the ḍākinīs’ net.
'di phyi bar do rmi lam dag tu yang / / tA ra nA tha nyid dang mi 'bral bar/ / gsang ba'i mdzod thob brtul zhugs phyogs med grub/ / kha sbyor bde chen rol par 'tshang rgya shog /

May I never be separated from you, Tāranātha, in this life or the next, in between, or in dreams. May I attain the secret treasury and achieve impartial deliberate conduct, and become enlightened in the play of great-bliss union.
rtag tu rje btsun mnyes pa'i bya ba sgrub/ / byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs nas rje nyid dang / / rnam dbyer med pa'i phrin las rab 'byams kyis/ / mkha' khyab dzam gling bkra shis dpal 'bar shog /
May I always accomplish acts that please the Venerable One, may blessings enter my being and my awakened activity be ever inseparable from yours, lord, may auspicious glory pervade the world.
[Colophon]

ces rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i ljon shing gi kha skong dam pa snga mas mdzad pa 'ga' zhig rgyas bsdus ma 'tshams pa dang lung rgyun ma bzhugs pas/ / rang gzhan dad pa'i gsos 'debs kyi tshul du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel// // (457)

I wrote this supplement to [Tāranātha’s] Verdant Tree of Faith: The Life Story of the Glorious Holy Guru because some previous holy masters’ compositions were too long or too short or their transmission had not lasted. It is written in the manner of a faithful supplication for myself and others by Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso at the secluded retreat of Palpung. Let virtue prevail.
@#/ /ni gu ma'i smon lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs so/ /
29. Niguma’s Aspiration Prayer of the Sealed Word[1]
rgya gar skad du/ Ar+Ya pra Ni d+hA na rA dza na ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /
Sanskrit: Āryapranidhanarāja Tibetan: ’Phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po
sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Homage to all the buddhas and bodhisattvas.
phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ / thugs rje'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yis/ / bdag gis smon lam 'di dag thams cad kun/ / ji ltar btab pa bzhin tu 'grub par shog /
May the prolific compassionate activity of the many victors in ten directions and three times accomplish all these prayers of mine just as they are expressed.
'di nas bzung ste rnam pa thams cad du/ / mos gus tshad med bla ma mnyes byed cing / / rnam dag lus ngag longs spyod mkha' mnyam mchod/ / skad cig mi 'bral phrin las rgyas byed shog /

May I please my guru with immeasurable devotion from this time on and in all circumstances, filling space with offerings of pure bodies and enjoyments[2] so their activity flourishes and is never absent.
tshe rabs kun tu nyan bshad sgom sgrub tshe/ / log pa'i slob dpon de bzhin bla ma ngan/ / grogs ngan sbyin bdag ngan dang mi phrad cing / / bla ma mchog bsten byang chub der thob shog /

May I never, in all lives, meet false ācāryas, bad gurus, bad companions, and bad benefactors when hearing, explaining, meditating, and practicing, but attend excellent gurus and thereby attain awakening.
skye ba kun tu rigs bzang nad med cing / / dbyangs snyan gzugs mdzes gzi brjid stobs ldan nas/ / tshe ring 'khor dang longs spyod chos rnams kun/ / lhun gyis grub cing kun gyis bkur bar shog /
May I have good family, health, eloquence, good form, charisma, and strength in all my lives, and with a natural long life, dedicated friends, wealth, and dharma, be respected by all.
gang du skyes pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ / sems can rnams kyis mthong thos dran reg tshe/ / mdzes shing yid 'ong lta bas mi ngoms shing / / mi mthun phyogs bral kun dang mthun par shog /
May I be free of discord and in harmony with all wherever I am born, throughout my lives, and be perceived as lovely, attractive, and fascinating by those who see, hear, recall, or touch me.
bdag ni mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ / mgon skyabs re gnas dpung gnyen gyur nas kyang / / gang la gang 'dod re ba thams cad kun/ / tshul bzhin bdag gis ma lus skong bar shog /
May I be protector, refuge, hope, and champion to all sentient beings throughout space; all their hopes and desires justly fulfilled by me.
bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs rnams dang / / lus ngag yid gsum smon lam gcig tu sbyang / / dus 'di nas bzung skad cig mi 'bral zhing / / dag snang bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /
May I train alongside friends who wish me well, body, speech, and mind joined in a single aspiration, never separate from this moment on in the sublime happiness of our pure perception. {460}
gang skyes yid bzhin nor bur bdag (460) gyur nas/ / dgos 'dod thams cad yid la bsam ma thag / phun sum tshogs pa dpag med char babs nas/ / sems can thams cad bde la 'god par shog /
May I be a wish-fulfilling gem wherever I am born, raining down a boundless cornucopia of desires as soon as they are thought, placing all beings in a state of happiness.
bdag ni gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad du/ / 'gro kun nad gdon 'thab rtsod dbul phongs bral/ / tshe ring nad med chos dang longs spyod ldan/ / bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /
May all migrators wherever I stay be free of illness, bad spirits, strife, and poverty; and with long life, health, dharma, and wealth, may auspiciousness and well-being abound.
skye ba 'di dang skye ba thams cad du/ / longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes nas/ / sbyin pa rnam bzhi phyogs bcur gtong byed cing / / pha rol phyin bcus 'gro kun smin grol shog /
May I, in this life and in all lives, gain access to the sky-treasure of wealth and dispense the four gifts in the ten directions, maturing and liberating beings through ten perfections.[3]
'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ / chags thogs med pa'i shes rab phun tshogs nas/ / dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun/ / skad cig tsam gyis thams cad mngon gyur shog /

May my superb wisdom, without desire or limitation for all phenomena of cyclic existence or transcendence, bring every sphere of what’s knowable in the three times into sharp focus within a single instant.
bdag ni bslab gsum dri med legs brgyan zhing / / rtsod bral lhar bcas 'jig rten mchod cing bstod/ / tshul khrims mchog la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / / legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs shog /

May I be graced by the flawless three trainings and honored by the world, with its conflict-free gods,[4] establishing all migrators in supreme ethical discipline to fully perfect all their excellent qualities.[5]
ri khrod dgon par chog shes zas gos ldan/ / phyi nang bar chad skad cig mi 'byung bar/ / nyams rtogs mthar phyin phrin las tshad med kyis/ / 'gro rnams ma lus smin cing grol byed shog /

May I be content in remote retreat with food and clothes, and without a moment of outer or inner obstacle, gain ultimate experience, realization, and activity that matures and liberates every migrator.
lha 'dre stobs ldan dregs can ma lus kun/ / bsnyen sgrub rbad bskul skad cig mi dgos par/ / srog snying phul zhing bran bzhin nyan pa dang / / mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa bsrung bar shog /
May all the powerful gods and arrogant demons, without need of a moment of exhortation or worship, offer me their life force and obey like servants to guard the doctrine with mighty magical powers.
bdag gis byams dang snying rje mngon gyur te/ khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ / gcig la gcig 'tshe'i gnod pa rab zhi nas/ / bu gcig ma bzhin brtse bas gnas par shog / (561)
May I manifest love and compassion to pacify the mutual hatred and harm of all sentient beings in the three realms so they dwell in a mother’s love for her only child. {461}
nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe/ / gnad gcod mi 'byung chos sku mngon gyur nas/ / gzugs sku rang shar gzhan don lhun grub cing / / sku gdung ring bsrel 'gro ba 'dren par shog /
May dharmakāya manifest at the time of my death before the cessation of the vital elements,[6] form kāyas arise to spontaneously help others, and my remains and relics continue to draw beings.
rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus thams cad du/ / sangs rgyas bskal pa'i rdul snyed rgya mtsho la/ / kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' mnyam pa yis/ / bskal pa rgya mtshor bdag gis mchod byed shog /
May I make offerings throughout the ages to the multitudes of buddhas of the eon who dwell in all the pure lands of the victors, and fill space with Samantabhadra’s offering clouds.
zhing khams rnam dag rgya mtshor mngon gyur te/ / spyod pa rnam dag shes rab tshad med kyis/ / chos rnams rgya mtsho thams cad rab mthong nas/ / ye shes rgya mtsho ma lus rtogs par shog /
May I perceive the ocean of totally pure realms, and with totally pure conduct and limitless wisdom, perfectly behold all the oceans of dharmas and realize the whole ocean of timeless awareness.

rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung dbyangs mngon gyur nas/ / nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tshangs pa'i dbyangs sgrogs shing / / 'gro rnams skad du bdag gis chos bstan nas/ / sems can ma lus sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /

May I actualize the victors’ melodious speech, and with my Brahmā voice resounding through space, teach the dharma in the languages of all people and place all beings without exception in Buddha’s state.
kun bzang sgyu ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin tu/ / mtha' bral sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin mngon gyur nas/ / sangs rgyas sku dang zhing khams ma lus kun/ / rdul gcig steng du skad cig 'grub par shog /
May I actualize the absorption of boundless illusion like Samantabhadra’s liberation through illusion, to instantly establish upon every atom the buddha bodies and realms without exception.[7]

sems can khams dang rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dang / / nam mkha'i mtha' dang chos dbyings tshad med lhag / bdag gi smon lam ting 'dzin phrin las rnams/ / gting mtha' dpag med tshad bzung med par shog /
