rang sems tshir gyi ma bzung na/ / don med kyi las la zad nyen gda'/ / rang don la hril gyis ma sgril na/ / gzhan don ltar snang gi mgo skor yod/ /
If you don’t firmly grasp your own mind, you could squander life on useless activity. If you don’t totally wrap up your own welfare, you’ll fool yourself with the semblance of helping others.
da res tsam ma gtogs mi lus ni/ / yang yang du thob pa shin tu dka'/ / ngan song gsum du skyes tsa na/ / dam chos kyi skal pa ni gcig kyang med/ /
This unique opportunity of a human body is very difficult to obtain over and over. Once you are born in the three bad states, there’s no chance to meet the Holy Dharma.
da res rdog sna gcig 'dred na ni/ / dmyal ba'i gting rdo gcig byed byed 'dra/ / phyi ma la phan pa'i dge ba dang / / nyams len byas rjes ni 'di kar gda'/ /
Right now if you take one misstep and slip, you’ll fall like a millstone to the depths of hell. The results of virtue that benefit the next life and engaging in practice are just like that.
sdig pa dang nyes ltung ni char ltar 'bab/ / don 'di ltar bsams la chos la 'bungs/ / rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yang myur du 'ong / /
Unvirtuous acts and violations fall like rain. Think about that and devote yourself to dharma. The suffering of old age quickly approaches.
na tshwa dang mi 'dod pa byung tsa na/ / sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i shes pa de/ / chos kyis lam du longs dka' bas/ /
Once sickness and the unwanted occur, consciousness is pained by suffering and it’s hard to be taken on the path of dharma.

skyid dus nas chos la 'bungs ba zhu/ / re zhig rang cag tsho'i mi tshe la/ / rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi dar rgud dang / / yar bla ma slob dpon gyi gnas lugs dang / / gra rogs dang grogs mched kyi 'byung lugs dang / / pha ma dang dgra gnyen gyi gnas lugs sogs/ / thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang 'tshang (534) ston/ /

Please pursue dharma while you are still at ease. During our temporary human life, the growth and decay of our country, the circumstances of our gurus and masters, the fortunes of our fellow monastics and tantric siblings, and the situations of our parents, friends, and enemies all expose the inherent flaw of impermanence. {534}
'phral lo dang zla ba zhag re la/ / mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon kun/ / skyo ba skyed byed kun gam na 'dug /
Presently, each passing year, month, and day is a spiritual master who teaches impermanence and inspires disillusionment, standing right here beside us.
nam yang tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/ / ji ltar byas kyang 'dor ba la/ / bu bya ba btang la sgrub pa 'tshal/ /
All acts that we have ever done in this life, no matter what they are, must be abandoned. Give up activity, my child, and pursue practice.
lus mi rtag sha rus 'gyes 'gyes 'dra/ / gces gces mor byas pa'i lus 'di yang / / tha ma rus pa'i phung por gda'o/ /
Your transient body of flesh and bone seems pleasing, but no matter how much you cherish it, in the end it will be a heap of bones.
rang ser snas 'bad 'bungs bsags pa yi/ / nor kun yang sus thob dang bgo bshar byed/ / da lta zas gos kyis 'byor ba yang / / ro shun dang ro zas kham gcig yin/ /
The wealth you strenuously accumulated by avarice will be taken and distributed by who knows who. Even the food and clothing currently in your possession are death shrouds and dry corpse food.
khong kha drag dpung pa 'dzom pa yang / / dus nges med 'chi ba byung ba'i tshe/ / nor mnga' thang longs spyod kun bor nas/ / slar ngan song gsum du 'grim pa mthong /
Even though you amass a mighty army, when the uncertain time of death comes, you’ll relinquish wealth, power, and enjoyment and again face roaming in the three bad places.
lar mi rtag 'dus byas spyi lugs yin/ / don 'di la bsams nas chos la 'bungs/ / byams snying rje phyogs med du sbyong ba dang / / 'phral gang shar la zhen med du skyong ba dang / /
Still, impermanence is the way of all composite things. Think on its meaning and devote yourself to dharma. Train in universal love and compassion and maintain nonattachment to whatever arises now.
tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ / dus gnas skabs kun tu rin po che/ / pha bla mar yid ches blos khel gyi/ / snying thag pas gsol ba 'debs par 'tshal/ / lar nam yang bslu ba med par nges/ /

In this life, the next, and the intermediate state, at all times and circumstances, the most precious is to maintain confidence in your guru. Please supplicate the guru from your heart. Anyway, that would certainly not deceive you.
nges 'byung dang snying rje mos gus dang / / zhen med yangs med du skyong ba ste/ / don bzhi po 'di la 'bad gyur na/ / 'dun ma rtse la phyin pa yin/ / ces so/ /
Maintain renunciation, compassion, devotion, and nonattachment without distraction— if you persevere in those four points, you will reach the summit of your intentions.
dar yul brag nag tu rgyal bzang rtogs ldan rin chen bkra shis kyis zhal gyi gdams pa zhus pa la 'di gsungs so/ /
Tāranātha said this at Daryul Draknak in response to a request by Rinchen Tashi, the realized one of Gyalzang, for personal instruction.
bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bu snang ba sems la khyad par med/ / gang shar bzo bcos med par zhog / snying rje dang stong nyid 'gro ldog gcig /
Homage to all gurus. Son, appearances are not different in the mind. Whatever arises, remain without fabrication. Compassion and emptiness are two sides of the same coin.
snying rje 'dzin par ma shor zhing / / stong nyid chad stong du ma lus pa'i/ / zung 'jug nyams len gal re (535) che/ /

las 'bras kyi blang dor phyin ci log / cis kyang dgos med kyi nges 'byung stor/ / gzhan phan mkha' khyab kyi sems bral ba'i/ / stod skad rbad khams kyi phyag chen dang / / mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi rtsa rlung la/ / blo rtse gtod pa'i sgom chen de/ / blo chung gi mgo bskor mkhas srid kyang / / sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam las gol/ /

A “great meditator” who narrowly focuses on the wrong choices concerning actions and their results, or spurns the renunciation of needing nothing at all, or secedes from the attitude of universal altruism, or boasts with highfalutin language of mahāmudrā, or practices the subtle body yogas of non-Buddhists may be clever at confusing the gullible but has strayed from the Buddha’s joyful path.
bu sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub gyur na/ / sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu yin pas/ / bzang 'dod kyi tsab tsob ma mang bar/ / lus ngag yid gsum chos dang bstun/ /
Son, if you do as the Buddha taught, since that is the cause for attaining buddhahood, your body, speech, and mind will be in harmony with the dharma, without a lot of frenzied attempts to seem good.
lta ba ma thol yangs pa dang / / spyod pa zhib tig skabs su bab/ / sgom pa yengs med rgyun chad med/ / de gsum 'dzom na 'bras bu smin/ /
With a view both high and wide, actions meticulous and appropriate, and constant meditation without distraction; these three will mature as the result.
bza' btung don gnyer gyi kha spyad can/ / rgyal khams bskor ba'i zog po la/ / sgom chen gyi dri yang mi yong bas/ / dben pa'i ri la tshugs par 'tshal/ /
Phonies who wander around the country using their eloquence to pursue food and drink won’t exude even a whiff of a great meditator. Please stay in isolation in the mountains.
long gtam la chags shing zhen pa des/ / ngag gi bden tshig ga la 'grub/ / nus na gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod gyis/ / min na'ang smra ba bcad na legs/ /
With attachment and fondness for idle talk, how can you ever achieve the spoken truth? Recite the mantras of Secret Mantra if you can. If not, it is best to remain silent.
mthun 'jug dang mi dge'i ngos srung gis/ / sems bzhag kyang chags sdang 'phel ba'i ngang / / 'di spangs kyang spangs pa dka' ba'i phyir/ / rbad kyis chod la rgyangs kyis bskyur/ /

If you conform and try to please others with unvirtuous acts, though you rest the mind, desire and anger will just increase. It’s difficult to give this up even if you want to, so vigorously cut them off and leave them far behind.
nyams myong cung zad skyes skabs su/ / bzang 'dzin skyes na bdud kyis khyer/ / dpe ri la 'dzegs pas g.yang la lhung / / mtho ru song gin sgrim pa gces/ /

When a little meditative experience arises but you fixate on its excellence, the devil kidnaps you. Like falling into a ravine while climbing a mountain, it’s crucial to take great care during the ascent.
bla ma'i zhal lung gi gdams ngag rnams/ / chud zos med par nyams su longs/ / ham pa dang 'ud gog ma che bar/ / rtse gcig tu bsgoms na 'tsheng ba yin/ / ces so/ /
Practice all the guru’s personal instructions without letting them go to waste. Don’t become haughty or boastful; be happy just to meditate with a single intent.
la stod sba lung gi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig gis gdams ngag zhus pa la 'di gsungs so/ /
The following was spoken to some yogins of Latö Palung who requested instruction: {536}
na mo gu ru/ (536)
namo guru
pha gcig chog rgyal po bla ma la/ / dus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag bu slob kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ / sems mkha' khyab rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /
Sovereign guru, my single sufficient father, I supplicate you continuously without a break. Turn my disciples’ minds to the dharma and bless them to realize all-pervasive mind.
dus da nges mthun rkyen kun 'dzom zhing / / mtshan ldan rje dang mjal ba dang / / gdams ngag zab dgu thob dus 'dir/ / don med du ma lus pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /
At this time, you’ve accrued all favorable conditions, you have met a qualified spiritual master and received many profound instructions. Now, no matter what, do not render them futile.
lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po la/ / rtag 'dzin gyi yid brtan mi rung bas/ / dge sbyor phyi shol ma byed par/ / 'phral 'phral du lag len la thebs par mdzod/ /
This body is a composite heap of flesh and bones, unbefitting to hold as stable and permanent. Establish your virtuous practice right away without postponing it to a later time.
nyams su ma myong ba'i stong shob can/ / stong nyid kyi rbad gog khar khyer nas/ / nag po kha 'byams su song nyen bdog / las 'bras la zhib tig gal re che/ /

Those without meditative experience make false claims and mouth on with assertions about emptiness. They are at risk of succumbing to dark, empty talk. It’s vitally important to scrutinize cause and effect.
mos gus gdung ba rgyun chad med/ / bla ma'i gsol 'debs la nan tan mdzod/ / de la'ang bden zhen mi 'tshal te/ / bla ma rang rang sems las logs na med/ /
With unceasing longing devotion, fervently engage in supplicating the guru. But please don’t cling to that as real. Your mind and the guru’s are no different.
rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ / tshugs med kyi snyeng rje gal re che/ / bden med kyi 'khrul pas bslus pa yi/ / bde sdug kun rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /
Not knowing yourself, you wander cyclic existence, but irresistible compassion is most important. The delusion of clinging to its reality tricks you. Regard all joy and sorrow as a dream.
rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa 'di/ / bcas bcos mi dgos chos sku yin/ / rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci shar yang / / chu dang rlabs bzhin go bar gyis/ /
This ordinary consciousness of your mind need not be modified, for it is dharmakāya. Whatever arises are the experiences of discursive thought. Understand them to be like water and waves.
spyod pa zhib rtsing ci ltar yang / ngo lkog gi rdzun rib mi 'tshal te/ / de yang chos dang mthun pa gces/ / chos 'gal gyi sgom chen phaT tshar re/ /
However meticulous your conduct, please don’t be false and hypocritical. It’s crucial to be in harmony with dharma. Perverse “great meditators”: phaṭ—be gone!
sgom pa 'khor yug rgyun chags de/ / byar med las med gal re che/ / de yang rtsol med kyi dran pas bzung / / mu thom du lus na the le le/ /
For continuous meditation day and night, it’s most important to lack action or work. Effortlessly maintain that with mindfulness. If you are left in the dark: te le le—despair!
'bras bu rang sems sangs rgyas 'di/ / gzhi thog tu zob stong ma las shing / / re dogs kyi g.yang sar ma lhung ba/ / thag chod kyi shes pa'i nges shes dgos/ /
The fruition, this buddha of your own mind, is fundamental, not from baseless delusion. Do not fall into the abyss of hopes and fears. You need assurance of knowing this decisively.
gang snang thams cad chos sku la/ / phyogs 'dzin (537) gyi dbye ba med lags mod/ / gcam bu'i dag snang 'dis rang chugs skyel/ / bla ma'i brgyud pa zin par mdzod/ / ces so/ /
All that appears is the dharmakāya. {537} Sure, it’s fine not to make biased distinctions, but artificial pure view undermines autonomy. Stick to your guru’s lineage.
re zhig gtsang g.yo ru na bzhugs pa'i skabs snang ba thams cad ngo sprod kyi slob dpon tu shar bas rdo rje'i glu 'di ltar gsungs so/ /
This one time, when Tāranātha was staying at Yoru in Tsang, all appearances arose to him as teachers to introduce [the nature of mind]. So he sang this vajra song.[57]
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
bdag phyogs ris bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ / dus me tog ldan pa khyu mchog lo/ / yul bkra shis 'phel ba'i g.yo ru na/ / rje bla ma'i bka' drin snying la dran/ /
Here in Yoru where auspiciousness spreads at the time of flowers in the Ox year, I, a yogin free from bias, fondly recall my kind lord guru.
sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ / mthar da lta'i bar du 'khyams pa lags/ / lar 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa 'dir/ / sems can sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i rin po che/ /
Indeed, I have previously wandered until now in cyclic existence from beginningless time. Yet, here in this cycle without bottom or boundary, the precious one sends beings[58] to buddhahood.
'gro drug pha ma drin che yang / / 'khor bar bskyur rogs gcig ma lags pa/ / gtan gyi 'dun gros la sbyor mkhan med/ / snying gi 'dun gros de rje la zhus/ /
Although the six kinds of migrators are kind parents, not one has helped me out of cyclic existence; no guide to prepare me for everlasting [happiness]. For such essential plans I ask my mentor.
lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po 'di/ / nam 'jig la nges pa cung zad med/ / shi rjes su brod pa'i gding med kun/ / rig pa 'di nang du 'gugs par zhu/ /
This physical composite of flesh and blood will destruct we know not at all when. Those who lack confidence in the afterlife, please focus inward with this knowledge.
da 'chi bas 'jigs nas bla ma btsal/ / nyams len kun rdo rus thug par 'bad/ / da tsam nas shi yang blo re bde/ / blo bde tshags su tshud pa gcig mi dgos sam/ /
Fearing my death, I sought out a guru. I fully applied all practices, as rock breaks bone. Since then, I know I’ll be perfectly fine when I die. Don’t you need a provision for such a carefree state?

nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba 'di dang gcig / mtho dman 'byor rgud kyi ri mo 'di dang gnyis/ / rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi 'gyur tshabs 'di dang gsum/ / 'dus byas mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /

byas kyang zin med kyi zhing las 'di dang gcig / bskyangs kyang drin med log sgrub kyi spyod pa dang gnyis/ / 'thungs kyang ngoms med kyi lan tshwa'i chu dang gsum/ / las don med du ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /

grong khyer 'du 'dzi'i lang long 'di dang (538) gcig / brel la don chung sbrang bu'i spyod pa 'di dang gnyis/ / sprin dkar ban bun gyi 'gyed 'khor 'di dang gsum/ / 'khor ba gtad med du ston pa'i ngo sprod gcig gda'/ /

snang la gzugs med kyi 'ja' tshon 'di dang gcig / lhang lhang dmigs med kyi brag cha 'di dang gnyis/ / med kyang dga' sdug 'char pa'i rmi lam dang gsum/ / snang ba rang sems su ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /
phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dang gcig / nang rig pa sems kyi 'char sgo dang gnyis/ / dbyings ngos gzung bral ba'i stong nyid dang gsum/ / chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med gcig gda'/ /
lar nyams myong cung zad gcig skyes tsa na/ / snang ba gang shar ci shar ngo sprod du 'dug / sgo gsum bya ba ci byas bogs 'don du gda'/ / don 'di la bsam na a la la/ /
But when a little meditation experience is born, any and all appearances demonstrate this. Any acts of the three doors serve to enhance it. When you think about this meaning—a la la!
da yang mi tshe'i lhag ma cung zad 'di/ / nyams len sgrub pa la skyel ba dang / / dben pa'i ri khrod zin pa dang / / gang shar lam du longs pa ru/ /
Now then, whatever little is left of this life will be spent in accomplishing the practice, keeping to remote mountain retreats, and integrating whatever arises on the path.
drin chen bla ma rin chen gyis/ / sngar tshad gzung med par byin brlabs mod/ / da yang byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / skyabs gzhan na med do chos kyi rje/ /
Surely my benevolent, precious guru granted inconceivable blessings in the past. Now again please grant your blessings; Dharma Lord, I have no other refuge.
tA ra nA thas rgyal khams kyi 'gyur lugs 'dra mthong bas/ sems la ngo sprod pa ltar gyur pa'i skabs shig tu glur blangs pa'o/ /
When Tāranātha saw the apparent changes in the country, they seemed to be introducing mind’s nature, so he rendered it into song.
yar 'brog stag lung du tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i tshe rdo rje nA da'i rang sgra bsgrags pa ni/ /
While participating in a communal feast in Yardrok Taklung, the natural sound of the vajra nāda resounded:[59]
na mo ma hA mu drA ya/
namo mahāmudrāya
dbyings bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' la/ / rig pa ye shes phyogs med kyi rtsal/ / mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gza' skar bkra/ /
In basic space, the sky of great bliss, the impartial energy of intrinsic timeless awareness displays bright stars of knowledge, love, and power.
rje dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / sprang gus pas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ / lar byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /
Lord, glorious guru Vajradhara, this vagabond respectfully supplicates you: bless me again, compassionate one.
ya gi shed dag pa'i zhing khams na/ / sku mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i thugs/ / khong rdo rje 'chang (539) zhes grags pa de/ / yongs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin no skad/ /
In the upper regions, the pure realm, is the unchanging form of the mind of great bliss. He is known as Vajradhara, {539} said to be the principal of all mandalas.
de gzhan na yod pha ma yin te/ / pha rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu lags/ / rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ / mi nga yang brtan pa cung zad zin/ /
But he is not somewhere else— indeed he is my one father root guru. Lord, through the kindness of your compassion this person has gained some stability.
gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la/ / thag chod kyi gdings 'di nyams su dga'/ / sems gsal la dwangs pa'i rang snang la/ / mi 'char bya ba ni gcig kyang med/ /

I derive joy from my decisive confidence in the basic ground, the uncontrived abiding nature of the native state. In the natural appearances of mind’s radiant clarity there is not a single thing that might not arise.
de shar tsam nyid nas grol ba 'di/ / rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma lags sam/ / yongs rang ngo shes pa'i yengs med 'di/ / zhi gnas kyi sgom zhes bya ba lags/ /
This liberation at the very moment of arising— is it not the yoga of self-liberation? This total recognition of my essence without wavering is indeed called “meditation of calm abiding.”
rang bzhin ma rnyed pa'i rtsa bral 'di/ / lhag mthong shes rab ma lags sam/ / rje rang sems dang dbyer med du shes tsa na/ / chos sku zhal mjal la dka' rgyu med/ /
This rootlessness of not finding an intrinsic nature— is it not the wisdom of higher insight? When I knew the lord inseparable from my mind, it was not hard to meet the face of dharmakāya.
rang zhal mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ / 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus skyes/ / bdag dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dang / / spyir du chos dang mjal ba dang / / sgos su gsang sngags thob pa dang / /

For the yoga of seeing one’s own face, arouse[60] devotion beyond meeting and parting. I have obtained a free and endowed human form, encountered the dharma in general, and found the Secret Mantra in particular.

yang sgos zab don rig pa 'di/ / sngon cung zad bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ / blo cung zad chos la song ba dang / / rje mtshan ldan bla mas bskyangs pa dang / / chos mdo rgyud la nges pa rnyed pa dang / / 'phral chags sdang phyogs ris med pa 'di/ /

More specially, this knowledge of profound meaning is a sign that I previously accumulated a little merit. My mind has turned somewhat to the dharma, I was nurtured by a qualified guru, my lord, I am certain of the dharma, Sutra and Tantra, and presently I am unbiased by desire or aversion.
yul gang du bsdad kyang skyid par gda'/ / tshe 'dir ltas kyi bde ba'i mgo bskor dang / / gtam snyan gyi phye 'thor ma blangs shing / / dbang thang la smon sems ma byas pas/ /
Thus, wherever I stay I’ll be happy. I’m not fooled by the delights of this life’s sights, nor taken by the pleasant-sounding flattery. I don’t harbor aspirations for power and influence.

dus nam yang blo sems bde mor byung / / phyi chos su brdzus pa'i 'jig rten dang / / ngan khong du bzung ba'i ngag snyan dang / / phug rang 'dod kha rgyal gyi gzhan don phyed/ / don 'di gsum spangs pas chos su song / /

Thus, my mind will be at ease at all times. Outwardly, a mundane impersonator of a religious person, inwardly, holding evil within while speaking pleasant words, ultimately, helping others for winning personal desires— I renounced these three intentions and turned to the dharma.

tshul 'di yang dpal ldan bla ma'i drin/ / da dung yang (540) gsol ba 'debs lags pas/ / byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ / rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ / deng phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du/ / bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog / ces so/ /

This approach was also due to the glorious guru’s kindness. Once again I supplicate you well: {540} please grant your blessings, compassionate one. Lord, by your blessings of compassion may there be abundant auspiciousness in all places, times, and situations.
dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos kyi lam rim dang 'brel ba'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba ni/ /
The song “Essence of Elixir” is based on the oral instructions relating to the progressive path of the Glorious Shangpa’s Golden Dharmas:
na mo gu ra be/
namo guruve
dbyings skye ba med pa'i nam mkha' la/ / gdangs 'gags pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ / thugs rje'i 'od brgya 'gyed pa yi/ / pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /
In the unborn sky of basic space, mandalas of unhindered radiance abound with a hundred lights of compassion— I bow to Vajradhara, my father guru.
rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i char sprin las/ / chos gdams ngag gi char rgyun phab pa de/ / mi kho bo'i sems kyi zhing sar babs/ / 'bras bu nyams rtogs kyi lo tog rgyas/ /
From the rainclouds of your compassion falls a steady rain of dharma instructions. It falls on the field of this one’s mind, producing the fruit of experiential realization.
khyed skal ldan yod na 'di las long / / dpal rdo rje 'chang chen skad pa des/ / rgyud mtha' yas gsungs pa'i snying po lnga/ / zab dgu bsdus pa'i nye lam zhig/ / ming ni gu chos drug zhes bya ba/ /

If you [disciples] are lucky, you’ll take this from me. That one called Glorious Great Vajradhara [taught] infinite tantras, with five essential ones. A direct path that encompasses many profundities is called the Six Dharmas of Niguma.
ma mkha' 'gro kun gyi gsang tshig de/ / nges gsang bdud rtsi'i snying po de/ / pha bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi de/ /
The secret words of all mother ḍākinīs, the definitive secret, essence of elixir, is elixir from the mouth of my father guru.

dus de ring rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ / phyogs med kyi ldum dur spyod pa zhig / nges med kyi tshul la spyod bzhin du/ / gnas ri gong dpal gyi gzhal yas 'dir/ / don snying po rdo rje'i glu ru len/ /
Today, this wandering yogin, whose conduct is aimless begging while behaving in indefinite ways, will sing a vajra song of essential meaning in this glorious citadel of Rigong.
gnas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo las/ / brda skye med mtshon pa a yi brda/ / 'phrul bdud rtsi 'bab pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ / nyams sdig sgrib dag pa'i nges shes can/ /

In the chakra of great bliss in the head, the symbol A signifies the unborn, emanating a stream of elixir; the vital point of visualization that ensures our faults, sins, and obscurations are purified.

ming yang dag byed stong ra zer/ / 'di sngon 'gro la gnad du che ba zhig gda'/ / rten rdo rje'i lus la rtsa thig gi 'gros/ / gzhi gnad du che ba 'khor lo bzhi/ / 'phral 'bar 'dzag rang lus dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ / 'di rgyud sde'i nges gsang gnad du che/ /
rkyen thabs dang shes rab 'dzom pa las/ / gzhi rang (541) sems gnyug mar ngo sprod pa/ / rten thig le dbab ldog dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ / de yin ni las kyi gtum mo yin/ /
zer ni gzhan lus kyi gdams pa zer/ / 'dod yon lam 'khyer la gnad du che/ / mi kho bos bde stong dbyer med du bsgoms/ / khyed 'dir 'dus kyang bde stong dbyer med sgrubs/ /

That is to say, instructions on another’s body, the vitally important integration of sense pleasures. I myself meditated on bliss and emptiness inseparable. You, assembled here, should practice bliss-emptiness inseparable.
tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod na/ / lam gzhan la med do skal ldan kun/ / bde drod rang 'bar gcig mdzad de 'tshal/ /
If you want to reach awakening in one lifetime, there is no other way, fortunate ones. Try to practice this innate blazing of bliss and heat.
phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i lam khyer de/ / lus byas kyang sems kyi rang snang tsam/ / rang snang lha sku rang shar la/ / sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa zhig /

Outward appearance is integrated on the path of illusion, a body is produced but is just the mind’s own appearance. The self-arising self-appearance of the deity’s form is like an illusion, without intrinsic nature.
sgyu lus kyi gdams pa'i snying po'i don/ / mi ngas kyang 'di la nyams len byas/ / chags sdang gi snang ba rang sar dag / a 'thas sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig /
This is the essence of Illusory Body instruction. I myself also practiced this. Appearances of attraction and aversion were purified in place. The coiled snake of reification was released.
khyed 'dir 'dus kyang a 'thas bshig pa gcig 'tshal/ / 'phral 'dun pa sgyur ba'i gnad ka las/ / rig pa'i rang rtsal phyogs med kyi gdangs/ /
You, assembled here, should seek the release of reification. Now, vital points of intentionality and transformation bring the self-energy of awareness, impartial radiance.
dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba 'grol ba la/ / nges med du sbyong ba gnad du che/ / ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag zer/ / sgyu lus pa rnams la mkho ba lags/ /

To liberate the bonds of fixating on the reality of things, it is vitally important to train in unfixed ways. The designated name is instruction on Dream. It is required for those who practice Illusory Body.
gzhi gdod ma'i rang zhal lta ba dang / / rkyen mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag dang / / gnad rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las/ / sems rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od gsal che/ /
dus nyin par rtsol ba bskyed bskyed nas/ / mtshan mo rang shar gyi gsal snang can/ / gsal tsam nyid nas stong par shar/ / gsal stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal zer/ /

In time, generating effort repeatedly in the day brings nighttime’s self-arising lucid appearances. Emptiness arises from mere clarity itself. This is called lucid clarity of clarity-emptiness inseparable.
zhu bde dang gnyug ma 'dres pa las/ / nyams bde tsam nyid nas rang dag cig / bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal yin/ /
By blending the bliss of melting with the native state, the experience of mere bliss itself is self-purified. This is the lucid clarity of bliss-emptiness inseparable.

sems rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa la/ / sgrib gnyis brdzun gyi stong zob yal/ / dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal yin/ / 'od gsal lam (542) gyi 'bras bu de/ / rje rdo rje 'chang chen gyi spyan snga ru/ / gdams ngag rnams phu thag chod par zhus/ /

In the mind’s nature, which is pure since forever, the false empty effigy of two obscurations vanishes. This is the lucid clarity of having two purities. {542} Regarding that result of the path of Lucid Clarity, in the presence of my lord Great Vajradhara I requested instructions, leaving no room for doubt.
zhus pa tsam la yang ma bzhag par/ / rang sems dang 'dres pa'i nyams len byas/ / ban bun nyams kyi 'char sgo dag / 'gyur med rtogs pa'i gtan yul zin/ /
And I didn’t leave it as a mere request— I practiced blending them with my own mind. Impressions of hazy experiences were purified and I gained a lasting place of unchanging realization.
khyed 'dir 'dus kyang 'od gsal rtse gcig tu sgoms/ / ngo mtshar rlung sems 'phrul gyi gnad/ / sems rtse gcig gyen du 'phang ba dang / / cir snang la bar do'i 'dun pa sbyongs/ /

You, assembled here, should meditate single-mindedly on lucid clarity. The vital point of amazing wind-mind’s magic is to shoot the focused mind upward and train with intentionality of the intermediate state, whatever appears.
gang shar la dag snang lam khyer bya/ / 'pho ba dang bar do'i gdams ngag zer/ / las dang po pa la gnad du che/ / sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang ngo la/ / gang shar rjen cher gyi ngang la zhog /

Integrate on the path whatever arises as pure perception. Called instructions of Transference and Intermediate State; they are vitally important for beginners. In the face of the native state of uncontrived mind, rest within the vast naked state of whatever arises.
sgo gsum ma bcos so ma'i ngang / / rang babs lhug pa'i gdams pa zer/ / sal le dang sing nge'i ngang du sgoms/ / lhod de dang shigs se'i rgya yan gyi dang / /
The state with the three doors fresh and uncontrived is called instructions on relaxed, Naturally Settled State. Meditate in a state of purity and brilliance; a relaxed, loose, and open state.
sems gang shar ngo shes kyi rnal 'byor pa/ / shar tsam nyid nas rang sar grol/ / ming yang rang grol gyi gdams ngag zer/ /
For a yogin who recognizes whatever arises as mind, it is liberated on its own ground as soon as it arises. By name, this is called instruction of Self-Liberation.
gsal ba dang stong pa zung 'jug gsum/ / sems gnas sam 'gyu'am ci ltar rung / / gdod nas rang gnas kyi ngo shes la/ / sku gsum rang shar gyi gdams ngag zer/ /
Clarity, emptiness, and their integral unity, these three, whether mind abides or moves or whatever, is recognized as primordially indwelling. This is called instruction of Self-Arising Three Kāyas.
'gyu ba 'gyu stong gi ngang du thim/ / mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams zhig nas thal/ / mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen rgya can mang lags shing / / gdams ngag kyi bdag po mang mod kyang / /

Movement dissolves within emptiness of movement. The line between equipoise and postmeditation collapses. Many possess vast knowledge of Sutra and Tantra, and certainly there are many masters of instruction.
don 'di las med ces bya ba nyung / / rang grol phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor 'di/ / mdo rgyud kyi snying por lags par 'khums/ / mi kho bos de ltar nyams su blangs/ /
But few admit “there is no other significance than this.” This yoga of Naturally Free Mahāmudrā I know is definitely the heart of Sutra and Tantra. I also brought it into experience in that way.
khyed 'dir 'dus kyang de ltar nyams len mdzod/ / rang shar phyogs med kyi dag snang gcig / gang snang mos gus kyi lam khyer la/ / mos gus kyi rtsa ba bla mar shar/ /
You, assembled here, should also practice like that. The self-arising is one with impartial pure perception. In integrating devotion with whatever appears, the root of devotion arises as the guru.
bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi dang / / (543) yi dam de sgyu mar rang shar gcig / rang shar ma bcos lhug pa'i gdangs/ / yin ni dag snang phyogs med kyi khrid/ /
zer ni lam 'khyer rnam gsum zer/ / mi kho bos kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs/ / khyed 'dir 'dus kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyongs/ / thabs 'gags med kyi gnad de dag snang la gda'/ /

This is called the Three Integrations on the Path. I trained in impartial pure perception. You, assembled here, should also train in impartial pure perception. The vital point of unceasing method is pure perception.
sems gsal stong lha sku'i snang cha dang / / rang rig pa 'gyur med bde ba'i ngang / / de dang po nyid nas skye ba med/ / gang ma skyes pa la 'gag pa med/ /
Mind’s clarity-emptiness appearing as the deity’s form and intrinsic awareness within the state of unchanging bliss were never born in the first place. What is not born cannot cease.
sems skye 'chi med pa'i rang bzhin de/ / 'phral drin can gyi bla mas ngo sprod pa/ / ming yang rang sems 'chi med zer/ / bskyed rdzogs snying por dril ba gcig na gda'/ /
The unborn, undying intrinsic nature of mind is introduced at present by the kind guru. By name, this is called One’s Own Mind as Immortal. It is the heart of creation and completion rolled into one.

rlung dang rnam rtog sems gsum pho/ / dbyings su bsdoms pa nyams len gyi gnad/ / 'khrul 'khor gyi kha bsgyur nyams len gyi rtsal/ / gzhan lus la thogs pa med pa yi/ / thig le 'dzag med kyi rang grol las/ / dga' bzhi dbyings su ngo sprod pa/ /

The vital point of practice is to bind in basic space these three: vital winds, thought, and mind. Mastery of yogic exercises brings energy to practice. Introduction of the four ecstasies in basic space comes from the self-liberation of retaining vital drops in the unobstructed practice based on another’s body.

ming ni rang lus 'chi med zer/ / rlung sems rang dbang du chub cig rnal 'byor pa/ / 'phral phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgrub pa'i gnad/ / pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / myur mdzad ye shes mgon po gnyis/ /

By name, this is called One’s Own Body as Immortal. Yogin, get control of your vital winds and mind! The vital point of accomplishing the four activities is both the benevolent root guru and Swift-Acting Awareness Protector.
mtshan tha dad don la khyad par med/ / mos gus nyag gcig gi rnal 'byor las/ / dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi klong brdol nas/ / 'gro don lhun grub tu 'char ba lags/ /
With different names, they are not really different. The yoga practice of this unique devotion causes an upsurge of the two spiritual powers that surely arises spontaneously to benefit beings.
dbyangs mchod pa 'bul lo mtshan ldan rje/ / dpal rdo rje 'chang chen nas brtsams te/ / pha rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ / nyams dbyangs kyi glu 'di mchod pa 'bul/ /
I offer this melody to the authentic master. I offer this melodious song of experience to all the gurus from Glorious Great Vajradhara through to my father root guru.
khyed 'dir 'dus kyi skal ldan pho mo la/ / nges gsang bdud rtsi'i ro mchog 'di/ / dga' ston gyi tshul du byin pa lags/ /
To you, fortunate women and men assembled here, I give a sublime taste of this secret elixir in the fine fashion of a celebration.

bdag phyogs ris med pa'i rgyal khams pa/ / ro snyoms kyi (544) rnal 'byor gu yangs bor/ / chos brgyad kyi dgra mkhar zhig pa zhig / gnyug ma'i gtan sa zin pa gzhig / dngos kun gyi rang zhal lta ba po/ /

I, a wanderer without direction or bias, am a carefree yogin of equal tastes, {544} a destroyer of the enemy fort of eight concerns, a resident of the safe place of the native state, and a seer of the actual face of all things.

chos tha snyad tshig la ma rmongs kyang / / mkhas 'dod kyi bzang 'dzin dbyings su grol/ / 'phral lus sems tha mal du snang ba tsam/ / drin can gyi mkhan pos gnang ba'i ming / / kun dga' snying po zhes bya yin/ /

Though not ignorant of religious terminology, my wish for excellence in erudition was lost in space. Now, with just the appearance of ordinary body-mind, the name given by my kind preceptor was Kunga Nyingpo.[61]

rang sems kyi rang bzhin ngo sprod pa/ / mi sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i bka' drin can/ / pha bla mas bka' drin stsal ba ni/ / ming tA ra nA tha zhes bya yin/ / deng snying gtam gyi tshul du smras pa yin/ /
The one who introduced the nature of my mind, the kind one who sends people to buddhahood, my benevolent father guru bestowed the name Tāranātha.[62] Today I have spoken this heartfelt advice.
ces pa'ang rang lo nyer lnga pa la ri gong dpal gyi mgon po'i gnas rang byung mgon po'i drung du tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tshe glur blangs pa / /
I composed this song at the age of twenty-five during a communal feast held in the presence of a self-occurring [statue of] the Protector at the sacred site of Glorious Protector in Rigong. ithi
rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mchog gi grub pa mngon tu gyur nas shugs 'byung gi spyod pas 'gro ba tshad med pa 'dul ba'i tshe rtags bdun bkra shis kyi rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs gsungs pa ni/ /

The all-knowing Venerable [Tāranātha] actualized the supreme accomplishment and its spontaneously arising conduct with which he tamed innumerable migrators. At that time, he presented this melody of the vajra song of seven auspicious signs:
na mo gu ru/
namo guru
bde chen chos sku'i rang nyams las/ / phyogs med kyi thugs rje'i 'gro don shar/ / pha rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la 'dud/ / bdag 'dir tshogs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /
Impartial altruistic compassion arises from great bliss, the natural experience of dharmakāya. I bow at the feet of father Vajradhara; please bless my assembly here.
gzhan don phyogs med du 'phel ba 'di/ / sems stong nyid snying rjer shar ba'i rtags/ / gnas lugs kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa 'di/ / mos gus tshad du phyin pa'i rtags/ /
This growth of impartial altruism is a sign of mind arising as emptiness and compassion. This recognition of the abiding nature is a sign of the full expression of devotion.
nam yang yengs pa med pa 'di/ / rtsa bral gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ / rnam rtog gi skye thag chod pa 'di/ / rtog med kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ /
This lack of distraction at any time is a sign of realizing rootless abiding nature. This resolution of arising thoughts is a sign of realizing the nature of nonthought.
bde stong gi nyams myong rgyun chad med/ / rtsa thig rlung gsum dul ba'i rtags/ / spyod pa gza' gtad dang bral ba 'di/ / chos brgyad kyi rlung dmar zhi ba'i rtags/ /
Continuous felt experiences of bliss-emptiness are signs of controlling channels, drops, and winds. This conduct free of reference points is a sign of calming the gale of eight concerns.
thob 'dod kyi re dogs zhig pa 'di/ / rang sems sangs rgyas su (545) nges pa'i rtags/ / rtags 'di bdun tshang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ / sems bde zhing skyid pa'i rang so zin/ /
This destruction of hopes and fears for attainment is a sign of the certainty that my mind is Buddha. {545} The yogin with all these seven signs has achieved an innately blissful, happy mind.
blo mi bde mi gda' bde mor gda'/ / slar bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog / ces gsungs so/ /
I am not unhappy; I’m just fine! May there be auspiciousness of happiness and well-being.
Lochen Gyurme Dechen[63]
grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i dbon lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyi gsung mgur chos drug gi gsol 'debs bde chen char 'bebs zhes bya ba/
This song called “Rainfall of Great Bliss” is a supplication to the Six Dharmas by Lochen Gyurme Dechen, the nephew of the great adept Tangtong Gyalpo:
na maHshrI dz+nyA na DA ki ni gup+dA yai/ /
namaḥ śrījñāna ḍāki niguptāyai
[Homage to the glorious Awareness Ḍākinī, definitely secret mother.][64]
mkha' spyod kyi gtso mo thugs rje can/ / ye shes kyi gtso mo ni gu ma/ / bu gdung bas gsol ba 'di 'debs na/ / spros bral gyi dbyings nas dgongs su gsol/ /
Compassionate Queen of the Celestial Realm, Lady of Timeless Awareness, Niguma, when your child supplicates with longing, please think of me from unembellished space.
gsang chen gyi dkyil 'khor ston mkhas mas/ / dga' bzhi yi dbang bskur da stsol cig / skye med kyi sgo mo 'byed mkhas mas/ / dag byed kyis sdig sgrib da sbyongs shig /

Wise woman who reveals the mandala of great mystery, bestow now the empowerment of four ecstasies. Wise woman who opens the door to the unborn, refine now negativities and obscurations through purifying practice.
a shad kyi gtum mo spro mkhas mas/ / snyigs ma yi phung khams da sregs shig / haM yig gi bde chen 'jo mkhas mas/ / lhan skyes kyi ye shes da stsol cig /
Wise woman who radiates the inner heat of the A-stroke, burn now my residual aggregates and elements. Wise woman who milks great bliss from haṃ, grant now the timeless awareness of coemergence.
sgyu ma yi rang nyams ston mkhas mas/ / chags sdang gi bden 'dzin da shigs cig / rmi lam gyi dus na sprul bsgyur mas/ / nying 'khrul gyi 'ching ba da chod cig /

Wise woman who shows the natural experience of illusion, destroy now my fixation on the reality of desire and anger. Emanating-changing woman at the time of dream, sever now the bonds of this double delusion.
lhun grub kyi 'od gsal 'char mdzad mas/ / gti mug gi mun pa da sol cig / 'da' ka yi dus su yang 'dren mas/ / mkha' spyod kyi gnas su da khrid cig /
Illuminating woman who raises spontaneous lucid clarity, dispel now the darkness of my stupidity. Guiding woman at the time of passing, lead me now to the place of the celestial realm.
bar do yi 'khrul snang 'joms mdzad mas/ / gzhom med kyi longs sku da stsol cig / ces chos smra ba 'gyur med bde chen gyi gsol ba btab pa'o/ ! /
Vanquishing woman of intermediate state deluded appearances, grant now the invincible saṃbhogakāya. This was the supplication of the dharma teacher Gyurme Dechen.
Losal Tenkyong[65]

rdo rje btsun mos rjes su bzung ba nyams rtogs mkhyen rab kyi rtsa kha bye ba zhwa lu pa rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong gi gsung mgur phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i dran tho'i nyams glu yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ /

Nurtured by the Vajra Queen, his channels of experiential realization and highest knowledge were opened. From the songs of Rinchen Losal Tenkyong of Zhalu, this song of experience is a reminder to himself concerning the Amulet Mahāmudrā, called “The Wish-Fulfilling Gem”: {546}
ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo (546) ni gu ma'i/ / thugs bdud rtsi'i yang zhun tA la'i 'dab/ / tshig yi ger btab nas gwa'ur bcug / rje khyung po'i mgul la mdzes so skad/ /
The refined elixir of the heart of Niguma, chief of the mother ḍākinīs, was inscribed on palm leaves and placed in an amulet called “Lord Khyungpo’s beautiful necklace.”
mgon de dang dbyer med chos kyi rje/ / pha mthu stobs zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ / chos phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i/ / khrid dmigs rim thob pa'i dran tho brjod/ /

Through the kindness of my spiritual father Tutop,[66] the dharma lord inseparable from that protector, I received the guidance in the visualization process of Amulet Mahāmudrā, here expressed as a reminder.
lam sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum dang / / don dngos gzhi skyon tshogs bzhi las grol/ / mthar sku bzhi'i rang zhal lhun grub pa/ / de lam bzang 'di yi khyad chos nyid/ /

The preliminary path of Three Naturally Settled States, the main practice of Liberation from Four Faults, and the final spontaneous presence of the four kāyas are the special features of this excellent path.

a ho/ / ma bcos 'phro bcad dang zhe bcang sgrim zhing glod/ / mtho dman nye ring dang chos spyod sngags dang sgra/ / spyod lam nges med zhi gnas sems 'dzin yin/ / ngo bo skye 'gags dang yul snang rnam rtog 'tshol/ /

Aho! Calm abiding is captured by being (1) uncontrived; (2) thoughts stopped; (3) resolute; (4) tight and relaxed; [by gazing] (5) high, low; (6) near; and (7) far; [and blending] (8) dharma activities; (9) mantras; (10) sounds; (11) and indefinite activities. [Insight is] searching for (1) the essence; (2) beginning and end; (3) objective appearance; and (4) thought.

de gnyis yod med kyi khyad tshol gnyis re drug / rang bzhin chos dbyings su sems thag bcad da bdun/ / lhag mthong ngo sprad de tsit+ta'i dkyil du zhog / rang bab rnam gsum la sgom tshul bco brgyad yod/ /

Then for each, searching for the difference between existence and nonexistence—that’s [five (5) and] six (6). Gaining certainty in the natural realm of phenomena is seven (7). Place that introduction to higher insight in your heart’s mandala. Those are eighteen ways to meditate on Three Naturally Settled States.[67]
kye ho/ / nye drags nas de ko ngo ma shes/ / zab drag nas de nyid ngos ma zin/ / sla drags nas de la yid ma ches/ / bzad drag nas de blor ma shong 'dug /
Kyeho! Too close—you don’t recognize it. Too profound—you don’t grasp it. Too easy—you don’t believe it. Too excellent—you don’t comprehend it.
da chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum/ / sems gsal stong zung 'jug sbubs nas thon/ / de dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ / rang rig stong sems kyi rtsal du rdzogs/ /

Now, dharmakāya, saṃbhogakāya, and nirmāṇakāya emerge from mind’s matrix of clarity, emptiness, and their unity. Their inseparability is the svabhāvakāya, complete in intrinsic empty awareness, mind’s energy.
mdangs mos gus snying rje thabs dang gsum/ / thabs rlung dang bskyed rim grung 'jug bsre/ / bogs rgyangs kyis thon pa'i lag cha yin/ / gegs byung na sel thabs gnyis bo shog /

The radiance is devotion, compassion, and methods, these three. The method that blends winds and creation phase as unity is a device produced by enhancement and holding winds. If obstructions occur, apply the two methods to remove them.

pha bla ma'i man ngag yid bzhin nor/ / sems brjed ngas rkun pos 'phrog dogs nas/ / dpal zhwa lu ri phug yang dben du/ / ban blo gsal bstan skyong zhes pas smras/ / phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i dran tho'i nyams glu'o/ ! /

The wish-fulfilling gem of my father guru’s instructions was in danger of being stolen by the thief of my forgetful mind. So in the secluded cave of glorious Zhalu, the Buddhist monk called Losal Tenkyong composed this. This was the experiential song of remembering Amulet Mahāmudrā. {547}
Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo

rtsod dus shin (547) tu snyigs ma'i skabs su u dum+ba ra ltar dkon la don che ba ngo mtshar sprul pa'i skyes mchog bka' babs bdun gyi mnga' bdag 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung bas gangs can gyi khor yug na yongs su grags pa'i mtshan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i dgongs klong ye shes kyi gter mdzod nas shugs 'byung du brdol ba'i rdo rje'i glu zab cing rgya che ba las skabs su babs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug brtson 'grus bzang po'i nang gi rnam par thar pa la bsngags pa'i rdo rje'i thol glu rig pa 'dzin pa'i me tog ces bya ba/

In the age of conflict, during extreme degeneration, there is one supreme wondrous emanation as significant and rare as an uḍumbara flower. Master of the seven transmissions (bka’ babs bdun), Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo and his unrivaled life of freedom is so wonderful that his name is known throughout the surrounding Land of Snows. Profound and vast vajra songs well up spontaneously from the treasury of the timeless awareness of his intentions. The spontaneous vajra song in praise of the inner spiritual biography of the mighty adept Tsöndru Zangpo, called “Flower of the Awareness Holders,” is presented for this occasion:[68]
a ho/ srid gsum dus gcig za ba'i tsaN+DA lir/ / haM yig bdud rtsi'i bgo bshar sbyin pa yis/ / 'bar 'dzag dbu mar thim pa'i ye shes sku/ / bde stong gtum mo'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

Aho! In caṇḍālī that consumes the three existences all at once, the generosity[69] of spreading elixir from the syllable haṃ blazes and drips, dissolves into the central channel, the awareness body. I bow to the transcendent perfection of Fierce Inner Heat’s empty bliss.
dkar dmar thig le'i 'bros 'ded la goms pas/ / 'pho med dga' bas tshims pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ / nying 'khrul rang sar dag pa'i nA da'i gsung / / gsal stong rmi lam pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

Familiarity with the flight and chase of white and red vital drops creates ethical conduct of satisfaction with the changeless ecstasies, which is the awakened speech of the nāda of self-purifying double delusion. I bow to the transcendent perfection of Dream’s empty clarity.
rab zhi skye med bdud rtsi'i rlabs 'thungs pas/ / zab mo'i don la bzod pa'i pad+mo ni/ / zla bral mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i thugs/ / rig stong 'od gsal pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

Through drinking the elixir waves of unborn total tranquility, the lotus of patience with the profound meaning is unrivaled beauty, the perfect vajra awakened mind. I bow to the transcendent perfection of Lucid Clarity’s empty awareness.
chos kun bden med goms pa'i blo gros dang / / gcig tu 'dza' ba'i brtson 'grus brtsoms pa yis/ / nye 'khon las 'das lhun grub yon tan dbyings/ / snang stong sgyu lus pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

The intelligence of familiarity with phenomena’s lack of reality accompanied closely by the application of diligence[70] is the delight[71] of spontaneous qualities beyond near and distant. I bow to the transcendent perfection of Illusory Body’s empty appearance.
don dam 'gro 'ong sred len ma mchis kyang / / kun rdzob srog rtsol sbyor ba'i bsam gtan gyis/ / 'phyugs med mkha' spyod grub pa'i phrin las can/ / tshor stong 'pho ba'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

Ultimately there is no going or coming, craving or grasping, but relatively the meditation of applied breath control is the awakened activity of achieving the unerring celestial realm. I bow to the transcendent perfection of Transference’s empty sensation.
bar srid 'khrul pa'i snang cha ji snyed kun/ / lha sngags chos skur rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ / zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs skur ldang nus pa'i/ / myong stong bar do'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

However much delusion appears in the intermediate existence, the wisdom that realizes deity and mantra as dharmakāya is able to raise all of it as the saṃbhogakāya of unity. I bow to the transcendent perfection of Intermediate State’s empty experience. {548}
mdor na nges (548) don pha rol phyin drug dang / / dbyer med rdo rje'i chos drug la goms pas/ / sku gsung thugs yon phrin las mi zad pa/ / rtag pa dam pa'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /

In short, the definitive meaning of the six transcendent perfections is inseparable from the Six Vajra Dharmas; familiarity breeds inexhaustible awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. I bow to the transcendent perfection of sublime permanence.
de ltar gus pa'i nyi gzhon bcud g.yo bas/ / rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i tshig sbyor ut+pa la/ / 'dzum bcas rol 'dis mgon po khyod nyid dang / / dbyer med grub pa'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog /

The moving warmth of the rising sun of my devotion opens the utpala of words that please the awareness holders. May this smiling display achieve a free life of accomplishment inseparable from yours, my lord protector.

zhes bsil ljong grub rigs rgya mtsho'i khyu mchog pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul thang stong pa'i nang gi rnam par thar pa la ye shes kyi DA k+ki ni gu mas bkral ba'i rdo rje'i chos drug gi sgo nas bsngags pa'i slu dbyangs 'di'ang rje de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas shrI dza la sarba ta'i lcags zam dang nye ba'i gnas lo ha'i ta'i phung po dal gyis 'babs pa rkang 'thung gi lang tshos bkra ba'i gzings kyi 'khrul 'khor la brten nas brgal ba'i lam bar kho na bris te gsol ba btab pa'o/ / zab don bsdus pa'i rdo rje'i thol glu nges don them skas zhes bya ba/ /

This song of praise to the foremost of innumerable adepts in the cool region, an emanation of Padma[sambhava], Tangtong [Gyalpo], is a eulogy of his inner spiritual biography in terms of the Six Vajra Dharmas elucidated by Awareness Ḍākinī Niguma. I composed this while praying solely at the sacred site blessed by the lord himself, near the iron bridge of Śrījala Parvata,[72] while crossing the gently flowing Lohita River[73] confluence in the mechanism of a boat decorated with young foot-drinking (i.e., fresh wooden) carvings. “A Spontaneous Vajra Song That Condenses the Profound Meaning, the Ladder of Definitive Meaning”:[74]
e ma ho/ gzung 'dzin las 'das gdod ma'i de bzhin nyid/ / spros pa kun bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis/ / 'gyur med bde ba chen pos rab 'khyud pa'i/ / rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan snying gar rol/ /

Emaho! Primordial suchness beyond subject-object dualism is the innate character of unembellished lucid clarity. Fully enfolded by unchanging great bliss, the supreme of all aspects dances in my heart.
sbas don gsang ba'i de nyid ston pa yi/ / grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ / rab mthong min kyang gang shar rdo rje'i glus/ / zab mo dga' ba'i chu rgyun deng 'dir 'bebs/ /

The secret suchness of the hidden meaning is revealed in the potency of accomplished awareness-holders’ intent. I have not fully seen it, but this vajra song of whatever occurs is falling here and now in streams of profound joy.
rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs nges pa'i don/ / kun tu rtogs nas gnad du bsnun pa yis/ / bde stong ye shes skye bar rab gzigs nas/ / thabs lam zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan/ /

They fully realized and emphasized the vital points of the definitive meaning of the vajra body’s abiding nature. [They] saw the birth of timeless awareness of bliss-emptiness and taught the completion phases of the profound path of methods.
de la bkod pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung / / thig le byang chub sems mchog rnam pa gsum/ / chags gnas 'jigs gsum mdzad pa rdzogs pa'i gar/ / rang bzhin ye shes chen po'i rten du gnas/ / (549)

There is a framework of channels, the movement of winds, and the supreme bodhicitta of vital drops—these three— enacting creation, abiding, and destruction; the dance of completion. [These three] remain as the support for natural great awareness. {549}

rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi ldan pa'i/ / mdud pa kun ni thabs shes ma ning gi / yi ge gsum dang srog rtsol mnyam pa'i rlung / / de bzhin bde stong 'khril sbyor thig le ste/ / gsum tshan rim pas bde gsal mi rtog kyi/ / chos nyid bskyed dang sku gsum rten 'brel 'grub/ /

The three channels with their four chakras and all their knots; the three letters of method, wisdom, and neuter; the vital winds of vitality, [vitality-] exertion, and [fire-] coinciding, and the vital drops of emptiness, bliss, and union— this sequence of sets of three generates the natures of bliss, emptiness, and nonthought, and establishes the links for the three kāyas.
rdo rje'i chos dang ldan pa rtsa yi lam/ / gcud cing 'khrul 'khor bya ba rtsa yi gnad/ / srog rtsol bum par bskyil ba rlung gi lam/ / sbyor ba bzhi ldan rlung gi gnad mchog yin/ /
a haM zhu bde'i 'bros 'ded thig le'i lam/ / 'khor lo bzhi ru bcings pa thig le'i gnad/ / snang stong lha skur lta ba sgyu lus lam/ / zhen med sprul par ldang ba sgyu lus gnad/ /
nyal khar 'dun pas gcun pa rmi lam lam/ / nyal slong skye med la gzhol rmi lam gnad/ / snod bcud dwangs mar bsdu pa 'od gsal lam/ / rlung sems mnyam par 'ching ba 'od gsal gnad/ /
chos nyid rnam gsum dran pa bar do'i lam/ / rtag tu 'khrul par blta ba bar do'i gnad/ / tshangs bug dwangs ma 'pho ba 'pho ba'i lam/ / rlung sems bsdu zhing bkag pa 'pho ba'i gnad/ /

de ltar rtsa ba yan lag rim pa yis/ / zab mo rdzogs pa'i don rnams bsdus pa ste/ / gzhan du rlung la gnad du bsnun pa yis/ / gsal ba'i nyams dang thig le bde ba nyid/ / 'thob byed so sor dbye bas rab tu bstan/ /

Thus the sequence of the roots and branches include the meanings of profound completion. Moreover, concentrating on the winds produces the experience of clarity and on vital drops, bliss itself. Those are distinguished by different results and taught accordingly.
mi rtog mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ / gdod nas ma skyes mkha' 'dra'i 'od gsal don/ / chos dang gang zag bdag gis ma bcings pa/ / stong pa nyid kyi mchog tu rnam par gnas/ /
Completion phase without characteristics and concepts means primordially unborn sky-like lucid clarity. Not bound by self-identity of persons or phenomena, it remains wholly within supreme emptiness.
de phyir phyag rgya chen po blo yul las/ / 'das pa'i yid la mi byed snying po'i don/ / rab kyi dam pas ngo sprod de ma thag / gcer mthong skyes nas rang bzhin ngang gis grol/ /

Therefore, mahāmudrā is beyond the intellect, the essential meaning of mental nonengagement. For the best,[76] as soon as a holy one introduces it, naked seeing is born and they are liberated in its nature.
gzhan dag myong ba gang skyes der bstun nas/ / (550) rlung sems thig le'i gnad kyis gcun pa yis/ / brten pa 'od gsal bsam mi khyab par 'char/ /

de skad du yang rje btsun te lo pas/ / blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na/ / rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud la bor/ / lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis/ / reg pa ngang la mi gansa bar du gcun/ /

In the words of Venerable Tilopa: People of lesser intellect who do not dwell in this actuality [should] hold the vital points of the winds and tighten awareness with many yogic gazes and concentrations. Persevere until you abide within intrinsic awareness.

dper ni nam mkha'i dkyil na brtag byas nas/ / mtha' dad dbus su 'dzin pa 'gags bar 'gyur/ / de bzhin sems kyis sems la brtag byas na/ / rnam rtog tshogs 'gags thog med gnas 'gyur nas/ / bla med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mthong / /

For example, when you examine the center of the sky, fixation on center and circumference ceases. Likewise, when you examine the mind with the mind, thought patterns cease and are transformed to openness, and you see mind’s intrinsic nature in unsurpassable awakening.[77]
zhes gsungs de phyir zab mo'i gsang lam gyi/ / thabs la brten nas gnad kyis gcun pa yis/ / brtson 'grus dag dang dbang po'i bgo skal las/ / dus gsum sgrol ba snying po'i don mchog go /

Therefore, as he said, the intense focus on the vital points, based on the methods of the profound secret path, is the supreme essential meaning that liberates in the three times according to your share of diligence and capability.
rig 'dzin DA k+ki'i zhal lung nges pa'i don/ / rang gi rgyud la myong ba ma skyes shing / / mos pas spyod pa'i gral mthar lhung gyur phyir/ / 'di ltar smra bar 'os min de lta na'ang / /

I have not personally experienced in my mind stream the definitive meaning of the Awareness Ḍākinī’s advice, and since I fall to the lowest rank of those who engage devotion alone, it is inappropriate for me to be saying these things at all.
gang shar rdo rje'i rol mor 'khrol ba la/ / nyes pa'i tshogs kun rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor la/ / mi 'chab mthol zhing dge tshogs gang mchis des/ / 'gro kun phyag rgya che la gnas par shog /
In playing the vajra music of whatever arose, I openly confess all faults before the Three Roots’ mandala and dedicate whatever virtue there is so that all beings may dwell in mahāmudrā.
grags stong rdo rje'i thol glu sgyu ma'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba/ /
“A Spontaneous Vajra Melody of Empty Sound, an Offering Cloud of Illusion”:[78]
a ho/ tshogs brgyad 'khrul pa zad pa yi/ / gzhi grol ka dag dpal gyi ri/ / 'od gsal sgyu mar rol pa'i gar/ / rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshom bur 'dud/ /

Aho! The delusion of eight consciousness groups falls away, freed on the glorious mountain of primordially pure basic ground. Lucid clarity is the playful dance of illusion: I bow to the circle of awareness-holding ḍākinīs.
yang grags stong glu yi mchod pa yis/ / dpa' bo DA ki dgyes phyir len/ / rtsa dag pa rab 'byams kyi mgrin pa nas/ / snang stong bskyed rim gyi glu blangs pas/ /

With an offering of this song of sound and emptiness, I will sing for the pleasure of heroes and ḍākinīs. From the throat of infinite pure channels came the song of creation phase of empty appearance.
kun brtag 'khrul pa'i phung khams tshogs/ / gdan gsum lha yi sku ru thim/ / (551) rlung dbu mar rol pa'i mgrin pa nas/ / gsal stong bzlas brjod kyi glu blangs pas/ /

My aggregates and constituents of deluded imaginary nature dissolved into the forms of the deities in the three seats. From the throat of winds playing in the central channel came the song of mantra recitation in empty clarity.
sgra tshig rang mtshan zhen pa kun/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i ngang du thim/ / thig le bde chen gyi mgrin pa nas/ / bde stong dga' bzhi yi glu blangs pas/ /

All attachment to self-characterized sounds and words dissolved within the space of scripture and reason. From the throat of great bliss of the vital drops came the song of the four ecstasies of empty bliss.
tha mal nyon mongs kyi 'ching ba kun/ / zung 'jug 'od gsal ngang du thim/ / rang rig brjod med kyi mgrin pa nas/ / ngang gzhag lhun 'byams kyi glu blangs pas/ /

All bonds of ordinary afflictive emotions dissolved within the integral unity of lucid clarity. From the throat of inexpressible reflective awareness came the song of settling in spontaneous vastness.
sna tshogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa kun/ / shar grol dus mnyam gyi ngang du thim/ / ka ti shel spug gi mgrin pa nas/ / 'ja' zer thig le yi glu blangs pas/ /
All concepts of various subject-object dualism dissolved within simultaneous arising and liberation. From the throat of the kati crystal channel came the song of drops of rainbow light.
phung khams gdos bcas kyi mtshan ma kun/ / chos zad blo 'das kyi ngang du thim/ / sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi mgrin pa nas/ / bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi glu blangs pas/ /

All marks of the corporeal aggregates and elements dissolved within the unthinkable exhaustion of phenomena. From the throat of the balanced three doors came the song of creation, completion, and great completion.
'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog tshogs kun/ / byar med 'bras bu'i klong du thim/ / chos dred skal dman gyi mgrin pa nas/ / sna tshogs grags stong gi glu blangs pas/ /
All concepts of the duality of samsara and nirvana dissolved within the expanse of the effortless result. From the throat of an unfortunate jaded practitioner came the song of various empty sounds.
byed snyam bsgrub 'dod kyi dam chos kun/ / le lo phyi bshol gyi ngang du thim/ / de nges don glu yi mchod pa yin/ / rang rgyud la skyo ba'i gdung dbyangs yin/ /
All ideas and desires to practice the Holy Dharma dissolved within lazy procrastination. This is my offering of the song of definitive meaning. It is a melody of searing disappointment with my mind.
dge ba des ma rtogs 'gro ba'i khams/ / rang rig gi ngo bor lhun grub shog / ces gsungs so/ /
By this virtue, may the nature of grandmother migrators be spontaneously present in the essence of intrinsic awareness.
Jamgön Kongtrul

tshad ma'i skyes bu rnams kyis rgyal bas lung bstan par bsngags pa 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung zab lam ni gu chos drug sogs dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos kyi rdo rje'i gnas nges pa'i mgrin glu ka la ping+ka'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /

Praised by all authoritative masters as one who was foretold by the Buddha, Jamgön Vajradhara Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso taught the vajra topics of the Glorious Shangpa’s Golden Dharmas, such as the profound path of Niguma’s Six Dharmas, with the voice of certainty in this “Melodious Song of the Kalaviṅka.”[79]

rdo rje 'chang chen nas brtsams te brgyud pa rin po che rnam bdun/ / mi min mi yi tshul bzung rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyi gser phreng / / sangs (552) rgyas rjen par stsol ba'i dpal ldan rtsa ba yi bla ma/ / zhabs kyi pad mor 'dud do nyams rtogs gong 'phel du mdzod cig /

e ma/ snying po'i lam 'dir kho bo skal pa ni bzang ldan/ / rdo rje 'chang gi zhal lung ye shes DA ki yi gsang tshig / grub thob brgyud pa'i nyams myong rtsa ba'i bla ma yi pha phogs/ / snying gi nor bur bcangs pas blo yi gtad so 'dra bdog go /

Ema! My fortune on this essential path is most excellent; Awareness Ḍākinī’s secret words of Vajradhara’s oral transmission, the experiences of the adept lineage, and my root guru’s legacy: all this I hold as the gem of my heart and the focus of my mind.

gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir chos rgyal lo paN gyi drin las/ / mdo sngags chos kyi rin chen kun la thang ma ru brdal yang / / grub thob bar ma chad cing myong rtags mngon sum du thon pa/ / mkhas grub khyung po'i gser chos yid bzhin nor bu las lhag go /

Through the kindness of dharma kings, translators, and scholars, the precious dharma of Sutra and Tantra spread widely in Tibet. Adepts appeared continuously, showing signs of experiential realization. The Golden Dharmas of the learned adept Khyungpo are better than a wish-fulfilling gem.

mthar thug rnam lnga ston mdzad su kha sid+d+hi dang ni gu/ / gsang ba'i lam mchog snang byed ye shes dkyil 'khor ni lnga ldan/ / bshad sgrub bka' srol 'dzin pa sar gnas byang sems kyi gdung brgyud/ / ma bsgrubs byin rlabs sgo 'char bsgrub na grub pa lta ci smros/ /

Sukhasiddhi and Niguma revealed the five culminating [tantras] in fivefold mandalas of awareness, illuminating the supreme secret path. Their system of teaching and practice is held by high-level descendants. Their blessings are accessible even without practice; what need to mention accomplishment through practice?

mkha' lding khyung chen zhes pa'i ming gi mngon brjod tsam kho nas/ / bya bran gzhan gyi gnas lugs ji mi snyam pa yi sems thob/ / khyung po'i gser chos zhes pa'i mtshan gyi gzi brjid kyi zil gyis/ / rang rtog yi ge ris la gus pa lhong po ru byed do/ /

Just the mention of the name “Great Garuḍa Soaring in Space” makes the mind quit pondering the state of other lesser birds. The brilliant splendor of the title “Khyungpo’s [i.e., Garuḍa’s] Golden Dharmas” slackens one’s interest in others’ writings about their own ideas.

kha nag yig nag sprad pa'i bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod ni bye bas/ / chos 'di yud tsam bsgom pa'i nyams myong rtags tshad la mi nye/ / rtog ga'i rig pa'i 'khor lo lo dang zla ba ru bskor yang / / don 'di nyams su blangs pa'i shes rab cha shas su mi phyin/ /

Reciting millions of mantras to accomplish practice from dark letters and dark mouths doesn’t come close to the signs of experience from just a little meditation in this dharma. Years and months of turning the wheel of theoretical dialectics doesn’t bring a fraction of the wisdom from practicing this subject.

deng gsang dus kyi dbang gis rtse gcig sgom dus mkhan dkon kyang / / yid gnyis the tshom med pa'i chos la nges shes ni chen pos/ / spang blang res 'jog med par rgyun gyi nyams len tsam 'bad na/ / ring min mchog dngos grub pa ye shes (553) mkha' 'gro yi tha tshig /

Due to the power of the times, those who can meditate with single focus are rare. Yet with great certainty in the dharma without hesitant doubt, and effort in steady practice alone without starting and stopping, supreme spiritual power won’t be far; that was the Awareness Ḍākinī’s final promise. {553}

sgrub la snying rus chung bas nyams rtogs rtsal kha ni ma rdzogs/ / col chung rnam par g.yeng bas drod tshad mngon sum 'dra dben kyang / / dkar po'i las kyi 'phro yis chos 'dir yid ches ni gdeng khel/ / snying dang srog ltar gces pa'i mos pa lhan skyes su 'dug go /

With meager fortitude for practice, the power of my experiential realization is incomplete. Totally distracted by silly prattle, I am bereft of any actual degree of meditative warmth. But through residual good karma I have trust and confidence in this dharma; I cherish it as my heart and life with a devotion that seems innate.

gser chos rin chen mdzod las rgyud chen sde lnga yi yang bcud/ / mtshan gyi grags pa gsal ldan rtsa ba ni gu yi chos drug / stan thog gcig gi steng du nyams rtogs myu gu ni 'khrungs pa/ / tshe lus gcig gi khongs su mchog gi 'bras ster 'di rmad do/ /

From the precious treasury of Golden Dharmas, the quintessence of the great Five Tantras is clarified by its title: the roots are the Six Dharmas of Niguma. A single sitting can germinate the sprout of experiential realization. This wonder produces the supreme fruits within one life in one body.

gdod nas skye med yig 'bru 'khor 'das chos kun gyi sgo mo/ / bde chen 'khor lor shar ba'i dag byed bdud rtsi yi khrus kyis/ / sdig sgrib nad gdon bkrus las stong gsal rjen pa yi nyams ldan/ / dag byed stong ra'i thabs 'di gnad du phyin pa yi sngon 'gro/ /

The primordially unborn seed syllable is the gate to all phenomena of samsara and nirvana. Arising in the great-bliss chakra, purifying elixir washes away negativities, obscurations, sickness, and spirits with an experience of naked empty clarity. This method, the Purifier of Empty Space, is the preliminary that strikes the vital point.

tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub na bde stong zung 'jug las gzhan pa'i/ / thabs lam yod pa ma yin de rgyu rang lus ni thabs ldan/ / rtsa rgod rlung rgod 'dul la gtum mo me rgod nyid myur bas/ / bdun phrag gsum gyi zhag nas ras skar bla gos kyis 'khyongs so/ /

To achieve buddhahood in a single lifetime, you [must realize] the integral unity of bliss and emptiness. There is no other way, and its cause is that “one’s own body is the means.”[80] To tame wild channels and wild winds, the Wildfire of Fierce Inner Heat is swift: after three weeks you can endure wearing a white cotton shawl [in the snow].

rten gzhi rdo rje'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i stong rar/ / sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i bum can tshad ldan tu khebs pas/ / a haM 'bar 'dzag 'phrul las skad cig dga' ba bzhis brgyan pa/ / thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar 'phags bod grub thob kyi snying nor/ /

In the basic support of the vajra body, the empty spaces of three channels and four chakras are held in the correct vase breath through fourfold breathing applications, causing the blazing and melting of A-haṃ, instantly adorned by the four ecstasies. This self-igniting bliss-heat in the Path of Methods is the heart jewel of Indian and Tibetan adepts.

gtum mo zas su zos pas bde stong gzhon sha ni chags la/ / gtum mo gos su gyon pas bde drod bzod med du 'bar ba/ / gdan bting rta ru zhon pas brtan cing gang 'dod du phyin pa/ / thun mong tsam dang mi mnyam bla med rgyud rgyal gyi dgongs pa/ /

Eating the Food of Inner Heat nurtures the youthfulness of bliss and emptiness. Wearing the Clothes of Inner Heat makes bliss-warmth blaze unbearably. Spreading the Seat and Riding the Horse are stabilizing, letting you go wherever you wish. This is the intention of the unsurpassable sovereign tantras that the mere common methods cannot equal.

mos gus bla ma'i lam las cir snang bden med du shar zhing / / snang stong (554) lha sku rang shar cir snang sgyu ma ru mthong ba/ / sgyu lus snying po yin kyang nyams 'og chud pa ni dkon 'dug / bla ma grub pa'i dbang pos thugs nyams mthil phyin tu myong song / /

The path of guru devotion causes the arising of all appearance as unreal. {554} Empty appearance arises by itself as the deity’s form, seen as illusion. This is the essence of Illusory Body, but those who take it into experience are rare. The guru, lord of adepts, has tasted the depths of the experience.

sad pa'i rkyen bzhi bral bas 'gro drug sgyu ma ru 'char byed/ / 'dun pa brgyad gsum sbrags shing nad gdon sgyu ma ltar shes pas/ / yon tan tshogs drug 'char zhing a 'thas sbrul mdud nyid bkrol ba/ / dang po'i las can rnams la snying gi bdud rtsi ru 'dug go /

Free of four conditions of wakefulness, Make the Six Kinds of Migrators Arise as Illusion. Apply eight intentions and three sets of three [methods] to understand sickness and spirits as illusion.[81] A sixfold set of qualities arise and the snake’s knot of reification uncoils. This is elixir of the heart for beginners.

nying 'khrul snang ba rang zin dbang bzhi thig le yi gdams ngag / ma zin 'chug med gnad dgus 'khrul pa thug phrad du bzung nas/ / sbyong spel sgyur ba'i gnad kyis rang rtsal phyogs med du sbyangs pas/ / yul snang gtan la pheb cing rmi lam rnam thar yang 'byongs te/ /

Instruction on the Vital Points of the Four Empowerments of Drops [causes] self-recognition of the appearances of [dream’s] double delusion. If not recognized, Nine Infallible Vital Points will let you recognize delusion when encountered. Then through the vital points of refining, increasing, and changing [dreams], their natural expression is trained impartially. In Ascertaining Objective Appearance, the freedom of dreams is further perfected.

rtsol med lha sku rang shar mthar thug 'od gsal du bstims las/ / nying 'khrul btsan thabs gcod pa'i gdams ngag zab dgu yi yang rtse/ / blun po ba lang rdzi yang sangs rgyas nyin rgyugs su btang 'dir/ / bla ma sangs rgyas drin las 'brel pa g.yar khral tsam bzhag go /

The effortless self-arising of the deity’s form ultimately dissolves into lucid clarity. This is the pinnacle of the many profound instructions to sever double delusion by force. Even simple cowherds can be transported to buddhahood here with just a minimal connection to Guru Buddha’s kindness.

mi rtag skyo shas spyod lam dam rdzas thabs lam dang gsol 'debs/ / rtsa ba yal ga lo ma me tog 'khri shing ni rgyas las/ / srab mthug 'od gsal 'bras bu bzung zhing sku gsum du khyer ste/ / gsal stong mnyam gzhag rjes thob nyin mtshan bde stong dag bsres pas/ /

Impermanence, disillusionment, conduct, sacred substances, the path of methods, and supplication form the root, branches, leaves, flowers, and vines that grow[82] to produce the light or dense lucid clarity, integrated as three kāyas. Blend clarity and emptiness, equipoise and postmeditation, day and night, bliss and emptiness.

gti mug gnyid kyi mun khang 'od gsal sgron me yis bcoms te/ / rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel khyad par bla ma yi byin gyis/ / bde gsal stong pa dbyer med zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od gsal/ / khor mo yug gi sbubs su gnyis snang bar lag 'dra 'gyes so/ /

Thus the lamp of Lucid Clarity vanquishes the darkness of stupid sleep. Through the connection of gathering wind-mind and the special blessing of the guru, bliss, clarity, and emptiness become inseparable in the lucid clarity of profound peace and simplicity, parting the seeming barrier of dualism in the recesses of the surroundings.

chos sku de bzhin nyid de longs sku zung 'jug gi yi dam/ / byin rlabs bla ma'i stobs dang 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi gong 'phos/ / dbang po'i rim dang mthun (555) par 'da' ka'i mtshams sbyor 'dra bgyid pa/ / da lta'i sngags spyod kun gyi bskyed rdzogs grub mtha' ni 'di'o/ /

Transfer Consciousness to the Suchness of Dharmakāya, to the saṃbhogakāya in Union with the Yidam, by the force of the Blessings of the Guru, and to the Unerring Celestial Realm above. Do this according to the level of capability at the moment of passing away. {555} Now this is the tenet of creation and completion practiced by all tantric practitioners.

'od gsal chos kyi sku dang rgyal ba longs spyod ni rdzogs pa/ / sprul sku 'gags med rang shar spyi gnad 'chug med dang bcas pas/ / bar do gsum las grol byed dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par/ / dal dus grabs su btsud pas brel dus sleb par ni 'gyur ro/ /

Lucid clarity in the Natural Arising of the Dharmakāya, the Victors’ Saṃbhogakāya, the Natural Arising of Unrestricted Nirmāṇakāya, and the General Unerring Vital Points all liberate in the three intermediate states according to the level of capability. By preparing when there’s still time, it will work when the time of death comes.

sngon 'gro rang bab gsum gyis zhi lhag ting 'dzin ni bskyed nas/ / dngos gzhi ngo sprod zab mos skyon bzhi rang grol du btang ste/ / rjes shes gsal stong zung 'jug sku gsum rang shar du shes pa/ / phyag rgya chen po'i lam 'di chos kyi sdong po nyid yin no/ /

The preliminary of Three Naturally Settled States gives rise to absorptions of calm abiding and higher insight. The main practice is introducing the profound Natural Liberation of Four Faults. The concluding realization is to know the unity of clarity and emptiness as the natural arising of the three kāyas. This path of mahāmudrā is the trunk of all these doctrines.

ye shes DA ki rnam gnyis mai tri gup+ta pa zhal lung / / bzo med rang bab ngo bo glang chen lta stangs dang 'grogs pas/ / ngos bzung kun dang bral ba'i tha mal shes pa ni so ma/ / sku gsum rjen par 'char bas sangs rgyas sbar bcangs su rnyed do/ /

In the oral instructions of the two awareness ḍākinīs and Maitrīpagupta, the unfabricated settled state in the essence, supported by the elephant’s gaze, induces the ordinary mind free of all identity, which is fresh and arises nakedly as three kāyas—buddhahood in the palm of your hand.

cir snang bla mar shes pa'i mos gus phyogs med ni dang po/ / snang grags lha sngags rang bzhin dag snang phyogs med ni gnyis pa/ / snang sems sgyu ma rmi lam bden med lam khyer ni gsum pa/ / yal gar mtshan tu gsol yang mdo sngags chos kun gyi snying po/ /

First is impartial devotion of knowing whatever arises as the guru. Second is impartial pure view of appearance and sound as the nature of deity and mantra. Third is the integration of appearance and mind as unreal illusion and dream. These three bear the title of the branches, but they are the core of all Sutra and Mantra.

zla ba li khri'i mdangs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ting 'dzin/ / khyad 'phags gsol 'debs shugs kyis snying rje'i chu rgyun ni bskul zhing / / 'khor lo bzhi yi mar mes chags grol bde stong la bslab pas/ / mkha' spyod me tog tshal du lhan skyes mdzes ma yis bsu'o/ /

The absorptions of [two forms of Khecarī] Vajrayoginī, in colors of the moon and vermilion, draw their streams of compassion through the power of specially elevated supplications. Once you train in the bliss and emptiness of liberated desire through the light in the four chakras, the beautiful coemergent goddesses greet you in the flower garden of the celestial realm.

rang sems skye ba med pas 'gags shing 'chi ba yang med la/ / lus nyid bem po'i rang bzhin 'chi ba'i gdags gzhi tsam ma grub/ / rlung sems dbyings su bsdoms shing 'khrul 'khor kha lo 'dra bsgyur bas/ / 'dzag med (556) dga' bzhi'i yo lang 'bras bu thang brdal du sbyar chog /

Since one’s mind is not born, it does not cease and die. The body’s nature is inert matter, so even the basis of the term death does not exist. Wind and mind are bound in basic space, as if piloted by yogic exercises, {556} and the movement of undissipating four ecstasies may be enjoyed as the fruit on display.

bla ma mgon po dbyer med sku lnga'i 'phrul chen ni bsgyur bas/ / las bzhi mchog gi dngos grub lo zla'i shas tsam gyis ster ba/ / lhag par bar do'i 'jigs skyobs myur mdzad spyan ras ni gzigs dbang / / mos gus snying rje'i phyag rgyas gtan gyi snying nor du bcangs yod/ /

Guru-Protector inseparable become five great emanated forms, granting the supreme spiritual power of four actions in just years or months. Especially, Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara gives refuge from fears of the intermediate state. With devotion, the seal of compassion keeps the abiding gem in the heart.

sangs rgyas thub pa'i bstan pa drang nges rang thad du bden cing / / grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag che bshad rang sa na yod kyang / gzhan la mtshan tsam dkon pa mkhas grub khyung po yi gser chos/ / bdud rtsi'i bcud la 'thung tsho chang la 'gram chu 'dra mi ldangs/ /

Buddha Śākyamuni’s doctrine is both conventional and definitive, each true in its own context. The instructions of the adept lineages are each great in their own traditions. But the great adept Khyungpo’s Golden Dharmas are barely even known to others. Those of us who have drunk of its ambrosial essence don’t drool for the likes of beer.

byed lugs zom zom ngang la bsam lugs don thog tu bcar ro/ / snang lugs glad med 'dra la yin lugs gcig thog tu grims pa/ / zer lugs bcos ma nyid la byung lugs rang bzhin gyi bab gshis/ / btang snyoms sdod par ma nus sprang po blo gros kyi sug rjes/ /

My style of behavior is unpredictable, but my style of thought lands on the ultimate meaning. My style of appearance seems brainless, but my style of being is confined to a single thing. The style of my words is contrived, but their style of arising falls in my natural character. Unable to rest in equanimity, this is the final handwriting of the vagrant Lodrö.

skye dang tshe rabs kun tu gser chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ / snying gi dpal ber bcangs te zung 'jug rdo rje yi rgyal sar/ / mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol ba'i skyob pa gnyis med ni gzigs pa/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rjes myur du 'grub pa ru mdzod cig /

In this and all future lifetimes, may I hold the wish-fulfilling gem of Golden Dharmas in the brocade cloak of my heart, in the victorious state of vajra unity. May I see the nonduality of giving liberating refuge to all migrators throughout space and quickly achieve this through the compassion of the root and lineage gurus.

ces pa'ang kun mkhyen ma hA gu ru'i don chen rdo rje'i ljags brkyangs pas mos pa'i myu gu bsros pa las smra ba'i pad+mo dbang med du kha bye ste dben pa'i skyed tshal de bI ko Ti tsA 'dra rin chen brag gi g.yon mgul du/ pad+ma'i 'bangs spong ba pa'i gzugs brnyan yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes zab don bung ba'i mgrin glu cung zad cig blangs pa dge/ !

The omniscient mahāguru’s great meaning stretched forth from his vajra tongue to nurture the sprout of my devotion. Then the lotus of my speech opened uncontrollably at the isolated grove of Devīkoṭi on the left flank of Tsadra Rinchen Drak.
