This semblance of a renunciant, a servant of Pema,[83] Yönten Gyatso Lodrö Tayepai De, sang this little song of profound meaning in the voice of a bee. Virtue!
[Conclusion]

de ltar mgur rnams mos gus kyi shugs dang nyams rtogs kyi rtsal bskyed de legs par blangs pa'i mthar tshogs kyi yo byad ci ltar 'byor ba bshams la/ / byin rlabs (557) nas lhag ma'i bar bde mchog lha lnga'i cho ga lta bu btang / / tshogs mgron la nongs bshags bzod gsol dang rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ / bsngo ba khyung pos mdzad pa'i bka' rgya mar grags pa ni/ /

At the conclusion of reciting these songs that arouse the strength of devotion and the energy of experiential realization, arrange whatever feast items you have collected. {557} Perform the offering ritual, from the consecration through the offering of leftovers according to the Five-Deity Cakrasaṃvara. Do the confession of faults and request for forbearance to the guests of the feast. If you have a support image, then do the request to remain. Recite the dedication of merit by Khyungpo known as Sealed Word:
sku gsum mkhyen bcu chos kyi rje/ / bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong la sogs kun/ / brtse bas bsngo ba'i dbang du bzhugs/ /
Lord of dharma with three kāyas and tenfold knowledge, gurus, yidam deities, ḍākinīs, dharma protectors, and all others: remain here with love to witness my dedication.
skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ / bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ / dkar po'i dge ba ci bgyis pa/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /
In this life and in all other lives, may whatever positive virtue I have made with my body, speech, and mind be for the benefit all sentient beings.
nyon mongs lam du slong gyur cig / snang ba dbang du 'dus gyur cig / sku gsum rang la rnyed gyur cig /
May I use afflictive emotions on the path. May I gain control over appearances. May I find the three kāyas in myself.
rang don chos sku 'grub gyur cig / gzhan don gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis/ / ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ / 'gro don phrin las rab rgyas pa'i/ /
May I accomplish dharmakāya for myself, and the two rūpakāya for others’ sake, increasing activity for the welfare of migrators until cyclic existence has become empty.
gang la gang 'dul der ston nas/ / gzhan don rlabs chen 'grub gyur cig / gdul bya dus la thabs gyur cig / rten 'brel thabs la mkhas gyur cig /
May I manifest as whatever tames whomever, and achieve great waves of benefit for others. May I teach disciples in a timely way. May I become skilled in the ways of interdependence.
'brel tshad don dang ldan gyur cig / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs gyur cig / 'od gsal chos sku thob gyur cig /
May my relationships be meaningful. May the ocean of cyclic existence run dry. May I gain the lucid clarity of dharmakāya.
dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ / bsngo bar mdzad pa ji bzhin tu/ / bdag gis bsngo ba 'grub gyur cig /
In whatever way all buddhas of the three times made their dedications [of merit], may I accomplish such dedication.
ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ / rigs bzang nad med dbang po gsal/ / khrims ldan shes bzhin chos spyod cing / / kun gyis bkur par bdag gyur cig /
Until I attain buddhahood, may I have good family, health, and clear senses. With discipline and alertness in dharma activity, may I be respected by everyone.

re 'dod thams cad bskang bar shog / byang chub mngon du ma gyur tshe/ / nad dang gdon dang bgegs rnams dang / / mi dang gcan gzan srin po dang / / 'byung ba bzhi yi gnod pa sogs/ / thams cad zhi ba nyid gyur cig /

May I fulfill all hopes and desires until such time as I realize awakening, may the harm from sickness, spirits, obstructors, humans, wild animals, sinpo spirits, the four elements, and so forth become completely tranquilized.
tshe dang bsod nams dar ba dang / / dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas gyur nas/ / snyan grags nam mkha' mnyam gyur cig /
lus (558) ngag yid kyi mdzad spyod kun/ / ci byas sems can don gyur nas/ / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs pa dang / / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /
May all my thoughts, words, and deeds, whatever they are, help sentient beings. May I empty the ocean of cyclic existence and attain perfect buddhahood.
ces dang bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod la phyogs dus yul khams thams cad dge legs dpal gyis khyab par bya'o/ /
Recite the Sealed Word of Auspiciousness[84] to spread the glory of virtue and well-being to all countries and realms in all directions and times.
[Colophon]

bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag srol la rdo rje'i mgur len pa shin tu gal po che mdzad cing dar srol che yang / / shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i ring lugs phyogs 'dir dar srol chung bas grub thob brgyud pa rnams kyi gsung mgur dpe tsam yang nyin mo'i skar ma'i rjes su song bas/ / rnam thar sogs las 'byung ba gtso bor byas/ /

The precious Kagyu tradition considers singing vajra songs extremely important and so the custom has spread widely. But the long tradition of the Shangpa Kagyu has not spread much in this context, so even texts containing the songs of that lineage of adepts have become like daytime stars. I have gathered these mainly from the biographies and similar sources, and supplemented them from the [songs of] the later lineage wherever appropriate.

brgyud pa phyi ma ci rigs pa'i gsung gis kyang kha bskangs te brgyud pa 'di'i zab chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog ji snyed sngon dge ba'i gser snod du 'khyil ba/ / karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes dpal de bI ko Ti tsA 'dra rin chen brag gi dben khrod du 'du bgyis pa dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / dge legs 'phel// !

Whatever sublime quintessence of the elixir of the profound dharma from this lineage was to be found is now contained in this golden receptacle of former virtue. Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso Lodrö Tayepai De compiled this at the secluded retreat of Devīkoṭi at Tsadra Rinchen Drak. May this become the cause for the immaculate long tradition of the glorious Shangpa Kagyu to spread and flourish in all directions and times. Let virtue prevail.
[Dedication]
khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang DA ki nI/ / grub thob brgyud pa rim par byon rnams kyi/ / rang byung rang shar mi shigs nA da'i sgra/ / thos pa don ldan byin rlabs kun 'byung phyir/ /

From the pervading lord Vajradhara and ḍākinīs, and the succession of adepts in the lineage, the self-occurring self-arising, indestructible sound of nāda is meaningful to hear and is the source of all blessings.

rim gnyis ting 'dzin la gnas rnal 'byor ram/ / dad mos rtse gcig ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ / rdo rje'i do ha dbyangs su len pa der/ / bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs/ / yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong gegs sel phrin las sgrub/ /

For yogins who abide in the absorptions of the two phases or people with single-minded faith and devotion, reciting these melodies of the vajra dohas will amass the blessing clouds of the Kagyu gurus, causing a rain of yidam deities’ spiritual powers to fall continuously, and the ḍākinīs and dharma protectors to accomplish the activity of dispelling obstructions.

dkar phyogs skyong rnams dgyes shing gzi mdangs skyed/ / nag phyogs dpa' zhum byang sems bdud rtsis brlan/ / nyams kyi rtsal skyed rtogs pa'i bogs bton cing / / dad ldan rnams la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ /

de ltar (559) don chen 'bras bzang smin pa'i phyir/ / tshar du dngar ba'i nor bu'i phreng ba rnams/ / dad blo gser gyi skud par legs brgyus pa/ / gcig las du mar 'phel ba'i sbar nyid gang / / byed po rang gi lhag bsam dag pas bskrun/ /

Since this excellent result ripens in such a meaningful way, I have prepared this garland of gems in proper order. Strung with the golden thread of my faithful mind, a single print [woodblock] that can make many copies, printed by my, the creator’s, pure altruistic intention.
dge bas bdag gzhan 'brel thogs gtsor gyur pa'i/ / lus can kun gyi thogs med sgrib pa bral/ / byang chub sems mchog rnam gnyis rtsol med du/ / rgyud la skyes nas gnas lugs mngon tu gyur/ /

By this virtue, may I and those with whom I’m connected and all unlimited embodied beings be free of obscuration. May the two supreme aspirations of awakening arise effortlessly in their mind streams so that the abiding nature becomes manifest.

grub thob brgyud pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs nas/ / bde can zhing du pad+mor brdzus te skyes/ / 'od dpag med las lung bstan mchog thob ste/ / sa lam myur bgrod phrin las tshad med pas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub sar 'god pa/ /

Once the spiritual life is perfected like the lineage adepts, may we be born miraculously in a lotus in Sukhāvatī and receive the supreme prophecy from Amitābha, quickly traverse the paths and levels, and with immeasurable activity place all migrators throughout space in that awakened state.
rgyal mchog snang mtha' yas dang mtshungs par shog / thugs bskyed rlabs che smon lam mthu btsan pa'i/ / bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yis/ / 'dir btab smon bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /

May we become equal to the supreme victor Amitābha. May the guru, victors, and their heirs, with great waves of the awakening mind and the power of aspirations, grant their blessings to achieve these aspirations.
ces spar byang smon tshig bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi grangs ldan 'di'ang rnam dkar bgyi ba'i byed po ku sA li blo gros mtha' yas kyis brjod pa dge legs 'phel// // (560) (561)
These words of aspiration for this printing, which have the same number [of verses] as the signs of auspiciousness, were written with good intention by the kusāli Lodrö Taye. Let virtue prevail.
Five Ḍākinīs
@#/ /shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / (562)
31. Ḍākinīs of the Five Classes Sādhana and Authorization Ritual in the Shangpa Tradition[1]
@#/ /oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ / btu da nas sngags rigs thams cad kyis/ / legs par sgrub la nyer mkho ba'i/ / sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /
Having bowed to the gurus, yidams, and buddhas, I will write a concise sādhana required for proper accomplishment by all practitioners of the Mantra family.

bdag nyid sngags gi yi dam yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed gnas pas/ / rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' hU~M las byung ba'i srung 'khor dang / / chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su gzhal med khang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan lnga tshom/ dbus su zla ba la oM las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhi ba'i nyams ldan/ shar du nyi ma la hU~M las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro bo'i nyams ldan/ lho ru zla ba ser po la trAM las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ dgyes pa'i nyams ldan/ nub tu nyi ma dmar mo zer dang bral ba la hrIHlas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ / chags pa'i nyams ldan/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje (563) la AHlas sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu don grub kyi dbu rgyan can khro zhing bzhed pa sogs nyams sna tshogs pa/

Visualize yourself as whatever Secret Mantra yidam is appropriate. Before me in space, hūṃ becomes the protection circle and source of phenomena. In the center of the space element [inside] is the celestial palace with the eight charnel grounds that are the source of spiritual powers. In the middle of the palace is a cluster of five lotus seats. In its center, on a moon, oṃ becomes white Buddha Ḍākinī crowned by Vairocana. She has a peaceful expression. On the eastern seat, on a sun, hūṃ becomes blue Vajra Ḍākinī crowned by Akṣobhya. She has a wrathful expression. On the southern seat, on a yellow moon, trāṃ becomes yellow Jewel Ḍākinī crowned by Ratnasambhava. She has a joyful expression. On the western seat, on a red sun without rays, hrīḥ becomes red Lotus Ḍākinī crowned by Amitābha. She has a passionate expression. {563} On the northern seat, on a vajra cross, āḥ becomes green Diverse Ḍākinī crowned by Amoghasiddhi. She has shifting expressions, such as wrath and mirth.

thams cad kyang g.yas cang te'u 'khrol zhing / / g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa ldang cu'i do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings su gnas pa/ / mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha T+wAM ga la rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che pad+ma ral gri rnams kyi mtshan pa/ 'od zer sna lda 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / rang mtshungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo 'bum 'bum dang 'khor mkha' 'gro grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba'o/ / dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AHthugs kar hU~M/

All the ḍākinīs are rattling small drums with their right hands and holding elixir-filled skull cups to their hearts. They have crowns of five dry human skulls, long necklaces of fifty fresh heads, and the five symbolic bone ornaments. Their black hair is partly bound on their heads. On their left sides are khaṭvāṅgas, representing methods (male consort), each adorned by a wheel, vajra, jewel, lotus, and sword, respectively. They stand amid radiating light rays of five colors. Each of the principal ḍākinīs is surrounded by one hundred thousand similar ḍākinīs and innumerable retinue ḍākinīs. At their foreheads is oṃ, at their throats āḥ, and at their hearts hūṃ.

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nas gtso mo ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs (564) med pas bskor ba badzra sa mA dza/

Immeasurable light rays radiate from my heart, invoking the principal five awareness ḍākinīs each with countless worldly and otherworldly ḍākinīs from their natural abodes and all cardinal and intermediate directions—vajra samājaḥ. {564}
rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing /
Flourish the five-pronged vajra mudra.

oM shrI he ru ka ma hA badzra A ka d+ha ya/ A ka D+ha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+d+ha ya/ ban+d+ha ya/ to Sha ya/ to Sha ya/ sarba DA ki nAM/ hri da yaM hU~M hU~M phaT phaT/ lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/
oṃ śrīheruka mahāvajra ākaḍhaya / ākaḍhaya / praveśaya / praveśaya / bandhaya bandhaya / toṣaya toṣaya / sarva ḍākinīnaṃ / hṛdayaṃ / hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ (Repeat three times to invoke them.)
dzaHhU~M baM hoH lan lnga/
jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ (Repeat five times.)
ar+g+haM nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ oM hU~M trAM hrIHAH oM AHhU~M/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/
Offer with arghaṃ through śabda; (the inner offerings with) oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ āḥ / oṃ āḥ hūṃ, and recite the two verses of praise, “Glorious Vajra Ḍākinī…(etc.)” [as in the torma offering].

oM bud+d+ha DA ki nI AHhrIHoM hU~M phaT swA hA/ oM badzra DA ki nI aHhrIHhU~M hU~M phaT swA hA/ oM rat+na DA ki ni AHhrI trAM hU~M phaT swA hA/ oM pad+ma DA ki nI AHhrIHhrIHhU~M phaT swA hA/ oM karma DA ki nI AHhrIHAHhU~M phaT swA hA/ spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ oM AHoM hU~M swA AHhA hU~M phaT swA hA/ zhes pa rnams bzlas par bya'o/ /

Repeat the following mantras: oṃ buddha ḍākinī āḥ hrīḥ oṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ vajra ḍākinī āḥ hrīḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ ratna ḍākinī āḥ hrīḥ trāṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ padma ḍākinī āḥ hrīḥ hrīḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ karma ḍākinī āḥ hrīḥ āḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā The general collective mantra: oṃ āḥ oṃ hūṃ svā āḥ hā hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
mchod gtor bdag bskyed dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud kyi dang po'i gtor ma/ oM shrI he ru ka ma hA badzra pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM hU~M phaT/ lan bdun gyis phul/
Consecrate the offering torma as in the self-visualization. For the first torma of the select portion, repeat seven times: oṃ śrīheruka mahāvajra pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hūṃ phaṭ

de nas mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba ni/ oM bud+d+ha DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM oM phaT/ oM badzra DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM hU~M phaT/ oM rat+na DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM trAM phaDaH oM pad+ma DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM hrIHphaDaH oM bi shwa DA ki nI pra tI ts+tsha i maM ba liM hoHphaT/ ces lan gsum sogs kyi phul/

Then offer to the ḍākinīs three times or more: oṃ buddha ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ oṃ phaṭ / oṃ vajra ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ ratna ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ trāṃ phaṭ / oṃ padma ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hrīḥ phaṭ / oṃ viśva ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hoḥ phaṭ[2]

rgyas par na tshig bcad dang bcas pa dang / bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / nas sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ bdag bsrung smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /

For an extensive version, include the [five praise] verses that begin with “Akṣobhya, great timeless awareness…(etc.)” [as in the following torma offering], but for a concise version, just use the mantras to present the outer, inner, and secret offerings. Then recite from “All phenomena are like reflections…(etc. to)…born into the Buddha’s family.” Supplicate for your desires with “Accept this torma I offer to you…(etc.).” Then do the hundred syllables, request for forbearance, request for departure, dissolution of the pledge beings into oneself, self-protection, aspiration prayers, and auspicious verses.

gong gis gtor chog de nyid kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul ba dang / lnga tshan lnga ba'i gtor ma thun bzhir 'bul ba gtor ma brgya pa dang / bzhi tshan bcu drug cu 'bul ba dbyug gu'i gtor ma ste/ rgyas pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbang dug gi las la bsngags so/ / de dag gi lag len (565) dang / las byang gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /

The above torma ritual may be offered one hundred and eight times, or the five sets offered five times in each of four sessions for the one hundred torma offering, or four times in the sixteen [sessions] for the sixty torma offering. Do the mantras for the activities of enriching, pacifying, magnetizing, and destroying. Look elsewhere for those practices and activity manuals. {565}
Torma Empowerment

'di'i gtor dbang ni/ chos 'byung gi dbus su tshom bu lnga bkod/ de'i steng du gtor ma lnga la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gzugs sam/ sngags byang 'dzugs/ stegs bu mtho ba zhig la phud gtor chung ba zhig bsham/ mchod pa rnams ci bder bsgrigs nas gong bzhin bdag mdun bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul 'dod gsol kyi bar byas nas/ slob ma la chab btang / maN+Dal bkye bsdu/ sems bskyed gsal btab/

Now, for the torma empowerment, arrange five heaps in the center of a source of phenomena. Upon that, place five tormas with images of the five classes of ḍākinīs, or with their mantras listed. On a raised platform, place a small select-portion torma. Arrange any nice offerings and recite the liturgies for the self- and front visualizations as before, continuing in the torma offering up to the request for one’s desires. [That concludes the ritual master’s acts.] Give the disciples the cleansing water, emanate and gather the mandala, and clarify the mind of awakening.[3]

de'ang lam zab mo gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'dir rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa'i nang nas rgyud sde gong ma mchog tu gyur pa rnal 'byor bla med/ de la thabs shes kyis phye ba'am pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su dbye ba'i/ rnal 'byor pha ma gnyis mthar thug dgongs pa gcig kyang / / dngos bstan ston tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ pha rgyud kyi khyad chos zab gnad thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la tshang zhing / pha rgyud du mi gsal ba'i zab gnad mang po yang ma rgyud la lhag por yod pas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud nyid mchog tu zab cing myur ba yin/ des na rnal 'byor ma rgyud la/ rnal 'byor ma'i thabs dang dngos grub gtso bor ston pa'i phyir/ dngos grub ni rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi gtso bor stsol ba'i phyir gang zhig sgrub pa po sngags lam zab mor 'jug pa rnams kyis ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams rtag tu mnyes ba'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che'o/ /

Now, in this profound path of Secret Mantrayāna, there are four classes of tantra. Among them, the most excellent of the higher tantras is Unexcelled Yoga (anuttarayoga). This is divided into methods and wisdom or into father tantras and mother tantras. Ultimately, father and mother tantras share a single perspective. However, in terms of how the actual doctrine is presented, all the profound important special features of the father tantras are included in the yoginī [mother] tantras. And there are many profound vital points that do not appear clearly in the father tantras but that are in the mother tantras, so the yoginī tantras are the most profound and efficacious. For that reason, mainly those methods and spiritual accomplishments from the yoginī mother tantras are presented. Therefore, since the vajra emissary (consort) is the primary giver of spiritual powers, it is crucial that those practitioners who have entered the profound path of Mantra should exert themselves in ways of always pleasing the awareness ḍākinīs.

de ltar 'bad pas ni rigs sngags myur du 'grub pa dang / nyams chags skong zhing / / las bzhi'i dngos grub sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mchog 'grub pa gdon mi za bas/ 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po khyung po lo ts+tsha ba'i man ngag las byung ba ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bka' gtad gtor dbang zhu ba'i don du maN+Dal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maN+Dal 'bul gzhug /

Through their efforts, they will quickly accomplish the knowledge mantras, restore any transgressions and violations, and undoubtedly attain the common spiritual powers, such as the four activities, and the uncommon, supreme accomplishment. So now, offer a mandala in order to request the torma empowerment entrustment of the five classes of awareness ḍākinīs that comes from the esoteric instructions of the great lord of adepts, Khyungpo Lotsāwa. Have them offer a mandala.

thal mo me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / srid (566) pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ / de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ / gtso bos bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/

With palms together holding a flower, repeat this supplication three times after me: {566} “Omniscient one with a heap of wisdom, purifier of the wheel of existence, precious giver of today’s teachings: Principal, show me your kindness.”[4]
rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ / bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /
In order to fully purify your mind stream, repeat this regular confession three times after me: “Whatever negative acts I have done,
bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ / sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ / ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /
[encouraged others to do, or rejoiced in, I confess every single one before the eyes of the buddhas.
sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / / rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis/ / bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ / tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /
I rejoice in the accumulated merit of buddhas and bodhisattvas, pratyekabuddhas, arhats, and migrators, in their meditations and recitations.
bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyis/ / sems can rgyud la gang 'tsham pa'i/ / gang 'dul de la der bstan nas/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /
Gurus and deities of the Five Tantras, I request you to turn the dharma wheel by teaching whatever tames beings according to their particular mind streams.
bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ / mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ / sangs rgyas dag la ma 'khod par/ / de srid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /
Gurus and hosts of yidam deities, I supplicate you to remain until all sentient beings filling space are established in pure awakening.
sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog / de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /
I go for refuge in those who aroused the awakening mind, attained buddhahood, and turned the wheel of the dharma, and in the supreme assembly of bodhisattvas.
sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ / skam ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ / de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /
Just as the fortunate bodhisattvas aroused the mind of awakening, which is the cause of buddhas appearing, I too will arouse the mind of awakening.
bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di dag gis/ / 'jig rten 'di' ni myur du sangs rgyas shog / 'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing / / sems can sdug bsngal gzir las sgrol bar shog /
Through this virtuous act of mine, may I quickly become a buddha in this world and teach the dharma for the sake of migrators, liberating them from the torment of suffering.
bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ / bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum ni/ / ltos med sems can don du 'bul/ / khyod kyi sku gsum 'grub par shog /]
Guru, yidam, and Buddha, for the sake of beings, I freely offer my body, speech, and mind. May I attain your three kāyas.]”[5]
sogs lan gsum/

de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar sgoms shig / khyod rang rnams kyi snying ga'i nang du pad+ma'i gdan lnga tshom sogs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ ye shes bkug cing bstim/ mchod bstod kyi bar song nas/ gtor ma kha gsos byin rlabs byas la gtor chog bsngo/ 'dod don gsol ba btab par bya/ de nas gtor ma thogs la/

Now meditate on this visualization: within your hearts, there is a cluster of five lotus seats…(etc.). Follow the visualization description [above]. The awareness beings are invoked and dissolve into you. Continue until the offerings and praises [in the liturgy]. Then refresh and consecrate the tormas and dedicate the torma ritual. Do the supplication for desires. Then hold up the torma and say:

gtor ma 'di nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pas bskor ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon/ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa stan thog 'di nyid du stsol bar mos shing / bcom ldan 'das ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor nas rim par byon pa'i rtsa ba dang rgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs ye shes thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ rlung sems snang ba thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dgra gdon bgegs tshogs thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ / mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don re ba thams cad yid (567) bzhin tu 'grub pa dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/

This torma [carried by] the five classes of awareness ḍākinīs, surrounded by their retinues of innumerable worldly and otherworldly ḍākinīs, arrives at the top of your head. Imagine that you are granted every empowerment, blessing, and spiritual power right where you are. Bhagavatī Siṃhamukha, Khedrup Khyungpo Naljor, and their succession of holy root and lineage gurus, and the five classes of awareness ḍākinīs with their retinues of countless worldly and otherworldly ḍākinīs, please confer empowerment and blessings with your awakened body, speech, and mind on these vajra disciples who hold awareness. Please pacify all their negative actions, obscurations, sickness, spirits, and obstacles. Please increase their life spans, merit, prosperity, experience, realization, and timeless awareness. Please bring under control all winds, mind, and appearance. Please terminate all their self-fixation and afflictions, and hosts of enemies, spirits, and obstructors. In short, please accomplish all their short- and long-term desires, goals, and hopes just as they wish. {567} And please grant them every supreme and common spiritual power.
sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs cing / / dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung pa'i gnas/ / gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /
All the buddhas bless you in all awakened body, speech, and mind, and give you the torma empowerment conferral, the source of the two spiritual powers.

zhes dang gong gi sngags rnams brjod la gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag / rjes dam tshig khas blang / gtong rag maN+Dal/ lus 'bul dge bsngo rnams bya/ / mdun bskyed mchod pa kha gsos la mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab nongs bshags bzod gsol/ rten yod na ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ rten med na lha gshegs/ dge bsngo shis brjod rgyas par spel lo/ /

Say the aforementioned mantras and touch [the disciples’] three places with the torma. Afterward, they take the sacred pledges, offer a mandala in gratitude, offer their bodies, and dedicate the merit. Refresh the offerings of the front visualization and do the offerings, praises, request for desires, confession of errors, and request forbearance. If there is a support representation, the awareness beings remain there. The pledge beings gather into you. If there is no support, the deities depart. Dedicate the virtue and do auspicious prayers to widely increase [the benefits].
[Colophon by Tāranātha]
kun nas nyams chags bskang ba dang / / las sgrub gang la'ang shis shing dga'/ / sgrub bo kun la mkho ba 'di/ / snying nas brtse bas myur por bris/ /
Fully amending transgressions and violations and practicing the actions is auspicious and joyful. This requirement for all the practitioners was written quickly with love from my heart.
mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no/ /
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul]
zhes sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas khol du byungs te rjes gnang bklags chog tu bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ / (568) (569)
This was taken from [Tāranātha’s] Mine of Jewels. The authorization ritual was arranged as a liturgical ritual.[6] Let virtue and goodness prevail.
32. Torma Offering to the Ḍākinīs of the Five Classes Just for Regular Practice[1]
@#/ /oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mchod gtor 'bul ba dkyus ma tsam gyi lag len byed na/ zlum gtor lnga'am gcig la thebs kyu bzhis mtshan pa bshams/ yi dam ltar byin brlabs la/

To practice just the usual version of the Torma Offering to the Ḍākinīs of the Five Classes, put up five round tormas or one torma marked with four dough buttons. Do the consecration as in the yidam practice.

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hU~M las byung ba'i srung 'khor dang / chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su gzhal med khang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan lnga tshom/ dbus su zla ba la oM las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhi ba'i nyams ldan/ / shar du nyi ma la hU~M las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro bo'i nyams ldan/ lho ru zla ba ser po la trAM las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ dgyes pa'i nyams ldan/ nub tu nyi ma dmar po zer dang bral ba la hrIHlas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ chags pa'i nyams ldan/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje la a las sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ khro zhing bzhad pa sogs nyams sna tshogs pa/

Before me in space, hūṃ becomes the protection circle and source of phenomena. In the center of the space element [inside] is the celestial palace with the eight charnel grounds that are the source of spiritual powers. In the middle of the palace is a cluster of five lotus seats. In its center, on a moon, oṃ becomes white Buddha Ḍākinī crowned by Vairocana. She has a peaceful expression. On the eastern seat, on a sun, hūṃ becomes blue Vajra Ḍākinī crowned by Akṣobhya. She has a wrathful expression. On the southern seat, on a yellow moon, trāṃ becomes yellow Jewel Ḍākinī crowned by Ratnasambhava. She has a joyful expression. On the western seat, on a red sun without rays, hrīḥ becomes red Lotus Ḍākinī crowned by Amitābha. She has a passionate expression. On the northern seat, on a vajra cross, āḥ becomes green Diverse Ḍākinī crowned by Amoghasiddhi. She has shifting expressions, such as wrath and mirth.

thams cad kyang g.yas cang te'u 'khrol zhing / g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam pa lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings su gnas pa/ mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha TaM' ga la rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che pad+ma ral gri rnams kyis mtshan pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / rang mtshungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo 'bum 'bum dang 'khor mkha' 'gro grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba'o/ / dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med (570) pa 'phros/

All of the ḍākinīs are rattling small drums with their right hands and holding elixir-filled skull cups to their hearts. They have crowns of five dry human skulls, long necklaces of fifty fresh heads, and the five symbolic bone ornaments. Their black hair is partly bound on their heads. On their left sides are khaṭvāṅgas, representing methods, each adorned by a wheel, vajra, jewel, lotus, and sword, respectively. They stand amid radiating light rays of five colors. Each of the principal ḍākinīs is surrounded by one hundred thousand similar ḍākinīs and innumerable retinue ḍākinīs. At their foreheads is oṃ, at their throats āḥ, and at their hearts hūṃ. {570}
rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nas gtso mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro lnga la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pas bskor ba badzra sa mA dzaH

Immeasurable light rays radiate from my heart, invoking the principal five awareness ḍākinīs each with countless worldly and otherworldly ḍākinīs from their natural abodes and all cardinal and intermediate directions—vajra samājaḥ.
rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing /
Flourish the five-pronged vajra mudra.

oM shrI he ru ka ma hA badzra A ka D+D+ha ya/ A kaD+D+ha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+d+ha ya/ ban+d+ha ya/ to Sha ya/ to Sha ya/ sarba badzra DA ki nI naM/ hr-i da yaM hU~M hU~M phaT phaT/ lan gsum gyis spyan drang /
oṃ śrīheruka mahāvajra ākaḍhaya / ākaḍhaya / praveśaya / praveśaya / bandhaya bandhaya / toṣaya toṣaya / sarva vajra ḍākinīnaṃ / hṛdayaṃ / hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ (Repeat three times to invoke them.)
dzaHhU~M baM hoH lan lnga/
jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ (Repeat five times.)
ar+g+haM nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oM hU~M trAM hrIHAH oM AHhU~M/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/
Offer with arghaṃ through śabda. Present the inner offerings: oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ āḥ / oṃ āḥ hūṃ
dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ / ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ / 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Glorious Vajra Ḍākinī, wheel wielder of the ḍākinīs; five awarenesses and three kāyas— homage to the protectors of migrators.
ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / / 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ / de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Every vajra ḍākinī severs the bonds of concept and engages in worldly activity; I pay homage to every one.[2]
gtor chog tsam la bzlas pa mi dgos kyang / spro na/ spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ oM AHoM hU~M swA AHhA hU~M phaT swA hA/ zhes bzla/
When doing just the torma ritual, the recitation of the mantras is unnecessary, but if you wish, you may do their collective mantra: oṃ āḥ oṃ hūṃ svā āḥ hā hūṃ phaṭ svāhā

de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oM bud+d+ha DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM oM phaT/ oM badzra DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM hU~M phaT/ oM rat+na DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM trA~M phaT/ oM pad+ma DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM hrIHphaT/ oM bi shwa DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM AHphaT/ oM sarba DA ki nI pra tIts+tsha i maM ba liM hoHphaT/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis phul/

Then to offer the torma, repeat the following mantras three times and so forth. oṃ buddha ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ oṃ phaṭ / oṃ vajra ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ ratna ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ trāṃ phaṭ / oṃ padma ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hrīḥ phaṭ / oṃ viśva ḍākinī pratīccha imaṃ baliṃ hoḥ phaṭ
rgyas par na tshigs bcad dang bcas pa dang / bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams phul/
For an extensive version, include the [following five praise] verses, but for a concise version, just use the mantras to present the outer, inner, and secret offerings.
mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ / rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Akṣobhya, great timeless awareness, vajra expanse, the great space, three sublime vajras, three mandalas: Vajra Ḍākinī, I pay homage and praise.
rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ / rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ / rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog / sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Vairocana, utterly pure, vajra peace, great joy, sublime lucid clarity by nature: Buddha Ḍākinī, I pay homage and praise.
rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ / rdo rje nam (571) mkha' dri ma med/ / rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ / rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Ratnarāja, utterly profound, {571} vajra space without defilement, naturally pure, without covering: Jewel Ḍākinī, I pay homage and praise.
rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ / mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ / 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ / pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Amitāvajra, great king, nonconceptual sky, vajra holder, the perfection of desire attained: Lotus Ḍākinī, I pay homage and praise.
don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ / dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / / sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Amogharāja, perfect buddha, bringing fulfillment of all wishes, the real thing arisen from purity itself: Diverse Ḍākinī, I pay homage and praise.[3]
ces de nyid lnga pas bstod/ /
Thus praise them with five verses. Then:
chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing brjod du med/ / rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /
All phenomena are like reflections: clear, vivid, and not muddled. Ungraspable and inexpressible, they arise from causes and actions.
ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ / de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ / sems can don ni bla med phyos/ / 'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /
Without real essence or place— know phenomena as such and create the highest benefit for beings; be born in the family of buddhas.[4]
mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ /
Then recite the supplication for one’s desires: Accept this torma I offer to you…(etc.).
yig brgya/ / bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ / bdag srung / / smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /
Do the hundred syllables, request for forbearance, request for departure, gathering the pledge beings into oneself, self-protection, aspiration prayers, and auspicious verses.
[Colophon]
zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu rin 'byung las zur du bkol ba ste gu Nas so// // dge legs 'phel// // (572) (573)
This was taken separately from [Tāranātha’s] Mine of Jewels as a useful supplement by Guṇa.
Six-Armed Mahākāla
@#/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// // (574)
33. Treasure Trove of Awakened Activity. Sādhana and Torma Ritual for Glorious Awareness Protector Six-Armed Mahākāla[1]
@#/ /oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba/
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /
I bow and go for refuge to the Guru-Protector inseparable.
spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rjes khros pa'i sku/ / ma rungs bdud dpung phye mar thag mdzad pa/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs pad la/ / gus pas btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ /
Wrathful form of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion who grinds to dust the hordes of nasty devils; at the lotus feet of the Guru-Protector inseparable I bow with respect and write this brief sādhana.

rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rim pa mtha' dag legs par mnos pa zhig gis/ bris sku mchod gtor sogs mtshan nyid tshang bar bshams la/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ nang mchod byin rlabs yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar ram/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la/ gnas khang mchod rdzas gtor ma rnams la gtong

A yogin who holds the sacred pledges and has properly received all the stages of blessings for this [practice] should set out unimpaired images, offerings, tormas, and so forth. While you maintain the yoga of yourself as the yidam, consecrate the inner offering[2] as in the yidam’s liturgical description, or as described below in the torma consecration. Sprinkle [the liquid inner offering] around the dwelling place, offering substances, and tormas.
a mr-i tas bsang / swa b+hA was sbyang /
Cleanse: [oṃ vajra] amṛta [kundṇḍali hana hana hūṃ phaṭ] Purify: oṃ svabhāva [śuddāḥ sarva dharmaḥ svabhāva ’ham]

stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang b+h+rUM las byung pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pA la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hU~M zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog / bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/

From within emptiness, the dwelling place arises from bhrūṃ as a celestial palace. In its center, the syllable A becomes a wide and vast kapāla of awareness. Within that, the melting of hūṃs produces drinking water, washing water, flowers, incense, lights, perfume, food, and music—filling the reaches of space.
mchod pa byin rlabs kyi sngags dang / rol mo byin dbab spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyang / /

Say the mantras for consecrating the offerings: oṃ vajra arghaṃ svāhā / oṃ vajra padyaṃ svāhā / oṃ vajra puṣpe āḥ hūṃ…(etc. through)…śabda. Play music for the descent of blessings as in general practice. Then the consecration of the torma: {575}

yaM las (575) rlung / raM las me/ kaM las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ a las ka pA la dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar du go las ba lang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub du da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha rnams hU~M b+h+rUM AM dzriM khaM rnams kyis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ lho ru ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las sha chen kyi dwangs ma rnams/ bAM mAM lAM pAM tAM gyis mtshan pa de rnams kyi steng du oM dkar po mgo bo mthur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba/ hU~M las rdo rje'am gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa/ hU~M las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khel ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ba/ oM dang hU~M la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag / hU~M gi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim/ oM yig zla ba rdo rje'am gri gug dang bcas pa lhung ste/ rdo rje'am gri gug gis lan gsum du dkrugs nas/ thams cad zhu ba gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oM AHhU~M ha hoHhrIH

Wind arises from yaṃ, fire from raṃ, three skull hearthstones from kaṃ, and on them a three-piece kapāla from A, white on the outside and red inside. In its center, human meat comes from na; in the east, ox meat from go; in the south, dog meat from ku; in the west, horse meat from da; and in the north, elephant meat from ha. They are marked by hūṃ - bhrūṃ - aṃ - jriṃ - khaṃ. Above them, in the center, urine from mu; in the east, feces from vi; in the south, blood from ra; in the west, semen from śu; and in the north, extract of human flesh from ma. They are marked by vāṃ - māṃ - lāṃ - pāṃ - tāṃ. Above them is an upside-down white oṃ, and above that a moon from A, and from hūṃ a vajra flaying knife marked with hūṃ. Light radiates from the hūṃ. Wind stirs, fire burns—the contents melt and boil. Steam rises up striking oṃ and hūṃ; streams of elixir flow down. Light from hūṃ invokes the elixir of awareness from the hearts of all the tathāgatas and it dissolves [into the skull]. The oṃ letter, moon, and vajra or flaying knife fall. The vajra or flaying knife stirs [the contents] three times. Everything melts and the torma becomes a vast ocean of undissipating elixir. oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha hoḥ hrīḥ {576}
oM swa b+hA wa shud+d+ha sarba (576) d+harmaHswa b+hA lba shud+d+ho‘haM/
oṃ svabhāva śuddha sarva dharma svabhāva śuddho ’haṃ

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang / mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su paM las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / raM las nyi ma'i steng du gaM dkar po 'od du zhu ba las/ / dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol pa/ g.yon ne'u le rin po che skyug pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ kha gshang ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du hU~M las rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba hU~M mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa

From within emptiness, the letter hūṃ produces the vajra protection circle. Within it, in the center of the unbearable great charnel ground, a multicolored lotus comes from paṃ and a sun from raṃ. Upon that, white gaṃ melts into light and arises as white Gaṇapati with a three-eyed elephant’s head. In his right hand he holds a leafy radish, the essence of earth, which he feeds to his mouth. In his left hand he holds a mongoose that vomits jewels. He is adorned by silks and jewels. Gems flow out from his orifices—mouth, anus, and pores—as he lies prone. On top of him, hūṃ becomes a blazing vajra[-handled] flaying knife marked with a deep-blue hūṃ. It radiates light, annihilating all enemies, obstructors, and noxious spirits. The light makes offerings to the noble ones and enacts the welfare of sentient beings, then returns and dissolves [into hūṃ].

yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khong nas 'khrugs shing rngam pa'i zhal drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang / dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin+d+hu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang / g.yon dang pos thod pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas DA ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje'i zhags pa nag po bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po gnon cing brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/

That completely transforms into Six-Armed Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, fulfiller of the hopes of living beings just as they wish. He is pitch black like the clouds at the end of all time. He has one face and six arms and glares angrily with his three round, red eyes. His gaping mouth reveals bared fangs and a curling tongue that twitches from deep down as he laughs fiercely from his awesome mouth. His tawny eyebrows, whiskers, and hair swirl upward. His forehead is anointed with a drop of vermilion. [3] His head is sealed above by King Akṣobhya. He holds a vajra flaying knife with his first right hand above his heart and a skull cup filled with the flesh and blood of enemies and obstructors with his first left hand, below his heart. He holds a dry skull garland with his middle right hand and violently rattles a ḍamaru with the lower right. He holds a trident with his middle left hand and a black vajra lasso with the lower hand. His two legs, with the strength to completely suppress the three levels of existence, stand in a perfectly straight parallel position pressing down on the obstructor king, Gaṇapati. He wears a tiger-skin skirt tied with a green silk sash.

klu chen po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ (577) sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang gu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ske rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung lto ba rgyas shing yan lag hrags pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ ha ha dang hU~M hU~M phaT phaT la sogs pa 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad rlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / tsan+dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /

The ornaments of the great nāgas adorn him: {577} blue snakes bind his hair, and he has red snake earrings, striped snake armbands, a white snake collar, yellow snake bracelets, a green snake necklace, and white snake anklets and belt. On all his arms and legs there are strings of large and small bells. He is short and fat, with a protruding belly and thick limbs. He has boundless charisma that is difficult to bear. He has a crown of five dry human skulls and a garland of fifty fresh skulls dripping with blood. He is beautified by the six bone ornaments and a jewel on his crown. His terrifying roars of ha ha and hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ resound like thunder, annihilating all devils and enemy obstructors. He stands within a bonfire of timeless awareness like the fire at the end of the eon, supported by the trunk of a sandalwood tree.

de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su b+h+yoHlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog nag mo rngam zhing khros pa/ / phyag g.yas kyis bdud kyi khram shing nag po phyar zhing / g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ chibs kyi snga long la sho rde'u dkar nag dang / byang dmar khres po/ phyi long la mtshon gyi gru gu ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra gyen du 'khyil zhing spyi bor rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ srin po'i ya mgal la sga'i snga ru byas shing ma mgal la phyi ru byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs dang gos nag gsol ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ me dpung dang rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'tshub pa'i dbus na bzhugs shing / 'khor sha za dang / ma mo (578) mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o/

To his left, in the middle of a turbulent sea of blood and fat, bhyoḥ becomes Śrīdevī, mighty queen of the desire realm. She is black, awesome, and wrathful. She waves a devil’s black cross-scored stick in her right hand and grasps a bag of diseases with her left. On the front of her mount’s harness hang black and white spotted dice and a bundle of red curses (byad dmar). On the back is a weaponized ball of yarn. [These are] her five magical weapons.[4] She has three eyes, bared teeth, and her face is gathered into a wrathful grimace. Her hair swirls upward and is adorned by a peacock-feather fan. The sun rises from her navel and the moon from the crown of her head. She rides a three-legged mule. The front part of its saddle is made from the upper jawbone of a bloodthirsty demon (rākṣasa), and the back part from the lower jawbone. She wears a hair-felt skirt and black clothing. An elephant hide covers her upper back and an ox hide her lower back. She wears bone ornaments and a crown and garland of human heads. Her right earring is a poisonous snake and the left is a lion. She stands in the midst of a conflagration of fire and dark wind. {578} A retinue of one hundred thousand flesh-eating ḍākinīs and mātṛkās surrounds her.

gtso bo'i mdun du k+ShiM las gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldangs pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar bas lha dang lha min thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

In front of the principal figures, kṣiṃ becomes Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla. He is blue-black with a gaping mouth and bared fangs, bellowing at his enemies. Winds of the end-times rise from his nose. With his right hand he brandishes a flaying knife to the sky, terrifying all the gods and demigods. With his left hand he feeds the principal’s mouth from a blood-filled skull cup containing the hearts of enemies and obstructors. He rides a crazed black bear and is surrounded by a retinue of hordes of noxious yakṣas.

g.yas su hU~M las dbang phyug dzI na mi tra/ sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs can/ zhal nas dug dang khrag gi char 'bebs pa/ phyag g.yas DA ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba/ 'khor gza' dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

To the right, hūṃ becomes Īśvara Jinamitra. He is dark red with the body of a wrathful bloodthirsty demon. Poison and blood spews from his mouth. He rattles a ḍamaru violently with his right hand and with his left hand makes the threatening gesture with fire shooting out from his pointing finger. A retinue of planetary spirits and bloodthirsty demons surrounds him.

rgyab tu TaM las gshin rje Ta k+ki rA dza sku mdog nag po mi'i sha khrag la ches rngam pa/ phyag g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa dgra la 'phen cing / g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/ gshin rje'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ gsum ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/

In back, ṭaṃ becomes the death lord, Yamarāja Ṭakkirāja. He is black and ravenous for human flesh and blood. With his right hand he throws a lasso made of intestines at enemies and with his left he shows the threatening gesture to harm-doers. Hordes of death lords surround him. Those three are all adorned by bone ornaments and tiger-skin skirts.

g.yon du hU~M las bdud mgon chen po trak+shad smu mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ phyag g.yas su mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying khar bsnun pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ ya sos ma mchu mnan cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang / sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ 'khor lha dang bdud dmag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/

To the left, hūṃ becomes the great devil lord, Trakṣad. He is black like the clouds at the end of time. He pierces the enemies’ hearts with a red three-pronged ensign spear in his right hand and drinks from a blood-filled skull cup in his left. He bites his lower lip and bares his fangs. He wears a black cloak with maroon svāstika designs, high rawhide boots, and a golden belt. He rides a black devil horse with white fetlocks. He is surrounded by a retinue of countless armies of gods and devils.

bzhi ka'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu lta ba/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnam pa bzhi gtsigs pa/ gtum zhing khros la cher 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs dang mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can sma ra dang smin (579) ma dang dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / / mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ me rlung drag tu 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa'o/ /

All four of them glare at enemies and obstructors with three round red eyes, gnash their terrible four fangs, and appear very agitated, savage, and wrathful. They have stocky, ugly forms and their orange eyebrows, whiskers, and hair blaze like fire. {579} They wear crowns of dry skulls and garlands of human heads dripping with blood. They dwell in the midst of violently swirling fire and wind.

de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar por skyes la zhon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po smug nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang gu sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa nor bus mtshan pa'i be con 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'byung po dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa lha mo so la 'khyud pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa bdag nag po phag pa la zhon pa rin po che 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs mtshungs 'bum 'bum gyis yongs su bskor ba phyag g.yon pas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/

Around them, yellow Śakra is in the east riding an elephant and holding a vajra; red Agni is in the southeast riding a urial goat; blue Yama is in the south riding a water buffalo and holding a club; maroon Rākṣasa is in the southwest riding a zombie and holding a sword; white Varuṇa is in the west riding a makara and holding a snake lasso; green Vāyu is in the northwest riding a stag and holding a banner; yellow Yakṣa is in the north riding a horse and holding a gem-studded club; and white Bhūta is in the northeast riding an ox and holding a trident. Each of them embraces their personal goddess. Above them, yellow Brahmā is riding a swan and holding a vase. Below, black Pārthiva is riding a boar and holding a blazing jewel. They are all completely surrounded by one hundred thousand of their own kind. They pay homage to the principal ones with their left hands.

gzhan yang ma hA de ba la sogs pa lha chen po brgyad/ nor rgyas la sogs pa klu chen po brgyad/ nyi ma la sogs pa gza' chen po brgyad/ drag po la sogs pa 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ smin drug la sogs pa rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor srung la sogs pa rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

Further, all around are the seventy-five protectors of the pure abodes: the eight great gods, such as Mahādeva; the eight great nāgas, such as Vāsuki; the eight great planets, such as Sun; the nine great terrifiers (bhairavas), such as Rudra; the twenty-eight constellations, such as Kṛttikā (Pleiades); and the four great kings, such as Dhṛtarāṣṭra. They are each surrounded by a retinue of millions.

de'i phyi rol du 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams sha la dga' ba khrag la rol pa/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ bzhin bsdus pa/ gtum zhing 'jigs la mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa/ skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ (580) gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za dang / gshin rje dang / bdud dang / ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su g.yog / thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o/ / de thams cad kyi dpral bar oM dkar po/ mgrin par AHdmar po/ thugs kar hU~M sngon po/

Outside of them are the eight classes of gods and rakṣas, the retinue armies of oath-bound [protectors]. They look horrible and ruthless, with gaping mouths, bloodshot eyes, bared fangs, scowling faces, and ferocious demeaners. They carry various lethal weapons in their hands and could suck out the vital breath of all living beings in an instant. {580} They wear the garb of yakṣas, rākṣasas, yamas, māras, and mātṛkās. They completely cover the ground and fill all the sky and space. All are perfectly fulfilling the hopes and desires of practitioners. All are marked with white oṃ at the forehead, red āḥ at the throat, and blue hūṃ at the heart.

rang gi thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing / g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la DA ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra si li li khro lo lo 'ur 'ur chem chem du byon par gyur/

Light rays radiate from the hūṃ in my heart, invoking Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Six-Armed Mahākāla from in front of the single trunk of a sandalwood tree in the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast.[5] He arrives instantly with the root and lineage gurus above him, strong heroes on his right, smiling heroines on his left, and all the armies of obedient ones, realm protectors, messengers, and an ocean of the oath-bound, accompanied by the sounds of ḍamarus, bells, and small bells: si li li–khro lo lo–ur ur–chem chem.
hU~M dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs ma hA kA la che/ / dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ / dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /
hūṃ By faith and by sacred pledge, great Mahākāla, come here. Glorious Protector with your retinue, please approach the site of this mandala.
k+She tra pA la la sogs pa/ / 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ / bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ / dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /
Kṣetrapāla and the others, retinue of obedient ones, hosts of yakṣas, you who promised to guard the doctrine, ocean of the oath-bound, please approach.
dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / / rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / / bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /
When you come to this mandala site, partake of this decorated torma, show yourselves in signs and forms, and accomplish the entrusted activity.

oM badzra ma hA kA la sa pA ri wA ra k+ShiM/ k+ShiM ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ de nas k+ShiM gi gnas su e h+ye hi bcugs pa dang / badzra sa mA dzaH bcug pa lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/
oṃ vajra mahākāla saparivāra kṣiṃ…(etc.). Repeat kṣiṃ twenty-one times. Then in place of kṣiṃ, insert e hye hi [and] vajra samājaḥ three times each. Swift Actor and retinue are invoked.
hU~M rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ / ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ / byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas 'di ru/ / bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /
hūṃ Just as, in the presence of Vajradhara, you promised and took an oath, please come to this blessed place and stay to protect the doctrine.

dzaHhU~M baM hoHgnyis su med par thim/ / pad+ma ka ma lA ya s+t+waM/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba (581) yi/ / lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ / mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /

jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they dissolve indivisibly. padma kamalāyastvaṃ This excellent drinking water, a divine substance {581} produced through interdependent origination, I offer to Protector and entourage: please accept it to guard the doctrine.
oM shrI ma hA kA lA ya sa pA ri wA ra ar+g+haM pra tits+tsha hU~M swA hA/
oṃ śri mahākālaya sapārivāra arghaṃ pratīccha hūṃ svāhā

de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil= pA d+yaM= me tog= puSh+pe= bdug spos= d+hU pe= snang gsal= A lo ke= dri chab= gan+d+he= zhal zas= nai wi d+ya= rol mo= shab+da= snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/

Similarly, substitute “washing water” [for drinking water] and padyaṃ [for arghaṃ]; “flowers” and puṣpe; “incense” and dhūpe; “light” and āloke; “perfume” and gandhe; “food” and naividyā; and “music” and śabda. Present the inner offerings by adding the three seed syllables to the essence mantra.
chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang / / gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ / bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i/ / nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Without stirring from the realm of reality, yet your wrathful form to subdue the vicious vanquishes the rudra of the doctrine; homage and praise to Great Black One.

de nas rgyun gyi nyams len gtor chog tsam bya bar 'dod na/ 'og gi gtor ma 'bul ba man chad byas pas kyang rung la/ yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med dang / grib sil dang / gnad dbab kyi bka' legs par thob cing / de dag gi don nyams su len par 'dod na/ dmigs pa dang gnad rgyas pa rnams man ngag ltar shes par byas la/

Then if you wish to do just the daily practice and torma ritual, it is suitable to only continue from the torma offering below. But if you wish to practice the topics of Guru-Protector Inseparable, Dispelling Defilements, and Getting Down to the Vital Point (gnad dbab) to properly receive the precepts, you should know in detail the visualizations and important points according to the esoteric instructions.
dang po
Guru-Protector Inseparable
bla ma mgon po'i gsol 'debs ni/
The supplication to the guru and Protector:

mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon gser gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ mgon po 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'ur 'ur/ sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sil sil/ khrol khrol gar mdzad/ bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med par gyur/

Above Protector’s head, my benevolent root guru is yellow and as brilliant as one hundred thousand suns, holds a wish-fulfilling gem to the heart with the right hand, a golden bell at the hip with the left, and sits in vajra posture, adorned by all decorations. The guru is the essence of all the lineage gurus starting with Vajradhara. Light radiates from the guru’s body—Protector becomes the nature of light and bliss, dancing with the sounds of ur ur, sil sil. Light radiates from Protector and dissolves into the guru’s body. Guru becomes the nature of light and bliss, dancing and ringing the bell with the sounds of sil sil, khrol khrol. Guru is Protector. Protector is Guru. Guru and Protector are inseparable.
bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba (582) 'debs so/ /
I and all sentient beings throughout the reaches of space supplicate Guru-Protector inseparable. {582}

mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ / khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Protector-Guru inseparable. We supplicate the benevolent root guru. We supplicate the pervading lord Great Vajradhara. We supplicate glorious mighty Śavarīpa.

mnga' bdag me tri pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / grub chen rA hu la chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Lord Maitrīpa the Great. We supplicate the adept Rāhula the Great. We supplicate the learned adept Khyungpo Naljor. We supplicate incomparable Rinchen Tsöndru.

rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng la gsol ba 'debs so/ / dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs so/ / 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate the realized Zhangom Chöseng. We supplicate the great Öntön Kyergangpa. We supplicate Nyentön Bepei Naljor. We supplicate Drogön Sangye Tönpa.

mkhas grub shangs ston chos rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ / khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bya bral ri khrod ras chen la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Khedrup Shangtön Chöje. We supplicate Khyungpo Tsultrim Gönpo. We supplicate Jadral Ritrö Rechen. We supplicate Khyenden Shangpa Karpo.

mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs so/ / grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ / rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ / rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Nyame Sangye Palzang. We supplicate Drupchen Namkha Gyaltsen. We supplicate Gyagom Lekpa Gyaltsen. We supplicate Jetsun Kunga Drolchok.

chos sku lha dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ / rje btsun tA ra nA tha la gsol ba 'debs so/ / rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so/ / rgyal tshab ye shes rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Chöku Lhawang Drakpa. We supplicate Jetsun Tāranātha.[6] We supplicate Gyaltsap Rinchen Gyatso. We supplicate Gyaltsap Yeshe Gyatso.

mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs so/ / chos rje ngag dbang phrin las la gsol ba 'debs so/ / chos rje kun bzang dbang po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Khedrup Lodrö Namgyal. We supplicate Chöje Ngawang Trinle. We supplicate Chöje Kunzang Wangpo. We supplicate Rikzin Tsewang Norbu.

bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bka' (583) brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs so/ / pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la gsol ba 'debs sa/
We supplicate Kagyu Trinle Shingta. We supplicate Tenzin Chökyi Nyima. {583} We supplicate Kagyu Trinle Namgyal. We supplicate Pema Nyinje Wangpo.
na mo bud+d+hA ya/ na mo bu ru he/ badzra bI ra bI ri Ne/ shrI DA ka DA ki nI/ dzo ga dzo gi nI/ sarba bud+d+hA bod+hi sa twa ya sha rA NI/ gats+tsha mi/
namo buddhāya / namo guruhe / vajra vīra vīriṇe /śrī ḍāka ḍākinī / joga jogiṇī / sarva buddha bodhisatvaya śarāṇī / gacchāmi

kyai phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /

Kyai! Holy root and lineage gurus dwelling in the ten directions and three times, bless me. Yidam deities of the mandala, bless me. Heroes and heroine yoginīs, bless me. Buddhas and bodhisattvas all, bless me. Glorious Six-Armed Awareness Protector and deities, do not veil your timeless awareness. Do not delay your compassion. Do not block your power and ability. Do not distance your blessings. All of you, bless me through your body, bless me through your speech, bless me through your mind. Bless me through your unlimited awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. Bless me right now! Bless me quickly! Bless me on this very seat!
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyis/ / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang / / dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /
Guru-Protector inseparable, I supplicate you with faith: remove every affliction of myself and all sentient beings. Please grant every spiritual power.
gnyis pa grib sel ni/
Dispelling Defilements

mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa/ / g.yon pas mnyam gzhag gi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkha' (584) la 'khod par gyur/ /

Above Protector’s head, my root guru is white Vajrasattva, his right hand holding a five-pronged crystal vajra at his heart and his left hand in equipoise with an elixir-filled skull cup on top. He sits in vajra cross-legged position, with infinite light radiating from his body. Light rays radiate from his heart and invoke the vajra body, speech, and mind of all buddhas and bodhisattvas in the forms of deities. {584} They are arrayed in the sky above.
rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas ba'i mthar/
Repeat Vajrasattva’s hundred syllables twenty-one times. Afterward recite:
rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan sha wa ri/ / rgyal ba mai tri grub chen rA hu la/ / a mi de ba lo ke shwa ra dang / / ha ya grI ba pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ /
Vajradhara and glorious Śavarī, sovereign Maitrīpa, great adept Rāhula, Amideva, Lokeśvara, Hayagrīva, glorious Padmākara,
khyung po jo gi rat+na bIr+Ya dang / / d+harma siM ha d+harma pra dz+nya dang / / bIr+Ya siM ha shangs ston chos rje sogs/ / rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /
Khyungpo Yogi, Ratna Vīrya, Dharma Siṃha, Dharma Prajñā, Vīrya Siṃha, Shangtön Chöje, and the others, gurus of the jewel lineage, please think of me.
'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i/ / brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ / dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs pa/ / 'jig rten rtog bcas dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ /

I did not realize that the guru with a lineage of perfected qualities that fulfill beings’ hopes was the embodiment of doubly pure buddhas of the three times: I confess falling under the influence of worldly thought.
sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las dang / / phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ / bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ / rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams mthol lo bshags/ /

All outer, inner, and secret deities with awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities, please think of me. Now that I enter the door of supreme Mantra Vehicle, I confess my transgressions and damages of its root and branch pledges.
mthu stobs nus pa phrin las phun tshogs shing / / skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ / 'du 'bral med par dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ / ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol/ /

With your abundant activity of power and capability, just recalling you for an instant dispels all obstacles. Giver of spiritual powers without meeting or parting: Six-Armed Awareness Protector, please think of me.
dur khrod nags mtha' chu gling bas mtha' ru/ phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyur nas/ / bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub bar/ / le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ /

In secluded charnel grounds, forests, and islands, I collected the outer and inner supports and pledge substances, but did not properly do the recitations, fulfillments, and confessions; I confess falling under the influence of laziness and distraction.
khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen sku/ / khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bral med kyis/ / rnam dag chos skur ma rtogs mthol lo bshags/ /

In particular, I did not realize that the supreme secret support is the great-bliss kāya of the Guru-Protector inseparable. Through constant devotion and belief in you, I confess not realizing you as totally pure dharmakāya.

bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ / bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ / sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ / gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang / / lha mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /

Whatever I have done under the influence of ignorant delusion that opposes the body, speech, and mind of Guru-Protector and retinue, with a mind full of sorrow and regret I confess before your eyes, sublime deity.
ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ / k+She tra pA la dzi na mi tra dang / / TA k+ki rA dza trak+shad re ma ti/ / phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongs su gsol/ /
Awareness beings who carry out my commands, activity messengers Kṣetrapāla, Jinamitra, Ṭakkirāja, Trakṣad, and Rematī,[7] protectors of the ten directions and pure regions, please think of me. {585}
ji ltar khyed kyis (585) khas blang dam bcas bzhin/ / bdag gi phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la/ / yi chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis/ / gtong rag dus su ma thongs mthol lo bshags/ /
True to your word and commitment, straight away you accomplished my activities, but sadly I did not offer a flesh-and-blood torma feast; I confess not giving thanks in a timely way.
mngon shes med pas nyes skyon ma rtogs par/ / bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la/ / drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma bgyis par/ / gsang ba bsgrags shing byams bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /

With no clairvoyance, I did not realize the faults and mistakes of the doctrine’s destroyers and guru’s lethal enemies, and so I did not destroy them with wrathful activity; I confess disclosing the secrets and loving them.
dam nyams grib phog gtam 'dres zas zos dang / / rgyu chung phud nyams 'gal 'khrul nor la sogs/ / nyes skyon 'khrul pa'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/ / gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags/ /

Whatever errors, faults, and delusions I have committed, such as being contaminated by talking or eating with vow-breakers, or meager offerings, spoiled select portions, and mixed-up rituals; I confess with shame and regret.
sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ / gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ / thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ / rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /

I confess violating the sacred pledges of awakened body. I confess violating the sacred pledges of awakened speech. I confess violating the sacred pledges of awakened mind. I confess violating the root sacred pledges.
yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ / tshor te dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ / ma tshor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ / nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas/ /

I confess violating the branch sacred pledges. I confess consciously violating the sacred pledges. I confess unconsciously violating the sacred pledges. I have confessed in order to purify the defilement of violation.
bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ / pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la/ / dngos grub thams cad dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /
Guru and Protector with your entourage, please be patient with me, as parents with their child, and now grant me all the spiritual powers.
bshags dang bshags par bya ba ma dmigs kyang / / rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir/ / rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ / rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig /

Though the acts I confess and the act of confession are nonexistent, in order to purify the habitual patterns of discursive thought, I fully confess before the sublime object of my venerable guru. May I thereby attain great bliss.
gsum pa gnad dbab ni/
Getting Down to the Vital Point

mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ / sku mdog dmar po g.yas thod pa'i DA ma ru 'khrol zhing / / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ / bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ / sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ / chags pa'i nyams can/ / spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum dbang du sdud pa/ / skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ /

Above Protector’s head, my benevolent root guru is red and rattles a skull ḍamaru with the right hand and holds an elixir-filled skull cup to the heart with the left hand. The guru is so brilliant it is hard to bear, youthful and charming with a passionate expression, sitting in cross-legged position. Ḍākinīs and the three existences are brought under control just by the guru’s glance. {586}
