mgon po'i (586) dpral ba'i sin+d+hU ra'i thig le gru gsum gyi steng na yi ge hrIHdmar po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lang tsho ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs can/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs shing gar mdzad pa bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bo/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin tu babs par gyur/

At Protector’s forehead there is a triangular spot of vermilion, on which are thirteen red hrīḥ letters, the essence of noble Lokeśvara, Lord of the World. They completely transform into thirteen red secret ḍākinīs, youthful, with one face and two arms, holding small drums in their right hands and skull cups filled with elixir in the left. They stand in the posture of right leg bent and left outstretched, gazing with three eyes wide open and dancing; the essence of Tārā. They bring under control all sentient beings in the three realms. All needs and desires fall like rain.
oM badzra na ra kriM kriM hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ / ces pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/
oṃ vajra nara kriṃ kriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā Repeat one hundred times or more.

rang gi thugs ka'i hU~M las sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ phreng rdog ltar gnas pa la/ 'od zer sna lnga phreng thag gi tshul du brgyus pa/ rang gi zhal nas thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs pa mgon po'i thugs ka'i hU~M la thim/ yang hU~M las byung / mgon po'i lte ba nas thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i hU~M la thim par gyur/

A black mantra garland with red light rays emerges from hūṃ in my heart. It appears like rosary beads while the five-colored light rays thread them like a rosary string. It emerges from my mouth and enters Protector’s mouth, dissolving into the hūṃ in his heart. It arises again from hūṃ, emerges from Protector’s navel, enters my navel, and dissolves in the hūṃ at my heart.
de ltar rtag tu 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bsams la/
Imagine that it circulates continuously in that way, and say:

oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra bi g+h+nAn bi nA ya ka hU~M hU~M phaT ces pa dang / phaT gnyis dang / swA hA bsnan pa yi de nyer gnyis pa yang rung ste/ snying po ci 'grub bzlas/ drag po'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/

oṃ vajra mahākāla saparivāra kṣiṃ kṣetra vighnān vināyaka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ (say that and add a second) phaṭ (and) svāhā It is also appropriate to make it twenty-two letters [by those additions]. Recite the essence mantra however much. Do the visualization for the wrathful recitation:

oM shrI ma hA kA la shA sa na/ u pa hA ri NE/ e Sho‘pash+tsi ma kA lo‘yaM e daM rat+na tra yA ya/ a pa kA ri Ni ya di pra ti dz+nya/ sma ra si ta dA/ i daM duSh+TaM kha kha khA hi khA hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gr-ih+na gr-ih+na/ ban+d+ha ban+d+ha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mA ra ya hU~M phaT/ zhes pa ni drag sngags te/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum yang 'di la tshang bar bzhed do/ /

oṃ śrī mahākāla śāsana / upahāriṇi / eṣo ’paścima kālo ayaṃ idaṃ ratna trayāya / apakāriṇaṃ yadi pratijñāṃ / smarasi tadā / idaṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi / māra māra / gṛhṇa gṛhṇa / bandha bandha / hana hana / daha daha / paca paca / dinamekena māraya hūṃ phaṭ This wrathful mantra is said to include the three [injunctions to] call, curse, and kill.
oM shrI de bI hU~M phaT/ lha mo'i mtshan sngags so/ / b+h+yo ma mo nag mo bai tA li sin+d+ha ku lu ku lu hU~M phaT swA hA/ lha mo'i snying po'o/ /
Śrīdevī’s namesake mantra and essence mantra: oṃ śrīdevī hūṃ phaṭ bhyoḥ mamo nakmo vetāli sindha kulu kulu hūṃ phaṭ svāhā

oM k+She tra pA la bi g+h+nan hU~M phaT/ oM dzi na mi tra ba shaM ku ru hU~M phaT/ oM tA k+ki rA dza sa ma ya b+h+yoHdu dza hU~M phaT/ oM du yo ga dza (587) ma hA kA la trak+shad hU~M phaT/ las mkhan bzhi'i snying po'o/ /
The essence mantras of the four workers: oṃ kṣetrapāla vighnān hūṃ phaṭ oṃ jinamitra vāśaṃ kuru hūṃ phaṭ oṃ ṭakkirāja samaya bhyoḥ du jaḥ hūṃ phaṭ oṃ du yogja mahākāla trakṣad hūṃ phaṭ {487}
de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas mthar/
Do as much of those recitations as you can. At the end:
mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hU~M las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshim nas dgyes par gyur/

The tongues of the Protector and retinue become tubes of red vajra light arisen from hūṃ, through which they suck up the torma and drink it. They are satisfied and delighted by the undissipating bliss in their mind streams.

snying po'i mthar/ i daM ba liM ta kha kha khA hi khA hi btags pa'am/ oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra bi g+h+nan bi nA ya ka traka rag mo ba liM ta mAM sa rak+ta ru d+hi ra kha kha khA hi khA hi/
After the essence mantra, add idaṃ baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi or oṃ vajra mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra vighanen vināyaka trakrakmo baliṃta māṃsa rakta rudhira kha kha khāhi khāhi

de bzhin du 'khor rnams la snying po'i mthar/ i daM ba liM ta kha kha khA hi khA hi/ /zhes pa btags la lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ ma hA kA la sa pA ri wA ra Ar+g+haM sogs kyis mchod/ gong ltar nang mchod phul la/ /

Likewise after the essence mantras of the entourage, add idam baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi and offer three times each. Then offer with mahākāla sapārivāra arghaṃ…(etc.) and do the inner offering as before. [The praise:]
hU~M/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nA ya ka mnan/ /
hūṃ Homage to Swift-Acting Avalokita. Your bangled feet trample Vināyaka.[8]
nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ / phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ / g.yas pas gri gug bar pas phreng ba 'dzin/ / tha mas DA ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /
Great Black One in a tiger-skin skirt, your six arms are fully adorned by snake ornaments, top right hand holding flaying knife, the middle a rosary, and the last fiercely rattling a ḍamaru.

g.yon pas thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ / de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ / drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ / spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ / dpral bar sin+d+hU ra yi thig les byugs/ /

Your left hands hold a skull, a trident, and a lasso that catches and binds. Your wrathful gaping mouth fully bares fangs. You have three eyes, wild hair streaming upward, and a spot of vermilion anointing your forehead.

spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brten/ / khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ / rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ / shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ / dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /

King Akṣobhya is the seal above your head. You wear a garland of fifty blood-dripping human heads and a crown of five skulls with jewel finials. Come from your tree to accept the torma. Glorious Six-Armed One, I pay homage and praise.

sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / / dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod pa dang / / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ / rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / / ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ /

Strictly guard the Buddha’s doctrine, strictly honor the sovereignty of the Three Jewels, and for us, master, disciples, and entourage, please pacify all adverse conditions and obstacles and quickly grant whatever spiritual powers we desire.
lang ka pu ri gsum bsregs shing / / sangs rgyas bstan skyong bdud dpung 'joms/ / zhal gcig phyag drug nag po che/ / (588) 'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod la bstod/ /
Thrice you burned Laṅkāpurī to protect Buddha’s doctrine and conquer the devil hordes. With one face and six arms, Great Black One {589} with a fearsome form: I pay homage and praise.
b+h+yo/ khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na/ / tsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar/ / mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ / bdud kyi khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams/ /

bhyoḥ In a vast lake of seething, boiling blood, you sit astride a sturdy mule, ablaze with charisma. Dark blue, with one face and two arms, you hold a devil’s cross-scored stick and a bag of disease.
sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung / / gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed/ / thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ / ma gcig re ma ti la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Emanations of your body guard the Buddha’s doctrine. Emanations of your speech shake the three realms. Your immutable mind accomplishes beings’ welfare. Sole Mother Rematī: I pay homage to you.
hU~M/ dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' nyan pa/ / ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ / ma rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ / las byed pho nya bzhi la bdag cag bstod/ /

hūṃ Obedient ones in four directions around glorious Protector, action messengers who accomplish Awareness’s commands, spreading various emanations to subdue all malevolent forces, four action messengers; I praise you.
dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang / / me lha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang / / steng gi tshangs pa sa yi lha mo ste/ / sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Śakra, Yama, Varuṇa, Yakṣa, Agni, Rākṣasa, Vāyu, Bhūta, Brahmā above, and Earth Goddess; ten emanated direction protectors, I pay homage and praise.

dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / / dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams/ / sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ / mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ / mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang / / bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /

Seventy-five glorious protectors and armies of an ocean of the oath-bound: accept this flesh-and-blood torma and dispel adverse conditions and obstacles, grant favorable spiritual powers, and accomplish all entrusted activity for us yogins and our retinue.
thun gtor yod na sgron me btsugs te khang steng la sogs par 'bul zhing /
If you have an [end-of-] session torma, attach a flame to it and offer it on top of buildings and other [high] places.

dpal ldan mgon po ma hA kA la dang / / ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti/ / lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ / k+She tra pA la dzi na mi tra dang / / Ta k+ki rA dza bdud mgon tra k+shad sogs/ / dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ / 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /

Glorious Protector Mahākāla and Sole Mother Rematī, mighty one of the desire realm, sister and brother, and those who do not oppose your command, Kṣetrapāla, Jinamitra, Ṭakkirāja, the devil lord Trakṣad and others, glorious Great Black One and retinue: come here to accept this decorated torma.
sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig / dzam bu dwI pa'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig / dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig / sngar bcol las kyi gtong rag gnyan por 'bul/ /
Accept this red torma of flesh and blood. Accept this Jambudvīpa food. Accept this beer, the hero’s select portion. I offer it in strict gratitude for previously entrusted action.

da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ / 'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams zlog pa dang / / sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ / bdud dang bar (589) du gcod pa rnam mang po/ / thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /

Accept it now as strict supplication for entrusted action. Make your retinue my guards and repel adverse conditions. Grind into dust all the many forms of devils and obstacles— hateful enemies and harmful obstructors. {589}
bstan pa rgyas pa'i las ni myur du sgrubs/ / rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /
Quickly accomplish acts that spread the doctrine and perform the activities that yogins request.
thun gtor med na rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs spyi bstab 'di bya mi dgos so/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / zhes sogs dang /

If you do not have the session torma, it is unnecessary to do this general offering during regular practice. Repeat many hundred-syllable mantras. Say, “For whatever has been left out…” (ma ’byor ba dang…etc.) and
ma rnyed yongs su ma tshangs dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni bya min gang bgyis pa/ / de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /
Whatever was missing or incomplete, or anything I was incapable of doing, for whatever was not done here, I ask your reasonable forbearance.
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /
Guru-Protector inseparable, I go for refuge with devotion. May I dispel every afflictive emotion of all sentient beings.
oM khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /
oṃ You enact all benefit for sentient beings and grant them appropriate spiritual powers. Though you depart now for the buddha lands, please be sure to return again.
badzra muH
vajra muḥ
gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/
Awareness beings among the torma guests return to their natural abodes. Pledge beings dissolve into my heart.
rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam btab/
If there is a support image, do the request [to the awareness beings] to remain immanent. Make aspiration prayers.
↓ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ / byin rlabs chu bos skal bzang tshims mdzad cing / / rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i/ / chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /

Recite the Sealed Word of Auspiciousness: Qualities fully perfected like the snow mountains, from which blessing rivers quench fortunate disciples, you who reveal my own mind as coemergence: may there be auspiciousness of the sublime gurus, dharma sovereigns.
sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / / mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ / dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ / yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /
You watch over practitioners as your children, ever together like a body and its shadow, giver of spiritual powers to those with sacred pledge; may there be auspiciousness of the yidam deities.
dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brangs shing / / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ / sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ / chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi= /

You take care of practitioners holding vows and properly accomplish various awakened activity, such as pacifying, enriching, controlling, and subjugating; may there be auspiciousness of the dharma protectors.
snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ / bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ / yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / / bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i= /

Apparent existence self-liberates like illusion and dream, that is the experience of uninterrupted great bliss in the space of empty clarity without mental engagement; may there be auspiciousness of great-bliss mahāmudrā.
sgrub pa po la brten cing mchod pa dang / / skur pa 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ / thams cad byang chub lam la 'god (590) mdzad pa'i/ / mnyam med byang chub sems kyi= /
Whether they support and offer to practitioners or treat them with contempt, everyone will be placed on the path of awakening; {590} may there be auspiciousness of the incomparable awakening mind.
'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi/ / bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ / skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu= /
However many states of auspiciousness there are in all of cyclic existence and its transcendence, like the course of a great river of abundance; may there be auspiciousness for all beings always.

bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ / snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin tu khyab/ / tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ / yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog / ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /

May merit rise like the sovereign Supreme Mountain, great acclaim pervade everywhere like the sky, and long life, health, and others’ welfare be spontaneously present; may there be auspiciousness of an ocean of supreme qualities.[9] ↑
[Variations]

yang dpal ldan lha mo phyag bzhi ma la mos na/ phyag g.yas na ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang gri gug / g.yon na la bu'i rgyal mtshan dang thod rlon 'dzin pa/ yang na phyag gnyis ma g.yas ral gri 'bar ba dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka la yang srin po'i ya mgal sga'i snga ru byas pa khroM baM dang / ma mgal phyi rur byas pa la nad rkyal btags pa/ sngags kyang phyag bzhi ma la/ oM ma ma sarba tsa dur b+hak+Sha dzaH re ma ti 'ur ba 'ur ba/ sa ma tri ra dza hU~M hU~M phaT phaT/ phyag gnyis ma 'di la yang gong dkyus ltar gyi sngags dang / oM trag rag mo rak+ta ru d+hi ra hU~M phaT/ ces pa dang /

If you would rather do the four-armed goddess, visualize that her right hands hold a sword with a scorpion handle and a flaying knife, and her left hands hold a victory banner of [the skin of] a misbegotten child and a fresh skull. Otherwise, the two-armed version holds a blazing sword in her right hand and a blood-filled skull cup in the left. In both cases, the front part of the saddle is formed from the upper jawbone of a bloodthirsty demon, with the cross-scored stick and the lower jawbone forming the back part with the bag of diseases attached. The mantra for Four-Armed Śrīdevī is oṃ mama sarva cadur bhakṣa jaḥ / remati urva urva / samatrir / ja hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ. The mantra for this two-armed version is the same as the mantra given in the course of the text and oṃ trag rakmo rakta rudhira hūṃ phaṭ.

bstod pa'i skabs su yang phyag gnyis ma la/ ral gri 'bar ba dang ni thod khrag 'dzin/ ces pa dang / phyag bzhi ma la ni/ / mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ / ral gri gri gug rgyal mtshan thod rlon 'dzin/ / zhes 'don pa spo/

During the praises for the two-armed goddess, change the line to “holding a flaming sword and blood-filled skull cup.” For the four-armed, change the lines to “dark blue, with one face and four arms / holding a sword, flaying knife, banner, and fresh skull.”

las mkhan rnams kyang / k+She tra pA la smug nag dang / dzi na mi tra cang te'u dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ TA k+ki rA dza cang te'u dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dang / bdud mgon phyag bzhi pa/ mdung dmar beng chen tho ba thod khrag rnams 'dzin pa ltar byas kyang rung / yang dzi na mi tra g.yas rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam dang / g.yon gcod pa'i 'khor lo 'phen pa'am DA ma ru dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ TA k+ki rA dza spu gri dang thod snying 'dzin pa ltar ram/ / gshin rje gri thod 'dzin pa ltar yang rung / / yang phyag mtshan dkyus ltar las/ / dzi na mi tra ljang gu dang / TA k+ki rA dza dmar po byas pa yang yod de/ de dag thams cad gang ltar byas kyang rung ba'o/ /

The activity [protectors] also vary: Kṣetrapāla is dark brown, Jinamitra holds a small hand drum and blood-filled skull cup; Ṭakkirāja holds a small hand drum and makes the threatening gesture; the devil lord Trakṣad has four hands holding a red club, long beam, hammer, and blood-filled skull cup. These versions are also suitable. Moreover, Jinamitra holds a diamond in his right hand and throws a cutting wheel with his left, or else holds a ḍamaru and a wheel. Ṭakkirāja holds a knife and a skull cup with heart inside, or holds Yama’s flaying knife and skull cup. Alternatively, keep the hand implements from the main text, except visualize Jinamitra as green and Ṭakkirāja as red. Any of these versions is appropriate.

las sbyor gyi tshe zhon pa can du bya ste/ nges par lha mo dang bdud mgon phyag bzhi par bya/ dzi na mi tra seng ge dang / TA k+ki rA dza stag la zhon pa/ phyag mtshan snga ma ltar ram/ spyang ki la chibs pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par bsgoms la gtor ma 'bul ba yin no/ /

During the activity application (las sbyor), visualize the protectors on mounts. In that case, definitely visualize the goddess and the devil lord with four arms. Jinamitra rides a lion and Ṭakkirāja rides a tiger. Their hand implements are the same as before, or else they ride wolves and hold hooks and lassos. Meditating like that, offer the torma. {591}

'khor rnams rgyas bar (591) bskyed ma nus na/ gtso bo'i mngon rtogs kyi rjes su 'khor rnams kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa'am/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ dpral bar oM zhes pa man chad bya/

If you are unable to do the extensive visualization of the retinue, after the description of the main figure, just say their names or say, “Completely surrounded by an ocean of the oath-bound.” Then continue from “At their foreheads is oṃ…(etc.).”

gtor chog 'bring po ni/ 'khor mi bskyed par gtso rkyang bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa man chad bya/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyang dor bas 'grub cing / bsdus pa ni/ dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yin te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes sogs man chad bya ste/ / 'bring bsdus gnyis la gnad gsum gyi dmigs pa bor te gtor ma 'bul ba sogs bya'o/ / bsnyen pa'i dus ma yin pa rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs kyang phal cher phyi ma 'di nyid gtso bor bzung ngo / /

For a middle-length torma ritual, do not visualize the retinue; just visualize the principal figure alone and continue with the invocation. Make the offerings without the verses. The concise ritual is just an invocation of the awareness beings without visualizing the pledge beings. Recite from “Light rays radiate from the hūṃ in my heart, invoking Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Six-Armed Mahākāla from in front of the single trunk of a sandalwood tree in the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast…(etc.).” In both the middle-length and abridged versions, skip the visualizations of the three vital topics and just offer the torma and so on. Except for the times of the approach phase of recitation, generally this latter version is the main one for daily practice.

bdag bskyed ni/ spyir yi dam gang la brten kyang rung mod kyi/ gtso bor ni bde kye 'jigs byed rta mgrin rnams gang rung gcig la brten nas mdzad par snang ngo / / bdag mdun dbyer med du byed pa dang tha dad du byed kyang mgon po gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs 'di nyid dam/ / gsang sgrub rgyan can la brten pa sogs kyang man ngag khungs ma las kyang 'byung zhing / / lung rig dang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir shin tu rung mod kyi/ / 'on kyang las dang po pa rnams kyis dkyus ltar nyams su blangs na chog go /

Concerning the self-visualization, in general, any yidam is certainly permissible. It seems that Cakrasaṃvara, Hevajra, Yamāntaka, or Hayagrīva have been the main choices. You can make the self- and front-visualized deity inseparable, or keep them separate, according to this liturgical description of the principal deity alone, or based on such texts as Adorned Protector Secret Sādhana.[10] They are all drawn from source esoteric instructions, so there is no contradiction with scripture and reason. Therefore, they are certainly very appropriate. However, a beginner may want to do the practice as described in the course of this text.
'dir smras pa/ /
[Concluding Verses and Colophon]
de ltar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi/ / sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa 'di/ / dam pa snga ma rnams kyis yang nas yang / / gsal bar mdzad mod gzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /
This expression of the very short sādhana of the Guru-Protector Inseparable was surely well presented by past holy ones. This was done in response to others’ requests.
shin tu gsal zhing rgyas bsdus skyon bral bar/ / go bde'i tshig gis brjod na blo dman la/ / phan par 'gyur bas mos pa sna tshogs dang / / mtshungs pa'i rim pa so sor phye ba yin/ /
I have written the lines above, very clearly and neither too short nor too long, with the idea to benefit simple folk with various interests, and divided it into sequences fitting to the individuals.
dge des bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la/ / bar chad kun zhi mthun rkyen kun 'grub nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ / da lta nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /
Through this virtue may obstacles to awakening be pacified and all conducive conditions attained. May it become the cause for the immediate attainment of every common and supreme spiritual power.
gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ / skad cig tsam gyis tshar bcad de/ / zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/ / phrin las phyogs bcur spel bar shog /
May all those with toxic, angry minds be instantly eliminated; may pacifying, enriching, controlling, and wrathful awakened activity spread in the ten directions.

ces pa'ang mchog tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tA ra nA thas rang lo nyer bdun pa nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la legs par sbyar ba'o/ (592) (593)
At the request of many excellent spiritual mentors, the vagabond Tāranātha composed this at the age of twenty-seven on the eighth day of the waxing moon under [the constellation] Chitra Nakshatra.
@#/ /dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor chog rgyas pa'i kha skong dmigs rim dang bcas pa gsal bar bkod pa las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// // (594)
34. Spontaneous Accomplishment of the Four Actions. A Supplement to the Long Torma Ritual of Glorious Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, with a Clearly Arranged Sequence[1]
@#/ /na mo gu ru dz+nyA na nA thA ya/
namo guru jñāna nāthūya
spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul ni/ / bdud 'dul nag po chen po'i skur ston pa/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med der btud nas/ / gtor chog rgyas pa'i kha skong khrigs su dgod/ /
Magical emanation of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, displaying the form of Great Black Devil Subduer: Guru-Protector inseparable, bowing to you I will arrange this supplement to the long torma ritual.

rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tA ra nA thas mdzad pa'i mgon po'i sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba dgung grangs nyer bdun par mdzad pa 'di ni nyams su len bya thams cad tshang zhing gsal la rgyas pas mgon po 'di'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la med du mi rung ba'i yig cha yin la/ de las bsdus pa da lta'i sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi sdebs su bzhugs pa 'dir ni grib sel gnad dbab rgyas par 'dzud par ma gnang bas de dag gi bka' thob cing bsnyen sgrub byed pa sogs la cung zad mi bde bar mngon zhing gtor chog tsam la khyer bde bar mthong / yang de dag tshang zhing tshig tshogs shin tu bsdus pa dgung lo nyer gsum par mdzad pa zhigs kyang 'dug la/ gangs dkar sku gnyer nyi ma rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i ches bsdus pa 'di dag ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lta bur spros pa mi lcogs pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba yin no/

The all-knowing lord Tāranātha created a sādhana and torma ritual for Glorious Awareness Protector Six-Armed Mahākāla called Treasure Trove of Awakened Activity at the age of twenty-seven. Everything that is required for practice is complete and explained in detail therein, so it is an indispensable manual for yogins of this protector. A more abbreviated version is now included in Mine of Jewels: Sādhanas of an Ocean of Yidams.[2] However, this does not include the full versions of Dispelling Defilements and Getting Down to the Vital Point. So obviously it is somewhat inadequate for those who have received the permissions and wish to do the approach phase of recitation and so on. I see it as convenient for those doing only the simple torma ritual. There is also a text that he wrote at age twenty-three that is all-inclusive but extremely brief, and an even more concise version that he gave to Nyima Namgyal, the attendant at Gangkar (which is chapter 35). These are good as daily yoga practices for those who cannot handle elaboration.

'di dag thams cad la rang bka' spyi dang khyad par snying zhugs bla mgon dbyer med kyi byin rlabs dang khrid nos shing bsnyen sgrub nyams len sngon du song ba dag gis bdag mdun gnyis ka mgon po gtso 'khor du bskyed chog la/ bka' thub thun mong ba tsam las ma thob cing bsten sgrub sngon du ma song ba dag gis ni bdag nyid yi dam dang / mdun du mgon po (595) 'khor bcas bskyed pa nyid legs pa yin/ bdag bskyed yi dam gang rung du bsgom par gsungs pa ltar bka' gdams gsar ma bdag gis bdag bskyed rta mgrin gsang bsgrub la mdzad pas mtshon mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma yin kyang / rang re rnams kyi rgyun gyi lag len tu rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi lus dkyil rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa 'dis byed dgos pa yin/ gtor sgrub skabs lta bur rje btsun nyid kyis mdzad pa'i skyer sgong rta mgrin kyi las byang dregs pa kun 'dul nyid btang na 'brel chags shing ches legs par 'byung ba'ang 'phros su smos pa'o/ /

In all of these versions, those who have received the blessings and guidance of the general permission and particularly that of the Guru-Protector Inseparable Entering the Heart and have previously completed the approach and attainment practices may visualize both themselves and the one in front as the Protector and retinue. Those who have only received the common permission and have not done the approach and attainment stages previously would do well to visualize themselves as the yidam with the Protector and retinue in front. {595} It is said that any appropriate yidam may be used for the self-visualization—for instance, the new Kadampas use the secret sādhana of Hayagrīva as the self-visualization—so it is not restricted. However, in our practice tradition [we should use] the Principal Deities of the Five Families as the [self-visualization of one’s] body mandala according to the text of Venerable [Tāranātha] Rinpoche.[3] On occasions like the torma ritual, if you use Tāranātha’s own composition of Kyergangpa’s Hayagrīva activity manual called Subduing All Haughty Ones,[4] it will make a good connection [to our lineage] and turn out very well. I mention this as an aside.

'dir phrin las rgyas pa nyid gzhir bzhag rgyun tu de las cung zad bsdu bar 'os pa dang / gtor sgrub gtor chen nyer dgu'i dus mchod/ gzhan yang 'bar ma lta bu'i skabs kha skong bar 'os pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te 'bri bar bya ba la/

In this case, I took the extensive version of Treasure Trove of Awakened Activity as the basic text. Then I added any relevant materials, such as slightly shorter versions for daily practice, the torma rituals for the Great Torma Ritual on the twenty-ninth day [of the lunar month],[5] and additional occasions such as the Flaming [Mouth] offerings. Putting all that together, I wrote this text.
thog mar rgyun 'don lta bur mngon rtogs cung zad rgyas pas ma lcogs na 'di bya ste/
To begin, if you are not able to do the slightly extensive visualization description for situations like daily recitation, then do this:
oM swa b+hA wa sogs kyis sbyang /
oṃ svabhāva…(etc. purifies).

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M yig las byung ba'i/ rdo rje'i srung 'khor dur khrod chen po'i dbus/ paM las pad+ma raM las nyi ma'i steng / gi las tshogs bdag dkar po glang chen dbu/ la phug ne'u le 'dzin pa nyal stabs gnas/ /

From within emptiness the letter hūṃ becomes a protection circle and great charnel ground. In its center a lotus comes from paṃ and a sun from raṃ. From gi on top comes white Gaṇapati with an elephant’s head, lying prone and holding a radish and mongoose.

de steng hU~M las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan/ / 'od 'phros dgra bgegs tshar bcad 'phags pa mchod/ sems can don byas slar 'dus yongs gyur las/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po mthing nag 'bar/ / (596) zhal gcig phyag drug spyan gsum dmar la zlum/ /

On him, hūṃ becomes a hūṃ-marked flaying knife radiating light that annihilates enemies, makes offerings to the exalted ones, achieves the welfare of beings, and returns, completely transforming into Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, blazing blue-black, {596} with one face, six arms, and three round, red eyes.
zhal gdangs ljags 'dril 'jigs pa'i nga ro bzhad/ / smar smin dbu skra kham nag gyen tu brdzes/ / li khri'i thig le mi bskyod rgyal pos brgyan/ /
dang po gnyis kyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ / bar pas thod phreng bgrang zhing rtse gsum gsor/ / 'og mas DA ru 'khrol zhing zhags pa 'phen/ /

He holds a flaying knife and blood-filled skull cup in the upper two hands, tells a skull garland and waves a trident with his middle hands, and rattles a ḍamaru and throws a lasso with the lower hands.

mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po brdzis/ / thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal mdzad/ / stag lpags sham thabs dar dang rin po che/ / klu chen brgyad dang rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes/ / phyag zhabs dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba 'khrol/ /

His legs in parallel position press on the Obstructor King. He wears a dry skull crown and wet-head garland, a tiger-skin skirt, silks, and jewels. He is adorned by eight great nāgas, six bone ornaments, and strings of bells that jingle on his wrists and ankles.
sbom thung lto ba rgyas shing yan lag hrag / bzod dka'i gzi ldan bskal me 'bar ba'i klong / / tsan+dan sdong por sku rgyab bsten pa'o/ /
He is short with a protruding belly and thick limbs, unbearably brilliant in an expanse of blazing end-time fire, his body supported by the trunk of a sandalwood tree.

g.yon du khrag zhags 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong / / b+h+yo las lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug nag / drag shul nyams ldan sprul pa'i mtshon lnga 'chang / / dbu skra gyen brdzes rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan/ /

To his left, in the middle of a turbulent sea of blood and fat, bhyoḥ becomes Glorious Goddess, black mistress of the desire realm, with the expression of fury, bearing five magical weapons, her hair flows upward, adorned by a peacock feather fan.

lte bar nyi ma spyi gtsug zla ba 'char/ / snyan cha g.yas g.yon dug sbrul seng ge 'phyo/ / glang chen ba lang ko bas stod smad g.yogs/ / re lde'i sham thabs gsol zhing gos nag gyon/ / rus pa'i rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang / / me rlung dbus bzhugs dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /

The sun rises from her navel and the moon from her crown. Her right earring is a poisonous snake and the left a leaping lion. Elephant and ox hides cover her upper and lower body, she wears a thatched felt skirt and black clothing, is draped with bone ornaments and human-head garland, and rides a three-legged mule in the midst of fire and wind.
ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor/ / mdun du k+ShiM las k+She tra pA la mthing / / gri thod 'dzin cing dom nag smyon pa chibs/ / gnod sbyin gdug pa can gyi tshogs kyis bskor/ /

She is surrounded by a hundred thousand flesh-eating mātṛkā ḍākinīs. In front, from kṣim, black Kṣetrapāla appears holding knife and skull, riding a crazed bear, surrounded by a host of noxious yakṣas.
g.yas su hU~M las dzi na mi tra dmar/ / cang te'u 'khrol zhing sdigs mdzub me lce 'bar/ / gza' dang srin po 'jigs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /
To the right, from hūṃ, comes red Jinamitra rattling a small drum, flames blazing from his pointed finger, surrounded by a retinue of terrifying planets and rākṣasas.
rgyab tu TAM las TA k+ki rA dza nag/ / g.yas pas rgyu zhags g.yon pas sdigs mdzub sgreng / / 'khor du gsod byed gshin rje khros pas bskor/ / gsum ka rus pa'i rgyan dang stag sham gsol/ /

In back, from ṭāṃ, comes black Ṭakkirāja, in his right hand an intestine lasso, the left in pointing gesture, surrounded by a retinue of wrathful, murderous yamas. Those three wear bone ornaments and tiger skins.
g.yon du hU~M las bdud mgon trak+shad nag / ru mtshon thod 'dzin rta nag rting dkar chibs/ / bdud kyi chas ldan lha dang bdud dmag (597) bskor/ /
kun kyang khro gtum thod pa'i rgyan cha can/ / me rlung drag tu 'tshubs pa'i dbus na rol/ / de yi phyi rol phyogs skyong chen po bcu/ /
All are fiercely wrathful with skull ornaments and revel amid conflagrations of fire and wind, surrounded by hundreds of thousands of their own kind.
rang rang rigs mthun 'bum gyis yongs su bskor/ / gzhan yang lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' chen brgyad/ / 'jigs byed dgu dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /
Around are the eight gods, eight nāgas, eight planets, nine bhairavas, twenty-eight constellations, and the four great kings, each with retinues of millions.

rgyal chen bzhi rnams rang 'khor bye ba bcas/ / de yi phyi rol dam can sde brgyad dmag / gnod sbyin srin po sha za gshin rje bdud/ / ma mo'i cha lugs khro gtum mtshon cha thogs/ / gnam sa bar snang kun gang thams cad kyang / / sgrub po'i re ba tshul bzhin skong ba'o/ / kun gyi gnas gsum oM AHhU~M gis mtshan/ /

Outside them are the oath-bound, the armies of eight classes, wearing the garb of yakṣas, rākṣasas, flesh-eaters, yamas, devils, and mātṛkās; fierce and carrying weapons. They fill the sky, ground, and intermediate spaces, looking to fulfill the hopes of practitioners. All are marked in three places by oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
hU~M las 'od 'phros shar lho bsil ba'i tshal/ / tsan+dan sdong po'i drung nas nag po che/ / steng na bla ma g.yas na dpa' bo dang / / g.yon na dpa' mo mdun na bka' sdod bcas/ /

Light radiates from hūṃ to the Cool Grove in the southeast, invoking Great Black from in front of the sandalwood tree with the guru above, heroes to his right, heroines to his left, and servants in front.
skad cig nyid la DA ru g.yer kha'i sgra/ / sil sil khrol khrol 'ur 'ur byon par gyur/ /
Instantly with the sounds of drums and bells they arrive: sil sil, khrol khrol, ur ur.

zhes pa ni mngon rtogs 'dzin brjod bde bar bsdus pa ste/ / phrin las rgyas pa 'di btang phyin skabs rer mngon rtogs kyi tshig tshogs bsdus pa 'di tsam byed na ma gtor gzhan bsdur yod pa ma yin no/ / spyan 'dren gyi thog mar grub chen khyung pos mdzad pa 'di nyid bya ste/ /

This condensed version of the visualization description is easy to memorize and recite. For extensive activities, once this has been done, apart from doing just these condensed verses of the visualization description, there is no need for other brief [versions]. To begin the invocation, recite this passage by the great adept Khyungpo.
hU~M/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ / chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang / / gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ / lha chen ma hA kA la spyan 'dren no/ /
hūṃ Arise! Arise! Arise from the realm of phenomena. Without moving from within the pure phenomenal realm, you display the wrathful form to subdue the wicked. Great god Mahākāla—you are invoked.
nag po chen po gshegs su gsol/ / legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol/ / rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol/ / rig 'dzin srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /
Great Black One, please approach. Excellent Black One, please approach. War god of yogins, please approach. Guardian of awareness holders, please approach.
zhing skyong nag po gshegs su gsol/ / 'khor gyi dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol/ / 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ / k+She tra pA la gshegs su gsol/ / dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /
Black field protector, please approach. Armies of retinue, please approach. Attending retinues, hosts of yakṣas, Kṣetrpāla, please approach. Ocean of the oath-bound, please approach.

ma hA kA la mthu bo che/ / sku mdog mthing nag chen po la/ / dbu skra khams ser ral pa can/ / ral pa'i thor (598) cog gyen du bsgrengs/ / ral pa'i gseb nas me stags 'phro/ / me stags 'phros pas bgegs rnams bsreg /

Mahākāla, great mighty one, with massive body dark blue, golden-brown hair in dreadlocks, {598} your topknot locks streaming upward, sparks darting out from between them, shooting sparks that burn obstructors.
bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ / dam nyams dgra bo'i gdan steng na/ / brkyang brkum tshul du bzhugs pa ste/ / spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs/ /
In an expanse blazing like the final fire of the eon, on a seat of the enemy vow-breaker, you stand with feet straight and raised, three angry eyes darting like lightning.
rno gdug mche ba bgegs la gtsigs/ / sku stod glang chen ko rlon gsol/ / sku smad stag gi sham thabs can/ / thod rlon 'bar ba'i do shal 'phyang / / yan lag lhu tshigs sbrul gyis brgyan/ /

You snarl at obstructors with sharp, vicious fangs. You wear a fresh elephant hide on your back and tiger-skin skirt on the lower body, draped with a garland of fiery fresh skulls and adorned by snakes on your ankles and wrists.
nag po klu 'dul chen po khyod/ / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ / sdom dang sdig pa'i tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /
You are the great black tamer of nāgas, with spiders and scorpions shooting out from your every hair pore.
dam nyams dgra la sprul pa 'gyed/ / ral pa sprugs pas khams gsum 'gengs/ / stong gsum 'byung po rdul du rlog /
You disperse emanations to enemy vow-breakers, filling the three realms by a shake of your topknot and crushing the spirits of the universe to dust.
phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na/ / gnam lags 'bar ba'i gri gug gis/ / dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog rtsa gcod/ /
Of your six hands, the first right one wields a blazing meteorite flaying knife to sever the life of enemies, obstructors, and spirits.
phyag drug g.yon gyi dang po na/ / b+han+d+ha khrag gis gang ba bsnams/ / dgra bgegs klad khrag zhal du gsol/ /
The first left hand holds a blood-filled bhandha to drink the brain-blood of enemies and obstructors.

phyag drug g.yas kyi bar pa na/ / thod skam 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'dren/ / 'gro drug sems can 'dren pa'i rtags/ / phyag drug g.yon gyi bar pa na/ / kha T+wAM rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ / 'bras bu sku gsum brnyas pa'i rtags/ /

The middle right hand tells a rosary of blazing dry skulls as a sign of pulling out beings from the six realms. The middle left hand holds a khaṭvāṅga with three prongs as a sign of attaining the resultant three kāyas.
phyag drug g.yas kyi tha ma na/ / DA ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ / ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ / ma mo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol/ /
The lower right hand fiercely rattles a ḍamaru, taking control of mātṛkās and ḍākinīs. Mātṛkās and ḍākinīs, please approach!
'dir byon sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig / phyag drug g.yon gyi tha ma na/ / bdud zhags nag po bsnams pa ni/ / bstan pa bshigs pa'i rke la thob/ /
Come here to accept this flesh-and-blood torma; perform the action to liberate enemies and obstructors. The lower left hand holds a black devil lasso to snag the necks of doctrine destroyers.

khyod kyi 'khor gyi pho nya'i tshogs/ / mkha' 'gro ma dang shugs 'gro ma/ / gnod sbyin pho dang gnod sbyin mo/ / gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la'i tshogs/ / bran gyi tshul du khas blangs pa/ / dam bca' bzhin du 'dir gshegs shig /
Your retinue—hosts of messengers, ḍākinīs and powerful movers, male and female yakṣas, hosts of Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla— took vows to act as servants. Accordingly, come here now.
'bru bcud chang dang rak+ta khrag / mAM sa sha dang rus pa'i tshogs/ / dam rdzas (599) gtor ma 'di mchis kyis/ / phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /
Take this grain alcohol and rakta blood, maṃsa flesh and piles of bone, {599} pledge substances and this torma: please come here to accomplish the actions.

dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ / 'jigs su rung ba bskal pa yi/ / me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ / ma hA kA la mthu bo che/ / sde brgyad ma mo mkha' 'gros bskor/ / nag po mi zad bsam las 'das/ / lha mo dkar nag bgrang du med/ /

In the great charnel ground of Cool Grove, terrifying in the middle of a conflagration that burns like the fire at the end of the eon, great mighty Mahākāla is surrounded by the eight classes, mātṛkās, and ḍākinīs, unending and inconceivably dark, and countless white and black goddesses.
snang srid thams cad khyod kyi bran/ / srid gsum thams cad khyod kyi 'khor/ / dregs pa can rnams las mkhan te/ / stong gsum skad cig glog ltar myur/ / sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal bar rlog /

bdag cag dam tshig sgrub pa po/ / 'das dang bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ / spyan sngar zhal bzhes dran dgongs la/ / gtor ma ri la rak+ta mtsho/ / bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams tshang / / dam tshig ldan pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /

For us practitioners with sacred pledge, remember the promises you made before the past and present buddhas: come here to this place of sacred pledge with its mountains of torma, lakes of blood, and elixir swirling like an ocean, and complete outer, inner, and secret supports.
hU~M/ dad pa ni dam tshig sogs sbrel lo/ /
hūṃ By faith and by sacred pledge,…(etc.).[6]

mchod pa 'bul ba shin tu bsdu na/ / mchod yon sogs so sor mi bral bar lha rdzas bzang po'i phyi mchod 'di/ zhes dang / sngags kyang Ar+g+haM ma sogs chab gcig sbrel na rung / 'bring du byed na gzhung ltar dang / / rgyas par byed na de steng lha rdzas bzang po'i gzugs mchog 'di/ / ru pa zhes dang / de bzhin sgra snyan= shab+da= dri mchog= gan+d+he= ro mchog= ra sa= reg bya= zhes 'dod yon lnga mchod kyang 'bul/ yang mchod phreng tshig tshogs rgyas par spro na/ /

For a very brief offering, replace “drinking water” and the other specific offerings with “This outer offering of excellent divine substances…(etc.).” For the mantras, just recite them together, as in arghaṃ pādyaṃ…(etc.). For a middle-length offering, follow the main text. For the extensive version, as well as the foregoing, add the offering of five sense pleasures with “This excellent form, a divine substance…(etc.)” and insert rūpa [in the offering mantra]. Similarly, “music” and śabda; “sublime fragrance” and gandhe; “sublime taste” and rasa; “texture” and spareśa. Also, if you wish to do an extensive version of the offering verses, recite the following:
hU~M/ bla ma ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ / rdo rje'i dbang po rnam pa thams cad pa/ / mnyes byed phyi nang gsang mchod rdo rje'i sprin/ / dngos 'byor yid byung ting 'dzin rol pas mchod/ /

hūṃ I present actual and imagined offerings, a display of my absorption: vajra clouds of outer, inner, and secret offerings to please in all ways the vajra senses of my guru, Awareness Protector, and retinue.
dri med yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon sbreng / / dmar chen khrag gi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyo/ / yid byed mtshan rtog dwangs ba'i phyag rgya che/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas mdun sar 'bul/ /
I offer libation of pure drinking water with eight qualities, heaving waves of crimson human blood, and pristine mahāmudrā devoid of mind-made concepts to Awareness Protector and retinue.
oM shrI badzra ma hA kA la sa pA ri wa ra badzra ar+g+haM pra twits+tsha swA hA/
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra arghaṃ pratīccha svāhā
rnyogs med reg 'jam bsil zhing dwangs pa'i chu/ / gsod byed nag po (600) brtsegs pas sbags pa'i mtsho/ / nyes pa kun 'khrud dag byed a yi chab/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas zhabs la 'bul/ /
I offer limpid, smooth, cool washing water: {600} the water of A that purifies all defects in the ocean that was polluted by the killer Kālakūṭaḥ,[7] to the feet of Awareness Protector and retinue.
sngags thog mtha' sngar ltar la/
badzra pAd+yaM=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra padyaṃ pratīccha svāhā
ut+pal chu skyes sna tshogs 'dab brgya'i phreng / / dbang po rnam lnga dug gi me tog bkra/ / 'bar 'dzag bde stong pad+mo rab bzhad pa/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas dbu la 'bul/ /

I offer various flowers: utpalas, lilies, hundred-petaled garlands, the radiant blue lotuses of the five sense organs, and the open lotus of bliss-emptiness blazing and dripping to the heads of Awareness Protector and retinue.
puSh+pe= /
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra puṣpe pratīccha svāhā
sbyar dang lhan skyes dri bzang zhing kun khyab/ tshil chen dud pa'i sprin phung nam mkhar gang / / chos kun bden med sgyu mar rang shar spos/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas shangs la 'bul/ /

I offer produced and natural fine aromas pervading everywhere, smoke clouds of human fat filling space, and the self-arising incense of illusory false phenomena to the noses of Awareness Protector and retinue.
d+hU pe= /
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra dhupe pratīccha svāhā
nyi zla nor bu mar me'i snang ba brdal/ / zhun chen mar nag yi dwags me yis spar/ / kun rtog dbu mar thim pa'i 'od gsal ba/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas spyan la 'bul/ /

I offer the spreading light of the sun, moon, gems, and lamps, oil lamps of human fat lit by fires of the hungry ghost realms, and the lucid clarity of concepts dissolving into the central channel to the eyes of Awareness Protector and retinue.
dI pe=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra dīpe pratīccha svāhā
ga bur tsan+dan gur gum sbyar ba'i chu/ / khrag chen zhag gi spris chags sgron me lnga/ / nyid 'khrul lha sku rang shar byugs pa'i mchog / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas sku la 'bul/ /

I offer perfumed water of camphor, sandalwood, and saffron, the five lamps of human blood with congealed fat, and the sublime salve of dream’s delusion arising as the deity to the bodies of Awareness Protector and retinue.
gan+d+he= /
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra gandhe pratīccha svāhā
ro brgya nus pa stong ldan bza' bca'i rigs/ / dgra bgegs sha rus khyad par lcags kyu lnga/ / ma bsgoms 'tshang rgya ye shes zang thal bcud/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas ljags la 'bul/ /

I offer food of a hundred flavors and a thousand potencies, the five special hooks for flesh and bones of enemies and obstructors, and the quintessence of unhindered awareness to awaken without meditating to the tongues of Awareness Protector and retinue.
naiwi d+ya=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra naividya pratīccha svāhā
sil chol dung dang gling bu rnga bo che/ / dur khrod rdzas chen 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i sgra/ / lus gsum sbyangs pa'i sku gsum rang shar dbyangs/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas snyan la 'bul/ /

I offer cymbals, horns, flutes, and big drums, disturbing sounds coming from charnel-ground corpses, and the natural melody of three bodies refined as three kāyas to the ears of Awareness Protector and retinue.
shab+da=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara vajra śabda pratīccha svāhā

de tsam mam/ 'dod yon lnga'ang spro na/ snod bcud snang ba thogs bcas thogs med tshogs/ / yul shes rnam dag gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ / rang shar lha sku phyag rgya'i 'du 'phro yis/ / ye shes mgon po'i spyan mchog tshims gyur cig /

Leave it at that or continue with the five sense pleasures: May the vajra goddess of form, the totally pure object and consciousness of tangible and intangible appearances of the environment and its contents, and the merging and radiating of the mudra of self-arising deity’s form satisfy the sublime eyes of Awareness Protector and retinue.
oM shrI badzra ma hA kA la sa pA ri wA ra rU pa kA ma gu Na pra tI ts+tsha swA hA/
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara rūpa kāma guṇa pratīccha svāhā
zin dang ma zin phyi nang brjod pa'i tshogs/ / yul shes rnam dag sgra yi rdo rje ma/ / gzhom med rang byung sngags kyi sgra dbyangs (601) kyis/ / ye shes mgon po'i snyan mchog tshims gyur cig /

May the vajra goddess of sound, the totally pure object and consciousness of heard and unheard outer and inner expressions, and the melody of indestructible, self-arising mantra {601} satisfy the sublime ears of Awareness Protector and retinue.
shab+da=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara śabda kāma guṇa pratīccha svāhā
rang byung yongs su sbyar las skyes pa'i ngad/ / yul shes rnam dag dri yi rdo rje ma/ / 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por 'khyud pa'i dris/ / ye shes mgon po'i shangs mchog=

May the vajra goddess of smell, the totally pure object and consciousness of fragrance, whether concocted or natural, and the aroma of embracing Lucid Clarity Mahāmudrā satisfy the sublime noses of Awareness Protector and retinue.
gan+d+he=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara gandhe kāma guṇa pratīccha svāhā
ro mchog brgya ldan bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs/ / yul shes rnam dag ro yi rdo rje ma/ / 'pho med bde chen rtag pa'i sems byed kyis/ / ye shes mgon po'i ljags mchog=

May the vajra goddess of taste, the totally pure object and consciousness of food and drink of a hundred excellent flavors, and the unchanging great bliss of permanent contentment satisfy the sublime tongues of Awareness Protector and retinue.
ra sa= /
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara rasa kāma guṇa pratīccha svāhā
lhab lhub gos dang g.yang gzhi'i na bza'i tshogs/ / yul shes rnam dag reg bya'i rdo rje ma/ / dga' ba bcu drug lhan skyes 'khril chags kyis/ / ye shes mgon po'i sku mchog tshims gyur cig /

May the vajra goddess of touch, the totally pure object and consciousness of flowing clothes and animal furs, and the caresses of the sixteen ecstasies of union satisfy the sublime bodies of Awareness Protector and retinue.
spar+she=
oṃ śrīvajra mahākāla sapārivara sparśe kāma guṇa pratīccha svāhā

de nas nang mchod cung zad rgyas par spro na/ byin rlabs gong du ma song na 'dir bya/ song na gsar du mi dgos/ / mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor spyi bo snying kha ste gsang gi thad nas rim par bul bzhin tu/

Then if you would like to do a slightly longer inner offering, do the consecration here, but only if you have not done it earlier. Take [the inner offering] between your thumb and ring finger and sprinkle it as offering successively at the levels of the head, heart, navel, and crotch while reciting:
rdo rje 'chang dang dbang chen pad+ma 'byung / / sha ba ri pa mai tri rA hu la/ / khyung po rmog lcogs zhang sgom chos seng sogs/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Vajradhara and mighty Padmākara, Śavarīpa, Maitrīpa, Rāhula, Khyungpo, Mokchok, Zhangom Chöseng, and the rest; root and lineage gurus—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
'khor lo bde mchog dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus/ / sgyu 'phrul chen mo dgyes pa rdo rje dang / / rdo rje 'jigs byed ha ya grI wa sogs/ / yi dam lha tshogs zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Cakrasaṃvara, glorious Guhyasamāja, Mahāmāya, Hevajra, Vajrabhairava, Hayagrīva, and the rest; yidam deities—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
spro na gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar oM AHhU~M btags la 'bul/
You may also present the inner offering by adding oṃ āḥ hūṃ to the mantras of the principal and retinue.
myur mdzad ma hA kA la re ma ti/ / bka' sdod gnod sbyin bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ / gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs/ / dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /
Swift-Acting Mahākāla and Rematī, four attendant yakṣas and ten direction protectors, seventy-five protectors of pure domains and the rest; oceans of the oath-bound—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / / dkar phyogs skyong ba gnas dang gzhi yi bdag / skye bzhi lam rgyud lngas bsdus 'gro ba rnams/ / ye shes lhar gsal zhal du oM AHhU~M/ /

Heroes and yoginīs of the three places, virtuous protectors and lords of place and ground, migrators included in four ways of birth and five paths of being;[8] appearing as awareness deities—into your mouths oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
zhes 'bul la 'bru gsum brjod cing lhag ma rang gis myong ngo / /
After that offering, say the three seed syllables and taste the remainder yourself.
(1) [Guru-Protector Inseparable]

de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad gsum kyi thog mar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi skabs su/ bdag dang sems can thams cad mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'debs par mos la/ na mo bud+d+hA ya 'i (602) sngags bdun sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/

Now, of the three uncommon vital topics, the first is the Guru-Protector Inseparable.[9] Imagine that you and all sentient beings supplicate with one voice by saying the namo buddhāya mantra seven or more times. {602} Afterward, recite:
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag gis phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ /

Guru-Protector inseparable, I offer flowers and incense outwardly, five meats and five elixirs inwardly, the timeless awareness of bliss-emptiness secretly, and the sacred offering of suchness most secretly.
zhes dang dmigs pa chos drug dkyus ltar byas pa'i rjes su/
Do the visualization as taught in the course of the Six Dharmas. After that:
bdag gi lus la sku'i byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi lus la sku'i byin rlabs ma zhugs pa zhugs par gsol/ bdag gi lus la sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur to/ /
Please let the blessings of your awakened body enter my body. Please let any blessings of awakened body that have not entered my body enter. The blessings of awakened body have entered my body.

bdag gi ngag la gsung gi byin rlabs sogs dang / bdag gi yid la thugs kyi byin rlabs sogs dang / bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhes 'don pa spos te gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar/

Please let the blessings of your awakened speech…(etc. up to)…Please let the blessings of your awakened body, speech, and mind enter…(etc.). Change the recitation by substituting the words as necessary.

sku'i skabs su bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po dang mgon po'i dpral ba las mgon po sku chung la yan lag rags pa DA ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra sil sil khrol khrol hU~M phaT kyi sgra sgrogs pa dpag med byon te rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgon po'i sku dang dbyer med du gyur/

During the body blessings, visualize white light rays coming from the guru’s forehead and, from Protector’s forehead, countless miniature protectors with small bodies and thick limbs rattling ḍamarus and bells with sounds of sil sil, khrol khrol and shouts of hūṃ phaṭ. They dissolve into your forehead, purifying your body of all disease, demons, negativities, and obscurations. You receive the vase empowerment and become inseparable from Protector’s body.

des 'gres te/ gsung las 'od zer dang sku dmar po byon/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ mgon po'i gsung dang dbyer med du gyur/ thugs las 'od zer dang sku mthing kha byon/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / sher dbang thob/ mgon po'i thugs dang dbyer med du gyur/ gnas gsum ka nas 'od zer dang sku sna tshogs pa byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sgo gsum cha snyom gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / dbang bzhi pa thob/ mgon po'i ye shes rdo rje dang dbyer med du gyur par mos la/ /

Apply the same process: red light and bodies come forth, dissolve into your throat, purify your speech of all disease, demons, negativities, and obscurations. You receive the secret empowerment and become inseparable from Protector’s speech. Blue light and bodies come forth, dissolve into your heart, purify your mind of all disease, demons, negativities, and obscurations. You receive the wisdom empowerment and become inseparable from Protector’s mind. Multicolored light rays and bodies come forth from Protector’s three places, dissolve into your three places, and purify the disease, demons, negativities, and obscurations of your three doors equally. You receive the fourth empowerment and become inseparable from Protector’s awareness vajra.

kyai/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs kyis gsol ba btab gdung shugs bskyed pas mgon po'i zhal nas khyed kyi bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub bo zhes gsung lhang lhang bzhugs par mos/

Recite the supplication that begins “Kyai! Holy root and lineage gurus dwelling in the ten directions and three times,…(etc.).” By your developing intense longing, you distinctly hear Protector say, “I will remove all your obstacles. I will create all favorable conditions.”

slar mgon po'i sku lus thams cad las 'od zer dmar nag mang po chad pa dang / sngar gyi 'od zer dang mgon po de rnams rang gi sgo gsum dang dbyer med du 'dres/ lus sems thams cad bde bas gang bar bsam la bde stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang ngo la (603) mnyam par bzhag /

Again, many dark-red light rays break away from all parts of Protector’s body; the previous light rays and protector bodies all blend inseparably with your three doors. Think that your whole body and mind are infused with bliss and rest in the equipoise of innate, nonconceptual bliss-emptiness. {603}

yang lus kyi nang na mgon po de rnams gar mdzad cing nad gdon thams cad dmar chir chir zhal du gsol bar bsgom la 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / ces pa'i skabs su rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/ de nas gsol 'debs tshigs bcad ma ci 'grub brjod cing / bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub pa byed na skabs 'dir/ oM gu ru ma hA kA la sid+d+hi hU~M/ zhes bzlas bya'i snying po ste 'di'i bka' thob na skong gso'i skabs su'ang bzlas pa brgya rtsa tsam byed pa legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhing 'di'i dmigs pa ni gong gsal de nyid bskyar ba kho na'o/ / gzhung rkyang las sab kha 'di mi byed pa'i skabs su'ang dmigs pa ni gsol 'debs kyi skabs su 'gro dgos so/ /

Now meditate that within your body those protectors dance and gobble up raw all the disease and demons. Then say, “Please bless me on this very spot.” At this point, play intense music. Then repeat the supplication verse as much as you can. [“Guru-Protector inseparable,…(bla ma mgon po dbyer med la…(etc.).”]. When you are doing the attainment practice of Guru-Protector Inseparable, the heart mantra for recitation is oṃ guru mahākāla siddhi hūṃ. If you have received the permission, during the fulfillment practice (skong gso) it is good to recite it one hundred times as an auxiliary. The visualization is only the one described above. When you are practicing just the main text without these additions, the visualizations must be done with the supplications.
(2) [Dispelling Defilements]
gnad gnyis pa grib sel gyi skabs su rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis yod/
In the second vital topic, that of dispelling defilements, there are two versions: extensive and concise.
rgyas pa ni grib sel sger du sgrub pa sogs de nyid gtso bor ston pa'i skabs su bya rgyu yin te/
The extensive version is to be done on occasions where it is the main focus, such as the particular attainment practice of Dispelling Defilements.

de'ang bla ma rdor sems bskyed chog grub pa'i skabs/ steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa ba gsum dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku rdo rje rnam snang dkar po gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med dmar po thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sngon po'i rnam par byon te steng 'og rim pa gsum sprin gtibs pa ltar 'khod par mos la mos gus bskyed de/

During the ritual practice of visualizing the guru as Vajrasattva, imagine the Three Roots and all tathāgatas arrive in the space above—their vajra body in the form of white Vairocana, vajra speech as red Amitābha, and vajra mind as blue Akṣobhya. Imagine that they are lined up in three rows from top to bottom, like cloud banks, and generate devotion.

sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku la grib kyis phog pa dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams las yi ge brgya pa dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ bla ma'i dpral bar phog pas bla ma'i sku la grib kyis phog pa dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/

Vajra body deities, please cleanse and purify any defilements that have touched the guru’s body and all violations of the sacred pledges related to awakened body. With this supplication, white hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the deities of vajra body. They touch the guru’s forehead, cleansing and purifying the defilements that have stricken the guru’s body and all violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body.
zhes mos la yig brgya bzla/ de bzhin tu gsung dang thugs la sbyar te so sor yig brgya bzla/
Imagine that and recite the hundred syllables. Repeat the process for awakened speech and mind, reciting the hundred syllables each time.

de nas bla ma rin po che mgon po'i sku la grib kyis phog pa dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba nas yi ge brgya ba dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ mgon po'i dpral bar thim pas sogs

Then: Precious guru, please cleanse and purify defilements that have touched the Protector’s body and all violations in the sacred pledges related to awakened body. With this supplication, white hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the guru’s forehead. They dissolve into Protector’s forehead…(etc.).
yig brgya dang / gsung thugs kha bsgyur gong gis rigs 'gre/
Recite the hundred syllables and apply the process to awakened speech and mind, changing them appropriately.
bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ 'khor rnams kyi sku la sogs gsol ba gdab/ (604)
Guru-Protector inseparable, please cleanse and purify any defilements that have touched the retinue’s bodies…(etc.). {604}
bla ma dang mgon po gnyis ka'i dpral bar nas yi ge brgya pa dkar po'i tshogs sogs/
White hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the foreheads of both the guru and Protector…(etc.).
gsung thugs yig brgya bcas gong bzhin/
As before, do the same for awakened speech and mind, along with the hundred syllables.

bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ bdag sogs kyi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ /

Guru-Protector inseparable and retinue, please cleanse and purify all my and sentient beings’ negative actions, obscurations, flaws, downfalls, and violations of sacred pledge. With that supplication, white, red, and blue hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the three places of Guru-Protector inseparable and retinue. They touch my three places and those of others and dissolve, cleansing and purifying the defilements that have stricken our body, speech, and mind and all violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind.

zhes mos la yig brgya bzla/ / phyi ma 'di'i skabs su yig rnying nas bla mgon dbyer med kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa dang sgrags te dmigs bzlas so sor phye ba'ang bshad pas nus na de ltar yang bya'o/ /

Imagine that and recite the hundred syllables. Regarding this last occasion, the ancient texts state that it may be done with the visualization of taking the four empowerments, as described for the occasion of Guru-Protector Inseparable. Since it is also said that the visualization and recitation may be done separately, do it that way if you are able.
bsdus pa ni dgu gtor sogs kyi dkyus la sbyar bar bya zhing / / de'ang gong ma nyid cung zad bsdu ba yin te/
The concise version of Dispelling Defilements is done in the course of the torma ritual for the twenty-ninth day and others. It is a slightly abridged version of the one above.

rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya ba dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ bla ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/

Deities of three vajras, please cleanse and purify any defilements that have touched the guru’s body, speech, and mind and all violations of the sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind. With this supplication, white, red, and blue hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the three places of the deities of vajra body, speech, and mind. They touch the guru’s three places, cleansing and purifying the defilements that have stricken the guru’s body, speech, and mind, and all violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind.
yig brgya bdun/ des 'gre ste/
Recite the hundred syllables. Apply the same formula, making appropriate changes.
bla ma rin po che/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs la sogs dang / bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa sogs kyi mthar yig brgya bdun/
Precious guru, please cleanse and purify defilements that have touched the Protector’s body, speech, and mind…(etc.) (Afterward, recite the hundred syllables.)

bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi sgo gsum la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma mgon po'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ (605) 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshigs nyams chags thams cad dag/ / bdag gi lus kyi nang yi ge brgya pa'i 'od zer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur/

Guru-Protector inseparable, please cleanse and purify any defilements that have touched the retinue’s and my three doors and violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind. With this supplication, white, red, and blue hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the three places of the Guru-Protector. They dissolve into the retinue’s and my three places, {605} cleansing and purifying the defilements that have stricken the retinue’s body, speech, and mind, and all violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind. Within my body, the light rays of the hundred syllables cleanse and purify from the roots all negativities, obscurations, and downfalls.

zhes mos la yig brgya bdun bzla'o/ cho ga dkyus ltar la 'di'i sab kha mi byed pa'i tshe na'ang yig brgya nyer gcig la dmigs gnad 'di bzhin so so sbyar dgos so/ / de nas gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pas bshags pa byas la/

Imagine that and repeat the hundred syllables seven times. In the normal course of the ritual, without these additions, you must recite the hundred syllables twenty-one times while applying each of these important visualizations. Then do the confession with intense longing.
[Fulfillment]
skong rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsang sbyang /
Consecrate the substances for the fulfillment, and cleanse and purify [oṃ vajra amṛta…oṃ svabhāva…etc.].

stong pa'i ngang las/ b+h+rUM las gnas khang dur khrod drag po'i bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ hU~M yig nag po dpag tu med pa las byung ba'i/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas skong rdzas la sogs pa dgyes shing mthun pa'i rdzas ma tshang ba med cing phun sum tshogs pa/ ngo bo ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rnam pa ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes pa skong ba'i byed las dang ldan pa'i dam tshig gi mchod sprin tshad med pas nam mkha'i khams rgyas par gang bar gyur/

From within emptiness, the residence becomes a terrifying, wrathfully arrayed charnel ground arising from bhrūṃ. In its center, countless black hūṃs become the outer, inner, and secret support substances, accomplishment substances, offering substances, fulfillment substances, and other suitably pleasing substances. Nothing is left out of this excellent abundance. Its essence is the nature of timeless awareness. It takes the form of immeasurable offering clouds of sacred-pledge substances that serve to please and fulfill Awareness Protector and his retinue. The offerings expand to fill the realm of space.
na maHsarba ta thA ga te b+h+yo bi shwa mu khe b+h+yaHsarba thA khaM ung+ga te s+pha ra Na i ma ga ga na khaM swA hA/ / lan gsum/
namaḥ sarva tathāgate bhyoḥ viśva mukhebhyaḥ sarvathākhaṃ udgate spharaṇa imaṃ gagana khaṃ svāhā (Repeat three times.)
oM badzra spa ra Na khaM/ /
oṃ vajra sparaṇa khaṃ

hU~M/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rjes khros pa'i gar/ / myur mdzad ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ / thugs dam bskang phyir dad pas spyan 'dren na/ / dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs/ /

hūṃ Wrathful dancer of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, Swift-Acting Protector and your retinue, when I invite you with faith to fulfill your sacred pledge, by the power of sacred pledge, approach and remain here.
mchog gsum rtsa gsum sngags rgya ting nge 'dzin/ / chos nyid rten 'brel bslu med bden pa yis/ / mchod pa'i dam rdzas zhing khams kun khyab pas/ / mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes pa skong gyur cig /
By the truth of the Three Jewels and Three Roots, mantras, mudras, and meditative absorptions, may these pledge offerings that pervade all realms please and appease you, Protector and retinue.
mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang / / snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas rol mo'i sgra/ / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lhab lhub kyis/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /

Drinking water, washing water, flowers, incense, light, perfume, food, and the sound of music, parasols, victory banners, fluttering flags— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.

ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rgyal srid bdun/ / bkra shis rdzas rtags (606) brgyad dang dpag bsam shing / / yid bzhin nor sogs srid gsum dpal 'byor gyis/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /

Mount Meru, four continents, sun, moon, seven royal possessions, eight substances, auspicious signs, and wish-granting tree, {606} wish-fulfilling gem, and so on; the prosperity of three existences— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
'ja' 'od me tog char dang nor bu'i sprin/ / rin chen ri bo ma rmos lo tog 'bru/ / khrus rdzing skyed tshal 'dod 'jo'i ba mo yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Rainbows, flower showers, jewel clouds, gem mountains, grains harvested without cultivation, bathing pools, pleasure gardens, bountiful cows— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
sna tshogs gzugs dang sna tshogs sgra dbyangs dang / / sna tshogs dri dang sbyar ba'i bde bskyed chab/ / bcud ldan bza' btung reg 'jam gos mchog gis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Various forms and various melodies, various fragrances and their pleasurable waters, nutritious refreshments, soft fabric, and fine clothes— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
'jigs rung dur khrod drag po'i pho brang bkod/ / g.yang gzhi'i bla bre rgyu rlon lda ldi 'phyang / / zhing chen rgyal mtshan ro skra'i rnga yab kyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Terrifying charnel grounds set with wrathful palaces, animal-skin canopies, wreaths of draped intestines, human-skin victory banners, and human-hair fans— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
snying khrag ar+g+haM dug chu'i zhabs bsil dang / / dbang po'i me tog bam chen bsregs pa'i gsur/ / zhun chen snang gsal khrag mkhris zhag gi chab/ / ye shes mgon po= /
sha rus don snying ba liM ri ltar spungs/ / 'bru bcud dang sbyar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ / bsad khrag rba rlabs dgung du 'chel ba yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Flesh, bone, and organ baliṃ piled high as mountains, swirling oceans of elixir made from essential grains, and towering waves of murderers’ blood— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
thod rnga rkang gling rnga rol snyan brjid dbyangs/ / gu gul sha chen dug yungs bsregs pa'i spos/ / dar nag ba dan mi lpags g.yab mo yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /
bya nag rta nag drel nag dom nag dang / / g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag bcu gsum sogs/ / sna tshogs rgyan spras phyi yi rten rnams kyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Thirteen black birds, black horses, black donkeys, black bears, black yaks, black sheep, black dogs, and others, decorated with various ornaments; all outer supports— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
me long dar nag sngags byang btags pa'i mda'/ / bya rgod sgro dang gri lcags mde 'us spras/ / nal bu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs nang rten gyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Arrows with mirrors, black silk, and mantra texts attached, embellished with vulture feathers and iron-blade arrowheads, misbegotten-child victory banners and so on; all inner supports— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
srog sngags sman 'bru rin chen dar zab kyis/ / legs par bkang ba'i gri rgod tsit+ta dang / / nal bu dom nag snying sogs gsang rten gyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

The hearts of people killed by knives filled up with life-force mantras, medicines, grains, jewels, and brocade; misbegotten-child [skins]; black bear hearts; and so on; all secret supports— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
mkha' spyod dga' ma'i chos 'khor thabs shes kyi/ / b+ha gar rang sems bla ma dbyer med pa/ / snang stong sku la mi phyed gdung shugs kyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

My mind and the guru’s are inseparable in the bhaga of method and wisdom in the celestial woman’s dharma cycle, with strong undivided longing for the body of empty appearance— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.

bskyed rim lha bsgom bris 'bur sku yi rten/ / rlung (607) sngags bzlas pa srog 'khor gsung gi rten/ / phyag rgya ting 'dzin phyag mtshan thugs kyi rten/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /
b+han+d+ha zhA nag ber phod yon tan rten/ / zhi rgyas dbang drag las sbyor phrin las rten/ / drag po'i ru mtshon chas zhugs gar 'chams kyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Bhāndha, black hats, cloaks, and skirts, applied actions of pacifying, enhancing, controlling, and wrath: the awakened activity supports; wrathful banners, weapons, costumes, and dances— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
glang ko stag lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang / / thod phreng do shal phyag rgya rnam pa drug / sprul chun sin+d+hu ra yi byugs pa yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /
go mtshon sna tshogs rgyan gyi bye brag dang / / spyan gzigs dkor cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ / dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /
Various weapons, assorted ornaments, unimaginable presents and tribute, actually present and mentally emanated— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
bla med byang chub bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang / / las bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor srung bzlog drag shul gyi/ / mngon spyod rig sngags dmod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

Approach and attainment of unsurpassable awakening, magic diagrams of four actions, protecting, repelling, violent direct action, and application of mantras and curses— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
bcu drug rig ma'i dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed dang / / dug gsum khams gsum rtsad nas bcad pa yi/ / sbyor sgrol ga Na tsakra'i gsang pa yis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

The amusement of four ecstasies with sixteen awareness consorts, and the secret gaṇacakra of union and liberation that severs the three poisons and three realms at the roots— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
'bar 'dzag bde chen 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i ngang / / spros bral 'od gsal rang shar lha yi sku/ / mchog gi phyag chen thun mong grub brgyad kyis/ / ye shes mgon po= /

rten sgrub mchod skong khyad par dam tshig dang / / srid zhi'i dpal 'byor bde ba'i yo byad ni/ / chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthar thugs yongs su gang / / yid ches mos gus rtse gcig gdung shugs kyis/ / myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /

Supports for sādhana rituals, fulfillments, and especially sacred pledges; the prosperity of existence and peace, and excellent implements completely filling the far reaches of the realm of phenomena, and my intense belief, devotion, and single-pointed longing— Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
mgon po yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang / / blo 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i= / tshe bdag sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i= / ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i= /

Protector [and] Wish-Fulfilling Gem, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. King of Power [and] Increasing Intelligence, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Lord of Life [and] Diverse Ḍāka, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. One Mother Śrīdevī, may sacred pledge by fulfilled.
gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la'i= / dbang phyug dzi na mi tra'i= / gshen rje TA ki rA dza'i= / bdud mgon trak+shad nag po'i= /
Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Īśvara Jinamitra, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Yama Ṭakkirāja, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Devil lord Trakṣad, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu'i= / bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i= / sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyi= / pho nya las byed rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /

Seventy protectors of pure regions, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Ocean of oath-bound obedient ones, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Emanations and further emanations, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. Messenger and workers, may sacred pledge be fulfilled. {608}
thugs dam gnyen po dbyings su (608) bskangs nas kyang / / sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi/ / chags nyams 'gal 'khrul byang zhing sor chud nas/ / las dang dngos grub thogs pa med par stsol/ /

Now that the strict sacred pledge is fulfilled in basic space, purify and restore my violations, transgressions, and mistakes of root and branch pledges of awakened body, speech, and mind, and grant unrestricted actions and spiritual powers.
