chos 'khor dben gnas rnal 'byor 'khor bcas skyongs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen thams cad sol/ / byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog / 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun las skyobs/ /
mi nor zas gsum bshad sgrub 'du ba spel/ / rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par sgrub brgyud kyi/ / bstan pa yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas mdzad gsol/ /
Please increase people, wealth, and food for teaching and practice gatherings and expand like the waxing moon the Victor’s doctrine in general and the doctrines of the practice lineage in particular.
thugs bskyed thugs dam gnyan po ma bsnyel bar/ / mos pa'i bu la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs/ / lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang / / 'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /

Do not forget your sacred pledge of awakening mind, but always look with compassion after your devoted child. Please bless my body, speech, and mind and grant the spontaneous accomplishment of all my desires.
yang tshar grangs gsog bder lta bur de las bsdus par 'dod na chags med rin po ches mdzad pa 'di ltar bya ste/ /
If you want a shorter version that is conducive to accumulating multiple repetitions, then use this one by Chakme Rinpoche:[10]
hU~M/ myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ / thugs dam gnyan po bdag gis bskang / / nyams chags bskang la zhig ral gso/ / gnong 'gyod sems mkhon thams cad sbyang / /
hūṃ Swift-Acting Protector and retinue, I will fulfill our strict sacred pledge to repair my violations, restore what is damaged, and purify all my resentment of shame and regret.
gnam lcags rwa dang glog gi lce/ / sprin nag 'khrugs 'dra'i spu zhol can/ / g.yag lug dar snas brgyan pa 'dis/ / mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /
Yaks and sheep with meteorite horns, lightning tongues, and fur like turbulent black clouds, adorned with various silks— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
smyug ldems bya rgod sgro yis brgyan/ / gnam lcags ngar ma'i mdel gyis mthud/ / dar nag cod pan g.yo ba 'dis/ / mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /
Bamboo arrows adorned with vulture feathers, tipped with hard meteorite points, and fluttering black silk pendants— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi/ / don snying lag gis dmar 'byin byas/ / rin chen 'bru sman snying pos bkang / / mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /
Hearts pulled out raw by hand from enemies who hate the doctrine, filled with jewels, grain, and medicine— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang / / dbyer med myur mdzad mgon po la/ / yid ches drag po'i nges shes 'dis/ / mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /
Guru, the actual Three Jewels, inseparable from Swift-Acting Protector; with the certainty of my strong belief in you— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ / chang dang rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil/ / dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med 'dis/ / mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /

Human-blood tormas stacked like mountains, alcohol and rakta swirling like oceans, actually present and mentally emanated without limit— Awareness Protector and retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
khyed kyi thugs dam ngas bskang (609) gis/ bcol ba'i las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs/ / bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / / 'bod pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /
With your sacred pledge fulfilled by me, {609} my entrusted actions will be accomplished by you. When I attend to you, don’t be distant. When I call to you, don’t be hard of hearing.
sgrub pa'i tshe na gong ma g.yel/ / g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rdul/ / mngags pa'i tshe na bang ma bul/ / jo bor bsten no dbang ma che/ /
When I meditate on you, don’t wander off. When I beckon you, don’t look away. When I commission you, don’t be tardy. When I rely on you as lord, don’t be grand.
grogs por bsten na gzhung ma ngan/ / shag ltar bsten na khrel ma chung / / ma ltar bsten na snying ma sra/ / sring ltar bsten na zhe ma dan/ /
When I rely on you as friend, don’t be wicked. When I rely on you like a roommate, don’t be bashful. * When I rely on you like a sister, don’t be bad-tempered.
bran ltar bsten na snying ma ring / / sngar byas las kyi btang rag gtong / / da lta las kyi gnyer zas 'dren/ / phyi byed las kyi zhu skyem 'bul/ /
When I rely on you like a servant, don’t be inattentive. I give thanks for your past actions. I bring food for your current actions. I offer beverage for your future actions.
thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig / bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /
May our strict sacred pledge be fulfilled. Accomplish the requested actions.
de nas bshags pa ni/ /
Then the confession:

hU~M/ mgon po 'khor bcas spyan snga ru/ / bdag gis bag med dbang gyur bas/ / rten rdzas ma tshang mchod tshogs chung / / bskyed rim ma gsal sngags ma dag / rjen 'thag spos sbyor ma 'dzom dang / / bya khyi nag por 'tshe ba sogs/ / nyes pa gang mchis thams cad bshags/ / mi bsgribs tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /

hūṃ Protector and retinue, in your presence I confess whatever faults I have accrued through the influence of negligence: incomplete support substances, meager feast offerings, unclear visualizations, incorrect mantras, raw-flour [torma], lacking prepared incense, harming black birds or dogs, and so forth. Grant the spiritual power of undefiled purity.

'di'i lugs su man ngag gi yig brgya'ang bzla bar gsungs/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyis mdzad par grags pa'i skong ba de ni gnyan ston gyi gsung du mi snang la grong sngags pa mi mkhas pa rnying ma'i tshig rna bar thos bzhig gi las su dogs/ mkhas grub rje'i gtor chog tu bkod pa 'di'ang rje yab sras gang rung gi gsung las shangs lugs kyi yig rnying ni ma yin cing tshig tshogs cung mang bas 'dir khyer bder byas pa'o/ /

It is also said that you should recite the hundred syllables in the esoteric instructions of this tradition. The fulfillment ritual renowned as the work of Sangye Nyentön does not actually appear in Nyentön’s writings. I fear this must come from some uneducated village mantrin who heard a few words from the Nyingma tradition. The one arranged in the torma ritual by Khedrup Je[11] or from any of the writings of Je [Tsongkhapa’s] father-son lineage are not from the old texts of the Shangpa tradition and anyway are rather too wordy. Therefore I have written this easy-to-practice version.
de dag gong gi mthar yang dmigs bsal dgos pa dang 'brel na bstod bskul zlog pa dang 'brel ba 'di'ang bya ste/ /
After the above [liturgies], according to whether there is a particular need, do the following praise, exhortation, and averting ritual:
hU~M/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po ni/ / gnas la nges pa ma mchis kyang / / sems can so so'i snang ngo la/ / rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs ngos/ / dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ /

hūṃ Protector, mighty one on the tenth level, you have no definite residence, yet to the perception of individual beings you appear to the south of the Vajra Seat in the great charnel ground of Cool Grove.
'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog na/ / gshin rje'i ngar skad di ri ri/ / ma mo'i bshugs glu kyu ru ru/ / rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chi li li/ /
In that terrifying sublime holy site, death lords roar—di ri ri, mātṛkās whistle tunes—khyu ru ru, oceans of rakta swirl—chi li li,
tshil chen zhun mar lhabs se lhab/ / gsur chen dud pa chi li li/ / pho (610) bdud bro brdung chems se chem/ / mo bdud shon skor sgo ro ro/ /
human-fat lamps flicker—lhap se lhap, burning-corpse smoke wafts—chi li li, {610} male devils stamp-dance—chem se chem, female devils twirl-dance—go ro ro,
mi rkang gling bu kyu ru ru/ / gcan gzan ngar skad 'u ru ru/ / glog chen 'bar ba khyugs se khyug / 'brug sgra drag po chems se chem/ /
human thighbones blow—kyu ru ru, wild animals roar—u ru ru, blazing lightning flashes—khyuk se khyuk, violent thunder crashes—chem se chem,
gnam lcags ser chen sha ra ra/ / bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams kyi/ / 'jigs pa'i gad mos sa gzhig yo/ /
meteorite hail falls—sha ra ra, and the laughter of devils and bloodthirsty demons shake the earth.
de lta'i gnas mchog dam pa na/ / zhal gcig phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ / zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan rdeb cing / / spyan gsum dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /
In such a holy, sublime site stands your terrifying form with one face and six arms. In your gaping mouth your tongue curls against your palate and your three eyes blaze like the fire at time’s end.
rngams shing brjid la yan lag rags/ / drag po'i hU~M sgra 'brug ltar sgrog / lhun po ltar brjid mig sman mdog /
k+shiM k+shiM 'jigs pa'i bzhad sgra can/ / gri gug thod phreng cang te'u 'khrol/ / thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa 'dzin/ / gar mdzad dril bu'i sgra sgrog pa/ /
Laughing with the terrifying sound of kṣeṃ kṣeṃ, you hold flaying knife, skull garland, and rattling ḍamaru, blood-filled skull cup, trident, and lasso. You dance to the sound of ringing bells.
yum gcig ma mo kun gyi bdag / srog gcod shan pa gnod sbyin bzhi/ / phyogs skyong dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs/ / dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ / 'dir spyon mthun pa'i das rdzas bzhes/ /

One Mother, chief of all the mātṛkās, four yakṣas, murderous butchers, direction protectors, hosts of seventy glorious protectors, with retinues of oceans of the oath-bound: come here to accept these amenable pledge substances.
hU~M/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mtshan btags pa/ / mthu chen log 'dren rnams kyi gshed/ / phyag na rdo rjes mtshan btags pa/ / nag po klu 'dul chen po ste/ /
hūṃ Mañjuśrī gave you the name Powerful Executioner of Misleading Spirits. Vajrapāṇi gave you the name Great Black Tamer of Nāgas.
gshin rje'i gshed pos mtshan btags pa/ / rdo rje ro langs dur khrod bdag / gsang ba'i mtshan nas 'bod kyis spyon/ /
Yamāntaka gave you the name Vajra Zombie Lord of the Charnel Ground. Calling you by these secret names—approach!
bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ / g.yabs pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul/ / bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ / rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /
When I call to you, don’t be hard of hearing. When I beckon you, don’t look away. When I commission you, don’t be tardy. When I incite you, don’t use weak magic.
bskang ba'i tshe na thugs ma g.yel/ / gsol btab tshe na snying ma ring / / gtsang zhing tshang la ma nyams pa/ / dgyes pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho 'dis/ / do nub 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /

When I appease you, don’t be distracted. When I supplicate you, don’t be distant. By this ocean of pleasing pledge substances, pure, complete, and undamaged, this evening, with your retinue, may sacred pledge be fulfilled.
nyams chags ci mchis bshags par bgyi/ / sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gtong / / da 'chol las kyi rten du 'bul/ / bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /
I confess whatever violations I have committed. I give thanks for previous entrusted actions well done. I make offerings as support for actions entrusted now. Accomplish the activities I request!
hU~M/ khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ / bla ma dam (611) pa'i sku yi dgra/ / bstan bshig dam nyams dgra bo dang / / bdud kyi rigs gyur nag po'i phyogs/ / bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams kyis/ /

hūṃ Regarding my requests for your actions: {611} there are enemies who threaten the holy guru’s body, enemies who destroy the doctrine and damage vows, dark creatures who belong to a type of devil, and obstructing spirits who cause interference.
dkyil 'khor gnyen po dral ba ste/ / thub pa'i bstan pa bshig pa ste/ / rnal 'byor bshad sgrub gegs byed cing / / chos 'khor gnyan po bshig pa ste/ /
They violate the sacred mandala, destroy the Sage’s doctrine, obstruct the yogins’ teaching and practice, and ruin the sacred centers of dharma.
rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ / mi nor dge 'dun bcas pa rnams/ / bcol lo ltos so mthu ma chung / /
For us yogins and our entourages of people, wealth, and sangha: We entrust! We rely! No small magic!
nyin gsum bya ra ma g.yel zhig / mtshan gsum mel tshe ma g.yel zhig / 'gal rkyen zlog la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /
Don’t waver during the three watches of the day. Don’t waver during the three watches of the night. Avert adverse conditions and achieve favorable conditions.
[Exhortation]
hU~M/ dam nyams dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi/ / mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nyams par gyis/ / rgyab brten lha dang myur du khrol/ / mdza' bo kun dang rnam par phyes/ /
hūṃ Weaken the power and magical abilities of enemies and obstructors who violate vows, quickly liberating their supportive gods. Separate them from their companions.
khong nas snying byung srog rtsa chod/ / rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog / nyes can ltos la shor ra re/ / rtags phyungs mtshan ma myur du ston/ /
Tear out their hearts and sever their vital channels. Cut off their family lineage from its roots. See those criminals—they’re getting away! Quickly bring forth signs and show attributes.

gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis/ / bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra byas/ / rdo rje'i theg pa sun 'byin cing / / dge 'dun sde rnams dkrug cing 'joms/ / sdom brtson kun la brnyas shing smod/ / skye bo yongs la gnod cing 'tshe/ /
These noxious, hateful enemies threaten the holy guru’s body, disparage the Vajrayāna, disturb and suppress the sangha, insult and condemn monastics, and harm and threaten all beings.
rnal 'byor lha med zer nas brnyas/ / lta khyod mthu med zer nas smod/ / bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa 'di/ / lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ / ya ma rA dza'i zhal du thob/ /

They insult by saying, “Yogins have no gods.” They condemn by saying, “Your gods are powerless.” Regarding these enemies of the doctrine, don’t delay for months and years— feed them to the mouth of Yamarāja.
gshog pa can gyis mtha' nas chums/ / sder mo can gyis snying nas drongs/ / mche ba can gyis klad nas phug / las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded/ / mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus/ /
Make winged ones squeeze their extremities, those with claws hook their hearts, those with beaks pierce their brains, karmic winds push their backs, and black darkness greet them up front.
TA k+ki rA dzas g.yas nas chums/ tshogs bdag glang snas g.yon nas chums/ / gnam gyi 'ju thag chod la shog / sa yi lte phur thon la shog /
Ṭakkirāja, squeeze them from the right! Gaṇapati with your elephant trunk, squeeze from the left. Cut their cord to the heavens and strand them. Pull up their stake to the ground and strand them.
don snying lnga po phyung la shog / kha nas khong khrag skyug tu chug / ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thong / / bdud kyi sgo bro brdung du chug /
Extract their five inner organs. Make them vomit blood from their mouths. Send them eighty-four bad omens. Make devils stomp and dance.
btsan gyi zhags pa 'debs su chug / ma mo'i dal yams dgra la (612) thong / / bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa 'di/ / khram la babs kyis khram la thob/ /
Make tsen spirits throw lassos. Make mātṛkas send plague on these enemies. {612} Let those who become enemies of the doctrine be caught by the fall of the scored stick.
sho la bab kyi sho phye zhig / dam nyams las ngan sdig can 'di/ / lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ / rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston/ /
Let their number come up in the dice throw. To these evil vow-breakers doing bad actions, quickly display your signs and attributes. Don’t delay for months and years.

bcol pa'i las 'di ma byas na/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bcag / phyi rabs sngags 'chang sun yang phyung / / rig 'dzin bdag gi re ba bcad/ / sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po nyams/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig 'gal/ / thub pa'i bstan srung ming tsam gyur/ /

If you do not perform these entrusted actions you break the command of the victors of the three times, disappoint future generations of mantrins, dash the hopes of us awareness holders, damage your former strict sacred pledge, transgress the sacred pledge of root and lineage gurus, and become a guardian of the Sage’s doctrine in name only.
de bas dam la ma 'da' bar/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ / bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / ces pas bskul/ /
Better not to contravene your vows! Accept these amenable sacred substances and accomplish the entrusted awakened activity.
[Averting]

chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ / lha chen mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ / gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang / / 'tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa zlog /

From the vast palace of dharmakāya, great deity Protector and retinue, accept these amenable pledge substances, and for us yogins, master and disciple entourage: Avert others’ bad attitudes and behavior, thorn weapon magic,[12] and mustard-seed weapon magic.
'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa zlog / gshin rjes 'khor los bskor ba zlog / bdud kyis khram kha bstan pa= / ma mos khrag zor= /
Bhūtas hurling skull weapon magic—turn it back! Yamas spinning wheel weapon magic—turn it back! Māras displaying their scored sticks—turn it back! Mātṛkās hurling blood weapon magic—turn it back!
zhang zhung dzo dmar= / sum pas glang zor= / ban+des sngags zor= / bon pos brda zor= /

Red-metal weapon magic of Zhang Zhung—turn it back! Hurled-bull weapon magic of Sumpa—turn it back! Mantra weapon magic sent by Buddhists—turn it back! Symbol weapon magic sent by Bönpos—turn it back!
sngags pas kong zor= / skyes pas mda' zor= / bud med dmod zor= / mu stegs bar chad byed pa= /
Triangular-cup weapon magic sent by mantrins—turn it back! Arrow weapon magic sent by men—turn it back! Curse weapon magic cast by women—turn it back! Obstacles created by heretics—turn it back!
ngan sngags gdug pa'i rbod gtong= / klu yis byad du bcug pa= / the'u rang sris la rku ba= / rgyal pos smyo 'bog gtong ba= /
Evil dispatches sent by black magic—turn it back! Malediction sent by nāgas—turn it back! Souls stolen by teurang spirits—turn it back! Insanity sent by gyalpo spirits—turn it back!
drang srong gza' yi king kang= / ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= / ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu= / rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /
Kingkang of ṛṣi planets—turn it back! Eighty-four evil omens—turn them back! Three hundred and sixty calamities—turn them back! Bad dreams and bad signs,
lo kegs zla kegs zhag kags dang / / nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog / mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang / / rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa zlog /
obstacle years, months, or days, and four hundred and four diseases—turn them back! Obstacles made by ḍākinīs, zombies, and gyaltsen spirits—turn them back!
de la sogs pa'i gdug sems rnams/ / thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la b+h+yo/ / thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la b+h+yo/ / zhes so/ /
Those and all other malicious thoughts of all hateful enemies—bhyoḥ! All dangerous obstructors—bhyoḥ!
(3) [Getting Down to the Vital Point]

de nas gnad gsum pa mkha' 'gro dbang sdud ni gzhung gsal ltar la/ / gnad dbab ni rgyun tu mi bya zhing (613) dgos pa byung na 'di dang gong gi gnad gnyis po'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyang gud du shes par bya'o/ /

The third vital topic, bringing the ḍākinīs under control, is presented clearly in the source text. Getting Down to the Vital Point is not done in the daily practice. {613} If the need should arise, this and the uncommon esoteric instructions of the second vital topic above can be found elsewhere.
[Mantra Recitation]
snying po'i bzlas dmigs gzhung gsal ltar la/ rtsa sngags bzla ba'i tshe/
For the recitation of the essence mantra, follow the visualization in the source text. When reciting the root mantra, [visualize the following]:

rang gi thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer me 'od lta bu 'phros te mgon po'i thugs ka'i hU~M la phog pas/ mgon po khros 'khrugs rngams pas zhabs sa la rdebs cing zhal nas hU~M hU~M phaT phaT kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog / DA ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing 'khor rnams la spyan hrig hrig gzigs pas/ 'khor rnams rang dbang med par khros 'khrugs te rang rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur song bas bdag cag dpon slob sogs kyi chos sgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par bsam la shA sa na bzla/

Light rays like firelight radiate from the hūṃ in my heart and strike the hūṃ in Protector’s heart. Protector becomes wrathfully agitated and ravenous, stamping his feet and roaring with thunderous sounds of hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ. He violently rattles his ḍamaru and glares at his retinue. Powerless, they also become wrathfully agitated, and each one sends out replicas of themselves with boundless retinues to the ten directions, where they annihilate all obstacles to the successful dharma practice of master and disciples. Imagine that and recite śāsana…(etc.).

'khor rnams rang rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon bsgom/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dmar po 'phros te/ de dag la phog pas/ de dang de'i thugs rgyud bskul bar bsams la so so'i sngags bzla/ bzlas pa grub nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i

Each of the retinue meditates on their respective seed syllables on sun disks in their hearts. As the yidam, red light rays radiate from the seed syllable in my heart, striking all of them and evoking their mind streams. Imagine that and recite their individual mantras. When finished with the recitation, offer torma.
[Torma Offering]
thog mar sngar byin rlabs ma zin na chang dang / chu dang / byin gyis brlab pa'i nang mchod kyis rim par bran nas byin rlabs byas la/
If you have not already consecrated the torma, begin by sprinkling it successively with alcohol, water, and consecrated inner offering. Then for the consecration:
na mo/
namo
myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa ma g.yel zhig / ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti ma= / gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la ma= / dbang phyug dzi na mi tra ma= /
Swift-Acting Six-Armed Awareness Protector, don’t be idle. Sole Mother Śrīdevī Rematī, don’t be idle. Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla, don’t be idle. Īśvara Jinamitra, don’t be idle.
gshin rje TA k+ki rA dza ma= / bdud mgon trak+shad nag po ma= / gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga ma= / bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho ma= /
Yama Ṭakkirāja, don’t be idle. Devil lord Trakṣad, don’t be idle. Seventy-five protectors of pure regions, don’t be idle. Ocean of obedient oath-bound ones, don’t be idle.

bsgrubs bsgrubs bsten bsten pa rnams ma= / slob dpon brgyud pa'i srung ma= / bar chad bsrung ba'i dus la bab kyis ma= / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab kyis ma= / dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab kyis ma g.yel zhig /

I keep practicing and relying on you, don’t be idle. Guardians of the master’s lineage, don’t be idle. The time has come to guard us from obstacles; don’t be idle. The time has come to liberate enemies and obstructors; don’t be idle. The time has come to grant spiritual powers; don’t be idle.

mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags sogs gzhung ltar la dmigs pa dang bcas pas hU~M ring po drug brjod la so so'i gtor sngags kyis 'bul/ ar+g+haM sogs dang / / so so'i sngags la oM AHhU~M (614) btags pas nang mchod phul/ /

From the source text, recite, “The tongues of the Protector and retinue…(etc.).” With the visualization, intone the four long hūṃs and offer the tormas with the individual mantras. Offer with arghaṃ…(etc.) and add oṃ āḥ hūṃ to the individual mantras for the inner offering. {614}
Then entrust awakened activity:

gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan dam pa dang ldan pa/ dri dam pa dang ldan pa/ ro dam pa dang ldan pa/ reg bya dam pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ / dpal ma hA kA la/ mgon po legs ldan nag po/ bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpon/ srin po lang+ka bu ri'i grong khyer sum brtsegs brlag par byed pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ rig 'dzin gyi srung ma/ bla ma'i bka' srung / bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan/ legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin/ khro bo'i gzugs can/ za byed kyi sha gdong can/ ye shes kyi spyan ldan/ sha zan gyi gtso bo/ khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ mna' zan gyi gshed ma/ nag po 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor pa/ sha za bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ g.yas nas pho rgyud stong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ g.yon nas mo rgyud stong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ bka' sdod lha mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la= / dbang phyug dzi na mi tra= / gshin rje TA k+ki rA dza= / bdud mgon trak+shad nag po/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga= / bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa

This clean and cleanly made torma for offering and donating has sacred ornaments, sacred aroma, sacred taste, and sacred texture. The recipients for the offering and dedication are glorious Mahākāla, Excellent Black Protector, devil eradicators, commanders who defeat devils, annihilators of the rākṣasa’s three-tiered city of Laṅkāpurī, war gods of yogins, guardians of awareness holders, the guru’s command guards, sentries of the doctrine, regulators of good and bad, those with wrathful forms, those with faces of devourers, those with eyes of awareness, chiefs of meat-eaters, kings of blood-drinkers, killers of vow-breakers, and butchers of apostates—surrounded by retinues of one hundred thousand black ones, surrounded by retinues of one million meat-eaters, surrounded by retinues one thousand male protectors on the right, surrounded by one thousand female protectors on the left, attended by Black Goddess with retinue, Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla with retinue, Īśvara Jinamitra with retinue, Yama Ṭakkirāja with retinue, devil lord Trakṣad with retinue, seventy-five protectors of the pure regions, oceans of obedient oath-bound protectors, and retinues of armies:

khyed rnams kyis dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod cig / dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs shig / chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig / khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs thams cad myur du zhi zhing mi 'byung ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod snyan grags mnga' thang chos brgyud nyams rtogs la sogs pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyobs cing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsol cig /

All of you—accept this torma of sacred substance with ornaments. Guard the Buddha’s doctrine, honor the supremacy of the Three Jewels, protect the sangha’s dharma centers, and plant the victory banner of everlasting dharma. In particular, for us yogins and our entourage, quickly pacify and prevent all enemies, bad spirits, and obstructors who cause us obstacles. Spread and increase our longevity, merit, prosperity, enjoyments, fame, influence, dharma lineage, experience, realization, and so on. Protect us from all fears in this life, the next, and in between. Quickly grant us all supreme and common spiritual powers without exception.
ces phrin las bcol/
yang gtor chen sogs kyi skabs su/ (615)
For occasions such as the Great Torma Ritual: {615}

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba sun 'byin pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor bshig pa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i 'byung po las ngan sdig can mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /

Please perform actions to totally pacify those who threaten the glorious guru’s holy body, discredit the secrets of Vajrayāna, oppose the Buddha’s doctrine, degrade the status of the Three Jewels, and destroy the sangha’s dharma centers, as well as those who harbor hatred toward us—master, disciples, patrons, and entourage; those with evil thoughts; those with savage thoughts; bhūtas who lead astray; and all evil human and nonhuman bad actors with negative thoughts and violent deeds.

gal te de dag zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal ba lta na/ bsad pa dang / gzir ba dang / bskrad pa dang / rengs pa dang / rmugs shing lkugs pa dang / bsdigs shing sba bkong ba la sogs pa drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad de thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod cig /

In case you see that they are not subdued by those peaceful methods, finish them off by wrathful action, such as killing, oppressing, banishing, paralyzing, turning them deaf and dumb, intimidating, and threatening them. Reduce them to fine dust.

bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas la/ bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ dkon mchog dbu 'phangs smod pa dang / theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang / / bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ de dag nag po chen pos sgrol/ /

Guru-Protector and retinue, I present this offering torma. Those who degrade the Three Jewels, discredit the Vajrayāna, destroy or divide the doctrine, threaten the guru’s body, or hate us yogins: Great Black One, liberate them!
a mu ka mA ra ya phaT/ ces thal mo brdab bo/ /
amuka māraya phaṭ (Clap hands.)
de nas gzhung gi bstod pa myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyi 'phros su rgyas par bya ba'am/ res mos lta bu spro na/
Now, if you wish to expand on the praise in the source text that begins with “Homage to Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara…(etc.),” or to alternate,
use this one by the great brahmin Vararuci, Resounding Ferocity: Praise to the Great Black One:[13]

oM 'grub par gyur cig / dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i nang / / tshang tshing 'khrigs pa tsan+dan chen po'i tshal/ / bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ / bgegs chen bsnol ba'i gdan la rab tu bzhengs/ / ma hA kA la phyag drug brjid pa'i sku/ /

oṃ Let it be done. In the terrifying great charnel ground, the dense wilderness[14] of great sandalwood trees, amid fires blazing like those at the end of time, on a seat of the twisted body of Great Obstructor, you appear: magnificent Six-Armed Mahākāla.
sku yi cha lugs mi bzad 'bar ba la/ / dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa po/ / gsung gi nga ro mi bzad 'bar ba la/ / hU~M dang phaT kyi sgra yis stong gsum 'gengs/ /
The inexhaustible blazing[15] attire of your body are the attributes of the charnel grounds. The inexhaustible blazing roars of your speech are sounds of hūṃ and phaṭ that fill the universe.
rnam dag thugs ni mi bzad 'bar ba la/ / spros dang bral yang mtshan ma cir yang ston/ / (616) sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas khyod la bstod/ /
phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po'i gri gug ni/ / nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod cing dgra la 'phyar/ / phreng ba 'dzin pas skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs/ /
You sever the root of affliction and threaten enemies with the flaying knife in your first right hand. You account for migrators with the garland you hold.
DA ma ru yis mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ / 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ / g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa yis/ / dgra bgegs klad khrag zhal du gsol bar mdzad/ /

You bring ḍākinīs under control with your ḍamaru. I pay homage to the chief of transcendent ones. You consume the brain-blood of enemies and obstructors from the blood-filled skull cup in your first left hand.
mdung rtse gsum pas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ / zhags pas dam nyams ma lus 'ching bar byed/ / byin rlabs dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
You bring the three realms under control with the three-pronged spear. You bind the bodies of oath-breakers with your lasso. I pay homage to the giver of blessings and powers.
chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba med rtags su/ / sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba la/ / khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rtsa lngas brgyan pa bo/ / stag gi pags pa sbrul gyi chun pos mdzes/ /
As a sign of the immutable dharmakāya, your body color is a radiant dark blue. You are adorned by fifty-five blood-dripping heads and beautified by a tiger-skin skirt and snake clusters.
ma hA kA la khyod la bdag bstod do/ / bi nA ya ka bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ / krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs chen thal bar rlog /
I pay homage and praise you, Mahākāla. On a seat of twisted Vināyaka, your stamping feet smash the Great Obstructor to dust.
zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs shing rngams pa yis/ / dam nyams khong khrag 'dren cing zhal du gsol/ / mthu chen bgegs kyi gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
With voracious gaping mouth and bared fangs you draw and drink the vital blood of oath-breakers. I pay homage to the butcher of powerful obstructors.

spyan gsum me ltar 'bar zhing bgrad pa yin/ / khams gsum dbang du sdud cing rtsis la 'debs/ / dbu skra 'bar ba brdzes pa'i spyi bo na/ / mi bskyod rgyal pos rab tu brgyan pa po/ / dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

Your three fiery eyes are opened wide, taking control and accounting for the three realms. Above your beautiful, upward-blazing hair, King Akṣobhya fully adorns you. I pay homage to you who perfects the four powers.
hU~M/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ / bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ / thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /
hūṃ Arise! Arise! Arise from the realm of phenomena. Invoke! Invoke! I invoke you to care for migrators. I invoke your sacred pledge; perform the entrusted activity.
ma g.yel ma g.yel dpal ldan nag po che/ / skyobs pa shAkya seng ge'i spyan snga ru/ / bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ / las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /

Don’t be idle! Don’t be idle, Glorious Great Black One! In the presence of our refuge, Lion of the Śākyas, you promised to guard the doctrine and took an oath. Make good on the outcome of those actions.
skyes bu dam pa blo dang ldan pa yis/ / bstod pa 'di yis lan cig bstod byed na/ / pha ma bu tsha rnams la brtse ba bzhin/ / nag po chen pos rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /
If a wise and holy person repeats this praise just once, like a parent who loves their children, always support them, Great Black One. {617}
nag po chen po la bstod pa rngams pa'i sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'o/ / (617)
Praise [to Glorious Goddess] by Maitrīpa:
b+h+yo/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ / rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'tshubs pa'i pho brang na/ / ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tI/ /
bhyoḥ Amid a blazing expanse like the fire at the end of the eon, in a turbulent palace in a tempest of black winds, appears the one mother, queen of the desire realm, Rematī.

sku mdog nag mo char sprin lta bu la/ / thod skam dbu brgyan snyan g.yas seng ge 'phyo/ / g.yon pa sbrul 'khyil sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ / spyan gsum dmar 'khrugs zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ / 'jigs byed lha mo khyed la bdag bstod do/ /
Black as storm clouds, with a crown of dry skulls, right earring is a leaping lion, left a coiling cobra, three red agitated eyes, and gaping mouth with bared fangs— terrifying goddess, I praise you.
g.yas pa ral gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod/ / g.yon pa thod rlon dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol/ / sku stod zhing lpags sbrul nag ska rags bcings/ / sku smad glang chen ko rlon re ldes dkris/ /

You kill enemies with the blazing sword in your right hand and drink the heart blood of enemies and obstructors from the fresh skull in your left. A human skin tied with a black snake belt covers your upper body and an elephant hide cinched with a buckle on your lower body.

stong gsum bgrod phyir dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ / srin po'i ya mgal snga ru khram bam btags/ / gong smed sbrul nag nad rkyal dgra la 'phyo/ / mchod gtor 'di bzhes dgra bgegs sgrol la shog / bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /

To traverse the threefold universe, you ride a three-legged mule; the front of the saddle is a rākṣasa’s upper jaw with a scored stick attached, the saddle straps are black snakes; you shake a bag of disease at enemies. Accept this offering torma and liberate enemies and obstructors. Accomplish all the activities entrusted to you.[16]

b+h+yo/ bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ / rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'tshubs pa'i pho brang na/ / rta khrag mi khrag rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'khrugs/ / dam nyams dgra bo bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ / ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti/ /

bhyoḥ Amid a blazing expanse like the fire at the end of the eon, from a turbulent palace in a tempest of black winds, in an ocean of turbulent waves of horse and human blood, on a seat of the twisted body of the enemy vow-breaker, stands the one mother, mistress of the desire realm, Rematī.

sku mdog mthing nag char sprin lta bu la/ / dbu skra khams ser rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan/ / byang chub sems ldan spyi gtsug zla rgyas gsal/ / thod pas dbu brgyan snyan g.yas seng ge 'phyo/ / snyan g.yon dril 'khrol sbrul nag gdengs ka can/ /

Your body is blue-black like storm clouds, with tawny hair adorned by peacock feathers. Endowed with awakening mind, the full moon rises from your head. You wear a crown of skulls, a leaping lion as your right earring, the left is jingling bells and a coiling black cobra.

spyan gsum dmar 'khrugs glog ltar 'khyug byed cing / / zhal nas 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra chems chems sgrog / dpral ba'i dkyil nas gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs/ / shangs nas nad kyi rlung nag sprin ltar 'tshubs/ /

Your three red agitated eyes dart around like lightning and your mouth emits the fearsome sound of thunder—chem chem. Meteorite hail falls from the center of your forehead and black winds of disease billow like clouds from your nose.

'jigs pa'i zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril zhing / / a la la yi gad rgyangs 'brug ltar sgrog / stong gsum 'byung po'i tshogs rnams g.yo bar byed/ / 'jigs byed lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
phyag g.yas ral gri gri gug dgra (618) srog gcod/ / g.yon pas rgyal mtshan thod rlon snying khrag gsol/ / sku stod zhing lpags sbrul nag ska rags can/ / sku smad glang chen ko rlon re ldes dkris/ /

You kill enemies with the sword and flaying knife in your right hands, and hold a victory banner and fresh skull cup in the left hands, drinking their heart blood. You wear a human skin tied with a black snake on your upper body and an elephant hide with a black snake belt on the lower body.
stong gsum bgrod phyir dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ / srin po'i ya mgal snga ru khram bam btags/ / dgra bgegs thams cad khram la 'debs par byed/ /
nad ngan sna tshogs rkyal ba phyi shar btags/ / dam nyams dgra bo gtan nas brlag par byed/ / sbrul nag stong gi chun pos gong smed byas/ /
A bag of various virulent diseases hangs from the [saddle’s] back with which to annihilate forever the enemy oath-breakers. The saddle straps are clusters of a thousand black snakes.
bstan pa srung mdzad bdud mo 'bum gyis bskor/ / srog bdud chen mos dgra bgegs sgrol la shog / mi tri pas zhal gzigs dus bstod pa'o/ /

Surrounded by a hundred thousand demonesses who guard the doctrine— great demoness of life force, liberate enemies and obstructors! Maitrīpa offered that praise when he really saw her.[17] Lama Rāhula’s [praise]:
b+h+yo/ rnam dag dbyings la rang byung dpal 'bar ma/ / bdud rnams skrag mdzad rab 'jigs gzugs can ma/ / dur khrod chas kyis sku la rab brgyan ma/ /
bhyoḥ You are the self-arisen glory blazing in totally pure space. Lady who embodies the terrifying form that scares devils. Lady whose body is adorned with copious charnel-ground garb.
tshad med phyag bzhis thod khrag mtshon 'dzin ma/ / thugs rje myur mdzad dre'u chibs mdzad ma/ / bstan pa srung zhing rnal 'byor skyong mdzad ma/ /
Lady whose hands, the four immeasurables, hold blood-filled skull cup and weapons. Lady who rides a mule to quickly enact compassion. Lady who guards the doctrine and protects yogins.
las rnams sgrub cing bstan dgra tshar gcod ma/ / bstod cing gsol 'debs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /
Lady who accomplishes the actions and terminates enemies. I praise and supplicate you: perform the entrusted activities!
bla ma rA hu las rgyud 'bum nas byung ba'o/ /
Lama Rāhula took that from the Tantra Collection (rgyud ’bum).
[Another praise by Maitrīpa]:
b+h+yo/ dka' ba dang du blangs nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel ma gcig re ma ti/ / lus srog 'ban du bcugs nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / bsten pa'i tshe na ma gcig snying ma ring / /

bhyoḥ If I undertake hardships to accomplish your practice, Sole Mother Rematī, don’t be idle, don’t be idle! If I put my life on the line to accomplish your practice, Sole Mother Rematī, don’t be distant in your heart.
rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / bskul ba'i tshe na ma gcig bang ma bul/ / gtor ma ri ltar spungs nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / rbad ba'i tshe na ma gcig mthu ma chung /

If the rakta swirls like an ocean to accomplish your practice, Sole Mother, don’t slow your response when I exhort you. If the tormas are piled like a mountain to accomplish your practice, Sole Mother, don’t be weak when I incite you.
khyed kyi g.yog ni mi srun gdug pa can/ / chu srin gdong can dgra bgegs sgrol la shog / slad kyi rjes 'brang seng ge'i gdong pa can/ / dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod la shog /
With your rākṣasa-faced servants, unruly and obnoxious, liberate enemies and obstructors. With your lion-faced followers behind you, cut the life force of enemy oath-breakers.
ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis/ / sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad zlog pa dang / / mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /
Sole Mother Śrīdevī and your retinue, accept this red torma of flesh and blood. Please avert adverse conditions and obstacles, and grant all suitable spiritual powers. {619}
mai tri bas mdzad pa'o/ /
de nas 'khor gyi bstod pa (619) gzhung ltar ram/ cung zad rgyas par spro na/ /
Then do the praises of the retinue as in the source text. If you wish to do a little more:
hU~M/ mgon po'i bka' nyan phyogs bzhi'i las byad pa/ / mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul drag rtsal bsam mi khyab/ / srid gsum dregs pa yongs kyi sde dpon te/ / bka' sdod chen po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /

hūṃ Protector’s attendants perform actions in the four directions, with unimaginable strength, miraculous ability, and wrathful energy. Leaders of all arrogant ones in the three existences— I praise the great attendants and their retinues.
gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la mun pa'i mdog / gri gug phyar zhing thod khrag gtso la stobs/ / dom nag smyon pa chibs nas stong gsum bskor/ / drag gtum bzod par dka' ba khyod la bstod/ /

Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla, the color of gloom, brandishes a flaying knife, feeds the principal from a blood-filled skull cup, and rides a black bear to circle the threefold universe— I praise you, whose wrath is difficult to bear.
dbang phyug dzi na mi tra me ltar 'bar/ / zhal nas dug thun khrag gi ser ba 'bebs/ / cang te'u 'khrol zhing 'khor lo'i mtshon cha 'phen/ / 'jigs byed srin po'i gzugs can khyod la bstod/ /
Īśvara Jinamitra blazes like fire, magic poison and blood hail fall from his mouth, he rattles a small hand drum, and flings a weapon wheel— I praise you, terrifying in your rākṣasa’s body.
gshin rje TA ki rA dza rgyu zhags bsdogs/ / ha la'i mdog can sdigs mdzub bgegs la rngams/ / bltas pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs srog snying 'phrog / mi bzad gdug pa kun 'dul khyod la bstod/ /

Yama Ṭakkirāja twirls the intestine lasso, colored like hala poison, frightens obstructors by pointing and steals the vital hearts just by a glance at enemies and obstructors— I praise you, unbearable subduer of all malicious ones.
bdud mgon trak+shad dus kyi mun pa'i mdangs/ / rtse gsum snun cing thod snying zhal du gsol/ / ber nag chas ldan rta nag rting kar chibs/ / khro rngams sa gsum g.yo ba khyod la bstod/ /

Devil lord Trakṣad, with a radiance of the gloom at time’s end, pierces with the trident, eats the hearts from a skull cup, wears a black cape, and rides a black horse with white fetlocks— I praise you, fierce violent shaker of the three levels.
gnod sbyin lha dang gshin rje bdud kyi dmag / ma rungs 'jigs gzugs mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs/ / dam ldan skyong zhing dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed/ / rang rang ris mthun 'bum gyis bskor la bstod/ /

Armies of yakṣas, gods, yamas, and devils with terrifying, horrible forms, rain down weapons, protect keepers of sacred pledge, but execute the violators— I praise you, each surrounded by a hundred thousand of your own.
dpal ldan mgon po'i phyi 'khor las byed gtso/ / tshangs pa 'khor lo thogs shing ngang pa zhon/ / brgya byin glang chen steng gnas rdo rje bsnams/ / me lha ra zhon bgrang phreng ril ba 'chang / /
Chief actors in glorious Protector’s outer circle: Brahmā rides a swan and lifts a wheel, Śakra rides on an elephant and holds a vajra, Agni rides a goat and holds a round-bead rosary,

gshin rje ma he chibs shing zhing dbyug thogs/ / srin po ral gri phyir zhing ro langs zhon/ / chu lha chu srin steng du sbrul zhags bsdogs/ / rlung lha sha ba la zhon ba dan phyar/ / gnod sbyin rta zhon rin chen ne'u le btsir/ / dbang ldan rtse gsum thogs shing glang la gnas/ / sa bdag phag zhon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin/ / rang 'dra'i 'khor g.yog 'bum dang bcas la bstod/ /

Yama rides a buffalo and wields a club, Rākṣasa rides a zombie and brandishes a sword, Varuṇa sits on a makara and twirls a snake lasso, Vāyu rides a stag and raises a banner, Yakṣa rides a horse and squeezes a jewel-vomiting mongoose, Indra sits on an ox and holds a trident, Bhūpati rides a pig and holds a golden vase— I praise you all, with your hundred thousand servant retinues.

lha klu gza' dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ / (620) rgyal chen sde bzhi 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ / srid gsum 'byung po dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / bstan pa srung zhing sgrub mchog skyong la bstod/ /

Gods, nāgas, planets, twenty-eight constellations, {620} four great kings, nine terrifying ones, oceans of the oath-bound, and bhūtas of the three existences— I praise you, guardians of the doctrine and protectors of practitioners.
mchod bstod gtor ma phul ba dgyes bzhes la/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe sring ba dang / / rnal 'byor nyams rtogs ye shes 'phel bar mdzod/ /
Joyfully accept this offering torma, spread and enhance the Buddha’s doctrine, prolong the life of the glorious gurus, and increase yogins’ experience, realization, and awareness.
bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ / thams cad drag po'i las kyis tshar chod la/ / 'khor dang longs spyod bshad sgrub mthun pa'i rkyen/ / thams cad yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /

With wrathful actions, annihilate all enemies and obstructors who threaten the dharma and migrators. Increase like the waxing moon all conducive conditions for entourage, prosperity, teaching, and accomplishment.
ces bstod/
[Investiture of Power]
skabs 'dir khyad par gyi dus la sogs par mnga' gsol bar bya ste/ de'i 'don bya rgyas pa kho bos logs su bkod pa ltar dang / bsdu na rgyas lha khang ba blo gros seng ges mdzad pa ni/ /

At this point, do the investiture of power on special occasions. The extensive liturgy for that is placed elsewhere (chapter 39). For a shorter version, recite this one by the temple attendant Lodrö Senge:[18]
hU~M/ rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma dang / / dbyer med mgon po mnga' gsol lo/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang ngo bo'i phyir/ / yi dam mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ /
hūṃ Guru, the real Vajradhara, inseparable from Protector—power to you. Since you are the essence of Avalokiteśvara, supreme yidam—power to you.
sku bzhi mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas su mnga' gsol lo/ / theg chen dam chos thams cad kyi/ / mnga' bdag chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /
Since you manifest the four kāyas, perfect buddha—power to you. All Mahayana Holy Dharma’s great master—power to you.
'phags chogs dge 'dun thams cad kyi/ / gtso bo chen por mnga' gsol lo/ / thub dbang bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ / chos skyong chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /
All noble assembly of the sangha’s great chief—power to you. Since you guard the Buddha’s doctrine, great dharma protector—power to you.
lha chen rnams kyi gtso bo'i phyir/ / legs ldan chen por mnga' gsol lo/ / drag po'i las la dbang mdzad phyir/ / nag po chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /
Since you lead the great gods, great excellent one—power to you. Since you have the power of wrathful action, Great Black One—power to you.
gsang sngags rig 'dzin thams cad kyi/ / srung ma chen por mnga' gsol lo/ / rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan rnams kyi/ / dgra lha chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /
All Secret Mantra awareness holders’ great guardian—power to you. Sacred-pledge-holding yogins’ great war god—power to you.

bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ / mgon dang skyabs su mnga' gsol lo/ / thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa srung / / rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ / 'gal rkyen zlog cing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ / mnga' gsol don dang ldan par mdzod/ /

For all of us with our entourage, protector and refuge—power to you. Guard the doctrine of the mighty Sage, perform awakened activity for me, the yogin; avert misfortune and accomplish favorable conditions— make this investiture of power meaningful!

de ltar mnga' gsol rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang sku gzi mdangs bskyed pa'i dmigs pa ni/ mgon po'i spyi bor hU~M mthing nag khru gang ba gzi 'od 'bar ba zhig bsgom/ (621) de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs dang gzi byin thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas bsdus te hU~M de la thim pas hU~M sngon pas che zhing gzi brjid 'bar bar gyur te mgon po'i spyi bo nas thim thugs kar sleb pa dang / khro bo gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa ma he dang gshin rje pho mo brdzis pa gcig tu gyur te sku de nyid je cher song ba dang / /mgon po yang sku je che bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par gyur te mdun gyi nam mkha' gang ba tsam dang / stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing 'di gang ba tsam blos 'khyud tshad du bsgom zhing / mgon po'i 'od zer 'khor rnams la phog pas so so nas bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam zhing / stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na ye shes kyi mgon po 'di bas nus mthu che ba med ang snyam du bsam/

Whether you do a long or short investiture, this is the visualization for generating the brilliant charismatic form [of Protector]. Meditate on a brilliant, radiant dark-blue hūṃ, one cubit tall, above Protector’s head. {621} Light rays radiate from hūṃ and gather all the compassion blessings and abilities of the ten direction buddhas, bodhisattvas, deities, heroes, ḍākinīs, dharma protectors, and guards—and all the luster and splendor of the stable environment and moving inhabitants—in the form of light rays that dissolve into the hūṃ. The hūṃ grows larger and shines brighter. It enters through the top of Protector’s head and reaches his heart. There it becomes wrathful black Yamāntaka Vajrabhairava, with three heads and six arms, standing on a water buffalo and trampling on male and female yamas. That body grows larger and Protector’s body also grows larger with magnificent brilliance and splendor. First it fills up the space in front, then fills the whole universe of Endurance. Meditate as far as your mind can encompass. Light rays radiating from Protector strike his retinue and each of them also grows brighter and more magnificent. Imagine that and think, “There is nothing in the world system of Endurance with greater strength and capability than Awareness Protector.”

'di ni gtso bor mgon po bdag bskyed la bsgom rgyu yin kyang / mdun bskyed la'ang kha spo ba gong ma rnams kyis bzhed cing / spyir dpral ba'i sin+d+hU ra la brten nas mkha' 'gro dbang du sdus pa spyi bo'i mi bskyod rgyal po la brten nas rgyud 'jam du btang ba/ gshin rje gshed la brten nas gzi mdangs bskyed pa gsum po ni mgon po 'di sgrub phyin ma shes thabs med pa yin no/ /

This is primarily a meditation for the self-visualization of the Protector, but former masters also used it for front visualization. In general, these three points—bringing the ḍākinīs under control based on the vermilion spot on the forehead, softening your mind stream based on King Akṣobhya above the head, and developing brilliance based on Yamāntaka—are the three things that are crucial to understand once you begin Protector practice.
de nas rjes kyi las rim rnams ni gzhung nyid du gsal zhing tshang bar yod do/
The sequence of concluding practices is clear and complete in the source text itself.

phrin las kyi kha skong dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa 'di ni gtso bor gtor sgrub dang / dus kyi mchod pa rgyas pa la nye bar mkho zhing de dag gi dmigs ba'i gnad phal mo che'ang gsal bar bkod pas nongs pa mchis na bla ma mgon po thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa la snying nas bzod par gsol na tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal ba dang yig cha 'di dag gi'ang bka'i gnyer mdzad du gsol/

This single text containing the supplements to Awakened Activity is primarily intended for the Great Torma Ritual and other extensive holy-day offerings. The vital points of most of those visualizations are presented clearly here. If there are mistakes, I beg forgiveness of the Guru-Protector, mighty Compassionate One, and retinue. Please grant me the spiritual power of purity and also be the caretaker of these texts.

gsang sgrub dang bla mgon dbyer med snying zhugs gtso bo 'gyur ba'i thabs spyi dang bye brag gi gnad gdams thun mong ma yin pa rnams ni de dag so sor ltos pa las 'di dag gis gcig dpe kun 'gebs 'ong ba ma yin la/ gtor sgrub dang gtor chen gyi gnan (622) dang dmigs pa rnams kyang de dag so so'i zhal gdams las rtogs par bya ba kho na'o/ / de bzhin gtor chen sogs drag po'i las la nye bar mkho ba'i drag sku la sogs kyang phrin las 'di dang 'brel ba yin mod kyi rgyun tu mi mkho bas 'dir ma bris ba dgos pa byung na be bum dang yig rnying las len par bya'o/ /

The general methods for principally the Secret Sādhana[19] and Guru-Protector Inseparable Entering the Heart, and particularly their vital points and uncommon instructions, must be found in their individual [sources]. Other than that, there is not a single text that could include them all. {622} The application and visualizations of the torma practice and Great Torma Ritual can only be realized from their individual oral instructions. Likewise, in the Great Torma Ritual and others, the wrathful form and so forth required for the wrathful actions are certainly related to this Awakened Activity but are not always necessary and so were not written here. If the need arises, take them from the manuals and old texts.
[Concluding Verse and Colophon]
phrin las lhan thabs dad pas bris 'di yang / / sgrub brgyud rin chen rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab pa'i/ / cha rkyen mchog gyur des kyang skye 'di la/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med nyid 'grub shog /

May this faithfully written addendum to Awakened Activity be the excellent precondition for the widespread flourishing of the practice lineage’s ocean of jewels, leading me in this life to the accomplishment of the Guru-Protector Inseparable.

ces pa 'di'ang dpa' spungs yang khrod de bI ko Ti tsA 'dra rin chen brag gi mgul ye shes mgon po'i bsti gnas bsil ba'i tshal du nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te/ / rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus tshes bzang por karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos sbyar ba bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / dge legs 'phel/ // (623) (623)

In the secluded retreat on the slopes of Palpung, Devīkoṭi Tsadra Rinchen Drak, in order to make a needed connection with Awareness Protector’s hub of Cool Grove, Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso Trinle Kunkhyap Pal Zangpo compiled this on the excellent holy day of the Victor’s descent from the gods’ realm. May it be the cause for the spreading and flourishing of the precious doctrine. Let virtue prevail.
@#/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chog nyer bsdus bzhugs so/ /
35. Concise Torma Ritual for Swift-Acting Six-Armed Awareness Protector[1]
oM swa sti/
oṃ svāsti
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo/
Homage to Guru-Protector inseparable.
nang mchod gtor ma byin rlabs yi dam ltar bya/
Consecrate the inner offering [and] torma as in the yidam ritual.

rang gi mdun du pad nyi la hU~M las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa sku mdog mthing nag dang po gnyis gri thod/ bar ma gnyis mi mgo'i phreng ba dang rtse gsum/ tha ma gnyis DA ma ru dang zhags pa/ stag lpags dang mgo phreng rus pa dang sbrul dang phyag zhabs la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pas tshogs kyi bdag po mnan pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du rdzes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sin+d+hu ra'i thig le dpral bar byug pa/ tsan+dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /

Before me, on a lotus and sun, deep-blue Awareness Protector arises from hūṃ. He holds a flaying knife and skull cup in his two first hands, a human-skull rosary and trident in the two middle hands, and a ḍamaru and lasso in the last two. He wears a tiger skin and a garland of heads, and is adorned with bones, snakes, and bangles of small bells on his arms and legs. In the position of straight, even legs, he tramples on Gaṇapati. He has three eyes and bared fangs; his beard, eyebrows, and hair stream upward. He is crowned by Akṣobhya and anointed with a spot of vermilion on the forehead. He stands in the midst of a blazing mass of fire, the trunk of a sandalwood tree at his back.

de'i g.yon du b+h+yo las dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dre'u la zhon pa khram shing nad rkyal thogs pa/ mdun du gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la smug nag gri thod 'dzin pa/ dom nag smyon pa la zhon pa/ g.yas su dzi na mi tra dmar nag cang te'u dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu TA ki rA dza nag po spu gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du bdud mgon trak+shad ru mtshon dang thod snying 'dzin pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang swag l+h+wam gsol ba/ de'i phyi rol du dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/

On his left, glorious black Śrīdevī arises from bhyoḥ riding a mule and carrying a notched stick and disease bag. In front, dark-brown Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla holds a flaying knife and skull cup, riding on a crazed black bear. To the right, dark-red Jinamitra holds a small hand drum and wheel. Behind, black Ṭakkirāja holds a razor and blood-filled skull cup. On the right, devil lord Trakṣad holds a banner and skull cup containing a heart, riding a black devil horse with white fetlocks, and wearing a black silk cloak and rawhide boots. All around them are the seventy-five glorious protectors and an ocean of oath-bound hosts.

rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/

Light rays radiate from my heart, invoking Six-Armed Awareness Protector from in front of the sandalwood tree in the Cool Grove to the southeast. The root and lineage gurus are above him, grimacing heroes to his right, smiling heroines to his left, with armies of attendants, field protectors, messengers, and an ocean of the oath-bound.
oM badzra ma hA kA la sa pA ri wA ra k+ShiM nyer gcig /
oṃ vajra mahākāla sapārivāra kṣiṃ (Repeat kṣiṃ twenty-one times.)
badzra sa mA dzaHdzaHhU~M baM hoH
vajra samājaḥ—jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ
oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra bi g+h+nAn bi nA ya ka hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ zhes mang du bzla'o/ /
oṃ vajra mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra vighanān vināyaka hūṃ hūṃ phat phaṭ svāhā Repeat that mantra many times.
sngags de ka'i mthar/ i daM ba li ta kha kha khA (624) hi khA hi/ btags pa lan gsum/
Then add the following after the mantra and repeat three times: idaṃ baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi {624}

de bzhin tu/ / b+h+yo ma mo nag mo be tA li sing+ga ku lu ku lu hU~M phaT/ oM k+She tra pA la bi g+hAn hU~M phaT/ oM dzi na mi tra wa shaM ku ru hU~M phaT/ oM DA ki rA dza sa ma ya b+h+yo du dzaHhU~M phaT/ oM du yo ga dzaHma hA kA la trak+shad hU~M phaT/ zhes 'khor re re la i daM sogs btags pa gsum gsum/

Likewise, add idaṃ…to each of the following mantras of the retinue and repeat three times: bhyoḥ mamo nakmo vetāli sindha kulu kulu hūṃ phaṭ oṃ kṣetrapāla vighnān hūṃ phaṭ oṃ jinamitra vāśaṃ kuru hūṃ phaṭ oṃ ṭakkirāja samaya bhyoḥ du jaḥ hūṃ phaṭ oṃ du yog jaḥ mahākāla trakṣad hūṃ phaṭ

oM shrI ma hA kA la ya/ shA sa ni u pa hA ri NI e Sho a pash+tsi ma kA lo‘yaM i daM rat+na tra yA ya/ a pa kA ri Ni ya di pra ti dz+nya sma ra si ta dA/ i daM duSh+TaM ba liM kha kha khA hi khA hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gr-ih+Na gr-ih+Na/ ban+d+ha ban+d+ha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na mA ra ya hU~M phaT/ i daM sogs lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul/

Then repeat the following three times for the general oath-bound protectors, adding idaṃ…as before: oṃ śrī mahākāla śāsana / upahāriṇi / eṣo ’paścima kālo ayaṃ idaṃ ratna trayāya / apakāriṇaṃ yadi pratijñāṃ/ smarasi tadā / idaṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi / māra māra / gṛhṇa gṛhṇa / bandha bandha / hana hana / daha daha / paca paca / dinamekena māraya hūṃ phaṭ
ar+g+haM sogs mchod/ oM aHhU~M gis nang mchod 'bul/ /
Present offerings with arghaṃ…(etc.). Present the inner offerings with oṃ āḥ hūṃ.

hU~M/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nA ya ka mnan/ / nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ / phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ / g.yas pas gri gug bar bas phreng ba 'dzin/ / tha mas DA ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /

hūṃ Homage to Swift-Acting Avalokita. Your bangled feet trample Vināyaka, Great Black One in a tiger-skin skirt, six arms well adorned by snake ornaments, top right hand holding flaying knife, the middle a rosary, and the last fiercely rattling a ḍamaru.

g.yon pas thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ / de bzhin zhags pas bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ / drag po'i zhal nas mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ / spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ / dpral bar sin+d+hU ra yis legs par byugs/ /

Your left hands hold a skull, a trident, and a lasso that catches and binds. Your wrathful gaping mouth fully bares fangs. You have three eyes, wild hair streaming upward, and a spot of vermilion anoints your forehead.
spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal po'i rgyas btab brtan/ / khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ / rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ / shing las byon nas gtor ma len par mdzod/ /
King Akṣobhya seals the crown of your head. You wear a garland of fifty blood-dripping human heads and a crown of five skulls with jewel finials. Come from your tree to accept this torma.
mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/
Accept this torma I offer to you…(mchod sbyin gtor ma’di bzhes la…etc.).
bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs dang grib sel la sogs pa rjes 'di ltar byas kyang rung / yig brgya bzod gsol smon lam dang bkra shis brjod/

Continue with this supplication for your desires. It is also fitting to recite the supplications of Guru-Protector Inseparable, Dispelling Defilements, and so forth after this. Do the hundred syllables, request for forbearance, aspirations, and auspicious verses.
[Colophon]

phyag drug ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa khyer bde ba 'di ni/ gangs kar rdo rje gdan gyi sku gnyer ba nyi ma rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ tA ra nA thas pho brang gangs dkar du sbyar ba'o// //

This easy-to-practice Concise Torma Ritual for Swift-Acting Six-Armed Awareness Protector was requested by Nyima Namgyal, the caretaker of Gangkar Dorjeden, and written by Tāranātha at the Gangkar Palace.
mang+ga laM// (625)
@#/ /dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi bka' yig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa tsin+tA ma Ni'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (626)
36. Garland of Cintāmaṇi. Thirteen Major Authorizations for Six-Armed Mahākāla in One Place[1]
@#/ /bla ma dang myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
Homage to the guru and Swift-Acting Avalokita.
'gro ba kun la byams pa'i snying rje'i spyan/ / gdug pa can ngor sdang mig ltar gzigs ba/ / rgyal ba kun bskyed bla ma nag po ches/ / 'di dang gtan gyi bar chad kun sel mdzod/ /
With eyes of compassion for all migrators, you watch the wicked with seeming wrath, creator of all victors, Great Black One: remove all obstacles now and forever!
dpal ldan mgon po'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs tshul/ / ngo mtshar gsang ba zab mo nam mkha'i mdzod/ / mtsho skyes rdo rje bram ze yab sras sogs/ / grub mchog du ma'i rim pa las 'ongs phyir/ /
Glorious Protector’s tantras and sādhanas are an amazing, secret, profound sky treasury that came from a line of many sublime adepts, such as Padmavajra and the Brahmin succession.
mkhas chen rnams kyi thugs su'ang ma byon pa/ / dus gsum 'byon pa sgrol byed phreng ba las/ / shangs pa'i ring lugs rgyu skar bdag po gang / / sgo 'byed byin rlabs bka' rnams bshad par bya/ /

Since they did not appear in the minds of great scholars but like stars filled the masters of the Shangpa long tradition from the succession of liberators who appeared in the three times, I will open the door and explain the blessings and permissions.

snying rje drag po'i stobs su khyung pa'i gsang ba gsum gyis rtsod pa'i mtha' yi gdul bya ris su ma chad pa ma grol ba rnams btsan thabs su grol bar byed cing 'dod pa'i don yid bzhin tu stsol ba la ye shes dang / las dang 'jigs rten pa'i chos skyong ba gang gis kyang bskrun tu med cing sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog sgrub par byed ba myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos skor mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la rgya gar grub thob rnam gnyis kyis stsal ba'i gdams ngag nyid kyi thugs sras gtso bo rnam drug sogs la gnang ba dang / khyad par la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar nas brgyud pa'i stod lugs/ rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus nas brgyud pa'i smad lugs gnyis shin tu grags che zhing grub mtha' kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa las/ / mgon po stod lugs la dbang bskur rjes gnang man ngag gi rnam (627) grangs zab la rgya che ba bzhugs bar snang yang deng sang be bum rtsa ba tsam gyi lung rgyun dang / rjes gnang 'ga' zhig byin rlabs chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa tsam las rgyun shin tu dkon cing /

With the three secrets from the power of wrathful compassion, he uses forceful means to impartially liberate the beings to be tamed in the age of conflict and grants their desires like a wish-fulfilling gem. Unrivaled in awareness and actions, or by any worldly dharma protectors, the one who brings the accomplishment of the supreme state of a buddha is Swift-Acting Protector. That dharma cycle was granted to the learned adept Khyungpo Naljor by two Indian adepts.[2] He gave those instructions to his six main disciples and others.[3] In particular, the lineage from Könchok Khar of Latö is [known as] the upper tradition (stod lugs) and the lineage coming from Mokchokpa Rinchen Tsöndru is the lower tradition (smad lugs). These two are very well known and are held to be authentic by all schools. Of those, the upper tradition of the Protector was apparently complete with empowerment conferrals, subsequent authorizations, and profound and vast esoteric instructions. {627} However, these days the continuity is very rare, other than the reading transmission of the root text, [Khedrup’s] Book (be bum), and a few permissions that are combined into one blessing.[4]

smad lugs mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa 'di nyid rje rin po che yab sras kyi phrin las dang lhan cig dzam gling kun tu khyab pas gangs can du byon pa'i chos skyong zhig la mchod sgrub kyi phrin las kyang mgon po 'di nyid rgya che bar snang / 'di'i rjes gnang gi bka' srol sa kar sogs la rtsa ba mthing dkar gnyis tsam las mi bzhugs shing / de'ang grub mtha' rang lugs kyi lag len dang bstun pas rtsa ba'i gnad dang mthun min ci rigs 'dug /

As for the lower tradition, the lineage coming from Muchen Namkhai Naljor, together with the awakened activities of Je Rinpoche [Tsongkhapa] and his successors, have spread throughout the world, and for this one dharma protector that arrived in the Land of Snows, the activity of offering rituals appeared widely. Its permission systems of authorization in the Sakya and Kagyu and other [lineages] only exist for the main deep blue and white [forms] and no others. These are either compatible or incompatible with the main vital points of the practices of our school’s own tradition.

jo nang rje btsun chen po gong 'og la rnam par dag pa'i bka' srol 'ga' zhig 'dugs par 'dug kyang deng sang rin 'byung nang gi bka' lnga po las gzhan gyi rgyun mi bzhugs/ mkhas grub dge dpal bas bka' chen bcu gsum mtha' rten dang bcas par bsdus pa dang / gcig brgyud kyi bka' gsum/ be bum khyad par can gyi lung dang bcas pa dge phyogs su dar srol che zhing / mgon po 'di nyid brten pa la med du mi rung bar mthong nas/ lha mo gcig brgyud kyi bka' ma gtogs pa gzhan tshang ba kho bos kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas bka' drin tu thob pa yin no/ / de'i lugs la skyi shod sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las kyi yig cha mchis na'ang / 'dir rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' srol rgyun bzhugs pa rnams de nyid gtso bo byas/ mi (628) bzhugs pa rnams kha bskangs te bshad par bya'o/ /

The great Jonang Jetsun [Tāranātha asserted that] there did exist some former and later genuine teaching systems. However, they did not continue to the present time, other than the five permissions found in his Mine of Jewels.[5] There is the collection of thirteen major permissions including the supplemental support by Khedrup Gelek Palzang, the three permissions of the single [one-to-one] lineage, along with the special transmissions for the Book, which [remain] as a widespread system of virtue. Seeing that it was entirely inappropriate that there was no trustworthy basis for this protector, except for the teachings of the goddess’s single lineage, we have obtained all others directly from the mouth of the all-knowing Khyentse Wangpo, through his great kindness. In that system, there is the manual of Kyishöpa Tulku Tenzin Trinle,[6] but here we take as the main source omniscient Venerable One’s continual teaching system. Anything not contained in that will be supplemented. {628}
de'ang spyi shod pa'i yig char/

spyi'i mtha' rten brtul zhugs kyi rjes su gnang ba bcas kyi go rim du bzhugs na'ang / der mgon ser blo 'phel gyi bka' ma tshang ba dkyus su bcug / mgon po snying zhugs gcig brgyud yin pas zur du phyes pa'i bcu gsum dang / go rim yang sgrub thabs rin 'byung rtsa bar byas/ der ma bzhugs pa rnams kha bskangs te bshad par bya'o/ /

This is the sequence there, which includes general supplemental support and authorization for deliberate conduct. The permission for the Yellow Protector who increases intelligence was not usually included there. Protector Entering the Heart is from the one-to-one lineage, so separating that aside, there are [still] thirteen. He took the sequence mainly from the Mine of Jewels: Sādhanas of an Ocean of Yidams; whatever is missing will be added here.
I.
I. Removing All Obstacles
de la kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa bka' chen dang po rjes gnang bar chad kun sel rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab las byung ba la kha 'phang nag 'gros su bsdebs pa ni/ /
First, the root of all of them is the great permission of Removing All Obstacles borrowed from Venerable Rinpoche’s writings[7] and arranged for liturgical recitation.
oM swa sti/
oṃ svāsti

Well adorned by Avalokiteśvara, Tārā, and Vajravārāhī: great blessed Protector— bowing to you, I will explain the ritual to confer the absorption empowerment.

bar chad kun sel gyi bka' byed par 'dod pas gnas dben par nyer dgu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por maN+Dal zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing kha me ri can rtse mo tshur bstan pa/ dbus su nyi gdan drug la tshom bu sku mdog dang mthun par 'god/ phyi rol gru bcad dmar po/ zlum skor gyi phyi la'ang rdo rwa me ri bya/ der many+dzi'i steng du/ thod pa'i snod gang yang rung ba'i nang du/ bdud rtsi lngas spags pa'i gtor ma nor gzugs mche ba re 'god cing / 'khor gyi gtor ma bzhengs na/ snod de nyid du gnod sbyin la rtse mo g.yas su dkyus pa gru gsum/ las mgon la gru gsum phra mo/ gzhan gsum la zlum po phra mo re bya/ gtor ma chen po la mda' dar dang / tsakra yi btsugs/ 'bul gtor rgyas pa bshams na gtor sgrub yin la/ bsdu na zlum gtor che ba zhig mdun du bsham/ nang mchod dang / mchod pa gzhan rnams ci bde bar bsgrigs/

If you wish to give the permission for Removing All Obstacles, go to a secluded place on the twenty-ninth day of the lunar month or another propitious time. In the center of a circular mandala, draw a deep-blue triangular source of phenomena with a ring of fire, facing toward you. In its center, on six sun seats, arrange heaps [of grain] that correspond in color to the body colors [of the six figures]. The outer corners are red. Outside the circle, make the rings of vajras, fence, and fire. There, upon a mañji, place whatever skull vessel is suitable, filled with the five elixirs; and place each of those great “gem body” (nor gzugs ma) tormas. If you put out tormas for the retinue, in that same vessel [put] a three-cornered torma with the tip bent to the right for Yakṣa; a fine three-cornered torma for the action protector (las mgon); and for each of the other three retainers, fine round tormas. In the big torma, plant an arrow with a silk scarf and a deity card (tsa ka li). Extensive offering tormas are arranged for the Great Torma Ritual, but for a brief version, place one big round torma in front. Arrange the inner offering and other offerings in whatever way is nice.
de nas slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams la/ sum+b+ha sa bsang / swa b+hA wa sa sbyangs/ oM AHhU~M ha hoH (629) hrIH zhes byin gyis brlab/
Then, for the ritual master’s acts, put up the preliminary torma. Cleanse it with sumbha…(etc.) and purify with svabhāva…(etc.). Consecrate with oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha hoḥ hriḥ. {629}
phaiM badzra A ra l+li hoH dzaHhU~M baM hoH badzra DA ki nI sa ma ya s+t+waM/ dr-i sh+ya hoH sa mgron rnams bkug /
Invoke the guests with pheṃ vajra āralli hoḥ / jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ / vajra ḍākinī samaya stvaṃ / ḍriśya hoḥ

oM kha kha khA hi khA hi/ sarba yak+Sha rak+Sha sa b+hU ta pre ta pi shA tsi un mA da a pa sma ra DA ka DA ki n+yad yaH i daM ba liM gr-ih+Nan+tu sa ma ya rak+Shan+tu ma ma sarba sid+d+him+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu ya thai baM ya thaiSh+TaM b+huny+dza tha dzi g+h+ra tha pi pa tha mA ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kA ra ta ya sat+su khaM bi shud+d+ha ye/ sa hA yi kA b+hawan+tu hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ lan gsum gyis phul/ oM badzra ar+g+haM pra tI ts+tsha hU~M swA hA/ de bzhin du/ pA d+yaM/ badzra puSh+pe AHhU~M nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ /

Offer three times with oṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi / sarva yakṣa rakṣa bhūta preta piśāca unmāda apasmāra ḍāka ḍākinyādaya / idaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇāntu samaya rakṣantu mama sarva siddhi mem pryacchantu yataivaṃ yataiṣṭaṃ bhuñjaṭha jighraṭha pipaṭha mātikramatha / mama sarva kārātaya satsukhaṃ viśuddhaye / sahāyikā bhavantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā oṃ vajra arghaṃ pratīccha hūṃ svāhā…(similarly)…pādyaṃ…(etc.) (Then from) oṃ vajra puṣpe āḥ hūṃ…(etc. to)…śabda āḥ hūṃ
lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ / klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ / 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / / gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /
Eight great gods with your retinues, eight great nāgas with your retinues, the eight world protectors and hosts of yakṣas without exception,
srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / / 'byung po'i tshogs= / sha za'i tshogs= / smyo byed tshogs= /
hosts of rākṣasas without exception, hosts of bhūtas without exception, hosts of flesh-eaters without exception, hosts of crazy-makers without exception,
rjed byed tshogs= / ma mo'i tshogs rnams= / de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ / ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /
hosts of forgetful-makers without exception, hosts of mātṛkas without exception, those and others—hosts of spirits, none excluded; however many there are:
'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /
come here and pay attention to me. May we yogins and our retinues…(etc. to) …accomplish all that we desire.
dam can khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ / las la srung ba dam pa dang / / yul phyogs 'di dang sbyin bdag dang / / slob ma la yang shis par mdzod/ /
You oath-bound ones who guard the activities of this mandala: make this area and these patrons and also these disciples auspicious.
gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i/ / 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa/ / gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la/ / da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs/ /
Whatever groups of spirits are here not empowered to see the secret conduct, take this leftover torma and go elsewhere right now.
ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na/ / rdo rje 'dzin chen khros ba'i bkas/ / mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sprin spros nas/ / lus sems rdul du brlag ta re/ /
If somehow you do not leave, the command of the wrathful great vajra holder will emanate a cloud of blazing weapons and reduce your body and mind to dust—beware!
zhes gtor ma phyir dor la drag sngags rol mo bcas mtshams bcad/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni gong ltar bsang sbyang /
At this juncture, throw the torma outside with wrathful mantras and music. For the consecration of the place and equipment, cleanse and purify as before.

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i b+h+rUM las gnas khang gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oM AHhU~M rnams las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ (630) mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ yul dus chad pa med par yongs su khyab cing / rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung byed las rang gzhan mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshims par byed pas phyi nang thams cad du gang bar gyur/

From within emptiness, the protection circle arises from the letter hūṃ. Within that, the dwelling place arising from bhrūṃ becomes a celestial palace with all characteristics totally perfect. Inside, abundant excellent offering articles made of divine substances arise from oṃ āḥ hūṃ—offering water, washing water, flowers, incense, light, perfume, music, and so forth. {630} They completely pervade without interruption of place or time. The unimaginable emanations are in nature the timeless awareness of great bliss. In form they are cloud banks of offering substances that function to satisfy everyone, self and others, through undissipating bliss, filling up everywhere outside and inside the palace.

oM badzra ar+g+haM swA hA/ de bzhin du/ pA d+yaM= oM badzra pu Sh+pe AHhU~M/ de bzhin du/ d+hU pe/ A lo ke gan+d+he/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da AHhU~M/ oM sarba bid pU ra pU ra/ su ra su ra/ A brta ya A brta ya hoH oM badzra s+pha ra Na khaM/ rol mos byin 'bebs shing /

oṃ vajra arghaṃ svāhā (similarly)…pādyam svāhā oṃ vajra puṣpe āḥ hūṃ /…āloke…gendhe…naividya…śabda āḥ hūṃ oṃ sarva vida pūra pūra / sura sura / āvartaya āvartaya hoḥ / oṃ vajra spharaṇa khaṃ Play music to bring down blessings.

oM badzra g+hANaDe ra Ni ta/ pra ra Ni ta/ saM pra ra Ni ta/ sarba bud+d+ha k+She tra pra tsA li te/ pra dz+nyA pA ra mi tA nA da sam+b+ha wa te badzra d+harma hr-i da ya san+to Sha ni hU~M hU~M hoHhoHhoHAHkhaM swA hA/ zhes lan gsum brjod/

oṃ vajra ghāṇḍeraṇita / praraṇita / saṃpraraṇita / sarva buddha kṣetra pracālite / prajñāpāramitā nāda sambhavate vajra dharma hṛdaya santoṣani hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ hoḥ hoḥ āḥ khaṃ svāhā (Repeat three times.)

de nas bdag bskyed ni/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub bam rgyud sde gang yang rung ba la bya chog kyang / rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi lus dkyil tsam la brten pa ches legs pas de'i yig cha zur gsal ltar/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ skyabs sems srung 'khor nas brtsams/ bzlas pa/ bsdu ldangs kyi bar du grub pa dang /

Then for the self-visualization, you may follow the Hayagrīva Secret Sādhana or any other suitable practice from the tantra classes. However, the best is to rely solely on the body mandala of the Principal Deities of the Five Tantras.[8] Supplementing from that manual, recite from the consecration of elixir, arousing of awakening mind, and visualizing the protection circle up through the recitation, dissolution, and rearising.
mdun bskyed a mr-i ta dang / swA b+hA wa sa bsang sbyang /
For the front visualization cleanse and purify with amṛta…and svabhāva…
