'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang / dgra dang bgegs la sogs pa'i gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod pa dang / mdor na byang chub ma thob gyi bar du bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba (653) ba'i phrin las mdzad nas/ mi 'dod pa thams cad sol/ 'dod don thams cad sgrubs/ ji ltar bcol pa'i las thams cad la thogs pa med par mdzod cig /

Fully pacify all adverse conditions, sickness, spirits obstacles and all that is unharmonious. Increase all favorable conditions, longevity, and merit, entourage, and wealth. Bring under control all migrators, human and otherwise. Annihilate all who would cause harm, such as enemies and obstructors. In short, until we attain awakening, {653} perform the awakened activity of guarding, giving refuge, and concealing. Remove all that is undesirable and accomplish all that is desirable. Perform all activity exactly as requested without restriction.
bzhi pa sngags lung gi don du slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la gsol ba lan gsum 'debs dgos pa yin te/
Fourth, for the mantra transmission, the ritual master should supplicate the front visualization three times:
bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/
Bhagavat, surely grant to these [disciples], and please adhere to them.

de nas khyed rang rnams kyis kyang / bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kar pad nyi la hU~M gi mthar snying po dang rtsa sngags kyi bskor bar bsgom la/ mos gus dung pa dang bcas me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes mdzod/ / bcom ldan bdag la stsal= bdag la= lan gsum/

Now meditate on the essence and root mantras surrounding the hūṃ on the sun and lotus in the heart of guru and Protector inseparable. With deep devotion and while tossing flowers, repeat this three times after me: “Bhagavat, surely grant to me and please adhere to me.”

bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng me 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer dmar nag 'phro ba de dag las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du chad de zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams dang por gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hU~M gi mthar sngags thams cad mdog nag po 'od zer dmar nag me 'od du 'phro bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par byed pa dang bcas pa'i sngags phreng sgor gyis byung ba'i mos pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos

The mantra string in the heart of Guru-Protector inseparable blazes intensely with firelight, radiating dark-red light rays. A second [mantra] breaks away from that, in the way that the light of one candle becomes two, and emerges from his mouth. It enters you, visualized as Protector, through your mouth and settles around the hūṃ on the sun in your heart. All the mantras are black and emit dark-red light rays of firelight, which burn up all your sickness, bad spirits, negativities, and obscurations. Imagine the mantra string circulating around and repeat this three times after me:
oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra bi g+h+nan bi nA ya ka hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ lan gsum/
“oṃ vajra mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra vighnān vināyaka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā

oM shrI ma hA kA la shA sa na/ u pa ha ri Ni/ e Sho‘ pash+tsi ma/ kA lo‘ yaM i daM/ rat+na tra yA ya/ a ba ka ri Ni/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyA/ sma ra si tA dA/ i daM duSh+TaM/ kha kha khA hi khA hi/ mA ra mA ra/ gr-ih+Na gr-ih+Na/ ban+d+ha ban+d+ha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mA ra ya hU~M phaT/ lan gsum/

oṃ śrī mahākāla śāsana / upahāriṇi / eṣo ’paścima kālo ayaṃ idaṃ ratna trayāya / apakāriṇaṃ yadi pratijñāṃ/ smarasi tadā / idaṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi / māra māra / gṛhṇa gṛhṇa / bandha bandha / hana hana / daha daha / paca paca / dinamekena māraya hūṃ phaṭ
oM shrI de wI hU~M phaT/ gsum/
oṃ śrīdevī hūṃ phaṭ

oM k+She tra pA la big+h+nAn hU~M phaT/ oM dzi na mi tra ba shaM ku ru hU~M phaT/ oM TAk+ki rA dza sa ma ya b+h+yoHdu dza hU~M phaT/ oM du yo ga dza hA kA la trak+shad hU~M phaT/ ces pa rnams kyang lan gsum gsum bzla'o/ /
oṃ kṣetrapāla vighnān hūṃ phaṭ oṃ jinamitra vāśaṃ kuru hūṃ phaṭ oṃ ṭakkirāja samaya bhyoḥ du jaḥ hūṃ phaṭ oṃ du yogja mahākāla trakṣad hūṃ phaṭ” Repeat each of those three times.

mthar slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hU~M la thim pas/ bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs mtha' dag gis brgyud brlan par mos pa mdzod/ de (654) yan gyis dngos gzhi grub zin/

In the end, that mantra string in the master’s heart breaks away totally and dissolves into the hūṃ in your heart. Imagine that your whole being is moistened by all the blessings of Guru-Protector. {654} That concludes the main practice.
gsum pa rjes la/ dam tshig bzung ba/ yon dbul ba/ smon lam gdab pa ste gsum las/
Third, the concluding practices have three parts: (1) taking the sacred pledge, (2) offering the gift, and (3) making the aspiration prayer.

dang po ni/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyis yongs su blangs pa'i bslab pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / khyad par sems bskyed kyi bslab bya dang / sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag ma nyams pa gal che/ yang dgos mgon po nyid kyi dam tshig 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang / dam rdzas kyi spos sbyor ma chad par gyis/ bya nag dang / khyi nag la rdo mi rdeg yid ches par gyis la/ bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ 'byung po gzhan la zas phud mi 'bul/ sdig can gtum po grogs su mi bsten/ khyad par chos skyong 'di nyid gsang ba dang / sngags dang man ngag gsang ba dang / dus rgyun dang khyad par gyi mchod gtor la brtson pa gal che ba lags so/ / de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs bya/

First, from now on completely take up all the pure trainings, and especially the training of arousing the awakening mind. It is important not to damage any of the sacred pledges of Mantra. More particularly, keep the sacred pledges of this protector: offer torma of raw black barley, constantly offer incense bundles of pledge substances, do not throw stones at black birds or black dogs, faithfully regard the guru as inseparable [from Protector], do not offer first foods to other elemental spirits, and do not associate with evil, cruel friends. Especially, it is most important to keep this dharma protector secret, to keep the mantras and esoteric instructions secret, and always be very diligent in offering the daily and special tormas. Thinking that you will guard the sacred pledges and vows that you received on this occasion, repeat this after me: “I will do all that the master commands.”
gnyis pa gtang rag gi maN+Dal phul/ 'di'i rjes zlos kyang mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum bya/
Second, offer a mandala in gratitude. Repeat this three times after me: “From now on…(deng nas brtsams te…etc.).”
gsum pa chos gsan pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba zhu/
Third, dedicate the virtue of listening to the dharma to perfect awakening:
bsod nams 'di yis sogs sam/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams sogs
“By this merit…(bsod nams ’di yis…etc., or) All my virtuous acts…(bdag gi dge ba’i las rnams…(etc.).”
smon lam ci rigs par brjod do/ /
Recite any appropriate aspiration prayers.
'dir bde mchog lha lnga ltar tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma'i bar btang /
At this point, perform a communal feast as in Five-Deity Cakrasaṃvara from the consecration up to the leftovers.
de nas rjes kyi mchod pa bsham/
Then set out the offerings for the concluding practices.
spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ ar+g+haM nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/
Consecrate them as usual with arghaṃ…(etc. to)…śabda.
'bru gsum gyis mchod phul/
Present the inner offerings with the three syllables.
chos dbyings ngang las sogs kyis bstod/
Offer the praise “Without stirring from the realm of reality…(chos dbyings ngang las…etc.).”
yig brgya mang du bzlas/
ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / zhes sogs dang /
Say, “For whatever has been left out…(ma ’byor ba dang…etc.)” and
ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ / de kun khyed kyis bzod par rigs/ /
Whatever I did not find or was incomplete, and anything I was unable to do of the actions required in this ritual, it is reasonable that you tolerate them.
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus (655) sel bar shog /
Guru-Protector inseparable, I go for refuge in you with faith: may I remove every affliction of myself and all sentient beings. {655}

oM/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / gtor ma'i ye shes pa bris sku'i thugs kar thim/

oṃ You did everything for sentient beings’ welfare; grant the spiritual powers consistent with that. Though you depart for the land of buddhas, please return here again. The awareness beings of the torma dissolve into the painted image’s heart.
oM badzra muH
oṃ vajra muḥ
gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ / ces mos/
Torma guests return to their natural abodes. Pledge beings dissolve into my heart. Visualize that.
slar gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ bris sku'i lha la gtor chog bzhin phul nas/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam btab la/
Then again consecrate the torma as before. Offer the deity in the painted image as in the torma ritual. Do the request to remain firm in the painted image. Recite aspiration prayers
and the Sealed Word of Auspiciousness:
yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ / byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshim mdzad cing / / rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i/ / chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /
sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / / mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ / dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ / yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /
You watch over practitioners as your children, ever together like a body and its shadow, giver of spiritual powers to those with sacred pledge; may there be auspiciousness of the yidam deities.
dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing / / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ / sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ / chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /

You take care of practitioners holding sacred pledge and properly accomplish various awakened activity, such as pacifying, enriching, controlling, and subjugating; may there be auspiciousness of the dharma protectors.
snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ / bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ / yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / / bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i=

Apparent existence self-liberates like illusion and dream in the continual experience of great bliss. Within the space of empty clarity without mental engagement; may there be auspiciousness of great-bliss mahāmudrā.
sgrub pa po la brten cing mchod pa dang / / skur pa 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ / thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ / mnyam med byang chub sems kyi=
Whether they support and offer to practitioners or treat them with contempt, everyone will be placed on the path of awakening; may there be auspiciousness of incomparable awakening mind.
'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi/ / bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ / skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu=
However many states of auspiciousness there are in all of cyclic existence and its transcendence, like the course of a great river of abundance; may there be auspiciousness for all beings always.
bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ / snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ / tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ / yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis (656) shog /
ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /

yang 'di dag la lag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las mgon po dkar dmar mthing gsum spro ba dang / bzhi pa la sku'i stod smad thams cad nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spro ba yang lugs gcig yin/ yang yi ge 'bru gsum spro bas dbang gsum byed pa'ang yod cing / sku spro ba'i dbang bzhi/ gsung yig 'bru'i dbang bzhi/ thugs 'od zer gyi dbang bzhi/ yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bzhi/ phrin las phyag mtshan gyi dbang bzhi/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang nyi shu bskur ba ni/ zhang sgom chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin la/ tshul de bzhin ma shes par gtor dbang dkyus 'gro zhig gi gzhug tu phyag mtshan drug gi rjes gnang tsam byed pa ni snying po med do/ / mgon po stod lugs lha dgu ma la/ gnas rnying ba phyi ma 'gas gsar rnying gi cho ga ci rigs la brten nas dbang chog rgyas pa sbyar ba ni rang bzor byas la/ de'i yig rnying khung ma rnams phal cher 'di nyid dang mthun pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi cho ga 'di kho nas bya'o/ /

There are many different special practices associated with this, such as white, red, and blue protectors emanating from the three seed syllables in the guru’s three places. There is also a custom of heroes and ḍākinīs emanating from all the upper and lower bodies of all four, [three protectors plus guru]. There is also a version where the three seed syllables radiate and perform the three empowerments. There is the conferral of twenty empowerments of meditative absorptions, so called for the four empowerments of the body [syllable] radiating, four empowerments of the speech seed syllable, four empowerments of the mind by light rays, four empowerments of qualities from the torma, and four empowerments of awakened activity from the hand implements. That is the uncommon tradition of the great Zhangom [Chöseng]. Without understanding that system properly, a version of the ordinary torma empowerment has entered the picture that is merely a subsequent authorization of the six hand implements, and it is pointless. In the upper tradition of the Protector with Nine Deities, some later adherents in the old places added extensive empowerment rituals to any new or old rituals as they found suitable. These were their own creations. Their old texts are mostly in accord with this one, so you only need to practice this ritual of the absorption empowerment.[14]
rjes chog gi skabs bris 'bur sogs rten ye med na/ gtor ma'i lha dam ye ma phye bar nam mkhar spar la/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te phul nas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba yin no/ /

During the concluding ritual, if you never had a painted, carved, or other image, [do not][15] separate the awareness and pledge beings of the torma deities and raise them into the sky; after offering the torma blessing, [imagine that] the awareness beings depart and the pledge beings dissolve.
[Colophon by Tāranātha (a.k.a. Kunga Nyingpo)]

bstan srung kun las chos lhag pa'i/ / phyag drug mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi/ / lag len rab tu dga' ba'i tog / snying po tsam zhig gsal bar bkod/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bar chad kun sel gyi byin rlabs kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// // ! /

Higher dharma than all (Kun) other doctrine guards, to practice the Six-Armed Protector’s blessing is the pinnacle of utter joy (ga). I have clearly arranged just the essence (Nyingpo). This ends the chapter of the clear explanation of the practice of the blessing [empowerment] for Six-Armed Awareness Protector’s Removing All Obstacles. maṅgalaṃ
[Additional Comments]
oM swa sti/

bshad ma thag pa'i byin rlabs zab mo de ni brgyud 'dzin thun mong min pa las gzhan du bya ba ma yin la/ thun mong ba la mi zab pa'i lugs kyi gtor dbang dkyus mthun tsam byed na/ bsham sngar dang 'dra/ gtor ma lhar bskyed tshul la gtor ma'i steng du mgon po bskyed pa dang / gtor ma nyid bskyed pa gnyis yod pa/ gtor dbang gi tshe zab mi zab khyad par chen po yod pa 'dor len gal che bas skabs 'dir steng du bskyed/ rjes gnang sngon 'gro'i skabs thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab mi byed/ dngos gzhi'i skabs mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa tsam las/ slob ma la mgon po bskyed bstim mi byed/ dbang bzhi pa'i skabs slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas/ yig 'bru gnyis pa (657) chad de bstim/ slob ma'i yig 'bru gsum 'od gsal du bsdu ba mi byed/ /

Having said that, this profound blessing is intended for no one other than extraordinary lineage holders. For the common [version], just perform the regular torma ritual in the tradition that is not profound. Prepare as before. There are two ways to visualize the torma deity: visualizing the Protector on top of the torma or visualizing the torma itself [as the Protector]. There is a big difference in being profound or not profound during the torma empowerment, so it is important to choose correctly. In this instance, the visualization is above [the torma]. In the subsequent authorization, do not do the uncommon supplication. In the main part, other than invoking the awareness being to the front visualization, do not have the visualized Protector dissolve into the disciples. During the empowerment, a second [set of] the three seed syllables that came from the master’s three places breaks off and dissolves. {657} But do not do the dissolution in lucid clarity into the disciples’ three seed syllables.

lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ zhes pa dang / ji ltar bcol pa'i las sogs mi sbyar/ gong gi dmigs pa'i tshe/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sogs zhal bzhes dmigs pa mi sbyar/ sngags kyi bzlas lung mi byed pa'am/ byed kyang dkyus mthun tsam byed pa ni/ gtor dbang bar chad kun sel bsdus pa'am/ thun mong ba dkyus ma yin no/ /

[During the torma exhortation], do not add “Accompany these vajra disciples like a shadow follows the body…(etc. to)…Perform all activity exactly as requested without restriction.” In the foregoing visualization, do not add the Protector’s promise: “Child of good family…(etc.).” Do not perform the transmission of the mantra recitation, or if you do, just do it according to the regular version. This is the abbreviated torma empowerment of Removing All Obstacles, or the common regular version.

khyad par chos brgyud sel yod pa dang / chos sgor ma zhugs pa'i khyim pa la/ gtor dbang zab mo'i lugs su bskur ba ni/ tshe 'dir yang bskur bar bya ba'i yul la mi phan zhing / rang la bka' chad rin gyis nyo ba yin pas/ rnyed bkur la sogs pa'i don du gtor dbang tsam byed na'ang / mi zab pa'i lugs de nyid la tshig tshogs kyi sgros pa dang bcas pa byas na 'khu ldog chung ba yin/ spyir gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa la ni khyad cher med do/ /

In particular, to confer the torma empowerment in the profound tradition where there is discord in the dharma lineage or to householders that have not entered the dharma gate will be of no benefit in this life to those who receive it, and you yourself will pay a big price in consequences. So even if you do just the torma empowerment for the sake of wealth and esteem, making this unprofound style seem elaborate with lots of words, it will still be of little import. And, in general, there is not much difference regarding the fault of revealing secrets.
gtso rkyang 'jam zhing 'khor can bka' gnyan pa yin pas/ gtso rkyang la brten nas gtor dbang byed na'ang de'i 'dor len shes par bya'o/ /

Since the single principal deity is gentle and the retinues are obedient, if you perform the torma empowerment based on the single principal figure, you should know the choices of what to accept and what to reject.

'di la rje btsun rin po ches rjes gnang zab pa dang mi zab pa'i lugs zhes pa tsam las rnam grangs so sor bgrang bar ma mdzad kyang / mkhas grub rjes snga ma la rjes gnang bar chad kun sel dang / phyi ma la gtor dbang bar chad kun sel ces tha snyad dang rnam grangs so sor mdzad pa/ snga ma thob pa la phyi ma zur du bskur mi dgos kyang bskur yul gyi dbye ba phyed pa la zur du bgrang na go bde bar snang ba dang / bka' chen bcu gsum du 'dren pa'i skabs rnam grangs su bgrang bar snang bas zur du bkol ba'o/ /

In those statements, Venerable Rinpoche [Tāranātha], apart from just naming the profound and not profound authorizations, did not enumerate them individually. However, Khedrup Je [in Khedrup’s Book] distinguished the former as Removing All Obstacles Authorization and the latter as Removing All Obstacles Torma Empowerment, counting them individually. Although it is not necessary to confer the latter as follow-up to receiving the former, it seems best to count it separately [based on] distinguishing the types of recipients. And when enumerating the thirteen major permissions, [the torma empowerment] must be considered separately to calculate the numbers.
mang+ga laM// ! //
maṅgalaṃ
II.
II. White Protector
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
bla ma mgon po dbyer med ni/ / dbang gi rgyal po zhes grags la/ / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la btud de/ / yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bri/ /
Guru-Protector inseparable renowned as King of Power, I bow to you and the host of ḍākinīs and write this sādhana of Wish-Fulfilling Gem.

mgon bka' gnyis pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dang / rjes gnang byed tshul yang snying du dril ba ni/ mdun du stegs bu'i steng du/ rdul tshon gyis maN+Dal zlum po mu khyud dkar po/ dbus su chos 'byung dkar po/ re khA dmar/ grub bcad ljang gu/ chos 'byung gi dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dkar po zhig bkod/ de'i steng du many+dzi la rten (658) gyi gtor ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig bkod de/ dbyibs gru gsum du byed pa'am/ nor bu'i dbyibs su byed na/ zan zlum po'i steng du/ zan ril gsum 'dzom/ de'i steng du dzaM bshos 'dra ba zhig bkod pas/ phyogs gang nas bltas kyang nor bu mig gsum 'dra ba zhig yong bas de ltar byas kyang rung / gang ltar na'ang rgyu phye mar la rin po che brdar ba sogs las byas/ maN+Dal kyi mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po zas bzang dgus brgyan pa dang / mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bsham/ rten gtor la tsa ka li yod na 'thugs shing med kyang chog /

The second major permission of the Protector presents the combined essence of the sādhana and the way to confer the authorization of the White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem. On a platform in front of you, make a circular mandala of colored powder with a white circumference. In its center, make a white source of phenomena, a red circular outline (rekhā), and green square. In the middle of the source of phenomena, place a white heap [of grain] on a sun seat. {658} Upon that, on a mañji, arrange the support torma decorated with all the ornaments. Make the shape either three-sided or, if the gem shape, then attach three dough balls on the spherical dough torma. Upon that, put something like a Jambu food morsel so that from all angles it will seem fittingly like a three-eyed gem. In any case, make it from the substance of butter flour in which are polished jewels and so forth. In front of the mandala, put the round offering torma adorned with many good edibles. Set out the offerings in the usual way. If you have a deity card, stick it on the support torma, but if not, it is all right.
de nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/
Then consecrate the offerings in the usual way.

dngos gzhi nyams len ni/ bdag bskyed yi dam la bya ba'i lugs kyang yod med kyi 'di la bdag mdun dbyer med gtso che zhig phyag len yang bdag mdun dbyer med pa mdzad de/ de ltar na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed chad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ shU n+ya ta sa stong par sbyang /

In the main practice, there is of course the custom of doing a yidam as the self-visualization, but here the self- and front visualization is mostly inseparable, so the practice is also to make the self- and front inseparable. In that way, having done the preliminaries of going for refuge, arousing awakening mind, and the four immeasurables, purify into emptiness with śūnyata…(etc.).

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paM las pad+ma dang / raM las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaM las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ la phug dang / ne'u le 'dzin pa gnyis kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ rang sems chos nyid kyi thig le dkar dmar rgya sran tsam/ de'i dbus su hU~M dngul chu'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar zhing brjid pa/ zhal khro 'dzum gyi rnam pa can rab tu bzhad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / sma ra smin ma/ dbu skra kham ser brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin d+hU ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/

From within emptiness, the letter hūṃ in front becomes the protection circle. In its center, a lotus arises from paṃ and a sun from raṃ. Upon that, gaṃ becomes white Gaṇapati[16] with an elephant head, holding a daikon and a mongoose. He has fallen face down, and is adorned with silks and precious jewels. One’s own mind, the nature of phenomena, appears as a pink sphere the size of a pea. In its center is hūṃ, a color like quicksilver. Light rays radiate from that and dispel the suffering of poverty for all sentient beings. Light rays return again and absorb [into the hūṃ], which completely transforms into oneself inseparable from the front creation of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, King of Power. His color is brilliant white and his face has an expression of a wrathful smile, laughing ferociously. With three eyes, his tawny eyebrows, beard, and hair swirl upward. His forehead is anointed with a spot of vermilion and his head sealed by King Akṣobhya.

phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug nam mkha' la phyar ba/ bar pas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar gtod pa/ tha mas seng ldeng gi DA ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bum pa (659) nor bus gang ba ka pA la bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i nang du bcug ste brla g.yon pa la brten pa/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ tha ma na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs 'gro 'cham kyi stabs kyis pad nyi tshogs bdag gi gdan la bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sil khrol dang / chun 'phyang sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ 'khor dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor te me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /

His first right hand brandishes skyward a flaying knife, the middle holds the gem Mighty Sovereign to his heart, and the lowest rattles a sandalwood ḍamaru. {659} The first left hand resting against his left thigh holds a jewel-filled vase nestled inside an elixir-filled kapāla, the second one a trident, and the last one holds a lasso. His legs in a dance position stand on the seat of lotus, sun, and Gaṇapati. He wears an elephant skin on his upper body, a crown of five dry skulls, and a garland of fifty fresh heads. He is draped with beautiful precious jewels, bells, and various hanging jewelry. Surrounded by a retinue of one billion magnetizing ḍākinīs, he stands in the midst of a blazing bonfire.
de nas dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AHthugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le/ de'i dbus su hU~M dkar po'o/ /

At his forehead is oṃ, at his throat āḥ, and at his heart is a red magnetizing ḍākinī holding a hook and blood-filled skull cup. In her heart is a vital drop, the nature of phenomena, and in the middle of that is a white hūṃ.

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mA dzaH pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waM/ dzaHhU~M baM hoH ar+g+haM nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/

Light rays radiate from one’s heart and invoke from the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem with all the hosts of ḍākinīs—vajra samājaḥ / padma kamalaye stvaṃ / jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ (Offer with)…arghaṃ…(etc. to)…śabda.
mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can/ / sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro/ / 'gro ba'i dbul phongs ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ / 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /
Compassionate Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, white as a snow mountain, radiating light, you relieve all the poverty of migrators and grant the power of fulfilled desires—I bow and praise you.
snying ga'i thig le'i mtha' bskor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/
The mantra circles around the drop in the heart.
gu ru ma hA kA la ha ri ni sa sid+d+hi dzaH ces ci nus su bzla/
guru mahākāla ha ri ni sa siddhi jaḥ Repeat that as much as you can.
gtor ma bsang sbyang nag po'i mngon rtogs su bshad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs la/
Cleanse and purify the torma and consecrate as explained in the visualization description of the Black One.
ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur/
The tongues of the awareness deities are vajra straws through which they suck up and consume the torma.
snying po'i mthar i daM ba liM ta kha kha khA hi khA hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul zhing / shA sa na lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul ba phyag len la mdzad/
After the essence mantra, add idam baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi and repeat it seven times to offer. Saying…śāsana…(etc.) three times is the practice to offer to the general oath-bound protectors.

de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod (660) sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ rang nyid sgrub pa nyams len tsam yin na/ skabs 'dir rjes chog bya/ slob ma rjes bzung ni/ rjes chog gi sngon du bya ba yin te/ slob ma rnams la chab btang / me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ rgyas par spro na chos bshad mgon pos thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus sogs rgyas par bshad/ bsdu na/

Then do the offering and praise as above. {660} Supplicate for your desires with “Accept this torma I offer to you…(etc.).” If you are just doing the practice for yourself, then at this point do the concluding practices. If you are taking care of disciples, this precedes the concluding ritual. Sprinkle the disciples, distribute and gather flowers, and clarify the arousing of awakening mind. If you want to be more thorough, you can explain the history of the Protector’s arousing the awakening mind and other details. More briefly, continue here:

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma gyur skye dgu mtha' dag gi ched du bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bka' zab mo zhus la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan bya'i gdams ngag /

“For the sake of all the many mother sentient beings who equal the reaches of space, I must attain the state of the Guru-Protector inseparable. To that end, I will receive the profound permission of Bhagavat White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, and I will practice its meaning.” Arouse the awakening mind with that thought and please pay attention.

gangs can gyi ljongs su grags che ba'i sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ring lugs las ches zab cing ngo mtshar du gyur pa dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud la khyad par can gyi chos skyong gcig chog kho nar bzhugs pa ni myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po nyid yin te/ de'ang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid thugs bskyed dang thugs dam khyad par can gyi dbang gis drag por khros pa'i skur bzhengs shing / bstan srung kun gyi dbang phyug tu phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol/ grub chen sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ rA hu la gup+ta/ grub thob chen po khyung po rnal 'byor sogs dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi skyes chen dam pa rim par byon pa rnams kyis zhal gzigs shing grub par mdzad/

In this Land of Snows there are the famed Eight Great Chariots of the practice lineages. Of those long lineages, the most profound and amazing is the glorious Shangpa Kagyu, which possesses the very special singly sufficient dharma protector: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector. Through the power of Exalted Avalokiteśvara’s awakening mind and special sacred pledge, a wrathful fierce form was manifested. All the victors of the ten directions empowered and invested him as a mighty one among all the guardians of the doctrine. The great adepts Śavarīpa, Maitrīpa, Rāhulagupta, great adept Khyungpo Naljor, and the succession of holy masters in the Shangpa Kagyu had visionary encounters and became accomplished.

de lta bu'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po la sgrub skor rim pa mang por bzhugs na'ang / rtsa bar gyur pa/ drag po mthu sgrub dang / zhi ba nor sgrub gnyis su 'du/ dang po la'ang gtso rkyang lcam dral/ lha gsum/ dregs pa sde lngas bskor ba sogs dang / gzhan yang gtso 'khor gyi drag sgrub mang por bshad pa dang / zhi ba nor sgrub la/ mgon dkar/ mgon ser/ mgon dmar/ (661) mgon ljang tshe bdag la sogs pa nang gses dang bcas pa bzhugs pa las/ drag sgrub kyi skor ni gtso bor mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po las mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis gsan par snang zhing / zhi sgrub kyi skor ni gtso bor grub chen rA hu la gup+ta badzra'i zhal snga nas gsan par snang ste/

There are many sequences in the Protector’s practice cycle, but the main two are the wrathful practices for magical power and the peaceful practices for wealth. In the first of those, there are the sole principal figure, the brother and sister, the three deities, the encirclement by five classes of haughty ones, and so on. Additionally, there are many wrathful practices of the principal with retinue. Among the peaceful wealth practices, there is White Protector, Yellow Protector, Red Protector, Green Protector of Longevity, and others. {661} Among all of those, it appears that Khedrup Khyungpo Naljor received the cycle of the wrathful practice mainly from Master Maitrīpa the Great, and the cycle of peaceful practice primarily from the great adept Rāhulaguptavajra.

de'ang mkhas grub khyung po nyid 'phan yul kyog por chig rir mdzad pa'i skabs shig lon pa'i skyil po dgon par sku mtshams mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i grub chen rA hu la chen po de nyid ched du phebs nas rdzu 'phrul bkod pa ngo mtshar ba bstan/ rgyud dang gdams ngag spyi dang khyad par du gyur pa'i smin grol mtha' yas pa rnams dang / khyad par myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos skor sngar grags pa dang ma grags pa mang du gnang ba'i zhi ba nor sgrub kyi skor las/

One time Khedrup Khyungpo did a retreat at Lönpai Kyilpo Monastery while living alone in Jokpo in Penyul.[17] The great adept Rāhula the Great, who had attained the rainbow vajra body, came to visit him and displayed an array of amazing miracles. He taught the general tantras and instructions, and particularly countless maturing and liberating [empowerments and instructions]; in particular he gave many previously known and unknown [teachings from] the dharma cycle of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector and the cycle of the peaceful practice for wealth.

mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'di ni mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi snying nas skul ba'i man ngag / gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mchog dang thun mong gnyis ka 'byung ba/ dbang bskur thob pa tsam gyis kyang dngos grub sna re thob pa/ yig cha 'chang ba tsam gyis longs spyod rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i sgrub thabs khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi rim pa bsgrub par bgyi ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon tu grub zin pa lags pas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa maN+Dal 'bul bar zhu/ ces mtshams sbyar nas maN+Dal 'bul du gzhug cing / gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ ces sogs lan gsum/

This especially exalted method of accomplishment of the Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem is an esoteric instruction requested by all the ḍākinīs from the depths of their hearts; a source of both common and uncommon spiritual powers gained through mere supplication; an attainment of some spiritual powers just through receiving the empowerment; and naturally accumulates wealth by just holding the texts. In accomplishing the stages of its authorization blessing, the ritual master’s acts are now well completed. Now it is your turn. Please offer a mandala. At this point, have them offer a mandala. Repeat this supplication after me three times: “Vajra holder, please consider me…(etc.).”

rtog pa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab rnams phyag len rgyas pa'i tshe mdzad cing / mdor bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug /

Continue with the gathering of thoughts, uncommon refuge, regular confession in five branches, and the uncommon supplication as in the extensive practice. If you prefer the concise version, have them recite after you three times the regular confession that begins “I go for refuge in the Three Jewels…(etc.).” {662}

rjes gnang dngos (662) gzhi la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ mdun gyi gtor ma dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po yid bzhin nor bur gsal gdab dgos pa yin pas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin tu mdzad 'tshal/ oM shU n+ya ta dz+nyA na badzra swa b+hA wa At+ma ko‘haM/

Now for the main practice of the authorization, do the following visualization: Since you must clearly imagine the front torma inseparable from the master as the Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, I ask you to do this visualization. oṃ śūnyata jnāña vajra svabhāva atmako ’haṃ

stong pa'i ngang zhes pa nas bzhugs pa'o bar gong bzhin/ de lta bu'i slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ oMshU n+ya nas/ ko‘haM/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis kun rdzob rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid thig le hU~M dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur khrong gis gyur bar mos mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oM/ zhes pa nas/ hU~M dkar po'o/ / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ skad cig de nyid la DA ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha sil sil/ khrol khrol/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem byon te/ khyed rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod la rol mo drag tu bya/

From within emptiness…(etc. as before to)…he stands in the midst of a blazing bonfire. With your yearning devotion to this master and front visualization inseparable, on the basis of saying oṃ śūnya…ko ’haṃ, all phenomena included in relative consciousness disappear and become emptiness. From within emptiness, your mind itself is a vital drop with hūṃ. Imagine that completely transforms into the upright body of Glorious Awareness Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, King of Power. At your forehead is oṃ…(etc. to)…white hūṃ. Light rays radiate from the master’s heart and invoke Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem and all the ḍākinī hosts from the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast. At that very instant, they arrive with the sound of ḍamarus and bells—sil sil, khrol khrol, ur ur, chem chem. They dissolve indivisibly into you. Say that and intensely play music.
snying po'i mthar a we sha ya aH zhes drag tu bzla/ rol mo dang sngags bzlas ni 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre/
After the essence mantra, add aveśaya aḥ and recite intensely. This intense music and mantra recitation should be similarly applied below.

de sku'i rjes gnang bum dbang gi dod yin no/ / slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang hU~M gi mtha' bskor du sngags kyis bskor bar mos/ slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang du sbar btab pa bzhin du 'khod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

That is the equivalent of the vase empowerment in the authorization of awakened body. Imagine that the mantra circles around the hūṃ inside the vital drop of the nature of phenomena in the master’s heart. Through your yearning devotion to the master, a second mantra string breaks off from the master’s heart mantra string and emerges from the mouth. Imagine that it enters your mouth and settles inside the drop of the nature of phenomena in your heart like a photograph. Repeat [the mantra after me.] {663}
snying po (663) lan bcu gsum bzla ba phyag len la mdzad de gsung gi rjes gnang gsang dbang yin no/ /
The practice is to repeat the essence mantra thirteen times. That is the equivalent of the secret empowerment in the authorization of awakened speech.

yang slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma lus pa tshur bsdus te thugs kar thim/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka'i hU~M las/ gri gug / thod pa/ bum pa/ nor bu/ lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung / thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ rol mo/

Again, through your yearning devotion, light rays radiate from the master’s heart, gather back and dissolve into itself all the compassionate blessings without exception of all buddhas and bodhisattvas. From the hūṃ in the heart of the Guru-Protector inseparable boundless hand implements emerge, such as flaying knives, skulls, vases, gems, and hooks. They all melt into light and dissolve into your heart. Play music.

de thugs kyi rjes gnang shes rab ye shes kyi dod yin/ yang slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hU~M las/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga sku mdog dmar mo DA ma ru dang thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ shangs kyi bu ga g.yon pa nas 'thon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang / 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud/ dwangs ma/ tshe srog / longs spyod/ dbang thang thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur 'dus/ khyed rang rnams kyi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ srog rtsa'i lam nas brgyud de/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le la gnyis su med par thim/ rol mo/

That is the equivalent of the wisdom-awareness empowerment in the authorization of awakened mind. Again, through your yearning devotion, countless ḍākinīs of the five classes—red colored and carrying ḍamarus and skulls—radiate from the hūṃ in the master’s heart. They emerge from the left nostril and fill all the realms of worlds in the ten directions. They gather up all the brilliance, potency, refined essence, life force, wealth, and power in all of cyclic existence and transcendence. It all enters your left nostril, descends down through your life-force channel, and dissolves indivisibly into the vital drop of the nature of phenomena at the heart. Play music.

de yon tan gyi rjes gnang dbang bzhi pa'i dod yin no/ / yang slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag bskul bas tshogs bdag las rang dang 'dra ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa sprul/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin dregs ldan che dgu thams cad dbang du bsdus/ khyed rang rnams kyi bran du phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi tshogs kyi bdag po'i kha dang bshang lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char chen po babs pas/ (664) rang gi bang mdzod gnas khang yul phyogs thams cad zas nor longs spyod/ 'dod dgu sna tshogs pas phyur bur gang bar gyur/ rol mo/

That is the equivalent of the fourth empowerment in the authorization of awakened qualities. Again, through your yearning devotion in the master, Gaṇapati under the feet of the Guru-Protector inseparable is evoked. From Gaṇapati, countless hosts of identical forms emanate. They bring under control all the human and nonhuman spirits and nine great haughty ones. Imagine that they are offered to you as servants. The Gaṇapati underneath your feet discharges a great rainfall of wish-fulfilling gems from his mouth, anus, and all pores. {664} Your coffers, dwelling places, and the whole country are all filled to the brim with food, money, wealth, and various desires and requisites. Play music.

de phrin las kyi rjes gnang dbang gi mtha' brten gyi dod yin no/ / phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ mos pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas par gsal btab/ de rnams la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ rang gi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub par bya'o/ / zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par bsam zhing / byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs par gyur/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/

That is the equivalent of the follow-up empowerments in the authorization of awakened activity. Imagine the following: this torma is itself the Guru-Protector inseparable. Visualize White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem with the host of ḍākinīs. Through your yearning devotion, they arrive at the top of your head—ur ur, chem chem—saying, “We will accomplish all your desires just as you wish.” Think that they say that distinctly and remain there as if pouring down blessings. With the sound of music, say:

dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang / grub chen rA hu la gup+ta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor nas rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi bka' dang tha tshig gi rim pa bsnyel bar ma mdzad par/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rtsol ba med par yid bzhin du 'grub pa sogs ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus pa thogs med du bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ ces bka' bsgo drag tu bya/

Glorious Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, King of Power, and your retinue of hosts of millions of ḍākinīs: Do not forget the series of commands and oaths [you made to] all the mighty adepts of the precept lineage—from the overlord Great Vajradhara, sublime Exalted Avalokiteśvara, great adept Rāhulagupta, and learned adept Khyungpo Naljor down to my root guru Dorje Chang Padma Nyinje Wangpo. Accompany like a shadow to a body these vajra disciples holding sacred pledge. From this time on until they attain awakening, please accomplish without impediment whatever activity is entrusted to you, such as the attainment of all desired supreme and common spiritual powers. Do this exhortation intensely.
mthar bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang / zhes pa nas/ spyad du gsol zhes pa'i bar

At the end, imagine that Guru-Protector inseparable melts into light and dissolves into you. Thinking that you will guard the sacred pledges and vows that you received on this occasion…(etc. until)…please practice. (gnas skabs su thob pa’i dam tshig dang…(etc. to)…spyad du gsol).[18]

nag po'i rjes gnang gi skabs dang (665) 'dra/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams kyang mgon po nag po dang 'dra zhing / 'di nyid kyi rjes chog gi skabs gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs nas/ gtor ma de nyid dbul ba'i lag len yang 'dug mod kyi mgon dkar gyi phyag len dkyus la mi mdzad par snang ngo / /

Follow that formula from the Black Protector’s authorization, {665} including the concluding rituals. In its concluding ritual, there is a tradition of practice where the awareness beings of the torma raise up into space and then the torma itself is offered to them. But it seems that it is not done in the normal course of the White Protector.
[Colophon by Tāranātha Kunga Nyingpo]

nor sgrub kun las ches lhag pa/ / dga' bar bsngags pa'i g.yer po che/ / mkha' 'gro'i snying nas bskul ba'i thabs/ / gsal por brjod 'di e ma mtshar/ / mgon dkar yid bzhin kyi nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// // ! /

Greater than all (Kun) other wealth practice, joyfully (ga) proclaimed as illustrious, the way drawn from the ḍākinī’s heart (Nyingpo) is clearly spoken here—emaho! This was the chapter on the means of accomplishing White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem. maṅgalaṃ
III.
III. Yellow Protector
na mo gu ru/
namo guru
rgyal ba kun gyi bla ma ni/ / rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin pa/ / 'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ / mgon ser sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /
The guru of all the victors manifests as a youthful bodhisattva, I bow deeply to the world’s Protector and explain Yellow Protector’s sādhana.

mgon bka' gsum pa mgon ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ gtor ma gru gsum ser po'am/ nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs can zhig bya/ chos 'byung ser po gru gsum gyi steng du many+dzi la 'god pa sogs bsham gzhan dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang / skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang 'dra/ shU n+ya ta sa stong par sbyang /

The third permission is for Three-Faced Six-Armed Yellow Protector. The sequence of taking up the sādhana and authorization is as follows: Make a three-sided yellow torma or the torma with the body of “blazing gem.” Above a yellow triangular source of phenomena, place a mañji and so forth; the other arrangements are the same [as before]. The consecration of offerings, going for refuge, arousing the awakening mind, and the four immeasurables are the usual. Purify into emptiness with śūnyata…(etc.).

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad nyi la tshogs bdag pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du/ hU~M ser po yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ser la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser ba/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa na ut+pal/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na ne'u le dang / gsum pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis tshogs bdag pho mo mnan pa/ sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa/ (666) yum lha mo drag mo sku mdog dud kha gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mA dzaH dzaHhU~M baM hoHrang dang gnyis su med par thim/

From within emptiness, the letter hūṃ becomes the protection circle. In its center on a lotus and sun are male and female Gaṇapatis who have fallen face down. Upon them, yellow hūṃ completely transforms into oneself as the glorious Awareness Protector, yellow in color with a slightly red radiance. He has three faces and six arms. His main face is yellow, to its right is white and to the left is red, each with three eyes and bared fangs. His first two right and left hands hold a flaying knife and blood-filled skull cup, one above the other, while embracing the mother consort. The second right hand holds a banner and the third an utpala flower. The second left hand holds a mongoose and the third a lasso. He stands in the position of right leg bent and left straight, pressing on the male and female Gaṇapatis. He has the complete eight charnel-ground accessories. {666} The mother, smoke-colored Wrathful Goddess, embraces him holding a flaying knife and skull cup. The two of them stand within a blazing fire of timeless awareness. At their foreheads is oṃ, at their throats āḥ, and at their hearts hūṃ. Light rays radiate from one’s heart and invoke all the buddhas and bodhisattvas, and Swift-Acting One and retinue from the great charnel ground Cool Grove—vajra samājaḥ. jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they dissolve indivisibly into oneself.

slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mA dzaH oM badzri b+ha wa a b+hi Shiny+tsa hU~M/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

Again light rays radiate from the heart invoking the five classes of empowerment deities—vajra samājaḥ. (They say) oṃ vajrī bhava abhiṣiñca hūṃ and confer empowerment. The [protectors’] bodies are purified of stains, and the excess water rises up and becomes Akṣobhya as the crown.
gu ru ma hA kA la k+ShiM uSh+Ni Sha ya yak+Sha hU~M/ rat+na gr-i sid+d+hi hU~M/ pra dz+nyA war+d+ha ni swA hA// //
guru mahākāla kṣiṃ uṣṇiṣaya yakṣa hūṃ / ratna gṛi siddha hūṃ / prajñā vardhani svāhā
a mr-i ta sa bsang / swa b+hA lba sa sbyang /
Cleanse with amṛta…purify with svabhāva…(etc.).
stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang sems zhes dang / rang nyid ces pa bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /
As in the self-visualization, say, “From within emptiness…(etc. to)…Akṣobhya as crown,” except omit “one’s own mind…” and “oneself.”
ar+g+haM nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/
Offer with arghaṃ…(etc. to)…śabda. Praise with
byad ma zlog cing bsrung ba dang / / tshe dang blo gros kun 'phel zhing / / zhi dang rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa/ / bla ma mgon po khyod la 'dud/ /
Averting and guarding against sorcerers, increasing long life and intelligence, performer of peaceful and enriching actions: Guru-Protector, I bow to you.

mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i mngon rtogs dang mtshungs/ oM gu ru ma hA kA la i daM ba liM ta kha kha khA hi khA hi/ lan bdun gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /

Focusing on the front visualization, do the mantra recitation however much. The torma consecration is the same as in the liturgical description of the Black One. Then offer [the torma] seven times with oṃ guru mahākāla idaṃ baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi. Do the offerings and praises as above, and supplicate for your desires with “Accept this torma I offer to you…(etc.).” Those were the master’s acts.

slob ma rnams kyis yon dbul ba la sogs pa'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba mgon po dkar nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/ sems bskyed gsal btab skabs/ bcom ldan 'das mgon ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i bka' zab mo zhes dang /

The disciples do the gift offering [for requesting empowerment] and other preliminary acts in the authorization of both the White and Black Protectors, except during the visualization for the mind of awakening, substitute with “I will receive the profound permission of Bhagavat Three-Faced Six-Armed Yellow Protector” and

gsan bya'i chos grub chen rA hu la chen pos mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la stsal ba'i myur (667) mdzad ye shes mgon po/ zhi ba nor sgrub kyi skor las yon tan gyi mgon po ser po 'di ni/ spyir byad kha rbod gtong srung zhing zlog pa dang / zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i las rab 'byams 'grub par byed cing / khyad par 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dang / chags thogs med pa'i blo gros kyi stobs 'phel ba zab cing myur ba'i mthu dang ldan pa

The dharma to receive concerns the Swift-Acting Awareness Protector that the great adept Rāhula the Great granted to the learned adept Khyungpo Naljor. {667} This is the Yellow Protector of qualities from the cycle of peaceful wealth practices. In general, he guards and turns back sorcery and curses, and accomplishes a multitude of peaceful and enriching actions. In particular, he possesses the rapid magical power of immortal vajra life and the profound increase of the strength of intelligence free of desire and obstruction.
'di nyid kyi rjes gnang sogs sbyar la/ gsol gdab sogs grub bdas/
Then continue from “the authorization…(etc.),” doing the supplication and so forth.

rjes gnang dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces byas la/ bla ma mgon ser du gsal ba'i zhal nas/ oM shU n+ya tA dz+nyA na badzra swa b+hA wa At+ma ko‘haM/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su sbyang /

Now for the main practice of the authorization, do the following visualization: From the mouth of the clearly visualized guru [and] Yellow Protector [comes] oṃ śūnyata jñāna vajra svabhāva atmako ’haṃ. On the basis of saying that, all impure appearances are purified in basic space.

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M las nas dbu brgyan gyi bar sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las rang sems ces pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi ces pa dang / rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams ces 'don pa spo/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te badzra sa mA dzaH dzaHhU~M baM hoH zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ rol chen bya zhing / snying po'i mthar a we sha ya a/ zhes brjod pa rnams ni khyad par ro/ /

From within emptiness, from hūṃ…(etc. to)…“Akṣobhya as crown.” Follow the sādhana, except change the liturgy and instead of one’s own mind” say “your minds,” and instead of “oneself” say “your.” Then say “invokes the awareness beings—vajra samājaḥ / jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ.” Afterward, play grand music, and after the essence mantra, say aveśaya a. Make those changes.

bla ma'i dpral ba nas oM yig dkar po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa nas AHyig dmar po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ gsang dbang thob/ thugs ka nas hU~M yig sngon po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gnas gsum char nas oM AHhU~M dkar dmar mthing gsum byung / khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob par mos pa mdzod/

A white oṃ letter comes from the guru’s forehead and dissolves into your foreheads. You receive the vase empowerment. A red āḥ letter comes from the throat and dissolves into your throats. You receive the secret empowerment. A blue hūṃ letter comes from the heart and dissolves into your hearts. You receive the wisdom-awareness empowerment. White, red, and blue letters oṃ, āḥ, and hūṃ come from all three places and dissolve into your three places. Imagine that you receive the fourth empowerment.
'di la sngags kyi bzlas lung mi dgos/ phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/
Here, you do not need the mantra recitation transmission. Now the exhortation for awakened activity.

gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med du gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar mos/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sku phra mo dpag tu med pa (668) byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/

Clearly visualize this torma itself as the Guru-Protector inseparable, surrounded by the assemblies of buddhas and bodhisattvas all around. They come to the top of your head. Countless tiny forms of Guru-Protector inseparable come forth. {668} Imagine that they slowly dissolve into your bodies.
byas la/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po ser po yum lha mo drag mo sprul pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen sogs mgon dkar ltar la/ thogs med du bsgrub pa dang /

Glorious Swift-Acting Yellow Awareness Protector with the Wrathful Goddess and your emanated retinue of hosts of millions of ḍākinīs: Do not forget the series of commands and oaths you made to all the mighty adepts of the precept lineage—from the overlord Great Vajradhara, sublime Exalted Avalokiteśvara, great adept Rāhulagupta, and learned adept Khyungpo Naljor down to my root guru Dorje Chang Padma Nyinje Wangpo. Accompany like a shadow to the body these vajra disciples holding sacred pledge. From this time on until they attain awakening, please accomplish without impediment whatever activity is entrusted to you.

khyad par byad kha rbod gtong phas rgol gyi dmod ngan thams cad zlog cing srung ba dang / 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang chags thogs med pa'i blo gros yar zla ltar 'phel ba dang / chags che nyam nga mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing 'byor pa drug dang nyams rtogs kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /

In particular, please turn back and guard against all evil maledictions of magic and curses from adversaries, increase like the waxing moon longevity and intelligence free of desire or obstruction, pacify all adverse conditions of great attachment or fear, and increase the six riches and the qualities of experiential realization more and more.

ces rol chen dang bcas te bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang ba sogs dang rjes 'og mi mgon po nag po'i rjes gnang gi yi ger bris zin pa 'don pa spos la sbyar bar bya'o/ /

Do this exhortation intensely accompanied by grand music. The concluding ritual of promising to keep the sacred pledge and other concluding acts were already written down in the authorization of Black Protector, so transpose them here.
mgon ser 'di'ang / bla ma mgon po dbyer med ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gnyis la mgon ser bka' gnyis zhes zer na'ang / mgon ser dngos ni 'di kho na'o/ /

It is said that there are two permissions for Yellow Protector: this Yellow Protector and Yellow Guru-Protector Inseparable with Eight Faces and Sixteen Arms. But the only real Yellow Protector is this one.
[Colophon by Tāranātha Kunga Nyingpo]
nor 'phel bsrung ba kun gyi mchog / shes rab dga' ba skyed byed pa/ / mgon ser sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ / shin tu dkon pas snying por dril/ / mgon ser blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /

Supreme of all (Kun) guardians who increase wealth, creator of wisdom and joy (ga), Yellow Protector’s amazing means of accomplishment so extremely rare, its essence (Nyingpo) is contained. This was the chapter on the means of accomplishing Yellow Protector Increasing Intelligence.
mang+ga laM// // !
IV.
IV. Red Protector
na mo gu ru/
namo guru
spyan ras gzigs dbang khro bo'i sku/ / dbang sdud lha la gus phyag 'tshal lo/ / pad+ma rA ga'i 'od 'phro ba/ / mgon po'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /
Avalokiteśvara’s wrathful form, magnetizing deity, I respectfully bow. You radiate the light of rubies. I write this sādhana of the Protector.

mgon bkar bzhi pa mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi rim pa ni/ mdun du stegs bu/ / maN+Dal gru gsum mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la/ rdo rje'i lte bar hU~M dang / gri gug gi lte bar AHsa mtshan pa/ de tsam 'bri ma thub na tshom bu dmar po bkod/ de'i steng du many+dzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ me long la sin+d+hU ra btsag la bkram/ de la chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs dbus su rdo rje hU~M dang / gri gug AHsa mtshan pa/ zur drug po la g.yas bskor gyis ha ri ni sa swA hA/ zhes pa'i yi ge drug po rnams bri/ steng du dar dmar po'i gur phub/ (669) de'i g.yas su dpal gtor nor gzugs ma dmar po sha dang bu ram sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig dang / 'bul gtor dang mchod pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shU n+ya ta sa stong pa nyid du sbyang /

The fourth permission is for Red Protector, King of Power.[19] The sequence of taking up the sādhana and authorization is as follows: On a platform in front of you, make a blue-black triangular mandala with a ring of fire. In its center, draw an eight-petaled red lotus, and in its center draw a vajra marked with hūṃ at its center and a flaying knife marked with āḥ. If you can’t draw that, just place a red heap of grain there. Upon that, put a skull cup full of elixir on a mañji and on that a mirror smeared with vermilion. In the vermilion, inscribe a source of phenomena—two stacked triangles—and in its center a hūṃ-marked vajra and āḥ-marked flaying knife. In the six corners, write the six letters going clockwise: ha ri ni sa svā hā. Above, cover it with a red silk canopy. {669} To the right of that, set out a red glory torma, the “gem form” (nor gzugs ma), decorated with all the ornaments made of meat, treacle, and so forth. Arrange the offering torma and general offerings as usual. Perform the consecration of offerings as usual, and, having first recited the refuge, awakening mind, and four immeasurables, purify into emptiness with śūnyatā…(etc.).

stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung mthing ga'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po dang / nyi ma/ bgegs kyi rgyal po kha bub tu bsgyel ba rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hU~M las rdo rje gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ pad+ma rA ga ltar dmar zhing zhal gcig phyag drug dang po gnyis gri thod bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis cang te'u rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ tha ma lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /

From within emptiness, a deep blue source of phenomena arises from an e with a red lotus, sun, and face-down obstructor king Gaṇapati all stacked up in its center. A hūṃ-marked flaying knife arisen from hūṃ radiates and reabsorbs light. That totally transforms into oneself as Red Protector, Mighty King, ruby red with one face and six arms. The first two hands hold a flaying knife and skull cup embracing the mother consort, the middle pair a small hand drum and trident, and the last pair a hook and a lasso.

spyan gsum skra ser gyen du brdzes/ / thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang / / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ / stag lpags grol zhing g.yon brkyang stabs/ / mi rus sbrul dang g.yer khas brgyan/ / dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /

Three eyes, yellow hair swirling upward, wearing a crown of five dry skulls, a garland of fifty fresh heads, a loose tiger skin, with left leg drawn in, adorned by human bones, snakes, bells, and all eight charnel-ground accessories.
yum chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ / chags pa'i nyams can sku mdog dmar/ / gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan ma/ / gri gug thod bcas yab la 'khyud/ / gnyis ka'ang me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /
Great Mother, Lotus Ḍākinī, is red, with an expression of passion, naked, with five symbolic ornaments, embracing the father holding knife and skull. Both stand in an expanse of towering flames.

gtso bo yab yum gyi mdun du ma hA ka la sku mdog nag po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su k+She tra pA la dmar po DA ma ru dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu dzi na mi tra nag po gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon du TAk+ki rA dza ser po rtse gsum dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyi skor du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ / gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje hU~M gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi thugs kar gri gug aM gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil (670) ba'i tshal nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mA dzaH dzaHhU~M baM hoH

Black Mahākāla stands in front of the principal couple, holding a flaying knife and skull cup. Red Kṣetrapāla is to their right holding a ḍamaru and making the threatening pointing gesture. Black Jinamitra is in back, holding a flaying knife and skull cup. Yellow Ṭakkirāja is to their left holding a trident and making the threatening gesture. All around are the hosts of an ocean of the oath-bound. In the heart of the principal figure is a vajra marked with a hūṃ. In the heart of the mother is a flaying knife marked by aṃ. {670} From one’s own heart light radiates and invokes the Red Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, King of Power, and his retinue from the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast—jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ.

dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mA dzaH ar+g+haM nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oM badzri b+ha wa a b+hi Shiny+tsa hU~M/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la 'od dpag med dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi phreng ba bsgoms la/

At their foreheads is oṃ, at their throats āḥ, and at their hearts hūṃ. Again light rays from the heart seed syllables invoke the five classes of empowerment deities with their entourages—vajra samājaḥ. (Offer with) arghaṃ…(etc. to)…śabda. Supplicate with “All tathāgatas, please confer empowerment on me.” Saying oṃ vajrī bhava abhiṣiñca hūṃ, they confer empowerment. The [protectors’] bodies are purified of stains, and the excess water rises up and becomes Amitābha as the crown of both father and mother while the retinue is crowned by the principals. Meditate on the mantra string at one’s heart:
oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra big+h+nAn bi nA ya ka hU~M hU~M phaT/ hU~M ma gu ye swA hA/ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ /
oṃ vajra mahākāla saparivāra kṣiṃ kṣetra vighnān vināyaka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ / hūṃ maguye svāhā Repeat that as much as you can.

mdun bskyed bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las e las zhes pa nas/ gtso bos dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las bdag nyid ces pa'i tshig bor ba ni khyad par ro/ / oM gu ru ma hA kA la sa pa ri wa ri b+h+yaH ar+g+haM pra tIts+tsha swA hA/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/

Then cleanse and purify for the front visualization. From the self-visualization repeat, “From within emptiness a deep-blue source of phenomena arises from an e…(etc. to)…crowned by the principals,” except omit the words “one” and “oneself.” Offer with oṃ guru mahākāla saparivāri bhyaḥ / arghaṃ praticcha svāhā…(etc. to)…śabda
bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen gsung / / rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin 'od dpag med/ / chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ / dbang gi skur ston nag po che la bstod/ /
Guru-Protector inseparable, great-bliss speech, the nature of all victors: Amitābha and dharma lord, migrators’ protector, Avalokita, displayed in the mighty body of Great Black One.

mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub tu bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i skabs dang 'dra/ snying po'i mthar i daM ba liM ta gr-ih+Na gr-ih+Na hU~M hU~M phaT/ ces phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar slob ma byin rlabs ji ltar byed pa thams cad rang gis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas blang bar bya'o/ /

Clearly imagine this according to the front-visualization recitation and repeat however much. Then for the torma consecration, do the same as in the Black Protector. After the essence mantra, add idaṃ baliṃta gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ and offer it. Do the offerings and praises as above. Supplicate for your desires with “Accept this torma I offer to you…(etc.).” Whatever ways the disciples’ consecration is done below, you should perform the visualization here in the manner of a self-induction.
slob ma rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i bya ba yan chad nag po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i (671) bka' zab mo zhes dang /

All the preliminary acts of the disciples after that are the same as in the Black Protector, except that during the clarification of the mind of awakening, say “the profound permission of the Red Protector, King of Power,” {671} and

gsan bya'i chos/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa'i rdo rjes mkhas grub khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la stsal ba'i myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhi ba nor sgrub kyi skor las/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po 'di ni/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo byin rlabs shin tu myur zhing tshe dang dbang gi las sgrub pa la gzhan las myur zhing stobs che ba/ rtsa ba'i mgon po mthing ga nang ltar du sgrub pa yin cing zhag bdun tsam bsgrubs pas zhal ston par gsungs pa sogs yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa

The dharma to receive concerns Swift-Acting Awareness Protector that the great adept who gained the deathless vajra body, Rāhulaguptavajra, granted to Khedrup Khyungpo Tsultrim Gönpo. This is the Red Protector, King of Power, from the cycle of peaceful wealth practices. With an extremely swift blessing of the essence of Amitābha, the vajra of speech, this powerful one accomplishes longevity and magnetizing actions faster than any others. The practice is similar to the main Black Protector, but it is said that after only seven days of doing it, you will see him, plus other immeasurable qualities.
'di nyid kyi rjes gnang sogs sbyar la/ gsol gdab nas rgyun bshags yan grub pa dang /
Then continue from “the authorization for this…(etc.),” doing the supplication through the regular confession, and
khyed rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gsal btab la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oM sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pA da yA mi/ lan gsum/
In your hearts on a white moon, imagine a five-pronged white vajra and repeat this three times after me: “oṃ sarva yogacitta utpādayāmi”
gsang sngags 'byung ba dkon par bstan pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/
The Secret Mantra is very rare; listen to this teaching and fully receive it.
'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag / res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ / u dum+bA ra'i me tog ltar/ / brgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung / /
In this world, omniscient ones might sometimes arise, or not. Or like the uḍumbara flowers appear every few hundred years.
gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ / de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ / gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis/ / sems can sangs rgyas byed pa'o/ /
The way of Secret Mantra conduct occurs even more rarely than that. This way of conduct of profound nonduality makes all sentient beings buddhas.

zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te gnyis su med par thim/

Then light rays radiate from the master’s heart and compel the mind stream of the deities in the front visualization, invoking all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the form of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector. He enters the tops of your heads and dissolves indivisibly.
rol chen bya/ snying po'i mthar/ A we sha ya a a a/ zhes lan bdun nas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/
Play grand music. After the essence mantra, add āveśaya a a and repeat seven or twenty-one times.

de'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur (672) gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po/ gri thod DA ma ru rtse gsum lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa lags te/ chos 'byung mthing kha'i dbus su nas/ brtsegs pa'i steng du mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs pa ni pad+ma rA ga ltar dmar ba zhes pa nas/ tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med par mos mdzod/

Through that connection, you instantly become the form of Red Protector, King of Power, {672} red in color, holding a flaying knife, skull cup, ḍamaru, trident, hook, and lasso. Mother Lotus Ḍākinī holds a flaying knife and skull cup, embracing Protector. As for introducing the deities, here they dwell in the mandala of the Swift-Acting Awareness Protector. In the center a deep-blue source of phenomena…(etc. to)…all stacked up in its center. Upon that is Red Protector, King of Power, ruby red…(etc. to)…around are all the hosts of an ocean of the oath-bound. Imagine that they are all inseparable from your root guru.

dbang gi dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de'i spyi bo'i oM dkar po las mgon po sku mdog dkar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob par gyur/ rol mo'i sgra bya/

Now for the main part of the empowerment, on the basis of your yearning devotion to the Guru-Protector inseparable, from a white oṃ on the crown of his head, countless white protectors with small bodies and thick limbs come to the tops of your heads and dissolve. You receive the vase empowerment. Play music.
yang mgrin pa'i AHdmar po las mgon po sku mdog dmar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa chad nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob/ rol mo/
Again from the red āḥ in the throat, countless red protectors with small bodies and thick limbs break off and dissolve into your throats. You receive the secret empowerment. Play music.
de bzhin du sbyar nas/
Apply the same formula:

thugs ka'i hU~M sngon po las/ sngon po snying gar/ rol mo/ yang gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las dkar dmar mthing gsum/ gnas gsum kar du/ tshig dbang rin po che/ rol mo/ de rnams phyi'i dbang bzhi lags/

From the blue hūṃ in the heart…blue…into your hearts…(music). Again from the three seed syllables in the places come white, red, and blue…into your three places. You receive the precious word empowerment (music). Those were the four outer empowerments.

de nas yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ mgon po yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer du zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang dbang thob/ lhen sna yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang / tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob (673) par mos mdzod/ de dag ni nang sku dngos kyi dbang bzhi'o/ /

Then again, on account of your yearning devotion to the Guru-Protector inseparable, the two protectors come to the tops of your heads and melt into light, the essence of bodhicitta. That enters the tops of your heads and fills down to the eyebrow level; you obtain the vase empowerment; down to the throat, the secret empowerment; and down to the breast bone, the wisdom-awareness empowerment. Imagine that as your whole body fills up, you obtain the precious word empowerment, the profound fourth empowerment. {673} Those were the four inner empowerments. Now think of the torma as the Protector.
gtor ma mgon por gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ /
Place the torma on the disciples’ heads:
oM/ gzi brjid dpal 'bar mgon po yab yum sku/ / ngo mtshar lhun grub dam rdzas gtor ma 'dis/ / dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ / mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la longs spyod shog /

oṃ Blazing glorious charisma, body of Protector father-mother, this wondrous, spontaneous torma of pledged substance confers empowerment on you, vow-holding noble disciples: may you enjoy the unchanging vajra body.
snying po'i mthar/ kA ya badzra a b+hi Shiny+tsa hU~M/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur thob pa yin no/ / thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mgrin par gtad/
(Essence mantra plus:) kāya vajra abhiṣiñca hūṃ Now you have obtained the vase empowerment. Touch the skull cup filled with elixir at their throats.
AH/ zab mo gsang sngags mgon po yab yum gsung / bde chen snod bcud zag med bdud rtsi 'dis/ / dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ / 'gag med tshangs dbyangs gsung la longs spyod shog /

āḥ Profound Secret Mantra, speech of Protector father-mother, this undissipating elixir, the vessel and contents of great bliss, confers empowerment on you, vow-holding noble disciples: may you enjoy unrestricted divine melodies of speech.
kA ya badzra gyi gnas su wA ka badzra= des gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob pa yin no/ / sin+d+hU ra'i dkyil 'khor snying gar gtad la/ /
(Replace kāya vajra with) vāka vajra… Now you have obtained the secret empowerment. Touch the vermilion mandala to their hearts.
hU~M/ gzung 'dzin kun bral mgon po yab yum thugs/ / dri med snang stong me long ye shes 'dis/ / dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ / rnam dag ye shes thugs la longs spyod shog /

hūṃ Devoid of dualism, mind of Protector father-mother, this awareness mirror, stainless empty appearance, confers empowerment on you, vow-holding noble disciples: may you enjoy the totally pure awareness mind.
tsit+ta badzra= des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /
citta vajra… Now you have obtained the wisdom-awareness empowerment.

'di skabs su yig rnying las ma bshad kyang / slob ma la nang mchod blud pa dang / snying gar sin+d+hU ra'i thig le re mdzad pa phyag len la snang ngo / / de nas khyed rang rnams rig pa rten med gyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cig/ /
