At this point, although not elucidated in the ancient texts, there seems to be a practice of giving inner offering to the disciples to drink and anointing them with a drop of vermilion at their hearts.
ho/ chos dbyings mtha' bral spros pa rab zhi'i ngang / / rang rig ye shes ting 'dzin klong yangs 'dis/ / dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ / chos dbyings yang dag don la longs spyod shog /

ho Limitless realm of phenomena, elaboration fully calmed, this vast expanse of reflexive awareness in absorption confers empowerment on you, vow-holding noble disciples: may you enjoy the utterly pure realm of phenomena.
dz+nyA na badzra= des tshig dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no/ /
jñānā vajra… Now you have obtained the word empowerment.
de dag ni gsang ba dam rdzas kyi dbang bzhi yin no/ /
Those were the four secret empowerments of pledge substance.
bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshogs rnams byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos (674) la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / snying po lan gsum/
Sets of mantra strings emerge from the heart of Guru-Protector inseparable. Imagine that they dissolve into your hearts. {674} Repeat this after me three times. (Repeat the essence mantra.)
slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /
After tossing flowers at the master, repeat this three times after me: “Bhagavat, surely grant to me and please adhere to me.”

slar yang me tog rnams sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnams la gtor bas/ sngags nus pa mthu can du mos mdzod/ / bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/

Again, consecrate the flowers as the mantra strings. Tossing them to you, imagine that you have the ability and power of mantra. Bhagavat, surely grant to these [disciples], and please adhere to them. (Repeat three times.)
de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang zhes sogs/
The vows that you received on this occasion…(etc.).
slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni/ mgon nag gi skabs su bshad pa kho nas 'grub bo/ /
For the disciples’ concluding practices, follow only the description in the Black Protector.
cho ga'i rjes chog kyang de dang mtshungs so/ /
The concluding practices of the ritual are the same.
mgon dmar gyi sgrub thabs rtsa ba 'di yin cing / tshe sgrub ni 'di'i las kha char gyi lta yin par shes par bya'o/ /
This is the root sādhana of Red Protector; the longevity practice should be understood as an extra deity [practice].
[Colophon by Tāranātha Kunga Nyingpo]
dbang bsdud kun las ches dga' ba/ / rmad byung sgrub thabs snying po 'di/ / yig rnying ma gtogs phyis byung gi / lag len dkon phyir bris pa yin/
Magnetizing that is most of all joyful (Kunga), this essence (Nyingpo) of the wonderful means of accomplishment was written because, apart from the old texts, the practices that came later are rare.
mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// // ! /
This was the chapter on the means of accomplishing the Red Protector, King of Power. maṅgalaṃ
V.
V. Green Protector
na mo gu ru/
namo guru
tshe dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ / myur mdzad mgon po zhes bya ba/ / de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/
Amitāyus and Avalokita, called Swift-Acting Protector, I bow to you and explain the sādhana.

'dir mgon bka' lnga pa mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs ni/ stegs bu'i steng du chos 'byung ljang gu me ri can/ dbus su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom du bkod/ de'i steng du many+dzi la dpal gtor nor gzugs ma rgyan gyis brgyan la bzhag / g.yon du many+dzi'i steng du/ nang mchod ka pA la bdud rtsis gang ba dang / de'i steng du sin+d+hU ra'i dkyil 'khor mgon dmar gyi skabs dang 'dra bar bris la/ dar ljang gi gur phub/ g.yas su bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod gtor bsham tshul spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnam la bsgom/ swa b+hA wa sa stong pas sbyang /

The fifth protector permission is for Green Protector, Lord of Longevity. For the sādhana, create a green source of phenomena with a ring of fire arranged on a platform. In its center arrange heaps of grain equal to the number of deities. Upon those, put the glory torma “gem body” adorned with ornaments on a mañji. To the left, put the inner offering of a kapāla full of elixir on a mañji. Upon that, put a vermilion[-smeared mirror] and draw a mandala on it as in the Red Protector practice. Cover it with a green silk canopy. To the right, arrange the vases as usual. Set out the offering torma as usual. After first consecrating the offerings, meditate on going for refuge and the four immeasurables. Purify with svabhāva…(etc.).

stong pa'i ngang las hU~M las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang / gzhal med khang pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ tsan+dan (675) gyi ljon pa'i drung du/ e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas ljang gu/ de'i dbus su paM las pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma dang bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la/ rang sems hU~M las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag drug pa/

From within emptiness, a protection circle arises from hūṃ surrounded by the eight great charnel grounds. Within that is a celestial palace with all characteristics perfectly complete. {675} In its center, in front of a sandalwood tree, a green source of phenomena arises from e. In its center, on a seat of a lotus arisen from paṃ with a sun at its center and the Obstructor King, one’s own mind is a hūṃ-marked flaying knife arisen from hūṃ. That completely transforms into oneself as Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, green in color, with one face and six arms.

phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis cang te'u dang tri shu la 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag lpags dang dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba sogs rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pang du yum rdo rje DA ki ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can gyis 'khyud pa/ gtso ba'i mdun du bud+d+ha DA ki dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lho ru rat+na DA ki ser mo rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma DA ki dmar mo pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang du karma DA ki ljang khu ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng ba can sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / de'i phyi rol du mkha' 'gro ma 'bum sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/

The first two hands hold a flaying knife and skull cup embracing the mother consort, the middle pair a small hand drum and trident, and the last pair a rosary and a lasso. He has three eyes and bared fangs, hair swirling upward, a crown and garland of human heads, the six bone ornaments, tiger skin, bells, and strings of small bells, and so on—all adornments completely perfect. Embracing him, Mother Vajra Ḍākinī on his lap is blue, holding a flaying knife and skull cup, with a garland of fifty dry skulls. In front of the principal figures, white Buddha Ḍākinī holds a wheel and blood-filled skull cup, yellow Ratna Ḍākinī is in the south holding a jewel and blood-filled skull cup, red Padma Ḍākinī is in the west holding a lotus and blood-filled skull cup, and green Karma Ḍākinī is in the north holding a knife and blood-filled skull cup. All of them have bone and human-head garlands and expressions of charm and affection. They stand in the position of left leg extended. One hundred thousand ḍākinīs with an ocean of the oath-bound are situated around them.

thams cad kyi dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M/ lte bar swA/ gsang gnas su hA/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing / khyad par shar lho dur khrod chen po (676) bsil ba'i tshal nas/ mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mA dzaH

At their foreheads is oṃ, at their throats āḥ, at their hearts hūṃ, at their navels svā, and at their private parts hā. Light rays radiate from my heart and invoke all the buddhas and bodhisattvas with their retinues in the forms of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector. In particular, from the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast {676} comes Protector and ḍākinīs—vajra samājaḥ.
k+ShiM ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/
Slowly repeat kṣiṃ twenty-one times, either with or without a melody.
Then invoke them:

dpral mgrin thugs lte gsang gnas nas/ / oM AHhU~M swA hA'i yig 'bru las/ / dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba yi/ / 'od 'phros phyogs bcu kun khyab pas/ / rgyud drug sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs/ / skyabs gsum thugs rje'i mnga' bdag can/ / ye shes spyan drangs ma lus mchod/ / tshe bdag phrin las mgon por gyur/ /

From seed syllables oṃ, āḥ, hūṃ, svā, and hā in forehead, throat, heart, navel, and private parts, light radiates and pervades in ten directions, purifies sins and obscurations of six realms of beings, makes offerings to all invoked awareness beings who possess the compassion of three refuges, and becomes the protectors of longevity activity.

'phro 'du 'od zer lngas bskul te/ / dbus 'gyur rang bzhin mchog sgrub nas/ / bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ / dpal ldan 'byor bcu tshe yi bdag / phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i tshogs/ / dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi yi/ / dam can 'khor bcas 'dir 'dus la/ / rnal 'byor bdag la mchog stsol cig /

Compelled by the five light rays radiating and returning, from Cool Grove Charnel Ground, the nature of Magadha, center of supreme accomplishment, the glorious ten fortunes, masters of longevity, Six-Armed Awareness Protector and hosts in the eight charnel grounds and twenty-four [sites] with retinues of the oath-bound: gather here and grant me, the yogin, the supreme [spiritual power].
ces spyan drangs/
dzaHhU~M baM hoH dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'am gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ / dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they dissolve indivisibly into the pledge beings. Again light rays radiate from my heart or from my five places and invoke the five families of empowerment deities to the space before me.
ar+g+haM nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/
Offer with arghaṃ…(etc. through)…śabda.

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oM badzri b+ha wa a b+hi Shiny+tsa hU~M/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ bud+d+ha DA ki la rnam snang / rat+na DA ki la rin 'byung / pad+ma DA ki la snang mtha'/ karma DA ki la don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan/

[The deities] supplicate with “I supplicate all tathāgatas, please confer the empowerment.” The [deities] confer empowerment with oṃ vajri bhāva abhiṣiñca hūṃ. The [protectors’] bodies are filled, stains purified, and the excess water rises up and becomes Akṣobhya crowning the principal couple, Vairocana on Buddha Ḍākinī, Ratnasambhava on Ratna Ḍākinī, Amitābha on Padma Ḍākinī, and Amoghasiddhi on Karma Ḍākinī.
gtor ma nag po'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes kyi lha la dmigs te/
Consecrate the torma following the liturgical description in the Black Protector practice, then visualize the awareness deities:
dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/
The tongues of the mandala deities become vajra tubes through which they suck up the torma and drink it.

snying po'i mthar/ i daM ba liM ta kha kha khA hi khA hi/ zhes lan 'dun gyi gtor ma phul/ gu ru ma hA kA la bi shwa DA ka sa pa ri wa ra ar+g+haM pra tIts+tsha swA hA nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod pa 'bul/
After the essence mantra say idaṃ baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi seven times to offer the torma. Present offerings with guru mahākāla viśvadāka saparivara arghaṃ pratīccha svāhā…(etc. through)…śabda.
Praise with
bla ma mgon po dbyer med phrin las sku/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ / gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ / phyag drug sna tshogs (677) mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal/ /
Guru-Protector inseparable’s activity body, honored by all buddhas in the three times, you show up to whomever is to be trained: Six-Armed Diverse Ḍāka—homage to you. {677}
ces bstod/
bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oM badzra ma hA kA la ha ri ni sa sarba A yur dz+nyA na sid+d+hi dzaH ces ci 'grub bzla/
Clearly keep in mind the recitation visualization, and recite the mantra however much: oṃ vajra mahākāla ha ri ni sa sarva āyur jñāna siddhi jaḥ
'di la bdag mdun dmigs pas tha dad du sgom pa yin na'ang / bskyed chog phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa yin pas/ de nyid kyis bdag mdun gnyis char 'grub bo/ /

Here one [normally] meditates separately on the self- and front visualizations. However, since the creation ritual joins them, the [preceding liturgy] accomplishes both the self- and front visualizations.
bum pa'i nang du/
Within the vase:

myur mdzad mkha' 'gro lnga dang bcas la skad cig gis grub bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags kyi 'od zer rnams gzungs thag la 'khril zhing / bum pa'i nang gi bcud la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs dwangs ma rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bkug ste thim par gyur/

Swift-Acting Protector and the five ḍākinīs are instantly present. The mantra string with light rays radiate from my heart and evoke the mind streams of the deities created in front. The mantra’s light rays coil into a dhāraṇī cord and dissolve into the contents inside the vase. Light rays radiate from the five places of the deities in front, drawing in the brilliance, radiance, and refined essence of all the environment and its inhabitants in the form of elixir, which also dissolves [into the vase].
bum pa la dmigs nas snying po brgya tsam bzla'o/ /
Visualize the vase and do some hundred repetitions of the essence mantra.

'og tu slob ma la ji ltar byed pa'i cho ga rnams/ skabs 'dir dmigs pa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ slob ma'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba/ phyag 'tshal khrus/ me tog bkye bsdu byas nas/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ mgon ljang tshe'i bdag po'i bka' zab mo/ zhes dang /

All of the rituals done in the following [actions for] the disciples are practiced by means of this visualization in the manner of a self-induction. The preliminary acts of the disciples are prostrating, cleansing, and distributing and collecting the flowers. During the refuge and awakening mind, say “the profound permission of the Green Protector, Lord of Longevity.”
dngos gzhi la/
Then for the main practice:

gsan bya'i chos/ 'phags yul grub ba'i dbang phyug sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa'i zhal snga nas/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la nye brgyud du stsal ba myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i zhi ba nor du sgrub pa'i bye brag mgon ljang tshe'i bdag po'am phyag drug sna tshogs mkha' 'gro zhes grags pa 'di ni rgya gzhung las/

The dharma to receive came from the mouth of the mighty adept Rāhulagupta in India and was received by Khedrup Khyungpo Naljor as a direct lineage. From the cycle of peaceful wealth practices of the Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, this is the particular practice of Green Protector, Lord of Longevity, also known as Six-Armed Diverse Ḍāka. It states in the Indian source text:
bar mtshams med par zhag bdun bsgrub/ / zhal mthong dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung / / tshe 'phel gzhon nu'i lang tsho rgyas/ / lung bstan 'du ba rnam gsum 'byung /
Practice this for seven days without break— you will see him, attain both spiritual powers, extend your life, and grow more youthful; the prophesied three gatherings will occur.
zhes bsngags par mdzad pa mgon po nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul du sgrub pa/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub spyi dang khyad par tshe spel ba la mchog tu bsngags pa'i rjes gnang sogs

That is how it was praised. This protector is accomplished in an uncommon way. The general supreme and common spiritual powers, and particularly the extension of the life span is supremely extolled. The authorization for this…(etc.).

sbyar la maN+Dal 'bul/ gsol btab rnams mgon bka' spyi dang 'dra/ rgyas pa la dga' na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnang ba sbyin pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ yan lag lnga pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams byas la/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs (678) sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa kho nas 'grub/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag / ces sogs mgon dmar gyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod/

Add the rest, as far as offering the mandala. The supplications are the same as the general protector permissions. If you prefer the extensive version, then do refuge, awakening mind, granting permission, gathering thoughts, the five branches, and taking the vows of the five families. For short, recite only the seven-branch practice from the [Vajra] Tent [Tantra]: “I go for refuge in the Three Jewels…(etc.).” {678} Say, “In this world, omniscient ones…(etc.),” from the Red Protector practice.
slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/ oM swa b+hA wa nas/ 'khod par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin brjod/ de lha ngo bstan pa'i dod yin no/ /

For the visualization of the mandala of the ritual master inseparable from the front visualization [of the protectors], (recite from the liturgical description starting with) “oṃ svabhāva…(etc. to)…situated around them.” That is the equivalent of introducing the deities.

khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon ljang tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M/ lte bar swA/ gsang bar hA/ slob dpon gyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil pa'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem byon pa khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ /

In a mere instant, you all clearly appear as the Green Protector couple, lords of longevity, with oṃ at the forehead, āḥ at the throat, hūṃ at the heart, svā at the navel, and hā at the private parts. Light rays radiate from the master’s five places. Imagine that from the great charnel ground Cool Grove in the southeast, Swift-Acting Awareness Protector with hosts of ḍākinīs arrives—ur ur, chem chem—and dissolves slowly into you.
rol chen dang bcas pas snying po'i mthar/ a we sha ya AHAHAH zhes btags la drag tu bzla/
Accompanied by grand music, repeat the essence mantra and add aveśaya āḥ āḥ āḥ, reciting intensely.
de ye shes dbab pa'i dod yin no/ /
That is the equivalent of the descent of the awareness beings.
de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maN+Dal 'bul du bcug la/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pas bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol btab lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug /
Then offer a mandala for the sake of the main part, and repeat this supplication three times after me: “Guru-Protector inseparable, please confer the four empowerments on me.”
bum bskyed kyi lha'i dpral ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par mos mdzod/ /
A white stream of elixir emerges from the foreheads of the vase deities. Imagine that it washes away all your outer and inner sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations.

bkra shis tshe brtan rnam rgyal bum bzang na/ / nyon mongs gti mug ye shes ngag pa'i lha/ / rgyal ba'i 'od gzugs sgrib bral longs sku bzhugs/ / phyag drug tshe dpag med mgon dbang bskur bas/ / me long ye shes 'phro 'du'i 'od zer can/ / mi shigs rdo rje'i sku yi dbang thob shog /

In the excellent all-victorious vase of auspicious steadfast life, the deity of the awareness of the purified affliction of stupidity dwells as the Victor’s body of light, unobscured saṃbhogakāya. Six-Armed Amitāyus Protector confers empowerment with radiating and gathering light rays of mirror awareness. You obtain the empowerment of indestructible vajra body.
sngags bzla bzhin pas/ bum pa dpral bar reg ste/ bum chu blud/
As you repeat the mantra, touch the vase to their foreheads and pour them some vase water.
de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gres yang
Follow the same pattern in the following sections.

bum bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas/ bdud rtsi dmar po= nyon mongs 'dod chags dag pa'i ye shes lha/ rgyal ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhugs/ / rtsa sngags stong nyid snying po'i dbang bskur bas/ / sor rtog= gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbang thob shog /

A red stream of elixir emerges from the throats…(etc.). In the excellent all-victorious vase of auspicious steadfast life, the deity of the awareness of the purified affliction of desire dwells as the Victor’s eighty-four thousand sets of dharma and confers the empowerment of essence mantras, heart of emptiness, with radiating and gathering light rays of discriminating awareness. You obtain the empowerment of melodious speech with sixty branches.
mgrin par reg ste/
Touch the vase to their throats.

thugs ka nas bdud rtsi sngon po= nyon mongs zhe sdang dag pa'i ye= rgyal ba'i thugs mchog dpal gyi ye shes bzhugs/ / (679) mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes dga'i dbang bskur bas/ / chos dbyings= / rnam kun thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang thob shog /

A blue stream of elixir emerges from the heart…(etc.). In the excellent all-victorious vase of auspicious steadfast life, the deity of the awareness of the purified affliction of hatred dwells as the Victor’s supreme mind, glorious timeless awareness, {679} and confers the empowerment of unchanging coemergent purity with radiating and gathering light rays of the realm-of-phenomena awareness. You obtain the empowerment of knowing everything in all aspects.
snying gar/
Touch the vase to their hearts.

lte ba nas bdud rtsi ser po= / nyon mongs nga rgyal dag pa'i ye shes lha/ / rgyal ba'i yon tan phan bde mchog stsol bzhugs/ / chos kyi dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med pa/ / mnyam nyid= / mthong thos dran reg myur du sangs rgyas shog /

A yellow stream of elixir emerges from the navel…(etc.). In the excellent all-victorious vase of auspicious steadfast life, the deity of the awareness of the purified affliction of pride dwells as the Victor’s qualities, granting supreme welfare, the realm of phenomena inseparable from intrinsic awareness, [conferred] with radiating and gathering light rays of equality awareness. May you quickly attain awakening by seeing, hearing, recalling, and touching.
lte bar/
Touch the vase to their navels.

gsang ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun ljang gu= / nyon mongs phrag dog dag pa'i ye shes lha/ / rgyal ba'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par bzhugs/ / lnga ldan gsang rig gzungs sngags dbang bsgyur te/ / bya grub ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ / lhun grub rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thob shog /

A green stream of elixir emerges from the private parts…(etc.). In the excellent all-victorious vase of auspicious steadfast life, the deity of the awareness of the purified affliction of jealousy dwells as the Victor’s unceasing awakened activity, the master of fivefold secret knowledge dhāraṇīs, and confers the empowerment of great all-accomplishing awareness. May you obtain infinite buddha realms spontaneously.
snying po'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ gsang ba'i phyogs su reg pa ltar byas/ bum chu blud/ phyi ma rnams la bum chu 'thor bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang ngo / /
As you repeat the essence mantra, gesture in the direction of their groin and pour the vase water. It seems there is also a practice of sprinkling the vase water later on.
de dag ni bum pa'i dbang ngo / /
Those were the vase empowerments.
sin+d+hU ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi me long spyi bor gtugs/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba snying gar reg ste/
Place the mirror mandala of vermilion to their heads. Touch their hearts with the elixir-filled skull cup.

rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho dbyings brgyud pa'i/ / mtshan ldan thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang / / sgrib bral snang stong zung 'jug me long la/ / sin+d+hUr chos 'byung mkha' 'gro'i gzhal yas nas/ / bde stong sa bon phyag mtshan rtsa sngags lhas/ / skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /

With the authentic skull cup filled with elixir from the lineage of an infinite ocean realm of victors and the ḍākinīs’ palace of the vermilion source of phenomena on the dust-free mirror of form-emptiness inseparable, the deities of root mantras, hand implements, and seed syllables of bliss-emptiness confer empowerment on the fortunate children of good family.
rtsa sngags brjod cing sin+d+hU ras dpral bar thig le bya/ / nang mchod bdud rtsi sbyin no/ /
Recite the root mantras while marking the disciples’ foreheads with a spot of vermilion. Give the inner offering elixir.
de ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /
This was the secret empowerment.
de nas 'di skad ces brjod de/
Then repeat this:
gsang yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ / lha mo spros te bu la gtad/ / snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas gang / / thabs dang shes rab dbyer med gyur/ /
The secret mother Vajra Ḍākinī emanates a consort to give to the disciples. They enter into union and fill with bliss; method and wisdom become inseparable.
gang 'dul lha sku mtha' yas su/ / sems can don du byed gyur cig / rtsa sngags brjod la/ de'i don sgom du gzhug go / / de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /
With infinite deity forms to train whomever, may you enact the welfare of sentient beings. Repeat the root mantra and have them meditate on its meaning. This was the wisdom-awareness empowerment.

phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom du bcug ste/ (680) spros pa'i mtha' bral gcer mthong rang rig 'di/ / nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor ba/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ / ma rig 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgyud drug dang / / 'khrul rtog nyon mongs dug lnga rtsad chod nas/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus go 'phang mchog thob shog/ /

Have them meditate on the meaning of mahāmudrā. {680} Free of elaboration’s limits, this intrinsic awareness with naked perception in union with the space realm of phenomena confers empowerment on the fortunate children of good family, severing the roots of ignorance, the cyclic suffering of the six realms, and the delusional concepts of five toxic afflictive emotions. May you attain the supreme state of the unified three refuges.
oM d+ha re d+ha re d+ha ra Na b+ha te swA hA/ zhes me tog gtor/
oṃ dhare dhare dharaṇa bhate svāhā Toss flowers.
rgyas pa la spro na/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod cing / mdor bsdu na/ nyin mo bde legs sogs sh+tso ka gcig brjod/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ spyi bor bzung la/

If you are interested in more, recite the Sealed Word of Auspiciousness. For a brief version, recite the single verse, “May the day be auspicious…(nyin mo bde legs…etc.).” Now for the torma exhortation, hold the torma on their heads.

gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med du gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar mos/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sku phra mo dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

Clearly visualize this torma itself as the Guru-Protector inseparable, surrounded by the assemblies of buddhas and bodhisattvas all around. They come to the top of your head. Countless tiny forms of Guru-Protector inseparable come forth. Imagine that they slowly dissolve into your bodies.

dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po ljang gu tshe'i bdag po sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa sogs mgon dkar ltar la/ thogs med du bsgrub pa dang / khyad par du tshe la gnod pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad srung zhing zlog pa dang / 'chi ba med pa rdo rje tshe'i dngos grub stsal bar mdzad du gsol/ ces rol mo dang bcas te bka' bsgo bya/

Glorious Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, Green Lord of Longevity, Diverse Ḍāka, with retinue of millions of ḍākinī hosts…(etc., as in the White Protector)…accomplish without impediment whatever activity is entrusted to you. In particular, guard against and avert all harmful interruptions in the life span. Please grant the spiritual power of undying vajra longevity. Give this command exhortation accompanied by music.
de nas sngags kyi bzlas sung ni/
Then the transmission of the mantra recitation:

bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshogs byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ /

The mantra strings emerge from the heart of Guru-Protector inseparable. Imagine that they dissolve into your hearts and repeat this after me. (Say the essence mantra three times.) As the master scatters flowers, repeat this after me:
bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /
“Bhagavat, surely grant to me and please adhere to me.”

slar yang me tog rnams sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnams la gtor bas/ sngags (681) nus pa mthu can du mos mdzod/ / bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/
de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang zhes sogs/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni mgon nag gi skabs su brjod zin pa ltar ro/ /
The vows that you received on this occasion…(etc.). For the disciples’ concluding practices and the concluding ritual of the mandala, follow what has already been described for the Black Protector.
[Colophon by Tāranātha Kunga Nyingpo]
kun nas zab mo'i tshe sgrub ste/ / bar chad bsrung thabs dga' ba'i tog / mgon ljang sgrub thabs snying po 'di/ / gzhan la phan phyir sbyar ba yin/ /
More profound than all (Kun) longevity practices, pinnacle of joyful (ga) methods to guard against obstacles, this essence (Nyingpo) of Green Protector’s sādhana was added to share with others.
mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs kyi le mtshan no/ / mang+ga laM// // ! /
This was the chapter on the means of accomplishing the Green Protector, Lord of Longevity. maṅgalaṃ
VI.
VI. Permission for Guru-Protector Inseparable
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
rtsa brgyud bla ma rdo rje can/ / ye shes mgon po'i skur snang ba/ / zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag byas te/ / bla mgon dbyer med rjes gnang bshad/ /
Vajra root and lineage gurus appearing in the form of the Awareness Protector; I prostrate to your lotus feet and write the permission of Guru-Protector Inseparable.

gnas dben par sa gzhir chag chag dang phyag dar legs par byas/ dkon mchog gi rten dang khyad par mgon po'i bris sku sogs legs par bsham/ sa gzhi dri bzang gis byugs par ji tsam 'tshams pa'i thig gru bzhi btab/ de gnyis kyi bar nag pos byas pa la dur khrod gcig bri/ de'i nang du zlum po gnyis skor/ zlum skor dang gru bzhi'i bar shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba byas la zlum skor gcig gi bar sngon po/ zlum po'i nang ljang khur byas pa'i dbus su chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su hU~M dam gri gug gi lte ba la hU~M gis mtshan pa bris/ de'i steng du many+dzi'i khar nas nag rjen btags las byas pa'i gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum pa la mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba rgyan dang bcas pa la mda' dar me long mgon po'i tsakli btags pa btsugs la bzhag / mtha' mchod pa dang gtor ma spyan gzigs sna tshogs pas bskor/ sngon gtor gnas yo byin rlabs/ yi dam bsgom bzlas sogs nas brtsams/ mdun bskyed sgrub tshul rtsa ba bar chad kun sel gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin la/

In a secluded place, sprinkle and sweep the ground. Make a nice arrangement of supports for the Three Jewels and particularly for the Protector, such as a picture of his form. Anoint the ground with a suitable number of drops of saffron water and make a square. Make it black between the two, and draw one charnel ground. Make two circles within that. Between the circles and square, make the east white, the south yellow, the west red, and the north green. Make one circle area blue and the inner circle green. In its center make a blue-black source of phenomena, with three corners and a ring of fire. In its center, draw a hūṃ or a flaying knife marked with hūṃ at its hub. Upon that, on the opening of a mañji, place a three-cornered glorious-food torma made from raw black barley, adorned with dough buttons (mtheb kyus) around the edges. Then stick in an arrow with attached silk, mirror, and a card drawing (tsak li) of Protector. Around that, place the offerings, tormas, and various protector offerings.[20] Consecrate the preliminary torma, dwelling place, and implements. Begin with the yidam’s meditation, recitation, and so forth. The way to generate the front visualization is the same as described for the root practice of Removing All Obstacles.
khyad par gsol 'debs gong du/
Particularly, before the supplication, say:

mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon gser gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing (682) rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ mgon po 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'ur 'ur sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sil sil/ khrol khrol gar mdzad/ bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med par gyur/

Above Protector’s head, my benevolent root guru is yellow and as brilliant as one hundred thousand suns; he holds a wish-fulfilling gem to the heart with the right hand, a golden bell at the hip with the left, sitting in vajra posture, adorned by all decorations. {682} The guru is the essence of all the lineage gurus starting with Vajradhara. Light radiates from the guru’s body—Protector becomes the nature of light and bliss, dancing with the sounds of ur ur, sil sil. Light radiates from Protector and dissolves into the guru’s body. Guru becomes the nature of light and bliss, dancing and ringing the bell with the sounds of sil sil, khrol khrol. Guru is Protector. Protector is Guru. Guru and Protector are inseparable.

bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ / zhes lan ci rigs dang /

I and all sentient beings throughout the reaches of space supplicate the Guru-Protector inseparable. We supplicate Protector-Guru inseparable. We supplicate the benevolent root guru. Repeat an appropriate number of times.

na mo bud+d+ha 'i gsol 'debs lan brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba dang / bla mgon dbyer med gsol 'debs tshig rkang lnga po'ang mang du brjod la/ gzhung bsnyen khyug tsam mthar/ gtor 'bul tshig lhug 'dod gsol ma sbyar ba dang / bstod pa yan grub pa dang / bdag 'jug blang / slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gser gyi maN+Dal bcas mdun du 'khod pa la/

Then repeat the namo buddha supplication no less than one hundred times. Repeat the five lines of supplication to the Guru-Protector inseparable many times. After briefly doing the approach [recitation] from the source text, recite the prose words of the torma offering without the supplication for desires, finish up through the praises, and perform the self-induction. Do the cleansing of the disciples, who offer the mandala of gold in front.

slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i bka' zab mo zhu bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed khyad par can gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/

Then the ritual master says: Now then, for the sake of all mother sentient beings equal to the reaches of space, you absolutely must attain the state of Avalokiteśvara, Lord of the World. In order to do that, cultivate the special motivation and think that you will receive the profound permission of Guru-Protector Inseparable. Please pay attention.

de la rang cag rnams kyis snyed par dka' ba mi'i lus rten bzang po thob/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang ni mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i dus 'dir/ snying thag pa nas chos la 'bad dgos/ chos bsgrub pa la deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mthun rkyen nyung zhing 'gal rkyen mang ba yin te/ (683) yum las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la de la 'tshe ba mang / zhes gsungs pas/ de'i gnyen por chos skyong khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de la mnyam med shangs pa bka' brgyud pa 'di'i phyag bzhes dang bod kyi lha min 'dre min bsten pa'i lugs mi gcig / grub thob gtsang brgyud kyi srol skyong ba khyung po rnal 'byor gyi chos lugs yin/ khong gis mgon po phyag drug pa 'di rgya gar nas bod du spyan drangs pa yin te/

All of us now have obtained the excellent support of a human body, which is so difficult to find. We have encountered the precious doctrine of the Buddha, so difficult to encounter. At this time, while we have [the opportunity to] practice the essence of the doctrine—the Secret Mantra Vajrayāna—you must strive from the bottom of your heart to practice the dharma. In these days of degeneration, there are few favorable conditions for the practice of the dharma, but many adverse conditions. {683} It states in the Mother [Perfection of Wisdom]: “The precious dharma is rare, while constant dangers are many.”[21] To counteract that, you need to rely on a special dharma protector. This is the spiritual practice of the incomparable Shangpa Kagyu, which is not the same as systems that “rely on neither Tibetan gods nor demons” (i.e., haphazard). The protector of the customs of the pure adepts’ lineage was Khyungpo Naljor. He was the one who invited this Six-Armed Protector to Tibet from India.

khyung pos rgya gar du byon nas/ bla ma me tri pa ko sa la b+hi k+Sha'i dur khrod nang zhugs pa la/ gser srang bdun phul nas/ nged bod rnams longs spyod chung ba yin pas/ nor sgrub mthu myur la rtags mtshan che ba gcig zhu zhus pas/

Khyungpo went to India and offered seven measures of gold to the guru Maitrīpa, who was living in the beggar’s (bhikṣu) charnel ground in Kośala. He said, “We Tibetans have very little wealth. I request a speedy wealth practice that has big results.”

mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsan+dan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug ces kyang bya ba/ tshe 'di dang bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba/ mi nor rdzas gsum shugs la 'byung ba/ dgra thams cad brlag par byed pa/ zlog pas me tshugs pa/ mchog thun mong thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa/ mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhor la 'byung ba/ thun mong bsgrub pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba gcig yod pa de spyin gsungs so/ /

Maitrīpa said, “Called Wish-Fulfilling Gem, also called Tree-Dwelling Protector, also called Sandalwood Protector, also called Black Compassionate One, also called Six-Armed Protector—it guards from the fears of this life and the intermediate state. It brings gods, demons, and humans under control. It naturally attracts people, riches, and food. It destroys all enemies and repels invasions. It establishes all supreme and common powers in a matter of years and months. The attainment of supreme powers automatically entails the common ones. The attainment of common powers automatically entails the supreme ones. I’ll give you that one!”

de bla mas su la zhus byas pas/ kho bos dpal sha ba ri pa la thob/ dpal sha ba ri pa zhes bya ba de ni bram ze'i rigs su gyur pa/ dpal 'bras spungs dang nye bar grong khyer chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i dbus na/ tri pa la bya ba rol mo mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur nas/ sngon sangs rgyas la glu dang rol mo'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa de dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi 'jag ma'i spyil bu gcig na bsgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs yod (684) pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la DA ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po grags nas gzigs pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas rigs kyi bu nga'i sgrub thabs zungs shig gsungs nas/

“From which guru did you receive that?” asked Khyungpo. “I got it from glorious Śavarīpa. The one called glorious Śavarīpa was [once] born into the brahmin caste and became a talented musician known as Tripala who lived in the center of the thirty-two great cities near glorious Dhānyakaṭaka. He delighted the previous buddha with his singing and playing. Once when [in his later life as Śavarīpa] he was doing his practice in a grass hut in the great charnel ground Cool Grove, {684} a great pounding sound of ḍamarus and bells reverberated from the sky. He looked up and saw this Awareness Protector arrive and say, ‘Son of good family, receive my sādhana!’

sha ba ri pas sgrub thabs 'di yi ger bkod/ yang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang / thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma gsum byon nas sgrub thabs kyi lung gsungs te bsngags par mdzad do/ / de lta bu'i bla ma de lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i dus su kho bos phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud dang gdams ngag zhus/ de'i dus su phyag drug pa 'di gnang nas bsgrub pas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig nas zhal mthong ba yin no/ /

“So Śavarīpa wrote the text for this sādhana. Also Exalted Yoginī, Avalokiteśvara, and Tārā arrived and transmitted their sādhanas with praises.[22] At the time that this guru was living at the Śrīparvata mountain in the south, I received the mahāmudrā tantra and instructions. It was then that he granted the Six-Armed Mahākāla. After practicing it for twenty-one days, I saw the Protector face to face.

da khyung po rnal 'byor khyod kyis kyang / phyag drug pa 'di la nas nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang / spos sbyor ma chad par gyis/ khyi nag po la rdo ma rdeg / yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ de ltar byas pas dngos grub thams cad tshul bzhin du ster bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes lung bstan nas bka' bsgo lan gsum gyi bar mdzad nas gnang ngo / /

Now, Khyungpo Naljor, you too must offer a torma of raw black barley dough and continuously burn incense for this Six-Armed One. And do not throw rocks at black dogs. Believe, and regard [the Protector] as inseparable from the guru. If you do this, all the spiritual powers will be duly granted.” He made this prediction and then granted the permission blessing three times.

gzhan yang sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus su dur khrod chen po mun pa mi bzad pa zhes bya bar/ slob dpon chen po d+ha na saM skr-i ta zhes bya ba la/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / 'khor tshogs dbang du bsdus nas las thams cad bsgrub par mdzad pa'i bla ma des/ rA hu la gup+ta badzra la zhal gzigs nye brgyud kyi tshul du gnang / des khyung po rnal 'byor 'phan yul jog po'i ri la bzhugs dus rgya gar nas nam langs pa la phebs te/ bod du nyi shar la gdams pa sgo skyel du mdzad pa ste/

Furthermore, in an early account of a time past, in the great charnel ground of Intolerable Darkness,[23] there was a great master ācārya named Dhanasaṃskṛta who had actually seen this Awareness Protector. He brought under his control an entourage and accomplished all activities. That guru appeared in a vision to Rāhulaguptavajra and bestowed a direct lineage. Rāhula left from India at dawn and arrived in Tibet at sunrise one morning when Khyungpo Naljor was staying at Jokpori in Penyul and transferred the instruction to him.

grub thob rnam pa gnyis las brgyud pa'i myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gdams skor la rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi bka' rigs mi gcig pa mang du bzhugs na'ang / zhi drag gi sgrub thabs kun gyi zab gnad srog snying (685) lta bu med du mi rung ba'i yan lag gi bka' gsum gyi

There are many different kinds of permissions for authorization blessings of this Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s instruction cycle in the lineages coming from those two adepts. However, the profound vital points of all the peaceful and wrathful means of accomplishment that are like an indispensable life force are the three branch permissions. {685}
dang po bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'di ni/ grub chen sha ba ri ba'i zhal nas/ sngags dang gsol 'debs phyed mar byas shing gtor ma phul na zhal myur du ston par 'gyur ro/ /

The first of those is this Guru-Protector Inseparable, about which the great adept Śavarīpa said that if one offers a torma of buttered flour with mantras and supplications, the Protector would quickly reveal himself.
de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing gsol ba btab na mos gus zhung zhung byed par bsam na gzhan don dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /
Furthermore, if you supplicate him in the common way of all sentient beings and think that you bow repeatedly with devotion, immeasurable benefit for others will arise.
bla ma dang mgon po'i sku gang gsal ba la sems bzung na longs sku dang sprul skur 'tshang rgya'o/ /
If you hold in your mind the forms of the guru and Protector, however clearly, you will gain enlightenment as saṃbhogakāya and nirmāṇakāya.
rtogs pa skyes tshad sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du thag bcad na dag pa'i sa gsum thob bo/ /
If the degree of your realization is decisive, like cutting down a tree at the roots, you will gain the three pure levels.
gsol ba btab pa'i rjes sam 'gro 'chag gang gi dus su yang cir snang thams cad gsal la 'dzin med glang po'i lta stangs su bzhag na chos skur 'tshang rgya'o/ /

If, after supplicating or whenever you are moving about, you regard whatever appears clearly without fixation, resting with the elephant’s yogic gaze, then you will attain enlightenment as dharmakāya.
maN+Dal dang gtor ma bcas nas yid ches the tshom med par gsol ba btab na thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar byed do/ /
If, with mandalas and torma, you supplicate with belief free of doubt, you will be given the common spiritual powers.
ma yengs par zla ba bdun bsgom na de nyid du 'tshang rgya bar byed do/ /
If you meditate for seven months without distraction, you will be awakened in that suchness.
tho rengs thun re bskom na 'chi khar gzugs sku dang chos sku thob bo/ /
If you meditate for every session at dawn, at death you will attain the rūpakāyas and dharmakāya.
dbang dang 'brel ba lan gcig thob na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang bar dor 'tshang mi rgya mi srid do/ /

If you once obtain the empowerment and make a connection, even if you have committed the five acts with immediate retribution, it is impossible that you will not be enlightened in the intermediate state.
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus bsal bar shog /
Guru-Protector inseparable, I go for refuge with devotion. May I dispel every afflictive emotion of all sentient beings.
ces pa lan gcig thos pa dang gser la bris nas btags na yang 'chi khar zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /
If you hear that [prayer] just once or if you write it in gold letters and wear it, you will see them at death.
ye shes mgon po mdun byon nas/ / bdag 'dra sha ba ri pa la/ / lan gsum bar du gsungs nas kyang / / bka' rgyas btab nas mkha' la gshegs/ /
“Awareness Protector arrived in front, and to one such as myself, Śavarīpa, spoke thrice and sealed his command then departed into the sky.
e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ / tshig brgyud dag las ma spel cing / /
Ema! this wonderful, amazing dharma: do no spread it beyond the single lineage.”
ces ched du bsngags shing bka' rgyas btab pa'i gser chos (686) yin la/
As it was extolled purposefully in that way, it is a golden dharma sealed by command. {686}

spyir chos skyong gzhan dag la'ang bla mgon dbyer med kyi kha skad tsam re mchis kyang de dag ni chos skyong ye shes pa yin par sgrub pa dang bla ma nyid rtsa gsum kun 'dus su shes dgos pa'i gtan tshig tsam yin la/ 'di ni rgya gzhung gi khungs dang ldan pa'i sgrub tshul khyad par can byin rlabs kyi bka' dang bcas pa dmigs bsal du bzhugs pas 'di ltar sgrub pas nyams rtogs skyed byed kyi bla sgrub khyad par can du 'gyur ba ma zad/ mgon po 'di la rten bzhi gnad gsum zhes bya ba yod pas bla ma mgon po dbyer med du bsgrub pa 'di de kho na nyid kyi rten zhes bya ba mgon po 'di brten pa la med du mi rung ba'i yan lag kyang yin pas

In general, although other dharma protectors sometimes have a mere proverbial guru and protector inseparable, those dharma protectors are practiced as awareness beings, and the guru must be understood as the union of all Three Roots through logic alone. This one here is the special manner of practice with authentic origins in Indian scripture, and it is endowed with the exclusive permission blessings. So by practicing in this way, it becomes a special kind of guru yoga that generates experiential realization. Not only that, this protector has what is called “four supports and three vital points.” Thus this practice of Guru-Protector Inseparable is “the support of suchness” (de kho na nyid kyi rten), also making it an indispensable branch on which to depend.
de lta bu'i bka' zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maN+Dal phul 'tshal/ zhes 'bul du gzhug /
Please offer a mandala and visualize it as a gift to request such a profound permission. Have them offer the mandala.

thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs 'di'i rjes= khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ / gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ / 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen pos/ / bdag la blo mchog stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ /

Hold a flower between your joined palms and repeat this three times after me: “Once your lotus feet are abandoned, there is no other lord of refuge. Great mighty hero of migrators, please grant me the sublime mind.”
de nas lha ngo sprad pa ni/
Then the introduction to the deities:

mdun gyi dkyil 'khor pa de nyid srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su sogs rtsa ba mgon mthing gi rjes gnang skabs ltar/ tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa/ de dag gi steng du drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/

This mandala in front of you has the protection circle with the unbearable great charnel ground. In its center…(etc., as in the authorization of the main Black Protector). Do the fulfillment ritual properly. Above [the front visualization], the benevolent root guru and all the lineage gurus dwell like a dense mass of clouds. In their presence, think that you arouse the sublime mind of awakening that begins with the regular confession and repeat this three times after me: “I go for refuge in the Three Jewels…(etc.).”
khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag legs par blangs nas tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/
In particular, think that you will fully undertake the Vajrayāna sacred pledges and vows and will keep them properly, and repeat this three times after me:
sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su/ / ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /
“All buddhas and bodhisattvas, however many in all times— all of you, please heed me.

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ / dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ / nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ / yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu/ / bdag gis byang chub mchog gi (687) sems/ / ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi/ /
I, named so-and-so, from this time forward until such time as I fully abide in the heart of awakening, will arouse every aspect {687} of the mind of supreme awakening.
ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ / byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ / byang chub sems ni bla na med/ / dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /
Just as the lords of the three times roused the unsurpassable awakening mind that definitely leads to awakening, I too will produce that holy thought.
sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ / tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / / dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / / sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ / bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /
I resolutely take the vows of the buddha yoga of the three ethical behaviors: the training [of controlling malpractices], gathering virtuous dharmas, and helping sentient beings.
sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ / deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ / nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /
From now on I resolutely take the vows to [honor] the Buddha, dharma, and sangha, the unsurpassable Three Jewels, and never to reject them.
rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ / rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / / yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ / slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /
I take as the true state vajra, bell, [and] mudra of the great, sublime vajra family. I also accept the [vajra] master.
rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ / dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ / nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ / sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /
The pleasant sacred pledge of the great, sublime jewel family is to always give the four gifts at the six times of every day.
byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ / pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ / phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ / dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /
I uphold every Holy Dharma of the outer, inner, and secret three vehicles of the pure great lotus family that arises from great awakening.
las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ / sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ / yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ / mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /
The great, sublime action family possesses all the vows. I take them as the genuine state and will make all possible offerings.
byang chub sems ni bla na med/ / dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ / sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /
Awakening mind is most sublime; I will arouse that holy aspiration and maintain all vows without exception for the sake of all sentient beings.
ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ / ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ / dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / / sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /
I shall free those not freed. I shall liberate those not liberated. I shall relieve those not relieved and place all sentient beings beyond misery.”
lan gsum/
Repeat three times.

de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos mdor bsdus pa grub nas/ dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i slad du bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa la mos gus dung ba sogs mgon mthing gi skabs ltar la/ thugs kar hU~M sngon pos mtshan par sgoms (688) shig / de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po sogs dbang sgrub skabs ltar la/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid du mos pa dung dung mdzad nas sku'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

After completing those brief practices of induction, in order to bring down blessings in the main practice, your yearning devotion to the Guru-Protector inseparable…(etc., as in Black Protector practice). Meditate that the heart is marked with blue hūṃ. {688} Then, on the crown of Protector inseparable from the torma visualized in front, my benevolent root guru is yellow…(etc., as in the section on accomplishing the empowerment). Arouse strong devotion to that embodiment of Guru-Protector inseparable and repeat this supplication after me to receive the blessing of awakened body:
na mo bud+d+ha ya/ na mo gu ru ha/ badzra bI ra bI ri Ne/ shrI DA ka DA ki nI/ dzo ga dzo gi nI/ sarba bud+d+ha bo d+hi s+t+wA ya sha ra NAM/ gats+tsha mi kyai/ zhes lan gsum/
“namo buddhāya / namo guruve / vajra vīra vīreṇe / śrī ḍāka ḍākinī / joka jokinī / sarva buddha bodhisatvāya śaraṇaṃ / gacchāmi kyai” (Repeat three times.)
bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug /
“I and all sentient beings throughout the reaches of space supplicate the Guru-Protector inseparable. We supplicate Protector-Guru inseparable.” (Repeat three times.)

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po dang mgon po'i smin mtshams nas mgon po'i sku dkar po chung la yan lag rags pa mang po byung / khyed rang gi smin mtshams na phar sib sib thim pas bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i sku'i byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/

By your supplicating like that, white light rays emerge from between the eyebrows of the guru atop Protector’s head and from Protector’s midbrow many miniature protectors with small white bodies and thick limbs arise. They come across to the point between your eyebrows and slowly dissolve. Think that you have obtained the blessing of the awakened body of Guru-Protector inseparable.
bla mas na mo bud+d+ha dang badzra ma hA kA la 'i sngags drag tu brjod cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya/
The guru powerfully recites the namo buddha and vajra mahākāla mantras and plays intense music.
de la bla ma dang mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag / bum pa'i dbang bskur thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

With that, you have obtained the blessing of the guru’s and Protector’s awakened body. All negative actions and obscurations accumulated through your body are purified. Think that you have obtained the vase empowerment.
gsung gi byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du sngar ltar gsol ba gdab/
Supplicate as before to request the blessing of awakened speech.

mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po dang mgon po'i mgrin pa nas mgon po'i sku dmar po chung la rags pa mang po byung / khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas thar sib sib thim pas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la sngags dang rol mo byed/

Red light rays emerge from the throat of the guru atop Protector’s head and from Protector’s throat many miniature protectors with small red bodies and thick limbs arise. They come across to your throat and slowly dissolve. Think that you have obtained the blessing of the awakened speech of Guru-Protector inseparable. Repeat the mantra and play music. {689}
des bla ma (689) dang mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

With that, you have obtained the blessing of the guru’s and Protector’s awakened speech. All negative actions and obscurations accumulated through your speech are purified. Think that you have obtained the secret empowerment.
thugs kyi byin rlabs zhu ba'i don du sngar ltar gsol ba btab/
Supplicate as before to request the blessing of awakened mind.

mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas mgon po'i sku mthing ga chung la rags pa mang po byung / khyed rang gi snying kha nas phar sib sib thib pas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / ces brjod la sngags dang rol mo byed/

Blue light rays emerge from the heart of the guru atop Protector’s head, and from Protector’s heart many miniature protectors with small blue bodies and thick limbs arise. They come across to your heart and slowly dissolve. Think that you have obtained the blessing of the awakened mind of Guru-Protector inseparable. Repeat the mantra accompanied by music.

des bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /

With that, you have obtained the blessing of the guru’s and Protector’s awakened mind. All negative actions and obscurations accumulated through your mind are purified. Think that you have obtained the wisdom-awareness empowerment. Again, repeat this supplication after me to request the blessings of Guru-Protector inseparable’s awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities:
bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs gsol 'debs nyer gcig dang / na mo bud+d+ha lan gsum/
“I and all sentient beings throughout the reaches of space…(etc.).” Repeat that supplication twenty-one times and namo buddhā…three times.

de ltar gsol ba btab pas mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku'i cha thams cad las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa byung / mgon po'i sku'i cha thams cad las kyang mgon po'i sku chung la rags pa sna tshogs pa'i mdog can DA ma ru dang g.yer kha'i sgra dang hU~M hU~M phaT phaT kyi sgra sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rang gi lus kyi stod smad bar gsum nas phar sib sib thim pas khyed rang gi lus sems bde bas gang / lus kyi nang na mgon po rnams gar mdzad cing nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhal du gsol/ khyod kyi bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub ces pa'i gsung lhang lhang 'byon bzhin pa dang bcas pas (690) khyed rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob stim pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brjod la sngags dang rol mo dang bcas pas/

By your supplicating like that, countless multicolored light rays emerge from all physical aspects of the guru atop Protector’s head and from Protector’s physical aspects countless miniature protectors with small bodies in different colors and thick limbs arise with the sounds of ḍamarus and bells and shouts of hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ. They come across and dissolve slowly into your body’s upper, lower, and in-between parts, filling your body and mind with bliss. Inside your body, the protectors dance and devour all your sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. As they arrive they loudly declare, “I will remove all your obstacles. I will create all favorable conditions.” {690} Think that as your whole body is filled, you obtain the blessings of the awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities of Guru-Protector inseparable. Repeat the mantra accompanied by music.

phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /

Holy root and lineage gurus dwelling in the ten directions and three times, bless me! Yidam deities of the mandala, bless me! Heroes and heroine yoginīs, bless me! Buddhas and bodhisattvas all, bless me!

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /

Glorious Six-Armed Awareness Protector and deities, do not veil your timeless awareness. Do not delay your compassion. Do not block your power and ability. Do not distance your blessings. All of you, bless me through your body, bless me through your speech, bless me through your mind!

sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / ces brjod do/ /
Bless me through your unlimited awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities! Bless me right now! Bless me quickly! Bless me on this very seat!
des bla ma dang mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag /

With that, you have obtained the blessing of the guru’s and Protector’s awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. All negative actions and obscurations accumulated through your body, speech, and mind are purified.
dbang bzhi pa thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /
Think that you have obtained the fourth empowerment.
mtha' rten byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang zhu ba'i slad du gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos/
Repeat this supplication after me to receive the supplemental support of the torma empowerment:
bla ma mgon po dbyer med sogs tshig rkang lnga po lan gsum/
“Guru-Protector inseparable…(etc.).” Say the five lines three times.

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hU~M gi 'od zer gyis gtor ma mgon por gsal ba de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs/ mos gus dung pa byas shing bla mas bka' bsgos (691) pa'i tshe/ sku'i gnas rnams nas bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam pa dang khro chung me mtshon dpag tu med pa byung / khyed rang gi lus la zhugs pas sdig sgrib nad gdon 'gal rkyen thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa bzhin du bcom tshe bsod nyams rtogs la sogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par byas/ bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsang ba gsum dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

Through your supplicating in that way, light rays from the hūṃ in the guru’s heart invoke the torma appearing clearly as Protector to the top of your head. Arouse yearning devotion, and when the guru exhorts [Protector], {691} from his body comes elixir in the form of light rays and countless wrathful miniatures with fireweapons. They enter your body and vanquish all negativities, obscurations, sickness, spirits, and adverse conditions, like sunrays striking frost. They increase and expand your life span, merit, experience, realization, and so forth. Imagine that you are blessed by the three secrets of Guru-Protector with retinue.

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang / rtsa brgyud bla ma/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thugs bskyed dam tshig gnyen po ma g.yel bar rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlob par mdzad du gsol/ mi 'bral bar rtag tu dgongs shing 'grogs la mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad sel zhing dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor yar zla ltar 'phel ba sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thogs med yid bzhin du 'grub bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur ba nyid du bde blag tu thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces dang gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams brjod/

Glorious Awareness Protector, Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara; root and lineage gurus; buddhas and bodhisattvas; heroes and ḍākinīs; ocean of the oath-bound; emanations and further emanations with retinues: do not forget your strict sacred pledge of awakening mind just as you promised. Please quickly grant your blessings to these vajra disciples. Please constantly consider and accompany them, never apart, and be their lord protector and champion. Please remove all adverse conditions that interfere with their attainment of awakening and increase like the waxing moon their prosperity of the necessities conducive to practicing the Holy Dharma. Accomplish peaceful, enriching, magnetizing, and wrathful awakened activity without restriction just as it is desired. In short, please quickly and easily obtain [for them] every common and supreme spiritual power. Say the mantras of the principals and retinue.
mthar/ dzaHhU~M baM hoH
At the end: jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ

zhes brjod pas steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la thim/ de las rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa 'phros/ khyed rang la thim pas mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

By saying that, the root and lineage gurus in the space above melt into light and dissolve into the torma visualized as Protector. From that, a second identical form radiates and dissolves into you. Imagine that you are blessed with Protector’s awakened body, speech, and mind inseparable from your own body, speech, and mind.
spro na gtor ma'i cha shas sbyin par bshad/ bkra shis brjod/
If you wish, distribute parts of the torma. Recite verses of auspiciousness. {692}

de ltar dbang (692) dang 'brel pa lan cig thob na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'ang bar dor 'tshang mi rgya mi srid par gsungs pa'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi bka' zab mo legs par grub sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la/ dam tshig khas blangs nas de dang / dkyil 'khor rjes chog rtsa ba'i mgon po ltar ro/ /

It is said of this that if you once obtain the empowerment and make a connection, even if you have committed the five acts with immediate retribution, it is impossible that you will not be enlightened in the intermediate state. The profound permission of Guru-Protector Inseparable is well achieved…(etc.). Make the connection with that, and continue up through taking the sacred pledges. The concluding rituals of the mandala are the same as in the main protector practice.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Yönten Gyatso]
yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas ni/ / bla mgon dbyer med gsol 'debs yin/ / byin rlabs rgya mtshor 'jug nus na/ / don gnyis nor bu lon par nges/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi rjes gnang gi le tshan no/ /

The source of all qualities (Yönten) is the supplication of Guru-Protector inseparable. If you can enter the ocean (Gyatso) of blessings, it will surely yield the gems of two purposes. This was the chapter on the authorization for Guru-Protector Inseparable.
mang+ga laM// // !
VII.
VII. Protector Dispelling Defilements
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
snying rje'i dbang phyug sems dpa' che/ / sdig sgrib 'joms phyir khros pa'i tshul/ / gang de'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ / btud nas grib sel rjes gnang bkod/
Mighty compassionate one, great hero, in wrathful form to conquer negativities and obscurations; I bow to your lotus feet and arrange the authorization of Dispelling Defilements.

maN+Dal mchod gtor bsham tshul bar chad kun sel dang 'di/ sgrub thabs kyi phrin las kyang de dang mtshungs pa las/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod rjes/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon pas mnyam gzhag gi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkha' la 'khod par gyur/

Lay out the mandala, offerings, and torma as in Removing All Obstacles. The same for the activities of the sādhana. After the invocation, offerings, and praises, begin: Above Protector’s head, the root guru is white Vajrasattva, his right hand holding a five-pronged crystal vajra at his heart and his left hand in equipoise with an elixir-filled skull cup. He sits in vajra cross-legged position, with infinite light radiating from his body. Light rays radiate from his heart and invoke the vajra body, speech, and mind of all buddhas and bodhisattvas in the form of deities. They are arrayed in the sky above.

rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ bla ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/

Deities of three vajras, please cleanse and purify any defilement that has touched the guru’s body, speech, and mind and all violations of the sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind. With this supplication, white, red, and blue hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the three places of the deities of vajra body, speech, and mind. They dissolve into the guru’s three places, cleansing and purifying the defilements that have stricken the guru’s body, speech, and mind, and all violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind.
yig brgya bdun/ des 'gre ste/
Repeat the hundred syllables seven times. Then apply the same formula: {693}
bla ma rin po che/ (693) mgon po'i sku gsung thugs la sogs dang / bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa sogs kyi mthar yig brgya bdun/

Precious guru, please cleanse and purify defilements that have touched Protector’s body, speech, and mind…(etc., and)…hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the guru’s three places…(etc.). At the end, repeat the hundred syllables seven times.

bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi sgo gsum la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma mgon po'i gnas gsum nas yi ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ 'khor rnams dang bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la grib kyis phog pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag / bdag gi lus kyi nang yi ge brgya pa'i 'od zer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur/

Guru-Protector inseparable, please cleanse and purify any defilement that has touched the retinue’s and my three doors and violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind. With this supplication, white, red, and blue hundred-syllable mantras radiate from the three places of the Guru and Protector. They dissolve into the retinue’s and my three places, cleansing and purifying the defilements that have stricken the retinue’s body, speech, and mind, and all violations of sacred pledges related to awakened body, speech, and mind. My body inside is filled with the light rays of the hundred syllables, which cleanse and purify from the roots all negativities, obscurations, and downfalls.

ces mos la yig brgya bdun te nyer gcig gam/ 'byung na re re la'ang grangs ci mang bzla/ mthar bshags pa dang gzhung bsnyen khyug tsam/ gtor 'bul bstod pa bdag 'jug bcas grub nas/ slob ma la khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab gong ltar la/

Imagine that and repeat the hundred syllables seven or twenty-one times or, to accomplish it, recite many times for each [visualization]. Afterward, do the confession and a cursory approach from the source. After practicing the torma offering, praises, and self-induction, the disciples wash and the mind of awakening is clarified as before, except change to:
de'i ched du ye shes mgon po sdig sgrib sbyong mdzad kyi bka' zhes bsgyur/
“To that end, I will receive the permission for Awareness Protector who purifies negative acts and obscurations.”
de la 'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhi drag gi sgrub thabs spyi la med du mi rung ba'i yan lag gi bka' gnyis pa grib sel mgon po 'di ni/ rgya gzhung las/

In that, this is the indispensable branch, the second permission, [which forms part of] the general peaceful and wrathful sādhanas of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector—that is, the Protector Dispelling Defilements. An Indian source text states:
bla ma ye shes mgon po la/ / grib phog dam tshig 'gal gyur na/ / bshags pa bya zhing dam tshig bskang / / dam tshig bskang bas dngos grub thob/ /
If sacred pledge is transgressed and defiles the guru [and] Awareness Protector, confess and amend the sacred pledge; by fulfilling the pledge, spiritual powers are attained.

ces gsungs pa ste/ dper na rgyal rigs sam/ bram ze gtsang ma gdol pa'i gnas mi gtsang ba la 'byon tu mi gtub pa ltar rgyud ma dag pa'i sgrib pa can la bla ma mgon po'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs 'jug par mi 'gyur cing / khyad par rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig la 'gal nyams shor na dngos grub mi thob pa'i steng du bar chad sna (694) tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur la/

For instance, just as someone of the pure kṣatriya or brahmin caste cannot visit the impure dwelling of a caṇḍāla person, Guru-Protector’s compassion and blessings will not enter a person with the obscuration of an impure mind stream. Especially if they have gone astray by transgressing and damaging the root and branch sacred pledges, not only will they not obtain spiritual powers, various obstacles will occur as well. {694}

sgrib pa dag na byin rlabs rtsol med du 'jug pa dang / dam tshig nyams chags bskangs na dngos grub bde blag tu thob par 'gyur pa yin cing / de dag gi thabs ni gsar rnying kun las rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas las zab pa gcig kyang ma gsungs shing de la'ang skabs don rigs pa yod pa las/ 'dir nyams chags sgrib pa sbyong ba la shin tu zab pa'i grib sel gyi bka' zab mo bsgrub par sogs mtshams sbyar la maN+Dal/ gsol gdab/ lha ngo sprad pa/ rgyun bshags/ sdom bzung / slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni sngar ltar la/

But if they purify the obscurations, blessings will enter unbidden. If violations are amended, spiritual powers will easily accrue. And there is no more profound method to do that than the meditation-recitation of Vajrasattva. There is not one instance from the Sarma or Nyingma traditions that does not concur. Of all the suitable versions, this occasion is for the purification of the obscuration of violations, the extremely profound practice of the permission for Dispelling Defilements…(etc.). Continue with the mandala, supplication, introducing the deities, regular confession, taking vows, and up to the disciple’s visualization as the deity.

de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de rnams la mos gus drag po dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

Then: Visualize the Protector in front inseparable from the [support] torma. Above Protector’s head, the benevolent root guru is white Vajrasattva, his right hand holding a five-pronged crystal vajra at his heart and his left hand in equipoise with an elixir-filled skull cup. He sits in vajra cross-legged position, with infinite light radiating from his body. A mass of light rays radiate from his heart and invoke from all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions, their vajra bodies in the forms of Vairocana, vajra speech as Amitābha, and vajra mind as Akṣobhya. Imagine that they come before you in the sky like dense cloud banks. Then with intense devotion to all of them, repeat this supplication after me:

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod du gzhug /

“Guru, yidams, buddhas, bodhisattvas, and deities of the three vajras, please bless me with cleansing and purifying all violations of sacred pledge related to the awakened body, speech, and mind of my holy root and lineage gurus.” Have them say that.

de ltar gsol ba btab pas sku rdo rje rnams kyi thugs ka nas oM yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung ste/ gtor ma (695) dang dbyer med kyi mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i smin mtshams nas phar thim pas bla ma'i smin mtshams kyi nang thams cad oM yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pas gang / bla ma'i sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag go snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod par zhu/ zhes yig brgya bzlar gzhug /
