By your supplicating in that way, a white letter oṃ along with white light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the hearts of the body vajras. {695} From the point between the eyebrows of the guru atop the head of Protector and torma inseparable, they come over and dissolve. The inside of the guru’s midbrow is all filled with white oṃ letters and white light rays of the hundred syllables. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge relating to the guru’s body are purified. Imagine that and repeat the hundred syllables three times. Have them recite the hundred syllables.

des bgre ste/ gsung rdo rje rnams kyi thugs ka nas AHyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung sogs gong ma ltar la/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang / gsung gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum bzla/

Apply that pattern to the following: A red letter āḥ along with red light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the hearts of the speech vajras…(etc., as before). The inside of the guru’s throat is all filled. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge relating to the guru’s speech are purified. Recite the hundred syllables three times.

thugs rdo rje rnams kyi thugs ka nas hU~M yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung / bla ma'i thugs ka'i nang thams cad gang / thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum bzla/

A blue letter hūṃ along with blue light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the hearts of the mind vajras…(etc., as before). The inside of the guru’s heart is all filled. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge relating to the guru’s mind are purified. Recite the hundred syllables three times.

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i spyi bo nas oM yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung nas gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i smin mtshams nas phar thim pas mgon po'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu oM yig yig brgya 'od zer dang bcas pas gang mgon po'i sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la yig brgya lan gsum brjod du gzhug /

Again repeat this supplication after me: “Guru, deities of the three vajras, please bless me and all sentient beings with purifying all violations of sacred pledge related to the awakened body, speech, and mind of the Swift-Acting Awareness Protector.” By your supplicating in that way, a white letter oṃ along with white light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the guru’s head. They come over and dissolve at the point between the eyebrows of the Protector and torma indivisible. The coiled hair between the eyebrows of the Protector is filled with white oṃ letters and white light rays of the hundred syllables. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge relating to Protector’s body are purified. Say that and have them repeat the hundred syllables three times.

de bzhin du bla ma'i mgrin pa nas AHyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung / mgon po'i mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang / gsung gi dam (696) tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum/

Similarly: A red letter āḥ along with red light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the guru’s throat. Protector’s throat inside is all filled. {696} Think that all the violations of sacred pledge relating to Protector’s speech are purified. Say the hundred syllables three times.

bla ma 'i thugs ka nas hU~M yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung / mgon po'i thugs ka'i nang thams cad gang / thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum/

A blue letter hūṃ along with blue light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the guru’s heart. Protector’s heart inside is all filled. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge relating to Protector’s mind are purified. Say the hundred syllables three times.

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i spyi bo nas oM yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung nas/ gnod sbyin bzhi dang lha mo la sogs 'khor rnams kyi smin mtshams nas phar thim pas 'khor rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu oM yig yig brgya 'od zer dang bcas pas gang / sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la yig brgya lan gsum brjod du gzhug /

Again repeat this supplication after me: “Guru-Protector inseparable, please bless me and all sentient beings with purifying all violations of sacred pledge related to the awakened body, speech, and mind of the retinue.” By your supplicating in that way, a white letter oṃ along with white light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the Protector’s head. They come over and dissolve at the point between the eyebrows of the retinue, such as the four yakṣas and goddesses. The coiled hairs between the eyebrows of the retinue are filled with white oṃ letters and white light rays of the hundred syllables. Think all the violations of sacred pledge of the body are purified. Say that and have them say the hundred syllables three times.

de bzhin du mgon po'i mgrin pa nas AHyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung / mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang / gsung gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum/

Similarly: A red letter āḥ along with red light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from Protector’s throat. [The retinue’s] throats inside are all filled. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge of speech are purified. Say the hundred syllables three times.

mgon po'i thugs ka nas hU~M yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung / thugs ka'i nang thams cad gang / thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag snyam pa dang yig brgya lan gsum bzla/

A blue letter hūṃ along with blue light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from Protector’s heart. [The retinue’s] hearts inside are all filled. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge of the mind are purified. Say the hundred syllables three times.

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung phyi nang grib dang mi gtsang ba'i gnod pa thams (697) cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i smin mtshams dang mgon po'i smin mtshams nas oM yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pa byung khyed rang gi smin mtshams nas phar thim pas smin mtshams kyi nang thams cad oM yig dkar po yig brgya 'od zer dkar po dang bcas pas gang / bla ma dang mgon po gnyis kyi sku'i byin rlabs thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod la yig brgya lan gsum gyi rjes zlos mdzod cig ces yig brgya lan gsum zlar gzhug /

Again repeat this supplication after me: “Guru-Protector inseparable with retinue, please bless me and all sentient beings with cleansing and purifying all negative actions, obscurations, faults, downfalls, outer and inner defilements, and dangerous impurities accumulated through body, speech, and mind since beginningless time.” By your supplicating in that way, a white letter oṃ along with white light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from between the eyebrows of the guru atop the head of Protector inseparable from the torma and from between Protector’s eyebrows. They come over and dissolve at the point between your own eyebrows. Between your eyebrows inside is all filled with white oṃ letters and white light rays of the hundred syllables. Think that all the violations of sacred pledge of the body are purified. {697} Think that you have obtained the body blessing of both the guru and Protector. Imagine that and repeat the hundred syllables three times after me. Have them repeat the hundred syllables three times.

bla mas kyang yig brgya brjod la rol mo bya/ des khyed rang gis tsho 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag / bla ma dang mgon po'i sku dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin no/ / yang bla ma dang mgon po'i mgrin pa nas AHyig dmar po yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa byung / khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas phar thim pas mgrin pa'i nang thams cad AHyig yig brgya 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pas gang / bla ma dang mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod pa yig brgya rol mo sogs byed/

The guru also says the hundred syllables while music plays. That purifies all physical sickness, spirits, negativities, obscurations, and violations of sacred pledge accumulated in your lives of beginningless cycle existence. You become inseparable from the awakened body of the guru and Protector. Again, a red letter āḥ along with red light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the guru’s and Protector’s throats. They come over and dissolve from your throat. Your throat inside is all filled with red āḥ letters and red light rays of the hundred syllables. Think that you have obtained the speech blessing of both the guru and Protector. Say that and do the hundred syllables with music, and so on.

des khyed rang gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag bla ma dang mgon po'i gsung dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin no/ / yang bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas hU~M yig sngon po yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pa byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas phar thim pas snying ga'i nang thams cad hU~M yig yig brgya 'od zer sngon po dang bcas pas gang / bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig (698) ces brjod la yig brgya rol mo sogs byed/

des khyed rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag / bla ma dang mgon po'i thugs dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin no/ / yang bla ma dang mgon po'i gnas gsum nas oM AHhU~M gsum yig brgya 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang bcas pa byung / khyed rang gi lus kyi stod smad thams cad nas thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad oM AHhU~M yig brgya 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang bcas pas gang / bla ma mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la yig brgya dang rol mo byed/

That purifies all mental sickness, spirits, negativities, obscurations, and violations of sacred pledge accumulated in your lives of beginningless cycle existence. You become inseparable from the awakened mind of the guru and Protector. Again, oṃ, āḥ, and hūṃ along with white, red, and blue light rays of the hundred syllables emerge from the guru’s and Protector’s three places. They dissolve into all your upper and lower body. Your whole body inside is filled with oṃ, āḥ, and hūṃ letters and white, red, and blue light rays of the hundred syllables. Think that you have obtained the blessings of the awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities of the guru and Protector. Say that and do the hundred syllables with music, and so on.

des khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag / bla ma mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dang dbyer med du 'gyur ba yin pas de lta bu'i dga' spro dang nges shes bskyed par mdzod cig / ces brjod/

That purifies all physical, verbal, and mental sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations accumulated in your lives of beginningless cycle existence. You become inseparable from the awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities of the guru and Protector. Therefore, be joyful and arouse certitude.
de nas gtor dbang / bkra shis rjes kyi rim pa rnams snga mas 'gre shes par bya'o/ /
Then do the [remaining] stages from the torma empowerment to auspicious verses that you can apply from the previous descriptions.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Taye]

bsod nams blo gros ldan rnams kyis/ / bsgrub bya'i snying po 'di yin pas/ / mtha' yas 'jig rten rnams su yang / / brtson pa chen pos tshol bar rigs/ / grib sel mgon po'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// !

As this is the essence of what to practice for those with merit and intelligence (Lodrö), rightly have they sought it with great effort throughout all the boundless (Taye) worlds. This was the chapter on the authorization for Protector Dispelling Defilements. maṅgalaṃ
VIII.
VIII. Authorization for Both Magnetizing Ḍākinīs and Getting Down to the Vital Point
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje/ / 'khor 'das dbang du mdzad de la/ / btud nas mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi/ / ngo mtshar gdams pa'i sgo 'byed bri/ /
Lord of the hosts of heroes and ḍākinīs, overpowering cyclic existence and transcendence, to you I bow and write the wonderful instructions to open the door to magnetizing ḍākinīs.

maN+Dal bca' gzhi sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rten gtor ma 'dzom na gsang rten dang ldan pa'i mda' dar me long dang lhan cig btsug / ma 'dzom na me long la sin+d+hU ras hrIHbcu gsum bris pa btags/ sgrub thabs phrin las rtsa ba bar chad kun sel ltar la/ bzlas pa'i gong du/

The ritual preparation of the mandala is the same as before, except in the absence of a support torma, [use] an arrow with attached silk and mirror along with the secret support [i.e., vermilion]. If you don’t have that, use [just] the mirror with thirteen hrīḥ syllables drawn in the vermilion. As in the basic activity sādhana of Removing All Obstacles, before the recitation, say:

mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ sku mdog dmar po g.yas thod pa'i DA ma ru 'khrol zhing / (699) g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum dbang du sdud pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i dpral ba'i sin+d+hU ra'i thig le gru gsum gyi steng na yi ge hrIHdmar po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lang tsho ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs can/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs shing gar mdzad pa bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bo/

Above Protector’s head, the benevolent root guru is red and rattles a skull ḍamaru with the right hand {699} and holds an elixir-filled skull cup to the heart with the left hand. The guru is so brilliant it is hard to bear, youthful and charming with a passionate expression, sitting in cross-legged position. Ḍākinīs and the three existences are brought under control just by the guru’s glance. At Protector’s forehead there is a triangular spot of vermillion, on which are thirteen red hrīḥ letters, the essence of Exalted Lokeśvara, Lord of the World. Those completely transform into thirteen red secret ḍākinīs, youthful, with one face and two arms, holding small drums in their right hands and skull cups filled with elixir in the left. They stand in the posture of right leg bent and left outstretched, gazing with three eyes wide-open and dancing; the essence of Tārā.
khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs par gyur/
They bring under control all sentient beings in the three realms. All needs and desires fall like rain.
oM badzra na ra kriM kriM hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ ces pa brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub bzla/
oṃ vajra nara kriṃ kriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā Repeat one hundred times or more.
de nas gzhung gi bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ bdag 'jug bcas grub pa dang / slob ma la khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/

Then from the source text [Treasure Trove of Awakened Activity], do the mantra recitation, torma offering, praise, and self-induction. Cleanse the disciples, and during the clarification of awakening mind, change to:
de'i ched du ye shes mgon po mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i bka' zhes bsgyur/
“To that end, I will receive the permission of Awareness Protector Magnetizing Ḍākinīs.”
de la 'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhi dag gi sgrub thabs spyi la shin tu gal gnad che ba yan lag gi bka' gsum pa mkha' 'gro dbang sdud 'di ni/ rgya gzhung rdo rje'i gsung las/ /

Now, from the general peaceful and wrathful sādhanas of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, the extremely important branch of the third permission is Magnetizing Ḍākinīs.[24] It states in the vajra speech of the Indian source:

bla ma mgon po sin d+hU ra'i/ / sngags rnams dbang gi mdog ldan pas/ / mgon po dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ / dbang du sdud pa'i gnad mchog 'dis/ / 'di dang phyi ma'i don mchog 'grub/ / gcig brgyud 'di ni srog ltar chongs/ /

zhes gsungs te/ ye shes mgon po 'di nyid kyi sprul pa'i rang gzugs dur (700) khrod bsil ba'i tshal na rtag tu bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyad dang yul chen nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogs kyi gtso bo mdzad cing dbang bsgyur ba yin pas rnal 'byor zab mo 'di la brten nas gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi chos skyong ba thams cad gnad la dbab cing dbang du 'dus pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad lo zla tsam gyis 'grub pa dang / phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med bsam pa tsam gyis sgrub pa'i gnad chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag srog ltar gces pa yin pas de lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo bsgrub pa sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maN+Dal gsol gdab sogs nas/ slob ma lhar bskyed yan gong dang mtshungs/

The natural emanated embodiment of this Awareness Protector is constantly present in the charnel ground Cool Grove. He acts as chief and dominates all the hosts of heroes and ḍākinīs in the eight great charnel grounds and twenty-four great sacred sites. Therefore, based on this profound yoga, you can get down to the vital point and bring under control all ḍākas, ḍākinīs, awareness actors, and worldly protectors, and thereby achieve all supreme and common spiritual powers in a matter of months or years. It presents the vital point of accomplishing the four awakened activities without restriction just by thinking of them. Since this single lineage of extraordinary instructions is as precious as one’s life force, you will practice this profound permission of blessings…(etc.). Continue at this juncture with mandala, supplication, and so on up through the generation of the disciples as deities as before.

de nas mdun bskyed gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dang / bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bor gsal thob la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / bla ma rin po che gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'du bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/

Then, on the crown of Protector inseparable from the torma visualized in front, the benevolent root guru…(etc. to)…the essence of Tārā. Visualize that and repeat this supplication three times after me: “Precious guru, please grant your blessing to magnetize all heroes and ḍākinīs of the three places.”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag med 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad la phog pas de thams cad 'od zer 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma mgon po mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa la thim pas bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'bar/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dmar sgor sgor gar mdzad/ mgon po yang DA ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'ur 'ur sil sil 'khrol ba'i sku las mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa byung / slob ma mgon por gsal ba'i lus thams cad dang khyad par (701) dpral ba'i sin+d+hU ra'i steng du stong gsum g.yo bar byed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bcu gsum du gyur cing de rnams kyi sku las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos 'dod thams cad bsdus nas byin gyis brlab byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/

Through supplicating in that way, infinite light rays like hooks radiate from the body of the guru on Protector’s head. They strike all the heroes and ḍākinīs dwelling in the ten directions and invoke them all in the form of the nature of radiant light rays. Those dissolve into the guru and Protector with the ḍākinīs. The guru shines with the nature of light and bliss. The red ḍākinīs dance in circles. The Protector plays the ḍamaru and small drum with sounds of ur ur, sil sil while countless ḍākinīs emanate from his body. {701} The bodies of the disciples, visualized as protectors, and especially the vermilion at their foreheads, become the thirteen ḍākinīs who shake the billionfold universe. Imagine that from their bodies, light rays like hooks radiate to the ten directions and gather up all the needs and desires of the world and beyond, and blessings ensue.
byas la DA dril dang bcas pas na ra kriM kriM brjod/
Say that and nara kriṃ kriṃ…(etc.), accompanied by the ḍamaru and bell.

des mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi byin rlabs grub nas mgon po gnad la 'bebs par byed pa la gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la mgon po 'khor bcas gnad la dbab pa'i byin rlabs mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/

That concludes the practice of the blessing of Magnetizing Ḍākinīs. Now for Getting Down to the Vital Point, repeat this supplication three times after me: “Precious guru, please grant me your blessing for Protector and retinue’s Getting Down to the Vital Point.”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad shin tu khros pa'i rnam par spyan drangs bla ma la thim pas/ bla ma de nyid sku mdog smug nag 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i rnam pa can shin tu khros pa'i rang bzhin gyis mgon po'i spyi bor chem chem 'ur 'ur gar mdzad cing 'od zer smug nag 'phros pas/ mgon po 'khor bcas dang khyad par mgon po'i sku la dmar lam lam phog pas mgon po 'khor bcas gnad la phab ste mgon po dgra bgegs kyi steng du mer mer sil sil gar mdzad cing khros 'khrugs zhabs sa la brdab/ zhal nas hU~M phaT kyi sgra drag po sgrog spyan gsum 'khor rnams la hrig hrig gzigs pas 'khor rnams kyang rang dbang med par drag tu khros shing dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed bstan dgra sdig can rnams kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bkug / mgrin pa zhags (702) pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gi bsdams nas bsad bcad gtub/ don snying gtso bo la stob sha rus lhag med du 'khor rnams kyis rol/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/

By your supplicating like that, light rays radiate from the body of the guru on Protector’s head. They invoke all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions in extremely wrathful forms, which dissolve into the guru. The guru appears in the form of a maroon body with radiating red light rays, the very nature of extreme wrath, dancing on the Protector’s head with thundering and roaring—chem chem, ur ur. Maroon light radiates and strikes the Protector with retinue, particularly striking the Protector’s body with utter redness, and [inciting] Protector and retinue to get down to the vital point. Protector dances—mer mer, sil sil—upon the enemies and obstructors and fiercely stamps his feet on the ground. He roars with sounds of hūṃ phaṭ reverberating from his mouth and glares with his three eyes at his retinue. The retinue becomes uncontrollably enraged and wrathful. Those who would cause harmful obstacles to the accomplishment of the Holy Dharma and evil enemies of the doctrine are caught by hooks in their hearts, tied by lassos around their throats, bound by chains on their limbs, and slaughtered, cut up, and chopped. {702} Their organs are fed to the principal. The retinue finish off the flesh and bones without remainder. Imagine that blessing occurs by means of smashing to fine dust all harm-doers and enemy obstructors.
sha chen spos sbyor sogs bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/
Burn incense prepared with human flesh and so on, accompanied by the sound of music.

oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra big+h+nAn bi na ya ka trag raglo rak+Sha ru d+hi ra tsit+ta la a dun rbad hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra big+h+nAn tsit+ta la a dun dun bi bi nA ya hU~M phaT/ ces srog sngags brjod do/ /

oṃ vajra mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra vighanen vināyaka trakrakmo rakṣa rudhira citta la a dun be hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ vajra mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra vighanen citta la a dun dun vi vi nāya hūṃ phaṭ Recite that life-force mantra.

des mgon po nyid gnad la dbab pa'i byin rlabs grub nas de dag gi mtha' brten du sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i spyi bo'i oM las 'od zer dkar po byung / slob ma'i spyi bo'i oM la phog pas oM yig dangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag / mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rol mo dang spos btul/

That completes the blessing of Getting Down to the Vital Point of the Protector. As supplemental support, visualize the subsequent authorization blessing of awakened body, speech, and mind, and practice like this. The torma appears clearly as the Awareness Protector, with oṃ at the head emitting white light rays. They touch the oṃ in the disciples’ heads, which makes the oṃ letters brilliant and clear, the nature of light. A stream of elixir emerges from them, fills the insides of the body, and purifies physical obscurations. Imagine that the blessing of Protector’s body has entered you. Say that and subdue with music and incense.

yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i AHlas 'od zer dmar po byung / slob ma'i mgrin pa'i AHla phog pas AHyig dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag / mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par mos mdzod/ spos rol bya/

Again, the torma appears clearly as the Awareness Protector, with āḥ at the throat emitting red light rays. They touch the āḥ in the disciples’ throats, which makes the āḥ letters brilliant and clear, the nature of light. A stream of elixir emerges from them, fills the insides of the body, and purifies verbal obscurations. Imagine that the blessing of Protector’s speech has entered you. Offer incense and music.

yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer sngon po byung / slob ma'i snying ga'i hU~M la phog pas hU~M yig dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur te/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas yid kyi sgrib pa dag / mgon po'i thugs kyi (703) byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya/

Again, the torma appears clearly as the Awareness Protector, with hūṃ at the heart emitting blue light rays. They touch the hūṃ in the disciples’ hearts, which makes the hūṃ letters brilliant and clear, the nature of light. A stream of elixir emerges from them, fills the insides of the body, and purifies mental obscurations. {703} Imagine that the blessing of Protector’s mind has entered you. Offer incense and music.

de nas mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi oM dkar AHdmar hU~M mthing gsum rbad kyis chad nas khyed rang gi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum la rim gyis thim/ oM dang AHyang hU~M la thim/ hU~M gi zhabs kyu 'a chung la thim/ 'a chung ha yig la/ ha mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ thig le nA da la/ de'ang je phra je phrar gyur te stong nyid du yal/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rang ngo la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes cung zad mnyam par bzhag /

Then from Protector’s three places, white oṃ, red āḥ, and blue hūṃ suddenly break off and sequentially dissolve into the three letters in your three places. Then oṃ and āḥ dissolve into hūṃ. The vowel sign (zhabs kyu) dissolves into the small a-chung. That into the ha letter, that into the head stroke, that into the crescent moon, that into the drop, and the drop into the nāda. That becomes subtler and subtler until it vanishes in emptiness. Please rest in the nature of Lucid Clarity Mahāmudrā. Thus rest in equipoise for a while.
de nas gtor dbang sogs rdzas kyi cho ga snga ma ltar bya'o/ /
Then do the torma empowerment and other parts of the concluding rituals as before.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Yönten Gyatso]

chos 'di yon tan tshad med pas/ / rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab/ / gzhan las byin rlabs sgo myur bas/ / dngos grub 'dod rnams bsten par 'os/ / mkha' 'gro dbang sdud gnad dbab lhan cig pa'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// ! /

This dharma clothed in immeasurable qualities (Yönten) an ocean (Gyatso) that pervades everything, has access to blessings faster than others, a suitable support for those who desire powers. This was the chapter on the authorization for both Magnetizing Ḍākinīs and Getting Down to the Vital Point combined. maṅgalaṃ
IX.
IX. Liver-Colored Protector
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
'od dpag med mgon thugs rje'i sku/ / drag po'i tshul ston he ru kar/ / btud nas gsang sgrub mchin kha yi/ / byin rlabs bka' yig 'di ltar ro/ /
Protector Amitābha’s body of compassion displaying the wrathful manner of a heruka, I bow to you and write the blessing permission of the Secret Sādhana of Liver-Colored Protector.

maN+Dal chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hU~M mchin pa bri/ rten gtor mchod gtor bca' gzhi sogs bar chad kun sel dang 'dra/ sgrub tshul bdag bskyed sogs de dang khyad par med pa las/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang /

Draw the mandala as a triangular, dark-blue source of phenomena with a fire ring and in its center an eight-petaled lotus marked with hūṃ at its center. Do the support torma, offering torma, and other ritual preparations as in Removing All Obstacles. The way to practice the self-visualization and so forth is no different, but for the front visualization, after cleansing and purifying, say:

stong pa'i ngang las mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su paM las pad+ma/ raM las nyi ma'i steng du ga~M las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ g.yas pas sa'i snying po lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol zhing g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa/ rin po che dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du hU~M dmar smug las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar (704) bcad/

From within emptiness appears a vast and wide triangular source of phenomena. In its center, a lotus appears from paṃ and a sun from raṃ. Upon that, from gaṃ, white Gaṇapati appears with the head of an elephant. In his right hand he holds leaves of the essence of earth (daikon radish) that he feeds to his mouth, and in his left hand a mongoose that is vomiting various jewels. He has three eyes and is adorned with various jewels and ornaments. He is fallen on his back with a maroon hūṃ on him, which becomes a hūṃ-marked flaying knife. That radiates light that terminates all evil ones. {704}

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog mchin kha nag la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ rab tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin d+hU ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang / g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas DA ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/

The light returns and completely transforms into Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, fulfiller of the hopes of living beings just as they wish. He is liver-colored, black with a red hue. He has one face and six arms and glares angrily with his three round, red eyes. His gaping mouth reveals bared fangs and a curling tongue as he laughs loudly. His orange eyebrows, whiskers, and hair swirl upward. His forehead is anointed with a drop of vermilion. His head is sealed above by King Akṣobhya. He holds a vajra flaying knife with his upper right hand above his heart and a skull cup filled with the flesh and blood of enemies and obstructors with his upper left hand, below his heart. He holds a dry skull garland with his middle right hand and violently rattles a ḍamaru with the lower right. He holds a trident with his middle left hand and a black vajra lasso with the lower hand.

zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la/ dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang gu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ska rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrag pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse bran can dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas bdud dang bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ (705)

His two legs, with the strength to completely suppress the three levels of existence, stand in a perfectly straight parallel position pressing down on the Obstructor King. He wears a tiger-skin skirt tied with a green silk sash. The ornaments of the great nāgas adorn him: blue snakes bind his hair, and he has red snake earrings, striped snake armbands, white snake collar, yellow snake bracelets, green snake necklace, and white snake anklets and belt. On all his arms and legs there are strings of large and small bells. He is short and fat, with a protruding belly and thick limbs. He has boundless charisma. He has a crown of five dry human skulls with golden finials and a garland of fifty fresh skulls dripping with blood. He is beautified by the six bone ornaments and a jewel on his crown. His terrifying roars resound like thunder, annihilating all devils and enemy obstructors. He stands within a bonfire of timeless awareness like the fire at the end of the eon. {705}

de'i g.yon du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po dmar la dwangs pa'i nang du dre'u rkyang ser gwa pa'i steng du b+h+yoHlas ma gcig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas gri gug / g.yon dang pos nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pas skra dang bcas pa'i thod rlon khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba'i gseb na rma bya'i mdongs dang zla tshes kyis brgyan pa/ snyan g.yas la seng ge dang g.yon na sbrul nag 'phyo ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang re lde ser po'i shams thabs la sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ lte ba'i dbus na nyi ma 'char ba/ dre'u'i steng na phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i zhal phyi la gzigs pa/ de'i mdun tu chu srin gdong can dang rgyab tu seng ge'i gdong can/ phyi rol tu ma mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'o/ /

To his left, in a great ocean of pure red rakta, stands a yellow dun mule with a blaze [on its forehead]. Upon it, bhyoḥ becomes the One Mother, mighty queen of the desire realm. She is black as storm clouds, with one face and four arms. She holds a sword in her first right hand, and a flaying knife in the second, with a misbegotten-child victory banner in the first left hand and a fresh hair-attached skull filled with blood in the second. She bares her teeth in her open mouth. Her tawny hair streams upward, decorated in between [the locks] with a peacock feather fan and crescent moon. Her right earring is a lion, and the left is a black coiling snake.[25] She has a crown of five dry skulls and a garland of fifty fresh heads. She wears a human-skin cloak and a yellow hair-felt skirt cinched with a snake belt. The sun rises from the middle of her navel. She sits in half-lotus position on top of the mule, her face looking back. In front of her are the makara-faced, behind are the lion-faced, and all around she is surrounded by a retinue of mātṛkās.

yab yum gnyis kyi mdun du hU~M las gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug phyar zhing dgra srog gcod pa/ g.yon ban+d+ha khrag gis gang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa'o/ /

In front of the principal couple, hūṃ (or kṣiṃ) becomes Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla, dark maroon with one face and two arms, brandishing a flaying knife to cut the enemy’s life force with the right hand, and with his left hand he feeds the principal’s mouth from a blood-filled skull cup. He rides a crazed black bear.
g.yas su tri ljang gu las dzi na mi tra sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas DA ma ru 'khrol zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la gdengs pa stag la chibs pa'o/ /

To the right, green tri (or traṃ) becomes Jinamitra. He is dark green with one face and two arms. He rattles a ḍamaru violently with his right hand, and with his left hand points to the sky with the threatening gesture. He rides a tiger.
rgyab tu dzaHlas gshin rje TA k+ki rA dza sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa g.yon sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la gdengs pa spyang ki la zhon pa'o/ /

In back, jaḥ becomes the death lord Ṭakkirāja. He is dark maroon, with one face and two arms. With his right hand he throws a lasso made of intestines, and with his left he points to the sky with the threatening gesture. He rides a wolf.

lha mo'i g.yon tu hU~M las bdud mgon trag shad nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas dang pos thod khrag gnyis (706) pas ru mtshon dmar po phyar ba/ g.yon dang pos lcags kyi tho lum dang gnyis pas tsan+dan gyi bing chen bsnams pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber dang sag l+h+wam nag khra gsol zhing rta nag rting dkar la chibs pa'o/ /

To the left of the goddess, hūṃ becomes the devil lord Trakṣad. He is black, with one face and four arms. The first right hand holds a blood-filled skull cup and the left brandishes a red ensign spear. {706} His first left hand holds an iron-ball hammer (tho lum) and the second a sandalwood club (bing chen). He wears a brocade cloak with blue designs and high boots with black design. He rides on a black horse with white fetlocks.

de thams cad kyang rngams shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yo bas dgra bgegs la gzir ba/ mi mgo skam rlon gyi phreng ba 'phyang ba'o/ / de dag gi phyi rol du shar du brgya byin sogs rtsa ba'i phrin las dkyus ltar btang ba las/ gsol 'debs dang yig brgya ma 'grub kyang chog / gong gsal gnang dbab skabs kyi dmigs bzlas de sbyar/

All of them are ravenous and bare their fangs. Their orange eyebrows, whiskers, and hair bristles upward. Their three round, red eyes rove around intimidating enemies and obstructors. They are draped with dry and wet human-head garlands. Around them, yellow Śakra is in the east…(etc.). Follow the liturgy in the root text, [Treasure Trove of] Awakened Activity. It is also suitable to do the supplication and hundred-syllable practice. Add the recitation and visualization from the section on Getting Down to the Vital Point clarified above.

dngos gzhi'i bzlas pa'ang shA sa na gtso bor byed/ gtor 'bul bstod pa bdag 'jug grub nas/ slob ma la khrus dang / sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po gsang sgrub mchin kha'i bka' zhes bsgyur/

The main recitation practice is the śāsana mantra. Continue with the torma offering, praise, self-induction, up to the washing of the disciples and the section of clarifying the awakening mind, except change to “To that end, I will receive the permission of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s Secret Sādhana, the Liver-Colored.”

de la 'dir sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas nyid rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i skur bzhengs te rdo rje 'chang gi mgon po zhes grags pa mchog thun mong gnyis ka lo zla tsam gyis 'grub par byed pa 'di la/ phyi sgrub 'jig rten dbang phyug / nang sgrub khro bo rta mgrin/ gsang sgrub ye shes mgon po ltar sgrub pa'i skor rgyud dang grub thob so so'i gdams ngag gi bka' srol mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ sgrub brgyud kyi shing rta chen po dpal shangs pa bka' brgyud la bka' babs pa'i bka' srol 'di la'ang sgrub thabs mi gcig pa du ma bzhugs pa las da lam gsang sgrub mchin kha'i rjes gnang bsgrub pa la sogs mtshams sbyar nas maN+Dal dang / gsol gdab lha ngo bstan pa sngar bzhin song nas/

Buddha Amitābha himself manifested the form of a vajra dharma protector called Vajradhara’s Protector, through which the supreme and common [spiritual powers] can be accomplished in a matter of months or years. In this, the outer practice is Lokeśvara, the inner practice is wrathful Hayagrīva, and the secret practice is the Awareness Protector. In this practice cycle, there are countless systems that come from the tantras and individual adepts. From among those, the most excellent is this special transmission system that fell to the great chariots of the practice lineages and the glorious Shangpa Kagyu. In this also there is not just one means of accomplishment. Of the many that exist, now the approach is that of the secret sādhana of the Liver-Colored [Protector]. To practice the authorization for this…(etc.). Continue with the mandala, supplication, and introduction to the deities as before. Then:

sprin gtibs pa bzhin tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs )707)su 'gro zhing thun mong gi sdom pa gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la= dge 'dun la= bla ma yi dam gyi lha tshogs la= ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ / bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/

[The kind root guru and all the lineage gurus] dwell like a dense mass of clouds. In their presence, think that you and all other sentient beings throughout the reaches of space go for refuge until reaching enlightenment {707} and will take the common vows. Repeat three times after me: “I go for refuge to the buddhas who dwell in the ten directions. I go for refuge to the dharma that dwells in the ten directions. I go for refuge to the sangha who dwell in the ten directions. I pay homage and go for refuge to the yidam mandala deities and to the deities of Six-Armed Awareness Protector and retinue. Please grant me your blessings.”
slob ma lhar bskyed tshul gong gis 'gre zhing gnas gsum 'bru gsum bcas gsal gdab/
Apply the previous way of visualizing the disciples as deities, and visualize the three seed syllables in their three places.

de nas khyad par gyi gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/

Now repeat this supplication after me: “Precious guru, please grant me the authorization of Glorious Awareness Protector’s awakened body. Please make the body blessings enter my body. Please confer the vase empowerment.”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de'i spyi bo'i oM yig las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad dang / khyad par du yang mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs oM yig la thim/ de las bdud rtsi mchin kha'i rgyun babs/ slob ma'i smin mtshams nas zhugs/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo khrig mer gyis gang bas lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ ye shes mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ {byas la} DA dril dang bcas pas sngags brjod/

By your supplicating in that way, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the guru’s heart. They strike the heart of the torma appearing as Protector and evoke his mind stream, so that light rays radiate from the oṃ in his head. Those invoke all the blessings of awakened body from all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions, particularly from Protector, in the form of light rays, which dissolve into the oṃ. A stream of liver-colored elixir falls from there and enters the point between the eyebrows of the disciples. It fills precisely the great-bliss chakra in the head, cleansing and purifying all physical sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. You obtain the vase empowerment. Imagine that you have obtained the blessing of Awareness Protector’s awakened body. Say the mantra accompanied by the ḍamaru and bell.

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/

Again repeat this supplication after me: “Precious guru, please grant me the authorization of Glorious Awareness Protector’s awakened speech. Please make the speech blessings enter my speech. Please confer the secret empowerment.” {708}

By your supplicating in that way, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the guru’s heart. They strike the heart of the torma appearing as Protector and evoke his mind stream, so that light rays radiate from the āḥ in his throat. Those invoke all the blessings of awakened speech from all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions, particularly from Protector, in the form of light rays, which dissolve into the āḥ. A stream of liver-colored elixir falls from there and enters the throats of the disciples. It fills precisely the enjoyment chakra in the throat, cleansing and purifying all verbal sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. You obtain the secret empowerment. Imagine that you have obtained the blessings of Awareness Protector’s awakened speech. Say the mantra accompanied by the ḍamaru and bell.

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/

Again repeat this supplication after me: “Precious guru, please grant me the authorization of Glorious Awareness Protector’s awakened mind. Please make the mind blessings enter my mind. Please confer the wisdom-awareness empowerment.”

By your supplicating in that way, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the guru’s heart. They strike the heart of the torma appearing as Protector and evoke his mind stream, so that light rays radiate from the hūṃ in his heart. Those invoke all the blessings of awakened mind from all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions, particularly from Protector, in the form of light rays, which dissolve into the hūṃ. A stream of liver-colored elixir falls from there and enters the hearts of the disciples. It fills precisely the dharma chakra in the heart, cleansing and purifying all mental sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. You obtain the wisdom-awareness empowerment. Imagine that you have obtained the blessings of Awareness Protector’s awakened mind. {709} Say the mantra accompanied by the ḍamaru and bell.

yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur du gsol/

Again repeat this supplication after me: “Precious guru, please grant me the authorization of Glorious Awareness Protector’s awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. Please make the body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities blessings enter my body, speech, and mind. Please confer the fourth empowerment, the precious word empowerment.”

By your supplicating in that way, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the guru’s heart. They strike the heart of the torma appearing as Protector and evoke his mind stream, so that light rays radiate from the three seed syllables in his three places. Those invoke all the blessings of awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities from all the buddhas and bodhisattvas in the ten directions, particularly from Protector, in the form of light rays, which dissolve into the three letters in Protector’s three places. A stream of elixir falls from there and enters the heads of the disciples. It fills from there to the soles of their feet, cleansing and purifying all physical, verbal, and mental sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. You obtain the precious word empowerment. Imagine that you have obtained the blessings of Awareness Protector’s awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. Say the mantra.
de nas sngags dbang zhu ba'i phyir du me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ / bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/

Then in order to request the mantra empowerment, toss flowers and repeat this three times after me: “Bhagavat, take hold of me (bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi), please fully bestow on me” (bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol).”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi gdan gyi steng du hU~M yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ snying po dang / rtsa sngags shA sa na lan gsum/

By your supplicating in that way, a second mantra string emerges from the mantra string in the heart of the front visualization. It enters the disciples’ mouths and moves down to the hūṃ on sun seats in their hearts, settling around it in a clockwise direction. Imagine that and repeat after me. Say the essence mantra and the root mantra śāsana three times.
slob dpon gyis me (710) tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ / 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/
de nas gtor dbang dang rjes kyi bya ba rnams gong dang mtshungs so/ /
Then do the torma empowerment and concluding acts as before.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Taye]
rgya che rab zab blo gros can/ / khyung po'i gdams ngag mtha' yas las/ / gang 'di yid bzhin nor mtshungs pa'i/ / bsam kun lhun gyis grub byed do/ /
Endowed with vast and very profound intelligence (Lodrö) from Khyungpo’s infinite (Taye) instructions, this that equals a wish-fulfilling gem and achieves all one’s wishes spontaneously.
gsang sgrub mchin kha'i rjes gnang gyi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// ! /
This was the chapter on the authorization for the Secret Sādhana of Liver-Colored. maṅgalaṃ
X.
X. Saraha’s Tradition of Three-Faced Six-Armed Protector
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
byin rlabs mgon po snying gi dbus/ / mi shigs thig ler bkod nas 'dir/ / 'phags yul grub pa kun gyi gtso/ / mda' bsnun chen po'i bka' srol 'chad/ /
After placing an indestructible vital drop, blessings in Protector’s heart center, I will explain the great sharp arrow system of the chief of all Indian adepts.

maN+Dal gtor ma'i bca' gzhi sogs rjes gnang bar chad kun sel gyi skabs dang 'dra zhing / slob dpon gyis gnas yo nang mchod byin rlabs bdag bskyed sogs sngar dang 'dra/ mdun gyi maN+Dal gtor ma bsang sbyang /

The ritual preparations of the mandala, torma, and such are the same as the section in the authorization of Removing All Obstacles, and the ritual master’s consecration of the place, articles, inner offering, and the self-visualization and so forth are the same as before. Cleanse and purify the mandala torma in front.
stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rdo rje'i brag sna tshogs pa'i mdog can gyi steng du/
From within emptiness, appears a source of phenomena, white outside and red inside, vast and wide. Within it, on a vajra rock of various colors,
paM las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raM las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gaM las tshogs kyi bdag po/ de'i steng du

hU~M las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal drag po ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/

hūṃ becomes a hūṃ-marked flaying knife radiating light rays that make offerings to all the exalted assembly and purify all sentient beings of negativities, obscurations, sickness, and spirits. The light rays gather back in and completely transform into glorious Wrathful Awareness Protector, blue-black in color with three heads and six arms.

phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis thod pa'i phreng ba dang DA ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis kha T+wAM ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ rab tu khros pa'i zhal gsum gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur sdang mig tu blta ba/ khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ sma ra smin ma dmar ser glog ltar 'khyug cing dbu (711) skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/

His first two hands hold a flaying knife and blood-filled skull cup, one above the other. In the rest, he holds a skull rosary and a ḍamaru in the two right hands, and a khaṭvāṅga and lasso in the left. His middle face is deep blue, the right one white, and the left one red. Those extremely wrathful three gaping mouths bare his fangs. Three red, round eyes look glaringly in the ten directions. He scowls with shifting wrinkles. His orange eyebrows and whiskers quiver like lightning and his tawny hair bristles upward. {711}

thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ snyan rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu ska rags sogs rin po che dang rus pa dang dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa/ sbrul sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ yan lag rags la bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ dpral bar sin d+hU ra'i g.yung drung 'khyil pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /

Five dry skulls adorn his head, and he wears a garland of fifty blood-dripping heads. His earrings, collar, anklets, belt, and so on are precious jewels, bones, bells, and small bells. A variety of snakes adorn him. He wears a tiger-skin skirt and an elephant-skin upper garment. With his thick limbs, he is unbearably charismatic. At his forehead is a vermilion svāstika swirl. His right leg is contracted, and his left is straight. He stands in the midst of intensely blazing fire of timeless awareness arisen from his body.

de'i phyogs bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi steng du mdun tu dzA las dzA li ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yas su k+She las k+She tra pA la ma du ba'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas DA ma ru dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu ma las ma hA kA li ma dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du TA las TA k+ki rA dza ma ser mo g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang shin tu khros shing spyan gsum ma/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku las skyes pa'i me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol du bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams kyis bskor bar gyur pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oM dkar po/ mgrin par AHdmar po/ thugs kar hU~M sngon po'i 'od zer gyis po ta la dang bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa'i gnas nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ (712)

In the four directions, upon lotus, sun, and enemy obstructors, in front from jā appears black Jālima with one face and two hands holding a flaying knife in her right hand and a blood-filled skull cup in the left. To the right, smoke-colored Kṣetrapālama appears from kṣe, with one face and two hands holding a ḍamaru in her right hand and pointing with the threatening gesture with the left. In back, maroon Mahākālīma arises from ma, with one face and two hands, holding a flaying knife in her right and blood-filled skull cup in the left. To the left, yellow Ṭakkirājama comes from ṭā, holding a trident in her right hand and a lasso in the left. Those four are very wrathful, each with three eyes, tawny eyebrows, whiskers, and hair swirling upward, and adorned by bones and other scary ornaments. They stand in the midst of blazing fire arisen from their bodies. Around them are immeasurable hosts of attendants and an ocean of the oath-bound. The principals and all retinues have white oṃ at the head, red āḥ at the throat, and blue hūṃ at the heart, from which light rays radiate and invoke the Protector and retinue from the sacred sites, such as Potala and Cool Grove. {712}
oM shrI ma hA kA la sa pa ri wA ra e h+ya hi khriM khriM zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs/ dzaHhU~M baM hoH sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/
oṃ śrī mahākāla sapariwāra ehyahi khriṃ khriṃ…(etc., invokes). jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they become indivisible with the pledge beings.

slar yang thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ oM sarba ta thA ga ta a b+hi She ka te sa ma ya shrI hU~M/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma dag bde ba chen po myong / chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la ye shes mgon pos dbu brgyan par gyur/

Again, light radiates from the hūṃ in their hearts and invokes the empowerment deities. The [protectors] say, “Please confer empowerment.” [The deities] say, “oṃ sarva tathāgata abhiṣekate samaya śrī hūṃ” and confer empowerment. Their bodies are filled, stains purified, and they taste great bliss. The excess water rises up to the place on their heads and completely transforms into Akṣobhya crowning the principal figures and Awareness Protector crowning all the retinue.
oM shrI badzra ma hA kA lA ya sa pa ri wA ra Ar+g+haM pra tI ts+tsha hU~M swA hA/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pA d+yaM nas shab+da 'i bar dang / snying po la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/
oṃ śrī mahākāla sapariwāra arghaṃ praticcha hūṃ svāhā (similarly) pādyaṃ…(etc. through)…śabda Present the inner offerings by adding the three seed syllables to the essence mantra.
bstod pa ni/
Then the praise:
khyod sku zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / khyod gsung hU~M dang phaT kyi nga ro sgrogs/ / khyod thugs mi bzad snying rje rab 'bar bas/ / phyi nang bar chad kun 'dul khyod la bstod/ /

Your body, terrifying form with three heads and six arms, your speech, resounding roars of hūṃ and phaṭ, your mind, blazing with inexhaustible compassion: tamer of all outer and inner obstacles, I praise you.
phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bzhi po khyed rnams kyis/ / dpal ldan he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ / zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs las rnams ni/ / g.yel ba med par da lta bsgrub par mdzod/ /
Four goddesses in the four directions, you follow the commands of glorious Heruka, in such actions as peaceful, enriching, magnetizing, wrathful: accomplish them right now without wavering.
gzhan yang mgon po'i bka' nyan 'khor bcas kyis/ / ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol pa'i las kun mdzod/ /
Protector and retinue of attendants, accept these outer, inner, and secret offerings consecrated by absorptions, mantras, and mudras, and perform the acts that I, the yogin, charge you with.
ces bstod/
bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po gtso 'khor gyi thugs rgyud bskul te las rab 'byams bsgrub par bsam ste/

For the mantra recitation: Light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the heart of oneself as yidam, evoking the mind streams of the Protector, principals, and retinue. Think that they accomplish infinite actions.
oM shrI ma hA kA la swa s+thi shaTha na ma ma hU~M phaT/ ces snying po dang / badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra sogs nye snying dang shA sa na bzla/ (713)
oṃ śrī mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra…(etc.). Recite that quintessence mantra and śāsana. {713}
'khor rnams kyi sngags bzla bar spro na/
If you would like to recite the retinues’ mantras:

oM ma hA kA li hU~M hU~M phaT/ oM ma hA kA li k+She tra pA la hU~M phaT/ oM rA dza Ta k+ki rA dza hU~M phaT/ oM ma hA kA li ni sha trUM mA ra ya hU~M phaT/ ces bzlas/ slar mchod bstod bya zhing bdag nyid 'jug / slob ma la khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang zhes bsgyur/

oṃ mahākālī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ mahākālī kṣetrapāla hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ rāja ṭakkirāja hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ mahākālī niśa trūṃ māraya hūṃ phaṭ Recite the offerings and praises again, and the self-induction. The disciples wash. During the clarification of the mind of awakening, change to “To that end, I will receive the authorization of Three-Faced Six-Armed Swift-Acting Awareness Protector.”

de'ang sngon dge bsnyen chen po zhi ba'i go cha lcags kyi byin pa can du grags pa de ri po ta lar lan gsum byon/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos su mjal/ snga phyir pho brang gzhal med khang gzhan thams cad mjal zhing bskor/ rten kun la'ang phyag mchod grub pa la/ mtha' gcig na khang bzang shin tu che ba nam yang sgo mi 'byed pa zhig 'dug pas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la sgo 'di 'byed bar zhu zhus pas/ 'di sgo phyes na 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag dngangs shing 'chi ba'am 'chi la thug par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ slar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid la zhus shing gsol ba btab pas sprul pa'i pho nya zhig mngags te 'phags pa'i bkas gnang ba'i stobs kyis sems can su la'ang gnod pa med par sgo phyes/

Formerly, the great upāsaka known as Śāntivarman with iron armor visited Mount Potala three times and saw Exalted Avalokita face to face. Before and after, he traveled around and saw all the other celestial palaces. He made prostrations and offerings to all the images. At one place, there was a very big fine mansion with a door that never opened. He politely requested the heroes and ḍākinīs to open the door. They replied, “If we open this door, all the [inhabitants of] the entire three worlds will be frightened and die or come close to death.” So then he supplicated and again requested it from Exalted Avalokita, who requisitioned one emanated messenger who, due to the strength of being commanded by the Exalted One, opened the door that no living being could open without harm.

der ye shes mgon po 'di nyid mjal/ gsol ba btab pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba la 'byon par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal gyi shing n+ya gro d+ha'i phug na sprul pa'i sku zhig rtag tu bzhugs/ de la brten nas dpal sa ra ha sogs kyis sgrub thabs mdzad par grags/ gzhan yang ye shes kyi sku gcig dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten na bzhugs pa las slob dpon klu (714) sgrub dang bram ze mchog sred kyis gdan drangs pa'ang bshad/ de dag la brten nas 'phags pa'i yul du gdams ngag gi bka' srol ci rigs pa byung zhing / bod du'ang gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis mgon rkyang gi skor bsgyur ba dang / steng ba lo tsA bas mkha' 'gro drug bskor gyi gdams pa bsgyur ba dang / mgar chos bzang gis sa ra ha dang sha ba ri'i gzhung sogs bsgyur ba las/ khyad par du 'phags pa mkhas grub khyung po'i bka' grol las byon pa'i myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i lugs kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang sogs mtshams sbyar la maN+Dal phul/

Inside there, Śāntivarman encountered this very Awareness Protector. He prayed and received blessing. He supplicated, saying, “I have come to request protection of the Buddha’s doctrine for the sake of all sentient beings in the world.” Protector swore to it, and accordingly one emanated form remains forever in the great charnel ground of Cool Grove, in the hollow of a nyagroda (banyan) tree. Based on that, glorious Saraha and others are known to have created means for accomplishment. Meanwhile, it is said that one form of the Awareness Protector resided at the stupa of glorious Dhānyakaṭaka and was invited from there by Master Nāgārjuna and Brahmin Vararuci.[26] {714} Based on these, all kinds of instruction systems arose in the exalted land of India. In Tibet, Gyijo [Lotsāwa] Dawai Özer[27] translated the cycle of the Single Protector. Tengpa Lotsāwa[28] translated the instructions of [Protector] Surrounded by Six Ḍākinīs. Gar Chözang[29] translated the source texts of Saraha, Śavarīpa, and others. From among those, the particular precept system from exalted Khedrup Khyungpo’s Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s dharma cycle, now is the authorization for the great brahmin Saraha’s tradition of Three-Faced Six-Armed Protector…(etc.). Continue as before to the mandala offering.
gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / phrin las dbang phyug ye shes sku/ / dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol/ zhes lan gsum/

Repeat this supplication three times after me: “Awareness form of powerful activities of all buddhas in the three times— glorious Protector with retinue, grant the authorization of body, speech, and mind.”

de nas lha ngo bstan pa/ thun mong thun min gyi sdom pa bzung ba/ slob ma ltar bskyed bcas bla mgon dbyer med skabs su smos pa ltar/ thugs kar hU~M sngon pos mtshan par sgoms shig ces pa'i bar song nas/

Then do the introduction to the deities, the taking of common and uncommon vows, and the visualization of the disciples as deities as in Guru-Protector Inseparable. Continue as far as “Meditate that the heart is marked with blue hūṃ.”
de nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ /
Now, in order to request the authorization for Glorious Awareness Protector’s awakened body, speech, and mind, repeat this after me:
bla ma ye shes mgon po yis/ / dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ / sgrib bzhi dag par mdzad du gsol/ / phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang / / sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol/ /
“Guru Awareness Protector, please confer the complete four empowerments. Please purify the four obscurations. Please help me accomplish the four actions and attain the four kāyas.”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung na bzhugs pa'i mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te sku'i cha thams cad las mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa byung / (715) gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i dpral ba nas kyang mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa/ sku rngam brjid dang ldan pa/ gsung hU~M phaT dang ha ha'i sgra drag po sgrog cing rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad ngas sel mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub/ zhes gsung lhang lhang byon bzhin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba rnams slob ma'i dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad khrig mer gyis khengs/ lus kyi nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi rnam par zhal du dmar chem chem gsol nas tshar bcad pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/

By your supplicating in that way, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the heart of the guru as the yidam. They strike the hearts of the Protector and retinue dwelling in front of the single trunk of the sandalwood tree in the Cool Grove Charnel Ground in the southeast and evoke their mind streams. Immeasurable large and small bodies of Protector and retinue arise from all aspects of awakened body. {715} Also from the forehead of the torma visualized as Protector and retinue immeasurable large and small bodies arise. Their bodies are voracious and brilliant. Their speech resounds with wrathful hūṃ phaṭ and ha ha. They arrive and loudly declare, “Children of good family, I will remove all your obstacles. I will create all favorable conditions.” These unimaginable miniatures enter the disciples’ foreheads. Their whole bodies are filled inside with redness. Imagine that all physical sickness, spirits, and obstacles in the form of flesh and blood of enemy obstructors are consumed red and raw, and annihilated.

DA dril dang spos dud bcas te snying po dang nye snying brjod pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ des mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ lus kyi sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang mgon po'i sku dbyer med du gyur snyam pa mdzod cig /

Accompanied by the ḍamaru, bell, and incense smoke, repeat the essence and quintessence mantras. Do the same for the following: Through that, the blessings of the Protector and retinue’s awakened body enter your body. All physical negativities, obscurations, and obstacles are purified. You obtain the vase empowerment. Especially, think that your body becomes inseparable from Protector’s awakened body.

slar yang bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i hU~M las sogs sngar ltar la/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i mgrin pa/ zhes dang / slob ma'i mgrin pa nas/ ngag gi nad gdon/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la/ ngag gi sdig sgrib/ gsang ba'i dbang / ngag dang mgon po'i gsung dbyer med/ ces bsgyur/

Again, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the heart of the guru as the yidam…(etc., as before). From the throat of the torma visualized as Protector…(etc., and)…enter the disciples’ throats…(etc. to) Imagine that all verbal sickness, spirits…(etc.). Blessings of the Protector and retinue’s awakened speech enter your speech. All verbal negativities, obscurations…(etc.)…the vase empowerment…(etc.)…speech becomes inseparable from Protector’s awakened speech.

slar yang bla ma yi dam sogs sngar ltar/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka/ /slob ma'i snying kha nas/ yid kyi nad gdon/ thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la/ yid kyi sdig sgrib/ shes rab ye shes kyi/ yid dang mgon po'i thugs dbyer med ces bsgyur/

Again, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the heart of the guru as the yidam…(etc., as before). From the heart of the torma visualized as Protector…(etc.)…enter the disciples’ hearts…(etc.). Imagine that all mental sickness, spirits…(etc.). Blessings of the Protector and retinue’s awakened mind enters your mind. All mental negativities, obscurations…(etc.)…the wisdom-awareness empowerment…(etc.)…mind becomes inseparable from Protector’s awakened mind.

slar yang bla ma yi dam sogs sngar ltar las/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i gnas (716) lnga/ slob ma'i gnas lngar/ sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi nad gdon/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs pa sgo gsum la gcig char du zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib/

Again, light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the heart of the guru as the yidam…(etc., as before). From the five places of the torma visualized as Protector…(etc.)…enter the disciples’ five places…(etc.). {716} Imagine that all three doors’ sickness, spirits…(etc.). Blessings of the Protector and retinue’s complete awakened body, speech, and mind enter your three doors all at once. All physical, verbal, and mental negativities, obscurations…(etc.).
dbang bzhi pa thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum dang mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med ces bsgyur/
You obtain the fourth the empowerment. Your three doors become inseparable from Protector’s awakened body, speech, and mind.
de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung zhu ba'i phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ / bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/
Then to request the transmission of the mantra recitation, repeat this supplication three times after me: “Bhagavat, take hold of me, please fully bestow it on me.”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas mgon po'i thugs kar nyi gdan gyi steng du hU~M yig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog nag po 'od zer me 'od 'phro bas bskor ba de las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du mgon po'i zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hU~M gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khor/ de las drag po'i 'od zer me 'od rab tu 'bar ba 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa bzhin du gzhob thul thul bsregs shing tshar bcad pa'i mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug /

By your supplicating in that way, the black mantra string radiating red light rays situated around the hūṃ letter on the sun seat in Protector’s heart splits off a second mantra string in the way that the light from one candle lights a second one. It enters your mouth and moves down to the hūṃ on a sun mandala in your hearts, settling around it in a clockwise direction. Intense light rays fiercely blazing with firelight radiate from that. All sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are singed like chicken feathers in a fire and burned up, completely eliminated. Imagine that and repeat this after me: Have them repeat all the mantras of the principal and retinue three times each.
slob ma'i mgor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyis/ / 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/
Place flowers on the disciples’ heads and say three times: Bhagavat, surely grant to these [disciples], and please adhere to them.

de nas byin rlabs yongs rdzogs gtor mas bka' bsgo ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs bar chad kun sel gyi skabs ltar las/ bla ma brgyud pa'i skabs/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug sogs nas/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i (717) dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de rnams kyi zhes bsgyur/ /
rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang de dang mtshungs so/ /
Similarly, follow [that liturgy] for the concluding practices.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Yönten Gyatso]

'phags yul grub brnyes kun las kyang / / yon tan khyad 'phags bram ze'i lugs/ / mkha' 'gro bzhi skor grags pa 'di/ / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i snying po lags/ / bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i lugs kyi mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// // ! /

Of all the accomplished adepts of India, the especially exalted qualities (Yönten) of the brahmin’s tradition, known for its retinue of four ḍākinīs, is indeed the essence of the ocean (Gyatso) of sādhanas. This was the chapter on the authorization for Saraha’s Tradition of Three-Faced Six-Armed Protector. maṅgalaṃ
XI.
XI. Adorned Protector Secret Sādhana
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan srung zhing / / sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa/ / myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ / btud nas rgyan can bka' yig bri/ /
Guardian of all buddhas’ doctrines, inseparable from all buddhas; I bow to Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara and write the permission for Adorned Protector.

maN+Dal chos 'byung mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su hU~M dang a bri/ de'i dbus su rten gtor mdun du mchod gtor rnams sngar ltar la/ g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsi dang dri bzang chus bkang ba/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa/ g.yon tu thod pa'i bdud rtsi rnams bsham/ byin rlabs rnams dang bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/ mdun gyi maN+Dal bsang sbyang /

Draw a hūṃ and an A in the center of the blue-black source-of-phenomena mandala with its ring of fire. Place the support torma in its center and the offering torma in front as before. To the right, place a vase filled with elixir and saffron water with an ornament at its opening and [silk ribbon] tied around its neck. To the left, put up a skull cup full of elixir. Begin with the consecrations and the self-visualization, then cleanse and purify the mandala in front.

stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung mthing nag me rab tu 'bar pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng du/ hU~M las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa dang a las rdo rje as mtshan pa gnyis las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog shin tu gnag pa zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa'i phreng ba dang DA ma ru/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis kha TAM ga dang rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po sdang mig tu blta ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra nag po rnams gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan cing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ dpral bar sin+d+hU ras byugs pa/ sbrul dkar (718) khras dbu skra bcings shing dmar khras snyan rgyan byas pa/ ser pos mgul rgyan ljang gus phyag gdub dang do shal byas pa/ nag khras zhabs gdub dang ska rags byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pas spras pa/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs dang glang po che'i pags pas stod g.yogs byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis sku las skyes pa'i me'i phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

From within emptiness, the letter E becomes a blue-black source of phenomena with a ring of fiercely blazing fire. Within that is a seat of a multicolored lotus, sun, and Gaṇapati. Upon that, a hūṃ-marked flaying knife arises from hūṃ, and an A-marked vajra from A. Light rays radiate from both and accomplish the two purposes. They gather back and transform into Glorious Awareness Protector, pitch black, with one face and six arms. Of his six hands, in the first two he holds a vajra flaying knife in his top right hand and a blood-filled skull cup in the left, one above the other at his heart, and embraces the mother. In his two lower right hands he holds a skull rosary and a ḍamaru, and in his two lower left hands a khaṭvāṅga and vajra lasso. His gaping mouth reveals his bared fangs. He glares angrily with three round, red eyes. He grimaces with wrathful frowns and his black beard, eyebrows, and hair swirl upward. He has a crown of five dry human skulls and a garland of fifty fresh heads. His forehead is anointed with a drop of vermilion. {718} White mottled snakes bind his hair, and he has red mottled snake earrings, yellow snake collar, green snake armbands, and black mottled snake anklets and belt. He is draped with bone ornaments and strings of large and small bells. He wears a tiger-skin skirt and an elephant skin over his torso. With right leg contracted and left leg straight, he stands in the midst of a bonfire arisen from his body.

de'i pang na yum rdo rje gcig shes ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon gyis thod khrag yab la stob cing g.yas pas gri gug bzung nas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod skam lngas dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /

In his lap is the mother Vajra Knows One (rDo rje gcig shes ma), black, with one face and two arms. Her left hand holds a blood-filled skull cup feeding the father and the right holds a flaying knife and embraces the father. She wears a crown of five dry skulls and a garland of fifty fresh heads, and is adorned by the five symbolic ornaments.
