phyogs bzhir mdun tu pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dzA las dzA li ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yas su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du k+She las k+She tra pA la ma du ba'i mdog can g.yas DA ma ru dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma las ma hA kA li ma dmar nag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du TA las TA k+ki rA dza ma ser mo g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra 'khyugs cing dbu skra gyen du g.yengs pa rus pas brgyan cing drag po'i gzugs can no/ /

In the four directions around them: in front on a lotus and sun seat, black Jālima appears from jaḥ with one face and two hands holding flaying knife in the right and blood-filled skull cup in the left. To the right, upon a lotus and sun, smoke-colored Kṣetrapālama from kṣe holds a ḍamaru in her right hand and points with the threatening gesture with the left. In back, upon a lotus and sun, maroon Mahākālīma arises from ma, holding a flaying knife in her right and a blood-filled skull cup in the left. To the left, upon a lotus and sun, yellow Ṭakkirājama comes from ṭā, holding a trident in her right hand and a lasso in the left. They all have one face, three eyes, and bared fangs. Their eyebrows and whiskers flash and hair flows upward. They are adorned by bones, with very wrathful forms.

de'i phyi rol du bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oM dkar po/ mgrin par AHdmar po/ thugs kar hU~M sngon po/ thugs ka'i hU~M gi 'od zer gyis bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa nas mgon po 'khor dang (719) bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/

Around them are immeasurable hosts of attendants and an ocean of the oath-bound. The principals and all retinues have white oṃ at the head, red āḥ at the throat, and blue hūṃ at the heart. Light rays radiate from their hearts and instantly invoke the Protector and retinue from Cool Grove and other [charnel grounds]. {719}
oM shrI ma hA kA la sa pa ri wA ra e h+ye hi khriM khriM zhes sogs brjod nas/ dzaHhU~M baM hoH sa ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/
oṃ śrī mahākāla saparivāra e hye hi khriṃ khriṃ…(etc., say that and) jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—the awareness beings and pledge beings become indivisible.

slar yang thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod pas de rnams kyis oM sarba ta thA ga ta a b+hi She ka te sa ma ya shrI ye hU~M/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/

Again light rays radiate from hūṃ in the heart and invoke the empowerment deities. [Protector and retinue] say, “Please confer the empowerment.” They all say “oṃ sarva tathāgata abhiṣekate samaya śrīye hūṃ” and confer empowerment. [Protector’s and retinue’s] bodies are filled and the excess water overflows to the tops of their heads, becoming Akṣobhya crowning the principals and the principals crowning the retinue.

oM shrI ma hA kA la sogs sngags tsam gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la snying po dang / yum la/ oM a swA hA/ zhes bzla/ gtor 'bul dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ bum pa bsang sbyang /

Make the offerings with just the mantra oṃ śrī mahākāla…(etc.). Present the inner offering. Recite the praises from “Without stirring from the realm of phenomena…(etc.).” Clarify the visualization of the mantra recitation and repeat the essence mantra and oṃ a svāhā for the mother. Perfectly perform a brief torma offering with offerings and praise. Then cleanse and purify the vase.

stong pa'i ngang las baM las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du e las chos 'byung zhes pa nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su rang gi thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar bsam la gong gi sngags gnyis po bzla/

From within emptiness, from paṃ appears a precious vase with all characteristics perfectly complete. Within that, from E, appears a blue-black source of phenomena…(etc.). Continue until the recitation as before. In the recitation section, say: Light rays from hūṃ in my heart radiate and evoke the mind streams of the deities inside the vase. A stream of elixir falls and fills the vase. Imagine that and recite the two mantras.
mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mgon po gtso 'khor zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la bdag 'jug blang /
Do the offering and praise as before. The principal protectors and retinue melt and become elixir. Imagine that and practice the self-induction.
de nas slob ma khrus bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du ye shes mgon po rgyan can gsang sgrub kyi bka' zab mo zhes bsgyur/
Then the disciples are cleansed. During the clarification of the mind of awakening, change to: “To that end, I will receive the profound permission of Adorned Awareness Protector Secret Sādhana.”

de la spyir sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che gnas shing rgyas pa gal che/ bstan pa srung ba la chos skyong khyad par can zhig nges par dgos pa yin cing de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs bskyed kyi dbang gis ye shes mgon po 'di las lhag pa nam du'ang med pas/ (720) sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa thams cad kyis chos skyong 'di la gtor ma re phul zhing bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer bcol na bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / rang gzhan gyi bar chad sel zhing bsam pa thams cad 'grub par gsungs pa dang / khyad par ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i gdams ngag 'chad pa dang / nyan pa dang / nyams su len pa rnams la mgon po 'di nyid ma bsgrubs kyang shugs la 'go zhing phrin las sgrub par mdzad pa yin la/ 'di nyid kyi gdams pa mkhas grub khyung po'i bka' srol mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ skabs 'dir gsang sgrub rgyan can du grags pa'i bka' zab mo bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maN+Dal 'bul du gzhug / /

In general, it is important for all sentient beings that the precious doctrine of the Buddha abides and flourishes. For that, a special dharma protector who guards the doctrine is a definite requirement. There has never ever been a better one than this Awareness Protector, who is the power of Exalted Avalokita’s mind of awakening. {720} So for all those who have entered the Buddha’s doctrine, if they occasionally offer [this protector] a torma and charge him with guarding the doctrine, then the precious doctrine will spread and flourish for a long time, one’s own and others’ obstacles will be removed, and all one’s wishes will be accomplished. So it is said. In particular, for those who teach, listen to, or practice the instructions of Niguma, Ḍākinī of Timeless Awareness, even if they don’t personally practice this protector, he will stand by them and automatically accomplish awakened activity. From all the infinite instructions on this protector that were held in Khedrup Khyungpo’s tradition, the present occasion is the practice of the profound permission known as Adorned [Protector] Secret Sādhana…(etc.). After this juncture, have the disciples offer a mandala.

gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo bud+d+ha ya/ na mo d+harma ya/ na mo saM g+ha ya/ kun mkhyen ye shes snying po can/ / srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ / de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ / gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ / lan gsum/

Repeat this supplication three times after me: “namo buddhāya / namo dharmāya / namo saṃghaya With the heart of omniscient timeless awareness, completely purifying the wheel of existence, principal one, kindly grant me today the explanation of this precious gift.”
lha ngo bstan pa dang thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i sdom pa bzung / slob ma lhar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs par bla mgon dbyer med ltar bya/

Do the introduction to the deities, the taking of common and uncommon vows, the visualization of disciples as deities, and up through the blessing of the three places, as in Guru-Protector Inseparable.

de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad mgon po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas lus thams cad lha sku 'od zer dang bcas pas gang ba la brten nas lus gyi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la

Light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the master’s heart. They strike the torma appearing as Protector and evoke his mind stream. From his heart infinite light rays radiate and invoke all the body blessings of all tathāgatas and victors’ heirs from the ten directions in the forms of countless big and small bodies of the principals and retinue. They dissolve into the disciples’ heads and fill their whole bodies with deity bodies and light rays. Based on that, all physical negativities, obscurations, and obstacles are purified. Imagine that you have obtained Protector’s blessings of awakened body.

rtsa sngags (721) brjod cing spos rol bya ba 'gre/ des sku'i rjes gnang grub pa lags/ yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad mgon po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i mgrin pa nas thim pas lus thams cad lha sku 'od zer dang bcas pas gang ba la brten nas ngag gi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sbyang / mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rtsa sngags brjod cing spos rol bya/

des gsung gi rjes gnang grub pa lags/ yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad mgon po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying kha nas thim pas lus thams cad lha sku 'od zer dang bcas pas gang ba la brten nas yid kyi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad sbyang / mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ / byas la rtsa sngags brjod cing spos rol bya/

That was the authorization of awakened speech. Again light rays radiate from hūṃ in the guru’s heart. They strike the torma appearing as Protector and evoke his mind stream. From his heart infinite light rays radiate and invoke all the mind blessings of all tathāgatas and victors’ heirs from the ten directions in the forms of countless big and small bodies of the principals and retinue. They dissolve into the disciples’ hearts and fill their whole bodies with deity bodies and light rays. Based on that, all mental negativities, obscurations, and obstacles are purified. Imagine that you have obtained the Protector’s blessings of awakened mind. Say the root mantra while offering incense and music.
des thugs kyi rjes gnang grub pa lags/
That was the authorization of awakened mind.

de nas dbang bzhi zhu ba'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / bla ma ye shes mgon po yi/ / dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ / sgrib bzhi dag par mdzad du gsol/ / phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang / / sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/

Then to request the four empowerments, repeat this three times after me: “Guru Awareness Protector, please confer the complete four empowerments. Please purify the four obscurations. Please let me accomplish the four awakened actions and obtain the four kāyas.” {722}

de la bum dbang gi slang (722) du nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis shig / bum pa mgor bzhag la/

For the vase empowerment, imagine that the whole sky is filled with the victors and their heirs who arrive holding vases full of elixir water and confer the empowerment. Place the vase on their heads.
ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ / de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /
Just as the tathāgatas bathed him as soon as he was born, just so I confer empowerment with pure water of the gods.
oM sarba ta thA ga ta a b+hi Shiny+tsa mi zhes brjod la bum chu sbyin/
oṃ sarva tathagata abhiṣiñca mi Say that and give them the vase water.
de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ lha sku bsgom pa la dbang / sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no/ /

That conferral of the vase empowerment purifies physical obscurations. You obtain the vase empowerment and are empowered to meditate on the deity’s body. It establishes the ability to attain nirmāṇakāya.

de nas gsang dbang gi don tu dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hU~M gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ chags pa chen po'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar byon nas bde ba skyes shing / de lta bu'i bde ba'i rten byang sems de nyid khyed rang rnam pa'i ljags thog tu bzhag nas gsang dbang bskur byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la nang mchod dam thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/

Then visualize this for the secret empowerment: Light rays radiate from hūṃ in the master’s heart and invoke the father and mother victors in the ten directions. They enter the mouth of the Protector visualized in front and melt in the fire of great passion. They emerge from his vajra and arrive in the mother’s lotus, generating bliss. The support of that bliss is the bodhicitta, which is placed upon your tongues. Imagine that it confers the secret empowerment. Give them the inner offering or elixir from the skull cup.
phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ / gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ / khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ / rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/
Arisen from the place of the three secrets of all victors in the ten directions, venerated by all in the three realms, I bestow the great vajra empowerment.
oM sarba ta thA ga ta gu h+ya a b+hi Shiny+tsa mi/
oṃ sarva tathāgata guhya abhiṣiñca mi

de lta bu'i byang sems myong ba la brten nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes/ de'i rang ngo la mnyam par bzhag pas gsal stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ sngags bzla ba la dbang / longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no/ /

Based on your tasting of the bodhicitta, the experiences of bliss, clarity, and nonthought arise. Rest in the equipoise of that very state. Imagine that the timeless awareness of undivided clarity-emptiness is actualized. That conferral of the secret empowerment purifies verbal obscurations. You obtain the secret empowerment and are empowered to recite mantra. It establishes the ability to attain saṃbhogakāya.

de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa (723) 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ gtor ma ye shes mgon po yab yum dngos su gsal ba'i yum las rang 'dra ba'i yum gnyis pa spros pa khyed rang mgon por gsal ba dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba'i dga' bzhi rim bzhin drangs/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser lhan skyes kyi dgar ba brten nas bde ba chen po mtha' dbus med pa skyes/ de'i rang ngo la mnyam par bzhag pas bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes mngon tu byas par mos mdzod/ /

Then visualize like this for the wisdom-awareness empowerment: {723} The torma appears clearly as Awareness Protector father and mother. A second mother consort resembling the first emanates and enters into union with you, who appear as the Protector. The sounds of your ecstasy invoke the victor couples from the ten directions. They enter the disciples’ bodies. They melt in the fire of great bliss, inducing the sequence of the four ecstasies. Based on the coemergent ecstasy at the tip of the vajra gem, great bliss without center or boundary arises. Rest in the equipoise of that very state. Imagine that the timeless awareness of integral unity of bliss-emptiness is actualized.
gsang gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro las/ / mkha' 'gro spros nas bu la gtad/ / snyoms par zhugs pas bde bas gang / / lhan skyes ye shes chen po thob/ /
The secret mother, awareness ḍākinī, emanates a ḍākinī to give to the child. They join in union and fill with bliss: great coemergent awareness is obtained.
oM sarba ta thA ga ta pra dz+nyA dz+nyA na a b+hi Shiny+tsa mAM/
oṃ sarva tathāgata prajñājñāna abhiṣeñca māṃ
de ltar dbang gsum pa bskur ba la brten nas yid kyi sgrib pa dag / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dngos dang yid kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang / chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no/ /

That conferral of the third empowerment purifies mental obscurations. You obtain the wisdom-awareness empowerment and are empowered to rely on a real or imagined awareness consort. It establishes the ability to attain dharmakāya.

dbang bzhi pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor skad cig gis gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad ye shes mgon por gyur/ de rnams 'od kyi rnam par bkug ste 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/

Then visualize like this for the fourth empowerment: Instantly visualize yourself as Awareness Protector, principals and retinue, radiating light from the hūṃs in your hearts that strike all of the environment and its inhabitants. The environment all becomes a celestial palace and the inhabitants all become Awareness Protector. All of that in the form of light is drawn in and dissolves into the retinue. The retinue dissolves into Awareness Protector.

slob ma mgon por gsal ba yang sku'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hU~M yig la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu nas rim bzhin je phra je phrar gyur nas dbyings su yal te 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes brjod la dar cig mnyam par 'jog tu bcug la/

The disciples’ bodies appearing as Protector melt into light from the top and bottom and dissolve into the hūṃ letter in the heart. That also gradually shrinks from the vowel sign up and vanishes into basic space. Please rest in equipoise within a state of lucid clarity and emptiness. Say that and have them rest in equipoise for a moment.
nam mkha' skye med mtshon pa'i phyir/ / (724) nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ / nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas/ / rang sems stong pa chos kyi sku/ / tshig gi ngo bor bstan par bya/ /
As the sky illustrates the unborn, {724} the sky has no characteristics. By joining equanimity to the sky, one’s mind is empty dharmakāya. Show the essence of the word.
chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no/ / zhes ngo sprad/
All phenomena are free of all extremes of embellishment—that is the essence of the fourth empowerment. Say that to introduce [mind’s nature].
de ltar tshig dbang rin po che bskur bas sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi sgrib pa dag /
That conferral of the precious word empowerment purifies obscurations of the three doors in equal measure.
dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam zung 'jug sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no/ /
You obtain the fourth empowerment and are empowered to meditate on the path of integral unity. It establishes the ability to attain the fruition of svabhāvakāya.
zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung dang / gtor dbang / rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya ste bar chad kun sel du bshad pa bzhin no/ /
Thus engender realization. Do the mantra recitation transmission, torma empowerment, and concluding acts as they were described in Removing All Obstacles.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Taye]

sngon sbyangs blo gros dag pa'i mkhar/ / chos zab zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'char/ / des kyang skye dgu mtha' yas pa'i/ / yid ci gdung ba sel bar byed/ / gsang sgrub rgyan can du grags pa'i rjes gnang gi le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// !

In the sky of previously cultivated pure intelligence (Lodrö) the moon’s reflection of profound dharma rises, soothing the mental pain of infinite (Taye) living beings. This was the chapter on the authorization for Adorned Protector Secret Sādhana. maṅgalaṃ
XII.
XII. Four Deities Combined Practice
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
spyan ras gzigs dbang rnal 'byor ma/ / sgrol ma myur mdzad mgon po dang / / dbyer med bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / spyi bor bkod nas rjes gnang 'bri/ /
Avalokiteśvara, Yoginī, Tārā, and Swift-Acting Protector, inseparable from Guru Vajradhara, I place you on my head and compose the authorization.

maN+Dal pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gdan la tshom bu sngon po/ shar kyi pad 'dab la nyi gdan tshom bu nag po/ lho'i pad 'dab la dmar po/ nub tu dkar po/ byang du ljang gu ste tshom bu lnga bkod/ mthar mchod gtor kyis bskor ro/ / de nas skyabs sems spyi ltar byas la/

On a four-petaled lotus mandala, place a blue heap [of grain] on a sun-moon seat in the center, a black heap on a sun seat on the lotus petal in the east, red on the lotus petal in the south, white in the west, and green in the north, making five heaps. Then place offering tormas around it and do the refuge and awakening mind as usual.
oM badzra rak+Sha rak+Sha hU~M phaT/
oṃ vajra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ

phyi rol du me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur rnams su gyur/ de'i nang du bdag nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde ba 'char zhing rgyas pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba khru gang gis mtho ba la nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la hU~M las rdo rje sngon po hU~M gis mtshan pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje (725) dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan cing / dar gyi na bzas klubs pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /

Outside appears the protection circle with a ring of blazing fire, a vajra enclosure, and tent. Within that, one appears clearly in the form of the yidam [Cakrasaṃvara] with a source of phenomena on the head, white outside and red inside. It arises as bliss and expands in the nature of light. In its center is a four-petaled lotus with stamens that rise a cubit in height. Upon them, on a stacked seat of the sun and moon, hūṃ becomes a blue vajra marked by hūṃ. That becomes the root guru in the form of Great Vajradhara, blue, with one face and two arms. He holds a vajra in his right hand and a bell in the left, embracing Vajradhātviśvarī, who holds a flaying knife and skull cup. {725} They are both adorned by bones and precious jewels, and clothed in silks. They sit in vajra posture and lotus posture [respectively], radiating light.

mdun gyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan la/ hU~M las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug / bar pas thod pa'i phreng ba/ tha mas DA ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag / bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom brjid pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing yan lag rnams sbom la rags pa/ dpral bar sin d+hU ras byugs shing / phyag dang zhabs rnams dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na tshogs bdag dkar po gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /

On the lotus petal in front, on a sun seat, hūṃ becomes a flaying knife marked by hūṃ. That transforms into Awareness Protector. He is as black as storm clouds, with one face and six arms, standing in the position of straight legs. He holds a flaying knife in his top right hand, a skull rosary in the middle hand, and fiercely rattles a ḍamaru in the lower right hand. He holds a blood-filled skull in his upper left hand, a trident in the middle hand, and a vajra lasso in the lower left hand. He has three round, red eyes, and fangs bared in his open mouth. His eyebrows, whiskers, and goatee are resplendent; and orange hair streams upward. He wears a crown of five dry skulls and a garland of fifty wet skulls dripping with blood. He is adorned by the six bone ornaments and snakes, and wears a tiger-skin skirt cinched by a green silk sash. He is short and stocky, with thick limbs and protruding belly. His forehead is smeared with vermilion. Large and small bells adorn his arms and legs. His upper body is cloaked in a wet elephant skin. He stands in the midst of blazing fire on a seat of white Gaṇapati fallen on his back.

g.yas kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan la hrIHlas gri gug hrIHsa mtshan pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba nas tsam 'bur ba/ spyan gsum g.yon phyogs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyangs nas (726) 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon na kha TAM ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing / zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa'o/ /

On the lotus petal to the right, on a sun seat, hrīḥ becomes a hrīḥ-marked flaying knife. That becomes Exalted Vajrayoginī, red, with one face and two arms, youthful as a sixteen-year-old. As she smiles, her eyeteeth protrude slightly. Her three eyes glance to the left. Her right hand holds a flaying knife downward, {726} and her left holds up a skull cup full of elixir for her to drink. She has a khaṭvāṅga in the crook of her left elbow and is adorned by the five symbolic ornaments. She stands with right leg extended, trampling on Bhairava, and the left bent, pressing on Kālarātri.

rgyab kyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i gdan la hrIHlas pad+ma hrIHsa mtshan pa las spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ dbu skra dpung pa'i steng na nag si le yod pa 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /

On the lotus petal in the back, a white hrīḥ on a moon seat becomes a white lotus marked by hrīḥ. That transforms into Avalokita, white, with one face and two arms. He is peaceful and smiling, adorned by all the silks and precious ornaments. His right hand holds a vase with the mudra of supreme generosity; his left hand grasps the stem of a white lotus flower at his heart, the full blossom near his left ear. His hair is piled on top with locks falling loosely, and a crown of Amitābha. He sits in the position of right leg extended and left contracted.

g.yon gyi pad 'dab kyi zla gdan la tAM las ut+pal tAM gis mtshan pa las rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu/ lang tsho dar la bab cing / lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yon ut+pala'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ spyi bor don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /

On the lotus petal to the left, upon a moon seat, tāṃ becomes an utpala flower marked by tāṃ. That becomes Exalted Tārā. She is green and in the prime of youth, in a form like a sixteen-year-old. Her right hand is in the mudra of supreme generosity, and her left hand holds the stem of a green utpala flower. She is crowned by Amoghasiddhi. She sits in the position of right leg slightly extended and the left drawn in.

de rnams kyi dpral bar oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M/ hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma lus pa rdo rje 'chang dang lha bzhi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaHhU~M baM ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/

All are marked with white oṃ at their foreheads, red āḥ at their throats, and blue hūṃ at their hearts. Light rays radiate from the hūṃs, invoking the gurus, yidams, buddhas, bodhisattvas, heroes, ḍākinīs, and hosts of dharma protectors and guards, all in the forms of Vajradhara and the four deities—jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ. They dissolve indivisibly [into the respective deities above your head]. They become the unified essence of every source of refuge.

bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi bde ba/ de kho na nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing mnyes par bgyi'o/ / byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

Guru and group of four deities: Outwardly I offer flowers and incense; inwardly five meats and five elixirs; secretly the bliss of union; and the offering of suchness is the timeless awareness of nondual bliss and emptiness. These and other special unimaginable offerings I present for your pleasure. Please partake of them and grant your blessings. {727}
na (727) mo bud+d+hA ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bI ra bI re ci/ shrI DA ka DA ki ni/ dzo ka dzo ki nI/ sarba bud+d+hA bo d+hi sa twA ya/ shar Na gats+tsha mi kyai/ lan gsum/
namo buddhāya / namo guruhe / vajra vīra vīriṇī / śrī ḍāka ḍākinī / joka jokinī / sarva buddha bodhisatvāya śaraṇa gacchāmi kyai (Repeat three times.)

bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ de bzhin du lha so so la dmigs te rim bzhin sngags brjod pa ni/

A stream of elixir falls from the guru’s body and enters the crown of my head. It fills the body and purifies sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. I obtain the blessings of the guru’s awakened body, speech, and mind. Likewise, visualize each of the deities (and say their mantras in order):
oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra big+h+nAn bi nA ya ka hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ lan gsum/
oṃ vajra mahākāla kṣiṃ kṣetra vighanāṃ vināyaka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā (Repeat three times.)
mgon po'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sogs nas/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ ces rigs 'gre/
A stream of elixir falls from Protector’s body…(etc. to)…obtain the blessings of the Protector’s awakened body, speech, and mind.
oM badzra na ra kriM kriM hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ lan gsum/
oṃ vajra nara kriṃ kriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā (Repeat three times.)
rnal 'byor ma'i sku las=
A stream of elixir falls from Yoginī’s body…(etc.)
oM ma Ni pad+me hU~M/ oM badzra rak+Sha na maHsa man+ta hU~M phaT/ lan gsum/
oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ / oṃ vajra rakṣa namaḥ samanta hūṃ phaṭ (Repeat three times.)
spyan ras gzigs kyi sku las/
A stream of elixir falls from Avalokita’s body…(etc.)
oM tA re tut+tA re tu re swA hA/ lan gsum/
oṃ tāre tuttāre ture svāhā (Repeat three times.)
sgrol ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/

A stream of elixir falls from Tārā’s body and enters the crown of my head. It fills the body and purifies sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. I obtain the blessings of the Tārā’s awakened body, speech, and mind.

bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ lha bzhi spyan drangs bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par sgrol ma/ thugs kar mgon po/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ sngags tshan lnga sbrel nas lan gsum bzla/

Light rays radiate from hūṃ in Guru Vajradhara’s heart and invoke the four deities. Avalokita comes to dwell on guru’s head, Tārā at the throat, Protector at the heart, and Yoginī at the navel. Connect the set of five mantras and repeat them three times.
rang gi gsang gnas nas rlung g.yos/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ sngags tshan lnga sbrel nas lan gsum bzla/
rang gi gsang gnas rlung g.yos/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar/ bla ma'i sku la phog pas bde ba chen pos lha bzhi bdud rtsir zhu nas sku lus gang /
Wind stirs in my perineum, the fierce inner heat of awareness fire blazes at the navel. It strikes the guru’s body and great bliss melts the four deities into elixir, which fills the [guru’s] body.
gsang ba'i lam nas rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / lus kyi sdig sgrib dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs (728) zhugs/

It emerges from the secret path and enters through the head. It fills down to the throat, purifying physical negativities and obscurations. I obtain the vase empowerment and the blessing of awakened body enters. {728}
snying ga yan chad gang / ngag gi sdig sgrib dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/
It fills down to the heart, purifying verbal negativities and obscurations. I obtain the secret empowerment and the blessing of awakened speech enters.
lte ba yan chad gang / yid kyi sdig sgrib dag / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/
It fills down to the navel, purifying mental negativities and obscurations. I obtain the wisdom-awareness empowerment and the blessing of awakened mind enters.
lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag / dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/
It fills the whole body, purifying negativities and obscurations of the three doors. I obtain the word empowerment and the blessing of awakened body, speech, and mind enter.
bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas/ rang lus 'od du yal/ sems ma bcos pa la mnyam par bzhag go /
The guru melts into light and dissolves into me. My body disappears in light. Mind rests in equipoise without contrivance.
de nas maN+Dal bsang sbyang /
Then cleanse and purify the mandala.

stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba khru gang gis mtho ba la nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la hU~M las rdo rje hU~M gis mtshan pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang zhes pa nas/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/

From within emptiness, appears a four-petaled lotus with stamens that rise a cubit in height. Upon them, on a stacked seat of the sun and moon, hūṃ becomes a blue vajra marked by hūṃ. That becomes the root guru in the form of Great Vajradhara…(etc. to)…They become the unified essence of every source of refuge. Recite that as above.
mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ gu ru de ba tsa tu ra sa pa ri wA ra ar+g+haM sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oM AHhU~M gis nang mchod/
Then for the consecration of offerings, say guru deva catura saparivāra arghaṃ…(etc.) for the outer offerings; oṃ āḥ hūṃ for the inner offering;
gsang mchod dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa yid kyis bya/
and present the secret and suchness offerings mentally.
gang gi drin gyis sogs sh+tso ka gcig dang / byin rlabs ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo/ / dngos grub ma lus thob pa'i gnas/ / bar chad ma lus sel ba'i lha/ / bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la 'dud/ ces bstod/

Then the praises with the one quatrain that begins “The benevolent one…” (gang gi drin gyis…etc.) and Door to the source of every blessing, place to attain every spiritual power, deities who remove every obstacle: I bow to the guru and group of four deities.
gtor ma yod na yi dam spyi ltar byin brlabs/
If you have a torma, then consecrate as in general yidam practice.
lha rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/
The tongues of the deities are vajra straws through which they suck up and consume the torma.
oM gu ru badzra d+ha ra i daM ba liM ta kha kha khA hi/ lan gsum/
oṃ guru vajradhara idaṃ baliṃta kha kha khahi (Repeat three times.)
mgon po sogs la so so'i rang sngags mthar gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis phul/
Say the personal mantras of each of the deities, adding that torma mantra and repeating three times to offer it.
mchod bstod dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis phrin las zhu/
Make offerings, praises, and the request for desires with “Accept this torma I offer to you…” (mchod sbyin gtor ma…etc.).
de nas slob ma khrus bya/
Now cleanse the disciples.
sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du bla ma dang lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi bka' zab mo zhes bsgyur/
During the clarification of the mind of awakening, change to: “To that end, I will receive the profound permission of the guru and Four Deities Combined Practice.”
de'ang grub thob chen po sha ba ri pas bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i skabs su thog mar dpal (729) ye shes kyi mgon po nyid byon nas rang gi sgrub thabs la sogs pa gsungs/

This one time, when the great adept Śavarīpa was doing his practice in the charnel ground Cool Grove, {729} first Glorious Awareness Protector himself arrived and said, “Receive my sādhana…” and so forth.

de nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma rnams kyang byon nas rang rang gi sgrub thabs gsungs/ byin rlabs lha bzhi 'bral ba med/ ces bya ba yin pas lha bzhi po 'di ngo bo dang phrin las gnyis ka'i sgo nas gcig bsgrubs pas kun 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir nam yang tha dad yod pa ma yin kyang / rnam pa tsam du'ang bzhi po phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad nas mai tri pa la gnang / lho phyogs kyi grub chen rA hu la yang yum la 'khrungs ma thag lha bzhi zhal gzigs/ phyis rdo rje mkha' spyod mas sgrub thabs rnams gnang ba ste/ mkhas grub khyung pos bla ma dam pa de gnyis dang / khyad par ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro su kha sid+d+hi las gsan pa yin cing / ji skad du/

Then Exalted Vajrayoginī, Avalokita, and Tārā all came and taught their own sādhanas. Since it is said of this, “The four blessing deities are never apart,” any one of these four practices will achieve all of them in terms of the essence and awakened activity. Therefore, there is never any distinction between them. However, in appearance, it was made into a sādhana that combines the four separate [deities] into one and was given [in that form] to Maitrīpa. Rāhula, the great adept from the south, had a visionary experience of the four deities as soon as his mother gave birth to him. Later, Vajra Khecarī granted him all the sādhanas. Khedrup Khyungpo received them from those two holy gurus and especially from the Awareness Ḍākinī Sukhasiddhi. As spoken:
ma yengs zla ba gsum nas 'grub/ / tho rengs thun re ma chags bsgom/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'grub/ /
Accomplished in three months without distraction, meditating without fail in each session at dawn accomplishes supreme and common spiritual powers.

ces gsungs te/ de lta bu'i byin gyis brlab pa'i lha bzhi'i bka' 'bul bar byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba sngon du grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu maN+Dal phul mdzod/ / ces brda sprad/

In offering you the permission of the four deities with this kind of blessing, the ritual master’s acts were completed previously. Now it is your turn. As a gift to request entrance into this teaching, now offer a mandala.
de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/
Now repeat this supplication after me:
dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /
“Great joy, you, my teacher, you, Master, please consider me. You teach the way to great awakening; I pay homage to you, great lord.

dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ / byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ / mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /
Grant me the actual sacred pledge. Grant me the mind of awakening. Grant me the triple refuge in Buddha, dharma, and sangha. Protector, please usher me into the supreme city of emancipation.”
lan gsum/
(Repeat three times.) {730}
mdun bskyed bla ma lha bzhi'i lha tshogs (730) rnams kyi spyan sngar rgyun bshags dang sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/
In the presence of the guru and four deities in the front visualization, repeat this confession and taking of the vows after me: “I go for refuge to the Three Jewels…” (dkon mchog sum la…etc.)

de nas slob dpon bla ma lha bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la mos gus drag po dung pa gcig byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bla ma lha bzhi'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung / khyed rang gi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i snang zhen sbyangs te/ lus 'khor lo bde mchog gi skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hU~M gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

Then on account of your intense devotion to the ritual master who dwells as the essence of the guru and four deities, light rays radiate from the heart and evoke the mind streams of the guru and four deities visualized in front. Boundless light rays come from their hearts, and by merely touching your bodies, they purify impure perceptions and attachments. Imagine that your body is Cakrasaṃvara. On the head of your body as the yidam is a source of phenomena, white on the outside and red on the inside…(etc. to)…hūṃ at their hearts. Imagine that.
ces gong bzhin bskyed chog gi tshig brjod nas lha rnams dam tshig ba'i tshul du bskyed la/
Thus recite the words of the creation ritual above and create the deities in the manner of pledge beings.

de nas mdun bskyed maN+Dal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis de nyid yer gyis byon khyed rang gi spyi bo'i rdo rje 'chang la thim/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos dang DA dril bya zhing / na mo bud+d+hA ya 'i gsol 'debs tshar gsum brjod/

Through your supplicating with intense devotion to Guru Vajradhara who sits in the center of the mandala visualized in front, he comes quickly and dissolves into the Vajradhara above your head. A stream of elixir falls from the body and enters in the crown of your head, filling your body and purifying sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. Imagine that you have obtained the blessing of the guru’s awakened body, speech, and mind. Offer incense and play the ḍamaru and bell. Supplicate three times with namo buddhāya…(etc.).

yang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i mgon po la thim/ sku las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhal du dmar chem chem gsol/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dang sgo gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos dang DA dril mgon po'i sngags lan gsum gyis byin rlabs 'bebs pa 'gre'o/ / (731)

Again by supplicating the Protector visualized in front, he comes quickly and dissolves into the Protector above your head. Boundless replicas break off from his body and enter in the crown of your head. They fill your body and ravenously consume raw all the sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. Imagine that Protector’s awakened body, speech, and mind merge inseparably with your three doors. Offer incense, play the ḍamaru and bell, and say the mantra three times for the descent of blessings. Apply that to the following. {731}

yang rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ gsang gnas nas bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol sngags tshar gsum/

Again by your supplicating Vajrayoginī, she comes quickly and dissolves into Vajrayoginī above your head. A stream of red elixir falls from her vagina and enters your head. It fills your body, purifying sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. Imagine that you obtain the blessings of Yoginī’s awakened body, speech, and mind. Offer incense, play the ḍamaru and bell, and say the mantra three times.

yang thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la thim/ bum pa dang sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags brjod cing spos DA dril/

Again by your supplicating Avalokita, he comes quickly and dissolves into Avalokiteśvara above your head. A stream of white elixir falls from the vase and body, and enters your head. It fills your body, purifying sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. Imagine that you obtain the blessings of Great Compassionate One’s awakened body, speech, and mind. Offer incense, play the ḍamaru and bell, and say the mantra three times.

yang sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la thim/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag / sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang spos DA dril bya/

Again by your supplicating Tārā, she comes quickly and dissolves into Exalted Tārā above your head. A stream of white elixir falls from her right big toe and enters your head. It fills your body, purifying sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations. Imagine that you obtain the blessings of Tārā’s awakened body, speech, and mind. Repeat the mantra, offer incense, and play the ḍamaru and bell.
de nas dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon tu maN+Dal= gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs gsum/

Now as a gift to request the main [empowerment], offer the mandala and repeat this supplication three times after me: “Just as Awakened Vajra granted [the great offering to the Buddha, grant me this today, Vajra Space, in order to protect me.]”

khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor gyi lha bzhi spyan drangs te bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par sgrol ma/ thugs kar mgon po/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa la mos gus dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / na mo bud+d+hA ya sogs nas/ tu re swA hA 'i bar/ sngags tshan lnga sprel ba lan gsum/

de nas khyed rang (732) gi rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar pa'i 'od zer bla ma'i sku la phog / lha bzhi 'od du zhu/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / lus kyi sdig sgrib dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ DA dril/

Then, beneath your feet, the wind stirs and light rays from the blazing fire of awareness in the fierce inner heat at your navel strikes the guru’s body. The four deities melt into light. A stream of awareness elixir falls from all aspects of [the guru’s] body and enters the top of your head. As it fills up above the throat, physical negativities and obscurations are purified. You obtain the vase empowerment. Imagine that the blessing of awakened body has entered. (Play ḍamaru and bell.)
bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis snying ga yan chad gang / ngag gi sdig sgrib dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ DA dril/

As the stream of elixir fills up above the heart, verbal negativities and obscurations are purified. You obtain the secret empowerment. Imagine that the blessing of awakened speech has entered. (Play ḍamaru and bell.)
bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lte ba yan chad gang / yid kyi sdig sgrib dag / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ DA dril/

As the stream of elixir fills up above the navel, mental negativities and obscurations are purified. You obtain the wisdom-awareness empowerment. Imagine that the blessing of awakened mind has entered. (Play ḍamaru and bell.)
bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag / dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/

As the stream of elixir fills your whole body, negativities and obscurations of the three doors are purified. You obtain the fourth empowerment. Imagine that the blessings of awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities have entered.
mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang la thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med du gyur par mos la sems 'dzin med du ci gnas mnyam par zhog mdzod/

In the end, the guru melts into light and dissolves into you. Imagine that the three vajras become inseparable from your three doors and rest in that equipoise without mental fixation for as long as you can.
DA dril bag tsam re bya ba ma gtogs gzhan mi dgos/
Other than the occasional brief playing of the ḍamaru and bell, anything else is unnecessary.
des byin rlabs lha bzhi'i bka' grub pa yin pas 'di nyid yi dam du bzung zhing dam tshig las mi 'da' bar bgyid do snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/
That accomplishes the permission of the four blessing deities. Think that you will take this as your yidam [practice] and will not transgress the sacred pledges, and repeat this:
gtso bos ji ltar sogs dbang rjes spyi ltar bya/
“I will do all that the master commands.” Also do the general practices for concluding empowerments.
lha bstims zin pas/ yig brgyas bzod gsol dang / shis brjod tsam las rjes chog gzhan mi dgos so/ /
Once the deities have dissolved, say the hundred syllables and request for forbearance. Other than the verses of auspiciousness, other concluding rituals are not necessary.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Yönten Gyatso]

yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas pa'i/ / dril sgrub 'di ni spros med kyi/ / rnal 'byor can rnams snying gi dpyid/ / gdams ngag rgya mtsho'i snying po'ang yin/ lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba'i bka' bshad pa'i le tshan no/ / mang+ga laM// ! /

Praise of its qualities (Yönten) are infinite. This combined practice is the heart’s Spring for those with unembellished yoga; it is the essence of an ocean (Gyatso) of instructions. That was the chapter describing the authorization for Four Deities Combined Practice. maṅgalaṃ
XIII.
XIII. Supplemental Support for Deliberate Conduct
oM swa sti/
oṃ svasti
bdud 'joms phrin las thogs med pa/ / khrag 'thung (733) chen pos de ring 'dir/ / snying po'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / / las kun 'grub pa'i shis pa stsol/ /
Unrestricted awakened activity defeating evil, {733} great Blood Drinker, here today make auspicious the accomplishment of all actions and the spread of the essential doctrine.

gang zhig spros pa la dga' zhing lag len rgyas par bya ba dag gis/ mgon po'i bka' chen bcu gsum rdzogs pa'i mthar brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang byed pa'i srol snang zhing / de'ang skyi shod pa'i yig char mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu rjes su bzhag pas de'i rjes gnang gi mthar sel bar snang yang / 'dir gong gi gsang sgrub rgyan can la sbrel na 'jug pa bde bas de ltar na gtor dbang grub ma thag par/ 'di'i byin rlabs nas 'jug cing slob ma lhar bskyed spyan 'dren mi dgos/ 'on kyang rtsa ba mgon mthing gi bka' tsam rdzogs pa la'ang 'di'i rjes gnang sbyor du rung ba kho na yin cing / dkar dmar sogs la sbrel na/ dkyus su bshad pa'i slob ma lhar bskyed dgos pa ni khyad par ro/ /

For those who like embellishment and wish to do an extensive practice, there is the custom of giving the authorization for deliberate conduct at the end of the thirteen great permissions of the Protector. The general explanation in the manuals suggests doing it in connection with White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, at the end of that authorization. However, here, doing it in connection with the Adorned Protector Secret Sādhana is a convenient way to proceed. In that case, right after the torma empowerment, commence with the consecration of this [practice]. It is not necessary to do the generation of the guru as deity or the invocation. Nevertheless, at the completion of just the permission of the main practice of Deep-Blue Protector, it is suitable to perform just this authorization. The difference is that, if done in connection with the white, red, or other protectors, then it is required to follow the course of the descriptions and generate the disciples as the deity.

de'ang rjes gnang gang dang sbrel ba de'i gsham dang mnyam du/ gri gug sogs phyag mtshan drug so so ba/ dbu rgyan thod phreng sbrul rgyan glang lpags stag lpags rus pa'i rgyan drug sin+d+hU ra rnams sta gon byas la/ bsang sbyang /

Whichever authorization it is connected with, at the same time as arranging its shrine, do the prelude for the individual six hand implements, such as the flaying knife, and the crown ornament, skull garland, snake ornaments, elephant skin, tiger skin, six bone ornaments, and vermilion [mirror]. For that, cleanse and purify.

stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bdag nyid yin pa la rnam pa phyag mtshan dang rgyan so so'i rnam par gyur zhes brjod cing snying po tshar gsum res byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob ma rnams bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las paM las pad+ma dang raM las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs mngon rtogs ltar mgon po 'khor bcas yongs rdzogs su bskyed la spyan drangs/

From within emptiness, one’s own name’s initials adorned by vital drops completely transforms into, in essence, the embodiment of glorious Protector’s body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities—in form, the individual hand implements and adornments. Say that and repeat the essence mantras three times each to consecrate. Then the disciples cleanse and purify. Then recite “From within emptiness appears a lotus from paṃ and a sun mandala from raṃ…(etc.)” according to the liturgical description, visualizing the complete Protector with retinue and invoking them.
dzaHhU~M baM hoH dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes sogs brjod/
jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they become indivisible with the respective pledge beings…(etc.).

de ltar khyed rang rnams myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dngos su gsal ba la/ phyag rnams su rdo rje'i mtshon cha rnams dang / dbu la sogs pa'i sku'i gnas rnams su dur khrod rol pa'i chas chen rnams phul te mda' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod cig / ces mtshams sbyar te/ slob ma'i lag (734) g.yas su gri gug gtad nas/

You clearly manifest as Swift-Acting Awareness Protector with vajra weapons in your hands and all the great charnel-ground accessories on all parts of your body, head, and so forth. Imagine that you are thus invested with power. {734} At this juncture, present the flaying knife in each disciple’s right hand [and say]:
skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ / phyag mtshan gri gug dbang bskur bas/ / dgra bgegs lus ni kha 'byed cing / / bsad pa'i las rnams thogs med shog /
Fortunate child of good family, I confer on you the empowerment of the flaying-knife hand implement: split open the bodies of enemy obstructors and [perform] unrestricted actions of slaughter.
thod ba'i phreng ba gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ / mgo phreng khrag 'dzag 'di byin pas/ / dgra bgegs don snying 'byin pa yi/ / las kyis srung ma tshims byed shog /
Present the skull rosary: Fortunate child of good family, I give you this skull rosary dripping with blood: extract the inner organs of enemy obstructors and satisfy the guardians by your actions.
cang te'u gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ / thod pa'i cang te'u 'di byin pas/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang sdud cing / / dgra bgegs myos pa'i las 'grub shog /
Small hand drum: Fortunate child of good family, I give you this small hand drum made of skulls: bring the heroes and ḍākinīs under control and act to drive the enemy obstructors crazy.
thod pa gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ / phyag mtshan thod pa'i dbang bskur bas/ / dgra bgegs snying khrag rol byed cing / / rengs pa'i las la thogs med shog /
Skull cup: Fortunate child of good family, I confer on you this empowerment of the skull hand implement: revel in the heart blood of enemy obstructors and perform unrestricted actions of paralyzing.
rtse gsum gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ / kha TAM rtse gsum 'di byin pas/ / dgra bgegs gnas gsum snun byed cing / / sgrol dang skrad pa'i las rdzogs shog /
Trident: Fortunate child of good family, I give you this three-pronged khaṭvāṅga: impale the three places of enemy instructors and complete actions of liberating and exorcising.
rdo rje'i zhags pa gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ / rdo rje'i zhags pa 'di byin pas/ / dgra bgegs ma lus 'dren byed cing / / 'ching ba'i las rnams rdzogs par shog /
Vajra lasso: Fortunate child of good family, I give you this vajra lasso: rope in every enemy obstructor and complete the actions of binding.
thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan bkon la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / ye shes lnga ldan thod skam lnga/ / skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/
Crown of five dry skulls: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze: fortunate child of good family, take the five dry skulls as five timeless awarenesses.
mgo phreng gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / bdud rigs bsgral ba'i mgo phreng 'di/ / skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/
Skull garland: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze: fortunate child of good family, take this skull garland that liberates evil types.
sbrul rgyan bkon la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / dug lnga dag pa'i sbrul rgyan rnams/ / skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/
Snake ornaments: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze: fortunate child of good family, take these snake ornaments, the five poisons purified.
glang lpags gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / (735) gti mug rnam dag glang chen lpags/ / skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/
Elephant skin: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze: {735} fortunate child of good family, take the elephant skin, stupidity purified.
stag sham gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / nga rgyal rnam dag stag lpags gos/ / skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/
Tiger-skin skirt: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze: fortunate child of good family, wear this tiger skin, pride purified.
rgyan drug gtad la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / pha rol phyin drug dag pa'i rgyan/ / skal ldan bu yis blang bar bgyi/
Six ornaments: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze: fortunate child of good family, take the pure ornaments of the six perfections.

de nas dpral bar sin+d+hU ra'i thig le byas la/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yi/ / rgyan dang cha lugs rab 'bar ba/ / gsang ba'i rdzas mchog sin d+hU ras/ / skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang sdud shog /

Then put a spot of vermilion on their foreheads: Swift-Acting Awareness Protector’s ornaments and accessories are ablaze. I confer empowerment on the fortunate child with this secret substance, excellent vermilion: bring heroes and ḍākinīs under control.
de lta bu'i sin d+hU ra'i thig le'i steng du yi ge hrIHdmar po ring cha tshegs drag dang bcas pa bcu gsum re gsal 'debs par mdzod/ byas la/
Visualize clearly on this spot of vermilion the thirteen red hrīḥ letters, each long and with final aspiration marks (visarga).
'gro drug 'dren pa'i dpal mgon che/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag / hrIHyig thugs rje chen po 'dis/ / skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro/ / zhes brjod/
Great glorious Protector, guide of the six migrators, epitome of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, with this great compassion letter hrīḥ I confer empowerment on you, fortunate child.

de ltar brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang byin pas/ khyed rang srid pa gsum na mthu stobs gzi brjid 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi rje bor mnga' chen gsol ba la/ de dag gis mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas mchod cing / rdo rje'i glus bstod pa phul bar mos shig /

Having been given the authorization for deliberate conduct, you are imbued with power and charisma beyond compare in all the three existences. You are invested as the lord of the hosts of an ocean of the oath-bound. Think that they make various and sundry offerings to you and offer you praise with vajra songs.
mchod pa gsar du bshams pa byin brlabs nas/ tshigs bcad dam sngags tsam gyis mchod/ gtso bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/
Put up fresh offerings on the shrine, consecrate them, and offer them with verses or just mantras. Do long or short praises of the principal figures, as appropriate.

slar yang nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang / slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha lhan cig pas shis pa brjod pas kyang ye shes 'phel zhing brtan pa'i mnga' chen gsol bar mos shig / ces byas la bkra shis (736) bka' rgya ma brjod cing me tog 'thor/

Again, imagine that all the victors and their heirs who dwell throughout space, as well as the ritual master and mandala deities, all together say auspicious verses and congratulate you on the great investiture of increasing and stabilizing awareness. {736} Say that and the Sealed Word of Auspiciousness, and toss flowers.

de ltar na de dag rnams kyis myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi bka' rtsa ba dang yan lag deng sang rgyun bzhugs nges pa rnams legs par phul grub pa yin pas/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag / sgos su mgon po 'di nyid kyi khyad par gnad kyi dam tshig ji skad bshad pa mtha' dag ma nyams par bsrung ba dang / bsnyen sgrub phrin las kyi rim pa la brtson cing / bla ma yi dam dang gnyis su med pa rnam dag chos sku'i rang bzhin tu shes pas srog ltar du brten snyam du mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar lan gsum/

Thus, with all of these, the root and branch permission blessings of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector that continue today have been well accomplished. Therefore, keep all the sacred pledges of Vajrayāna in general and in particular all the especially vital points of this protector’s sacred pledges without damaging them. Devote yourself with diligence to the stages of approach and activity. Know that the guru and yidam are none other than the totally pure dharmakāya by nature and think that you will uphold them as your own life force, and repeat this three times after me: “I will do all that the master commands.”

slob mas gtong rag gser gyi maN+Dal dang / lus longs spyod 'bul/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo/ rjes tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par byas shing dpon slob rnams kyis longs spyod/ slob dpon gyis gtong rag mchod bstod bzod gsol sogs rgyas par bya'o/ /

In gratitude, the disciples offer a golden mandala and their bodies and possessions. Dedicate the virtue to perfect awakening. Afterward, hold a delightful communal feast that the master and disciples enjoy. The ritual master performs extensive thanksgiving, offerings, praises, and requests forbearance.
[Colophon by Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Taye]
bstan la sems pa'i blo mthu thob/ / 'dun gros nges par legs la phyogs/ / rang 'dod tsam min gzhan gyi don/ / mtha' yas bsgrub phyir 'di byas so/ /
Attaining the power of mind (Lo) regarding the doctrine, and aims (drö) tending toward definite goodness, I did this to accomplish infinite (Taye) welfare, not just for myself but for others’ sake.
mtha' rten brtul zhugs rjes gnang gi le tshan no/ /
That was the chapter on the authorization of the Supplemental Support for Deliberate Conduct.
[General Concluding Words]

de ltar ye shes mgon po 'di nyid lhag pa'i chos skyong du 'dzin pa la med du mi rung ba'i rjes gnang gi bka' spol kho bos thob pa ni re zhig de tsam ste/ de la rtsa ba mgon mthing gi bka' bar chad kun sel 'di la'ang jo nang rje btsun chen po nas brgyud pa tha dad pa gsum/ dkar mthing gnyis la phyag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa bka' brgyud kaM tshang dang / sa skya pa'i lugs srol gnyis rnams nos shing / gzhan rnams ni brgyud pa'i srol gnyis las byon pa ste/ mkhas grub khyung po nas da lta'i bar du bka' yod nges shing bslad ma zhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /

I should say something about how I received this permission tradition of authorizations for the Awareness Protector, who is the indispensable superior dharma protector. The permission for the main Deep-Blue Protector, Removing All Obstacles, came down from the great Venerable One of Jonang in three distinct lineages. White and Deep-Blue [Protectors] include various special practices—I received them from both the Kagyu Kamtsang and Sakya traditions. All the others came with those two lineage systems. From [the time of] Khedrup Khyungpo until now, the existence of permissions is definite, and they are totally pure, without corruption.
'di nang phyi ma'i don kun bde blag tu/ / gsol ba btab na nges par stsol mdzad pa/ / bla ma nag po chen po'i byin rlabs bka'/ / gsal bar bkod la slar yang rjes brtser mdzod/ /
For the benefit of all, now and later, this convenient supplication is granted; the blessing permission of Guru Mahākāla, clearly arranged and then revised.
byang chub lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang / / chos mthun dpal 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas/ / gang 'brel tshe 'od dpag med zhing khams su/ / ye shes mgon pos lam (737) sna 'dren gyur cig /
May obstacles on the path to awakening subside, spiritual powers and prosperity expand, and may Awareness Protector guide those with connection to the pure land of long-life Amitābha. {737}

ces pa 'di ni rang nyid nas 'dun rtsol chen po byas pa'i snod dag par/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i byin rlabs kyi bcud cung zad thob pa/ skal mnyam gzhan dag la'ang bgo bsha' sbyin par bya sla ba'i ched du/ bla ma ye shes mgon pos rjes su bzung ba'i ku sA li karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ myur mdzad mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi snang bas srung ba'i gnas mchog tsA 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub sde/ kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel// // (738) (739)

With great effort and interest, I became a pure vessel to obtain a small portion of the contained blessings of Guru-Protector Inseparable. So that others whose fortune equals mine could easily be given their share, this was written by the vagabond who is looked after by Guru Awareness Protector, Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso Lodrö Tayepai De, at the sacred site protected by the appearance of the Swift-Acting Protector’s blessings, the practice site at Tsadra Rinchen Drak, Kunzang Dechen Ösal Ling. Let virtue prevail.
@#/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa srog gi rgya can bzhugs so/ / (740)
37. Sealed with Life Force. The Extraordinary Authorization of Swift-Acting Protector Entering the Heart[1]
@#/ /srid zhi'i khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / dbyer med myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug / mi 'bral snying gi thig ler bkod nas 'di/ / kun dang thun mong min pas khyad par dbye/ /
Guru Vajradhara, pervading lord of existence and quiescence, inseparable from Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara, always present within the sphere of my heart; this is especially distinct from all others.

spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig las nam yang mi 'da' zhing / mgon po 'di nyid chos skyong gi gtsor 'dzin pas bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor la brtson nus pa dang / chos brgyud 'dzin nges pa'i slob ma re re tsam la bka' 'di nyid sbyin par bya ba'i tshe/ sbyor ba maN+Dal rten mchod rnams rtsa ba bar chad kun sel skabs ltar bya/ gnas yo mchod gtor byin rlabs nas brtsam/ bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas/ mdun bskyed sgrub tshul rnams kyang de kho na ltar la/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ bdag 'jug bcas grub pa dang / dngos gzhi slob ma la khrus bya/ /

Grant this permission to select disciples who have never transgressed the general and particular sacred pledges; who hold this protector as their main dharma practice and are able to pursue its approach and accomplishment, and the torma offering; and who definitely hold this dharma lineage. On that occasion, the preparation, mandala, supports, and offerings are the same as in the main practice of Removing All Obstacles. Begin with the consecration of the place, articles, offerings, and tormas. Continue with the self-visualization, meditation, recitation, and front visualization, which are all accomplished in the same manner. Then do the torma offering, praise, and self-induction, continuing in the main practice with the cleansing of the disciples.
sems bskyed gsal gdab skabs/ de'i ched du myur mdzad ye shes mgon po snying zhugs kyi bka' zab mo gsan la zhes bsgyur/
During the clarification of the awakening mind, change the line to: “To that end, I will receive the profound permission of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector Entering the Heart.”

de'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos lnga dang ldan pa ni ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'di nyid yin te/ de'ang 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i skye brgyud dang mi 'brel ba spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid thugs bskyed lhag par stobs su gyur pa'i rang gzugs yin pa dang / mchog bsgrub pas thun mong zhor la 'byung zhing thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba/ byin rlabs kyi bka' thob pa lam bsgrubs par yang byin gyis rlob cing gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis bar chad sel bar mdzad pa dang / mchod bstod byas pa tsam gyis chos mthun gyi dpal 'byor rgyas kyang mchog la sgrib pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba dang / bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing bde ba can gyi zhing khams su lam sna 'dren pa ste de lta bu'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i mgon po 'di la byin rlabs kyi bka' rigs mi gcig pa du ma yod pa rnams kyi nang nas/ kun dang thun (741) mong ma yin pa lus dang grib ma'i tshul lam/ srog ltar 'bral med du 'grogs pa'i gnad snying zhugs kyi bka' zab mo bsgrub par bgyi ba la/ zhes sogs mtshams sbyar nas nges par gser gyi maN+Dal 'bul du gzhug /

The one who possesses the especially exalted Five [Golden] Dharmas, superior to all other dharma protectors who guard the Buddha’s doctrine, is this Six-Armed Awareness Protector. He is the self-embodiment arising from the power of the highest awakening mind of Avalokiteśvara, who is always present for the living beings of the world. By the accomplishment of the supreme [spiritual powers through his practice,] the common are accomplished automatically; and by accomplishing the common, the supreme is automatically accomplished. By your obtaining the permission of his blessing, even if you don’t practice this path, the blessing will be granted. Just by supplicating him, obstacles will be removed. Just through offering and praising, prosperity that is in harmony with the dharma will increase and will not become the cause of obscuring the supreme. He protects from the terrors of the intermediate state and guides you on the path to the pure realm of Sukhāvatī. Such a one as this wish-granting gem of a protector has many different kinds of blessing permissions. {741} From among those, the one that is distinct from all the others, and possesses the vital point of support like a shadow that follows the body or like a companion who is constantly present as one’s life force, is this Entering the Heart. To accomplish this profound permission…(etc.). At this point, have [the disciples] definitely offer a golden mandala.

snyims pa me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ ces sogs sh+tso ka gcig dang / khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ / gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ / 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ / blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ / ces pa'i gsol ba lan gsum btab/

With flowers in your hands, repeat these supplications three times after me: “The benevolent one…” (gang gi drin gyis…etc., one quatrain) “Once your lotus feet are abandoned, there is no other lord of refuge. Great mighty hero of migrators, please grant me the sublime mind.”
de nas lha ngo bstan pa dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba/ slob ma lhar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar bla mgon dbyer med kyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta bar bya/

Then proceed with revealing the deities, taking the common and uncommon vows, generating the disciples as deities, up to the consecration of the three places as was described in the section on Guru-Protector Inseparable.
de nas khyad par gyi gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams/ / bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/
Then repeat this special supplication three times after me: “Guru-Protector and deities, please descend to me.”
slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/
Place the vajra on the disciples’ heads.
bu khyod la ni bdag gis ni/ / nag po chen po'i dam tshig bsgrags/ / bsam gyis mi khyab des byang dang / / mtshan bzang gar dgu'i nyams ldan pa/ / bsgom dang dmigs bzlas mchod par gyis/ /

Child, I proclaim to you the sacred pledge of Great Black One. Refined by that unimaginable one, and his excellent characteristics, with nine dance expressions, do meditation, visualization, recitation, and offerings.
sngags rgyun drag po'i phyag mtshan sogs/ / rtag tu bcang zhing bzlas pa bya/ / las kyi sgrub pa ci byed kyang / / bla ma mchod cing gsol ba btab/ /
Always recite continuous mantras and hold the wrathful hand implements, and so on. Whatever actions you undertake, offer them to the guru and supplicate.
sgrub pa'i thabs dang sgrub pa las/ / ring du gyur la byams pa spongs/ / byang chub sems dang ldan bya'o/ / zhes dam la bzhag /
Give up the love of procrastination in the methods and actions of practice. Possess the mind of awakening. Thus bind them under oath.
dngos gzhi
Main Practice

khyad par can gyi byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god pa la gzhan tu ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig / khyed rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas gsang gnas kyi bar dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ spyi bo nas snying kha yan kha g.yel zhing spyi bo'i tshangs bug dang de yod pa'i snying ga'i thad kyi dbu (742) ma'i nang du khyed rang gi snying gyen du ldog ste log pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad du song ba'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du rang sems hU~M yig sngon po zhig tu song ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de lta bu'i spyi bo tshangs bug gi steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan la myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs gtor chog ltar la/ me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/

To establish the foundation of this special blessing, do the following visualization without being distracted by anything else. The central channel is situated from the cranial aperture in the crown of your head straight down the middle to the perineum. It is white outside and red inside. From the top of your head to the heart it is wide, and the cranial aperture is suitably big. {742} At the level of the heart, inside the central channel, your heart is reversed upward and has become an eight-petaled lotus. At its center, on a sun disk, imagine that your own mind has become a blue letter hūṃ. Upon the cranial aperture on your head, on a seat of lotus, sun, and Gaṇapati, Swift-Acting Awareness Protector…(etc., as in the torma ritual)…stands in the midst of an expanse of fiercely blazing fire.

de'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon gser gyi dril bu bsnams pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ yid la dran pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa/ gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa zhig bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i lha tshogs/ ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / lan gsum/

Upon his head, the benevolent root guru is yellow in color, with one face and two hands, holding a wish-fulfilling gem at the heart with the right hand and a golden bell with the left, so brilliant it is hard to bear. Just bringing the guru to mind makes you attain the level of a nonreturner. If you supplicate, the guru will grant the felicitous attainment of supreme and common spiritual powers. Once you have imagined the presence of such a one, repeat this supplication three times: “Deities indistinguishable from the guru and Protector, do not veil your timeless awareness. Do not block your power and magical ability. Do not delay your compassion. Do not distance your blessings. All of you, bless me through your inexhaustible awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. Bless me right now! Bless me quickly! Bless me on this very seat!”

de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'gros pas bsil ba tshal na bzhugs pa'i mgon po la phog pas nya la lcags kyus btab pa bzhin rang dbang med par spyan drangs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i nam mkhar DA ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sgrog cing khyod kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub bo zhes gsung lhang lhang byon nas spyi bo'i (743) mgon po'i dam tshig pa la thim pas de nyid bsil ba tshal gyi mgon po ye shes pa dngos su gyur snyam pa mdzod/

Through supplicating in that way, light rays like hooks radiate from the guru’s heart and strike the Protector dwelling in the Cool Grove and, like catching a fish with an iron hook, he is helplessly invoked. He arrives in the space above your head amid the sounds of the ḍamaru and bell, loudly declaring, “I will remove all your obstacles. I will create all favorable conditions.” {743} He then dissolves into the pledge-being Protector on your head. Imagine that has become the real Awareness Protector of Cool Grove.

slar yang mos gus drag tu bskyed pas mgon po'i spyi bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma 'od du zhu mgon po la thim/ mgon po nyid khyed rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug brgyud/ dbu ma'i nang du byon te rang sems hU~M yig tu gsal ba de nyid la thim pas dngul chu la dngul chu 'dres pa bzhin du dbyer med du gyur te ye shes mgon po'i skur gyur pa ni sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhes pa nas/ klong dkyil na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oM dkar po/ mgrin par AHdmar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hU~M sngon pos mtshan par gyur/

Again, by your arousing intense devotion, the guru sitting on the Protector’s head melts into light and dissolves into Protector. The Protector himself enters the cranial aperture on your head and travels down inside the central channel and dissolves into your mind visualized as hūṃ, merging inseparably like quicksilver merging with quicksilver. That becomes the form of the Awareness Protector. He is pitch black like the clouds at the end of all time…(etc. to)…standing in the midst of the expanse, marked with a white oṃ at the head, red āḥ at the throat, and blue hūṃ on a sun disk at the heart.

khyed rang gi gzhi lus kyang ye shes mgon po'i sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bur lhag par gsal thob la/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa/ rnam dag chos sku'i rang bzhin can de bdag nyid do snyam pa'i nga rgyal bzung la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug /
