Gain the heightened clarity of your main body also as the Awareness Protector; appearance and emptiness like an illusion. Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, fulfiller of the hopes of living beings just as they wish, with the intrinsic nature of totally pure dharmakāya—that’s me! Hold that thought of pride [of being Protector], and rest for a moment in that equipoise. Have them rest in equipoise.

yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba rtsa dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ snying ga'i pad+ma mgon po dang bcas pa la phog pas pad+ma bum sku ltar 'ubs se 'dus pa'i rtser rdo rje rtse lnga pa kha dog nag po lte bar hU~M gis mtshan pas tog gi tshul du spras pa la/ slar yang bla ma'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas mar zhugs/ snying ga'i mgon po dang bcas pa'i pad+ma bum sku ltar kha zum pa'i phyi rol nas snying po'i sngags kyi yig 'bru 'od 'tsher ba drwa ba'i rnam pa can gyi thag pas gru gu ltar bsdams pas rang nyid byang chub ma thob bar gyi tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin zhing 'bral med du bzhugs nas byin gyis rlob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

Now light rays come from the guru’s heart and move down inside the central channel. They strike the lotus with the Protector at the heart. The lotus is gathered up like a vase body, and at its tip, in the manner of a top ornament, is a black five-pronged vajra marked by hūṃ in its hub. A mantra string emerges from the guru’s mouth and enters down through the central channel. It comes to the Protector at the heart with the lotus like a vase body and [settles] around its circular opening. The letters of the essence mantra sparkle with light in the form of latticework, its filigrees bonding like a child. Think that in all your lifetimes, until such time as you attain awakening, [the Protector] remains there constantly nurturing and blessing you. {744}
de brtan par bya ba'i ched (744) du snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ badzra ma hA kA la tiSh+Tha badzra/ zhes brjod/
In order to stabilize that, place the vajra on their hearts and say, “vajra mahākāla tiṣtha vajra.”

de nas snying zhugs dngos gzhi song nas/ mtha' brten gtor ma la brten nas sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i spyi bo'i oM yig las 'od zer dkar po byung / slob ma mgon por gsal ba dang snying ga'i mgon po'i spyi bo'i oM yig la thim pas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag / bum pa'i dbang dang sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/

Now that the main practice of Entering the Heart is done, the supplemental support is the blessing by the totally complete awakened body, speech, and mind based on the torma. For that, do the following visualization. Clearly visualize the torma as Awareness Protector. White light rays emerge from the oṃ letter on his head. They dissolve into the oṃ letters on the head of the disciple as Protector and on the Protector in the heart. Physical obscurations are purified. Imagine that and you receive the vase empowerment and blessings of awakened body. Say the mantra and play music.

yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i AHyig las 'od zer dmar po byung / slob ma mgon por gsal ba dang snying ga'i mgon po'i mgrin pa'i AHyig la thim pas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag / gsang ba'i dbang dang gsung gi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/

Again visualize the torma as Awareness Protector. Red light rays emerge from the āḥ letter in his throat. They dissolve into the āḥ letter in the throat of the disciple as Protector and in the Protector in the heart. Verbal obscurations are purified. Imagine that and you receive the secret empowerment and blessings of awakened speech. Say the mantra and play music.

yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i snying ga'i hU~M yig las 'od zer sngon po byung / slob ma mgon por gsal ba dang snying ga'i mgon po'i snying gar hU~M yig sngon po la thim pas/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag / sher dbang dang thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/

Again visualize the torma as Awareness Protector. Blue light rays emerge from the hūṃ letter in his heart. They dissolve into the hūṃ letter in the heart of the disciple as Protector and in the Protector in the heart. Mental obscurations are purified. Imagine that and you receive the wisdom empowerment and blessings of awakened mind. Say the mantra and play music.

yang gtor ma ye shes mgon por gsal ba'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum rbad kyis chad nas slob ma dang snying ga'i mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum byed las dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa dag / tshig dbang dang yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

Again visualize the torma as Awareness Protector. The three seed syllables abruptly separate off from the three places. They dissolve into the three seed syllables in the three places of the disciple as Protector and in the Protector in the heart. Physical, verbal, and mental obscurations, and their functions, are purified. Imagine that you receive the word empowerment and blessings of awakened qualities and activities.

de nas mgo thog tu 'jog pa'i skabs su/ bla ma mgon po dgyes bzhin du spyi bor byon nas/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba dang / khyad par du yang snying ga'i rang sems mgon por gsal ba la sib sib thim pas bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs zhugs te bla ma mgon po dbyer med dang khyed rang gi shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems gsum ngo bo dbyer med du (745) gyur song snyam pa mdzod/ byas la

Then, when placing [the torma] upon the head: Guru-Protector gladly comes to the top of your head. They slowly dissolve into you visualized as Protector and, particularly, into your mind as Protector in your heart. Guru-Protector’s blessing enters. Guru-Protector inseparable and your very subtle wind-mind—think that these three become inseparable in essence. {745}

gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas dril bu bsil zhing / rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ / ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bca' dran mdzod la/ / skal ldan bu yi 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing / / mthun rkyen mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dzaHhU~M baM hoH zhes brjod do/ /

Place the torma on their heads and play the bell. From Vajradhara down to my root guru. recall the commands just as they were given. Please remove all fortunate ones’ adverse conditions, grant favorable conditions, and supreme and common powers. jāḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ

de dag gis mgon po snying zhugs kyi bka' gser chos chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa legs par grub pa yin pas spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa rnams dang skad cig kyang ma 'gal ba dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten tshul bzhin tu 'chang zhing bsnyen sgrub dus kyi mchod pa ma chags par brtson pa dang / khyad par gsang rten srog tu sba ba'i rnal 'byor nyin mtshan re re bzhin mi brjed pa dang / 'di nyid thob phyin chad dus rtag tu mgon po rang gi snying dbus su bstim pa ma gtogs phyi rol du mi bstim pa rnams gnad kyi dam tshig yin par gsungs pas/ ji skad bshad pa de dag las mi 'gal bar rjes su bsgrub bo snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ / gtso bos ji ltar sogs/

That fully completes the permission of Protector Entering the Heart, from the extraordinary word lineage of the Golden Dharmas. Never transgress for a moment all the sacred pledges contained in the general and particular root and branches. Properly hold these outer, inner, and secret supports, and strive to make offerings without break during the times of approach and accomplishment practices. In particular, do not forget to do the yoga of hidden life force, the secret support, every twenty-four-hour day. From the time of receiving this, at all times think that the Protector dissolved into the center of your heart and does not dissolve outside it. These are the vital sacred pledges. So it is taught. Think that you will follow these practices without contradicting how they were explained, and mentally repeat this: “I will do all that the master commands.”
gtong rag maN+Dal sogs dang / dkyil 'khor rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod/ gtong rag / bzod gsol nan tan sogs rtsa ba'i byin rlabs kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin legs par bsgrub par bya'o/ /

Offer a mandala in gratitude and the other concluding acts of the [deity] mandala. Resolutely do the feast offering, thanks giving, request for forbearance, and so forth as described on the occasion of the main [empowerment] blessing—do all that properly to complete it.
[Concluding Verse and Colophon]
bla ma ye shes mgon po'i gsang ba gsum/ / dad pa'i snying dbus byang chub thob kyi bar/ / mi 'bral bzhugs nas byin gyis rlobs pa dang / / 'gro kun go 'phang mchog der sbyor nus shog /
Guru-Awareness Protector’s three secrets, dwell in the center of my faithful heart, never apart until my awakening, and bless me with the ability of this supreme state for all beings.

ces pa 'di'ang phyogs 'dir rgyun shin tu dkon pas yig cha rnying pa'i gsal phyed kyi tshul du bla ma mgon po dbyer med mi 'bral snying gi thig ler 'dzin pa yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes mgon po dgyes pa'i gnas dang dus su bris pa dge legs 'phel// // (746) (747)

The preservation of this material is extremely tenuous. This is an attempt to clarify the old manuals by Yönten Gyatso Lodrö Tayepai De, who holds the Guru-Protector inseparable constantly in the sphere of my heart. Written during the time and place that delights the Protector. Let virtue prevail.
@#/ /mgon po phyag drug pa snying zhugs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ /
38. Guru Yoga Connected with Six-Armed Protector Entering the Heart[1]
bka' rgya ma'o// (748)
The Sealed One
@#/ /thugs rje'i gter chen bla ma mgon po la/ / byang chub snying po'i bar du gus btud nas/ / de yi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pas/ / snyan brgyud zab mo mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ /
Guru-Protector, great treasure of compassion, I bow with respect until the heart of awakening. I will write briefly on that extraordinary yoga from the profound aural lineage.
de la 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang /

Those individuals who have received the authorization for this uncommon practice and abide in the sacred pledges and vows, begin with going for refuge, arousing awakening mind, and meditating on the four immeasurables.
rang {rang yi dam gang rung mgon por bsgom kyang rung gsungs / mchan/} gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag tsam/
In the center of my body, (Note: it is taught to meditate either as one’s yidam or as the Protector, which is also appropriate.) the central channel is the thickness of a cane.
yar sna tshangs bug tu slebs shing / mar sna snying ga bud pa tsam du yod pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bum sku kha bsdus pa lta bu'i rtse mor rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga'i tog gis mtshan pa/

The upper end reaches the cranial aperture and the lower end just at the heart. A red eight-petaled lotus at the heart is compressed at the opening like a vase body. At its tip it is marked with a top ornament of a blue five-pronged vajra.
pad+ma'i dbus su shin tu phra ba'i thig le dkar dmar gyi nang du rang sems
In the center of the lotus is a very subtle pink vital sphere, within which is one’s mind.

myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hU~M yig rtse mor ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing / zhabs kyu las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa/ mgon po'i sku dang snying ga'i pad+ma bum sku las me 'od drag tu 'phro bar gyur par bsam/ rang gi spyi bor paM las pad+ma dang raM las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gaM las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas thod pa dang g.yon la phug 'dzin pa/ mgo bo g.yas su bstan nas gan rkyal du bsgyel ba/ de'i steng du hU~M las gri gug hU~M gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus gri gug sa bon dang bcas pa

yongs su gyur pa las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ cher 'bar ba rab tu khros shing shin tu rngams pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba rnon po bzhi (749) gtsigs pa/

That completely transforms into Swift-Acting Awareness Protector, blue-black in color, with one face and six arms. He is greatly ablaze and extremely wrathful and very voracious. His facial expression moves, and his four sharp fangs are bared. {749}

spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum po glog ltar 'khyug cing / khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing / sma ra dang smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ ljags rnam par 'dril zhing ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug / gnyis pa na thod pa'i phreng ba/ gsum pa na thod pa'i DA ma drag tu 'khrol ba/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag / gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/

His three eyes are red and round, darting around like lightning. His frowning wrinkles are drawn into a scowl. His tawny hair flows upward, and his eyebrows and whiskers blaze like fire at the end of time. His tongue is curled up as he roars with the laughter of ha ha, resounding like thunder. He holds a flaying knife in his first right hand, a skull rosary in the second, and is rattling a skull ḍamaru with the third. He holds a blood-filled skull cup in his first left hand, a trident in the second, and a vajra lasso in the third.

sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / dmar pos snyan rgyan/ khra bos dpung rgyan/ dkar pos mgul rgyan/ ser pos lag gdub/ ljang gus do shal/ dkar pos ska rags dang rkang gdub byas pa/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs la/ dar ljang gu'i ska rags bcings pa/ lte ba rab tu 'phyang zhing yan lag rags la bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/

Blue snakes bind his hair, and he has red snake earrings, striped snake armbands, white snake collar, yellow snake bracelets, green snake necklace, and white snake anklets and belt. He wears a fresh tiger-skin skirt tied with a green silk belt. He has a very protruding belly and thick limbs, with charisma that is difficult to bear. He has a crown of five dry human skulls and a garland of fifty fresh skulls dripping with blood.

dpral bar sin d+hU ras legs par byugs shing / spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pas rab tu brgyan cing / glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

His forehead is well anointed with a drop of vermilion. Akṣobhya crowns his head. On all his arms and legs there are strings of large and small bells. He wears an elephant-skin cape. He stands in the dance posture of right foot contracted and the left straight, standing in the midst of intensely blazing fire of timeless awareness.

mgon po'i spyi gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing / phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ bla ma dang mgon (750) po gnyis ka'i spyi bor oM/ mgrin par AH thugs kar hU~M gis mtshan pa/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer 'phros/ drin can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad spyan drangs/

Upon Protector’s head, the benevolent root guru is yellow with the radiance of one hundred thousand suns, holding a wish-fulfilling gem at the heart with the right hand and a golden bell with the left. The guru sits in vajra posture, adorned with countless precious ornaments. {750} Both the guru and Protector are marked with oṃ at their heads, āḥ at their throats, and hūṃ at their hearts. Light rays radiate from the hūṃ in the guru’s heart, invoking all the benevolent root and lineage gurus.
na mo bud+d+hA ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bI ra bI re na shrI ye/ DA ka DA ki ni/ dzo ka dzo ki ni/ sarba bud+d+hA ya/ bo d+hi s+t+wA sha ra NaM gats+tsha mi/ kye kye/ lan gsum brjod/
namo buddhāya / namo guruhe / vajra vīra vīreṇe śrīye / ḍāka ḍākinī / joka jokinī / sarva buddhāya / bodhisatvā śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi / kye kye (Repeat three times.)
dzaHhU~M baM hoH bla ma de nyid bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/
jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—the guru becomes the united essence of all gurus.

spyi bor bla ma dang mgon po snying ga'i mgon po gsum ka'i thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros pa gcig tu gyur nas/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod shing tsan+dan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas nag po chen po skad cig gis spyan drangs/ /

Light rays radiate from all three—the guru and Protector on the head and the Protector in the heart—and joins into one, invoking Mahākāla instantly from in front of the single trunk of the sandalwood tree in the Cool Grove Charnel Ground in the southeast.
hU~M/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur byon ma hA kA la che/ / dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /
* By faith and by sacred pledge, from Cool Grove Charnel Ground, great Mahākāla, come here: please approach this site of the mandala.
oM shrI ma hA kA la e h+ya hi k+ShiM k+ShiM nyer gcig dang /
oṃ śrī mahākāla e hye hi kṣiṃ kṣiṃ Repeat [kṣiṃ] twenty-one times, and
dzaHhU~M baM hoH dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/
jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—he becomes indivisible with the pledge being.

ces brjod pas bsil ba'i tshal gyi mgon po de nyid DA ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas te/ zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi 'gal rkyen ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub ces pa'i gsung lhang lhang byon bzhin pa spyi bo'i bla ma mgon po la thim pas/ de nyid mgon po dngos su gyur te/ zhal nas hU~M phaT kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing / rang gi nad gdon spyi dang khyad par steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal 'gong / 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar gzhob thul gyis bsreg / gri gug gi sos nyil nyil gtub cing sha khrag rus gsum gyi rnam par zhal du dmar chil chil gsol bar bsam/

Through saying that, the actual Protector of Cool Grove arrives to the sound of ḍamarus and bells, and loudly declares, “Child of good family, I will remove all your obstacles. I will create all favorable conditions.” He dissolves into the Guru-Protector on my head, which becomes the real Protector. From his mouth the sounds of hūṃ phaṭ reverberate like thunder. All my sickness and spirits in general, and in particular, all harm done to me by planetary and constellation spirits above, tsen and gyalgong spirits in between, and nāgas and earth lord spirits below, are singed like chicken feathers in a fire and burned up. [Protector] chops them up with the blade of his flaying knife and gobbles them down raw in the form of flesh, blood, and bones.
de nas rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod (751) par bsams la/
Then offering goddesses emanate from my heart and make the offerings: {751}
oM gu ru ma hA kA la ar+g+haM nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang / rU pa nas/ spar+she 'i bar gyis mchod/ oM gu ru ma hA kA la oM AHhU~M gis nang mchod 'bul/
oṃ guru mahākāla arghaṃ…(etc. to)…śabda, (and from) rūpa…(etc. to)…spareśa. (Present the inner offerings with) oṃ guru mahākāla oṃ āḥ hūṃ
spros pa'i lha mo dang snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen pos dgyes bar gyur par bsam/
He enters into union with the emanated goddesses and delights in great bliss.
gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ / skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur pa/ / bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ / rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /
Benevolent one who abides in great bliss and who instantly attains it, guru, with vajra like a precious jewel: I bow at your lotus feet.
chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang / / ma rungs kun 'dul khros pa'i sku/ / bstan pa'i ru dra 'joms mdzad pa'i/ / nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/
Praise: Without stirring from the realm of reality, yet your wrathful form to subdue the vicious vanquishes the rudra of the doctrine; homage and praise to Great Black One.
sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing zhes sogs kyis maN+Dal phul/
Offer the mandala with “The ground is anointed with perfume…(etc.).”
de nas gdung shugs drag pos/
Then with intense yearning, supplicate:
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/
Guru-Protector inseparable, I supplicate you. Grant your blessings to accomplish Guru-Protector Inseparable.

zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje 'chang dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po la phog pas mgon po {sku mdog ljang nag tu gyur par bsgom gsungs/ mchan/} 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'bar 'ur 'ur sil sil gar mdzad cing / mgon po'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma la phog pas bla ma 'od kyi {bla ma sku mdog ljang ser du gyur par bsgom/ mchan/} rang bzhin du mer mer dril bu'i sgra sgrog / bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer mi phyed par gyur/

Through supplicating three times, light rays radiate from [the guru’s] body, which has become the essence of Vajradhara and all the lineage gurus. They strike Protector (Note: it is said to meditate that his color becomes dark green), who blazes with the nature of light and bliss, dancing with the sounds of ur ur, sil sil. Light rays radiate from Protector and strike the guru’s body. Guru (Note: meditate on the guru’s color as yellow-green) becomes the nature of shimmering light and rings the bell. Guru is Protector. Protector is Guru. Guru and Protector are inseparable.
bdag dang nam mkha' mtha'i dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sku bzhi'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
I and all sentient beings throughout the reaches of space supplicate the precious kind root guru, epitome of the four kāyas.
rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la= dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug la= rje btsun mai tri pa chen po la= grub chen rA hu la chen po la=
We supplicate the mighty victor Vajradhara. We supplicate mighty glorious Śavarīpa. We supplicate great Venerable Maitrīpa. We supplicate the great adept Rāhula.
mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor (752) la= mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la= dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la= gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la=
We supplicate the learned adept Khyungpo Naljor. {752} We supplicate the incomparable Rinchen Tsöndru. We supplicate the great Öntön Kyergangpa. We supplicate Nyentön Bepai Naljor.
chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa la= mkhas grub shangs ston chen po la= mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la= sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu la=
We supplicate Chöje Sangye Tönpa. We supplicate great Khedrup Shangtön. We supplicate Muchen Gyaltsen Palzangpo. We supplicate Ngakchang Dorje Zhönu.
mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa chen po la= chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la= mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po la= paN chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la=
We supplicate the great Nyame Namkhai Naljor. We supplicate the great Chöje Tsongkhapa. We supplicate Khedrup Gelek Palzangpo. We supplicate Paṇchen Chökyi Gyaltsen.
grub chen chos kyi rdo rje la= rgyal ba blo bzang don grub la= mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la= paN chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la=
We supplicate Drupchen Chökyi Dorje. We supplicate Gyalwa Lozang Döndrup. We supplicate Khedrup Sangye Yeshe. We supplicate Paṇchen Lozang Chökyi Gyaltsen.
rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la= skyid shod ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las la= rje blo bzang chos 'phel la= rje blo bzang dar rgyas la=
We supplicate Dorje Dzinpa Könchok Gyaltsen. We supplicate Kyishö Ngawang Tenzin Trinle. We supplicate Je Lozang Chöpel. We supplicate Je Lozang Dargye.
rje blo bzang sbyin pa la= rje ngag dbang mchog ldan la=
We supplicate Je Lozang Jinpa. We supplicate Ngawang Chokden.
kha skong ni/
(Supplement:)
kun mkhyen rol pa'i rdo rje la= rje btsun dkon mchog bde chen la= 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma la= 'jam mgon don grub rgyal mtshan la=
We supplicate Omniscient Rolpai Dorje. We supplicate Venerable Könchok Dechen. We supplicate Jamyang Tupten Nyima. We supplicate Jamgön Döndrup Gyaltsen.
zhes so/ /
(And:)
drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= phyag drug ye shes kyi mgon po la= mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la/ mgon po myur mdzad thugs rje can la= bla ma mgon po dbyer med la=

We supplicate the benevolent root guru. We supplicate Six-Armed Awareness Protector. We supplicate Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem. We supplicate Protector Swift-Acting Compassion. We supplicate Guru-Protector inseparable.
mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /
We supplicate Protector-Guru inseparable.
de ltar gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i zhal nas khyod kyi bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub bo zhes lhang lhang bzhugs par bsam la/
Through supplicating with intense yearning, think that the Protector loudly says, “I will remove all your obstacles. I will create all favorable conditions.”
na mo bud+d+hA ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bI ra bI re na shrI ye/ DA ka DA ki ni/ dzo ka dzo ki nI/ sarba bud+d+hA ya/ bo d+hi sa twa sha ra NaM gats+tsha mi/ kyai/ zhes gang mang brjod pas/
namo buddhāya / namo guruhe / vajra vīra vīriṇe śrīye / ḍāka ḍākinī / joga jogiṇī / sarva buddhāya / bodhisatva śarāṇī / gacchāmi / kyai (Repeat however many times.)

spyi bo'i bla ma mgon skabs spyi bo'i bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / mgon po'i gnas gsum las sku dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa byung ste rang la thim par bsgom gsungs/ mchan/ po'i sku 'di (753) las bdud rtsi dang 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dang mgon po'i sku bong thung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung ste rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te mgon po'i zhal du gsol bas dag par gyur zhing / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur bar bsams la/

From the body of Guru-Protector on my head emerge {753} boundless elixir and light rays of the five colors and short, thick-limbed replicas of Protector. (Note: It is said to meditate on this occasion that elixir and multicolored light rays from the body of the guru on the head, and boundless white, red, and blue forms from the Protector’s three places arise and dissolve into oneself.) They completely fill my body, and all obstacles of sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are burned away and cleansed. Protector consumes them and they are purified. All qualities of longevity, merit, prosperity, scripture, and realization increase. (Thinking that, say:)

phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / da lta nying du byin gyis rlobs shig / myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / ces brjod pas/

Holy root and lineage gurus dwelling in the ten directions and three times, bless me! Buddhas and bodhisattvas all, bless me! Yidam deities of the mandala, bless me! Heroes and heroine yoginīs, bless me! Glorious Six-Armed Awareness Protector and deities, do not veil your timeless awareness. Do not block your power and ability. Do not delay your compassion. Do not distance your blessings. All of you, bless me through your unlimited awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. Bless me right now! Bless me quickly! Bless me on this very seat!

mgon po'i spyi bo'i oM las 'od zer dkar po dang / mgon po'i sku dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi dpral bar zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag / bum pa'i dbang thob/ sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /

White light rays and countless white bodies of the Protector emerge from the oṃ in Protector’s head. They enter my forehead. All physical obstacles of sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are purified. I obtain the vase empowerment, which instills the ability to achieve nirmāṇakāya. {754}

mgrin pa'i (754) AHlas 'od zer dmar po dang mgon po'i sku dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi mgrin par zhugs/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /

Red light rays and countless red bodies of the Protector emerge from the āḥ in Protector’s throat. They enter my throat. All verbal obstacles of sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are purified. I obtain the secret empowerment, which instills the ability to achieve saṃbhogakāya.

thugs ka'i hU~M las 'od zer sngon po dang mgon po'i sku sngon po dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi yid la zhugs/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /

Blue light rays and countless blue bodies of the Protector emerge from the hūṃ in Protector’s heart. They enter my heart. All mental obstacles of sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are purified. I obtain the wisdom-awareness empowerment, which instills the ability to achieve dharmakāya.

slar yang gnas lnga las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dang / mgon po'i sku kha dog sna lnga dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi gnas lngar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag / dbang bzhi pa thob/ ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam/

Again, light rays of five colors and countless Protector’s bodies of five colors emerge from his five places. They enter my five places and fill my whole body inside. All physical, verbal, and mental obstacles of sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are purified. I obtain the fourth empowerment, which instills the ability to achieve svabhāvakāya.

de nas slar yang / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis= dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis= / bla ma dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig / da lta nyid du= myur ba nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /

Holy root and lineage gurus dwelling in the ten directions and three times, bless me! Buddhas and bodhisattvas all, bless me! Yidam deities of the mandala, bless me! Heroes and heroine yoginīs, bless me! Glorious Six-Armed Awareness Protector and deities, do not veil your timeless awareness. Do not block your power and ability. Do not delay your compassion. Do not distance your blessings. All of you, bless me through your unlimited awakened body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities. Bless me right now! Bless me quickly! Bless me on this very seat!

khyad par bdag gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su byon te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'bral ba med par brtan par bzhugs la tshe 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa (755) thams cad las bskyab tu gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

Especially, come to the center of the eight-petaled lotus in my heart and remain there steadily without leaving until I attain awakening. Please protect me from all terrors of this life, the next, and the intermediate state. {755} Please grant all the supreme and common spiritual powers.

spyi bo'i bla ma mgon po'i zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag med par byas te/ zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub/ ces pa'i gsung lhang lhang dang bcas te tshangs bug nas zhugs te sngags kyi sgra sgrogs bzhin pa'i gar stabs ling nge dbu ma'i nang nas mar byon snying ga'i mgon po la thim zhing bla ma'i bum sku'i tog gi rdo rje la thim pas rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hU~M yig ser pos mtshan par gyur par bsam/ de las mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hU~M yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer dus mtha'i me 'od lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad gzhob thul gyis bsregs/ rang gi sha rus gdos bcas kyi lus 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i skur lam gyis gyur/ zhes nga rgyal brtan po bya/

Guru-Protector on my head eradicates Gaṇapati underfoot and says loudly, “Child of a good family, until you attain awakening, I will remove all adverse conditions. I will create all favorable conditions.” He enters the cranial aperture to the sound of the mantra while swaying in dance, coming down the central channel and dissolving into the Protector in my heart and into the vajra top ornament of the vase body of the guru. Imagine that the hub of the blue vajra is marked with a yellow letter. From that, light rays like the firelight at the end of time radiate from the mantra string around the letter hūṃ upon the sun mandala in Protector’s heart. They fill my whole body. All sickness, spirits, negativities, and obscurations are ignited and burned up. My corporeal form of flesh and bones suddenly becomes the awakened body of Swift-Acting Six-Armed Awareness Protector. Say that and stabilize the pride.
de nas ye shes kyi me 'od stong gsum thams cad khyab par 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyang ye shes kyi mgon po'i skur gyur pas sngags kyi sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog par mos te/
Then the firelight of awareness radiates throughout all the billionfold universe. All sentient beings change into the form of the Awareness Protector. The sound of the mantra resounds:

oM badzra ma hA kA la k+ShiM k+She tra big+h+nAn na bi nA ya ka hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/ zhes pa dang / oM shrI ma hA kA la ya/ shA sa na/ u pa hA ri Ni/ e Sho a pa sh+tsi/ ma kA lo‘yaM/ i daM rat+na tra yA ya/ a pa ka rI Ne/ ya di pra tI dz+nya/ sma ra si tA da/ i daM duSh+TaM kha kha khA hi khA hi/ mA ra mA ra/ gr-ih+Na gr-ih+Na/ ban+d+ha ban+d+ha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dE na me ke na/ mA ra (756) ya hU~M hU~M phaT phaT swA hA/

oṃ śrī mahākāla śāsana / upahāriṇi / eṣo ’paścima kālo ayaṃ / idaṃ ratna trayāya / apakāriṇaṃ / yadi pratijñā/ smarasi tadā / idaṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi / māra māra / gṛhṇa gṛhṇa / bandha bandha / hana hana / daha daha / paca paca / dīnamekena / māraya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
ces pa rnams ci nus su bzla/ mjug tu/
Recite that as much as you can. {756} Afterward, repeat this three or seven or more times:
bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /
Guru-Protector inseparable, I go for refuge in you with faith: may I dispel every affliction of myself and all sentient beings.
mgon po bla ma dbyer med la/ / bdag gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / bar chad ma lus sel bar shog /
Protector-Guru inseparable, I go for refuge in you with faith: may I remove every obstacle of myself and all sentient beings.

ces pa gsum mam bdun sogs brjod/ dus rgyun du sngags bzla shA sa na dang bcas/ mchan/ ba'i tshe snying ga'i mgon po'i thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la dmigs pa gtad nas bzlas na legs mthar rdo rje'i bzlas pa spyi ltar bya/ shing / gtor ma dang mchod pa sogs kyang snying ga'i mgon po la phul bas chog par gsungs so/ /

During the regular mantra recitation (Note: including the śāsana mantra), it is good to focus the visualization on the mantra circling in the heart of Protector at your heart while reciting (and to do the vajra recitation as usual). And it is said to be excellent to present torma and offerings and so forth to the Protector in the heart.

de ltar 'bad pas nyams su blang na gnas skabs su nad gdon bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing / tshe bsod dpal 'byor dam chos bshad sgrub sogs 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis 'di phyi bar do thams cad du 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ gzhan la gsang bas nyams su len pa gal che zhing / zhib cha bla ma'i zhal nas shes par pa la cher mchan gsal ltar ro/ bya dgos so/ /

If you do this practice diligently, the immediate results are that any sickness, spirit, or obstacle will not take hold and longevity, merit, prosperity, Holy Dharma teachings and practice, and so on will increase. Since this is the most sublime method of keeping the protection of Guru-Protector inseparable constantly present in this life, the next, and in the intermediate state, it is important to do the practice while keeping it secret from others. The details should be learned directly from the guru, (as is clarified in these notes).
smras pa/
Concluding Words

bla ma lha dang rang sems dbyer med du/ / rtse gcig bsgom zhing yid ches gsol btab pas/ / don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub byed lha mchog der/ / snying nas blo gtad gang de skal pa bzang / / 'dir 'bad dge ba sprin bral zla zer ltar/ / mchog tu dkar ba ji snyed thob pa des/ / skye dang skye bar bla mgon dbyer med kyis/ / rjes bzung rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /

Through meditating with single focus and supplicating with belief that the sublime deity will spontaneously achieve the two purposes, one who sincerely trusts in that is a fortunate one. By whatever virtue was attained from striving at this, the pure white excellence like moonbeams without clouds, may I be held by Guru-Protector inseparable in life after life and may the Victor’s doctrine flourish.

ces pa bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa shin tu zab pa 'di ni/ rang gi bla ma'i zhal shes ji lta ba bzhin du/ rig pa 'dzin pa lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes go bde bklags chog tu bsgrigs pa yin pas/ (757) rjes gnang ma thob pa dang snod min rnams la gsang bar bya'o/ / 'dis kyang bstan pa rgyas par gyur cig / mang+ga laM/ /

This extremely profound uncommon yoga of Guru-Protector Inseparable [was written] exactly as it was understood from the mouth of my guru. Since it was arranged in an easily read and understood format by the awareness holder Changkya Rolpai Dorje,[2] {757} keep it secret from those who have not received authorization and from unsuitable recipients. May this increase the doctrine. maṅgalaṃ
yig cha 'di'i steng nas khrid rgyun lung bcas ka chen blo bzang dge legs kyi zhal snga nas/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por nos so// // (758) (759)
In addition to this manual, the continuous guidance with the reading transmission was received by Khyentse Wangpo at the great monastic center of Tashi Lhunpo from Kachen Lozang Gelek.[3]
@#/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mthing dkar gnyis kyi mnga' gsol dge legs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // (760)
39. Clouds of Virtue and Goodness. The Investiture of Power for Deep-Blue and White Swift-Acting Awareness Protectors[1]
@#/ /oM swa sti sid+d+haM/
oṃ svasti siddhaṃ
[Deep-Blue Protector]

ye shes mgon po rdo rje phyag drug pa la mnga' gsol dbul bar 'dod pas rgyan gyis spras pa'i gtor chen dang sman phud sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba bshams la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ badzra a mr-i ta sa bsang / swa b+hA wa sa sbyang /

To offer the investiture of power to Vajra Six-Armed Awareness Protector, arrange a big ornamented torma and whatever offering items you have gathered, such as medicine, first offerings, and so on. To consecrate them, cleanse with vajra amṛta…(etc.) and purify with svabhāva…(etc.).

stong pa'i ngang las/ yaM las rlung / raM las me/ kaM las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bruM AMHdzriM khaM hU~M rnams las sha lnga/ lAM mAM pAM tAM pAM rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/ steng gi nam mkha' la oM dkar po/ a las zla ba/ hU~M las rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/ yig 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs thim/ oM dang zla ba rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu zhing thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa dang / rten skong sgrub cing mchod pa'i dam rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang bar gyur/

From within emptiness, yaṃ becomes wind, raṃ becomes fire, and kaṃ becomes three hearth skulls. Upon that, from A, the vast and wide perfect skull cup contains the five meats arising from brūṃ, āṃ, jriṃ, kha, and hūṃ, and the five elixirs from lāṃ, māṃ, bāṃ, tāṃ, and pāṃ. In the space above them is stacked a white oṃ, a moon from A, and a vajra from hūṃ. Wind stirs, fire blazes, and the five meats and five elixirs melt into light. A stream of elixir flows from the three seed syllables. Their light invokes the three vajras of all buddhas to dissolve into them. The oṃ, moon, and vajra also melt into light and dissolve [into the skull cup]. Its contents become an ocean of elixir imbued with inexhaustible color, smell, taste, power, and potency, and the supports fulfilling all requirements. The unimaginable sacred substances expand and fill all the realms of all worlds.
oM AHhU~M/ lan gsum brjod/ dbyangs rol bcas/ /
oṃ āḥ hūṃ (Repeat three times.) Recite the following with melody and music.
hU~M/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ / chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las (761) ma g.yos kyang / / gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /
myur mdzad mgon po 'dir gshegs mchod gsol bzhes/ /
Swift-Acting Protector, come here to accept offerings.
ye shes bskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na/ / thabs la mkhas pas rab khros skur ston pa/ / mi bsrun bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che/ / myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang mnga' gsol lo/ /

Amid an expanse of awareness fire like that of the end-times, with skillful means you display a wrathful form, great warrior who vanquishes unruly devil hordes: Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara—power to you!
rtag tu 'gro la khyab pa'i thugs rje yis/ / rab tu zhi yang mchog tu gtum pa'i sku/ / dus mtha'i sprin dang mig sman ltar gnag pa/ / 'jigs byed khrag 'thung gtso bo mnga' gsol lo/ /

With constant all-encompassing compassion for migrators, in total serenity yet your form is sublimely fierce, dark as clouds of the end-times or blue eye tincture: terrifying lord of blood drinkers—power to you!
rab bzhad rdo rje'i gad mo chen po yis/ / bdud dang gshin rje'i snying 'gas klad pa 'gems/ / lha dang lha min ma rungs sder bcas ltung / / drag shul bzod dka'i gtso bor mnga' gsol lo/ /

In mirth, your loud vajra laughter bursts the hearts and confounds the brains of devils and death lords; vicious gods and demigods with claws are brought down: chief of the unbearably savage—power to you!
phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs rgyal rnams kyi/ / brtse chen gcig tu bsdus pa spyan ras gzigs/ / dngos grub kun stsol byin rlabs mgon po mchog / phrin las myur du sgrub mdzad mnga' gsol lo/ /
All victors’ great love filling the ten directions of space is subsumed in Avalokiteśvara as supremely blessed Protector who grants all powers: swift accomplisher of activity—power to you!
zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum me ltar 'bar/ / sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzes/ / klu chen brgyad dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan/ / phyag drug ye shes mgon po mnga' gsol lo/ /

Gaping mouth, bared teeth, and three eyes blazing like fire, beard, eyebrows, and hair blazing upward, adorned by eight great nāgas and strings of bells: Six-Armed Awareness Protector—power to you! {762}
rin chen cod pan khrag (762) 'dzag mgo phreng can/ / phyag g.yas gri gug thod phreng cang te 'khrol/ / phyag g.yon thod pa rtse gsum zhags pa bsnams/ / stag lpags na bzas mdzes pa mnga' gsol lo/ /

With jeweled crown and garland of bleeding heads, right hands holding a flaying knife, skull rosary, and rattling a drum; left hands holding a skull, trident, and lasso: beautiful in a tiger-skin robe—power to you!
mnyam dang g.yon brkyang gyad kyi dor stabs sogs/ / sna tshogs gar gyis log 'dren steng na rol/ / pad nyi'i gdan bzhugs tsan+dan ljon pa'i drung / / brten mdzad ma hA kA lar mnga' gsol lo/ /

Reveling upon the errant one with various dance postures such as even-footed, left extended, or a champion’s pose, standing on a lotus-sun seat before the sandalwood tree support: Mahākāla—power to you!
zhabs sen cung zad brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo/ / hU~M sgras ri bo ral zhing chu gter 'khrugs/ / spyan tsam bskyod pas bar chad thams cad sel/ / thogs med mthu stobs mnga' ba mnga' gsol lo/ /
sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che/ / bar chad srung phyir chos spyod bka' sdod sku/ / sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad pa'i/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med mnga' gsol lo/ /
Precious guru, all buddhas in actuality, takes the form of an obedient protector to guard against obstacles, watching over practitioners as your own child: Guru-Protector inseparable—power to you!
rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo sgrib kun sbyong / / nyid kyi dpral bar brten pa'i chos 'byung dbyibs/ / sin+d+hu ra'i thig ler yum gcig rnal 'byor ma/ / 'khor 'das chos kun skyed mar mnga' gsol lo/ /

Essence of Vajrasattva, purifying all obscurations, on your brow, the shape of a source of phenomena in a vermilion drop is the One Mother Yoginī: birth mother of all things in existence and transcendence—power to you!
de dbus hrIHyig dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon/ / khams gsum dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro ma rnams spro/ / 'gugs byed bcu gsum yig 'bru'i gsang sngags mchog / 'phags ma sgrol ma'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /

In the drop’s center, hṛīḥ is glorious World Protector, commanding the three realms, emanating ḍākinīs who magnetize with the sublime secret mantra of thirteen letters: essence of Exalted Tārā—power to you!
mi bskyod dbang phyug rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ / bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyis mthu stobs sbyin/ / khyod la phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi/ / rtag tu gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /
Mighty Akṣobhya sits as lord of the family, conqueror Yamāntaka bestows strength and power: I pay homage and go for refuge with all my heart, and I always supplicate you—grant your blessings.
phyi nang gsang ba'i rten skong sgrub pa'i rdzas/ / sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa'i yo byad ni/ / dngos 'byor yid sprul 'jig rten khams gang bas/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas mnga' gsol lo/ /

Outer, inner, and secret substances of support, fulfillment, and accomplishment, offerings of medicine, rakta, torma, and feasts, real and mentally emanated, filling the realms of the world: Awareness Protector and retinue—power to you!
sgrub la bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ / chos kun sgyu mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / rmi lam rang grol 'char bar= / gtum mo'i bde chen 'char bar= /
Bless me to be free of obstacles to practice. Bless me to realize all things as illusion. Bless me with the arising of self-liberating dreams. Bless me with the arising of inner heat’s great bliss.
'od gsal phyag chen rtogs par= / tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par= / bar do'i 'jigs pa sel bar= (763) bar dor longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /

Bless me to realize the lucid clarity of mahāmudrā. Bless me to attain buddhahood in this lifetime. Bless me to dispel fears of the intermediate state. {763} Bless me to attain saṃbhogakāya in the intermediate state.
'gal rkyen thams cad zhi bar= / mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par= / thugs yid gnyis su med par= / sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /

Bless me with pacification of all adverse conditions. Bless me with attainment of all favorable conditions. Bless me so that our minds become one. Grant your blessings to spread the Buddha’s teaching.
hU~M/ rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma dang / / dbyer med mgon por mnga' gsol lo/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang ngo bo'i phyir/ / yi dam mchog tu mnga'= /
hūṃ Power to the guru, the real Vajradhara, inseparable from the Protector. Power to the sublime yidam, the essence of Avalokiteśvara.
sku bzhi mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas su mnga'= / theg chen dam chos thams cad kyi/ / mnga' bdag chen por mnga'= /
Power to the perfect Buddha who manifests the four kāyas. Power to the great masters of all Mahayana Holy Dharma.
'phags tshogs dge 'dun thams cad kyi/ / gtso bo chen por mnga'= / thub dbang bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ / chos skyong chen por= /
Power to the great leaders of the noble assembly of sangha. Power to the great dharma protectors who guard the mighty Sage’s doctrine.
lha chen rnams kyi gtso bo'i phyir/ / legs ldan chen por= / drag po'i las la dbang mdzad phyir/ / nag po chen por= /
Power to the Great Excellent One, chief of the great gods. Power to the Great Black One, who controls wrathful actions.
gsang sngags rig 'dzin thams cad kyi/ / srung ma chen por= / rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan rnams kyi/ / dgra lha chen por= /
Power to the great guardians of all Secret Mantra awareness holders. Power to the great warrior gods of yogins who hold sacred pledges.
bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ / mgon dang skyabs su mnga' gsol lo/ / thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa srungs/ / rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ /
Power to the protectors and refuges of all of us and our entourages. Guard the doctrine of the mighty Sage! Perform activity for me, the yogin!
'gal rkyen zlog cing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ / mnga' gsol don dang ldan par mdzod/ /
Avert misfortune, accomplish favorable conditions. Perform the purpose of your power investiture!

dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol lo mchod do/ / rdo rje nag po chen po dpal he ru ka dang rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ngang du gcig cing ngo bo ye shes su mtshungs pa/ mtshan nyid phrin las phyogs med du mnyam pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i dpa' bo/ snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi yongs rje/ zhing skyong drag po'i bka' nyan gyi sde dpon/ mi pham rdo rje gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ / rig 'dzin gyi dbang phyug bu bzhin du skyong ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba/ zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag pos dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa srung ba'i rtsal (764) 'byin pa/

Glorious Swift-Acting Awareness Protector and retinue—I supplicate you! I offer to you! Great Black Vajra, one with glorious Heruka within the nature of phenomena—identical in timeless awareness. In characteristics, you are equal in impartial awakened activity. You are the warrior who vanquishes adverse conditions everywhere, lord over all gods and demons in apparent existence, commander over obedient wrathful field protectors, king of invincible vajra charisma, parental guardian of mighty awareness holders, watcher over the meditation success of avowed practitioners. You are endowed with the countenance of peace, the resplendence of enrichment, the masterful energy of magnetizing, and the fast actions of wrathfully liberating enemies and obstructors. You display the dynamic energy of a doctrine guard. {764}

mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug zhing skyong rdo rje nag po phyag drug pa/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la/ gshin rje TA ki rA dza/ dbang phyug dzi na mi tra/ bdud mgon trak+shad nag po/ phyogs skyong chen po bcu/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ / mchod do/ / mnga' gsol lo/ /

Mighty one of power and strength, field protector, Vajra Black Six-Armed One; Glorious Goddess Rematī, Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla, Yama Ṭakkirāja, Īśvara Jinamitra, devil lord Black Trakṣad, ten great direction protectors, seventy-five protectors of the pure regions, armies of an ocean of the obedient oath-bound, and your retinues—I supplicate you! I offer to you! I invest you with power!

mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub dang bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su bgrod pa'i lam gyi bar chad dang / bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad las bsgral ba'i lam gyi skyel ma dam pa mdzod cig / yang dag pa'i lam dang 'phrad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sun ma dang sprad par mdzod cig / byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'gro zhing / thar pa byang chub kyi lam du blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog thun mongs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi dpal dang mgon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du phrin las bzhi'i bya ba thams cad la ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i don thams cad de kho na nyid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib 'jigs pa brgyad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags longs spyod sogs 'byor pa drug spel bar mdzad du gsol/ khams gsum gyi lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhis dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra gdon bgegs tshogs byad phur rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na skye ba kun tu thugs rjes yud tsam yang mi 'dor bar don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /

Accept this donation of vast offering torma. For this yogin, be my sacred guide to eliminate all obstacles and fears of the four devils as I travel the path to awakening and the Sukhāvatī pure land. Be my escort who welcomes me with meditative absorption when meeting the genuine path. Until I attain awakening, do not let me go down the wrong path in my body, speech, or mind, but guide my thoughts toward the path of awakening and emancipation. Once I have obtained all the supreme and common spiritual powers, may I become the protector and glory of all migrators. At all times and circumstances, please perform all the actions of the four awakened activities exactly according to the intent of my requests. Please pacify my sicknesses, bad spirits, negative actions, obscurations, and the eight fears. Please increase the six kinds of fortune[2] and longevity, merit, prosperity, renown, enjoyments, and so forth. Please bring gods, demons, and humans of the three realms under control through the four admirations.[3] Please quell and terminate all kinds of calamities—such as curses, ritual daggers, inciting sorcery—and the hosts of enemies, spirits, and obstructors. In short, do not abandon your compassion for me for a moment in all my lives and bless me to spontaneously accomplish the two purposes.
[White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem]
mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu la mnga' gsol 'bul bar spro na/ gtor ma phud mchod gtsang zhing dag la rgya che ba 'du byas la/ bsang sbyang /
To offer the investiture of power to White Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, prepare clean and pure torma, first offerings, and abundant offerings. Cleanse and purify [with the mantras]. {765}

stong pa'i (765) ngang las/ yaM las rlung / raM las me'i steng du AHlas ka pA la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba hU~M b+h+rUM oM dzriM khaM rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

From within emptiness, yaṃ becomes wind and raṃ becomes fire. Above that, from A, the vast and wide perfect skull cup contains the five meats marked with brūṃ, āṃ, jriṃ, kha, and hūṃ, and the five elixirs [marked with lāṃ, māṃ, bāṃ, tāṃ, and pāṃ]. Wind stirs, fire blazes, and the ten ingredients with their letters melt. Elixir from the hearts of all buddhas is invoked and dissolves [into the skull cup], filling it with a great ocean of the elixir of awareness.
oM AHhU~M ha ho hrIH lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ /
oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha ho hrīḥ (Repeat three times to consecrate.)
hU~M/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can/ / sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro/ / 'gro ba'i dbul phongs ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ / 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol 'dir gshegs mchod gsol bzhes/ /

hūṃ Compassionate Protector Wish-Fulfilling Gem, white as a snow mountain, radiating light, you relieve all the poverty of migrators, and grant the power of fulfilled desires—approach and accept offerings.
lhun stug kai lA sha yi ri bo ltar/ / 'od zer bye bas 'khyud pa'i rdul phreng can/ / dbang sdud mkha' 'gro stong gi bdag po ni/ / myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang mnga' gsol lo/ /
Like Mount Kailash, you are massive and dense, wreathed by particles of a million light rays, master of a thousand magnetizing ḍākinīs: Swift-Acting Avalokiteśvara—power to you!
'dzum bag brjid pa'i zhal ras yid tsam khro/ 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal po khyod/ / chos nyid thig le'i sgo ngar gdod ma'i sems/ / mngon gyur ye shes sku can mnga' gsol lo/ /

Your smiling resplendent facade is slightly wrathful, you bring rains of desires and needs, king of power, your original mind in the vital drop of phenomenal nature manifests as the form of timeless awareness—power to you!

dngul chu'i mdangs gsal hU~M yig las 'khrungs pa/ / skye 'gro'i re skong dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ / dbu skra gyen brdzes spyi bor mi 'khrugs rgyal/ / rgyas gdab dbang bskur che brnyes mnga' gsol lo/ /

Born from a hūṃ letter with the luster of quicksilver, you fulfill the hopes of living beings and relieve poverty’s pain. King Akṣobhya above your bristling hair seals and confers great empowerment—power to you!
kha ba'i ri la 'char ka gsar ba ltar/ / khyod zhal smin mtshams sin+d+hu'i thig le mdzes/ / rin chen gdu bu 'khrol ba'i phyag drug po/ / bla med phar phyin ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /

Like dawn on the freshly snowed mountain, your brow is beautified by a drop of vermilion, your six arms jingling with jeweled bracelets and armlets, essence of supreme transcendent perfections—power to you!
gri gug yid bzhin nor bu DA ma ru/ / nor bus gtams pa'i thod pa bum par bcas/ / rtse gsum dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bsnams/ / phyag drug ye shes mgon por mnga' gsol lo/ /
You hold flaying knife, wish-fulfilling gem, ḍamaru, gem-filled vase in a skull cup, trident, and hook for capturing the spiritual powers: Six-Armed Awareness Protector—power to you!
lhab lhub dar dang stag lpags na bza' can/ / 'od 'bar rin chen rgyan gyi sil khrol dang / / nor bu'i chun 'phyangs du mas rab tu mdzes/ / gzi byin lhang nger 'bar ba mnga' gsol lo/ /
With flowing silks and tiger-skin clothes, radiant lights and precious ornaments tinkling, beautified by draped clusters of many gems, blazing with resplendent brilliance—power to you! {766}
'dod pa'i (766) longs spyod char chen 'bebs byed pa/ / bi na ya ka'i steng na rol pas bzhugs/ / rab sngo tsan+dan ljon pa'i tshal na dgyes/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bdag po mnga' gsol lo/ /
You stand playing upon Vināyaka, who rains down a wealth of desirables, joyful in your grove of verdant sandalwood trees: master of ḍākinīs of three regions—power to you!
thugs kar dbang gi lha mo lang tsho ma/ / 'char ka'i 'od ris gsar pa glog phreng ltar/ / mdzes shing g.yo ba'i dngos grub lcags kyu 'dzin/ / srid gsum dbang du sdud mdzad mnga' gsol lo/ /

Youthful goddess of power at your heart, like new light rays at dawn or lightning garlands, gorgeous and moving, holding the hook of spiritual powers, she magnetizes the three existences—power to you!
mnga' gsol bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / / snying nas lha mchog khyod la gdung ba yis/ / mnga' gsol 'bul gyis bdag la mchog stsol nas/ / dpal dang 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /
With this investiture, praise, supplication, and heartfelt devotion to you, sublime deity, I offer this investiture; now grant me supreme powers and accomplishment of all desired goals and glory.
thugs rje'i sprin las dge legs char phab ste/ / 'dod dgu'i rba rlabs phreng ba chil chil g.yo/ / zas nor longs spyod dge legs yar 'phel gyi/ / dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gong nas gong 'phel shog /

The rainfall of virtue and goodness from your compassionate activity swells the rolling sets of waves of desires and needs. May the ocean of prosperity forever increase, bringing food, wealth, virtue, and goodness.
gsol lo mchod do/ /
I supplicate you. I offer to you.

myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin nor bu/ dran pa tsam gyis 'di phyi bar do'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char bzhin tu 'bebs pa/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /

Wish-Fulfilling Gem of Swift-Acting Awareness: just recalling you protects me from the sufferings of this life, the next, and the intermediate state. Just supplicating you causes a rainfall of the powers of desires and needs. With your hosts of billions of ḍākinīs of the three places, I supplicate you. I offer to you. Power to you!

dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag sa dang bar snang nam mkha' gang ba bla ma mgon po dbyer med chos nyid bde ba chen po la yid ches mos gus rtse gcig tu bsgom pa'i mchod sprin bla na med pas dgyes shing mnyes nas/ bdag sgrub pa po la bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin du brtse ba chen pos byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rtag tu mi 'bral bar gzigs la/ gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang dbang phyug zas nor longs spyod snyan grags mnga' thang la sogs pa rab tu 'phel zhing rgyas la nyams pa med pa dang / khams gsum srid gsum brten g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad thogs pa med (767) par dbang du 'du ba'i mchog sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ mthar thug bde ba can gyi zhing khams su lam sna 'dren pa'i ded dpon dang 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i skyel ma mdzad cing 'jig rten mgon po thugs rje'i dbang phyug gi go 'phang bde blag tu 'thob par byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor mchod nam mkhar 'bul bar bya'o/ /

I offer special offerings of actual and mentally emanated gifts that fill the earth and sky and space to the Guru-Protector inseparable, and meditate with undivided trust and devotion in that great bliss of phenomena’s nature. May these unsurpassable offering clouds delight and please you. With great affection for me, the practitioner, like a mother’s for her only child, watch over me constantly until I attain awakening. In the immediate situation, please accomplish the conducive conditions for dharma practice, such as longevity, merit, glory, power, food, wealth, possessions, fame, and influence—always expanding and flourishing without diminishing. Please grant me the supreme gift of unhindered control of the three realms, the three existences, and all the vital essence of the animate and inanimate. {767} Ultimately, be my guide on the path to the Sukhāvatī pure land and carry me to liberation from cyclic existence. Please bless me to readily attain the state of Protector Lokeśvara, the Lord of Compassion. Offer the torma to the sky accompanied by the sound of music.
[Colophon]

zhes pa 'di ni sgar bsang chen mo sogs dus kyi mchod pa'i skabs su 'jug 'os par mthong nas/ jo nang rje btsun chen po sogs byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i gsung rnams gung spros te mnga' gsol ba'i tshig mtha' bsgyur zhing 'don bde bar bsdebs pa ste/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod badzra ko TI ye shes mgon po nyid dgyes rgur rol pa'i dga' ba'i tshal du bris pa dge legs 'phel// / sarba mang+ga laM b+ha wan+tu/ / (768) (769)

Seeing that this was suitable to add during offering rituals, such as the Great Burnt Offering Ritual for Encampment, I used the teachings of the great Venerable Jonang Tāranātha and others endowed with blessings, changing section endings of the lines to those for investiture of power and making them easy to recite. I, Karma Ngawang Yönten Gyatso, wrote this at Palpung’s remote retreat of Vajra Devīkoṭi, the pleasure grove where the Awareness Protector enjoys himself in play. sarva maṅgalaṃ bhavantu
@#/ /zhing skyong chen po k+She tra pA la yab yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bskur chog bzhugs so/ / (770)
40. Ritual for Conferring the Uncommon Authorization of the Great Field Protector Kṣetrapāla Father-Mother[1]
@#/ /na mo ma hA kA la ye/
namo mahākālaye

myur mdzad ye shes mgon po shin tu drag por sprul pa'i zhing skyong chen po k+She tra pA la yab yum gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin par byed pa la/ stegs kyi khar chos 'byung gru gsum phyi nag nang dmar ba'i nang du tshom bu nag po gnyis bkod/ de'i steng many+dzi'i khar gtor ma zung gsum gnyis sha khrag gis sbags pa dar nag gis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor zur gsum gnyis dang mchod rdzas bying sha chen dang gu gul gyi dud pas hrul ba bcas legs par bsham/ rang mgon po gtso rkyang du bskyed la bzlas pa dang mchod bstod byas rjes mdun gyi mchod gtor rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma gnyis bsang sbyangs/

This is the uncommon authorization for the great protector of the fields, Kṣetrapāla father-mother, the very wrathful emanation of Swift-Acting Awareness Protector. To proceed, on a platform make a triangular source of phenomena that is black outside and red inside. Within that, place two black heaps. On that, put a mañji; at its opening, place two three-cornered tormas filled with flesh and blood and decorated with black silk. In front of that, carefully arrange two three-cornered offering tormas and offering substances made serviceable by the smoke of frankincense and human flesh.[2] Visualize yourself as sole Protector and perform the recitation, offerings, and praises. After that, consecrate the offerings and tormas in front with cleansing and purifying. Cleanse and purify the two tormas.

stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gnod sbyin dpag tu med pa'i dbus su k+ShiM las k+She tra pA la sku mdog char sprin ltar nag shing cung zad dmar ba/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la gdengs nas lha srin sde brgyad thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ g.yon dgra bo'i snying khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bzung nas zhal du gsol ba zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i tshul gyis dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ dar nag gi ang rag gsol ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu blta ba/ khro gnyer smin brag tu bsgril nas zhal rab tu gdangs nas ljags glog ltar bskyod pa/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing zhal nas khrag gi sbu ba 'khyil ba/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung chen po 'tshubs pa/ sbom zhing thung la yan lag rags pa/ bsus khyim che ba/ ral pa kham ser gyen du me ltar 'bar ba phyag g.yon gyis spre'u 'jigs pa'i gzugs can 'khrid pa/

From within emptiness, in the midst of countless yakṣas, kṣeṃ becomes Kṣetrapāla, dark as storm clouds with a touch of red. With his right hand he brandishes a flaying knife to the sky, terrifying all the eight classes of gods and spirits. With his left hand he holds at his heart a skull cup filled with the hearts of enemies, from which he drinks. His two legs are spread apart as he rides a crazed black bear. He wears a black silk loin cloth. He glares at enemy obstructors with his three red, round eyes. His frowning wrinkles and eyebrows are intensely contorted and his mouth is wide open, his tongue darting like lightning, his four-plus-four sharp fangs bared, and blood frothing from his mouth. The great wind of the end-times blows from his nose. He is fat and short with thick limbs. He has a big household escort. His tawny dreadlocks blaze upward like fire.

de'i g.yon du ma mo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa'i dbus su b+h+yoHlas lha mo dus mtshan ma nag mo bya (771) rog gi gdong pa can sku la dar nag gi 'jol ring gsol ba/ phyag g.yas nad rkyal dang / g.yon ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ zangs kyi sder mo can/ shin tu khros shing 'jigs pa'i gad mo rgod de gcer bur rgyu ba/ spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khrugs pa/ skad cig tsam gyis dgra bgegs thal bar byed pa/

To his left, in the midst of boundless mātṛkās and ḍākinīs, bhyoḥ becomes the black goddess Kālarātri with a raven’s head. {771} She wears a long black cloak. With her copper-clawed hands she holds a bag of pestilence in the right and waves a lance with the left. She is wholly wrathful, laughing with terrifying sounds, and moving around naked. Her bloodshot eyes dart like lightning. In an instant she reduces enemies and obstructors to dust.

de gnyis kyi spyi bor oM dkar po/ mgrin par AHdmar po/ thugs kar hU~M sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas gnod sbyin k+She tra pA la yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/

These two have white oṃ at their heads, red āḥ at their throats, and blue hūṃ at their hearts. Light rays radiate from the [hūṃs] and instantly invoke Yakṣa Kṣetrapāla father-mother and their retinues from the Cool Grove Charnel Ground in the southeast.
e h+ye hi dza dzaHdzaHhU~M baM hoH dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/
e hye hi ja jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ—they become indivisible with the pledge beings.

oM k+She tra pA la sa pa ri wa ra ar+g+haM nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bul/ snying po'i mjug tu ba liM ta kha kha khA hi khA hi btags pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ mgon po'i bka' nyan kun gyi gtso bo khyod/ ces sogs kyis bstod/ yab yum gnyis kyis rang mgon por gsal ba la gyen du bltas te bka' nyan par bsam la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pas/

Offer with oṃ kṣetrapāla saparivara arghaṃ…(etc. to)…śabda. Present the inner offering. To the end of the essence mantra add baliṃta kha kha khāhi khāhi and offer the torma. Praise with “You are the chief of Protector’s attendants…” (mgon po’i bka’ nyan kun gyi gtso bo khyod…etc.). Think that both father and mother Kṣetrapāla look up to you, appearing as the protector, and obey. Visualize that with the recitation.
oM k+She tra pA la big+h+nAn hU~M phaT/ oM ma hA kA la yak+sha dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi tsit+ta la dun dun rbad/ ces dang /
oṃ kṣetrapāla vighnān hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ mahākāla yakṣa dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi citta la dun dun rbad [3]
yum la/ rak+mo nag mo dam nyams kyi tsit+ta la rbad kha la phur ya swA hA/
For the mother: rakmo nakmo dam nyams kyi citta la rbad kha la phur ya svāhā
zhes ci mang bzlas la mchod bstod bya/ slob ma'i don tu gsol ba btab/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi ni/ slob mas phyag dang maN+Dal phul/ /
Recite however much, then do the offerings and praises. Supplicate for the sake of the disciples. For the main part of the authorization, the disciples prostrate and offer a mandala.
bla ma ye shes mgon po che/ / dus 'dir bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / zhing skyong drag po yab yum gyi/ / bka' gtad bdag la stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/
Then they supplicate three times: Guru, great Awareness Protector, at this time please consider me. Please grant me the permission entrustment by the wrathful field protector, father-mother.
mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas gsal btab la/ rgyun bshags bya/
In the space before you, visualize the Guru-Protector with retinue. Do the regular confession.

bla ma rin po che bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po/ (772) bshan pa kun gyi gtso bo/ za byed kun gyi dmag dpon/ k+She tra pA la yab yum gyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes khyad par gyi gsol ba lan gsum bya/

Then the special supplication three times: Precious guru, in order to guard the Buddha’s doctrine, please grant me all the authorizations of Kṣetrapāla father-mother—yakṣa wealth lord, {772} chief of all butchers, captain of all cannibals.
de nas slob ma mgon po dang mdun du k+She tra pA la yab yum bskyed/
Visualize the disciples as [sole] protectors and the Kṣetrapāla couple in front.

bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas gnod sbyin dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma'i mdun gyi gnod sbyin yab yum gyi thugs kar thim de'i thugs ka nas kyang sku dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma'i snying gar hU~M gi zhabs kyu la thim par bsam la/

Light radiates from the guru’s heart and evokes the mind stream of the front visualization. From their hearts, countless yakṣas arise and dissolve into the zhapkyu of the hūṃ in the disciples’ hearts.
sha chen dang gu gul gyi dud pa btang / rol mo dang bcas pa'i snying po'i mthar a wE sha ya dzaHhU~M baM hoH zhes yang yang brjod sku'i rjes gnang song ngo / /

Circulate smoke of human flesh and frankincense. Accompanied by music, say avēśya jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ at the end of the essence mantra. Repeating that again and again is the authorization of awakened body.

yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mdun gyi gnod sbyin yab yum gyi zhal nas sngags phreng bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas hU~M gi zhabs kyu la thim pa sogs snga ma bzhin gsung gi rjes gnang ngo /

Again, from the master’s heart light rays arise (as before except) unimaginable mantra strings arise from the Kṣetrapāla couple’s mouths and dissolve into the zhapkyu of the hūṃ…(etc. as before)…the authorization for awakened speech.

yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa sogs pa sku'i rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/ gnod sbyin yab yum slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mgon po'i sku che ba gzi brjid dang ldan pa byon/ slob ma dang gnod sbyin yab yum gyi spyi bor zhabs bzhag ste bzhugs pa la mos gus dung dung byas pas/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung lus thams cad khyab pas bar chad thams cad bsal/ nus mthu ma lus thob/ mthar de nyid 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim/

Again, from the master’s heart light rays radiate…(etc. as in the body authorization except that) the Kṣetrapāla couple comes above the disciples’ heads. From the master’s heart the big brilliant form of the protector arrives. He plants his feet on the heads of the disciples and the Yakṣa couple and remains there. Your strong respect and devotion causes infinite light rays to emerge from their bodies and pervade everywhere, removing all obstacles. You obtain all magical abilities. At the end, they melt into light and dissolve into the disciples.
spos rol sogs gong bzhin bya/ gri gug dang thod khrag nad rkyal ru mtshon rnams snying po 'don cing lag tu gtad thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /
Light incense and play music as before. Give the flaying knife, blood-filled skull cup, and lance standard while reciting the essence mantra. This is the authorization of awakened mind.
bla ma mgon por gsal bas gnod sbyin yum gyi phyag gnyis nas bzung ste slob ma'i lag par gtad par bsam (773) la
Imagine that the guru visualized as this protector takes [the implements] from the two hands of the Yakṣa mother and places them in the disciples’ hands. {774}

gtor ma gnyis slob ma'i lag tu gtad la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan dang / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'dis sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du phyi bzhin tu rgyug cig / 'gal rkyen thams cad sol cig / phrin las thams cad sgrubs shig / ces bka' bsgo lan gsum byas la

Place two tormas in the disciples’ hands and repeat the exhortation three times: Without contradicting the gurus’ names and Awareness Protector’s commands and vows, accompany these vajra disciples until their awakening! Dispel all adverse conditions! Accomplish all awakened activities!
bkra shis brjod/ gtong rag gi mchod bstod sogs spyi dang 'dra/
Recite verses of auspiciousness. Perform the usual offerings and praises in gratitude.

de ltar rjes gnang 'di gsum po mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du chig brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa dang / rjes gnang gi yi ge tho tsam zhig las gsal po mi bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis bla ma mgon po la gsol ba btab ste rang gi bla mas ji ltar gnang ba dang gzhan nas kyang cung zad kha bskangs te gsal por bkod pa la bla ma mgon pos bzod ngar mdzod cig / sarba dA mang+ga laM// //

These three authorizations [of awakened body, speech, and mind] exist only as word lineages from Omniscient Khedrup to my own root guru. Due to the fact that the words of the authorization have not remained very clear other than in a few places, I supplicated the Guru-Protector and wrote this based on what my guru gave me, adding just a little from others, in order to arrange a clear version. Guru-Protector, please forbear. sarvadā maṅgalaṃ
